title: A Time-Encoded Analog Photonic Interposer for Energy-EfficientIntegration of Analog Vision Sensors and Analog Accelerators
summary: This work introduces a time-encoded analog photonic interposer that enables long-distance, high-fidelity transport of analog signals between spatially separated chiplets. Unlike prior silicon-photonic links limited to digital data, the interposer preserves analog information by converting amplitudes into timing intervals using an analog-to-time converter (ATC), transmitting them over a wavelength-division-multiplexed photonic link, and reconstructing values at the receiver without an explicit high-precision ADC/DAC data-converter pipeline. The link instead embeds an implicit 6-bit time-domain quantization and uses a single wavelength per processing element independent of bit precision. Evaluated in a fully analog vision pipeline with an in-pixel computing (IPC) sensor, it achieves a 2.04x energy--delay product (EDP) improvement over an 8-bit digital electrical baseline on the 560x560 Visual Wake Words dataset, with the advantage widening with link length even against a precision-matched 6-bit baseline. The pipeline holds 89.87% and 86.15% accuracy on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2 for VWW and generalizes across CIFAR-10 and ModelNet40 within 2% of the digital baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时间编码的模拟光子中介层（interposer），通过模拟-时间转换器（ATC）将模拟信号编码为时间间隔，经波分复用光子链路传输并在接收端重建，无需显式高精度ADC/DAC，实现跨芯片长距离高保真模拟信号传输。在视觉唤醒词（VWW）数据集上相比8位数字电学基线实现2.04倍能量-延迟积（EDP）改善，并在多个模型和数据集上保持与数字基线接近的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有硅光子链路仅支持数字数据传输，而模拟信号的远程传输需要在发送端进行高精度ADC并在接收端进行DAC，引入巨大的功耗和延迟开销。随着芯片间距离增加，模拟计算范式（如像素内计算传感器）面临跨芯片传输模拟信号的挑战，需要一种能够保持模拟信息完整性的高效光子互连方案。
AI.method: 提出时间编码的模拟光子中介层架构：(1) 使用模拟-时间转换器（ATC）将模拟幅度转换为时间间隔；(2) 通过波分复用（WDM）光子链路传输时间编码信号；(3) 在接收端无显式高精度ADC/DAC数据转换流水线情况下重建原始值；(4) 链路内嵌隐式6位时域量化，每个处理元件使用单一波长，与位精度无关。
AI.result: 在560x560视觉唤醒词（VWW）数据集上，配合像素内计算（IPC）传感器的全模拟视觉流水线中，相比8位数字电学基线实现2.04倍能量-延迟积（EDP）改善；即使与精度匹配的6位基线相比，优势随链路长度拉大。在ResNet18和MobileNetV2上分别保持89.87%和86.15%的VWW精度，并在CIFAR-10和ModelNet40上泛化精度与数字基线差距在2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 时间编码模拟光子中介层证明了跨芯片模拟信号传输的可行性，避免了高精度ADC/DAC的功耗和延迟开销，同时通过时域量化实现精度可控的传输。该方案在能耗和延迟上显著优于数字基线，且精度损失极小，为大规模异构芯片间模拟计算互连提供了新的架构方向。

title: A single-precision floating-point systolic Givens-QRD Triangular Solver for MVDR Beamforming
summary: Computation of adaptive beamforming weights in Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) processing is a latency-critical operation that poses significant challenges for real-time hardware implementation. This paper presents an FPGA implementation of a systolic Givens-rotation QR decomposition pipeline for MVDR beamforming on a simulated 32-element ultrasound transducer array, using single-precision floating-point arithmetic. The design is deployed on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA at 100 MHz with three parallel kernel instances operating concurrently, achieving a measured throughput of 31,123 weight vectors/s at 90.9% parallel efficiency relative to the measured single-instance rate. At an estimated 2.451 W of programmable-logic power, and 5.286 W including the processing system, this corresponds to 12,698 and 5,888 weight vectors/s/W, respectively. Under a matched three-way dispatch, a 24-core Intel Xeon Gold 5220R at 2.20 GHz achieves 465,699 weight vectors/s at a measured 83.08 W package power, corresponding to 5,606 weight vectors/s/W. The FPGA therefore attains 2.3x the power-normalised throughput of the processor on a programmable-logic basis and 1.05x on a total on-chip basis. In contrast, the processor retains a raw throughput advantage of approximately 15x at this operating point. Numerical precision is validated against MATLAB float32 reference outputs from a Field II cyst phantom simulation, achieving a 100% pass rate with a root mean square error of 5.10x10^-7, confirming near-theoretical finite-precision behaviour without systematic bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了用于MVDR波束成形的FPGA脉动Givens旋转QR分解流水线设计，部署在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA上，三个并行内核实例实现31,123权重向量/s的吞吐量，90.9%并行效率，功率归一化吞吐量分别是处理器的2.3倍（PL）和1.05倍（整体），但处理器在原始吞吐量上约15倍优势；以100%通过率、RMS误差5.10x10^-7验证了数值精度。
AI.motivation: MVDR自适应波束成形权重计算是延迟关键操作，实时硬件实现面临重大挑战，需要高效的FPGA加速方案。
AI.method: 在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA上以100 MHz部署三个并行Givens旋转QR分解脉动阵列内核实例，采用单精度浮点运算，处理模拟32阵元超声换能器阵列。
AI.result: FPGA实现31,123权重向量/s吞吐量，90.9%并行效率；PL功耗2.451W、含PS总功耗5.286W，对应12,698和5,888权重向量/s/W；对比24核Xeon Gold 5220R（465,699向量/s @ 83.08W，5,606向量/s/W），FPGA功率归一化吞吐量为处理器的2.3x（PL）和1.05x（总），但原始吞吐量约为处理器的1/15；数值精度100%通过，RMS误差5.10x10^-7。
AI.conclusion: FPGA方案在功率效率上优于CPU（PL上2.3x），原始吞吐能力不及CPU但仍具实用价值，且numerical精度接近理论有限精度极限，适用于对功耗敏感的实时MVDR波束成形场景。

title: LevelSyn: Physical-Aware Logic Synthesis via Level-Asynchronous Graph Neural Networks
summary: As integrated circuit technology scales into the nanometer regime, the traditional disconnect between logic synthesis and physical design has led to significant PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) degradation and prolonged design closure cycles. Traditional logic synthesis relies on non-physical Wire Load Models (WLMs), while recent spectral-based placement predictors often neglect the inherent hierarchical logic depth and signal flow of netlists, which leads to low-fidelity spatial estimations. To bridge this gap, we propose LevelSyn, a novel physical-aware logic synthesis framework that integrates hierarchical representation learning with a wirelength-driven optimization engine. At its core, LevelSyn leverages a level-asynchronous Graph Neural Network (GNN) to predict high-fidelity gate coordinates by capturing the structural and directional semantics of And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs). To handle industrial-scale designs, a level-aligned subgraph partitioning strategy is introduced to eliminate memory bottlenecks while preserving local logical dependencies. These spatial insights are seamlessly integrated into a newly developed physical-informed synthesis engine within the Berkeley ABC framework. Experimental results on the EPFL benchmark suite demonstrate that LevelSyn significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, achieving an average power reduction of 6.89\% and a timing delay improvement of 27.48\%. Furthermore, post-place-and-route validation shows a 99.59\% reduction in design rule check (DRC) violations, highlighting its effectiveness in accelerating design convergence.

AI.tldr: LevelSyn是一个物理感知的逻辑综合框架，通过层次感知图神经网络和线长驱动的优化引擎来弥合逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟，在EPFL基准上实现平均功耗降低6.89%、时序延迟改善27.48%以及DRC违规减少99.59%。
AI.motivation: 随着集成电路进入纳米尺度，传统逻辑综合与物理设计之间的脱节导致显著的PPA退化和漫长的设计收敛周期。传统逻辑综合依赖非物理的线负载模型（WLM），而现有的基于谱方法的布局预测器忽略了网表的层次逻辑深度和信号流向，导致空间估计保真度低，难以在综合阶段准确预测物理布局效果。
AI.method: LevelSyn提出一个集成的物理感知逻辑综合框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 层次级异步图神经网络（level-asynchronous GNN），通过捕捉And-Inverter Graph（AIG）的结构和方向语义来预测高保真门级坐标；(2) 针对工业规模设计，提出层级对齐的子图划分策略以消除内存瓶颈同时保留局部逻辑依赖。这些空间预测被无缝集成到基于Berkeley ABC框架新开发的物理感知综合引擎中，实现线长驱动的优化。
AI.result: 在EPFL基准测试集上，LevelSyn相比最先进方法在功耗上平均降低6.89%，时序延迟改善27.48%。后布局布线验证显示DRC违规减少99.59%，显著加速了设计收敛过程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将层次表示学习与线长驱动的优化引擎相结合，LevelSyn成功弥合了逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟，验证了物理感知逻辑综合在实现高质量PPA结果和加速设计收敛方面的有效性。

title: Confidence-Gated Admission for Hardware Prefetching: When the Gate Matters More Than the Predictor
summary: Learned cache prefetchers are typically evaluated against classical predictors that always issue requests, confounding the prediction model with the admission policy. We disentangle these variables with matched controls: the same admission gate is applied to both a 257-parameter online MLP and a classical stride predictor. The neural advantage vanishes; the MLP is indistinguishable from gated stride on random traffic and slower on most regular streams. The gate itself is architecturally useful independent of the predictor: on twenty SPEC CPU2017 programs in native ChampSim, it removes 35% of prefetches and improves accuracy from 11% to 15%, but DRAM reads change by only 0.07% demonstrating that proxy metrics do not predict endpoint behavior. We prove gate-closed execution reproduces the no-prefetch baseline exactly. The gate matters more than the predictor, and better proxies do not imply better endpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入匹配对照（同一准入门控应用于神经网络预取器和经典步长预取器）来解耦预取预测模型与准入策略，发现神经网络的优势消失：MLP与门控步长预取器在随机流量上无法区分，且在多数规则流上更慢。准入门控本身对架构有独立价值，但代理指标不一定预测端到端行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习式缓存预取器评估通常与经典预测器进行对比，但经典预测器总是发出请求，这混淆了预测模型与准入策略的贡献。作者希望解耦这两个变量，进行公平对比，并探究神经网络预测器相较于经典方法的真实优势是否存在。
AI.method: 作者将同一准入门控（admission gate）同时应用于两个预测器：一个257参数的在线MLP和一个经典步长（stride）预测器，以此构建匹配对照实验。使用随机流量和规则流等多种负载测试两者性能；并在native ChampSim环境中对20个SPEC CPU2017程序进行基准测试，同时证明门控关闭执行可以精确复现无预取基线。
AI.result: 神经网络的相对优势消失：MLP与门控步长预取器在随机流量上无法区分，在多数规则流上反而更慢。准入门控本身在架构上有用：在20个SPEC CPU2017程序上消除了35%的预取，将准确率从11%提升到15%，但DRAM读次数仅变化0.07%，表明代理指标不能预测端到端行为。
AI.conclusion: 在预取器中，准入门控的作用比预测模型本身更重要；代理指标的改善并不意味着端到端性能的改善。评估预取器时必须将预测模型与准入策略分离，并关注端点指标（如DRAM读次数）而非仅看预取准确率等代理指标。

title: The Illusion of Independent Quorums: Epistemic Fault Domains and Correlated Cognitive Failures in Agentic Quorums
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code and frozen benchmark artifact available at https://github.com/openkedge/efd
summary: Multi-agent quorums are widely used to authorize high-stakes infrastructure and policy mutations, yet distinct reviewers often share upstream telemetry, documents, or tool backends. When upstream inputs fail, multiple votes collapse onto a single corrupted cause: replication does not imply epistemic redundancy. We introduce Epistemic Fault Domains (EFDs) and the Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E, which quantifies the minimum number of modeled root faults whose exposure covers an authorizing coalition relative to an explicit Epistemic Fault Basis. Under closed causal accounting, conservative exposure, and authorization alignment, κ_E lower-bounds the number of roots required for semantic compromise (κ_S). We prove that arbitrarily large quorums can retain κ_E=1, that recognizing shared ancestry never increases credited resilience, and that adding voters at a fixed threshold cannot increase the cut under compatible exposure extensions. Finally, we design the Dependency-Aware Quorum Controller (DAQC) to enforce structural cuts at runtime admission, evaluate its mechanics via analytical derivations and simulations, and provide a frozen 120-task external benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量化仲裁（quorum）系统语义冗余不足的方法，解决"复制不等于认知冗余"的问题——多个审阅者共享上游数据源时，单点故障会同时破坏多个投票。
AI.motivation: 多智能体仲裁被广泛用于授权高风险基础设施和策略变更，但不同审阅者往往共享上游遥测、文档或工具后端。当上游输入失败时，多个投票会同时塌缩到单一故障源上，导致复制（replication）并不带来真正的认知冗余（epistemic redundancy）。论文旨在解决这一系统性安全漏洞。
AI.method: 论文引入"认知故障域"（EFDs）和"结构化认知切割"κ_E，量化相对于显式"认知故障基"（Epistemic Fault Basis）覆盖授权联盟所需的最小根故障数。证明了在封闭因果核算、保守暴露和授权对齐条件下，κ_E是语义攻陷所需根故障数κ_S的下界。此外设计了依赖感知仲裁控制器（DAQC）在运行时准入阶段强制实施结构化切割。
AI.result: 论文证明了三个关键结论：（1）任意大规模仲裁可以保持κ_E=1（即扩大规模并不自动增加认知韧性）；（2）识别共享祖先不会增加已授信的韧性；（3）在兼容暴露扩展下，固定阈值增加投票者不能增加切割值。同时通过解析推导和仿真验证了DAQC的机制，并提供了包含120个任务的冻结外部基准测试套件。
AI.conclusion: 大规模仲裁本身不足以抵御依赖相关故障。必须显式建模并控制审阅者的认知故障域，引入结构化认知切割作为认证纪律，并通过DAQC在运行时强制执行，才能为高风险授权提供真正的语义韧性保障。

title: Structure and Implementation of New Practical English Textbooks Driven by Artificial Intelligence
summary: Artificial intelligence is changing the form of applied English materials from fixed paper sequences to adaptive learning systems that can diagnose learners, recommend tasks, and provide formative feedback. This paper studies the structure and application of a new practical English textbook driven by artificial intelligence. A five-layer architecture is proposed: knowledge mapping, learner profiling, task generation, feedback orchestration, and teacher-side governance. A prototype was tested on 186 non-English-major undergraduates for eight weeks of teaching. Compared with a static digital textbook, the proposed system increased the unit completion accuracy from 72.4% to 84.9%, raised the average score for speaking tasks by 10.8 points, and reduced the teacher's correction time by 31.6%. Therefore, an AI-driven textbook can maintain the stability of the curriculum while providing personalised learning paths, rich practice materials and traceable classroom data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种由人工智能驱动的实用英语教材系统，提出五层架构（知识图谱、学习者画像、任务生成、反馈编排和教师侧治理），通过186名非英语专业本科生的八周教学实验验证，相比静态数字教材将单元完成准确率从72.4%提升至84.9%，口语任务平均分提高10.8分，教师批改时间减少31.6%。
AI.motivation: 传统纸质教材为固定线性序列，无法满足个性化学习需求。人工智能为教材形态转变提供了可能，使其从固定纸质序列转变为能诊断学习者、推荐任务并提供形成性反馈的适应性学习系统，但目前对AI驱动的应用英语教材的结构与应用尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 提出一种五层架构的AI驱动英语教材系统：知识图谱层、学习者画像层、任务生成层、反馈编排层和教师侧治理层。构建原型系统，并在186名非英语专业本科生中进行为期八周的教学实验，与静态数字教材进行对照比较。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：该系统将单元完成准确率从72.4%提升至84.9%，口语任务平均分提高了10.8分，教师批改时间减少了31.6%。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的教材在保持课程稳定性的同时，能够提供个性化学习路径、丰富的练习材料和可追溯的课堂数据，兼顾了教学标准化与个性化需求的平衡。

title: Seeing Less Is Not Seeing Safely: Privacy Leakage from Task-Scoped Robot Perception Exports
summary: Domestic robots rely on rich perception to operate in private homes, but privacy risk persists even when raw sensor data remain local. Structured representations exported to downstream planners, cloud services, logs, or learning pipelines can still reveal household information through semantics, geometry, spatial structure, and task targets. We introduce Task-Functional Perception Distillation (TFPD), a task-scoped representation-export framework that keeps rich perception local and profiles downstream exports according to task utility, direct exposure, and multiple residual inference risks. Using 120 AI2-THOR scenes with scene-disjoint train/validation/test splits, frozen attacker selection, and representation-aware held-out attacks, we evaluate navigation, collision checking, and object-goal execution. Three navigation exports achieve identical success (1.000) and mean path ratio (0.898), yet representation-level linkability ranges from 0.532 to 0.970. Replacing an explicit target label with a target region reduces target-category macro-F1 from 1.000 to 0.077 while preserving success at 0.995, while geometric coarsening reduces object-category macro-F1 from 0.704 to 0.556 at a measurable collision-utility cost. A ProcTHOR replication preserves the navigation task-equivalence/privacy-inequivalence finding while changing the relative ordering of normalized and topological exports. These results show that neither field removal nor stronger abstraction induces a universal privacy ordering and motivate task-specific, multi-risk evaluation of the complete public representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务功能感知蒸馏(TFPD)框架,用于在保持丰富感知本地化的同时,对下游导出的结构化表示进行任务效用与多重重置推理风险评估。在AI2-THOR和ProcTHOR上的实验表明,任务等价与隐私不等价现象普遍存在,但没有任何单一的字段删除或抽象策略能产生通用的隐私排序。
AI.motivation: 家庭机器人依靠丰富感知运行,但即使原始传感器数据保留在本地,导出的结构化表示(如语义、几何、空间结构和任务目标)仍可能通过下游规划器、云服务、日志或学习管道泄露家庭信息。现有方法缺乏对导出表示的任务效用与隐私风险之间的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出TFPD框架,采用任务范围化表示导出方法:保持丰富感知本地化,并根据任务效用、直接暴露和多种残余推理风险对下游导出进行画像。使用120个AI2-THOR场景,以场景分离的训练/验证/测试划分、冻结的攻击者选择以及表示感知的保持外攻击进行评估,涵盖导航、碰撞检测和物体目标执行任务。
AI.result: 三种导航导出在成功率(1.000)和平均路径比(0.898)上完全相同,但表示级可链接性范围为0.532至0.970。用目标区域替代显式目标标签可将目标类别macro-F1从1.000降至0.077,同时保持成功率0.995;几何粗化将物体类别macro-F1从0.704降至0.556,但带来可测量的碰撞效用代价。ProcTHOR复制实验保留了导航任务等价/隐私不等价的发现,但改变了归一化与拓扑导出的相对排序。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明,字段删除或更强的抽象策略都不会产生通用的隐私排序,这推动了对完整公开表示进行任务特定、多风险评估的必要性。

title: Advances in Machine Learning for Directed Evolution: A Five-Year Retrospective
summary: The last five-plus years have seen many protein engineering disciplines transformed by advances in machine learning (ML), but the same cannot be said for directed evolution. Reflecting on a previously co-authored perspective, I discuss why I believe this to be the case, arguing that a disconnect between the goals of machine-learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) researchers--"identify an optimal protein"--and the goals of directed evolution more broadly--"identify a sufficient protein given time and resource constraints"--is a principal culprit. As an example, I highlight how nearly all current MLDE methods neglect to account for the cost of DNA synthesis, resulting in strategies that have limited practical applicability regardless of the underlying models' capabilities. I close by discussing recent works that are exceptions to this overarching trend, and emphasize that the last five years of efforts in ML-assisted protein engineering and the prescribed reframe of MLDE objectives need not be mutually exclusive.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇观点性文章，反思了过去五年机器学习辅助定向进化（MLDE）领域的现状，指出其与定向演化更广泛目标之间的脱节：MLDE研究者追求"找到最优蛋白质"，而定向进化的实际目标是在时间和资源约束下找到"足够好的蛋白质"。
AI.motivation: 作者反思为何过去五年机器学习已深刻变革许多蛋白质工程领域，但定向进化却未能同样受益，认为二者的核心目标错位是主要原因。
AI.method: 作者基于前期合作撰写的观点文章进行批判性反思，以DNA合成成本为例，论证当前大多数MLDE方法忽视实验成本约束、缺乏实际适用性的问题，并通过讨论近期例外工作来阐述新的目标框架。
AI.result: 作者指出几乎所有现有MLDE方法都忽视了DNA合成成本这一关键实践约束，导致即使底层模型性能优异，其策略也难以落地应用；同时强调近年已有部分工作正在打破这一趋势。
AI.conclusion: ML-assisted蛋白质工程领域过去五年的成果与重新定义MLDE目标（即从"寻找最优"转向"在资源约束下寻找足够好"）并非互斥，二者可以兼容并进。

title: SurfSpec: Enhancing Off-Target-Agnostic Specificity by Bounding Pocket-Ligand Geometric Mismatch
summary: Lead optimization in structure-based drug design aims to improve target binding while avoiding unintended interactions with off-target pockets. However, existing affinity-driven methods do not explicitly control specificity, whereas current specificity-aware approaches commonly require prior knowledge of off-target structures. We address off-target-agnostic specificity-aware lead optimization by analyzing the geometric mismatch between a ligand and the target pocket. We provide a conservative specificity lower bound for geometrically separated off-targets without requiring access to off-target structures. By metricizing pocket--ligand mismatch, the triangle inequality shows that reducing target--ligand mismatch improves a conservative lower bound on mismatch to a separated off-target class, which can be translated into a specificity lower bound through an empirical geometry--affinity calibration. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce SurfSpec, an off-target-agnostic lead optimization framework that iteratively grows ligands toward under-occupied regions of the target pocket surface. SurfSpec alternates between linker generation toward selected target-surface patches, which provides geometric pseudo-labels, and refinement under a pocket-conditioned ligand prior, which restores these pseudo-labels into valid ligands. On the CrossDocked2020 test set, SurfSpec reduces geometric mismatch and outperforms evaluated off-target-agnostic lead optimization baselines in empirical specificity, while maintaining competitive target-affinity improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurfSpec，一个无需离靶结构的特异性感知先导物优化框架。通过三角不等式分析配体-靶点口袋的几何失配，证明减小靶点-配体失配能保守地提高对分离离靶类别的失配下界，从而转化为特异性下界。SurfSpec通过向靶点口袋表面欠占据区域迭代生长配体，结合链接子生成与配体先验精炼，在CrossDocked2020上降低了几何失配并提升了经验特异性，同时保持竞争力靶点亲和力改进。
AI.motivation: 现有基于亲和力的先导物优化方法无法显式控制选择性/特异性，而当前特异性感知方法通常需要预先知道离靶口袋的结构。作者希望解决无需离靶信息的特异性感知先导优化问题。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：将口袋-配体失配度量化，利用三角不等式证明减少靶点-配体失配可提高对几何分离离靶类别的保守失配下界，并通过经验几何-亲和校准将其转为特异性下界。2) SurfSpec框架：迭代向靶点口袋表面欠占据区域生长配体，交替进行(a)对选定靶点表面patch的链接子生成（提供几何伪标签）和(b)在口袋条件配体先验下精炼，将伪标签恢复为有效配体。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020测试集上，SurfSpec降低了几何失配，在经验特异性上优于所有评估的无需离靶的先导优化基线，同时保持了竞争的靶点亲和力改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何分析可以从理论上保证无需离靶结构的保守特异性下界，SurfSpec框架验证了这种"以几何促特异性"的策略在先导优化中的有效性。

title: High-Order Triadic Functional Connectivity in the Brain and Beyond
summary: Here, we report high-order functional network connectivity as a promising way for studying the brain connectome. Traditional functional connectivity approaches capture only pairwise relationships between brain regions, overlooking complex multivariate dependencies that underlie cognition and behavior. First, we demonstrated that high-order interactions capture more information and can distinguish between resting-state and task-state brain activity. Second, we introduce a matrix-based entropy-functional method for estimating triadic interactions, which are statistical dependencies among triplets of brain regions, and apply it to large-scale functional brain networks. The resulting triadic networks revealed distinct community patterns that complement those observed in traditional pairwise functional connectivity analyses and simultaneously capture additional connection information. Despite the potential combinatorial explosion of triadic configurations, the networks exhibited constrained and hierarchical structures that allowed computation and interpretation. These findings position triadic connectivity as a promising next-step functional connectivity framework for probing brain network organization and high-order neural interactions, while also highlighting key biological and technical challenges that require careful consideration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将高阶功能网络连接性（尤其是三阶/三元交互）作为研究大脑连接组的新框架，通过矩阵熵函数方法估计脑区三元组之间的统计依赖关系，构建三阶网络，在补充传统两两功能连接的基础上揭示独特的社区结构。
AI.motivation: 传统功能连接方法仅捕捉脑区之间的两两（成对）关系，忽略了支撑认知和行为背后复杂的多变量依赖。研究者希望通过探索高阶交互（如三阶交互）来获取传统方法遗漏的信息，更全面地理解大脑连接组及其组织方式。
AI.method: 首先证明高阶交互能捕获更多信息并能区分静息态与任务态脑活动；随后引入一种基于矩阵的熵-函数方法（matrix-based entropy-functional method）来估计三元交互，即三个脑区之间的统计依赖，并将该方法应用于大规模功能脑网络，构建三阶连接网络。
AI.result: 构建的三阶网络揭示了与传统两两功能连接分析互补的独特社区模式，并同时捕获额外的连接信息。尽管三元配置存在潜在的组合爆炸问题，但网络表现出受约束的、层级化的结构，使得计算和解释成为可能。
AI.conclusion: 三阶连接性可作为功能连接框架的有前景的下一步发展方向，用于探测脑网络组织和高阶神经交互。同时，研究也指出需仔细考虑的关键生物学与技术挑战。

title: IDSPACE: A Novel Document Generator for Reliable Evaluation of Digital Identity Verification Systems [Extended Technical Report]
summary: As services move online, trust institutions such as banks, lenders, and governments must verify the identity of remote users. Fraud detection tools are widely available, but evaluating and fine-tuning them remains difficult because identity documents are sensitive and therefore scarce. Synthetic data generation offers a path forward, and demand is clear: our prior work in this area has been downloaded over $11{,}000$ times (aggregated from eight parts). We introduce IDSpace, extending this line of research in three directions. First, we propose model-guided Bayesian optimization, which tunes generation parameters to maximize both visual similarity and prediction consistency with target-domain models given only a few samples from a target domain. Second, we decouple user-specified metadata (demographics, fraud patterns, capture device) from automatically tuned control parameters (font styles, noise levels, image quality), allowing users to configure evaluations without low-level expertise. Third, we expand beyond template images to support scanned and mobile-captured documents. Experiments show IDSpace improves evaluation consistency by $15-45\%$ over baselines including CycleGAN, diffusion inpainting, and non-guided optimization, using only a few real samples, while improving training accuracy by up to $9\%$ and SSIM similarity with the target domain by $10\%$. We also released a new dataset consisting of $359{,}240$ high-quality synthetic documents across ten European ID types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDSpace，一种面向合成身份文档生成的系统，通过模型引导的贝叶斯优化、元数据与控制参数解耦以及支持扫描/手机拍摄文档三大扩展，在仅有少量真实样本条件下显著提升评估一致性和训练准确率，并发布了包含359,240张合成文档的新数据集。
AI.motivation: 服务线上化后，银行、贷方和政府等信任机构需要远程验证用户身份。伪造检测工具虽广泛可用，但身份文档属于敏感数据，稀缺性使得评估和调优这些工具变得困难。合成数据生成为此提供了出路，且需求明确（先前工作下载量超过11,000次），因此亟需更先进的合成数据生成方案。
AI.method: IDSpace在三个方向上进行扩展：(1) 模型引导的贝叶斯优化，在仅有少量目标域样本的情况下，调优生成参数以同时最大化视觉相似性和与目标域模型的预测一致性；(2) 解耦用户指定的元数据（人口统计、欺诈模式、采集设备）与自动调优的控制参数（字体样式、噪声水平、图像质量），使用户无需底层专业知识即可配置评估；(3) 从模板图像扩展到扫描和手机拍摄文档的支持。
AI.result: 实验表明，IDSpace相比基线方法（包括CycleGAN、扩散修复和非引导优化）在仅使用少量真实样本的情况下，评估一致性提升15-45%，训练准确率最高提升9%，与目标域的SSIM相似度提升10%。此外，发布了包含359,240张高质量合成文档的新数据集，涵盖十种欧洲身份证件类型。
AI.conclusion: IDSpace通过模型引导优化、参数解耦和多采集场景支持，有效解决了合成身份文档生成中评估一致性和用户可控性的关键问题，为伪造检测工具的评估与调优提供了更可靠的合成数据基础设施。

title: A Public-Key-Dependent Adversarial-Deletion Ceiling for Fixed-Alphabet Multi-Bit Pseudorandom Codes
summary:
A pseudorandom code (PRC) is a keyed error-correcting code whose codewords are computationally indistinguishable from uniform strings. We study public-key PRCs over fixed alphabets against adversarial deletions, where the deletion channel may both depend on the public encoding key and the transmitted codeword.
  Let $γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$ denote the asymptotic normalised longest-common-subsequence length of two independent uniform $q$-ary strings. We prove that for every fixed $q\ge2$ no multi-message public-key PRC with a single-output decoder is robust against all such $δ$-deletion channels for any $δ>1-γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$. For $q=2$, the current rigorous bound $γ_2\ge0.792665992$ rules out every constant $δ>0.207334008$. The proof uses pseudorandomness only to transfer an LCS event from uniform strings to independently sampled codewords and therefore also the resulting collision argument is information-theoretic and requires no secret key. We also extend the argument to list decoding: for every fixed constant $L$, provided the message space contains at least $L+1$ messages, no such PRC with output lists of size at most $L$ is robust for $δ>1-γ_2^{(L+1)}$. Since $γ_2^{(m)}=1/2+Θ(1/\sqrt m)$, these thresholds approach $1/2$. Our bounds are specific to public-key-dependent adversarial channels and do not apply to oblivious edit channels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公钥伪随机码（PRC）在对抗性删除信道下的鲁棒性边界。证明对于固定字母表q≥2，任何多消息公钥PRC（单输出解码器）在删除率δ>1-γ_q^LCS时都不具备鲁棒性；扩展到列表解码时，阈值趋近于1/2。这些下界仅适用于公钥依赖的对抗信道，不适用于 oblivious 编辑信道。
AI.motivation: 伪随机码（PRC）是一种键控纠错码，其码字与均匀随机字符串在计算上不可区分。此前关于PRC对抗删除信道的鲁棒性研究尚未给出精确的边界，特别是在公钥依赖的对抗性删除信道（信道可依赖公钥和发送的码字）下，需要明确哪些删除率阈值下PRC不可能保持鲁棒性。
AI.method: 证明的核心是利用最长公共子序列（LCS）的渐近规范化长度γ_q^LCS作为关键阈值。证明将伪随机性仅用于将LCS事件从均匀随机字符串转移到独立采样的码字上，随后通过信息论的碰撞论证（不需要密钥）得出结论。对二值情形q=2，使用已知下界γ_2≥0.792665992来排除所有δ>0.207334008的常数删除率。此外将论证推广到列表解码场景，考虑消息空间包含至少L+1条消息、输出列表大小不超过L的情况，利用γ_2^(m)=1/2+Θ(1/√m)的渐近性质推导阈值趋近于1/2。
AI.result: 对于每个固定q≥2，不存在任何在多消息设置下具有单输出解码器的公钥PRC能对所有δ>1-γ_q^LCS的删除信道保持鲁棒。对q=2，现有严格下界排除了δ>0.207334008的所有常数删除率。针对列表解码，当消息空间至少包含L+1条消息且输出列表大小不超过L时，PRC在δ>1-γ_2^(L+1)时也不鲁棒，且该阈值随L增大趋近于1/2。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了公钥PRC在公钥依赖的对抗性删除信道下的不可能性边界，将删除率阈值与LCS的渐近规范化长度联系起来。这些下界是信息论层面的，不依赖密钥。同时强调这些界限是专门针对公钥依赖的对抗性信道，不适用于 oblivious（与密钥和码字无关的）编辑信道。

title: Where Does Harness-Optimization Value Live? Localized Gains and the Budget-Splitting Trap in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
summary:
A growing body of work improves frozen large language models (LLMs) as agents by evolving their harness: the textual scaffolding around the model, including persona, strategy, format rules, and control heuristics. Existing reflective prompt-evolution methods usually optimize this harness as one flat string. We instead ask where the optimization value actually resides. We introduce HARNESSEVO, which decomposes the harness into four separately evolvable slots: role, task-strategy, tool/format-rules, and reflection/control. Using the same reflective optimizer under an iso-budget setting, we pair this decomposition with leave-one-in and leave-one-out attribution to measure the contribution of each slot.
  On ALFWorld with a frozen 7B backbone, HARNESSEVO does not significantly improve the overall binary success rate over either the stock harness or flat-string evolution: 0.657 versus 0.642 and 0.642, respectively. However, the slot-level analysis reveals that nearly all useful optimization value is localized in the reflection/control slot, which achieves a leave-one-in gain of +0.119. The other slots are individually null. We further show that uniform budget splitting is harmful: allocating 64 rollouts across four slots leaves only 16 per slot, below the optimizer's effective search floor, causing every slot to freeze at its empty seed. Concentrating the budget on the high-credit control slot recovers the lost gain, reaching 0.761 with half the split budget.
  The effect is task-contingent. On WebShop, all slots freeze empty and all methods tie, indicating a genuine absence of recurrent, verbalizable control failures rather than budget starvation. Overall, our results suggest that harness value is localized, uniform budget splitting can be actively harmful, and credit assignment should precede structured agent-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HARNESSEVO，将LLM智能体的文本提示框架（harness）分解为四个可独立进化的槽位（角色、任务策略、工具/格式规则、反思/控制），并通过leave-one-in/leave-one-out归因分析发现：几乎所有优化价值都集中在反思/控制槽位；均匀分配预算会产生危害（低于搜索有效下限导致冻结），集中预算则能恢复损失并提升性能；且该效应具有任务依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反思的提示进化方法通常将harness作为一个扁平字符串整体优化，但未能回答一个关键问题：优化的价值实际上分布在哪里？作者希望打破扁平化优化的黑箱，识别文本框架中不同组成部分的相对贡献，以实现更高效的信用分配和预算利用。
AI.method: 1) 将harness分解为四个独立可进化的槽位：角色（role）、任务策略（task-strategy）、工具/格式规则（tool/format-rules）、反思/控制（reflection/control）；2) 在iso-budget设置下使用相同的反思优化器；3) 采用leave-one-in和leave-one-out归因方法量化每个槽位的贡献；4) 在ALFWorld（冻结7B主干）和WebShop上进行验证。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上，HARNESSEVO整体二元成功率(0.657)相对stock harness(0.642)和扁平字符串进化(0.642)无显著提升；但槽位分析显示反思/控制槽位贡献了几乎所有价值（leave-one-in增益+0.119），其他槽位均无效。均匀分配预算有害（4槽×16次rollout低于搜索有效下限导致冻结）；集中预算到高信用控制槽位用一半预算达到0.761。在WebShop上所有槽位冻结且方法持平，表明的是真实缺乏可言语化的循环控制失败而非预算不足。
AI.conclusion: HARNESSEVO揭示了智能体提示框架(value)的优化价值具有高度局部性而非均匀分布；均匀预算切分可能产生积极危害；在结构化智能体进化之前应先进行信用分配。结果表明改进此类系统的关键不在于盲目增加预算或进化方差，而在于识别并优先优化高贡献的特定槽位。

title: The Geometry of Ignorance: LLMs Know When to Temper Bayesian Priors
summary: What does a language model predict when it has few clues? The answer lurks in its unembedding geometry: a single direction of the unembedding matrix encodes the unigram distribution of the training corpus, which serves as the Bayesian prior the model falls back on when uncertain. This structure --- which we term the \emph{direction of ignorance} --- appears in all four model families examined (\texttt{Llama}, \texttt{Qwen}, \texttt{Gemma}, and \texttt{Pythia}), ranging from 0.4B to 405B parameters. Projecting the final prediction state onto this direction yields a per-token \emph{prior loading factor} $λ$, which, empirically, declines steadily as the context becomes more informative. Formally, the same projection decomposes the prediction state into two orthogonal vectors that correspond exactly to the two factors of a tempered Bayesian update: a unigram prior raised to the exponent $λ$ and a context-driven likelihood. This geometric-probabilistic interpretation calibrates $λ$, making it meaningfully comparable across model sizes and families, with larger models generally exhibiting lower prior reliance in the high-context limit. Finally, we show that the direction of ignorance is causally active: raising or lowering $λ$ at the final prediction state steers the prediction toward or away from the unigram prior in KL divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文发现语言模型"不确定时的猜测方向"由其解嵌入矩阵中的单一方向编码，该方向对应训练语料的unigram分布，作为贝叶斯先验。将预测状态投影至此方向得到先验加载因子λ，λ随上下文信息量递减，且将预测状态分解为与tempered贝叶斯更新的两个因子——带指数λ的unigram先验和上下文驱动的似然——精确对应。λ在模型规模与家族间可比，大规模模型在高上下文场景下对先验依赖更低。该方向因果有效，调节λ可朝/背离unigram先验方向引导预测（以KL散度度量）。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型在信息不足时的预测行为是解析其内部机制的关键。作者旨在揭示模型在不确定情况下回退到何种"默认"猜测，以及这一回退过程的几何与概率本质，从而深化对语言模型预测机制的理论理解。
AI.method: 作者在四种模型家族（Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Pythia，参数量0.4B至405B）中系统地检查了解嵌入矩阵的结构，识别出编码unigram分布的先验方向（称为"ignorance direction"）。通过将最终预测状态投影到该方向，定义先验加载因子λ，并提出该投影将状态分解为tempered贝叶斯更新对应的两个正交向量（unigram先验的λ次幂与上下文似然）。最后通过因果干预实验验证该方向的有效性。
AI.result: 该"ignorance direction"在全部四种模型家族、0.4B至405B范围内均存在。投影所得的λ随上下文信息量增加而稳定下降；形式化推导表明预测状态分解与tempered贝叶斯更新的两项精确对应。不同模型规模和家族间λ可比较，较大模型在高上下文极限下对先验依赖更低。因果实验证实调节λ可沿KL散度方向操控预测。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的解嵌入几何中隐藏着训练语料的unigram先验方向，该方向不仅是统计上的先验编码，还具有明确的可解释性与因果可干预性。这一"ignorance direction"框架统一了模型的先验回退行为与tempered贝叶斯更新理论，为理解模型预测机制、比较不同模型特性以及引导模型输出提供了新的几何-概率视角。

title: Mesh-Native Physics-Informed Graph Surrogates for TCAD-in-the-Loop Design Space Exploration
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
summary: High-fidelity TCAD simulation of drift-diffusion transport remains the workhorse of emerging FinFET device design, but it is computationally expensive, especially for 3D structures where runtime escalates steeply with mesh complexity. This sharply limits multi-objective design space exploration. Existing machine-learning surrogates map a fixed set of design parameters to a few scalar device metrics, discarding the underlying physics and losing transferability across device geometries and families. A physics-informed graph attention network (GAT) surrogate is proposed. It operates directly on the tetrahedral TCAD mesh and predicts, at every mesh node, the electrostatic potential together with the electron and hole quasi-Fermi levels, the fundamental unknowns of the drift-diffusion system. Training combines a data loss with finite-volume current-continuity residuals, embedding carrier-transport physics into the objective. Operating on the mesh as a graph, the surrogate inherits size generalization: a model trained on few-fin meshes applies unchanged to substantially larger arrays, bounded at inference only by GPU memory. Per-node uncertainty from a deep ensemble drives an active-learning loop that screens large candidate pools in seconds and forwards only the most informative designs for full simulation. Benchmarked against Sentaurus Device on multi-fin tri-gate FinFETs, the surrogate reproduces the three drift-diffusion fields with sub-volt per-field RMSE and reaches a per-design throughput orders of magnitude higher than the full simulator. The advantage grows with device size: on large multi-fin arrays that are prohibitively slow to simulate directly, inference still completes in under a second per device, enabling Pareto-front exploration across device scales infeasible for direct TCAD sweeps.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理信息图注意网络（GAT）代理模型，直接在TCAD四面体网格上预测静电势及电子/空穴准费米能级的完整漂移-扩散场分布，通过结合数据损失与有限体积电流连续性残差进行训练，支持跨器件几何和尺寸的泛化，并利用深度集成驱动的主动学习实现大规模设计空间的高效筛选。
AI.motivation: 高保真TCAD漂移-扩散仿真计算开销极大，尤其对3D FinFET结构，运行时随网格复杂度急剧攀升，严重限制多目标设计空间的探索。现有机器学习代理仅将固定设计参数映射到少量标量指标，丢弃底层物理信息，缺乏跨器件几何与器件族的迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出物理信息图注意力网络（GAT）代理模型：直接对四面体TCAD网格建模，在每个网格节点预测静电势与电子/空穴准费米能级（漂移-扩散系统的基本未知量）；训练损失由数据损失与有限体积电流连续性残差构成，将载流子输运物理嵌入目标函数；网格以图形式处理以获得尺寸泛化能力；深度集成提供每节点不确定性，驱动主动学习循环筛选候选设计并仅将最有信息量的设计送入完整仿真。
AI.result: 以Sentaurus Device为基准，在多鳍三栅FinFET上，代理模型复原三个漂移-扩散场，每场RMSE低于伏级，单设计吞吐量比完整仿真器高出数个数量级。优势随器件尺寸增大而增强：大规模多鳍阵列上推断每器件仍可在1秒内完成，实现传统TCAD扫描不可行的帕累托前沿探索。
AI.conclusion: 该物理信息GAT代理模型能够在保持物理可解释性的同时实现跨器件规模的高效设计空间探索，为超出直接TCAD仿真能力的大规模FinFET多目标优化提供了可行路径。

title: Fully Fluctuating Sleepy Consensus from Minimal Assumptions
summary:
Bitcoin's proof-of-work (PoW)-based protocol is remarkable for how little it asks of its participants. Not only can miners take breaks from work whenever they please, but it is almost unique in offering a path of contrition: corrupt miners can reclaim honest status simply by resuming mining on the longest chain. The protocol only requires that honest miners hold the majority of computational power at any given time. Analogous proof-of-stake (PoS) protocols, usually formalized via the sleepy model of Pass and Shi (2017), have fallen short of matching this robustness. In fact, sleepy consensus protocols in the plain PKI model must heavily restrict fluctuations in adversarial participation over time. The recent work of Efron, Neu, and Pitassi (2025) enables fully fluctuating participation in the sleepy model by introducing the external adversary model. Their protocol, however, relies on verifiable delay functions (VDFs), a strong cryptographic primitive that somewhat resembles PoW, by assuming that the adversary cannot compute sequential work significantly faster than honest nodes.
  In this work, we design a sleepy consensus protocol for fully fluctuating participation with an external adversary under an honest majority, from minimal assumptions: a public key infrastructure (PKI) and a verifiable random function (VRF). In particular, we make no VDF or hardware assumptions. Our key technique is graded wakeness, a novel primitive that allows nodes to form consistent opinions on which other nodes are awake. We further extend our protocol to handle uncorruption, where corrupt nodes return to honesty. This extension requires only a mild additional assumption on the unpredictability of VRF outputs for liveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的睡眠共识协议，在外部敌手模型下支持完全波动的参与率，仅需PKI和VRF等最小假设即可在诚实多数条件下实现安全，无需VDF或硬件假设。核心技术创新是"分级清醒"（graded wakeness）原语，允许节点对其他节点的清醒状态形成一致意见，并进一步扩展到支持节点"回正"（uncorruption）的场景。
AI.motivation: 比特币的PoW协议具有极高的鲁棒性——矿工可以随意休息，腐败矿工可以通过恢复挖矿重返诚实状态，仅需诚实算力占多数。然而，基于Pass-Shi（2017）睡眠模型的PoS协议无法匹配这种鲁棒性：在普通PKI模型中，睡眠共识协议必须严格限制敌手参与度的波动。Efron、Neu和Pitassi（2025）的近期工作通过引入外部敌手模型实现了完全波动的参与率，但其协议依赖VDF这种强密码学原语，本质上与PoW类似，假设敌手无法比诚实节点显著更快地计算顺序工作。因此，本文的目标是在最小假设（仅PKI和VRF）下实现同等鲁棒性。
AI.method: 本文的核心技术是提出了一种名为"分级清醒"（graded wakeness）的新颖原语，该原语允许节点对其他节点的清醒状态形成一致且分级（graded）的意见。基于此原语，作者设计了一个在外部敌手模型下支持完全波动参与的睡眠共识协议，仅依赖PKI和VRF等最小假设。此外，作者进一步扩展协议以支持uncorruption场景（腐败节点恢复诚实），为此仅需对VRF输出的不可预测性增加一个温和假设以保障活性。
AI.result: 成功设计了仅基于PKI和VRF的睡眠共识协议，在外部敌手模型下实现完全波动参与，无需VDF或任何硬件假设，且在诚实多数条件下保持安全。协议还支持uncorruption扩展，只需添加VRF输出不可预测性的温和活性假设。
AI.conclusion: 本文显著缩小了PoS协议与PoW协议在鲁棒性方面的差距：通过引入graded wakeness原语，在无VDF/硬件假设的最小密码学假设下即可实现与比特币同等的参与鲁棒性（完全波动的参与率和腐败节点的回正机制），为睡眠共识协议的理论奠定了更坚实的基础。

title: MasterControl Seventeen Every Time
summary: We study a governed approach to enterprise analytics: a language model interprets the question, while deterministic policy selects and runs a pre-approved analytical program that returns both results and evidence. We show that this restriction can remain expressive within a defined analytical class, using relational operations plus aggregation, comparison, windows, ranking, and similarity. Fixed meaning, policy, data, and execution rules also make results replayable. Across 440 runs, three 8B models generated SQL and selected tools at runtime, while Qwen3-8B interpreted intent only and policy executed the approved program. None of 330 runtime-planning episodes matched the full answer-and-evidence contract across all test datasets; the policy-executed analyzer matched 110 of 110. This is a configuration-specific result, not evidence that runtime agents cannot succeed under other designs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种受治理的企业分析框架：语言模型仅负责理解问题意图，而确定性策略负责选择并执行预先批准的分析程序，该程序返回结果及证据。实验表明，在440次运行中，3个8B模型（即时规划）无一次完整满足"答案加证据"的契约，而策略驱动的受治理分析器在110次运行中全部匹配成功。
AI.motivation: 企业分析场景中，直接由大语言模型运行时自主规划（如生成SQL、选择工具）虽然灵活，但缺乏治理与可审计性，难以保证结果的可复现性和可靠性。作者希望通过引入确定性策略与预批准程序，探索一种既能保持表达力、又能实现可控可回放的企业分析架构。
AI.method: 采用"语言模型解释意图 + 确定性策略选择并执行预批准分析程序"的双层架构。分析类限定为关系运算加聚合、比较、窗口、排名与相似度等操作。固定语义、策略、数据与执行规则以保证结果可回放。实验采用3个8B参数模型进行运行时规划（生成SQL并选择工具），对比Qwen3-8B仅做意图解释、由策略执行批准程序的受治理方案。共440次运行：330次为运行时规划，110次为策略执行。
AI.result: 330次运行时规划中没有任何一次在所有测试数据集上同时满足"完整答案与证据"的契约；而受治理的策略执行分析器在110次中全部匹配。作者明确指出这是特定配置下的结果，并不构成"运行时智能体在其他设计下无法成功"的普遍性证据。
AI.conclusion: 在受限但具有表达力的分析类内，确定性策略驱动的预批准程序执行方式可以实现"完全匹配答案与证据"的高可靠性，优于同规模模型在运行时自主规划的表现。该结果强调了治理约束在保证可靠性与可回放性方面的价值，但也需谨慎推广，因其有效性与具体配置强相关。

title: GPU-Accelerated Astrodynamics World Models for Spacecraft Rendezvous and Proximity Operations
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables, Presented at Advanced Maui Optical and Space Surveillance Technologies Conference 2026
summary: World models are an emerging paradigm in representation learning in which an agent jointly learns state-action dynamics and observation models from offline trajectory data, enabling multi-step planning and trajectory prediction with uncertainty estimates. They have shown strong results in robotics and game environments, but, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been applied to the space domain. This paper introduces a world model-based approach to cooperative and non-cooperative spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations. First, we introduce an open-source, JAX-based International Space Station (ISS) docking environment supporting parallel GPU simulation of spacecraft orbit and attitude dynamics, generating the thousands of state-action transitions that world model training requires. Second, we introduce Out-of-this-World-Model, a transformer-based world model that encodes relative kinematic states and body-fixed camera imagery into a latent state and predicts its evolution under commanded thrusts and torques using one-step flow matching. It produces a distribution over future observations, capturing stochastic dynamics and per-timestep uncertainty, and outperforms DreamerV3-style posterior-correction baselines with fewer trainable parameters and hyperparameters. Third, we apply the approach to a capsule autonomously docking with the ISS under keep-out-zone constraints, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and task performance over reinforcement learning baselines (53% versus 29% docking success across ports), better out-of-distribution generalization (on held-out ports the world model more than doubles baseline success, 40% versus 17%), and detection of anomalous objects encountered during approach with 98% classification accuracy. We open-source the simulation environment and model architecture to enable further study of this paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将世界模型范式应用于航天器交会与近距操作任务。作者开源了一个基于JAX的ISS对接环境，支持GPU并行仿真，并提出了Out-of-This-World-Model——一种基于Transformer的世界模型，利用流匹配预测潜在状态的演化，在对接任务中超越了DreamerV3风格基线和强化学习基线，展示出更高的样本效率、更强的分布外泛化能力和97%以上的异常检测精度。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在机器人和游戏环境中已展示出强大能力，但在航天领域尚未得到应用。航天器交会与近距操作（尤其是自主对接）具有安全性要求高、动力学复杂、需要不确定性量化的特点，亟需一种能够从离线轨迹数据中学习状态-动作动力学并支持多步规划和不确定性估计的新范式。
AI.method: (1) 构建了开源、基于JAX的ISS对接仿真环境，支持轨道与姿态动力学的GPU并行仿真，以生成世界模型训练所需的大量状态-动作转移数据；(2) 提出Out-of-This-World-Model，一个基于Transformer的世界模型，将相对运动学状态和相机图像编码为潜在状态，并通过一步流匹配预测其在指令推力/力矩作用下的演化，输出未来观测的分布以捕获随机动力学和逐时间步不确定性；(3) 在带禁飞区约束的自动对接任务中对方法进行验证。
AI.result: Out-of-This-World-Model在对接成功率和参数效率上优于DreamerV3风格的后验校正基线；在样本效率和任务性能上优于强化学习基线（各停靠端口对接成功率53%对29%）；在分布外泛化中优势更明显（持保留端口上40%对17%）；异常物体检测的分类准确率达98%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型范式在航天交会与近距操作领域是可行且有效的，能提供改进的样本效率、更强的分布外泛化能力和内置的不确定性感知及异常检测能力。开源仿真环境和模型架构为该范式在航天领域的进一步研究奠定了基础。

title: An Integrative Computational Approach to Predict Viral Epitopes by Targeting the MHC-TCR Complexation
summary: T-cell immunity acts as a major defense system against controlling viral infections in vertebrates. During viral entry, innate immune cells degrade the viral proteins (antigens) and present them on their surface via Major Histocompatibility (MHC) proteins. T-cell receptors (TCRs) recognize these antigens/peptides presented by MHC (pMHC), initiating a T-cell mediated immune response. Despite its significance, the mechanism by which pMHC-TCR binding triggers T-cell activation remains unclear. In this study, we employed an integrative computational approach combining Bioinformatics, Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, and Machine Learning (ML) to identify viral epitopes as potential vaccine candidates. We performed large-scale all-atom and coarse-grained MD simulations on MHC-peptide-TCR complexes embedded into dendritic and T-cells, for which experimental immunogenicity data is available. One hundred fifty such systems are simulated for 1 μs each to capture the conformational and dynamical changes that underlie T-cell activation. Our ML model (DynamiT), trained on simulation-derived structural and dynamical features extracted from 2500 time points, revealed key determinants responsible for T-cell activation with an accuracy of 73.3%. Notably, we have identified the bending of the TCR transmembrane region, major dynamic motions of the TCRα constant region and the buried surface area at the pMHC and TCR interface as critical factors influencing immune response initiation. Our approach unravels the mechanism of T-cell mediated immune response and helps ML-guided screening of viral epitopes for vaccine development.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用整合计算框架（生物信息学、分子动力学模拟和机器学习），对150个MHC-肽-TCR复合物系统进行了各1微秒的模拟，开发了名为DynamiT的机器学习模型（准确率73.3%），识别出TCR跨膜区弯曲、TCRα恒定区动态运动及pMHC-TCR界面埋藏表面积是T细胞激活的关键决定因素，为ML引导的病毒表位疫苗筛选提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: T细胞免疫是脊椎动物抵抗病毒感染的主要防御系统，但pMHC-TCR结合触发T细胞激活的机制仍不明确，这限制了基于表位的疫苗开发效率。
AI.method: 采用整合计算方法：结合生物信息学、全原子和粗粒化分子动力学模拟（150个系统各模拟1微秒）对嵌入树突状细胞和T细胞膜中的MHC-肽-TCR复合物进行模拟，并从2500个时间点提取结构和动力学特征训练机器学习模型DynamiT。
AI.result: DynamiT模型以73.3%的准确率识别出T细胞激活的关键决定因素，包括TCR跨膜区弯曲、TCRα恒定区的主要动态运动以及pMHC与TCR界面的埋藏表面积。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了T细胞介导免疫应答的分子机制，并展示了ML引导的病毒表位筛选在疫苗开发中的应用潜力。

title: Sparse concept attribution for histomorphological hypothesis generation from whole-slide classifiers
summary: Histology images contain rich morphological information and can provide insights into pathological processes. However, deriving hypotheses relating morphological phenotypes to clinical attributes is bottlenecked by a manual image interpretation step. Here, we demonstrate that this process can be automated through interpretable deep learning. We present SCOPE, a method to interpret slide-level classifiers by combining pathology-specific vision--language models with sparse concept attribution onto a generalist histomorphological concept bank. To measure whether such explanations recover known morphology, we introduce MorphoRecoveryBench, a benchmark of seven tasks with pathologist-curated reference descriptions. On this benchmark, dense concept attribution is indistinguishable from a random baseline, whereas sparse attribution recovers substantial known morphology; decomposing the pooled slide embedding reaches similar explanation correctness at a fraction of the computational cost. Post-hoc interpretation of whole-slide classifiers can thus generate morphological hypotheses at scale, for expert validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE方法，通过结合病理特异性视觉-语言模型与稀疏概念归因于通用组织形态概念库，自动化解释全切片分类器，并引入MorphoRecoveryBench基准（含7个任务）验证解释质量。结果显示稀疏归因能有效恢复已知形态学知识，而密集归因接近随机基线；池化切片嵌入分解在更低计算成本下达到相近的解释正确性。
AI.motivation: 组织病理图像蕴含丰富的形态学信息，可揭示病理过程的见解。然而，从形态表型推导与临床属性相关的假设受限于人工图像解读步骤，这一瓶颈阻碍了大规模自动化假设生成。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE方法：将病理特异性视觉-语言模型与稀疏概念归因相结合，对通用组织形态学概念库进行属性分配，以解释全切片分类器的决策。同时引入MorphoRecoveryBench基准，包含七个由病理学家精选参考描述的评估任务，系统比较密集与稀疏概念归因及池化切片嵌入分解方案。
AI.result: 在MorphoRecoveryBench上，密集概念归因的结果与随机基线无法区分，而稀疏归因能显著恢复已知的形态学知识；将池化的切片嵌入分解的方法在解释正确性上与稀疏归因接近，但计算成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 全切片分类器的后验解释能够在规模化层面生成形态学假设，供病理专家验证，从而自动化原本依赖人工解读的假设生成过程。

title: Axonal delay dispersion decides whether a neuron detects an event or a sequence, and predicts cortical column diameter
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, under preparation for PLOS Computational Biology
summary: Cortical neurons fire sparsely -- often fewer than one spike per sensory window -- making rate coding insufficient and temporal coding a necessity. That conduction delays convert firing order into synchrony is long established. What governs which class of temporal feature a neuron detects -- one volley of coincident input, or two in a particular order -- has not been examined. We propose a delay-signature framework in which the axonal conduction delays converging on a dendritic branch constitute a physical key: only input sequences whose spike-time differences the delays compensate arrive synchronously, and coincidence detection, via calcium plateau thresholds, converts that synchrony into an all-or-none output. In simulations of an integrator-neuron model we report three results. First, a single physical scalar -- the dispersion of the delay set -- moves a population from event detection to order-selective sequence detection. The transition is emergent under random delays and connectivity: at narrow dispersion sequence detectors do not exist, and the dispersion at which they overtake event detectors tracks the inter-event interval with a slope statistically indistinguishable from one. This maps a computational distinction onto the anatomical one between myelinated and unmyelinated projections, making myelination a switch on what a neuron computes, not only a regulator of speed. Second, the same dispersion sets the code's limits: it bounds the longest codable interval and fixes an absolute timing tolerance of about a millisecond, with slowing better tolerated than speeding. Third, that millisecond window and horizontal conduction velocity together predict cortical column diameter, and the two areas with direct measurements fall where the relation puts them. One anatomically measurable parameter thus sets what a neuron detects and the limits of what it can represent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"延迟签名"（delay-signature）框架：轴突传导延迟在树突分支上的汇聚构成一个物理密钥，决定神经元检测的时间特征类别——是单次共时输入（事件检测）还是两次按特定顺序的输入（序列检测）。通过积分神经元模型模拟发现，延迟集合的离散度这一单一物理标量即可将神经元群体从事件检测推向顺序选择性序列检测，且该转变是涌现的。同一离散度还限定了编码的时间范围（约毫秒级的绝对时间容差），并预测皮层柱直径。
AI.motivation: 皮层神经元稀疏放电使速率编码不足以承载信息，时间编码成为必要。虽然早已知道传导延迟可将放电顺序转化为神经同步，但什么因素决定一个神经元检测哪类时间特征（一组共时输入还是两组按特定顺序的输入）此前从未被研究。作者提出用轴突传导延迟的汇聚结构来解释这一区分。
AI.method: 提出delay-signature框架：轴突传导延迟在树突分支上的汇聚构成"物理密钥"，只有时间差与延迟相补偿的输入序列才能到达产生同步，经由钙平台阈值（coincidence detection）转化为全或无的输出。在积分神经元模型中模拟了随机延迟连通下的群体行为，考察延迟集合离散度如何影响事件检测器与序列检测器的分布，并建立离散度与可编码区间、时间容差及皮层柱直径之间的定量关系。
AI.result: 三个主要结果：(1) 延迟集合的离散度是单一物理标量，可将群体从事件检测推向序列检测，转变是涌现的；窄离散度下序列检测器不存在，序列检测器超过事件检测器的离散度与事件间间隔的斜率在统计上不可与1区分。(2) 同一离散度界定了编码极限：限制最长可编码间隔，并固定约1毫秒的绝对时间容差（延缓比加速更易容忍）。(3) 毫秒时间窗与水平传导速度联合可预测皮层柱直径，两个有直接测量的脑区数据与该预测吻合。
AI.conclusion: 单个解剖学可测量参数（延迟离散度）同时决定了神经元检测什么（事件vs序列）、编码的极限（时间范围与容差），并将计算差异映射到髓鞘化与非髓鞘化投射的解剖差异上——髓鞘化不只是速度调节器，而是神经元计算类型的开关。该框架将毫秒级时间容差与皮层柱直径联系，提示时间编码的物理基础具有解剖学可预测性。

title: Position: Unlabeled IS NOT Equal to No Human Supervision in Visual Learning
summary: This position paper argues that the absence of labels does not imply the absence of human supervision in visual learning, and urges the research community to identify sources of supervision more explicitly. Many recent methods in computer vision build upon representations learned from large-scale unlabeled data, and are therefore grouped under the same umbrella term ``unsupervised.'' However, different data curation schemes and training objectives embed substantially different human priors on which models rely, and we argue that one ``unsupervised'' umbrella term is no longer capturing these distinctions. This ambiguity makes it harder to compare unsupervised learning research conducted under different assumptions, coinciding with a sharp decline in papers titled with ``unsupervised'' in flagship computer vision conferences since 2021, despite continued growth of the field. While we fully embrace pre-training as a strong foundation for modern computer vision, we advocate for a community-level effort toward greater conceptual clarity: authors are encouraged to disclose priors in data selection and learning objectives, and to specify which components of a learning pipeline depend on which assumptions. Standardized disclosure practices can improve academic communication, ensure fairer comparisons, and preserve methodological diversity in unsupervised learning.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，认为"无标签"并不等同于"无人类监督"，主张计算机视觉社区应更明确地识别和披露数据筛选与训练目标中隐含的人类先验，以取代目前过于宽泛的"无监督"这一统称术语。
AI.motivation: 近年来许多基于大规模无标签数据的方法都被归入"无监督"这一术语下，但不同数据筛选方案和训练目标嵌入了截然不同的人类先验，现有术语无法区分这些差异，导致在不同假设下进行的无监督研究难以公平比较，并可能加剧概念混淆。
AI.method: 提出社区级的标准化披露实践：鼓励作者披露数据选择和学习目标中的先验，明确标注学习流程中哪些组件依赖哪些假设，以提高学术交流的清晰度。
AI.result: 指出自2021年以来CV旗舰会议中标题含"unsupervised"的论文数量急剧下降，而无监督学习领域仍在增长，这一悖论暗示了术语模糊带来的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 虽然完全认可预训练作为现代视觉的坚实基础，但倡导社区共同努力实现更大的概念清晰度，通过标准化披露来改善学术沟通、确保更公平的比较并维护无监督学习的方法论多样性。

title: Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Multi-LLM Federated Inference for Cognitive Diagnosis
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Significant challenges remain in AI-driven educational systems in balancing privacy preservation with accurate cognitive diagnosis. To overcome this, we propose a federated inference framework in which several commercial LLM APIs collaborate without requiring access to raw student data or proprietary model internals. Using multiple federated entities, such as LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3-Haiku, our framework builds upon a heterogeneous multi-LLM architecture. The predictions generated by these entities are combined with epsilon-local differential privacy by adding Laplace noise locally to each entity's prediction output before aggregation, while residual-based aggregation mitigates model heterogeneity. Our approach is predicated on an honest-but-curious trust paradigm in which API providers are presumed not to abuse submitted queries, and our differential privacy mechanism shields the published diagnostic results from external inference. We conduct rigorous privacy-utility analysis showing strong privacy guarantees with minimal accuracy loss, and extensive real-world evaluations across three educational benchmarks confirm the framework's practical usability and cross-domain generalizability.

AI.tldr: 提出一个联邦推理框架，通过多个商业LLM API协作进行认知诊断，在不访问原始学生数据或模型内部参数的情况下实现隐私保护与诊断准确性的平衡。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的教育系统在隐私保护与准确认知诊断之间仍存在显著挑战，现有方法难以兼顾二者，因此需要一种既能保护学生隐私又能获得高精度诊断的方案。
AI.method: 采用异构多LLM架构（LLaMA-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3-Haiku等联邦实体），通过在本地向每个实体的预测输出添加Laplace噪声实现ε-局部差分隐私，再通过基于残差的聚合策略缓解模型异构性问题；整体基于诚实体但好奇（honest-but-curious）信任范式。
AI.result: 严格隐私-效用分析表明框架具备强隐私保证且准确率损失极小；在三个教育基准上的广泛真实世界评估验证了其实用性与跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该联邦推理框架能够在不访问原始学生数据或专有模型内部的前提下实现有效认知诊断，兼顾隐私保护与诊断精度，并具有良好的跨领域泛化性。

title: Bounded Personas Match Retrieval on Classification but Not Regression for a Frozen Agent
summary: A personalized language agent must convert a user's interaction history into behavior on each new request at inference time. Two strategies dominate. Retrieval pulls a few of the user's most relevant past items into the prompt, which is accurate but pays a per-query selection and context cost that grows with the history. Distillation instead compresses the history once into a compact natural-language persona, which is bounded, query-independent, and interpretable, but is widely assumed to sacrifice accuracy. Whether, and on which tasks, a distilled persona can match retrieval has not been characterized cleanly. We introduce PersonaLink, a training-free method that distills a user's history into a bounded three-field persona and recursively refines it: each pass self-evaluates the frozen agent on a held-out slice of the user's own labeled history, rewrites the persona from its errors, and keeps the result only when it does not regress on that slice. Because every comparison shares one frozen 7B backbone and differs only in what is placed in context, the design isolates the effect of representation from that of the model. The result is a clear task-type asymmetry. On 200 users of LaMP-2 (15-way news categorization), PersonaLink reaches 0.745-0.755 accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from BM25 retrieval (0.760-0.765).

AI.tldr: 本文提出PersonaLink，一种无需训练的蒸馏方法，将用户交互历史压缩为有界的三字段个性化描述（persona），并通过递归自我评估与改写机制进行优化。在LaMP-2的200名用户新闻分类任务上，PersonaLink达到约0.745-0.755的准确率，与BM25检索方法（0.760-0.765）在统计上无显著差异，揭示了“蒸馏型persona可在特定任务上媲美检索”这一关键结论。
AI.motivation: 个性化语言智能体需要在每个新请求的推理阶段将用户交互历史转化为行为。现有两大策略各有取舍：检索方法准确但在每次查询时需支付随历史增长的选择与上下文成本；蒸馏方法有界、查询无关且可解释，但被认为牺牲准确率。然而，蒸馏persona在哪些任务上能媲美检索、在哪些任务上不行，此前缺乏清晰的刻画，这是本文要填补的空白。
AI.method: 提出PersonaLink，一种训练无关（training-free）方法：1) 将用户历史蒸馏为有界的三字段persona；2) 递归精炼——每一轮在用户自身的标签历史切片上对冻结的agent进行自评估，依据错误改写persona，仅当在切片上无回退（不regress）时才保留结果；3) 所有比较共享统一的冻结7B骨干模型，仅上下文中放置的内容不同，从而隔离了“表示形式”与“模型能力”的影响。
AI.result: 在LaMP-2的200名用户（15类新闻分类）上，PersonaLink达到0.745-0.755的准确率，与BM25检索方法（0.760-0.765）在统计上无法区分，表明蒸馏persona在特定任务上能达到与检索相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示出清晰的任务类型不对称性：在新闻分类这类任务上，有界的蒸馏persona可以与成本更高的检索方法性能相当，推翻了“蒸馏必然牺牲准确率”的普遍假设。这一结果为理解个性化表征的选择提供了依据，并指出了一个值得进一步探索的任务维度。

title: Equation Recast for Canonical Operator Learning Across Parametric PDEs
summary: Learning solution operators across broad parameter ranges can require substantial coverage of both input functions and physical parameters, particularly for purely data-driven parametric models. In addition, the resulting models may fail silently outside the training distribution. We introduce equation recast, which reformulates parametric operator learning as the learning of a single canonical operator. Parameter-induced operator variations are derived analytically from the governing equation and absorbed into effective sources, enabling zero-shot prediction across new parameter regimes. Across multi-parameter, nonlinear, and singular PDE settings, equation recast supports extrapolation, integrates sparse heterogeneous datasets in a shared canonical representation, and uses loss of convergence as an internal warning signal for failure of the recast iteration. In high-fidelity tokamak simulations for nuclear fusion, the framework unifies electron-temperature data across four device geometries through canonical-domain mapping within one jointly trained operator. Equation recast provides a route toward reusable neural PDE solvers combining equation-guided transfer, data efficiency, and monitorable inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"方程重铸"（equation recast）方法，将参数化算子学习重铸为单一规范算子的学习，将参数诱导的算子变化解析地吸收进有效源项中，从而实现对全新参数域的零样本预测。在多变参数、非线性和奇异PDE场景中支持外推，在核聚变高保真模拟中统一了四种设备几何结构的电子温度数据。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的参数化模型需要在输入函数和物理参数上都有大量覆盖才能学习解算子，且模型在训练分布之外可能无声失败（fail silently），缺乏可靠性与数据效率。
AI.method: 将参数化算子学习重铸为学习单个规范算子：由控制方程解析地推导出参数诱导的算子变化，并将其吸收为有效源项，使模型在新参数域上具备零样本外推能力；同时将收敛性丧失作为重铸迭代失败的内部预警信号。
AI.result: 在多变参数、非线性及奇异PDE设置中实现外推；以共享规范表示为桥梁整合稀疏异构数据集；在核聚变高保真托卡马克模拟中，通过规范域映射将四种设备几何结构的电子温度数据在单一联合训练的算子中统一。
AI.conclusion: 方程重铸为可复用神经PDE求解器提供了一条路径，融合了方程引导的迁移、数据效率与可监控的推理过程，有望成为兼具泛化能力与可靠性的通用框架。

title: FlowTT: Exploiting Computation Flow Reuse in Irregular Tensor-Train Embedding
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
summary: Tensor-Train (TT) decomposition effectively compresses large embedding tables in recommendation models, but TT-based embedding lookup remains inefficient because partially shared computation flows across input indices are not fully reused and intermediate results are repeatedly materialized off-chip between sequential TT-core contractions. We present FlowTT, a flow-aware GPU execution framework that reformulates TT gather as a set of prefix-shared irregular computation flows. FlowTT combines flow-aligned prefix-based index grouping, a fused TT-embedding execution path with on-chip intermediate retention, and persistent-thread scheduling with chunk-based work stealing and L2 checkpointing to preserve reuse under skewed workloads. By co-designing task formation, data buffering, and scheduling with the structure of TT gather, FlowTT reduces redundant TT-core operations, global-memory traffic, and load imbalance. On Meta's synthetic recommendation benchmarks (Meta-240, Meta-480, and Meta-788), FlowTT consistently achieves the lowest latency compared to existing methods. At batch size 32,768, it reduces latency by up to 42.2% in inference and 49.2% in training relative to EcoRec, while also achieving the lowest inference peak memory usage. These results show that exposing prefix-shared computation is key to efficient TT-based embedding execution.

AI.tldr: FlowTT是一个面向GPU的流感知执行框架，通过将张量列（TT）分解的嵌入查找重构为一组前缀共享的不规则计算流，结合流对齐的分组、融合执行路径与持久线程调度，显著降低TT嵌入查找的延迟和内存占用。
AI.motivation: TT分解能有效压缩推荐模型中的大型嵌入表，但基于TT的嵌入查找效率低下，原因在于跨输入索引的部分共享计算流未被充分复用，且序贯的TT核收缩之间中间结果反复在片外物化，造成冗余计算和高内存流量。
AI.method: FlowTT采用四种协同设计策略：(1)流对齐的前缀分组，将共享计算前缀的索引归类；(2)融合的TT嵌入执行路径，在片上保留中间结果；(3)持久线程调度，结合基于块的工作窃取；(4)L2级检查点，在偏斜工作负载下保持复用。通过协同设计任务形成、数据缓冲和调度与TT gather的结构特征来提升效率。
AI.result: 在Meta的合成推荐基准（Meta-240、Meta-480和Meta-788）上，FlowTT始终达到最低延迟。在批大小32,768时，相比EcoRec，推理延迟最高降低42.2%，训练延迟最高降低49.2%，同时实现最低的推理峰值内存使用。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，暴露前缀共享计算是高效TT嵌入执行的关键，FlowTT通过流感知的设计有效减少了冗余TT核心操作、全局内存流量和负载不均衡。

title: Skywing: A Platform for Decentralized Mathematical Computing in Unreliable Environments
summary: Emerging edge, autonomous, and cyber-physical systems increasingly require mathematical computation across heterogeneous devices connected by unreliable communication networks. Traditional high-performance computing and distributed data-processing frameworks provide powerful abstractions for managed environments but are less suited to decentralized settings where centralized coordination, reliable communication, and global synchronization cannot be assumed. This paper presents Skywing, an open-source platform for decentralized mathematical computing in unreliable environments. Its programming model consists of three abstractions: agents represent participants in a decentralized computation, processors encapsulate algorithm-specific update rules, and iterations manage distributed execution. Skywing supports asynchronous operation, publish-subscribe communication, managed message handling, and the composition of independent algorithms into complex decentralized workflows. We demonstrate Skywing using representative algorithms from consensus, optimization, and numerical linear algebra. Experiments on the native Skywing runtime include Push Sum and Max Consensus, a composed monitoring and control workflow, resilient Push Sum under delayed communication, and resilient asynchronous Jacobi under malevolent data corruption. These demonstrations show that Skywing supports diverse decentralized algorithms while separating mathematical logic from communication and execution infrastructure. Skywing serves as both a deployment framework for decentralized applications and a research platform for developing resilient mathematical algorithms.

AI.tldr: Skywing是一个开源的去中心化数学计算平台，专为不可靠网络环境设计，通过"智能体(agents)、处理器(processors)、迭代(iterations)"三种抽象将数学逻辑与通信基础架构分离，支持异步操作和发布-订阅通信，并已在共识、优化、数值线性代数等代表性算法上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算、自主系统和信息物理系统日益需要跨异构设备的数学计算，但传统高性能计算和分布式数据处理框架依赖集中协调、可靠通信和全局同步，难以适用于不可信、无集中协调的分布式环境。
AI.method: Skywing采用三种核心抽象：agents表示去中心化计算中的参与者，processors封装算法特定的更新规则，iterations管理分布式执行。平台支持异步操作、发布-订阅通信、托管消息处理，并支持将独立算法组合成复杂的去中心化工作流。
AI.result: 在原生的Skywing运行时上进行的实验涵盖Push Sum和Max Consensus共识算法、组合式监控与控制工作流、延迟通信下具有韧性的Push Sum以及恶意数据损坏下具有韧性的异步Jacobi算法，验证了Skywing能够支持多样的去中心化算法。
AI.conclusion: Skywing成功地将数学逻辑与通信及执行基础设施分离，既可作为去中心化应用的部署框架，也可作为开发者设计韧性数学算法的研究平台。

title: Speculative Macro Commit for Faster Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents spend wall-clock time not only on model inference but also in serial action--observation turns, where each tool call, environment transition, and observation can delay subsequent decisions. We introduce \textbf{Speculative Macro Commit} (SMC), a runtime mechanism for a two-tier agent system: a large authoritative actor model produces the official trajectory, while a faster speculative drafter model continuously predicts and executes future action chains on an isolated environment snapshot. SMC mines recurring multi-action skeletons from training traces and stores them in a macro library used to match against action chains predicted by the drafter at runtime. When the actor's next tool call matches the first drafted action, SMC commits the remaining pre-executed draft steps, together with their observations, to the official trajectory. Using Qwen3.5-27B INT4 as the authoritative actor model and Qwen3.5-4B as the speculative drafter model, SMC matches the sequential agent's overall accuracy while reducing latency by 10.23\% over the Speculative Actions (SA) baseline and 18.59\% over sequential execution on the $τ^2$-Bench Telecom subset. On AppWorld, SMC reduces wall time by 7.7\% over SA baseline and 44.9\% over sequential execution, with a small reduction in task completion. Overall, SMC provides a practical way to reuse multi-step speculative execution and reduce agent latency beyond single-step speculative actions. Our code is publicly available \href{https://github.com/zeyuliu1037/speculative-macro-commit}{\textcolor{magenta}{here}}.

AI.tldr: SMC是一种面向工具调用LLM智能体的运行时机制，通过双层智能体系统（权威actor模型+快速投机drafter模型）提前预测并执行未来动作链，从训练轨迹中挖掘多步动作骨架存入宏库，当actor的实际工具调用与预测动作匹配时批量提交预执行结果，从而减少串行延迟。
AI.motivation: 工具使用的LLM智能体在实际运行中，大量墙钟时间不仅消耗在模型推理上，还消耗在串行的动作-观察回合中（每次工具调用、环境转换和观察都会延迟后续决策），单步投机性执行（Speculative Actions）虽能加速但未充分利用多步动作间的可复用性，需要进一步降低智能体延迟。
AI.method: SMC提出了双层智能体系统：1) 大型权威actor模型产生官方轨迹；2) 更快的投机drafter模型持续预测并在隔离的环境快照上预执行未来的动作链。SMC从训练轨迹中挖掘重复出现的多步动作骨架，存入宏库（macro library），在运行时用于匹配drafter预测的动作链。当actor的下一次工具调用与第一项草拟动作匹配时，SMC将剩余的预执行草稿步骤连同其观察结果提交到官方轨迹中。
AI.result: 实验使用Qwen3.5-27B INT4作为权威actor模型、Qwen3.5-4B作为投机drafter模型。在τ²-Bench Telecom子集上，SMC在保持与串行智能体相当的准确率的同时，相比Speculative Actions（SA）基线降低延迟10.23%，相比串行执行降低18.59%。在AppWorld上，相比SA基线减少7.7%墙钟时间，相比串行执行减少44.9%，任务完成率略有下降。
AI.conclusion: SMC提供了一种实用方法来复用多步投机执行并降低智能体延迟，超越了单步投机动作的效果，代码已公开发布。

title: Sensing Which Modality Matters: Evidence-Gated Regularization for Robust VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies fuse multimodal sensory inputs, but training on limited and homogeneous robot demonstrations encourages spurious inter-sensor correlations rather than task-relevant signal, a failure we term modality entanglement. Under real-world occlusions and distractors, this manifests as nuisance sensitivity to corruption of uninformative sensors and single-modality insufficiency when only one informative sensor remains intact. We propose Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR), a modality-agnostic training objective that introduces zero inference-time overhead. EGR derives a per-frame and per-sensor task-relevance signal to gate two state-conditional consistency objectives: invariance on low-evidence sensors, and single-sensor sufficiency on high-evidence ones. We introduce a benchmark based on BEHAVIOR-1K, comprising a fast inference-only diagnostic suite and 47 rollout-based skills targeting modality entanglement. We validate EGR on this benchmark and on two real-robot setups with fundamentally different embodiments: a bi-manual setup with two Kinova arms and three RGB cameras, and a single-arm MELFA ASSISTA setup combining vision and GelSight tactile sensors. EGR improves simulation success rates (SR) from 12.5% to 16.4% under full modalities (+31%), from 9.4% to 16.5% under uninformative-sensor corruption (+75%), and from 2.8% to 6.1% under single-sensor fallback (+120%). Under physical-object distractors, EGR boosts SR from 30% to 85% on the bi-manual setup (+183%) and from 55% to 70% on the tactile setup (+27%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出证据门控正则化（EGR），一种模态无关的训练目标，用于解决VLA策略中的模态纠缠问题（即传感器间的虚假相关性），在零推理开销下显著提升真实机器人和仿真基准在遮挡、干扰和单传感器失效条件下的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在有限且同质的机器人演示数据上训练，容易学习到传感器间的虚假相关性（即模态纠缠），而非任务相关信号。这在真实世界遮挡和干扰物场景下表现为：对无信息传感器损坏的过度敏感，以及仅剩单一信息传感器时的能力不足（单模态不足）。作者旨在解决这一鲁棒性缺陷。
AI.method: EGR通过逐帧、逐传感器地推导任务相关性信号，以此门控两个状态条件一致性目标：(1) 对低证据传感器施加不变性约束；(2) 对高证据传感器施加单传感器充分性约束。该方法是模态无关的，且推理时零额外开销。
AI.result: 在基于BEHAVIOR-1K的基准上：全模态SR从12.5%提升至16.4%（+31%）；无信息传感器损坏下从9.4%提升至16.5%（+75%）；单传感器回退下从2.8%提升至6.1%（+120%）。在真实机器人上：双臂设置（物理干扰物）SR从30%提升至85%（+183%）；触觉设置（单臂MELFA ASSISTA + GelSight）SR从55%提升至70%（+27%）。
AI.conclusion: EGR有效缓解了模态纠缠问题，使VLA策略对传感器损坏、遮挡和物理干扰物更具鲁棒性，且无需修改推理流程。该方法在仿真和两种不同形态的真实机器人上均一致地带来显著性能提升，验证了其通用性。

title: Structural control over equilibrium silicon and oxygen isotopic fractionation: A first-principles density-functional theory study
summary: Isotopic fractionation factors for oxygen and silicon in selected silicates (quartz, enstatite, forsterite, lizardite, kaolinite) have been calculated using first-principles methods. Good agreement between theory and experiment is obtained in the case of oxygen. In the case of silicon, agreement and differences with existing estimates of equilibrium fractionation factors are discussed. The relationships between silicon fractionation factors and oxygen fractionation factors, silicate polymerization degree and chemical composition is studied. The previously stated relationship with the polymerization degree of the mineral is not confirmed. Nevertheless, our calculation suggests that silicon fractionation depends on the cationic content of the mineral, in a way similar to oxygen.  Oxygen fractionation properties could thus provide some insights on silicon fractionation behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用第一性原理方法计算了多种硅酸盐矿物（石英、顽火辉石、镁橄榄石、利蛇纹石、高岭石）中氧和硅的同位素分馏因子，发现氧的理论计算结果与实验吻合良好，并探讨了硅分馏因子与矿物聚合度及化学组成的关系。
AI.motivation: 理解硅酸盐矿物中氧和硅同位素分馏的机理及其控制因素，检验硅分馏因子与矿物聚合度关系的既有假说，并探索氧分馏行为是否能为硅分馏提供预测参考。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理（first-principles）计算方法，对石英、顽火辉石、镁橄榄石、利蛇纹石和高岭石等代表性硅酸盐矿物的氧与硅同位素分馏因子进行从头计算，并与已有的实验值和平衡分馏估计进行对比分析。
AI.result: 氧同位素分馏因子的理论计算与实验结果高度一致；硅同位素分馏因子与已有平衡分馏估计存在部分共识和差异。研究发现硅分馏因子与矿物聚合度的既有关系未得到验证，但硅分馏与矿物阳离子组成存在依赖关系，其规律与氧相似。
AI.conclusion: 硅同位素分馏不受矿物聚合度直接控制，而主要受矿物阳离子组成影响，且该影响模式与氧同位素类似，因此氧同位素分馏特性可为理解和预测硅同位素分馏行为提供有用线索。

title: The Identification of Biological Stains at Crime Scenes: A Promising Role for Proteomics and Machine Learning
summary: Forensic body fluid identification is crucial for reconstructing crime scene events. While DNA analysis provides individualization, it lacks information about the fluid's origin. We developed and evaluated three complementary proteomic approaches using LC-HRMS/MS to identify blood, saliva, semen, urine, and vaginal fluid, including complex mixtures. The first method utilized fluid-specific peptide biomarkers, achieving high accuracy for pure fluids. The second employed peptide abundance ratios, demonstrating effectiveness in body fluid mixtures. The third, a machine learning model using Classifier Chain Random Forest, achieved 100% accuracy for pure fluids and promising results for mixtures. Our results revealed the complementarity of different tests, with the peptide-specific biomarker and machine-learning approaches being the most robust. This study demonstrates the potential of proteomics for comprehensive body fluid identification, offering valuable tools for forensic investigations.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并评估了三种基于LC-HRMS/MS的互补蛋白质组学方法，用于法医学体液鉴定（血液、唾液、精液、尿液、阴道液及其混合物），包括特征肽生物标志物法、肽丰度比值法以及基于链式分类器随机森林的机器学习方法，后者对纯体液达到100%准确率。
AI.motivation: 法医体液鉴定对犯罪现场重建至关重要，但DNA分析只能提供个体识别信息，无法确定体液来源。现有方法对混合体液样本的鉴定尤为困难，亟需开发更全面的体液来源识别技术。
AI.method: 采用液相色谱-高分辨质谱联用（LC-HRMS/MS）技术，开发三种互补蛋白质组学方法：(1)基于体液特异性肽段生物标志物的检测方法；(2)基于肽段丰度比值的分析方法；(3)采用链式分类器随机森林（Classifier Chain Random Forest）的机器学习模型。
AI.result: 特征肽生物标志物方法对纯体液样本达到高准确率；肽丰度比值法在混合体液样本中表现出有效性；机器学习模型对纯体液实现100%准确率，对混合样本也获得有前景的结果。研究发现不同检测方法具有互补性，其中特异性肽段生物标志物法和机器学习方法最为稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了蛋白质组学在全面体液鉴定方面的潜力，为法医调查提供了有价值的工具，尤其可用于纯体液和混合体液的来源判定。

title: Tensor-based Brain Surface Modeling and Analysis
summary: We present a unified computational approach to tensor-based morphometry in detecting the brain surface shape differences between two clinical groups based on magnetic resonance images. Our approach is novel in a sense that we combined surface modeling, surface data smoothing and statistical analysis in a coherent unified mathematical framework. The cerebral cortex has the topology of a 2D highly convoluted sheet. Between two different clinical groups, the local surface area and curvature of the cortex may differ. It is highly likely that such surface shape differences are not uniform over the whole cortex. By computing how such surface metrics differ, the regions of the most rapid structural differences can be localized. To increase the signal to noise ratio, diffusion smoothing based on the explicit estimation of Laplace-Beltrami operator has been developed and applied to the surface metrics. As an illustration, we demonstrate how this new tensor-based surface morphometry can be applied in localizing the cortical regions of the gray matter tissue growth and loss in the brain images longitudinally collected in the group of children.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的张量形态测量学计算方法，用于基于MRI检测两个临床群体之间的脑表面形状差异。该方法结合了表面建模、表面数据平滑和统计分析于一个统一的数学框架中，利用Laplace-Beltrami算子估计的扩散平滑处理表面度量，以定位皮层区域的结构差异。
AI.motivation: 大脑皮层是高度卷曲的二维薄片结构，不同临床群体之间的局部表面积和曲率可能存在差异，且这种差异在全皮层上并不均匀。现有方法缺乏将表面建模、平滑与统计计算统一起来的框架，因此需要一种连贯的计算方法来定位最快速结构差异的区域。
AI.method: 提出一种统一的张量形态测量方法：首先进行皮层表面建模，将皮层视为二维流形；然后基于显式估计的Laplace-Beltrami算子开发扩散平滑，应用于表面度量（局部面积和曲率）以提高信噪比；最后在统一的数学框架中进行统计分析和定位差异区域。
AI.result: 该方法被应用于纵向收集的儿童脑图像中，成功定位了灰质组织生长和损失的皮层区域，验证了该张量表面形态测量方法在实际应用中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为脑表面形状差异检测提供了一种统一的、连贯的计算框架，能够有效定位皮层结构差异区域，在脑发育和疾病研究中具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: Exemplar: Classical Priors Complement Frozen Features for Few-Shot Microscopy Segmentation at Native Resolution
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code, configurations, and the per-image score records behind every reported number: https://github.com/michalprusek/Exemplar
summary: Segmenting a new biomedical dataset usually means a domain-specific model trained on substantial annotation, or a foundation model steered at inference time. We present Exemplar, a few-shot segmenter that fuses a frozen DINOv3 backbone with a fixed bank of classical native-resolution filter responses in one lightweight head, fitted from the support masks alone. In the few-mask, native-resolution regime, classical priors and frozen self-supervised features are complementary: fused in one head, a single fixed configuration spans eleven biomedical imaging datasets. Under the same head, the classical bank alone reaches 0.693 on the eleven-dataset panel, scored by foreground intersection-over-union or centreline Dice, and the frozen features alone 0.672; the bank leads on seven of the eleven and the features on the rest, and fused they reach 0.782. Against five forward-pass few-shot methods, Exemplar leads in 54 of 55 method-dataset comparisons, 52 of them significant after Holm correction. From a single annotated mask it reaches 0.703 on the same panel, against 0.682 for a from-scratch nnU-Net trained on that same mask. At eight masks nnU-Net overtakes it on the panel mean, chiefly on centreline agreement, but takes 16-77x longer to fit.

AI.tldr: Exemplar是一种融合冻结的DINOv3自监督特征与经典原生分辨率滤波器响应的少样本分割器，仅需少量支持掩膜即可在十一个生物医学数据集上以单一固定配置超越多种少样本方法，并在单个注释掩膜情况下优于从头训练的nnU-Net。
AI.motivation: 新生物医学数据集的标注成本高昂且领域特异性强；尽管分割基础模型和领域专用模型是主流方案，但如何在极少量标注（few-shot）下实现跨域泛化的原生分辨率分割仍具挑战，特别是经典图像先验与冻结自监督特征在少掩膜场景下的互补性尚未被系统探索。
AI.method: Exemplar采用轻量级头部结构，融合(i)冻结的DINOv3骨干网络提取的自监督特征与(ii)固定的经典原生分辨率滤波器响应库，仅利用支持集掩膜来拟合该头部，无需微调骨干网络或滤波器库。
AI.result: 在十一个生物医学影像数据集的面板上：经典滤波器库单独达到0.693，冻结特征单独0.672，两者融合后达0.782；在55次方法-数据集比较中Exemplar领先54次，其中52次经Holm校正后显著；单掩膜下达0.703（nnU-Net仅0.682）；八掩膜时nnU-Net在面板均值上反超但拟合耗时为其16-77倍。
AI.conclusion: 经典先验与冻结自监督特征在少掩膜原生分辨率分割中具有强互补性，单一固定配置即可跨十一个数据集泛化。Exemplar验证了无需训练或适配基础模型即可高效实现少样本生物医学分割的可行路径，确立了当前少样本前向传播方法中最优的精度-效率权衡。

title: PrivateHub: Contrastive Diffusion Model for Private Sensor-Intensive Environment Data Generation
summary:
Sensor-intensive environments enable many intelligent services by inferring user applications from heterogeneous data streams. However, not all applications should be exposed: users want some activities to stay private. This creates a tension between inferring applications for useful services and preventing unwanted inference. Existing approaches such as differential privacy and rule-based filtering protect individual streams but cannot address the privacy risk from cross-sensor inference.
  We introduce Privatehub, which uses contrastive learning within a diffusion model to generate synthetic multi-sensor streams that keep non-private applications detectable while concealing private ones. Privatehub has two stages: App-Conditioned Pre-training (ACP), which conditions the model on multi-sensor data with application embeddings, and App-Aware Fine-tuning (AAF), which separates private from non-private data via contrastive learning. We also define a threat model for the multi-sensor sharing setting. Experiments on three real-world multi-sensor datasets show Privatehub lowers private-application accuracy by 40 to 50\% without hurting non-private performance, and stays robust when the attacker retrains on the synthetic data.

AI.tldr: Privatehub是一个基于扩散模型和对比学习的新型隐私保护框架，用于多传感器环境下的数据共享，通过生成合成多传感器数据流，在保持非隐私应用可检测的同时有效隐藏用户隐私应用。
AI.motivation: 传感器密集环境通过异构数据流推断用户应用并提供智能服务，但并非所有应用都应被暴露——用户希望某些活动保持私密。现有方法（如差分隐私和规则过滤）只能保护单个数据流，无法解决跨传感器推断带来的隐私风险。
AI.method: Privatehub采用两个阶段：1) 应用条件预训练（ACP），利用应用嵌入对多传感器数据建模；2) 应用感知微调（AAF），通过对比学习分离隐私与非隐私数据。此外，作者定义了多传感器共享场景下的威胁模型。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界的多传感器数据集上，Privatehub将隐私应用推断准确率降低40%至50%，且不影响非隐私应用的性能；即使在攻击者基于合成数据重新训练的情况下，该方法仍然保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Privatehub有效解决了现有方法无法处理的跨传感器隐私推断问题，在保护用户隐私与维持有用服务之间取得了平衡，并对对抗性重训练攻击具有鲁棒性。

title: Counterexamples as Feedback for Agent Self-Correction
summary: Single-turn code-generation metrics understate a central property of deployed agents: whether they can repair a wrong artifact after receiving concrete feedback. This paper presents A-CEGIS, a lightweight framework that uses counterexamples as feedback for evaluating multi-turn refinement in natural-language-to-regex synthesis. An agent proposes a regex, a deterministic oracle checks it under full-match semantics, and compact false-positive or false-negative witnesses guide the next turn. On 30 NL-RX-Turk tasks, diagnostic counterexample feedback solves 90\% of tasks within a four-turn ablation budget, compared with 17% for zero-shot generation, 27% for generic self-correction, and 23% for error-only feedback. In a full diagnostic run with hardening, all tasks are solved on the hidden set by the final turn, with mean time-to-success of 2.7 turns and robust success of 77% after targeted probing. These results show that A-CEGIS measures how efficiently an agent improves across turns while adding a practical robustness check beyond the original held-out cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-CEGIS，一个轻量级框架，利用反例作为反馈来评估多轮自然语言到正则表达式合成任务中的代码修复能力。实验表明，在30个NL-RX-Turk任务上，诊断性反例反馈在四轮中止预算内解决了90%的任务，远超零样本生成（17%）、通用自我修正（27%）和仅错误反馈（23%）等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有单轮代码生成指标无法反映部署型智能体的核心能力——即收到具体反馈后能否修复错误的产物。需要一种能够在多轮交互环境中评估智能体迭代修复能力的框架。
AI.method: A-CEGIS采用反例作为反馈信号：智能体提出正则表达式，确定性oracle在全匹配语义下进行验证，并生成紧凑的假阳性或假阴性见证（witness）以指导下一轮交互。该框架包含四轮中止消融预算评估以及带强化的完整诊断运行两种测试模式。
AI.result: 在30个NL-RX-Turk任务上：诊断性反例反馈以90%的成功率显著超越基线（零样本17%、通用自修正27%、仅错误反馈23%）；在完整诊断运行中，所有任务在最终轮解决了隐藏集问题，平均2.7轮达到成功，且经定向探测后仍有77%的稳健成功率。
AI.conclusion: A-CEGIS有效衡量智能体跨轮次的改进效率，同时为原始保留测试集之外的鲁棒性提供了一种实用的质询检查方法，弥补了单轮指标在评估实际部署能力方面的不足。

title: From Euclidean to Graph-Structured Data: A Survey of Collaborative Learning
comment: 96 pages. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), March 2026, with Survey Certification
summary: The conventional approach to machine learning, that is, collecting data, training models, and performing inference in a single location, faces fundamental limitations, including scalability and privacy, that restrict its applicability. To address these challenges, recent research has explored collaborative learning approaches, including federated learning and decentralized learning, where individual agents perform training and inference locally, with limited collaboration. Most collaborative learning research focuses on Euclidean data with regular, grid-like structure (e.g., images, text). However, these approaches fail to capture the relational patterns in many real-world applications, best represented by graphs. Learning on graphs relies on message-passing mechanisms to propagate information between connected nodes, making it conceptually well-suited for collaborative environments where agents must exchange information. Yet, the opportunities and challenges of learning on graph-structured data in collaborative settings remain largely underexplored. This survey provides a comprehensive investigation of collaborative learning from Euclidean to graph-structured data, aiming to consolidate this emerging field. We begin by reviewing its foundational principles for Euclidean data, organizing them along three core dimensions: learning effectiveness, efficiency, and privacy preservation. We then extend the discussion to graph-structured data, introducing a taxonomy of graph distribution scenarios, characterizing associated statistical heterogeneities, and developing standardized problem formulations and algorithmic frameworks. Finally, we systematically identify open challenges and promising research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述论文，全面系统地梳理了从欧几里得数据到图结构数据的协作学习领域，涵盖联邦学习与去中心化学习。文章首先在欧几里得数据场景下沿学习效能、效率和隐私保护三个核心维度回顾基础原理，进而将讨论扩展至图结构数据，提出了图分布场景的分类法，刻画了相关统计异质性，并建立了标准化的问题表述和算法框架，最后指出了开放挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习（集中式数据收集、训练与推理）面临可扩展性和隐私方面的根本性限制。协作学习（如联邦学习、去中心化学习）虽已引起广泛关注，但绝大多数研究集中于欧几里得数据（图像、文本等规则网格状结构），而许多真实应用中的关系模式以图结构为最佳表征。图上的学习依赖消息传递机制，在概念上与协作环境中智能体间信息交换天然契合，但该交叉领域尚未被充分探索。因此本文旨在填补这一空白，系统性地梳理并推动协作学习从欧几里得数据向图结构数据的拓展。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，从以下三个层面展开系统分析：(1) 在欧几里得数据场景下，沿学习有效性、学习效率和隐私保护三个核心维度，回顾了协作学习的基础原理与代表性方法；(2) 将讨论延伸到图结构数据场景，提出了一种图数据分布场景的分类法，刻画了不同场景下所伴生的统计异质性，并在此基础上给出了标准化的问题公式化表述与统一的算法框架；(3) 系统性地归纳了该新兴领域面临的开放挑战，并指出了有前景的研究方向。
AI.result: 本文系统整合并梳理了协作学习从欧几里得数据到图结构数据的完整研究脉络，提出了图分布场景的分类体系，覆盖了欧几里得与图数据场景下的标准化问题表述和算法设计框架，并在统一视角下识别出该领域关键的开放性问题与未来研究机遇。
AI.conclusion: 协作学习在欧几里得数据上的研究已形成较为成熟的方法论体系（围绕有效性、效率与隐私三个维度），但将其扩展至图结构数据仍处于早期探索阶段。图上的消息传递机制为协作学习提供了天然契合的通信范式，但图分布场景的多样性与统计异质性带来了新的理论和方法论挑战。该综述为该新兴领域提供了系统的组织框架，同时呼吁研究者关注尚未解决的开放问题，推动协作图学习走向更成熟的发展阶段。

title: LeanGRPO: Eliminating Redundant Recomputation in Diffusion RL
summary: Diffusion reinforcement learning (RL) has recently achieved significant success in post-training image and video generative models. However, most diffusion RL methods, including DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, recompute selected timesteps with gradient tracking after rollout. Under on-policy training with the same backend for rollout and update, this recomputation is mathematically redundant. Intuitively, the rollout and policy update steps can reuse the same feed-forward backbone to avoid redundant computation, but doing so can incur a large memory overhead during rollout.
