To address the issue, we present LeanGRPO by restructuring the data-parallel layout and introducing two recompute-free training schedules for trajectory-logprob diffusion RL: (1) LeanGRPO-Retain enables gradient tracking during rollout and directly reuses the resulting computation graphs and saved activations for backward during update, requiring no recomputation; and (2) LeanGRPO-Reweight also enables gradients during rollout, but immediately backpropagates each selected step using a provisional advantage and delays gradient synchronization, then corrects the provisional gradients with the true advantage after the trajectory is completed. These schedules target different model scales and input sizes. Across FlowGRPO/DanceGRPO with FLUX.1-dev and Wan, LeanGRPO achieves up to 1.83x end-to-end speedup while preserving the original optimization objective.

AI.tldr: LeanGRPO通过重组数据并行布局并引入两种免重算训练调度（Retain和Reweight），消除扩散强化学习（如FlowGRPO/DanceGRPO）中rollout与更新阶段对选定时间步的冗余前向重算，在FLUX.1-dev和Wan上实现高达1.83倍端到端加速且不改变优化目标。
AI.motivation: 大多数扩散强化学习方法（如DanceGRPO、FlowGRPO）在rollout后会以梯度跟踪方式重新计算选定的时间步。在on-policy训练且rollout与更新共用同一后端的条件下，这种重算在数学上是冗余的。虽然可以复用前馈骨干网络避免冗余计算，但会在rollout阶段带来巨大的显存开销。因此需要一种方法在不引入重算的情况下复用计算图来加速训练。
AI.method: 提出LeanGRPO框架，包含两项关键技术：(1) 重组数据并行布局（restructuring data-parallel layout）以缓解显存压力；(2) 两种免重算训练调度：LeanGRPO-Retain在rollout期间启用梯度跟踪，直接复用计算图与保存的激活值进行update阶段的backward，无需任何重算；LeanGRPO-Reweight同样在rollout期间启用梯度，但使用临时优势值（provisional advantage）立即对每个选定步骤做反传并延迟梯度同步，待轨迹完成后用真实优势值修正临时梯度。两种调度分别针对不同模型规模与输入尺寸进行适配。
AI.result: 在FlowGRPO与DanceGRPO框架下，基于FLUX.1-dev和Wan模型进行实验，LeanGRPO实现了最高1.83倍的端到端加速，同时保持原有的优化目标不变。
AI.conclusion: LeanGRPO验证了在on-policy扩散RL中rollout与更新可共享前向计算以消除冗余重算的可行性，通过两种针对不同规模/输入尺寸的免重算调度，在保持优化目标的前提下显著提升训练效率，为扩散模型后训练阶段的强化学习提供了高效的加速方案。

title: BASP: Communication-Efficient Batch-Aware Sequence Parallelism for LLM Training
summary: Long-context reasoning for large language models (LLMs) is becoming increasingly important, but training over long sequences remains challenging due to massive memory and communication requirements. Sequence parallelism has emerged as an essential technique for addressing bottlenecks in long sequence LLM training. However, we observe that existing sequence parallelism methods are batch-agnostic and apply uniform sequence partitioning across all batch sizes, resulting in inefficient communication. In this paper, we introduce Batch- Aware Sequence Parallelism (BASP), a sequence parallelism approach that leverages batch structure to reduce communication overhead. BASP exploits batch structure by partitioning GPUs into disjoint sequence-parallel groups according to the micro- batch size. This design reduces the all-to-all communication group size, thereby localizing communication and improving training efficiency. Experimental results on an NVIDIA A100 cluster show that BASP improves end-to-end training time by up to 1.17 - 1.31x in Llama and Qwen models compared to standard sequence parallel baselines, while preserving identical model accuracy and memory usage.

AI.tldr: 提出批感知序列并行（BASP）方法，利用微批大小将GPU划分为不相交的序列并行组，缩小all-to-all通信组规模以降低通信开销，在A100集群上实现1.17-1.31倍训练加速且不损失精度和内存。
AI.motivation: 长序列推理对LLM日益重要，但长序列训练受限于巨大的内存和通信需求。现有序列并行方法忽略批大小结构，对所有batch大小采用统一的序列划分，导致通信效率低下。
AI.method: 提出BASP，根据微批大小将GPU划分为不相交的序列并行组，缩小all-to-all通信组尺寸，使通信局部化，从而降低通信开销并提升训练效率。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA A100集群上，与标准序列并行基线相比，BASP在Llama和Qwen模型上的端到端训练时间提升1.17-1.31倍，同时保持完全相同的模型精度和内存使用。
AI.conclusion: BASP通过感知batch结构优化序列并行中的通信模式，在不牺牲模型精度和内存的情况下显著提升长序列训练效率。

title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
summary: Distributed LLM-agent teams can read the latest shared facts and still act on an obsolete plan. A planner may derive an action from requirement $r_3$, another agent may commit $r_4$, and an executor may receive $r_4$ without replacing the plan derived from $r_3$. We call this \emph{stale-plan execution}: state freshness does not establish that the plan authorizing an action remains valid. We introduce PlanFence, a dependency-scoped action-validation protocol. Plans cite the exact public records they used, and an executor validates only the records that can affect the pending external action, replanning once or blocking when validation is incomplete. In 30 controlled live workflows with a post-plan revision, a freshness-only executor acts on the obsolete plan in every task, whereas PlanFence completes all tasks without an invalid action. Controlled replay reveals two conditional boundaries: proactive synchronization yields lower coordination stall at low churn, while PlanFence avoids repeated update-path coordination as churn grows and avoids validating unrelated state as the shared keyspace grows. These are controlled safety and systems-cost results, not general task-accuracy gains.

title: Real-Time Shape Control of Multi-Segment Soft Robotic Arms Using Koopman Operators with Global and Local Observables
summary: Multi-segment soft robotic arms can continuously reconfigure their body shapes for safe interaction, but tip control alone is insufficient for constrained-space tasks. Therefore, shape control is a more important task for multi-segment soft arms than tip control, but remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and nonlinear dynamics of continuum deformation. In existing work, shape control accuracy is defined by the error in the global frame (global shape error). For multi-segment soft arms, using only global shape error as the control objective is insufficient, as segment coupling, gravity-induced loading, and inertial effects become more significant. This difficulty increases with the number of segments. In this paper, we present a Koopman-based model predictive control framework that combines global and local observables, enabling real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms. The framework is evaluated through numerical and physical experiments. Numerical experiments demonstrate the scalability of the proposed controller by achieving shape control on robots with up to 10 independently actuated segments. The physical experiments demonstrate that the controller is capable of (1) real-time shape control of 3- and 5-segment robotic arms with tip speeds up to 0.6 m/s, (2) robust tracking without retraining, including distal payloads up to 400~g and recovery from a 7~N lateral disturbance, and (3) the potential for future inspection applications through a confined-space demonstration. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables dynamic, scalable, and accurate real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Koopman模型预测控制的框架，通过结合全局与局部可观测变量，实现多段软体机械臂的实时形状控制。数值实验验证了在多达10个独立驱动段上的可扩展性，物理实验展示了在3段和5段机械臂上最高0.6 m/s的实时形状控制、无需重训练的鲁棒追踪（可承受400g远端负载和7N侧向扰动），并通过受限空间演示了潜在检测应用。
AI.motivation: 多段软体机械臂虽然能够连续重构自身形状以进行安全交互，但仅依靠末端控制不足以完成受限空间任务，因此形状控制更为关键。然而，由于连续体变形的高维性和非线性动力学，现有方法仅以全局坐标系下的形状误差作为控制目标是不够的——分段耦合、重力载荷和惯性效应随着段数增加而更加显著，导致形状控制的难度显著增大。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于Koopman算子的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，将全局和局部可观测变量相结合，实现对多段软体机械臂的实时形状控制。该方法通过Koopman理论将非线性动力学提升到线性空间中进行预测与控制。
AI.result: 数值实验表明控制器可扩展到多达10个独立驱动段；物理实验中控制器实现了：(1) 3段和5段机械臂最高0.6 m/s末端速度下的实时形状控制；(2) 无需重新训练的鲁棒追踪，包括承受400g远端负载和从7N侧向扰动中恢复；(3) 受限空间演示验证了未来检测应用的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架实现了多段软体机械臂的动态、可扩展且精确的实时形状控制，证明了结合全局与局部可观测量的Koopman MPC方法在实际软体机器人系统中的有效性和应用前景。

title: Inferring Affective Consciousness in an Artificial Agent: A Case Study
summary: Creatures that display 'hedonic place preference behaviour' are thought by many scientists to experience feelings, on the assumption that their attraction to pleasure-producing substances which lack nutritional value (e.g. cocaine, morphine) cannot easily be attributed to unconscious instinctual behaviour. In this paper, we discuss how a simple artificial agent that instantiates attributes of an affective system engaging in felt uncertainty about its intrinsic needs in relation to environmental resources can similarly display hedonic place preference behaviour -- through an apparently subjective form of information processing -- while simultaneously being entirely deter-ministic. We outline some implications of this artificially engineered behaviour for our understanding of the physical basis of consciousness and the experience of free will.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了一个完全确定性的简单人工代理如何模拟奖赏性场所偏好行为（类似动物的奖赏偏好行为），通过实例化情感系统中对内在需求与环境资源关系的不确定性感受处理来实现，并讨论了这一行为对意识物理基础和自由意志体验的含义。
AI.motivation: 许多科学家将"享乐性场所偏好行为"视为动物体验情感的证据，因为动物对无营养价值物质（如可卡因、吗啡）的趋近很难归因于无意识本能。作者希望通过构建一个完全确定性的简单人工代理来展示类似行为，从而质疑这种推论，并深入探讨意识的物理基础与自由意志问题。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个简单的人工代理，其实例化了情感系统的属性，使其对自身内在需求与环境资源之间的关系进行"不确定性的感受性"信息处理。尽管该代理是完全确定性的，它仍能表现出类似享乐性场所偏好的行为模式。
AI.result: 该完全确定性的简单人工代理能够展示出享乐性场所偏好行为，但这种行为是通过一种看似主观的信息处理方式实现的，而非真正的意识体验，揭示了确定性系统中也可能涌现出看似有意向性的行为特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过展示确定性人工代理也能产生类似奖赏偏好的行为，作者提出这一发现对理解意识的物理基础和自由意志体验具有重要启示，暗示某些被视为意识证据的行为可能并不足以证明真正的意识经验。

title: Solving the Needle-in-a-Haystack Problem in Mammography Vision-Language Model with Differentiable Subset Sampling
summary: There is growing interest in adopting CLIP-style vision--language model (VLM) pretraining for mammography. However, models that directly employ the standard CLIP architecture and training objective exhibit limited zero-shot performance in clinically important tasks such as cancer, finding-type, and BI-RADS predictions. We argue that this underwhelming performance is due to neglecting two characteristics of mammography data: (1) its high-res nature, and (2) homogeneity of radiology reports, largely driven by a predominance of negative/benign findings on examinations. We propose TopKSigLIP, a VLM designed to address these two limitations through a novel architecture and learning objectives. Instead of downscaling high-res mammography images to satisfy GPU memory constraints, TopKSigLIP introduces TopK-Patch module that learns to sample a sparse set of high-res patches likely to contain lesions, sidestepping the resolution--batch size tradeoff of VLM training. The sampled patch locations additionally serve as a built-in localization tool. To address report homogeneity, we replace the contrastive loss, which falsely repels semantically similar pairs, with a Sup-sigmoid loss. Sup-sigmoid loss extends the sigmoid loss from SigLIP with soft labels derived from structured data. TopKSigLIP outperforms existing open-source mammography and general medical VLMs on both internal and external benchmarks on density assessment, BI-RADS classification, finding subtyping, and cancer prediction under zero-shot evaluation. TopKSigLIP remains competitive under linear probing despite using a significantly smaller vision encoder and smaller training batches than baselines. The TopK-Patch module additionally achieves superior lesion localization over post-hoc Grad-CAM. Code and weights are made public:https://github.com/Youngseok0001/TopKSigLIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopKSigLIP，一个针对乳腺X线摄影优化的视觉-语言模型(VLM)，通过TopK-Patch模块处理高分辨率图像并采用Sup-sigmoid损失应对报告同质性，在零样本分类和病灶定位等临床任务上超越现有开源乳腺和通用医学VLM。
AI.motivation: 标准CLIP架构直接用于乳腺X线摄影VLM预训练时，在癌症预测、发现类型分类和BI-RADS预测等临床重要任务上零样本性能有限。作者认为原因在于忽视了乳腺X线数据的两个特点：(1)高分辨率特性；(2)放射学报告的高度同质性，主要由阴性/良性发现主导。
AI.method: TopKSigLIP包含两大核心设计：(1) TopK-Patch模块——学习采样稀疏的高分辨率图像块子集，这些块很可能包含病灶，从而规避VLM训练中分辨率与批大小的权衡，且采样位置本身可作为内置定位工具；(2) Sup-sigmoid损失——替换对比损失(对比损失会错误地区分语义相似的样本对)，该损失将SigLIP的sigmoid损失扩展到使用结构化数据导出的软标签。
AI.result: TopKSigLIP在密度评估、BI-RADS分类、发现亚型分类和癌症预测等零样本评估任务中，在内部和外部基准上均优于现有开源乳腺和通用医学VLM。在线性探测下，尽管使用更小的视觉编码器和更小的训练批次，仍保持竞争力。TopK-Patch模块在病灶定位上优于事后Grad-CAM方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用架构(TopK-Patch)和损失函数(Sup-sigmoid)显式建模高分辨率与报告同质性两大数据特性，可显著提升乳腺X线摄影VLM的临床零样本性能与可解释定位能力，代码和权重已开源。

title: When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization
summary: This paper focuses on defending generative search engines against malicious Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), which rewrites web documents to match engines' citation preferences and thereby manipulates generated answers. Recent GEO methods have advanced from hand-crafted rewriting to automated and agentic optimization, substantially increasing the visibility of target documents in generated answers. However, defending against such manipulation poses two major challenges: attack documents remain factually consistent with their originals, rendering fact verification and perplexity filtering ineffective, and the features they amplify equally characterize high-quality benign content. To address these limitations, we propose GEO Defender, a two-stage defense aligned with the attack chain that requires no fine-tuning of the target LLM. GEO Defender consists of Shield Reranker and Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG). Specifically, Shield Reranker learns a preference-based defensive residual over a frozen base reranker, demoting GEO-rewritten documents while preserving relevance judgments, and TFSG distills defense outcomes into a natural-language experience library that guides the target LLM's source use at inference. Experiments on two state-of-the-art closed-source LLMs and three open-source LLMs across seven GEO attacks demonstrate that GEO Defender reduces the average attack success rate from 50.32% to 6.20%, retains 94.12% of benign-evidence use, preserves answer quality, and generalizes to unseen attacks from construction instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEO Defender，一种针对生成式搜索引擎对抗生成引擎优化（GEO）攻击的两阶段防御框架，包含Shield Reranker和Training-Free Shield Generation两个组件，无需微调目标LLM即可将攻击成功率从50.32%降至6.20%，同时保持94.12%的良性证据使用率。
AI.motivation: 生成式搜索引擎易受GEO攻击操纵，攻击文档与原始文档保持事实一致，使得现有的事实验证和困惑度过滤方法失效；同时攻击所放大的特征与高质量良性内容特征高度相似，难以区分。现有防御手段无法有效应对从手工改写发展到自动化、智能体优化的GEO攻击。
AI.method: 提出两阶段防御框架GEO Defender，沿攻击链设计：(1) Shield Reranker：在冻结的基础重排序器之上学习基于偏好的防御残差，压制被GEO改写的文档同时保持相关性判断；(2) Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG)：将防御结果蒸馏为自然语言经验库，在推理时引导目标LLM的源文档使用决策。该方法无需微调目标LLM。
AI.result: 在两个先进闭源LLM和三个开源LLM上，对七种GEO攻击进行实验，GEO Defender将平均攻击成功率从50.32%降至6.20%，保留94.12%的良性证据使用，保持答案质量，并能泛化到未见攻击。
AI.conclusion: GEO Defender通过两阶段、无需微调的防御设计，在有效抵御GEO操纵的同时兼顾了对良性内容的保护与答案质量，展现出对未知攻击的泛化能力，为生成式搜索引擎的对抗性防御提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Probe Generalization as Subspace Selection for OOD Deception Detection
summary: Linear probes can be used to detect behaviors and concepts inside language model activations, but may fail to transfer to out-of-distribution examples. When studying the generalization performance of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct probes over 3 held-out deception detection datasets, we find that projecting inputs onto a small subset of principal components (PCs) from the training distribution of activations enables cross-domain transfer that nearly matches the performance of probes trained directly on the test distribution. Furthermore, we find that PC interpretations can be used to find a subset of those transferable PCs. By using an LLM judge to score each PC on whether its most/ least activating examples imply a transferable deception direction, then probing on the highest-scoring PCs, we close the baseline-to-oracle gap by 78% on Insider Trading Report and by 25% on Sandbagging. The directions a source probe weights heavily appear to encode source-specific surface features, while the directions that actually transfer appear to encode the same contrast more abstractly, in a way natural language descriptions can capture. Broadly, our results suggest that the OOD robustness of probes is largely determined by subspace selection.

AI.tldr: 本文发现线性探针在语言模型激活上的跨域泛化失败主要源于子空间选择问题。通过将激活投影到训练分布的一小部分主成分上，可以在未见过的欺骗检测数据集上实现接近直接在测试分布上训练探针的性能。进一步利用LLM评委对各主成分进行自然语言解释评分，选择可迁移的主成分，在Insider Trading Report上缩小了78%的基线到oracle差距，在Sandbagging上缩小了25%。
AI.motivation: 线性探针可用于检测语言模型激活中的行为与概念，但在分布外（OOD）样本上常出现迁移失败。作者旨在理解并解决探针跨域迁移的泛化问题，探究其OOD鲁棒性由什么决定。
AI.method: 以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为模型，使用3个未见过的欺骗检测数据集评估探针泛化性能。方法包括：(1) 将激活投影到训练分布的主成分（PCs）子集上以提升跨域迁移；(2) 利用LLM评委对每个PC的最高/最低激活示例进行语义解释，打分判断其是否暗示可迁移的欺骗方向；(3) 在得分最高的PCs上进行探针训练。
AI.result: 投影到少量主成分上即可实现几乎与直接在测试分布上训练探针相近的跨域迁移性能。通过PC语义解释筛选，可在Insider Trading Report上关闭78%的基线到oracle差距，在Sandbagging上关闭25%。还发现源探针权重较大的方向编码源特定的表面特征，而真正可迁移的方向以更抽象的方式编码相同对比，这些抽象方向可由自然语言描述捕捉。
AI.conclusion: 探针的OOD鲁棒性很大程度上由子空间选择所决定。自然语言解释可作为选择可迁移子空间的可行途径，为跨域探针泛化提供了实践指导。

title: Modern Transformers Are Implicit Hybrids: From Functional Differentiation to Principled Hybrid Architecture Design
summary: Hybrid architectures combining Full Attention (FA) and Linear Attention (LA) are increasingly prominent, yet their allocation remains heuristic. We seek an evidence-grounded basis in head-level functional organization learned by RoPE-based Transformers. Behavioral probes do not yield a complete taxonomy, so we propose two intervention metrics: RoPE Frequency Importance Score (RFIS), measuring how each frequency affects a head's attention distribution, and RoPE Positional Dependence (RPD), isolating dependence on rotary positional modulation. On Qwen3-series models and Llama3.1, RFIS suggests and RPD verifies a complete taxonomy of retrieval and positional heads separated by a salient mid-low-frequency band. Controlled Transformers show that this boundary follows the training-length positional scale; we term it the Global Positional Band (GPBand). The analysis suggests a potential cause of zero-shot length-extrapolation failure and yields two principles: positional modeling should operate only locally, with global access through position-independent retrieval; and both functions should be assigned at head granularity with layer-specific allocation. We instantiate them in Head-wise Hybrid Architecture (HwH), using NoPE FA for global retrieval and LA for local positional modeling. With an FA-to-LA ratio below 1:3, HwH retains strong language modeling and commonsense reasoning while improving retrieval and substantially strengthening zero-shot long-context extrapolation over Transformer, LA, and a layer-wise hybrid baseline. Ablations validate both principles and component roles, highlighting principled hybrid architecture design as a promising route toward future foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种干预指标（RFIS和RPD），对基于RoPE的Transformer头级功能组织进行了系统分析，发现了检索头与位置头之间的"全局位置带"（GPBand）边界。基于此提出了两个设计原则，并实例化为头级混合架构（HwH），在极低的FA:LA比例（<1:3）下实现了强语言建模、推理能力提升以及大幅增强的零样本长上下文外推性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全注意力（FA）与线性注意力（LA）混合架构的分配方式依赖于启发式规则，缺乏实证依据。作者希望从RoPE-based Transformer中头级功能的组织结构出发，寻找证据驱动的混合架构设计准则，从而替代主观启发式分配方法。
AI.method: 提出两种干预指标：(1) RFIS（RoPE频率重要性分数），衡量每个频率对头注意力分布的影响程度；(2) RPD（RoPE位置依赖度），隔离头对旋转位置调制的依赖性。在Qwen3系列和Llama3.1上验证，并在可控Transformer实验中探索GPBand边界与训练长度位置尺度的关系。最终实例化为HwH架构：使用NoPE FA处理全局检索，LA处理局部位置建模，按头粒度进行层特定分配。
AI.result: RFIS与RPD共同验证了一个完整的头分类体系：检索头与位置头之间存在显著的"中低频带"分离边界（即GPBand）。该边界随训练长度位置尺度变化。HwH在FA:LA比例低于1:3的情况下，保持了强的语言建模和常识推理能力，同时改善了检索性能并显著增强零样本长上下文外推能力，均优于标准Transformer、纯LA以及逐层混合基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了论文提出的两个原则：(1) 位置建模应仅在局部操作，全局访问依赖位置无关的检索机制；(2) 两种功能应按头粒度分配且具有层特定配置。消融实验证实了两个原则及各组件角色的必要性，说明基于原理的混合架构设计是通向未来基础模型的有前景途径。

title: AI-Assisted Design of a Post-Quantum Cryptographic Accelerator: A Deployed-Silicon Case Study
summary: Post-quantum migration is mandated on published timelines, and silicon that ships with a defect cannot be patched remotely. The standard acceptance gate cannot detect an entire class of ML-DSA defects. Signing resamples until a candidate meets its norm bounds, so the executed path varies with the message, whereas known-answer tests (KATs) sample fixed values and reach only the depths their seeds trigger. Our accelerator passed its full KAT regression while carrying a norm check that outran block-RAM latency, leaving each candidate's final coefficients unverified; the escape surfaced at reject-loop iteration 5. The blind spot lies in the instrument, not the engineer; care cannot remove it. We replace that gate. A byte-exact golden-reference oracle paired with randomized adversarial soak drives the rejection loop past any fixed vector, closing the gap: 301,343 data-dependent signings, zero escapes. Because the gate judges artifacts and never authors, trust becomes separable from authorship, making AI authorship an answerable question. We report 232 logged experiments in which an agentic large language model drove a unified ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 accelerator with on-chip key custody from RTL to PCIe bring-up on one Kintex-7 XC7K160T, shipped at 98.5% slice occupancy. Success was 71.6%, following a hardware-coupling gradient, 77-85% for documentation and research against 50-53% for synthesis and bring-up, which observability can explain: failure concentrates where corrective signals are physical-side only. That so unreliable an author produced an artifact byte-exact across all six FIPS operations -- its deployed baseline surviving the same 779,945-check zero-failure soak -- is the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了后量子密码（PQC）硬件验收中的一个关键盲区：ML-DSA签名的拒绝采样循环依赖消息数据驱动路径，而标准已知答案测试（KAT）仅覆盖固定种子可达的浅层路径，无法触发规范检查器超越块RAM延迟的缺陷。作者提出以字节精确的金标准参考预言机结合随机对抗浸泡测试替代传统验收门，在301,343次数据依赖签名中实现零逃逸。作者还报告了由智能体LLM从RTL到PCIe启动全程驱动的ML-KEM-768与ML-DSA-65统一加速器（Kintex-7 XC7K160T）实验，成功率71.6%，尽管作者在综合和启动阶段可靠性较低，其产出的工件在全部六项FIPS操作上字节精确，并通过779,945次检查的零失败浸泡测试。
AI.motivation: 标准验收门无法检测整类ML-DSA缺陷：KAT用固定种子采样只能到达有限深度，无法覆盖由消息决定的执行路径变化。作者实际遇到的逃逸案例（规范检查器超块RAM延迟导致最终系数未验证，在第5次拒绝循环迭代暴露）证明该盲区存在于仪器本身而非工程师失职，任何审慎都无法消除，因此必须替换该验收门。
AI.method: 采用双管齐下的验证方法：(1) 字节精确的金标准参考预言机作为验收判据；(2) 随机化对抗浸泡驱动拒绝循环超越固定向量覆盖范围。在代理实验中，由智能体LLM驱动统一的ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65加速器（含片上密钥托管）完成RTL到PCIe启动全流程，记录232个日志化实验。
AI.result: 新验收方法经301,343次数据依赖签名测试零逃逸。代理实验中LLM驱动的整体成功率为71.6%，且呈现硬件耦合梯度：文档与研究类任务成功率达77-85%，而综合与启动类仅50-53%，可观测性缺失解释此差异。在部署基线上779,945次检查的浸泡测试同样零失败，所有六项FIPS操作字节精确。
AI.conclusion: 传统KAT验收门存在原理性盲区，必须以数据依赖的随机对抗测试替代或补充。将验收判据设为对工件的判断而非对作者的评判，使"可信"与"作者身份"可分离，从而使AI作者身份成为一个可回答的问题——一个整体成功率仅71.6%的不可靠LLM作者，仍能产出通过全部FIPS操作字节精确验收与大规模零失败浸泡的硬件工件。

title: Carbon-aware Resource Management for Latency-Sensitive Cloud Computing Environments: A Taxonomy and Future Directions
summary: Proliferation of cloud-based latency-sensitive workloads requires infrastructures tuned to their workload-specific latency constraints. Today, they shape the cloud from a generalized computing platform to diverse workload-specific cloud environments. As the demand for latency-sensitive workloads increases, cloud service providers continue to scale their infrastructure, adversely increasing the carbon footprint and challenging climate-crisis-driven net-zero emission goals. Due to performance-oriented rigid deployment patterns of latency-optimizations, reducing its carbon footprint is challenging. Therefore, efficient techniques that exploit application specific opportunities are needed in that. To this end, we present a detailed taxonomy of recent literature on carbon-aware resource management in latency-sensitive cloud computing environments. Using the taxonomy, we analyze existing works discussing their optimization aspects, identify the gaps, and highlight future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文对延迟敏感型云计算环境中碳感知资源管理的最新文献进行了系统性的分类学分析，通过构建细粒度分类体系来审视现有工作的优化方面，识别研究缺口并指出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 延迟敏感型云工作负载的激增导致云基础设施大规模扩展，碳排放足迹显著增加，与净零排放目标相悖。由于延迟优化采用性能导向的刚性部署模式，降低其碳足迹具有挑战性，亟需利用应用特定机会的碳感知资源管理技术。
AI.method: 提出一个详细的分类法（taxonomy），对延迟敏感型云计算环境中碳感知资源管理的最新文献进行分类和组织，并基于该分类法分析现有工作在各方面的优化特性。
AI.result: 通过分类法系统分析了现有文献的优化方面，识别出当前研究中存在的空白与不足，并提出了未来研究方向的建议。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了延迟敏感型云计算碳感知资源管理的系统性综述与分类框架，为后续研究者在优化碳足迹的同时满足延迟约束提供了参考蓝图，填补了该交叉领域缺乏结构化认知的空白。

title: A Prompt-Engineering Approach to Develop Scalable, Flexible, and Real-Time Hybrid Micro-Level Personalization in a General Purpose AI Teaching Assistant
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) teaching assistants powered by large language models (LLMs) offer scalable educational support but often provide limited personalization. This study presents a prompt-engineering-based framework for personalizing general-purpose LLM/RAG-based AI teaching assistants such as Jill Watson across academic disciplines and courses. The framework adapts responses using six learner-specific dimensions: self-assessment, abstraction preference, verbosity preference, perceptual orientation, information processing style, and level of understanding, yielding 96 distinct learner profiles. Student queries are additionally analyzed using Bloom's Taxonomy to estimate cognitive complexity at the interaction level. Learner attributes and cognitive assessments are encoded in structured prompts that condition the LLM without requiring model retraining. The framework is evaluated through experiments using NLP metrics and a human study with five participants. Results show perceived differences in response style and structure across personalization conditions, with statistical analyses identifying learner attributes associated with measurable response changes. These findings provide preliminary evidence that prompt-based personalization can support adaptive behavior in LLM-powered educational agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于提示工程的框架，用于个性化基于LLM/RAG的AI教学助手（如Jill Watson），通过六个学习者维度（自我评估、抽象偏好、冗长偏好、感知取向、信息处理风格、理解水平）生成96种学习者画像，并结合布鲁姆分类法评估交互层面的认知复杂度，最终通过NLP指标和5人人类研究验证了提示驱动的个性化能够引发LLM教学代理的适应性行为。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的AI教学助手虽提供可扩展的教育支持，但缺乏个性化能力，难以满足不同学习者的差异化学习需求。
AI.method: 提出基于提示工程的个性化框架：1) 定义六个学习者维度（自我评估、抽象偏好、冗长偏好、感知取向、信息处理风格、理解水平），组合产生96种个性化画像；2) 使用布鲁姆分类法分析学生查询的认知复杂度；3) 将学习者属性与认知评估编码为结构化提示条件化LLM，无需模型微调。
AI.result: 通过NLP度量指标和5名参与者的人类研究评估，结果显示不同个性化条件下响应风格和结构存在可感知差异，统计分析识别出与可测响应变化相关的主要学习者属性，为提示驱动个性化的有效性提供了初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 提示驱动的个性化可以为LLM教育代理提供自适应行为支持，为无需重新训练模型即可实现个性化教育人工智能提供了一种可行路径。

title: Following a Unique Path: A Fast Certifier Applied to Outlier-Robust Pose Registration
summary: Certifiable methods have arisen as a means to guarantee global optimality of solutions to non-convex problems using convex semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations. The most performant of these methods use a local solver to obtain the candidate solution, and then certify its optimality using efficient linear algebra techniques. However, for many problems of interest in robotics, this local-solve-then-certify approach is impeded by a form of degeneracy in the relaxation, leaving a costly optimization of the relaxation as the only recourse. In this paper, we introduce our Central-Path Certifier (CP-Cert), a certifiable method explicitly tailored to certify candidate optima to problems that exhibit this form of degeneracy. Using a candidate as a starting point, our approach seeks a nearby region of the feasible space -- known as the central path -- where a valid certificate can be readily obtained. The approach is kept efficient by exploiting indirect linear algebra techniques, problem sparsity, and parallelism. We apply CP-Cert to both matrix-weighted pose registration and pointcloud data association, whose novel SDP relaxation is of independent interest. On simulated examples, we explore the properties of this novel relaxation and show that CP-Cert is fast and scalable, achieving runtimes that are up to three orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art direct solvers. Finally, we combine these contributions into a certifiable, outlier-robust pose-estimation pipeline, which we apply to real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Central-Path Certifier (CP-Cert)，一种专门针对半定规划松弛退化问题的可认证方法。该方法从候选解出发，在可行空间中寻找靠近中心路径的区域以获得有效证书，通过间接线性代数技术、问题稀疏性和并行性保持高效，并应用于矩阵加权位姿配准和点云数据关联问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的可认证方法通常采用"局部求解然后认证"的策略，即先用局部求解器获得候选解，再通过高效的线性代数技术验证其最优性。然而对于机器人领域的许多问题，松弛中存在的某种退化形式阻碍了这一方法，导致只能依赖代价高昂的松弛优化，这严重限制了方法的可扩展性和实用性。
AI.method: CP-Cert方法以候选解为起点，在可行空间中寻找一个靠近中心路径的近邻区域，在该区域中可以直接获得有效的最优性证书。方法利用间接线性代数技术、问题稀疏结构以及并行计算保持高效性。同时提出了一种新颖的SDP松弛用于点云数据关联问题。
AI.result: CP-Cert在矩阵加权位姿配准和点云数据关联问题上进行了验证，运行速度比最先进的直接求解器快至多三个数量级。最后将算法整合为完整的可认证、抗离群值位姿估计管线，并在真实数据上进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: CP-Cert成功解决了具有松弛退化问题的可认证优化中"局部求解后认证"策略失效的难题，提供了一种高效且可扩展的替代方案，并展现出在真实机器人应用中的实用价值。

title: Prospective Coding Improves Learning in Deep Continuous-Time Recurrent Networks
summary: Temporal integration gives continuous-time recurrent networks memory, but in deep stacks it also delays bottom-up signals and attenuates top-down errors. We develop Recursive Quadrature Filters (RQFs), biologically motivated complex-valued temporal filters that are a special case of diagonal state-space models (SSMs), and ask whether this failure mode can be addressed by making each layer's bottom-up input prospective. Starting from an energy model, we derive the RQF dynamics and show that each RQF is a band-pass filter whose learnable parameters control its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We then make each layer's bottom-up input prospective using a parameter-free two-tap update that leaves the recurrent transition and parallel scan unchanged. We extend this correction to general diagonal SSMs and show that it mitigates depth-dependent gradient attenuation when temporal gradients are truncated, i.e., spatial-only backpropagation. We evaluate the intervention in RQFs, S5, and ORGaNICs (a nonlinear gated RNN) trained using full backpropagation through time (BPTT) and spatial-only backpropagation. Under full BPTT, prospective variants match or outperform their non-prospective controls in every model and configuration. A non-residual width-32 six-layer RQF reaches 96.09% accuracy on raw-audio Speech Commands with 31.9k parameters; a width-64 six-layer RQF reaches 83.56% on the 16,384-step Path-X task. These results identify RQFs as a parameter-efficient recurrent substrate and prospective-input coding as an input-side correction for deep continuous-time recurrent networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归正交滤波器（RQFs）——一类特殊的对角状态空间模型（SSM）的复数时间滤波器，并引入"前瞻输入编码"（prospective-input coding）修正，以解决深度连续时间循环网络中底层输入信号延迟和顶层误差衰减的问题。前瞻变体在多种模型和配置下均匹配或超越非前瞻控制，并在Speech Commands和Path-X任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 连续时间循环网络通过时间积分获得记忆，但在深层堆叠中会延迟自底向上的信号并衰减自顶向下的误差。作者希望探究是否可以通过使每一层的底向输入成为"前瞻性的"来缓解这一失效模式。
AI.method: 从能量模型出发推导RQF动力学，证明每个RQF是带通滤波器，其可学习参数控制调谐频率和带宽。通过无参数的两步更新使每层底向输入前瞻化，保持递归转移和并行扫描不变。将该修正扩展到一般对角SSM，并在时间梯度截断（仅空间反向传播）情境下缓解深度依赖的梯度衰减。评估于RQF、S5和ORGaNICs三种模型上，分别使用全BPTT和空间-only反向传播训练。
AI.result: 全BPTT下，前瞻变体在所有模型和配置中均匹配或超越非前瞻控制。非残差宽度32的六层RQF在raw-audio Speech Commands上以31.9k参数达到96.09%准确率；宽度64的六层RQF在16,384步Path-X任务上达到83.56%。
AI.conclusion: RQFs是参数高效的递归基板，前瞻输入编码可作为深度连续时间递归网络在输入侧的修正手段，有效解决深层时间积分带来的信号延迟与梯度衰减问题。

title: WireSeg-32K: A Physics-Grounded Synthetic Dataset for Wire Instance Segmentation
comment: Synthetic Data for Computer Vision @ CVPR 2026 Workshop
summary: Deformable linear objects such as wires and cables are difficult to segment because they are thin, highly deformable, and frequently self-occluded, while large-scale instance-level annotations are expensive to obtain in real scenes. Existing resources either focus on cable tracing or semantic segmentation under constrained settings, or generate visually plausible images without physically grounded wire deformation. We present WireSeg-32k, a synthetic dataset for wire instance segmentation with 32,000 RGB images, instance masks, depth maps, and a complementary real-world test set with annotations. To generate this dataset, we develop DeformX, a co-simulation pipeline that couples Cosserat-rod dynamics with photorealistic Isaac Sim rendering, enabling physically plausible, contact-consistent wire shapes, CAD-based wire assets, and diverse visually grounded scenes. As a simple baseline, LoRA fine-tuning SAM3 on WireSeg-32k alone improves real-world mAP@75 by 10.2% over the off-the-shelf model, showing that physically grounded synthetic data can transfer to real wire perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WireSeg-32k合成数据集及其生成管道DeformX，用于线缆实例分割任务。该数据集包含32,000张RGB图像、实例掩码和深度图，通过结合Cosserat-rod物理动力学与Isaac Sim逼真渲染的协同仿真管道生成，解决可变形线性物体（线缆）因细长、高变形、自遮挡而难以分割且真实标注成本高昂的问题。
AI.motivation: 可变形线性物体（如导线和线缆）因细薄、高度变形且频繁自遮挡而难以分割；同时真实场景中大规模实例级标注成本高昂。现有资源要么局限于约束条件下的线缆追踪或语义分割，要么生成仅视觉上合理但缺乏物理真实线缆变形的图像，缺乏物理上可靠的合成数据资源。
AI.method: 提出DeformX协同仿真管道，将Cosserat-rod弹性杆动力学与Isaac Sim逼真渲染耦合，保证线缆形状的物理合理性与接触一致性，并利用CAD线缆资产和多样化视觉场景生成数据集。同时构建互补的真实世界测试集并配标注，并以LoRA微调SAM3作为简单基线验证数据有效性。
AI.result: 通过LoRA在WireSeg-32k上微调SAM3，仅用合成数据即可将真实世界mAP@75相对现成模型提升10.2%，证明物理可靠的合成数据能够有效迁移到真实线缆感知任务。
AI.conclusion: 物理上有依据的合成数据可以有效提升真实场景中线缆实例分割性能，WireSeg-32k数据集及其DeformX生成管道为可变形线性物体感知提供了新的训练资源与验证范本。

title: Privacy-Preserving Topology-Guided Safety for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Federated Graph Learning
summary: Topology-guided safeguards for LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) train a GNN over the inter-agent communication graph to localize risky agents and intervene on the topology---but they assume one operator can pool all labeled traces. Across organizations that assumption breaks: episodes contain private prompts, tool outputs, and proprietary workflows, and no silo alone sees the full attack distribution. We cast privacy-preserving MAS safeguarding as graph federated learning and instantiate FGLGuard: each operator fits an edge-featured graph attention detector on its own judge-labeled episode graphs and shares only model updates. The method couples a proximal local objective for non-IID clients, domain-balanced aggregation, over-refusal-constrained threshold calibration, corroborated upstream scoring, and a guarded rewrite for blocked answers. Federation is not optional: off-the-shelf transfer collapses under distribution shift (AUROC 0.51 to 0.70 only after in-domain retraining), so a deployable guard must adapt on each site's private traces. On Agent-SafetyBench, R-Judge, and AgentDojo, federated FGLGuard exceeds the in-domain centralized ceiling on all three benchmarks without pooling any data---where unsupervised anomaly guards and local-only training fail. One guard federated across four different-domain operators comes within 0.03 AUROC of multi-domain centralization, while any single-domain guard collapses on the others. Live FGLGuard cuts AgentDojo's ground-truth attack-success rate by 43% at near-unguarded utility, zero API cost, and negligible capability loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FGLGuard，一种基于图联邦学习（graph federated learning）的隐私保护多智能体系统（MAS）安全防护框架。它通过在组织间共享模型更新而非原始标注数据，训练边缘特征图注意力检测器来定位风险智能体并干预通信拓扑，在不汇聚任何私有数据的前提下，在三项基准上超越了集中式训练的安全防护性能上限。
AI.motivation: 现有基于拓扑引导的MAS安全防护方法假设存在一个中心化操作者可以汇总所有标注轨迹（包含私有提示词、工具输出和专有工作流），从而训练GNN来定位风险智能体。然而在跨组织的真实场景中，这一假设不成立：数据孤岛无法看到完整的攻击分布，且无法共享涉及隐私的episode数据，导致集中式训练不可行、直接迁移模型因分布偏移而失效。
AI.method: FGLGuard将隐私保护MAS安全防护建模为图联邦学习问题：每个操作者（client）在自己的judge-labeled episode图上拟合边缘特征图注意力检测器，仅共享模型更新。其核心组件包括：(1) 面向非IID客户端数据的近端局部目标函数（proximal local objective）；(2) 域平衡聚合策略（domain-balanced aggregation）；(3) 过拒绝约束的阈值校准（over-refusal-constrained threshold calibration）；(4) 协同性上游评分（corroborated upstream scoring）；(5) 对被阻断答案的受控重写机制（guarded rewrite）。
AI.result: 在Agent-SafetyBench、R-Judge和AgentDojo三项基准上，联邦FGLGuard在不聚合任何数据的情况下超越了域内集中式训练的上限，而无监督异常防护和仅本地训练的模型均失败。跨四个不同域操作者的联邦防护距离多域中心化仅差0.03 AUROC，而任何单域防护对其他域均崩溃。线下FGLGuard将AgentDojo的真实攻击成功率降低43%，同时保持接近无防护的效用水平、零API成本和可忽略的能力损失。此外，直接迁移在分布偏移下失效（AUROC仅0.51），经域内重训练后也仅恢复至0.70，表明联邦并非可有可无的选择。
AI.conclusion: 联邦并非可选方案而是必要前提：在数据孤岛和隐私约束的现实条件下，MAS安全防护必须通过联邦学习在每个站点的私有轨迹上进行自适应。FGLGuard证明了无需共享任何数据即可超越集中式防护性能上限的可行性，为跨组织多智能体系统的隐私保护安全治理提供了一条可部署的路径。

title: R$^{2}$Adapter: A Routing and Rewriting Adapter for Efficient Hybrid RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a prevailing paradigm for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with non-parametric knowledge. Vanilla RAG efficiently handles simple queries but struggles with relational or multi-hop reasoning. Graph-based RAG alleviates this issue but incurs higher inference complexity and latency. In practice, user queries can differ significantly in their complexity, rendering a fixed RAG strategy suboptimal. However, existing hybrid text-graph RAG methods typically rely on heuristic and LLM-based routing, resulting in unnecessary overhead and strong dependence on the underlying LLM. To address these challenges, we propose R$^{2}$Adapter, a lightweight plug-in Routing and Rewriting Adapter designed to allocate queries between vanilla and graph-based RAG dynamically. By routing only the queries that genuinely benefit from graph-based reasoning, R$^{2}$Adapter reduces unnecessary graph retrieval overhead. Additionally, uncertain graph-routed queries are rewritten to better expose their multi-hop reasoning requirements, improving retrieval quality without additional supervision. Extensive experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that R$^{2}$Adapter reduces graph-based RAG usage by up to 59% while maintaining comparable answer accuracy. This adapter is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into diverse vanilla and graph-based RAG pipelines, providing an efficient and adaptive solution for hybrid RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 提出R²Adapter，一种轻量级即插即用的路由与改写适配器，用于在vanilla RAG和基于图的RAG之间动态分配查询，通过仅路由真正受益于图推理的查询以及改写不确定的图路由查询，将图RAG使用率降低高达59%，同时保持相当的答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法存在以下问题：(1) Vanilla RAG处理简单查询高效，但在关系或多跳推理上表现不佳；(2) Graph-based RAG解决多跳推理问题但推理复杂度和延迟更高；(3) 实际用户查询复杂度差异大，固定RAG策略并非最优；(4) 现有的混合文本-图RAG方法依赖启发式或基于LLM的路由，导致不必要的开销并强烈依赖底层LLM。
AI.method: 提出R²Adapter，一个轻量级即插即用的Routing and Rewriting Adapter。它包含两个核心功能：(1) 动态路由：仅将真正受益于图推理的查询路由到基于图的RAG，减少不必要的图检索开销；(2) 查询改写：对不确定的图路由查询进行改写，以更好地暴露其多跳推理需求，在无需额外监督的情况下提升检索质量。该适配器是模型无关的。
AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上进行的广泛实验表明，R²Adapter将基于图的RAG使用率降低了高达59%，同时保持可比的答案准确率。
AI.conclusion: R²Adapter提供了一种高效且自适应的混合RAG系统解决方案，可无缝集成到各种vanilla和基于图的RAG流程中，兼顾效率与准确率。

title: Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning typically optimizes average reward. For generative policies, the average can hide an important distinction: two policies can achieve the same mean reward while having very different chances of producing a rare but high-reward rollout. This matters as sampling increases during training and inference, since its benefit depends on retaining probability mass on high-reward outcomes. We propose to optimize this coverage directly. Rather than considering only expected reward, we consider all of its upper tails: for each reward threshold, how likely is the policy to exceed it? This turns a continuous reward into a family of binary success events. We introduce Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (TailRL), which maximizes the log-probability of exceeding a randomly chosen reward threshold. Its gradient gives more weight to rare, high-reward rollouts and can be interpreted as a mixture of Best-of-(k) gradients. TailRL requires only a simple modification to the advantage function, making it compatible with existing reinforcement learning pipelines. Across object localization, maze navigation, GUI grounding, and code optimization, TailRL leverages rare high-reward training samples to avoid suboptimal solutions and yields models that benefit more from additional samples at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (TailRL)，通过最大化超过随机奖励阈值的对数概率来直接优化策略覆盖高奖励尾部的能力，而非仅优化平均奖励。该方法只需对advantage函数做简单修改，即可与现有RL管线兼容，在目标定位、迷宫导航、GUI grounding和代码优化等任务上均优于标准RL。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习优化平均奖励，但对于生成式策略，相同平均奖励可能掩盖尾部风险差异：两个策略可能有相同的均值奖励，但产生罕见高奖励rollout的概率截然不同。随着训练和推理时采样次数的增加，保留高奖励结果的概率质量变得至关重要，因此需要直接优化高奖励尾部的覆盖率。
AI.method: TailRL将连续奖励转化为一族二值成功事件（通过奖励阈值随机化），最大化超过随机阈值时的对数似然。其梯度对罕见高奖励rollout赋予更大权重，可解释为Best-of-(k)梯度的混合。实现上仅需对advantage函数进行简单修改，即可无缝集成到现有RL pipeline中。
AI.result: 在目标定位、迷宫导航、GUI grounding和代码优化等多样任务上，TailRL能够利用罕见的高奖励训练样本避免陷入次优解，并且生成的模型在推理时增加采样数量能获得更多收益，即推理时的Best-of-n优势更强。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化奖励尾部覆盖率而非平均奖励，是一种更合适的RL目标——尤其当采样预算充足时，保留高奖励rollout的概率质量对最终性能至关重要。TailRL作为轻量级修改，提供了实用且有效的方案。

title: A Technique for Load Shifting Low-latency Applications in Multi-Region Renewables Harvesting via SMT Core Pooling
summary: Load shifting across geographic regions to chase intermittent renewable energy availability is commonly used in reducing cloud infrastructure carbon footprint. However, it often omits low-latency applications due to high latency variances of wide area networks (WAN) that interconnect regions. This paper addresses accommodating low-latency applications into load shifting by minimizing their shifting across the WAN. We propose a technique using a hardware-software co-design approach. At the hardware level, we conduct server load matching over renewables supply peaks and valleys by deep idling physical cores in two otherwise identical server pools, with one enabling simultaneous multi-threading (SMT) in CPUs. In return, we achieve a static set of logical cores amidst energy supply dynamics, reducing the probability of workload shifting. At the software level, we efficiently chase the static set of cores for low-latency applications within regions while prioritizing best-effort applications to accommodate shifting requirements across WANs. Our approach exploits the lower performance compromise of SMT cores due to their hardware multi-threading. We implement the proposed technique with OpenStack and CPU idle states and evaluate its performance on a real experimental testbed with Azure VM arrival traces. Results show an 80% reduction in offloading low-latency VMs and a 43.81% reduction in coefficient of variation of p90 end-user latency while having a worst-case latency compromise of 11.97% due to SMT cores.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种软硬件协同设计技术，使低延迟应用能够参与负载迁移以降低云基础设施碳足迹，同时最小化其在广域网中的迁移。通过在硬件层利用CPU深度空闲和SMT创建静态逻辑核心集合，在软件层在区域内高效调度低延迟应用，实验结果实现了80%的低延迟虚拟机迁移减少和43.81%的p90端到端延迟变异系数降低。
AI.motivation: 跨地理区域的负载迁移常被用于利用可再生间歇性能源降低云基础设施碳排放，但由于广域网的高延迟变异性，低延迟应用往往被排除在这种迁移方案之外。现有方案未能兼顾低延迟应用的性能需求与可再生能源利用的碳减排目标。
AI.method: 提出一种硬件-软件协同设计方法：硬件层面，在两个配置相同（其中一个启用SMT）的服务器池中，根据可再生能源供给的峰值与谷值对服务器负载进行匹配，通过深度空闲物理核心建立静态的逻辑核心集合，从而在能源供应动态变化中减少工作负载迁移概率；软件层面，在区域内高效地将低延迟应用调度至该静态核心集合，同时优先调度尽力而为应用以满足跨WAN的迁移需求。利用SMT核心硬件多线程带来的较低性能妥协优势。基于OpenStack和CPU空闲态实现，并在真实实验测试平台上使用Azure VM到达轨迹进行验证。
AI.result: 低延迟虚拟机迁移减少了80%，p90端到端延迟变异系数降低了43.81%，最坏情况下因SMT核心造成的延迟妥协为11.97%。
AI.conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计，可以在不显著牺牲低延迟应用性能的前提下，将其纳入可再生能源驱动的跨区域负载迁移框架，从而在降低碳足迹和保证服务质量之间取得有效平衡。

title: Caught in the Story: Narrative Captivity in Multi-turn LLMs Conversation
summary: People increasingly turn to large language models (LLMs) for everyday advice, making ethically charged interpersonal problems a practical moral-advisory context. Most prior work has studied this context through single-turn judgments or pressure-laden rebuttals, assumptions that poorly match how guidance is sought in real-world contexts. These assumptions leave unclear whether narration alone, without an explicit opposing position, can shift model judgments during multi-turn moral consultation. Yet real-world moral-conflict conversation often elicits one party's self-justifying account, which can unfold over multiple turns and create information asymmetry. We introduce \textbf{narrative captivity}, a failure mode in which a model treats an unopposed one-sided account as complete and aligns with the narrator's interpretation without seeking missing perspectives. To measure this phenomenon, we build a benchmark of $5{,}078$ interpersonal-conflict scenarios spanning six moral dimensions. Across 17 LLMs, narrative captivity is widespread: end-state judgments under multi-turn narration shift by 25 percentage points on average beyond the matched single-turn baseline. Stage-level analysis identifies preference optimization as a major contributor, while four inference-time strategies provide only partial mitigation. We hope our project fosters LLM advisors that preserve independent judgment in real-world consultation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"叙事俘获"（narrative captivity）这一LLM失败模式：在多轮道德咨询中，模型将一方未经反驳的单面叙述视为完整事实，并过度认同叙述者的解释而忽略缺失的视角。研究构建了包含5,078个跨六种道德维度的人际冲突场景基准，在17个LLM上验证该现象普遍存在（多轮叙事使最终判断平均比单轮基线偏移25个百分点），并发现偏好优化（preference optimization）是主要成因，四种推理时策略只能部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中人们越来越多地使用LLM获取日常道德建议，但以往研究多通过单轮判断或施压式反驳来研究该场景，这与真实情境中咨询如何展开不符。现实中道德冲突对话常会诱发一方自我正当化的叙述，且会跨多轮展开，造成信息不对称。现有研究未解答：仅凭叙述本身（无明确对立立场）是否能在多轮咨询中改变模型判断。因此需要系统研究这一被忽视的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出"叙事俘获"概念定义该失败模式；构建包含5,078个跨六种道德维度的 interpersonal-conflict 场景基准；在17个LLM上进行多轮叙事条件下的系统评测，与匹配的单轮基线对比；通过阶段级（stage-level）分析定位偏好优化的贡献，并测试四种推理时缓解策略。
AI.result: 叙事俘获现象在17个LLM中广泛存在：多轮叙事条件下端状态判断平均比匹配的单轮基线偏移25个百分点。阶段级分析识别出偏好优化是主要促成因素。四种推理时缓解策略（如推理时干预）仅提供部分缓解效果，无法完全消除该问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示LLM作为道德顾问在面对冲突性咨询时存在系统性偏见——单向叙述即可俘获模型判断。该发现对构建能够保持独立判断的真实世界LLM顾问具有重要意义，相关工作未来仍需更强的训练阶段干预而非仅靠推理时策略。

title: Long-Horizon Consistent and Interaction-Aware World Models for Multi-Style End-to-End Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has increasingly adopted world model-based reinforcement learning frameworks to improve learning efficiency through \textit{imagined rollouts}. However, existing world models suffer from three key limitations: temporal inconsistency in long-horizon imagined rollouts, inadequate modeling of ego-environment interactions, and limited adaptability to diverse driving styles. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{StyleDrive}, a world-model-based learning framework that jointly enforces long-horizon consistency, explicitly disentangles interactive traffic states, and supports multi-style policy optimization within a unified learning paradigm. First, we introduce a temporal consistency regularization that integrates historical latent states through gated cross-attention, stabilizing long-horizon imagined rollouts and mitigating error accumulation. Second, we design an explicit state disentanglement module that separates ego-relevant from ego-irrelevant interactive states, enabling more interpretable and efficient decision-making in complex traffic scenarios. Third, we enable multi-style driving behaviors through Group Relative Policy Optimization, which replaces per-step reward optimization with trajectory-wise relative advantages, reducing reward variance and supporting diverse driving styles without retraining. We evaluate StyleDrive on the Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark, achieving a driving score of 88.44 (+17.08 over the previous best world model-based method) and a success rate of 66.82 (+16.58). Furthermore, we deploy StyleDrive on a real automated guided vehicle platform and demonstrate promising sim-to-real transfer capability in dynamic driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: StyleDrive是一个基于世界模型的端到端自动驾驶学习框架，通过时间一致性正则化、交互状态显式解耦和多风格策略优化三大创新，在Bench2Drive基准上取得88.44的驾驶分数（超此前最优世界模型方法17.08）和66.82%的成功率（超16.58%），并在真实AGV平台上验证了sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于世界模型的RL自动驾驶框架存在三个关键局限：长时序想象rollout中的时间不一致性、对自车-环境交互建模不充分、以及对多样化驾驶风格的适应性有限。这些局限制约了世界模型方法的想象学习效率和实际部署效果。
AI.method: StyleDrive从三方面解决上述问题：(1) 引入时间一致性正则化，通过门控交叉注意力整合历史潜在状态，稳定长时序想象rollout并缓解误差累积；(2) 设计显式状态解耦模块，将自车相关与自车无关的交互状态分离，提升复杂交通场景下决策的可解释性和效率；(3) 采用组相对策略优化（GRPO），以轨迹级相对优势替代逐步奖励优化，降低奖励方差并支持多风格驾驶行为而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive封闭驾驶基准上，驾驶分数达到88.44（较此前最优世界模型方法提升17.08），成功率达到66.82（提升16.58）。此外，在真实自动导引车（AGV）平台上完成了部署，在动态驾驶场景中展现了良好的sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: StyleDrive通过统一的学习范式同时解决长时序一致性问题、交互状态建模问题和多风格策略优化问题，实验证明其在仿真基准和真实平台上的有效性与可迁移性，为世界模型驱动的端到端自动驾驶提供了新的解决框架。

title: SLIDEFORGE: An LLM Agent for Controllable Editing of Slides as Structured Artifacts
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Haozhen and Fulin contributed equally
summary: Current AI agents compellingly describe slides. However, AI-assisted slide editing requires more than understanding: the output must retain layout, style, component structure, and native editability. Towards, AI-assisted slide editing, existing agents operate on screenshots or weak document representations and often fragment coherent visual units, rasterize editable content, or break layout. In contrast, for controllable slide editing, we introduce an agentic framework, SLIDEFORGE, which builds a Deck State Graph, an executable slide state that links visual decomposition, native pptx object structure, and perceptual organization. By recovering human-referable components while retaining fine-grained editable structure, SLIDEFORGE supports theme-preserving reconstruction through slide-native operations and rendered-state verification. We further introduce an evaluation paradigm for controllable slide transformation that jointly measures component recovery, preservation, restyling consistency, visual quality, and native editability. Experiments show that SLIDEFORGE outperforms direct prompting, screenshot-based agents, and generic code-agent baselines across these dimensions. Code is available at https://github.com/UIUC-MONET/SLIDEFORGE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLIDEFORGE，一个用于可控幻灯片智能编辑的智能体框架，通过构建Deck State Graph将视觉分解、原生pptx对象结构和感知组织连接起来，实现保持主题、版式与原生可编辑性的幻灯片重建。实验表明其在组件恢复、保真度、重样式一致性、视觉质量和原生可编辑性上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体虽能生动描述幻灯片，但AI辅助的幻灯片编辑需要输出保留布局、样式、组件结构和原生可编辑性，这要求超越理解层面的操作能力。然而现有智能体基于截图或弱文档表示进行操作，常常破碎连贯的视觉单元、栅格化可编辑内容或破坏布局。
AI.method: SLIDEFORGE构建Deck State Graph——一种可执行的幻灯片状态表示，将视觉分解、原生pptx对象结构与感知组织三者进行链接。通过恢复人类可指代的组件同时保留细粒度可编辑结构，框架支持通过幻灯片原生操作和渲染状态验证来实现主题保持的重建。同时提出了一套联合评估组件恢复、保真度、重样式一致性、视觉质量和原生可编辑性的可控幻灯片变换评测范式。
AI.result: 实验表明SLIDEFORGE在组件恢复、保真度、重样式一致性、视觉质量和原生可编辑性等多个维度上均优于直接提示、基于截图的智能体以及通用代码智能体等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SLIDEFORGE通过构建可执行的Deck State Graph并结合原生ppt对象结构，有效弥合了视觉理解与可编辑结构之间的鸿沟，为可控AI辅助幻灯片编辑提供了新的框架与评估范式，且代码已开源。

title: Privacy Leakage in Federated Learning: Gradient-Based Client Identity Inference and Defenses for Inertial Sensing in Vehicular Edge Networks
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE VTC2026-Fall, Boston, MA, USA, September 6-9, 2026
summary: As vehicular networks move toward 5G/6G edge intelligence, federated learning (FL) is widely promoted as a privacy-preserving way for vehicles and infrastructure to train shared models without exposing raw sensor data. Yet the updates clients transmit still leak enough information to identify who sent them, which threatens the anonymity that safety-critical V2X applications assume and adds to existing concerns over adversarial ML, model poisoning, and backdoor attacks. We study server-side client identity inference from transmitted weight deltas using inertial (IMU) measurements, evaluated on the UCI Human Activity Recognition (HAR) benchmark as an accessible proxy for the IMU streams produced onboard connected vehicles. Across five attack classifiers and five non-IID partitions, an honest-but-curious server recovers client identity with near-perfect accuracy (approximately 1.000) from undefended updates, confirming a concrete identifiability risk. We then quantify the privacy-utility trade-off of a lightweight clip-then-noise defense by sweeping Gaussian noise (sigma in {0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50, 1.00}) at fixed clipping (C=1.0), and report formal (epsilon, delta)-DP budgets through Renyi accounting. A practical region (sigma in [0.1, 0.2]) drives attack accuracy to near-random while costing under 5% relative FL accuracy. Ensemble FL supplies complementary structural privacy with a 1/K anonymity-set bound and no noise penalty. Results are supported by cryptographic (SHA-256) train/evaluation gradient disjointness, three seeds, and a count-normalized attacker-advantage metric. We position HAR explicitly as a proxy and discuss what validation on true vehicular telemetry would require.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了5G/6G车载边缘智能中联邦学习（FL）的客户端身份推断攻击问题。利用IMU（惯性测量单元）数据作为车载传感器的代理，在UCI人体活动识别（HAR）基准上验证了诚实但好奇的服务器可以从权重增量中近乎完美地（准确率约1.000）恢复客户端身份。通过裁剪-加噪防御，在sigma∈[0.1,0.2]范围内可将攻击准确率降至接近随机水平，同时FL精度损失小于5%。集成FL则提供了1/K匿名集界的互补结构隐私。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽被广泛视为保护车辆数据隐私的解决方案，但客户端传输的模型更新仍可能泄露客户端身份信息，威胁V2X安全关键应用所依赖的匿名性保障；同时该问题还与对抗性ML、模型投毒和后门攻击等既有风险叠加。
AI.method: 在UCI HAR基准上用IMU数据作为车载遥测的代理，使用五种攻击分类器在五种非IID数据划分下评估服务器端客户端身份推断攻击；采用固定裁剪（C=1.0）配合高斯噪声（sigma∈{0,0.05,0.10,0.20,0.50,1.00}）的轻量防御方案，通过Renyi差分隐私核算报告（ε,δ）-DP预算；利用SHA-256密码学哈希验证训练/评估梯度不相交性，基于三粒随机种子和计数归一化的攻击者优势指标进行消融与验证。
AI.result: 在无防御条件下，诚实但好奇的服务器能以近乎完美的准确率（约1.000）在所有攻击分类器和数据划分下识别客户端身份。防御方面，sigma∈[0.1,0.2]的噪声水平能将攻击准确率降至接近随机猜测，同时FL模型精度损失不超过5%。集成FL通过1/K匿名集界提供结构性隐私保护，且不引入额外噪声代价。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认了联邦学习中客户端身份可识别性是切实存在的隐私风险，裁剪-加噪防御在特定参数区间内能有效平衡隐私与效用。作者明确将HAR定位为车载IMU流的代理基准，并指出了在真实车辆遥测数据上验证所需的前提条件，为后续车载联邦学习隐私保护研究提供了参考框架。

title: BharatGather: A Culturally-Informed Benchmark Dataset for Misinformation and Fake News Detection in Indian Public Events
summary: Large-scale public events, such as religious festivals, political rallies, and cultural gatherings, are increasingly vulnerable to the rapid dissemination of misinformation, posing substantial risks to public safety and social cohesion. While automated fake news detection has seen significant methodological progress, existing benchmarks frequently fail to capture the socio-cultural nuances and event-specific dynamics characteristic of the Indian context. This paper introduces BharatGather, a curated, multi-source dataset specifically engineered for binary misinformation classification within the ecosystem of Indian mass gatherings. The corpus comprises 14,646 records constructed through a hybrid pipeline involving systematic web scraping of prominent fact-checking platforms, multimedia transcript extraction, and Large Language Model (LLM)-mediated synthetic augmentation to ensure narrative diversity. By providing a resource tailored to the unique complexities of event-aware misinformation in India, this work facilitates the development of culturally informed detection systems and establishes a rigorous benchmark for evaluating their performance in high-stakes public environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BharatGather，一个专门用于印度大规模公共活动（如宗教节日、政治集会、文化活动）背景下虚假信息二分类检测的多源数据集，包含14,646条经混合管道构建的记录，为文化敏感的东南亚事件级虚假信息检测提供基准资源。
AI.motivation: 大规模公共活动中虚假信息的快速传播对公共安全和社会凝聚力构成重大风险。尽管自动化假新闻检测方法已有显著进展，但现有基准往往无法捕捉印度语境特有的社会文化细微差别和事件特异性动态，缺乏针对印度大型集会生态系统的专门数据集。
AI.method: 构建了BharatGather数据集，采用混合管道方法：系统抓取知名事实核查平台的网络内容、多媒体转录文本提取，以及利用大语言模型（LLM）进行合成数据增强以丰富叙事多样性。最终形成包含14,646条记录的语料库，用于二元虚假信息分类。
AI.result: 产出了一个针对印度大规模集会中事件感知虚假信息分类的专门数据集（包含14,646条记录），为文化感知检测系统的开发和评估提供了严格的基准资源。
AI.conclusion: BharatGather通过提供针对印度大型公共活动独特复杂性的定制数据集，促进了文化感知虚假信息检测系统的发展，并为在高风险公共环境中评估这些系统的性能建立了严格的基准，填补了该领域针对南亚情境的数据空缺。

title: Lantern: Finding Committable Transactions via Back-Propagation on DAGs
summary: Existing concurrency control protocols either introduce nondeterminism, resulting in a serial execution-replay dependency between primary and replica nodes, or rely on impractical prior knowledge of transaction read-write sets. In this paper, we present Lantern, a deterministic concurrency control protocol tailored for high-performance transaction processing systems operating without prior knowledge. The key insight of Lantern is that all zero-out-degree transaction vertices in the local dependency graph can be safely committed in ascending order using an overwrite-permissive strategy. We further introduce a novel Back-Propagation mechanism that iteratively propagates dependency states from sink to source vertices to identify additional committable transactions. We also propose Conflict-Free Batch Selection (CFBS) for read-modify-write intensive scenarios. We integrate Lantern into the open-source blockchain platform ChainMaker. Extensive evaluations on YCSB and SmallBank benchmarks demonstrate that Lantern achieves up to a 4.2x throughput speedup over Aria and improves the throughput of ChainMaker's execution layer by at least 2.2x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lantern，一种无需预先知道事务读写集的确定性并发控制协议。其核心洞察是依赖图中零出度事务顶点可采用覆盖宽容策略按升序安全提交。通过Back-Propagation机制和Conflict-Free Batch Selection优化，在ChainMaker平台上相比Aria实现最高4.2倍吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有并发控制协议要么引入非确定性，导致主备节点间存在串行执行-重放依赖；要么依赖不切实际的先验知识（预先知道事务读写集）。这限制了高性能事务处理系统在无先验知识场景下的确定性执行能力。
AI.method: 1) 核心洞察：本地依赖图中所有零出度事务顶点可使用覆盖宽容策略按升序安全提交；2) Back-Propagation机制：从汇点向源点迭代传播依赖状态，识别更多可提交事务；3) Conflict-Free Batch Selection (CFBS)：针对读-修改-写密集型场景的批量选择优化；4) 集成到开源区块链平台ChainMaker。
AI.result: 在YCSB和SmallBank基准测试上，Lantern相比Aria实现最高4.2倍吞吐量提升，并将ChainMaker执行层吞吐量提升至少2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: Lantern通过确定性并发控制协议消除了对事务读写集先验知识的依赖，同时避免了非确定性引入的主备重放问题，为高性能确定性事务处理提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案。

title: Dude: A Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for Paper-Code Discrepancy Detection
summary: LLM-empowered paper-code discrepancy detection has received growing concern since the scaling of research submissions exceeds the manual review capability. However, the limited context capacity and one-sided discrepancy detection of existing single-agent LLM paradigms lead to an inferior recall performance in detecting discrepancies. In this paper, we propose Dude, the first Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for paper-code discrepancy detection. We discover that the granularity asymmetry of the paper-language and code-language introduces over-interpretation and over-reporting challenges in a multi-agent system design for discrepancy detection, resulting in increasing false positives. To address this, we propose a granularity-aligned negotiation and a two-stage salience-filtering mechanism in Dude, which effectively prevents agents from falsely reporting discrepancies. Experimental results in real-world paper-code discrepancy datasets showcase Dude's significant recall and precision improvement by up to 22.8%, increasing F1 score by up to 18.7% compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dude，首个用于论文-代码差异检测的双检测多智能体系统，通过粒度对齐协商和两阶段显著性过滤机制解决现有单智能体范式高误报和低召回问题，在真实数据集上F1最高提升18.7%。
AI.motivation: 科研论文提交数量激增已超出人工审阅能力，而现有基于单智能体LLM的论文-代码差异检测范式受限于上下文容量不足和差异检测的单向性，导致召回率表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出Dude这一双检测多智能体系统，包括两方面核心创新：(1) 粒度对齐协商机制（granularity-aligned negotiation），用于处理论文语言与代码语言之间的粒度不对称所引发的过度解释和过度报告问题；(2) 两阶段显著性过滤机制（two-stage salience-filtering），有效防止智能体错误报告差异以减少假阳性。
AI.result: 在真实世界论文-代码差异数据集上的实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，Dude的召回率和精确率最高提升22.8%，F1分数最高提升18.7%。
AI.conclusion: Dude作为首个针对论文-代码差异检测的双检测多智能体框架，通过解决粒度不对称和多智能体误报问题，显著提升了差异检测的性能，证明了多智能体协作范式在该任务上的有效性。

title: Establishing a Dynamic Multimodal HRI Dataset for Engagement Analysis with a Humanoid Robot
summary: This paper presents an experimental design for constructing a multimodal dataset to analyze user engagement in human-robot interaction (HRI). Prior studies have mainly relied on observable behavioral cues, with limited frameworks integrating physiological signals. We therefore propose a structured data-collection protocol to build a multimodal dataset that includes wearable physiological signals, behavioral data, and self-report measures under different levels of task complexity defined in this experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种构建多模态数据集的实验设计方案，用于分析人机交互（HRI）中的用户参与度，该数据集整合了可穿戴生理信号、行为数据和自我报告测量，并在不同任务复杂度水平下进行采集。
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要依赖可观察的行为线索来分析用户参与度，缺乏整合生理信号的框架。本文旨在弥补这一空白，提出更全面的多模态数据采集方案。
AI.method: 提出结构化数据采集协议，构建包含可穿戴生理信号、行为数据和自我报告测量的多模态数据集，并在实验中定义的不同任务复杂度水平下进行采集。
AI.result: 本文为实验设计方案，尚未报告具体实验结果，重点在于提出数据集构建的协议与方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合生理信号与行为数据，该多模态数据集有望提供更全面、更深入的人机交互用户参与度分析框架。

title: Beyond Small Patches: Black-Box Detection and Purification of Diverse Backdoor Triggers
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are increasingly deployed in real-world vision systems, yet their predictions can be covertly manipulated by backdoor attacks, in which malicious triggers cause targeted misclassification while preserving high clean accuracy. Existing defenses often rely on model internals, training data, or clean validation samples, making them difficult to deploy when only black-box access to a trained model is available. We propose TRIM (Trigger Removal by Identifying Manipulated Regions), a deployment-oriented black-box defense that detects and selectively removes backdoor triggers at inference time without requiring model internals, training data, or clean samples. The key insight behind TRIM is to identify image regions that are responsible for anomalous model behavior and purify only those regions while preserving benign content. TRIM innovates via three key components: (i) region-based segmentation with deep feature representations, (ii) adaptive trigger discovery through inpainting and diffusion-based reconstruction to isolate regions responsible for misclassification---without assumptions about trigger type, shape, or location, and (iii) selective region purification that cleans poisoned regions while retaining benign content. To support practical deployment, TRIM further caches feature embeddings of previously identified triggers, enabling efficient recognition and avoiding redundant detection and purification. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and backdoor types, including blended, sparse, varying-size, and multiple triggers, show that TRIM consistently outperforms existing black-box defenses, reducing attack success rates (ASR) to as low as 1.16% while preserving clean accuracy of up to 87.87%. These results demonstrate that effective backdoor mitigation is possible at inference time even when the defender has no access to any auxiliary data.

AI.tldr: TRIM是一种面向部署的纯黑盒推理时后门防御方法，无需模型内部信息、训练数据或干净样本，通过分割、扩散重建和选择性区域净化来检测并移除触发器，将攻击成功率降至1.16%的同时保持高达87.87%的干净准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御方法通常依赖模型内部结构、训练数据或干净的验证样本，在实际部署中当仅有黑盒模型访问权限时难以应用。当前需要一种不依赖任何辅助数据的、可在推理阶段直接部署的后门缓解方案。
AI.method: TRIM包含三大核心组件：(i) 基于深度特征表示的区域分割；(ii) 通过修复和扩散重建的自适应触发器发现，无需对触发器类型、形状或位置做先验假设；(iii) 选择性区域净化，仅清理被污染区域而保留良性内容。此外，通过缓存先前识别触发器的特征嵌入来避免重复检测，支持高效的实际部署。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和后门类型（混合、稀疏、变尺寸、多触发器）上的大量实验表明，TRIM持续优于现有黑盒防御方法，将攻击成功率（ASR）降至最低1.16%，同时保持高达87.87%的干净准确率。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，即使在防御方无法获得任何辅助数据的场景下，有效的后门缓解也可以在推理时实现，展示了TRIM在实际部署中的实用性。

title: Boundary-Mutation Testing for Pattern-Based Secret Detection: A Rule-Level Method and Cross-Scanner Evaluation
summary: Pattern-based secret scanners are commonly validated with example-based fixtures that fix one variable: the text surrounding a credential. We introduce boundary-mutation testing to vary that context, generating credentials from each rule's own regular expression, embedding them in realistic source contexts, and classifying outcomes at the rule level rather than the tool level, yielding three detection metrics. Applied to three scanners - a 43-rule open-source scanner, Gitleaks 8.21.2, and TruffleHog 3.82.13 - detection in the primary subject holds at >=0.9976 across ten contexts but collapses to 0.5233 when a credential ends in a hyphen. Five rules are affected: two, with fixed-count quantifiers, fail totally and deterministically; three, with variable-count quantifiers, backtrack and match a truncated credential; an entropy fallback rescues some failures but downgrades their severity. We validate a repair restoring full robustness with no new false positives, and report a caution: a plausible first attempt silently regressed two rules, caught only by re-running the same battery. Gitleaks has an unrelated, source-confirmed defect - a hard-coded terminator allowlist causing total misses for most credential types - while TruffleHog shows no boundary fragility but narrowest coverage. We report marginal, not conditional, failure probabilities: one common token format is structurally immune, another fails once in 64; on 292,527 lines of real code, the false-positive ordering inverts relative to the synthetic corpus. Because per-type detection is deterministic, the comparison unit is ten credential types, not hundreds of samples; no recall difference reaches significance, so we report the null result, not a ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出边界突变测试（boundary-mutation testing）方法，用于评估基于正则的密钥扫描器。通过在真实源码上下文中嵌入每种规则自身正则生成的不同凭据，在规则层面而非工具层面分类检测结果，并针对三个扫描器（43规则的OSS扫描器、Gitleaks 8.21.2和TruffleHog 3.82.13）进行评估。主要发现：主测对象在十种上下文中检测率保持>=0.9976，但当凭据以连字符结尾时骤降至0.5233；五条规则受影响（两条固定计数量词规则完全确定性失效，三条可变计数量词规则回溯匹配截断凭据）。验证的修复方案恢复完全稳健性且无新增误报；同时发现一个貌似合理的首次修复尝试会静默回归两条规则。Gitleaks存在无关硬编码终结符白名单缺陷，TruffleHog无边界脆弱性但覆盖最窄。报告边际而非条件失败概率；在292,527行真实代码上，误报排序与合成语料相比发生反转。由于按类检测是确定性的，比较单位为十种凭据类型而非数百个样本，无召回率差异达显著水平，故报告零结果而非排名。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模式的密钥扫描器通常仅用基于示例的固定fixture验证，只变动"围绕凭据的固定上下文"这一个变量，导致上下文变化时扫描器可能隐性失效而未被发现。作者旨在系统性地改变凭据周围的文本边界情境，揭示扫描器在真实多样环境下的脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出边界突变测试方法，流程为：从每条规则的自身正则表达式生成凭据，将其嵌入逼真的源码上下文中，在规则层面而非工具层面分类检测结果，并计算三种检测度量。应用于43规则开源扫描器、Gitleaks 8.21.2、TruffleHog 3.82.13三个扫描器，评估覆盖十种上下文、十个凭据类型。
AI.result: 主测对象在常规场景下检测准确率保持>=0.9976，但凭据以连字符结尾时降到0.5233。五条规则受影响：两条含固定计数量词的规则完全且确定性地失效；三条含变量计数量词的回溯匹配仅获截断凭据。熵回退能部分挽救但降低严重性分级。已提出修复方案并通过同套测试确认无新误报；但报告警告首次看似合理的修补会使两条规则静默回归，仅靠重跑同套电池测试才发现。Gitleaks有硬编码终结符白名单缺陷导致多数凭据漏检；TruffleHog无此脆弱性但覆盖面最窄。在292,527行真实代码上误报排序相对合成语料反转。统计上因按类型检测确定性，单位是10个凭据类型，无召回率差异达显著水平。
AI.conclusion: 边界突变测试能有效揭示正则扫描器在上下文边界处的系统性脆弱性，尤其是在特殊字符（如连字符）终止凭据时的量词回溯问题。修复策略需通过完整回归电池验证以防静默回归。不同扫描器各有其独特缺陷模式，且合成语料结论不能直接外推至真实代码——需报告边际失败概率和零结果而非误导性排名。

title: PiPMRE: A Pipeline Based on Language Model for Medical Relation Extraction
summary: Medical relation extraction (MRE) is commonly known for extracting entities and their relations jointly from a medical text, which has attracted considerable attention in recent years. Previous studies treat MRE as a sequence tagging task, which results in either a challenging design of the tagging schema or a failed extraction of multiple relations, due to intricate relationships among medical entities. In this work, we review the task from the linguistic perspective and propose a novel pipeline framework, PiPMRE, developed on language models to enhance MRE performance. Specifically, PiPMRE consists of a relation generator and a relation filter. Given a text, the generator first yields multiple relational triplets, and then the filter scores each triplet and retains only those that pass the borderline as the final results. Implementing PiPMRE requires no tagging schema; instead, we use a simple template to reformulate the input text, ensuring that entities and relations are generated in a contextual order. Extensive experimental results on two public datasets demonstrate the advancement of PiPMRE. It surpasses the previous state-of-the-art by an average of 5.6 recall points and 4.4 accuracy points. PiPMRE's superiority is also demonstrated in few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PiPMRE，一种基于语言模型的医疗关系抽取（MRE）流水线框架，包含关系生成器和关系过滤器两个阶段，无需设计复杂的标注模式，通过在公开数据集上超越SOTA平均5.6个召回点和4.4个准确点来验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统医学关系抽取方法将任务视为序列标注问题，存在两个关键缺陷：(1)需要设计复杂的标注模式；(2)由于医疗实体间关系错综复杂，难以提取多个重叠关系。作者从语言学视角重新审视该任务，旨在摆脱序列标注约束，设计更自然、更有效的抽取框架。
AI.method: PiPMRE采用两阶段流水线架构：首先通过关系生成器（基于语言模型）利用简单模板重写输入文本，使实体和关系按上下文顺序以三元组形式生成；随后关系过滤器对每个生成的三元组进行打分，仅保留超过阈值边界的结果作为最终输出。该方法不依赖任何标注模式设计，完全依靠语言模型的生成能力完成联合抽取。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，PiPMRE优于之前的最先进方法，平均提升5.6个召回率和4.4个准确率点。此外，在小样本（few-shot）设置下PiPMRE也展现出明显优势，验证了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PiPMRE通过将MRE重构为生成式流水线任务，有效规避了序列标注范式的局限，实现了更优越的多关系联合抽取性能，且在小样本场景下同样保持竞争力，为医学关系抽取提供了一种新的语言学驱动的解决思路。

title: TRACE: Spatiotemporal Contact Memory Graph Network Simulator for Granular Dynamics
summary: Learned graph simulators provide an efficient alternative to high-fidelity solvers for granular dynamics. However, granular motion depends strongly on inter-granular contact history, which is difficult to preserve when particle contacts form, break, and rearrange. Existing simulators mainly store temporal information in node features or node-level memory. Here we introduce TRACE, a graph-network simulator that stores interaction history directly on contact edges. Each edge maintains a persistent memory updated by attention-based message passing and a gated recurrent unit, while an edge-identity dictionary preserves this memory as the contact graph changes. A physics-structured decoder predicts inter-granular normal and tangential contact forces, enforces the Coulomb friction limit, and applies equal-and-opposite internal forces. The model is trained with single-step pretraining followed by autoregressive rollout fine-tuning. We evaluate TRACE on 2D and 3D granular column-collapse benchmarks. In both cases, TRACE produces stable, physically consistent long-horizon rollouts, closely reproducing the final deposit geometry and the kinetic energy released during collapse. Compared with graph network simulator (GNS) and node-memory graph neural simulator (NMGNS), TRACE reduces long-rollout position error by 31-62% and final-deposit error by 58-89% across the two benchmarks, while using fewer parameters and maintaining near-zero particle interpenetration. TRACE also achieves 12.2$\times$ and 8.9$\times$ speedups over the material point method (MPM) reference solver in 2D and 3D, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Data-Driven-Computational-Geotechnics/TRACE.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一种图网络模拟器，通过在接触边上持久存储交互历史来模拟颗粒动力学，相比现有方法在长时程展开中显著降低位置和沉积形态误差，同时比MPM参考求解器快8.9-12.2倍。
AI.motivation: 颗粒动力学强烈依赖于颗粒间的接触历史，但现有图网络模拟器主要将时间信息存储在节点特征或节点级记忆中，当颗粒间接触形成、断裂和重排时，难以保留交互历史，导致长时程模拟精度不足。
AI.method: TRACE将交互历史直接存储在接触边上：每条边维护一个由注意力消息传递和门控循环单元更新的持久记忆，并利用边身份字典在接触图变化时保持记忆；物理结构化解码器预测法向和切向接触力，强制执行库仑摩擦极限，并施加等大反向的内力；训练采用单步预训练加自回归展开微调。
AI.result: 在2D和3D颗粒柱坍塌基准上，TRACE均产生稳定且物理一致的长时间展开。相比GNS和NMGNS，长过程展开位置误差降低31-62%，最终沉积误差降低58-89%，参数更少且颗粒间穿透接近零；相比MPM求解器在2D和3D分别实现12.2倍和8.9倍加速。
AI.conclusion: TRACE证明显式地在边（接触）层级存储交互历史是提高颗粒图网络模拟器长时程精度和稳定性的有效方案，兼顾了物理一致性与计算效率。

title: Iapetus: Content-Aware Hierarchical Scheduling for Collaborative ViT Inference in LEO Satellite Networks
summary: Collaborative inference pools distributed resources to run compute-intensive Vision Transformers (ViTs) in satellite edge computing. Model partitioning enables such collaboration by assigning consecutive layer groups to different nodes, but the large volume of intermediate activation data incurs substantial transfer overhead that can erase its benefit. Token compression reduces downstream computation and activation transfer, but its quality impact depends on input content, model depth, and earlier pruning decisions, while layer offloading must adapt to time-varying contact and battery conditions. We present \sys, a content-aware hierarchical scheduler that screens constellation-wide options to retain a bounded candidate set, then refines each candidate into a complete token compression and layer offloading trajectory using quality prediction and joint planning. A unified objective balances per-task latency, energy, and quality loss against accumulated workload and battery pressures. We implement \sys on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin hardware-in-the-loop testbed and use its validated execution model for constellation-scale trace replay across multiple ViT workloads and constellation settings. At \(5\)~tasks/s, \sys accomplishes 91.6\% of released tasks, 26.1 percentage points above MARATD3, the strongest baseline, while reducing mean latency and battery draw by 53.0\% and 70.8\%, respectively, and meeting quality targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sys（内容感知分层调度器），用于卫星边缘计算场景下的协作推理。它通过模型分区将ViT层组分配到不同节点，结合token压缩与层卸载的联合规划，在屏幕级候选集中筛选并优化，兼顾延迟、能耗与质量损失。在Jetson AGX Orin测试台上实现，并在5任务/秒下达成91.6%任务完成率，比最强基线MARATD3高出26.1个百分点，同时延迟降低53.0%、电池消耗降低70.8%。
AI.motivation: 协作推理可汇聚分布式资源执行计算密集的ViT任务，但模型分区产生的中间激活数据量巨大，导致显著的传输开销，可能抵消协作收益。同时，token压缩效果高度依赖输入内容、模型深度和先前剪枝决策，而层卸载需适应时变接触与电池条件，亟需一个联合优化方案。
AI.method: 提出内容感知的分层调度器Sys：第一层屏幕星座级选项，保留有界候选集；第二层对每个候选进行细化，利用质量预测和联合规划生成完整的token压缩与层卸载轨迹。统一目标函数综合平衡每任务延迟、能耗、质量损失与累积工作负载及电池压力。实现基于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin的硬件在环测试台，并用其验证的执行模型进行星座级轨迹回放。
AI.result: 在5任务/秒的负载下，Sys完成了91.6%的已发布任务，较最强基线MARATD3高26.1个百分点；平均延迟降低53.0%，平均电池消耗降低70.8%，同时满足质量目标。
AI.conclusion: Sys通过内容感知的分层调度与联合token压缩和层卸载规划，有效解决了卫星边缘计算中协作ViT推理面临的传输开销与时变约束难题，在不同ViT工作负载与星座配置下均展现出显著优势。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval: Evaluating Implicit Instruction Following in Full-Duplex Voice Agents
summary: Full-duplex voice agents must continuously decide when to listen, backchannel, interrupt, handle speech overlaps, take the floor, and yield. Existing benchmarks largely test these behaviors through explicit turn-management instructions, while deployed agents are often configured through roles or personas from which the appropriate conversational behavior must be inferred. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval (DSB-IFEval) for evaluating implicit instruction-following in real-time spoken interaction. (DSB-IFEval) comprises 1,038 test cases spanning eight diverse assistant roles and evaluates five conditioning protocols for instruction-following: default behavior, explicit behavioral instructions, persona-implied behavior, combined persona--rule conditioning, and instruction conflict. We measure real-time floor management using a deterministic Instruction Adherence Score (IAS) and persona-consistent content using LLM-judged Persona Adherence Score (PAS). Across six real-time speech systems, we find architecture-dependent trade-offs. Full duplex models like F-Actor and PersonaPlex are more sensitive to whether conversational behavior is stated explicitly or must be inferred from a persona, with adherence dropping by 9.7% and 4.5%, respectively, under persona-only conditioning. In contrast, GPT-Realtime, MiniCPM-o, and Fun-Audio-Chat strongly adhere to persona-consistent content, but their floor behavior does not adapt across explicit and persona-only instructions and remains constrained on several proactive actions. We further find that even if systems reliably follow conflicting directives to their prescribed persona, they still struggle to override them under safety conflict. These results show that inferring the behavior implied by a role, executing it at the appropriate conversational moment, and resolving competing instructions remain distinct challenges for full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 提出了DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval (DSB-IFEval)基准，用于评估全双工语音代理在实时口语交互中的隐式指令遵循能力。该基准包含1038个测试用例，覆盖8种不同的助手角色和5种指令调节协议，并通过IAS（确定性指令遵循分数）和PAS（LLM判定的人格一致性分数）评估系统表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要通过显式轮次管理指令来测试全双工语音代理的对话行为，但实际部署的代理往往通过角色或人格配置来定义行为，需要从隐式信息中推断合适的对话行为。因此缺乏针对隐式指令遵循的评估基准，尤其是实时口语交互场景下的评估。
AI.method: 构建DSB-IFEval基准：包含1038个测试用例和8种多样的助手角色；设计5种指令遵循条件协议（默认行为、显式行为指令、人格隐含行为、人格-规则联合条件、指令冲突）；采用两维度的评估指标——确定性IAS分数衡量实时话语管理（轮次控制），LLM评判的PAS分数衡量人格一致内容；在6个实时语音系统上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 发现架构依赖性的权衡：全双工模型（F-Actor和PersonaPlex）对行为是显式陈述还是需从人格推断较为敏感，在仅人格条件下遵循度分别下降9.7%和4.5%；而GPT-Realtime、MiniCPM-o和Fun-Audio-Chat能强烈遵循人格一致内容，但其轮次行为不随显式与人格指令变化，且多种主动动作受限。此外，即使系统能可靠遵循指向其人设的冲突指令，在安全冲突下仍难以覆盖这些指令。
AI.conclusion: 从角色推断行为、在适当的对话时机执行该行为以及解决竞争性指令，仍是全双工语音代理面临的三个不同挑战，当前系统在这三方面表现存在显著能力分化。

title: R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models
summary: Evaluating robot manipulation policies is becoming increasingly important as generalist models, particularly vision-language-action (VLA) models, are deployed on physical robots. However, conventional real-world evaluation remains labor-intensive, unstable, and insufficiently informative. It requires repeated hardware trials, manual scene resets, and continuous operator monitoring, may produce different policy rankings across repeated evaluations, and primarily relies on success-rate metrics that provide limited information about execution quality. In contrast, humans assess robot performance by observing and comparing complete behaviors rather than relying solely on binary success outcomes. To this end, we propose R2S-Eval, an evaluation pipeline that combines real-to-sim calibration with vision-language model (VLM) preference evaluation. The real-to-sim component efficiently generates rollout videos in a simulator calibrated to the real-world evaluation setting, thereby reducing the need for repeated hardware trials. The VLM evaluator assesses the execution quality of rollout videos and produces pairwise preferences, which are subsequently aggregated into policy rankings. We further introduce a protocol to assess whether the proposed evaluation pipeline yields validated policy conclusions while mitigating the key challenges of conventional real-world evaluation. Experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that R2S-Eval produces reliable and stable policy conclusions, achieves agreement with human preferences, substantially reduces repeated hardware-operation effort, and reveals behavior-quality differences that are not captured by binary success labels. In general, R2S-Eval advances robot evaluation from manual success counting toward automated, statistically stable, and quality-aware evaluation of robot behavior. Project page: https://r2s-eval.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R2S-Eval评估流水线，结合"真实到仿真"校准与视觉语言模型（VLM）偏好评估，用于自动、稳定且质量感知地评估机器人操作策略。
AI.motivation: 随着VLA等通用模型部署于实体机器人，传统真实世界评估劳动密集、不稳定且信息量有限——需重复硬件试验、手动场景重置和持续监控，且结果可能在不同评估轮次中产生不一致排名，主要依赖成功率指标而无法反映执行质量。
AI.method: R2S-Eval包含两个核心组件：(1) 真实到仿真校准组件，在标定到真实评估环境的仿真中高效生成rollout视频，减少重复硬件试验；(2) VLM评估器，评估rollout视频的执行质量并生成成对偏好，再聚合成策略排名。同时提出一个协议来评估该流水线是否能产生经过验证的策略结论。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实环境中的实验表明，R2S-Eval能产生可靠且稳定的策略结论，与人类偏好达成一致，显著减少重复硬件操作工作量，并能揭示二进制成功标签无法捕捉的行为质量差异。
AI.conclusion: R2S-Eval将机器人评估从手动成功计数推进到自动化、统计稳定且质量感知的行为评估范式。

title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
summary: Visual fluency in generated video does not imply physical reliability, and a scalar quality score alone is incapable of indicating the obligation a clip violates or the moment it fails. We present VeriPhy, an auditable physical-verification system in which a text-only planner compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations and a statically validated execution plan before any frame is observed. During execution, observations gate and scope only declared calls to frozen low-level experts (e.g., segmentation and tracking, counting, eleven typed physical measurements over the resulting tracks, depth, OCR, and audio-event detection). Each action returns a provenance-carrying evidence record whose payload, when usable, is either a typed measurement or an explicitly tagged learned state. Typed resolvers and fixed composition map usable records to a three-valued state (supported, contradicted, or unknown, surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain) with full provenance, so that every verdict is traceable to the evidence that produced it. We anchor evaluation in a 1,500-clip corpus of human-annotated flaw records that localize real generation failures in prompt reference, space, and time. On a 149-clip core carrying 304 such records, VeriPhy accounts for 228, against 164 for a published question-decomposition evaluator given the same clips and the same claims. Recall alone does not separate it from prompting the same backbone monolithically, which reaches 222; what separates them is that each decision retains its evidence record and provenance, making the traces auditable one verdict at a time and usable as the interface through which a critic verdict could be written back into generation.

AI.tldr: VeriPhy是一个可审计的物理验证系统，用于验证AI生成视频中物理上的可靠性。它通过文本规划器将提示编译为类型化物理义务和执行计划，执行时由冻结的低层专家产生带来源证明的证据记录，类型化解析器将可用的记录映射为支持/矛盾/未知三值判断。在含304条缺陷记录的149条核心视频中，VeriPhy覆盖228条，优于已有评估器的164条，并与整体提示基线（222条）持平，但其关键优势在于每个判定都保留证据与来源，可逐条审计并支持将批评写回生成过程。
AI.motivation: 生成视频的视觉流畅度并不代表物理可信度，单一的标量质量评分无法指出视频违反了哪项约束或在哪一时刻出现故障。因此需要一个可审计的系统，不仅能给出判断，还能追溯每个结论背后承担的证据与失败的具体位置。
AI.method: VeriPhy包含三个核心组件：(1) 文本规划器在观察任何帧之前将提示编译成类型化的物理义务和静态验证过的执行计划；(2) 执行阶段观测门控并限定已声明的冻结低层专家调用（包括分割、跟踪、计数、十一种类型的物理测量、深度、OCR和音频事件检测），每个动作返回携带来源证明的证据记录，负载为类型化测量值或显式标记的学习状态；(3) 类型化解析器与固定组合将可用记录映射为三值状态（plausible/implausible/abstain），附带完整来源信息使每个判定可溯源。
AI.result: 在1,500条视频语料（含人工标注的缺陷记录，定位真实生成在提示引用、空间和时间上的失败）中，以149条核心视频的304条缺陷记录为基准，VeriPhy覆盖228条，优于发布的问答分解评估器的164条。与用相同骨干模型整体提示获得的222条相比，两者召回率相近，但VeriPhy的决定都保留证据记录和来源，提供逐条可审计的轨迹，可作为批评判定写回生成的接口。
AI.conclusion: VeriPhy的核心贡献不仅是提高检测覆盖率，而是建立了一个可审计的物理验证管线——每个判定都可以追溯到具体证据并逐条检查。这种来源保留机制使得验证结果不仅能判断视频是否物理可靠，还能作为生成过程的反馈接口，弥合验证与生成之间的鸿沟。

title: Population-Calibrated Graph Screening at 835-Million-Address Scale, with Label-Free Transfer to New Chains
comment: 25 pages, 9 tables. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/ai-decisions
summary: Compliance screening of blockchain addresses is, in practice, a lookup against sanctions registries plus clustering heuristics; it fails on unlabelled addresses and on chains with no label coverage at all. We describe a deployed system that scores an address by its position in a multi-chain transaction graph rather than by its presence in a list. The substrate is a single graph of 835,330,427 addresses and 15,826,261,934 edges across five EVM chains; a shared inductive encoder with per-chain normalisation feeds two scoring heads. Decision thresholds are exact quantiles of the score distribution over the full population, scanned per chain segment, so the alert volume is known in advance. We report: label-free transfer: heads trained on two chains recall 0.8598 / 0.8182 / 0.9967 of held-out positives on Base, Arbitrum and Gnosis at a $10^{-3}$ population alert rate, with no target-chain labels in head training; a static lead-time replay over 68 external registry events: 40 of 68 (58.8%) flagged at the 0.1% budget, $\times$152 over an event-level random-flagging baseline, with first on-chain appearance a median of 528.8 days (Ethereum) / 647.8 days (Tron) before public designation; a serving path whose score is bit-identical to the offline artefact at end-to-end p50 151 ms, gated by a 2,882-address drift panel; and an adversarial harness of eight recurrent reinforcement-learned archetypes that passes an 8-criterion degeneracy audit and, on a detector-independent snapshot, exposes a measured blind spot of the deployed heads against synthesised behaviour.
