AI.tldr: 本文描述了一个已部署的基于多链交易图地址位置评分而非黑名单匹配的合规筛查系统，覆盖5条EVM链上8.35亿地址、158亿边。系统采用共享归纳编码器加逐链归一化，配双评分头，决策阈值为全总体分数分布的精确分位数。实验表明：无需目标链标签即可跨链迁移（Base/Arbitrum/Gnosis上召回率0.8598/0.8182/0.9967）；对68个外部监管事件中40个实现早期预警；端到端服务p50仅151ms且与离线分数逐位一致；通过了8标准退化审计，但对抗性强化学习原型暴露了部署头在合成行为上的盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有合规筛查本质上是针对制裁名单的查找加聚类启发式，对未标注地址以及无标签覆盖的链完全失效。需要一个不依赖名单本身、能够在无标签链上泛化的图结构评分方案来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建跨5条EVM链的统一交易图（8.353亿地址、158.26亿边），采用共享归纳编码器配合逐链归一化，输出两个评分头。决策阈值取全总群分数分布的精确分位数并按链段扫描，使得告警量可预先确定。系统还配备2800余地址的漂移监控面板，以及由8种递归强化学习原型构成的对抗性验证装置。
AI.result: 跨链迁移：在Base、Arbitrum、Gnosis上对留出正样本召回0.8598/0.8182/0.9967（10^-3总体告警率，训练头不含目标链标签）；68个外部监管事件静态提前回放中40个（58.8%）在0.1%预算下被标记，为事件级随机标记基线的152倍，首次链上出现中位数比公开指定早528.8天（以太坊）和647.8天（Tron）；服务路径p50为151ms且分数与离线产物逐位一致；对抗性装置通过8标准退化审计，但在与部署模型无关的快照上暴露了探测盲区。
AI.conclusion: 基于图位置的评分系统可以替代名单式查找，实现跨链标签自由迁移和显著的提前预警能力，同时保持可部署级别的服务性能与确定性；但对抗性审计表明，面对递归强化学习合成的行为模式，部署模型仍存在可量化的盲区，提示需要持续演进对抗覆盖。

title: Margins, Not Windows: Training-Free Per-Step Lossy Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting candidate tokens and verifying them in parallel. Tree-attention drafters such as EAGLE-3 are widely adopted, yet typically hold two decisions fixed: (1) a strict token-match verification rule and (2) a static draft-tree shape. Prior work relaxes each in isolation under limiting assumptions: long draft chains for training-free lossy verification, and adaptive tree shaping under a fixed token budget. We introduce AdaptiveSpec, a training-free per-step speculative decoding method that adapts both decisions from internal signals already produced during decoding. A per-step margin rule promotes a mismatched draft-proposed token when the ratio of the target's probability on the drafted token to its top-1 probability exceeds a threshold with no dependence on draft length or underlying drafter architecture. A per-step tree policy adjusts the draft tree's depth, width, and node count directly from a fused signal of draft top-1 confidence and a rolling acceptance history capturing recent draft-target agreement, allowing the total draft count to vary rather than only be redistributed. The two adaptations operate on orthogonal axes and compound in effect. Implemented on the SGLang production-grade serving engine, AdaptiveSpec improves throughput over the state-of-the-art autoregressive speculative decoding method EAGLE-3 by up to 56%, recovering 93% to fully lossless task accuracy across GSM8K, MATH-500, and HumanEval on three target models (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B).

AI.tldr: 提出了AdaptiveSpec，一种无需训练的逐步骤投机解码方法，同时自适应调整两个传统上固定的决策：token匹配验证规则和草案树形状，在SGLang服务器上实现比EAGLE-3最高56%的吞吐量提升，并保持93%至完全无损的任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 树注意力草案生成器（如EAGLE-3）广泛用于投机解码，但传统上固定两个决策：(1)严格的token匹配验证规则和(2)静态草案树形状。先前工作仅在受限假设下各自松弛其中一个决策，缺乏同时自适应调整这两个正交维度的方案。作者希望利用解码过程中已产生的内部信号，无需额外训练即可同时优化这两个决策。
AI.method: AdaptiveSpec包含两个正交的自适应机制：(1)逐步骤margin规则——当目标模型对草案token的概率与其top-1概率之比超过阈值时，接受不匹配的草案token，该规则不依赖草案长度或草案器架构；(2)逐步骤树策略——融合草案top-1置信度和滚动接受历史（捕捉最近草案-目标一致性）两个信号，动态调整草案树的深度、宽度和节点数量，使总草案数量可变而非仅重新分配。
AI.result: 在SGLang生产级服务引擎上实现，相比当前最先进的回归投机解码方法EAGLE-3，吞吐量提升最高达56%；在GSM8K、MATH-500和HumanEval三个基准上，针对三种目标模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B），任务准确率恢复93%至完全无损。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明两个自适应机制在正交轴上工作且效果可叠加，AdaptiveSpec通过利用解码过程中已有的内部信号，实现了无需训练的自适应投机解码，在显著提升吞吐量的同时保持任务准确率的无损或近无损水平。

title: No-Regret Bayesian Optimization with Finite-Library Input-Warped Kernels
summary: Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization (GP-BO) excels at black-box optimization of costly functions, e.g., hyperparameter optimization (HPO) and multi-agent system (MAS) design. Convergence-rate guarantees exist for select methods, notably GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB), but require a fixed kernel. Critically, the kernel encodes how input proximity affects objective value similarity. When raw coordinates poorly match this geometry - as with log-scaled hyperparameters or localized peaks - input warping can greatly improve sample efficiency, yet known GP-UCB proofs require a fixed kernel. We propose Finite-Library Input-Warped Bayesian Optimization (FLIWBO), which selects warps from a finite library of smooth input maps by any history-dependent rule. It adapts the input geometry to accelerate learning while retaining high-probability convergence guarantees under mild hypotheses, with an explicit $\sqrt(N_\varepsilon)$ library-size cost. Controlled diagnostics show that finite-library warping repairs planted geometry mismatches and identify FLIWBO failure cases. Across four repeated benchmarks - warped synthetic objectives, a confidence-fence trap, and Fashion-MNIST HPO - FLIWBO-UCB beats raw-coordinate GP-UCB under misspecified geometry, escapes traps that defeat even oracle-warp expected improvement, and recovers much of the gain from manual log scaling, while leading the tested methods that admit a matching regret guarantee. A 20-dimensional MAS design study further shows feasibility under costly noisy evaluations. Code for experiments is available: https://github.com/edvin-ketabati/bogp-paper-experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLIWBO（有限库输入扭曲贝叶斯优化），从有限个平滑输入映射库中自适应选择扭曲函数以修正输入几何失配问题，在保持GP-BO高概率收敛保证的同时显著提升采样效率，并在四类基准测试及20维多智能体系统设计任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: GP-BO在昂贵的黑盒优化（如HPO和MAS设计）中表现优异，但收敛保证（如GP-UCB）要求固定核函数，而核函数中编码的输入几何关系在原始坐标与真实目标函数几何不匹配时（如对数尺度超参数或局部峰值）会严重损害采样效率。输入扭曲虽能改善效率，但现有理论证明不适用于扭曲后的可变核，缺乏兼具收敛保证与几何适应能力的方法。
AI.method: FLIWBO从有限平滑映射库中按任意历史依赖规则选取输入扭曲，通过自适应调整输入几何加速学习。理论层面在温和假设下保留了高概率收敛保证，并显式给出库规模导致的sqrt(N_epsilon)代价；实验层面通过可控诊断测试检验扭曲修复几何失配的效果并识别失败案例，在合成扭曲目标、置信栅栏陷阱和Fashion-MNIST HPO等重复基准上对比FLIWBO-UCB与原始坐标GP-UCB，并在20维MAS设计中验证代价评估场景下的可行性。
AI.result: FLIWBO-UCB在几何失配情况下优于原始坐标GP-UCB；能逃离连oracle扭曲期望改进都不能破解的置信栅栏陷阱；恢复手工对数缩放的绝大部分性能增益；在具备匹配遗憾保证的已测方法中表现领先；在20维MAS设计中证实了昂贵噪声评估下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: FLIWBO通过有限扭曲库自适应修正输入几何，首次在不牺牲严格收敛保证的前提下解决GP-BO中的几何失配问题，兼顾理论完善性与实际性能，为后续推广到更大扭曲库和更复杂应用提供了基础。

title: Latency-Aware Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows on Heterogeneous GPUs
summary: Concurrent multi-agent workflows expose future dependencies and serving-state requirements while running on heterogeneous GPU pools with time-varying load, model residency, and resource availability. The logical workflow defines the required computation, whereas its physical scheduling units, model-lifecycle actions, resource ordering, and placement must be selected according to the observed pool state. We present a prediction-guided runtime that uses workflow forecasts to construct and optimize a physical execution graph. Predictor estimates device-specific activation latency, peak memory, and model-loading cost, then propagates these predictions through workflow dependencies to forecast activation readiness and future model demand. Constructor builds semantics-preserving fusion and model-lifecycle alternatives, while Scheduler jointly optimizes their selection, placement, and execution order based on the live pool state. Across a workload spanning three workflow scenarios on a heterogeneous GPU pool, our system reduces end-to-end makespan and overall p95 completion latency under burst arrivals by up to 36.8% and 25.9%, respectively, over state-of-the-art workflow schedulers. It also saves up to 24.63 GPU-s per completed session.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个预测引导的运行时系统，利用工作流预测构建和优化物理执行图，以应对异构GPU池上并发多代理工作流的调度挑战，相比最先进的调度器在端到端makespan、p95完成延迟和GPU资源消耗上分别提升最高达36.8%、25.9%和24.63 GPU-s。
AI.motivation: 并发多代理工作流在异构GPU池上运行面临时间变化的负载、模型驻留和资源可用性等复杂状态，逻辑工作流定义了所需计算，但物理调度单元（模型生命周期动作、资源排序和放置）必须根据观测到的池状态来动态选择，缺乏能有效联合优化这些物理层面的调度方案。
AI.method: 系统由三个核心组件构成：预测器（Predictor）估计设备特定的激活延迟、峰值内存和模型加载成本，并通过工作流依赖传播预测激活就绪时间和未来模型需求；构造器（Constructor）构建语义保持的融合和模型生命周期替代方案；调度器（Scheduler）基于实时池状态联合优化这些方案的选择、放置和执行顺序。
AI.result: 在覆盖三个工作流场景的异构GPU池工作负载上，相比最先进的调度器，系统在突发到达下将端到端makespan降低最高36.8%，p95完成延迟降低最高25.9%，每个完成会话节省最高24.63 GPU-s。
AI.conclusion: 预测引导的物理执行图优化能够有效应对异构GPU池上的并发多代理工作流调度挑战，在延迟和资源效率上均显著优于现有方案。

title: Do GUI Agents Know When Not to Act? Enabling Conflict-Aware Termination for Multimodal GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are increasingly used to execute natural-language instructions on user interfaces, yet real users may issue infeasible instructions due to benign mistakes. A reliable agent should not only know how to act, but also when not to act. In this work, we introduce CONFLICTGUI, a benchmark covering instruction-internal conflicts and instruction-GUI context conflicts to study conflict-aware termination. Our evaluation reveals severe execution-biased overcompliance: agents that perform well on feasible tasks often continue to execute blindly under conflicting instructions. To mitigate this behavior, we propose CONFLICTGUARD, an inference-time framework that aligns an agent's feasibility awareness with its action generation. CONFLICTGUARD contains two coupled components: a feasibility verification protocol that guides the agent to assess instruction logic and GUI-side evidence before acting, and a conditional action modulation mechanism that steers agents from over-compliant execution into termination-oriented behavior. Experiments across five widely-used agents demonstrate that CONFLICTGUARD improves average conflict task success rate significantly, while preserving normal GUI-task performance. These results validate that a lightweight inference-time intervention can substantially boost GUI Agent's competence to identify inappropriate execution scenarios and refrain from unnecessary actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CONFLICTGUI基准，用于评估GUI代理在处理不可行/冲突指令时的冲突感知终止能力，并提出了CONFLICTGUARD推理时框架，通过可行性验证协议和条件动作调制机制，显著提升五个主流GUI代理在冲突任务上的成功率，同时不损害正常任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现实用户可能因无心错误发出不可行的指令，可靠的GUI代理不仅要知道如何行动，还要知道何时不行动。现有代理存在严重的"执行偏向性过度顺从"问题——在可行任务上表现良好的代理，面对冲突指令时仍会盲目执行。
AI.method: 1) 构建CONFLICTGUI基准，覆盖指令内部冲突和指令与GUI上下文冲突两大类；2) 提出CONFLICTGUARD推理时框架，包含两个耦合组件：可行性验证协议（引导代理在行动前评估指令逻辑和GUI侧证据）和条件动作调制机制（将过度顺从的执行行为引导为终止导向行为）。
AI.result: 在五个广泛使用的GUI代理上进行的实验表明，CONFLICTGUARD显著提高了冲突任务的平均成功率，同时保持了正常的GUI任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级的推理时干预能够大幅提升GUI代理识别不当执行场景并克制不必要行动的能力，验证了可行性感知与动作生成对齐的有效性。

title: ARTiS: An Adaptive Robotic Gripper for Enhanced Tool Manipulation in Disassembly Applications
summary: Grasping and holding tools while using them presents a considerable challenge not only for robots but also for humans. Such a challenge is particularly noticeable in processes involving assembly and disassembly, where efficiency and consistency depend on performing rapidly adaptive tasks. Nonetheless, contemporary robotic grasping technologies that can securely manipulate tools during operation frequently have significant constraints. In this paper, introduce ARTiS (Adaptive Robotic Tool Gripper in Disassembly Systems), a novel gripper that combines the adaptability of soft grippers, the dexterity of anthropomorphic hands, and the robustness of rigid mechanisms with a soft palm and fingertips. This unique combination makes it possible to hold tools securely in a variety of situations through using active jamming in the palm and fin-ray adaptation in fingertips. Furthermore, high finger dexterity is achieved through the seven degrees of freedom design, which enables the fingertips to orient to any surface, both for automated solutions and collaborative tasks. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted using a range of conventional disassembly tools to assess the gripper's compliance, durability, and functional versatility. More information, hardware instructions, and videos at https://romanmykhailyshyn.github.io/artis/

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种新型机器人夹具ARTiS（自适应机器人工具夹具，用于拆解系统），它结合了软体夹具的适应性、拟人手的灵活性和刚性机构的鲁棒性，采用带软质手掌和指尖的设计及主动堵塞和鳍射线适应机制，以实现拆装过程中工具的稳定握持与灵巧操作。
AI.motivation: 在组装与拆解等工业过程中，机器人及人类在使用工具时都需要可靠握持并操作工具，这对适应性和一致性要求极高。然而，现有机器人抓取技术在处理运行中的工具时存在明显局限性，无法同时兼顾快速适应任务所需的灵活性、稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 本文提出ARTiS夹具，其核心设计融合了三种机制：（1）软质手掌中的主动堵塞（active jamming）技术，用于牢固且自适应地握持工具；（2）指尖采用鳍射线（fin-ray）适应结构，增强对不规则表面的贴合能力；（3）通过七个自由度设计实现高手指灵活性，使指尖能够朝向任意表面，适用于自动化与协作任务。
AI.result: 使用一系列常规拆解工具进行了综合评估，验证了该夹具在顺应性（compliance）、耐用性（durability）和功能多样性（functional versatility）方面的性能。
AI.conclusion: ARTiS通过软硬融合的设计思路，在拆解系统中实现了对工具的稳定握持与灵巧操作，兼具自动化和人机协作场景的适用性，为机器人工具操作提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: Who Speaks for the Pruned? Visual Token Pruning as Coverage Optimization
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but most methods only ask which tokens to keep. This retained-token view can keep redundant high-scoring tokens while leaving discarded evidence without a close representative. We propose CoverPruner, a training-free pruner that asks the complementary demand-side question: after a token is removed, which surviving original token represents it for the target VLM? CoverPruner formulates pruning as Representational Coverage Maximization (RCM), covering the full projected visual-token set with query-weighted demand. It instantiates RCM with projector-space coverage and a lightweight first-layer attention probe. Across multiple VLM architectures and compression rates, CoverPruner achieves the best average accuracy among all compared methods, with the largest gains usually appearing under aggressive compression.

AI.tldr: CoverPruner是一种免训练的可视化token剪枝方法，通过问"token被移除后哪个幸存token能代表它"这一需求侧问题，将剪枝建模为表征覆盖最大化（RCM）问题，在多种VLM架构和压缩率下取得最佳平均准确率，尤其在激进压缩下增益最大。
AI.motivation: 现有可视化token剪枝方法大多只关注"保留哪些token"（供给侧视角），导致可能保留冗余的高分token，同时丢弃的token缺乏相近的代表token，信息损失无法被量化控制。
AI.method: 提出CoverPruner，一种免训练的剪枝器，从需求侧视角出发，将剪枝形式化为表征覆盖最大化（RCM）问题——用查询加权的需求覆盖完整的投影视觉token集合。具体实例化采用投影器空间覆盖和一个轻量级第一层注意力探针。
AI.result: 在多种VLM架构和压缩率下，CoverPruner在平均准确率上优于所有对比方法，最大的性能提升通常出现在激进压缩场景下。
AI.conclusion: 从供给侧转向需求侧的token剪枝视角是有效的，通过确保被移除的token有高保真的幸存代表，可以在不训练的情况下实现更好的剪枝性能，尤其是在高压缩率下优势更为明显。

title: Differentially private federated learning with Byzantine-robust aggregation: A cross-domain framework for secure model training in banking and healthcare systems
summary: Federated learning allows banks, hospitals, and other regulated organizations to train a shared model without moving raw records off their own servers, which is attractive wherever data protection law or competitive sensitivity rules out pooling data centrally. Two problems limit how far this promise can be trusted in practice. First, the parameter updates that clients exchange still leak information about local records through gradient inversion and membership inference attacks. Second, an honest averaging rule such as FedAvg has no defense against a subset of clients that submit corrupted or adversarial updates, so a small number of malicious or compromised participants can quietly steer the shared model off course. This paper presents a federated learning framework, DP-BR-FedAvg, that combines a Gaussian-mechanism differential privacy layer with a coordinate-wise trimmed-mean Byzantine-robust aggregation rule, evaluated on a simulated cross-institutional classification task resembling fraud and clinical-risk scoring. Across sixty communication rounds with twenty clients, a quarter of them Byzantine, plain FedAvg collapses on the minority class (F1-score 0.030) while the proposed framework recovers substantially more of the signal (F1-score 0.119) while bounding the privacy loss of any single client's contribution. A Byzantine-robust aggregator with no privacy layer performs best in raw accuracy, quantifying the cost privacy imposes on robustness. The results show that privacy and robustness mechanisms interact rather than simply add, and that system design for regulated, adversarial, cross-institutional settings needs to budget for that interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-BR-FedAvg，一个结合差分隐私（高斯机制）与坐标wise修剪均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合的联邦学习框架，在模拟跨机构分类任务（类似欺诈和临床风险评分）中验证其能在恶意客户端攻击下保持模型性能，同时限制单个客户端的隐私泄露。结果显示纯FedAvg在少数类上F1仅为0.030，而该框架恢复至0.119，并量化了隐私机制对鲁棒性的成本代价。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在受监管机构（如银行、医院）中虽有数据不出本地的优势，但存在两个关键问题：客户端交换的参数更新会通过梯度反演和成员推断攻击泄露本地数据信息；诚实平均规则（如FedAvg）无法防御恶意或受损客户端提交的腐败更新。这两个问题限制了联邦学习在实践中的可信度，亟需一个能同时应对隐私泄露和拜占庭攻击的框架。
AI.method: 提出DP-BR-FedAvg框架，由两部分组成：(1) 高斯机制的差分隐私层，用于限制任何单个客户端贡献带来的隐私损失；(2) 坐标-wise修剪均值（coordinate-wise trimmed-mean）拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则，用于抵御恶意客户端的腐败更新。在60轮通信、20个客户端（其中四分之一为拜占庭恶意节点）的模拟跨机构分类任务上进行评估，任务类似欺诈检测和临床风险评分。
AI.result: 在60轮通信中（20个客户端，四分之一为拜占庭客户端），纯FedAvg在少数类上崩溃（F1-score为0.030），而DP-BR-FedAvg大幅恢复了信号（F1-score为0.119），同时界定了任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失。无隐私层的仅拜占庭鲁棒聚合器在原始准确率上表现最佳，量化了隐私机制对鲁棒性造成的成本。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明隐私和鲁棒性机制之间存在交互而非简单叠加效应。在设计面向受监管、对抗性、跨机构联邦学习系统时，需要为这种隐私-鲁棒性交互进行预算规划，而不能将二者视为独立可加的设计因素。

title: Distilled Rapid Embedding Transfer (DRET): Parameter-Efficient Biomedical Domain Adaptation via Priority-Based Embedding Transfer
summary: Large domain-specific language models such as BioBERT and ClinicalBERT achieve strong performance on biomedical NLP tasks, but their computational demands make them impractical for many real-world deployments. General-purpose, parameter-efficient models such as DistilBERT are lightweight yet lack the domain knowledge required for specialized tasks such as PICO (Population, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome) classification. We introduce Distilled Rapid Embedding Transfer (DRET), a knowledge-transfer paradigm that injects biomedical domain knowledge from large specialized models into a smaller general-purpose model without retraining on the original specialized corpora. DRET is developed as an iterative family of strategies: a unified tokenizer-merge strategy (DRET 1.x), hybrid embedding averaging (DRET 2.0), and a priority-based embedding-transfer mechanism (DRET 3.x) that hierarchically selects embeddings from the most authoritative source models, further combined with embedding-layer freezing, differential learning rates, label propagation, and imbalance-aware loss functions (DRET 4.x). We evaluate DRET on token-level PICO classification using the EBM-NLP corpus under severe class imbalance, across a twelve-metric battery. DRET-enhanced DistilBERT (66M parameters) attains balanced accuracy, recall, and ROC-AUC competitive with, and on several class-wise metrics exceeding, models an order of magnitude larger, while retaining DistilBERT's efficiency. We further show that transfer occurs at the embedding level through cosine-similarity, semantic-shift, and t-SNE analyses. DRET offers a scalable, resource-efficient route to near-domain-expert performance for biomedical text mining, with direct application to automated systematic literature reviews and clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出蒸馏快速嵌入迁移（DRET）范式，将大型生物医学领域模型（如BioBERT、ClinicalBERT）的领域知识注入到小型通用模型（如DistilBERT）中，无需在原始专业语料上重新训练。DRET通过迭代策略家族（分词器合并、嵌入平均、优先级嵌入迁移、冻结嵌入层等）实现，在EBM-NLP语料库上以66M参数的DistilBERT获得了与大一个数量级模型相当甚至超越的PICO分类性能。
AI.motivation: 大型领域专用模型（如BioBERT、ClinicalBERT）性能强但计算开销大，难以满足实际部署需求；而参数高效的通用模型（如DistilBERT）虽然轻量却缺乏生物医学领域知识。亟需一种既能保留小模型效率、又能注入领域知识的方案。
AI.method: DRET是一个迭代式知识迁移范式家族：（1）DRET 1.x采用统一分词器合并策略；（2）DRET 2.0采用混合嵌入平均；（3）DRET 3.x采用基于优先级的嵌入迁移机制，从最具权威性的源模型中分层选择嵌入；（4）DRET 4.x进一步结合嵌入层冻结、差分学习率、标签传播和不平衡感知损失函数。
AI.result: 在EBM-NLP语料库上进行严重类不平衡条件下的token级PICO分类评估，使用12项指标集。DRET增强的DistilBERT（66M参数）在平衡准确率、召回率和ROC-AUC上与大一个数量级的模型相当，在若干类别级指标上甚至超越。通过余弦相似度、语义偏移和t-SNE分析证实迁移发生在嵌入层面。
AI.conclusion: DRET提供了一条可扩展且资源高效实现近领域专家级性能的路径，对生物医学文本挖掘、自动化系统文献综述和临床决策支持具有直接应用价值。

title: Evaluating Graph Neural Networks for Change-Criticality Classification in Maritime Navigation Charts
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a class of neural networks suitable for learning on graph-structured data. Their application to spatial data is a natural extension, however its relatively unclear which message-passing operations, architectural configurations, and graph representation is best suited for classifying changes to objects in electronic navigational charts (ENCs)--geospatial vector datasets used for marine navigation. Maintaining these datasets is a challenge, and categorizing changes to objects in the ENC based on their significance to navigational safety is of particular importance. Here, we propose to represent these vector navigation datasets as a graph structure where the spatial objects serve as nodes and their spatial and semantic relationships form edges. We encode both the old ENC dataset and new ENC dataset into a pair of graphs and frame the task as a graph-pair classification problem. Building on this representation, we investigate the use of GNN architectures to classify whether the encoded graphs constitutes a critical or non-critical risk to navigational safety. We train and evaluate several GNN architectures and model configurations on ENC changes reviewed by maritime experts. Our results demonstrate that graph-based representations improve the classification of ENC updates, providing a scalable approach for automating or improving ENC maintenance workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将电子航海图（ENC）矢量空间数据表示为图结构，将旧版与新版的ENC数据编码为图对，并采用图神经网络（GNN）分类图对，以判断对象变更是否为航行安全的关键风险，从而提升ENC维护工作流的自动化水平。
AI.motivation: ENC是用于海洋导航的地理空间矢量数据集，其维护过程中需要对空间对象的变化进行分类，判断其对航行安全的重要性。然而，目前尚不清楚哪种消息传递操作、架构配置和图表示最适合此任务，因此需要系统性地探索GNN在该领域的应用。
AI.method: 将ENC空间对象作为节点，空间与语义关系作为边构建图结构；将旧版和新版ENC分别编码为一对图，将任务形式化为图对分类问题；在此基础上训练并评估多种GNN架构和模型配置，对图中变化是否构成关键或非关键航行安全风险进行分类。
AI.result: 基于图的表示方法有效提升了ENC更新分类的性能，提供了可扩展的方案来自动化或改进ENC维护工作流。
AI.conclusion: 图表示和GNN架构适用于ENC变更的重要性分类任务，能够为海洋导航数据维护提供自动化支持，具有实际应用价值。

title: Beyond "Made with AI": Visualizing Provenance Density to Mitigate the Transparency Penalty
summary: As generative AI makes polished prose cheap to produce, users can no longer rely on fluency as a proxy for truth. We call this failure mode the Fluency Trap: users trust fluent hallucinations while also discounting accurate content once it is disclosed as AI-generated. Binary ``Made with AI'' labels respond with authorship disclosure, but they do not show what supports a claim. We propose Provenance Density, an evidence-visualization interface that shows the density of verified claims in a text. In a user study with 81 participants, an idealized Provenance Density interface produced a large discernment gap between truth and fabrication ($+4.15$ points, $d=1.82$), whereas participants given no signal showed no detectable discrimination. A technical audit with 200 samples shows that retrieval density alone is insufficient; unexpectedly, the Consistency Veto carries most of the discriminative signal on dynamic queries. As AI-generated content becomes indistinguishable from human writing, effective transparency must move from authorship disclosure toward evidence visualization.

AI.tldr: 提出"流畅性陷阱"概念：生成式AI让流畅文本不再是真实性的代理指标。论文提出"来源密度"（Provenance Density）作为证据可视化界面，通过81人用户研究显示其能产生明显的真伪判别差距（+4.15分，d=1.82），而对照组无信号时无判别能力。200样本技术审计发现仅检索密度不足，Consistency Veto在动态查询中承担主要判别信号。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使得流水般流畅的文本可廉价生产，用户不能再依赖语言的流畅度作为判断真实性的代理指标。这一失败模式被称为"流畅性陷阱"：用户既信任流畅的幻觉内容，又在内容被披露为AI生成后低估其准确部分。此外，现有的"Made with AI"二元标签只回应了作者身份披露，却没有展示文本中支持某一主张的证据，无法帮助用户有效辨别真伪。
AI.method: 提出源头密度（Provenance Density）界面，即一种证据可视化交互界面，用于展示文本中经核实主张的密度。研究方法包括：(1) 81名参与者的用户研究，对比理想化的Provenance Density界面与无信号对照组；(2) 200个样本的技术审计，检验检索密度（retrieval density）以及一致性否决（Consistency Veto）等不同判别信号的效能。
AI.result: 用户研究显示：使用理想化Provenance Density界面的参与者在真实与伪造内容之间产生了显著的判别差距（+4.15分，效应量d=1.82），而无信号的对照组表现出不可检测的判别能力。技术审计结果出乎意料：仅凭检索密度不足以提供判别信息，Consistency Veto（一致性否决）在动态查询场景中承载了大部分判别信号。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI生成内容与人类书写日益难以区分，有效的透明性机制应从作者身份披露（authorship disclosure）转向证据可视化（evidence visualization）。"Made with AI"之类的二元标签不足以帮助用户辨别虚假内容，需要从内容可信度源头提供可视化证据支撑。

title: Programming and execution of skill-based human-robot-crane collaborative tasks
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures, accepted for publication in IECON 2026
summary: Highly varying production sets increasing challenges for robotic manufacturing and indoor logistics. New capabilities for agility, flexibility, and robustness are needed. Robot skills, integrating motions, tool operations, and sensor perceptions consistently provide an execution mechanism for a versatile set of tasks with varying parameters. In this paper, easy-to-use CAD-model based programming and execution system for parametrized skills and skill monitors is showcased. The execution control structure is dynamic and parametrized, based on a modified Behavior Tree, where only event based communication is used. A human-robot-crane collaborative skill is shown as a test example, where a human instructs an overhead crane and a manipulator in inserting a heavy object supported by the crane, and guided by the manipulator, into the goal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CAD模型的编程与执行系统，用于参数化机器人技能和技能监视器，采用改进的行为树（仅事件通信）实现动态参数化执行控制。通过人-机器人-起重机协作插入重物的案例验证了系统性能。
AI.motivation: 生产集合高度变化给机器人制造和室内物流带来挑战，需要增强敏捷性、灵活性和鲁棒性。机器人技能将运动、工具操作和传感器感知一致集成，为多参数多任务提供执行机制，因此需要更易用的技能编程与执行系统。
AI.method: 提出一个基于CAD模型的编程与执行系统，支持参数化技能和技能监视器。执行控制结构采用改进的行为树（Behavior Tree），该结构是动态和参数化的，仅使用基于事件的通信方式。
AI.result: 通过一个人-机器人-起重机协作技能作为测试案例展示：人类指导高架起重机和机械臂协作，将起重机支撑的重物由机械臂引导插入目标位置，验证了系统在协作场景下的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该基于CAD模型的参数化技能编程与执行系统，结合改进行为树的动态事件驱动控制，为高度变化的制造与物流生产场景提供了灵活、易用且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
summary: Robot learning increasingly depends on broad and diverse demonstrations, yet collecting robot data remains expensive and poorly suited to covering the long tail of real-world tasks. To address this bottleneck, we introduce RoboTok, an internet-scale data engine that, given a query human manipulation video, retrieves manipulation-relevant human demonstrations from web videos for training dexterous robot policies. Specifically, we learn a latent motion space from 3D hand trajectories expressed in estimated actor-centered reference frames. This representation enables manipulation behaviors to be compared across variations in camera viewpoint, scene appearance, and actor occlusions, while remaining compact enough for efficient search and continual indexing over internet-scale video collections. We evaluate RoboTok against existing robot-data retrieval approaches on retrieval benchmarks and downstream robot policy performance. Our results show that RoboTok retrieves more relevant manipulation demonstrations and improves downstream task success, establishing hand-pose trajectory-aware retrieval as a way to make web video a scalable and continuously growing source of supervision for robot learning.

AI.tldr: RoboTok是一个互联网规模的数据引擎，通过查询人类操作视频，从网络视频中检索与操作相关的演示数据，用于训练灵巧机器人策略。该方法学习基于3D手部轨迹的潜在运动空间，实现了跨视角、外观和遮挡的操作行为比较，在检索基准和下游策略性能上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习日益依赖广泛多样的演示数据，但采集机器人数据成本高昂且难以覆盖真实世界任务的长尾分布。网络视频蕴含丰富的低成本人类演示，如何有效利用这些数据成为关键挑战。
AI.method: RoboTok学习一个来自3D手部轨迹的潜在运动空间，轨迹以估计的演员中心参考系表达。该表示使操作行为能够在不同相机视角、场景外观和演员遮挡情况下进行比较，同时保持紧凑性，从而支持对互联网规模视频集合的高效搜索和持续索引。
AI.result: 在检索基准和下游机器人策略性能评估中，RoboTok能够检索到更相关的操作演示，并提升下游任务成功率，验证了手部姿态轨迹感知检索的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 手部姿态轨迹感知的检索方法可以将网络视频变成机器人学习可扩展且持续增长的监督来源。

title: A Bayesian Correlated Equilibrium for Early Insider-Threat Detection
summary: We model insider threat detection as a dynamic Bayesian game in which a platform coordinates a committee of strategic certifiers to sustain equilibrium among honest users and detect malicious deviations before exfiltration. Certifiers and users operate under a Bayesian Temporal Correlated Equilibrium (BTCE), where a sealed-envelope correlating device issues private recommendations over time and obedience is verified at every on-path information state. Unlike Stackelberg formulations, BTCE coordinates heterogeneous certifiers without requiring commitment power. We incorporate present bias and loss aversion to capture impulsive escalation dynamics, enabling 1.7--4.5 days earlier detection than rational baselines. We prove three guarantees: (1) calibrated intervention losses make recommended behavior a current-self best response despite behavioral biases, (2) controlled evidence accumulation guarantees intervention in bounded expected time before exfiltration, and (3) median aggregation confines implemented actions to the honest recommendation range when fewer than half of certifiers are Byzantine. On CERT r6.2 our mechanism achieves up to 28.3% pre-exfiltration detection with false positives below 1.6%, while both a transformer baseline and a streaming provenance approximation (HOLMESLite) achieve near-zero pre-exfiltration detection under comparable constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文将内部威胁检测建模为动态贝叶斯博弈，通过平台协调战略认证者委员会维持均衡并检测恶意偏离。采用贝叶斯时间相关均衡（BTCE），结合密封信封相关设备推荐及服从验证。考虑现时偏差与损失厌恶以捕捉冲动升级动态，使检测比理性基线提前1.7-4.5天。在CERT r6.2数据集上实现28.3%渗出前检测率、低于1.6%的误报率。
AI.motivation: 传统内部威胁检测方法（如变换器基线和流式溯源近似HOLMESLite）在可比约束下几乎无法实现渗出前检测。现有Stackelberg博弈公式要求承诺权力且无法协调异构认证者，缺乏对行为偏差（现时偏差和损失厌恶）的建模。
AI.method: 将内部威胁检测建模为动态贝叶斯博弈：平台协调战略认证者委员会，在贝叶斯时间相关均衡（BTCE）框架下运行。密封信封相关设备随时间发布私有建议，并在每个在线信息状态验证服从性。纳入现时偏差和损失厌恶捕捉冲动升级行为，采用校准干预损失、受控证据积累和中间值聚合三种机制设计。
AI.result: 在CERT r6.2数据集上实现至多28.3%渗出前检测率，误报率低于1.6%；检测比理性基线提前1.7-4.5天。变换器基线和HOLMESLite在可比约束下渗出前检测率接近零。
AI.conclusion: 证明三个理论保证：(1)校准干预损失使推荐行为成为有行为偏差下当前自我的最佳响应；(2)受控证据积累保证在渗出前有界期望时间内干预；(3)当少于一半认证者拜占庭时，中间值聚合将实施动作限制在诚实推荐范围。BTCE方法无需承诺权力即可协调异构认证者。

title: Contamination Inflates Scores but Rarely Reorders Large Language Model Leaderboards
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/DoriaXiao/anchor-dif
summary: Benchmark contamination, the leakage of test items into training data, is widely described as a threat to the reliability of large language model (LLM) leaderboards. We argue that this concern conflates two distinct questions: whether contamination inflates absolute scores, and whether it reorders the ranking of models. We recast contamination as a violation of anchor-item invariance and measure it through the differential functioning of original versus semantically equivalent paraphrased items, a within-item contrast that holds the measured skill fixed and isolates memorization from capability. Using per-instance responses from 47 publicly released models and 74 models finetuned with a known dose of contamination, across four benchmarks (ARC, GSM8K, HellaSwag, MMLU), we first calibrate the measure against ground truth: it recovers injected contamination dose-responsively (a corrected effect of +0.187 accuracy points for test-set leakage) and never flags a negative-control model trained only on the legitimate training split (-0.012). We then quantify leaderboard impact: the rank correlation between a standard leaderboard and a paraphrase-controlled leaderboard is 0.997, and a sensitivity analysis shows that the observed differential contamination is far below the level needed to move rankings, with only 3 of 188 model-by-benchmark cases showing differential contamination corroborated across two references. Contamination among these public models is therefore largely uniform: it inflates absolute scores without reordering the leaderboard, and ranking distortion requires the rare case of differential contamination. We provide a calibrated invariance audit, released as a reference implementation, and recommend that leaderboards report paraphrase-controlled rankings alongside confidence intervals.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了基准测试污染问题，将污染对绝对分数的影响与对模型排名的重排影响区分开来。作者将污染重新概念化为"锚点项目不变性"的违反，并通过原始项目与其语义等价改写项目之间的差异表现来测量。利用47个公开模型和74个已知污染剂量的微调模型，在四个基准上校准了这一测量方法，发现公开模型间的污染是均匀的：会抬高绝对分数但不会重排模型排行榜（秩相关为0.997）。作者提供了校准后的不变性审计工具，并建议排行榜报告受改写控制的排名及置信区间。
AI.motivation: 基准测试污染（测试项泄漏到训练数据中）被广泛认为威胁LLM排行榜的可靠性，但现有讨论混淆了两个不同问题：污染是否抬高绝对分数（可能非致命），以及污染是否重排模型排名（这是对排行榜真正有害的）。作者希望厘清这一混淆，并提供一个可量化的方法来区分记忆与真实能力。
AI.method: 作者采用"锚点项目不变性"框架，将污染视为该不变性的违反。核心测量方法是对比原始测试项与语义等价的改写项之间的差分功能（differential item functioning），在同一技能固定条件下分离记忆与能力。实验使用47个公开模型和74个已知污染剂量微调的模型，覆盖ARC、GSM8K、HellaSwag、MMLU四个基准。通过校准测量以恢复注入污染剂的剂量-反应行为（校正效应+0.187准确率点），并验证负对照组（仅合法训练拆分训练的模型）不被误报（-0.012）。
AI.result: 校准结果表明该测量剂-反应性地恢复了注入的污染（+0.187点），且对负对照模型无误报。排行榜影响量化显示：标准排行榜与改写控制排行榜之间的秩相关为0.997；188个模型-基准组合中仅3例显示跨两个参考的一致性差分污染。公开模型间污染基本均匀——抬高绝对分数而不重排排行榜。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜排名扭曲需要罕见的差分污染这一特定条件，而均匀污染仅影响绝对分数。作者建议排行榜应报告经改写控制的排名并附带置信区间，同时发布了参考实现的校准不变性审计工具。

title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts. Vanilla OPD applies this supervision uniformly across prompts, without checking whether the teacher is reliable for each prompt. Because reverse KL is mode-seeking, a confidently wrong teacher can induce a strong yet misleading update. Distributional proxies, such as entropy or teacher-student likelihood agreement, measure uncertainty or agreement but do not directly verify outcome correctness. We introduce Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation (TGOPD), built on the principle that teacher reliability should be verified at the prompt level before dense supervision is admitted. TGOPD estimates reliability from a small set of verifier-scored teacher probes and routes each prompt exclusively to dense OPD when the reliability check passes or to verifier-grounded GRPO otherwise. Across 4B and 35B students in mathematics, code, and instruction following, TGOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD in all six single-domain settings and achieves higher seven-benchmark averages at both scales under multi-domain training. By using otherwise-idle teacher capacity for reliability estimation, TGOPD also reduces teacher-side compute waste in asynchronous OPD, increasing teacher-node GPU utilization from 9.8% to 78.9% in the measured 4B single-domain run.

AI.tldr: TGOPD提出了一种教师门控的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过验证教师模型的可靠性来决定是否使用密集蒸馏监督，从而避免错误教师带来的误导性更新，在不同规模的数学、代码和指令跟随任务中均优于Vanilla OPD。
AI.motivation: Vanilla OPD在所有prompt上均匀施加来自冻结教师的密集token级监督，不检查教师对每个prompt是否可靠。由于reverse KL具有mode-seeking特性，自信但错误的教师会产生强烈且误导性的更新。现有的分布性代理指标（如熵或师生似然一致性）只能衡量不确定性或一致性，无法直接验证结果正确性。因此需要在允许密集监督之前，在prompt层面验证教师可靠性。
AI.method: TGOPD基于"教师可靠性应在密集监督被采纳之前于prompt层面验证"的原则。它利用一小部分经verifier打分的教师探针样本来估计可靠性，根据可靠性检查结果将每个prompt分配到两条路径之一：当可靠性检查通过时，路由到密集OPD；否则路由到基于verifier的GRPO。在异步OPD中，利用原本空闲的教师容量进行可靠性估计，提高了教师节点硬件利用率。
AI.result: 在4B和35B学生的数学、代码和指令跟随任务中，TGOPD在所有六个单领域设置中均优于Vanilla OPD；在多领域训练下，两种规模均取得更高的七基准平均值。在异步OPD中，教师节点GPU利用率从9.8%提升到78.9%（以4B单领域运行为例）。
AI.conclusion: 按prompt级别验证教师可靠性再做路由决策，能有效避免错误教师误导学生，同时通过复用空闲教师算力提升了计算资源利用效率，为在线策略蒸馏中的教师可靠性评估提供了新的思路。

title: JuPyLive: Seamless Migration of Jupyter Notebook Resources from Laptop to HPC
summary: This work introduces JuPyLive, a migration mechanism that enables seamless transition of Jupyter notebooks between local resources of user's workstation and remote resources of high-performance computing~(HPC) environments, while preserving the user experience. JuPyLive eliminates the underlying complexities of migration process, enabling users to freely choose among available local and remote resources, directly within the familiar Jupyter notebook environment via a single click. JuPyLive leverages ElasticNotebook to manage in-memory state migration, it automates resource allocation on HPC cluster and orchestrates required remote communication channels between the source and destination to enable a bidirectional migration. Furthermore, HPC status monitor of JuPyLive provides a live overview of available remote resources, allowing users to make informed decisions on choosing the relevant resources before initiating a migration process. The proposed fully automatic mechanism requires no code changes or configurations by the end user, nor does it demand users to learn a new syntax, instead the migration process can be intuitively initiated and monitored using visual elements from within the Jupyter notebook. By bridging the gap between local workspace and remote resources, JuPyLive offers a seamless experience for scaling local resource-intensive workflows with minimal user intervention, thus further democratizing the usage of HPC clusters among the interdisciplinary researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JuPyLive，一种将Jupyter笔记本从本地工作站无缝迁移到远程高性能计算（HPC）环境的自动化迁移机制。它利用ElasticNotebook管理内存状态迁移，自动分配HPC集群资源并编排源与目标之间的双向通信通道，无需用户修改代码或学习新语法，仅需在熟悉的Jupyter界面中一键操作即可实现迁移，并提供HPC状态监控以辅助用户选择资源。
AI.motivation: 弥合本地工作区与远程HPC资源之间的鸿沟，使跨学科研究人员无需掌握HPC复杂的配置和操作知识，也能轻松扩展本地资源密集型工作流，从而降低HPC集群的使用门槛。
AI.method: JuPyLive基于ElasticNotebook实现内存状态迁移，自动化完成HPC集群资源分配，并编排源端与目的端之间的远程通信通道以支持双向迁移；同时提供HPC状态监视器，实时展示可用远程资源供用户在选择迁移前参考；整个机制通过Jupyter笔记本内的可视化元素以单击方式触发和监控，无需代码更改或配置。
AI.result: JuPyLive实现了全自动的Jupyter笔记本在本地工作站与远程HPC环境之间的无缝双向迁移，用户无需修改代码、配置或学习新语法即可在熟悉的Jupyter环境中通过一次点击完成迁移，并借助HPC状态监控做出资源选择决策。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除迁移过程的底层复杂性，JuPyLive以最小用户干预实现了本地资源密集型工作流向HPC集群的扩展体验，促进了HPC在跨学科研究人员中的普及化应用。

title: AutoGraphForge: Towards Automated Graph Theory Discovery
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to ITAT 2026 (Information Technologies -- Applications and Theory), CEUR Workshop Proceedings. Code: https://github.com/JanPastorek/AutoGraphForge
summary: We report on our ongoing project to develop a computational pipeline, AutoGraphForge, for an automated graph-theoretic conjecturing-refuting-formalizing-proving system. Conjecture generation is counterexample-guided and runs in rounds: a Graffiti3 generator proposes conjectures over a small, evolving snapshot table $T$ (initially a few hundred graphs with their computed invariants) that grows only by counterexamples to its own conjectures. A novelty filter of $559$ classical and folklore relations, closed under transitive composition and linear identity substitution, decides via a linear program whether a candidate is already implied by known results. Surviving candidates are tested against a dataset of about $348,000$ graphs, unioning the complete House of Graphs invariant export, the exhaustive census of all connected graphs on at most nine vertices, several extremal families (strongly regular, minimal Ramsey, Cayley, cages, barbells, lollipops, spiders), and random models. Counterexample-search algorithms then attack the remainder. Run for several rounds on an HPC cluster, the loop yields $6,522$ conjectures that survived the refutation dataset, the novelty filter and every active-search run -- among them nontrivial relations between the annihilation number and the edge-cover number for bipartite and regular graphs, which we prove by hand. A subsequent formalization and proving stage deterministically translates each surviving conjecture into a Lean 4 statement skeleton; every candidate proof is kernel-verified against a pinned mathlib4 and our custom invariant preamble. This stage integrates two neural provers -- DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (served with vLLM) and the Lean-specialised OProver-32B -- behind the independent kernel check. It is implemented end-to-end and passes initial sanity checks, with the full pipeline currently running on the cluster.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍AutoGraphForge，一个自动化图论猜想-反驳-形式化-证明流水线系统，通过反例引导的迭代猜测、新颖性过滤器和大规模图数据集的验证，生成6522个推测，并对部分非平凡关系进行了手工证明及Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 图论研究中存在大量未解决的猜想关系，传统上依赖研究者的直觉和经验，缺乏自动化系统能端到端地生成、筛选、形式化并证明新的图论猜想。作者旨在构建一个自动化流水线，将猜想生成、反驳、形式化与证明整合为一体。
AI.method: 该系统采用Graffiti3生成器基于快照表迭代提出猜想（仅由自身反例扩充数据）；通过559条经典关系的线性规划新颖性过滤；约348,000图的数据集（含House of Graphs导出、≤9顶点连通图穷举、若干极值族）进行反驳测试；再用反例搜索算法攻击剩余候选。幸存猜想经确定性翻译为Lean 4语句骨架，由DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B和OProver-32B两个神经证明器生成候选证明，并由内核核验。
AI.result: 在HPC集群上多轮运行产生6,522个通过反驳数据集、新颖性过滤器及所有主动搜索的猜想。其中包括双图与正则图中消没数与边覆盖数之间的非平凡关系（已手工证明）。正式化与证明阶段端到端实现，通过初步健全性检查。
AI.conclusion: AutoGraphForge成功实现了图论猜想发现到机器可验证证明的完整自动化闭环，验证了该流程的可行性；系统正在集群上全量运行，预期产生更多可证的新图论结果。

title: Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation via Shared Bird's-Eye Maps
summary: Air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) pairs an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with a global bird's-eye view and an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) with a local first-person view, yet the setting remains largely unexplored: existing training-free methods solve single-agent tasks but offer no collaboration mechanism, and a recent CARLA-Air evaluation found no stable cooperative behavior across five state-of-the-art VLA models; naive semantic communication or bidirectional coupling even degrades performance. We establish AGC-VLN (Air-Ground Collaborative VLN), the first training-free baseline for air-ground collaborative VLN. The key insight is that training-free methods decompose navigation into VLM-based semantic reasoning and deterministic geometric execution, exposing a collaboration interface: the UAV's global view, over which it renders the UGV's reported pose and the VLM-anchored target as CAR/GOAL markers with distance labels, yielding a shared bird's-eye map. From this map, the UGV acquires global spatial context its first-person view cannot provide, plans a road-following path with a frozen VLM, and executes it under closed-loop control; in parallel, the UAV runs 3D-SPF, a spatial-search upgrade of SPF that localizes the target in the downward view and flies toward it. On 100 closed-loop episodes in CARLA-Air's Town10HD scene, AGC-VLN reaches a 77.0% joint success rate, a collaboration gain of +27.0% over the weaker individual agent (the UAV, 50.0%), and exceeds the strongest published single-agent baseline (Travel UAV, 53.0%) by 24.0 points, stemming from the complementarity of the UAV's global view and the UGV's road-following execution. Project page: https://github.com/ZSN2024/AGC-VLN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGC-VLN，首个针对空地协同视觉语言导航（Air-Ground Collaborative VLN）的无需训练基线方法。其核心思想是将导航任务分解为基于VLM的语义推理与确定性几何执行，通过共享鸟瞰图实现UAV与UGV的协同：UAV（无人机）提供全局视图并渲染UGV位姿与目标标记，UGV（地面车辆）利用冻结VLM规划沿路路径并在闭环控制下执行。在CARLA-Air Town10HD的100个闭环情节中，AGC-VLN达到77.0%的联合成功率，较较弱的单一智能体（UAV，50.0%）提升+27.0%，并超出最强已发表单一智能体基线（Travel UAV，53.0%）24.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 空地协同的VLN设置此前几乎未被探索：现有无需训练的方法仅解决单智能体任务，缺乏协同机制；近期CARLA-Air评估发现五个SOTA VLA模型在协同场景中没有稳定的协作行为；而直观的语义通信或双向耦合方法甚至会降低性能。因此亟需建立首个有效的空地协同训练自由基线。
AI.method: AGC-VLN将训练自由方法分解为基于VLM的语义推理与确定性几何执行两部分，并利用二者之间的接口建立协同：UAV在全局鸟瞰视图上渲染UGV报告的位姿及VLM锚定的目标（绘制为CAR/GOAL标记并附带距离标签），形成共享鸟瞰图；UGV从该图中获取全局空间上下文，使用冻结VLM规划沿路路径并在闭环控制下执行；同时UAV运行3D-SPF（SPF的空间搜索升级版），在下视图中定位目标并飞向目标。
AI.result: 在CARLA-Air的Town10HD场景中100个闭环测试情节上，AGC-VLN实现77.0%的联合成功率，相比较弱单智能体（UAV，50.0%）有+27.0%的协同增益，并超出此前最强单智能体基线（Travel UAV，53.0%）24.0个百分点。性能源自UAV全局视图与UGV沿路执行的互补性。
AI.conclusion: AGC-VLN证明了无需训练方法可以通过"全局视图语义共享+局部视图几何执行"的分工模式有效实现空地协同VLN，验证了该协同架构的可行性，为该方向提供了首个强基线。

title: Learning to Zoom Efficiently with a Contrastive Curriculum
summary: Using a zoom-in tool is an important foundational part of modern visual agents, because it allows to efficiently handle tasks involving high-resolution images. Most previous methods need an extensive warm-start supervised fine-tuning phase for teaching models zoom-in. We show that this is not necessary by proposing a new intrinsic reward for learning tool use in MLLMs without the need for additional labels or warm-start SFT. Our InfoNCE-style reward uses a curriculum of increasingly hard negative tool calls as a contrastive training signal. Empirical experiments on $V^*$, HRBench and MME-RealWorld show that our approach is competitive while being more efficient. When used as a drop-in replacement for SFT, we even outperform all baselines. To directly measure the zoom-in ability of models, we further introduce the scalable synthetic Muffin&Chihuahua (M&C) dataset. Each image consists of a grid with every cell either showing a muffin or chihuahua. Leveraging the M&C dataset's unique region of interest labels, we find that recall is the metric that most strongly correlates the zoom-in region with final task performance. Our model and code for reproduction is publicly available under https://github.com/UKPLab/emnlp2026-zoom-in

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需监督微调(SFT)和额外标注的InfoNCE风格内在奖励方法，通过逐步增加难度的负工具调用课程作为对比学习信号，使多模态大语言模型(MLLM)学会使用缩放工具。实验表明该方法在V*、HRBench和MME-RealWorld基准上与基线性能相当且更高效，作为SFT的即插即用替代方案时甚至超越所有基线。此外，作者引入可扩展的合成Muffin&Chihuahua(M&C)数据集来直接衡量模型的缩放能力，并发现召回率(recall)是衡量缩放区域与最终任务性能最相关的指标。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉智能体处理高分辨率图像时，缩放工具的使用是基础能力。以往方法需要大量带标签的监督微调(SFT)阶段来教会模型使用缩放工具，这既昂贵又低效。本文旨在探索一种无需额外标签或冷启动SFT的缩放工具学习方法，以提升训练效率。
AI.method: 提出一种InfoNCE风格的对比内在奖励机制，通过逐步递增难度的负工具调用课程(即越来越难区分的负样本，如错误或次优的缩放区域选择)作为对比训练信号，使MLLM在强化学习范式中自然学会何时、何处进行缩放操作。同时构建可扩展的合成Muffin&Chihuahua数据集，每张图由包含松饼或吉娃娃图片的网格组成，用于直接量化模型的缩放定位能力，并分析各区域定位指标与最终任务性能的相关性。
AI.result: 在V*、HRBench和MME-RealWorld三个基准上的实验表明，该方法与SFT方法性能相当但训练效率更高；当作为SFT的drop-in替代品时，在全部基线上均取得超越。在M&C数据集上的分析揭示了召回率(recall)与最终任务性能之间的最强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 缩放工具的学习不依赖于冷启动SFT和额外标注，通过基于课程难度的InfoNCE对比奖励即可实现高效且竞争力强的工具学习。召回率作为缩放区域定位的核心评价指标，为未来视觉智能体构建提供重要指导。

title: SecDT: A Profile-Based Security Layer for TRDP Communications
comment: Submitted to IEEE Future Networks World Forum 2026
summary: The Train Real-time Data Protocol (TRDP) is widely used on rolling stock but it provides limited native support for cryptographic protection. Furthermore, the multicast traffic profile used in TRDP Process Data to exchange critical information between onboard subsystems makes the introduction of cryptographic protection a challenge. This paper presents a lightweight security layer for secure TRDP communication that implements a number of security profiles built around modern cryptographic algorithms. This additional layer relies on an On-board Key Management System (OKMS) for both security profile negotiation, dynamic key distribution and key lifecycle management. The security profiles allow for cryptographic agility and flexibility, ranging from simple authentication to Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) algorithms. The security profile negotiation procedure guarantees all TRDP End Devices (ED) on a common Communication ID (ComID) share the same security profile and can therefore process each other's messages. A prototype implementation based on mbedTLS and Arm Platform Security Architecture (PSA) was developed and evaluated. Experimental results demonstrate manageable overhead, suitable for the real-time and time-sensitive communication found on rolling stock.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于列车实时数据协议（TRDP）的轻量级安全层，该安全层基于现代密码算法构建多种安全配置文件，并依赖车载密钥管理系统（OKMS）实现安全配置协商、动态密钥分发和密钥生命周期管理，以在不影响实时性能的前提下为TRDP通信提供从简单认证到AEAD加密的灵活安全保护。
AI.motivation: TRDP广泛应用于轨道交通车辆，但其对密码学保护的本地支持有限，且其Process Data组播流量特征使得引入加密保护面临挑战，亟需一种兼顾安全性与实时性的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计了一个轻量级安全层，实现多种基于现代密码算法的安全配置文件，支持从简单认证到AEAD算法的密码敏捷性；该层通过OKMS进行安全配置文件协商、动态密钥分发与密钥生命周期管理；安全配置文件协商流程保证同一ComID上所有TRDP终端设备共享相同安全配置并能处理彼此消息；基于mbedTLS和Arm PSA实现了原型系统。
AI.result: 通过基于mbedTLS和Arm Platform Security Architecture（PSA）的原型实现与实验评估，证明该安全层引入的开销处于可管理范围内，适用于轨道交通车辆上的实时和时敏通信场景。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的TRDP轻量级安全层能够在提供灵活、可敏捷的密码学保护的同时保持可接受的性能开销，满足轨道交通车辆实时通信的安全需求。

title: Dual-Form ASR: Semantics-Aware Inverse Text Normalization for Chinese Speech Recognition
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) scenarios require both spoken-form transcripts for faithful transcription and readable written-form transcripts with inverse text normalization (ITN). However, these forms are typically produced by cascaded modules, where a spoken-form ASR output is rewritten by a separate ITN component, making written-form ASR-ITN vulnerable to recognition errors and decoupling normalization from acoustic-contextual modeling, especially for semantically dependent numeric expressions. In this paper, we propose Dual-Form ASR (DF-ASR), a framework that extends spoken-form ASR capability to semantics-aware written-form ITN through paired spoken-form and written-form supervision while retaining prompt-level selection between transcript forms. The dual-form supervision is constructed via a large language model (LLM)-driven generate-and-judge workflow, and training is further enhanced by ITN-MWER, a sequence-level objective that assigns higher cost to errors on normalization-sensitive spans. We also introduce a decision-aware REQUIRE-ITN/\FORBID-ITN protocol to separately measure required normalization and forbidden-span preservation. On manually annotated Chinese subsets from SpeechIO, DF-ASR consistently outperforms open-source ASR-ITN systems, remains competitive with strong closed-source references, and preserves reliable prompt-level control between spoken-form and written-form outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DF-ASR框架，通过配对的语音转录和书面转录监督将语义感知的逆文本正则化（ITN）能力整合进语音识别系统，同时保留基于提示词的转录形式选择，在中文ASR-ITN任务上显著优于开源系统并与强闭源参考性能竞争。
AI.motivation: 传统ASR-ITN采用级联架构，即先由ASR输出语音形式转录，再通过独立的ITN模块重写为书面形式。这种解耦方式使ITN对ASR识别错误敏感，且无法利用声学-上下文建模信息，尤其对语义依赖的数字表达式处理效果不佳。因此需要一种更统一的框架将ASR与ITN联合建模。
AI.method: 提出Dual-Form ASR（DF-ASR）框架，核心包括：(1) 通过配对的口语形式和书面形式监督扩展ASR能力至语义感知的ITN，支持提示词级别的转录形式选择；(2) 利用大语言模型（LLM）驱动的"生成-评判"（generate-and-judge）流程构建双形式监督数据；(3) 提出ITN-MWER序列级训练目标，对归一化敏感跨度上的错误赋予更高代价；(4) 提出决策感知的REQUIRE-ITN/FORBID-ITN协议，分别度量必需的归一化和禁止跨度保持能力。
AI.result: 在SpeechIO人工标注的中文子集上，DF-ASR一致优于开源的ASR-ITN系统，与强闭源参考系统性能相当，并在口语形式和书面形式输出之间保持了可靠的提示词级控制。
AI.conclusion: 将语音形式建模与语义感知的书面形式归一化整合在统一框架中是可行的，通过精心设计的监督数据构建和序列级训练目标，可以在不牺牲提示词级形式控制的情况下获得优于级联架构的ITN性能。

title: Causal Foundation Models
summary: Causal inference is the practice of estimating the effect of a treatment or intervention from data. It traditionally requires a bespoke pipeline for every new problem: first proposing a causal mechanism, selecting a compatible estimator, and finally training it. Meanwhile, across diverse settings and modalities, much of machine learning has shifted to the paradigm of foundation models: networks pretrained once at scale and applied to new tasks without fine-tuning. Causal foundation models (CFMs) bring this paradigm to causal inference. CFMs are pretrained neural networks that estimate causal quantities, such as the average treatment effect, on entirely new datasets using in-context learning without requiring model updates. This work provides a practical introduction to this emerging area. We summarize the necessary background in causal inference and machine learning before discussing CFMs. Throughout, we include example code and Jupyter notebooks.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于因果基础模型（Causal Foundation Models, CFMs）的实践性入门介绍。CFMs将基础模型范式引入因果推断领域，通过在规模化数据上预训练神经网络，使模型能够在全新数据集上通过上下文学习（in-context learning）直接估计因果量（如平均处理效应），无需微调或重新训练。文章涵盖了因果推断与机器学习的基础背景、CFM的核心概念，并配有示例代码和Jupyter notebooks。
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断需要为每个新问题构建定制化的处理流程（包括提出因果机制、选择估计器、训练模型），成本高且缺乏可复用性。同时，机器学习领域已广泛转向基础模型范式（大规模预训练后无需微调即可应用于新任务），但这一范式尚未在因果推断中得到充分推广。作者旨在弥合这一差距，系统性地介绍因果基础模型这一新兴方向。
AI.method: 文章采用教学性与综述性相结合的方式：首先回顾因果推断和机器学习的基础知识作为背景铺垫；然后介绍CFM的核心思想，即通过预训练神经网络学习因果估计能力，使其在面对全新数据集时能通过上下文学习直接输出因果估计量，而无需参数更新；文中还提供了示例代码和Jupyter notebooks作为实操辅助。
AI.result: 本文作为一篇实践性入门教程，系统性地介绍了CFM的基本概念、背景知识和应用方式，并提供配套的代码示例与notebook资源，帮助读者理解并上手因果基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 因果基础模型代表了因果推断领域向基础模型范式演进的重要趋势，有望显著降低因果估计的定制化成本，使因果推断更加通用和高效。本文为此领域的初学者提供了从理论到实践的完整入门路径。

title: Every Kernel Is a Join: Automatic Multi-GPU Parallelism for AI Computations in Einsummable
summary: Distributing an AI computation across the GPUs of a multi-GPU server is one of the central problems in systems-for-AI. We present Einsummable, a prototype system that accepts a PyTorch-like description of an AI computation and automatically distributes it across a multi-GPU server, with no device assignments, sharding annotations, or communication operations written by the programmer. Einsummable models every operation as a relational join followed by an aggregation over tensor relations, in which the tuples contain sub-tensors. Each operation exposes its possible decompositions through what we call "join-agg specs". An optimizer then selects decompositions across the whole computation to minimize a communication-cost proxy. Because it searches decompositions rather than a menu of named strategies, Einsummable discovers plans that mesh-based auto-parallelizers cannot. Each decomposed operation is implemented by synthesizing an exchange program, which is a topology-aware generalization of Volcano's exchange operator. Einsummable invokes no canned collectives: all communication and aggregation is special-purpose, derived at compile time. Despite being fully automatic, Einsummable can outperform custom-designed implementations. For example, on LLaMA transformer blocks on an eight-GPU A100 server, Einsummable achieves a geometric-mean runtime of 8.97 ms, versus 13.80 ms for hand-tuned PyTorch and 15.90 ms for vLLM.

AI.tldr: Einsummable是一个原型系统，接受类似PyTorch的AI计算描述并自动在multi-GPU服务器上分布式执行，无需程序员编写设备分配、分片标注或通信操作。它将每个操作建模为张量关系上的关系连接后接聚合，通过"join-agg specs"暴露可能的分解方式，优化器搜索分解方案以最小化通信成本代理，并在编译期合成拓扑感知的交换程序实现通信。在8-GPU A100服务器上的LLaMA transformer块测试中，几何平均运行时8.97ms，优于手调PyTorch(13.80ms)和vLLM(15.90ms)。
AI.motivation: 多GPU服务器上的AI计算自动分布是系统领域核心问题。现有的mesh-based自动并行化器局限于固定的命名策略菜单（如数据并行、张量并行等），无法探索更广泛的分解空间，且通常需要程序员提供分片标注或通信操作。
AI.method: 将每个AI操作建模为关系连接后聚合（join-agg）的模型；每个操作通过"join-agg specs"暴露可能的分解方式；优化器在全局范围内搜索分解组合以最小化通信成本代理；每个分解后的操作通过编译期合成拓扑感知的exchange程序实现，不使用预设的集合通信原语。
AI.result: 在八GPU A100服务器上的LLaMA transformer块实验中，Einsummable实现8.97ms的几何平均运行时间，优于手调PyTorch的13.80ms和vLLM的15.90ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过在分解空间中系统化搜索而非依赖固定策略菜单，全自动的分布式执行方案能够超越定制实现的性能，证明了从关系代数视角建模AI计算是一种有前途的自动并行化范式。

title: Making Every Tool Call Count: Necessary Tool-Evidence Path Rewards for Agentic Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can directly answer many image-grounded questions, yet they often struggle with complex queries requiring fine-grained visual details or external knowledge. To acquire this missing evidence, agentic VLMs invoke tools such as image cropping, image search, and text search. However, existing training paradigms primarily evaluate tool-use based on final answer correctness, leaving evidence acquisition and utilization insufficiently supervised. This leads to two critical shortcomings: (i) models frequently issue redundant or off-target tool calls that fail to gather necessary evidence, and (ii) even when appropriate tools are called, models often fail to extract the necessary information from the resulting observations. To address these limitations, we introduce the NTEP (Necessary Tool-Evidence Path), a novel annotation scheme that explicitly specifies the essential external evidence and corresponding tool calls for each query. Building upon this, we propose NTEP-R (NTEP Reward), a supervision mechanism ensuring that each tool invocation strictly advances the reasoning process toward the final solution. Specifically, our approach rewards the agent for aligning its pre-call intent with a necessary evidence-seeking goal, and for ensuring the information summarized from the post-call observation aligns with the necessary evidence. Furthermore, we introduce a non-repeated-goal regularizer to penalize redundant calls that revisit satisfied NTEP goals. Extensive evaluations on seven image-grounded benchmarks demonstrate that our 8B-parameter instantiation, NTEP-8B, significantly improves both search-oriented accuracy and tool-use efficiency within a unified three-tool framework. These results highlight the critical value of fine-grained tool-evidence path supervision for training robust agentic VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NTEP（必要工具-证据路径）标注方案及其对应的奖励机制NTEP-R，用于显式监督智能体视觉语言模型（Agentic VLM）在调用工具时的证据获取与利用过程，解决了现有训练范式仅基于最终答案正确性评估工具使用所带来的冗余调用和信息提取失败问题。基于此训练的8B参数模型NTEP-8B在七个图像基准上显著提升了搜索准确率和工具使用效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体VLM训练范式主要基于最终答案正确性来评估工具使用，导致证据获取和利用过程缺乏充分监督。这引发两个关键缺陷：(i) 模型经常发出冗余或偏离目标的工具调用，无法收集必要证据；(ii) 即使调用了合适工具，模型也常常无法从观察结果中提取所需信息。
AI.method: 本文提出NTEP（Necessary Tool-Evidence Path）标注方案，为每个查询明确指定必要的外部证据及对应的工具调用；并在此基础上提出NTEP-R（NTEP Reward）监督机制，奖励代理在调用前意图与必要证据寻求目标的一致性，以及调用后从观察中总结的信息与必要证据的对齐；此外引入非重复目标正则化器（non-repeated-goal regularizer）来惩罚重复访问已满足NTEP目标的冗余调用。整体框架为统一的三工具系统（图像裁剪、图像搜索、文本搜索）。
AI.result: 在七个图像相关基准上的广泛评估表明，8B参数的NTEP-8B在统一的三种工具框架内显著提升了搜索导向的准确率和工具使用效率。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的工具-证据路径监督对训练鲁棒的智能体VLM具有关键价值，证明了超越最终答案正确性、深入中间证据获取与利用过程的监督范式能有效提升模型的工具使用能力。

title: BRIDGE: An Open-Source Humanoid Platform via Morphology-Control Co-Design for Physical AI
summary: Developing humanoid robots capable of leveraging human behavioral data is essential for general-purpose embodiment, yet conventional development remains bottlenecked by a decoupled paradigm that isolates hardware design from whole-body control. This approach leads to suboptimal systems that compromise human-like fluidity and agility. To bridge this gap, we introduce a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework that optimizes humanoid morphology for human-like movement. To quantify morphological fidelity, we also introduce a novel metric that jointly considers kinematic retargeting fidelity to human motion and dynamic tracking performance. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all metrics compared to baseline humanoids (Bumi, K1, and Toddlerbot). Finally, we realize this design in Bridge, an open-source, 88cm-tall humanoid platform released alongside its control policy. We demonstrate that Bridge captures human motion data with superior fidelity, exhibiting exceptional performance across foundational locomotion, robust balance, and highly dynamic maneuvers. Videos and open-source materials: https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，用于优化人形机器人的身体形态以实现类人运动，并推出了开源人形机器人平台Bridge（88cm高），该平台在基础行走、鲁棒平衡和高动态机动等任务上均展现卓越性能，超越了多种基线人形机器人。
AI.motivation: 传统人形机器人开发采用硬件设计与全身控制相分离的解耦范式，导致系统整体次优，无法充分实现类人的流畅性和敏捷性。为突破该瓶颈，需要一种协同设计方法，将人体行为数据驱动的形态优化与整体控制结合，从而构建更通用的人形机器人。
AI.method: 提出一个数据驱动的形态-控制协同设计框架，同时优化人形机器人的形态参数与全身控制策略。引入一个新的量化指标，联合考虑运动学重定向到人体运动的保真度以及动力学跟踪性能，以评估形态的类人保真度。
AI.result: 在所有评估指标上均优于基线人形机器人（Bumi、K1和Toddlerbot），达到SOTA水平。实际实现为Bridge平台，该平台能更优地捕获人体运动数据，在基础行走、鲁棒平衡和高动态机动任务中表现出卓越性能。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的形态与控制协同设计范式能够有效打破传统解耦开发模式的局限，产出类人保真度更高、运动能力更强的人形机器人。Bridge作为开源平台与配套控制策略的公开，为该领域后续研究提供了可复现的基础。

title: ProgResViT: Progressive Resolution and Width for Adaptive Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) typically process every image using a fixed input resolution and model width, even though many images can be classified with substantially less computation. We introduce ProgResViT, an input-adaptive ViT that performs inference progressively across multiple rounds. The first round processes a low-resolution image with a narrow subnetwork. Inference terminates when the prediction is sufficiently confident; otherwise, the model reuses the representations produced in the current round and proceeds with a higher-resolution input and a wider subnetwork to refine its prediction. As all rounds share a single backbone, we propose Progress-Conditioned Soft Gating (PSG), which conditions token fusion and layer outputs on the current round, block, and input resolution. On image classification, applying ProgResViT to DeiT yields better accuracy-compute trade-offs than adaptive-width, adaptive-depth, and dynamic-token baselines. With knowledge distillation, a DeiT-based ProgResViT achieves 84.9% top-1 accuracy, slightly exceeding the reported DeiT-III-S accuracy under a comparable evaluation setting. We show that the same design also provides favorable accuracy-compute trade-offs for self-supervised DINO representations and downstream semantic segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/ds-kiel/ProgResViT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProgResViT，一种输入自适应的视觉Transformer，通过渐进式多轮推理（低分辨率窄子网络到高分辨率宽子网络）实现按需计算分配，在保持精度的同时显著提升计算效率，适用于图像分类、自监督表征和下游语义分割任务。
AI.motivation: 传统Vision Transformer对所有图像使用固定的输入分辨率和模型宽度，忽略了大量图像实际上可以用较少计算量完成分类的事实，导致计算资源浪费。作者希望通过输入自适应机制实现"简单图像少计算、困难图像多计算"的按需推理。
AI.method: ProgResViT的核心设计包括：(1) 多轮渐进推理框架，第一轮使用低分辨率输入和窄子网络，预测不够置信时升级到更高分辨率和更宽子网络；(2) 各轮共享单一骨干网络，通过Progressive-Conditioned Soft Gating (PSG)机制，根据当前轮次、块索引和输入分辨率来条件化控制token融合和层输出，实现高效的表示重用。
AI.result: 在图像分类上，ProgResViT相比自适应宽度、自适应深度和动态token基线获得了更好的精度-计算量权衡。结合知识蒸馏后，基于DeiT的ProgResViT达到了84.9%的top-1精度，略超DeiT-III-S在相近评估设置下的报告精度。该设计在自监督DINO表征和下游语义分割任务上也展示了有利的精度-计算量权衡。
AI.conclusion: ProgResViT通过渐进分辨率与渐进宽度相结合的输入自适应推理，辅以PSG门控机制实现跨轮次表示复用，验证了其在分类、自监督及语义分割等多种场景下的通用性和有效性，为高效ViT推理提供了新思路。

title: Trust Me, I'm Your Developer: Self-Issued Authentication in Large Language Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) security has largely focused on role-playing jailbreaks, with less attention to what happens when a user asks an LLM to verify an identity claim through a test designed by the model itself. We study this behavior through a staged developer-identity experiment with ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen, Mistral, and Llama. All five models initially rejected the unsupported claim "I am your developer." Claude refused to conduct an identity test, while ChatGPT generated developer-oriented questions but maintained that answers could demonstrate knowledge, not identity. In contrast, Qwen and Mistral generated technical challenges, defined what counted as convincing evidence, evaluated detailed answers, and returned Verified without receiving any externally validated identity evidence. Llama similarly generated and evaluated a developer test, accepted the claimed identity, and subsequently made unsupported claims of access to internal runtime and deployment state. We call the model-generated verification procedure a Model-Issued Pseudo-Credential (MIPC) and the resulting unsupported identity judgment Conversational False Authentication (CFA). In each CFA case, the same model acted as challenge generator, evidence evaluator, and identity decision-maker, converting technical knowledge into supposed proof of identity. The accepted identities did not change the tested authorization boundaries, showing that false authentication and privilege escalation are distinct outcomes. These results identify self-issued authentication as a conversational security failure: authenticated identity must originate from an external security component, and model-generated dialogue must never create or modify identity or authorization state.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在自我设计的身份验证测试中的行为，发现当用户声称"我是你的开发者"时，Qwen、Mistral和Llama等模型会生成并评估技术挑战，并在无外部身份验证证据的情况下错误地接受身份声明，产生"模型签发的伪凭据"（MIPC）和"对话式错误认证"（CFA）两种安全失败模式。
AI.motivation: 以往LLM安全研究主要集中在角色扮演越狱场景，而忽视了用户在模型自身设计的测试中被要求验证身份声明的场景。作者旨在揭示LLM在自设验证程序中可能产生的身份验证安全缺陷。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个分阶段的"开发者身份实验"，对ChatGPT、Claude、Qwen、Mistral和Llama五种LLM进行了受控测试，观察这些模型如何响应"我是你的开发者"这一未经支持的身份声明，并记录模型自主设计测试、评估证据和作出身份判定的全过程。
AI.result: 五种模型最初都拒绝了未经支持的身份声明。Claude拒绝进行身份测试；ChatGPT生成开发者导向问题但仍强调答案只能证明知识而非身份；而Qwen、Mistral和Llama生成了技术挑战、定义了证据标准、评估了详细答案并在无外部验证证据的情况下返回"已验证"结果。Llama在错误接受身份后还做出了关于内部运行时和部署状态访问权限的未经支持的声明。各模型在接受身份后均未改变授权边界，证明错误认证与权限提升是两种不同的安全结果。
AI.conclusion: 模型生成的认证过程本质上是一种对话式安全失败，应定义"模型签发伪凭据"（MIPC）与"对话式错误认证"（CFA）两类安全缺陷。认证身份必须来源于外部安全组件，模型生成的对话绝不能创建或修改身份或授权状态。

title: RL-ADA: A World-Feedback Framework for Adversarially Robust Enterprise Dialogue Agents
summary: Deploying task-oriented dialogue agents in enterprise customer support faces a persistent annotation bottleneck: robust training requires labelled interaction data at scale, yet enterprise conversational logs are privacy-sensitive and expensive to annotate, while user behaviour evolves faster than labelling pipelines can keep pace. We present RL-ADA (Reinforcement Learning with Adversarial Dialogue Agents), a co-evolutionary training framework that eliminates this bottleneck by replacing human labels with \emph{world feedback}: consequence-based reward signals derived directly from measurable interaction outcomes. A Customer Support Agent (DA, 3B parameters) and an Adversarial Customer Agent (CA, 7B parameters) co-evolve in an adversarial arena guided by a fixed automated judge: the DA is rewarded for correctly handling multi-turn customer conversations to successful resolution, while the CA is rewarded for producing realistic, intent-concealing utterances that cause misroutes, creating asymmetric adversarial pressure through opposing but independently structured rewards. An isolation gym iteratively retrains the weaker agent on prior-failure transcripts, requiring no human annotation at any stage. In a banking customer support proof of concept, tool-routing errors are eliminated and the strict end-to-end PASS rate doubles over five co-evolutionary cycles, driven solely by automated arena reward with no labelled data. We additionally observe the emergence of \textbf{Contextual Camouflage}, an adversarial strategy in which the CA learns to embed intent within dense realistic customer detail purely from reward pressure, with direct implications for enterprise red-teaming and robustness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出了RL-ADA框架，通过"世界反馈"（基于可测量交互结果的奖励信号）替代人工标注，让客服代理（3B参数）与对抗客户代理（7B参数）在固定自动评判者引导下协同进化，在银行客服概念验证中完全消除工具路由错误，端到端PASS率在五个进化周期内翻倍，且无需任何人工标注数据。
AI.motivation: 企业客服场景中部署任务导向对话代理面临持续的标注瓶颈：高质量训练需要大规模标注交互数据，但企业对话日志涉及隐私且标注成本高，同时用户行为演变速度快于标注管道更新速度，需要一种无需人工标注的训练方法。
AI.method: 采用协同进化训练框架：客服代理（DA，3B）与对抗客户代理（CA，7B）在自动评判者引导下进行对抗博弈，DA因正确解决多轮对话获得奖励，CA因产生逼真、隐藏意图导致路由错误的语句获得奖励。隔离健身房基于先前失败记录迭代重训较弱代理，整个过程无任何人工标注阶段。
AI.result: 在银行客服概念验证中，工具路由错误被完全消除，端到端PASS率在五个协同进化周期内翻倍，仅依靠自动化竞技场奖励驱动。此外观察到"上下文伪装"（Contextual Camouflage）这一对抗策略的涌现，CA纯粹从奖励压力中学会将意图嵌入密集的真实客户细节中。
AI.conclusion: RL-ADA通过对抗协同进化与自动化评判替代人工标注，有效解决了企业对话代理训练中标注瓶颈问题，同时对红队测试和鲁棒性评估具有直接应用意义。

title: ObserverBench: Testing Mechanistic Estimates for Intervention and Control
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Code, benchmark, leaderboards, and submission interface: https://kwisatzh.github.io/observerbench/. Frozen artifact release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22136091
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability is increasingly used to guide interventions such as activation steering, circuit removal, and safety monitoring. Yet an internal estimate that is accurate on average can still choose a poor action.
  We present ObserverBench, a benchmark framework for testing whether an internal estimator---an observer---is adequate for the intervention, control, or safety task it directs. Each task fixes the model, information boundary, allowed actions, decision rule, held-out cases, and loss. The benchmark reports estimation accuracy separately from the loss caused by the chosen action.
  Theory and experiments show why both are needed. In closed-loop control, observer errors matter at the starting point and along directions the allowed intervention can reach. On circuit-intervention tasks in GPT-2-small and Qwen2.5-7B, pairwise observers predict unseen effects more accurately without always choosing better actions; observers trained on action loss choose lower-loss actions. In safety triage, a score that perfectly separates violations can allocate a fixed intervention budget poorly when violations have different costs. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B-it, and prospectively frozen Qwen3.5-9B APPS tasks, AUROC can rank monitors differently from deployment loss, and the best information source changes across models. Sparse SAE readouts also trail their layer-matched dense controls on the reported Qwen panels, under disclosed activation-density or checkpoint mismatches.
  ObserverBench provides fixed task contracts, runnable baselines, and table-based submissions for evaluating interpretability methods through the actions they enable.

AI.tldr: ObserverBench是一个评估内部估计器（observer）是否适用于其所指导的干预、控制或安全任务的基准框架。该框架将任务建模为固定模型、信息边界、允许动作、决策规则、保留案例和损失的契约，并分别报告估计准确性与所选动作造成的损失。理论与实验表明两者都必需：在闭环控制中observer误差在起点及干预可达方向上至关重要；成对observer在电路干预任务中预测未见效应更准确但不总能选更好动作，而基于动作损失训练的observer能选择更低损失动作；在安全分诊中完美区分违规的分数在违规成本不同时可能错误分配固定干预预算。
AI.motivation: 机器学习可解释性机制日益被用于引导激活引导（activation steering）、电路移除和安全监控等干预措施，但一个平均意义上准确的内部估计（observer）仍可能选择糟糕的动作。现有评估范式通常只关注估计的准确性（如AUROC），忽视了估计所驱动的动作实际产生的损失，因此需要一种能将估计质量与动作后果（决策损失）分离评估的基准框架。
AI.method: ObserverBench将每个任务定义为包含固定模型、信息边界、允许动作、决策规则、保留案例和损失函数的任务契约（contract），并独立报告两个指标：估计准确性（estimation accuracy）和所选动作引起的损失（action-induced loss）。框架支持三类任务：闭环控制、电路干预和安全分诊，提供可运行的基线和基于表格的提交方式，允许参与者提交以信息集为输入的决策函数进行评估。
AI.result: 在GPT-2-small和Qwen2.5-7B上的电路干预任务中，成对（pairwise）observer能更准确地预测未见效应但不总能选择更优动作；基于动作损失训练的observer则能选择更低损失的动作。在安全分诊中，一个能完美区分违规的分数在违规成本不同时可能错误分配固定干预预算。跨Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B-it以及前瞻性冻结的Qwen3.5-9B APPS任务中，AUROC对监控器的排名与部署损失不同，且最佳信息源因模型而异。稀疏SAE读出在公开的Qwen面板上落后于层匹配的稠密对照组（存在激活密度或检查点不匹配的披露）。
AI.conclusion: ObserverBench表明仅依赖估计准确性（如AUROC）不足以评估干预和安全方法；评估必须考虑估计所驱动的动作决策带来的实际损失。框架提供固定任务契约、可运行基线和基于表格的提交机制，以"动作所实现的效果"为视角系统评估可解释性方法，为可解释性方法的实用部署提供了更具任务相关性的评测范式。

title: Barnacle: Adaptive Multi-Leader Scheduling for DAG-Based Consensus
summary: In DAG-based consensus, all validators propose blocks concurrently, and designated leader blocks drive transaction commit. Having multiple leader slots per round cuts queuing latency, yet production deployments run a single leader because of head-of-line blocking: a slow leader stalls the pipeline for at least one leader timeout, and for several waves when its slot must wait for the fallback indirect decision rule. This risk grows with the leader count. We introduce Barnacle, an add-on that adapts the leader count at run time. Every interval, it measures on the agreed committed DAG the fraction of slots decided as commit by the direct rule, and drives the leader count with additive increase, multiplicative decrease. The measurement requires no extra messages and no cryptography, and is deterministic. Barnacle is generic over DAG protocols; we instantiate it on four protocols spanning the Byzantine (3f + 1, 5f + 1), crash-only (2c + 1), and mixed (5f + 3c + 1) fault models, with proven safety and liveness. Results show Barnacle matches the best static leader count in every regime: in a healthy network its latency is 6-13% lower than a single leader's, and under degradation it matches a single leader while remaining 35-56% below a static high count. We are currently collaborating with the Sui team to integrate Barnacle into the Sui blockchain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Barnacle，一种面向 DAG 共识协议的运行时自适应调节 leader 数量的插件。它通过周期性测量已提交 DAG 上由直接规则决出的 slots 比例，采用加法增加/乘法减少（AIMD）策略动态调整 leader 数量，无需额外消息和密码学操作。Barnacle 可泛化到多种 DAG 协议，涵盖拜占庭（3f+1, 5f+1）、崩溃（2c+1）和混合（5f+3c+1）容错模型，被证明满足安全性与活性。实验显示其在健康网络下延迟比单 leader 低 6-13%，在性能退化时与单 leader 相当且比静态高 leader 数低 35-56%。目前正与 Sui 团队合作集成。
AI.motivation: DAG 共识中多 leader 槽位可减少排队延迟，但实际生产部署只用单 leader，原因是队头阻塞：慢 leader 会因超时及间接决策回退规则导致管线停滞数个轮次，且此风险随 leader 数量增加而加剧。需要一个能根据网络状况自适应调整 leader 数量的机制。
AI.method: Barnacle 采用在线测量与 AIMD 控制相结合的方法：每个时间间隔内，在共识所认可的已提交 DAG 上统计由直接规则（direct rule）确定性提交的 slots 比例作为健康度指标；基于该指标对 leader 数量做加法增加、乘法减少的调整。测量过程无需额外消息、无需密码学假设且确定性一致。该插件设计为与底层 DAG 协议解耦，可在拜占庭、纯崩溃及混合容错模型的多类协议上实例化。
AI.result: 在四种覆盖 3f+1、5f+1 拜占庭、2c+1 崩溃以及 5f+3c+1 混合容错模型的 DAG 协议上进行实例化验证，均保证安全性和活性。实验表明 Barnacle 在各场景下均能达到最优静态 leader 数配置的性能：健康网络中延迟比单 leader 低 6-13%；网络退化时与单 leader 延迟相当，同时比静态高 leader 数延迟低 35-56%。
AI.conclusion: Barnacle 通过运行时自适应 leader 数量，兼顾了多 leader 的低延迟优势与单 leader 的鲁棒性，避免了队头阻塞风险，是一种通用、轻量（无额外开销、无需密码学）、确定性且可证明安全的 DAG 共识增强方案。目前正与 Sui 团队合作将其集成到 Sui 区块链中，表明其具有实际的产业应用价值。

title: GrowPage: On-Demand KV Budgeting for Efficient LLM Reasoning Serving
summary: Long-output reasoning has made the key--value (KV) cache a critical memory bottleneck for efficient LLM serving. Existing KV compression methods usually rely on a predefined per-request budget and adjust only which KV states are retained, leaving the total capacity fixed throughout decoding. However, reasoning workloads exhibit substantial demand variation: different requests require different KV capacities, and the attention demand of an individual request evolves during generation. We introduce \textbf{GrowPage}, an on-demand KV budgeting framework that treats KV capacity as a runtime resource. GrowPage maintains lightweight dual-timescale query summaries to capture recent and long-term attention behaviors, and uses their relative attention working sets to estimate demand evolution. At each capacity boundary, GrowPage either compresses KV states within the current allocation or acquires an additional physical page when broader demand emerges. By integrating with PagedAttention's page-level memory abstraction, GrowPage preserves continuous batching and prefix caching. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks across multiple models show that GrowPage achieves a superior performance--throughput trade-off over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出GrowPage框架，将KV缓存容量视为运行时资源，通过双尺度查询摘要动态估计注意力需求变化，按需压缩或扩展KV空间，在PagedAttention页级抽象上实现动态预算管理，取得更优的性能-吞吐量权衡。
AI.motivation: 长输出推理使KV缓存成为LLM服务的关键内存瓶颈。现有KV压缩方法依赖预定义的单请求预算，仅调整保留哪些KV状态，总容量在整个解码过程中固定不变。然而推理负载存在显著的需求变化：不同请求需要不同KV容量，且单个请求的注意力需求在生成过程中动态演变。这种静态预算机制无法适应推理工作负载的波动特性。
AI.method: GrowPage将KV容量视为运行时资源而非固定预算。具体方法包括：(1) 维护轻量级双时间尺度查询摘要，分别捕获近期和长期注意力行为；(2) 利用两者的相对注意力工作集估计需求演变趋势；(3) 在每次容量边界处，根据需求判断对当前分配内的KV状态进行压缩，或在更广泛需求出现时获取额外的物理页面；(4) 与PagedAttention的页级内存抽象集成，保持连续批处理和前缀缓存能力。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准测试和多种模型上的实验表明，GrowPage在性能-吞吐量权衡方面优于现有KV压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 将KV缓存从静态预算转变为按需动态资源管理能够更有效地适配推理工作负载的需求变化，GrowPage通过与现有页级内存抽象的无缝集成，在保持批处理效率的同时实现了更好的性能与吞吐量平衡。

title: TRaIL-Odom: Tightly Coupled Continuous Time Radar-IMU-LiDAR Odometry with Adaptive Doppler Weighting
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters on 23 August, 2026
summary: Existing radar-LiDAR fusion methods rely on fixed residual weights, even though the informativeness of radar Doppler and LiDAR geometry is scan- and direction-dependent, leading to uniform radar weighting that misallocates Doppler information across translational directions. To address this limitation, we propose two degeneracy-aware Doppler reweighting modules within a tightly coupled Radar-IMU-LiDAR odometry framework: per-point radar reweighting and scan-wise radar gain scheduling. Since geometric degeneracy is directional, we first identify weak translational directions from the LiDAR geometry and reweight individual radar Doppler constraints based on their alignment with the weak subspace. We further adjust the overall radar contribution using LiDAR geometric anisotropy such that radar is emphasized when LiDAR observability is poor and suppressed when LiDAR constraints are already reliable. Across 13 evaluated sequences, TRaIL-Odom achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with clear advantages in geometrically degenerate scenes. In ablation experiments on three degenerate sequences, combining the two adaptive weighting modules reduces RMSE ATE and RTE by 86.0% and 78.5% relative to the fixed-weight baseline. We make our code and an accompanying dataset publicly available at https://github.com/ChiyunNoh/TRaIL-Odom.

AI.tldr: 提出TRaIL-Odom框架，通过两个退化感知的多普勒重加权模块（逐点雷达重加权和扫描级雷达增益调度）在紧耦合的雷达-IMU-LiDAR里程计中自适应调整雷达贡献，在13个序列上达到最优性能，几何退化场景下优势显著。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达-LiDAR融合方法使用固定的残差权重，但雷达多普勒和LiDAR几何的信息量是随扫描和方向变化的，固定均匀权重会在平移方向上错误分配多普勒信息，导致融合性能受限。
AI.method: 在紧耦合的Radar-IMU-LiDAR里程计框架内提出两个退化感知模块：(1) 逐点雷达重加权——首先从LiDAR几何中识别弱平移方向，然后根据各雷达多普勒约束与弱子空间的对齐程度进行重新加权；(2) 扫描级雷达增益调度——利用LiDAR几何各向异性动态调整整体雷达贡献，当LiDAR可观测性差时增强雷达权重，当LiDAR约束可靠时抑制雷达权重。
AI.result: 在13个评估序列上达到整体最优性能，尤其在几何退化场景中优势明显。在3个退化序列的消融实验中，结合两个自适应加权模块相比固定权重基线将RMSE ATE降低了86.0%，RTE降低了78.5%。代码和数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 方向感知的退化感知加权策略能有效解决几何退化场景下雷达-LiDAR融合中固定权重导致的Doppler信息错配问题，显著提升退化场景下的定位精度与鲁棒性。

title: Counting Animals in Camera-Traps Image Sequences without Count Labels: Winning Solution to the iWildCam 2021 Challenge
summary: Camera traps have become an essential tool for wildlife monitoring, motivating the development of computer vision methods for the automated extraction of information from these data. While most prior work has focused on species identification, many ecological applications also require estimating the number of unique individuals appearing across short image sequences. This task is particularly challenging because camera traps typically acquire bursts of images at approximately one frame per second, creating large temporal discontinuities that may make conventional multi-object tracking methods unreliable, and because manually collecting individual count annotations is prohibitively expensive. In this work, we describe the winning solution to the iWildCam 2021 Challenge, which introduced a benchmark for counting animals at the sequence level under realistic annotation constraints where count annotations are unavailable for training. Our approach, MaxBoxCount, combines a strong species classification pipeline with a simple yet effective counting heuristic based on MegaDetector detections to estimate the number of unique individuals without requiring count annotations. Code is available at https://github.com/alcunha/iwildcam2021ufam.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了iWildCam 2021挑战赛的获胜方案MaxBoxCount，该方案在缺乏个体数量标注的训练条件下，结合强物种分类模型和基于MegaDetector检测的简单计数启发式方法，估计短图像序列中唯一个体的数量。
AI.motivation: 野生动物监测中的生态学应用需要在短图像序列中估计唯一个体的数量，但该任务面临两大挑战：一是相机陷阱以约1帧/秒的速率采集图像突发，产生大的时间不连续性，使传统多目标跟踪方法不可靠；二是手工收集个体数量标注成本过高，难以获得训练所需的监督信号。
AI.method: MaxBoxCount方法结合两个组件：强物种分类Pipeline用于识别物种，以及基于MegaDetector检测结果的简单而有效的计数启发式算法，在无需数量标注的情况下估计序列中唯一个体的数量。
AI.result: 该方案赢得了iWildCam 2021挑战赛，在计数任务上取得了最佳性能，证明了无需标注的启发式计数方法在此类任务上的实用性。
AI.conclusion: MaxBoxCount表明，在标注约束严苛的现实场景下，利用现成的检测器输出辅以精心设计的启发式规则，可以在序列级个体计数任务上取得具有竞争力的结果，为缺乏标注的野生动物监测问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Memetic Search for Supersingular Elliptic Curves over $\mathbb{F}_p$
summary: The search for supersingular elliptic curves is a fundamental computational problem in isogeny-based cryptography. A recent metaheuristic formulation over $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$ introduced the NonMultiplicity Distance (NMD) objective, measuring the deviation of the Frobenius trace from a multiple of $p$, and showed that uninformed random search fails beyond $\approx 10^{13}$ candidates. This work investigates metaheuristic search over the prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$, the setting for oriented isogeny protocols such as CSIDH, OSIDH, and SQISign. Although the candidate space decreases from $p^2$ to $p$, the supersingular locus is asymptotically sparse ($O(\sqrt{p}\log p)$ curves), keeping the search exponentially difficult. We formulate a memetic algorithm tailored to $\mathbb{F}_p$ using a one-dimensional $j$-invariant chromosome, bit-level recombination, adaptive mutation, and periodic local search under the NMD objective. Benchmarks across 30 independent seeds at 40-bit, 46-bit, and 51-bit prime sizes ($p \approx 1.13\times 10^{15}$) show that the algorithm discovers an exact supersingular curve at 46 bits and consistently converges to ``near-supersingular'' ordinary curves with Frobenius traces remarkably close to zero: best NMD values of 19 at 40 bits and 3 at 51 bits, corresponding to relative trace deviations of $1.3\times 10^{-5}$ and $4.5\times 10^{-8}$ across the Hasse interval. These results demonstrate that NMD-driven memetic search effectively navigates the sparse $\mathbb{F}_p$ landscape and systematically locates near-supersingular structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在素数域𝔽_p上利用元启发式搜索（memetic算法）寻找超奇异椭圆曲线的问题。在NMD目标函数驱动下，算法在40-bit、46-bit和51-bit素数规模下均能发现精确或接近超奇异的曲线，最佳NMD值在51-bit时达到3，对应的Frobenius迹相对于Hasse区间的偏差仅4.5×10⁻⁸。
AI.motivation: 在同源密码学（如CSIDH、OSIDH、SQISign）中，寻找超奇异椭圆曲线是基础性计算问题。先前工作仅在𝔽_{p²}上进行了NMD目标的元启发式研究，并发现无信息随机搜索在约10¹³候选数之上即失效。本文动机在于探索素数域𝔽_p上NMD驱动的元启发式搜索——尽管候选空间从p²缩小到p，但超奇异轨迹渐近稀疏（O(√p log p)个曲线），搜索难度依然指数级，需要设计专门的算法来有效导航这一稀疏景观。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对𝔽_p的memetic算法，包含：一维j-不变量染色体编码、比特级重组算子、自适应变异策略，以及基于NMD目标函数的周期性局部搜索（memetic框架中的局部改进阶段）。算法在30个独立随机种子下，分别针对40-bit、46-bit和51-bit素数规模（p≈1.13×10¹⁵）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 在46-bit素数规模下，算法成功发现了精确的超奇异曲线。在40-bit和51-bit规模下，算法一致收敛于"近超奇异"普通曲线，Frobenius迹极其接近零：最佳NMD值分别为19（40-bit）和3（51-bit），对应的相对迹偏差在Hasse区间内分别为1.3×10⁻⁵和4.5×10⁻⁸。
AI.conclusion: NMD驱动的memetic搜索算法能够在𝔽_p上有效导航稀疏的超奇异曲线景观，系统地定位近超奇异结构。这证明了即使在候选空间缩小到𝔽_p的情况下，该方法仍能克服超奇异轨迹渐近稀疏带来的指数级搜索困难。

title: Listen to the Latents: Self-Correcting Speech Recognition in Large Audio Language Models Through Hidden-State Interactions
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems increasingly integrate large language models (LLMs) to leverage their semantic knowledge, either externally through logit fusion or internally through warm initialization. However, how to effectively combine these two strategies remains underexplored. In this work, we refine warm-initialized LLM-based ASR models by leveraging their own pre-adaptation base LLMs, focusing on LoRA-adapted settings where the base LLM is preserved. To achieve this, we propose Hybrid Search, a targeted correction strategy motivated by two observations. First, interaction features that characterize the relationship between LLM-based ASR hidden states and base-LLM hidden states provide informative signals about a token's degree of semantic dependence. Second, selectively refining targeted tokens with high semantic dependence improves ASR performance far beyond naive global LLM-correction methods including rescoring and late fusion. Our analysis suggests that, even after semantic knowledge transfer through warm initialization, LLM-based ASR models can still leverage their base LLM to further improve inference-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hybrid Search策略，通过利用基础LLM与warm-initialized LLM-based ASR模型之间的交互特征，在推理时对高语义依赖的token进行选择性精修，从而进一步提升ASR性能。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR系统越来越多地通过logit融合（外部）或warm initialization（内部）集成LLM以利用其语义知识，但如何有效将这两种策略结合仍未被充分探索。此外，即使在warm initialization之后，模型仍可能从基础LLM的推理时干预中获益。
