AI.method: 提出Hybrid Search策略，基于两个观察：(1) LLM-based ASR隐藏状态与base-LLM隐藏状态之间的交互特征能反映token的语义依赖程度；(2) 仅对高语义依赖的目标token进行选择性精修，远优于对整个序列进行naive的rescore或late fusion等全局LLM校正方法。该方法结合LoRA适配设置，利用pre-adaptation的基础LLM进行推理时修正。
AI.result: 选择性精修高语义依赖token的方法在ASR性能上显著超越naive的全局LLM校正方法（包括rescoring和late fusion）。分析表明，即使通过warm initialization转移了语义知识，LLM-based ASR模型仍可利用其基础LLM进一步改善推理时性能。
AI.conclusion: warm-initialized的LLM-based ASR模型在推理阶段仍可通过其基础LLM获得额外增益，Hybrid Search提供了一种高效且精准的推理时校正策略，为LLM与ASR的深度集成提供了新方向。

title: Learnable composition for neural operators
summary: Neural operators are fast, differentiable surrogates for physical simulation, but their accuracy often degrades when domain geometry, size, or operating conditions differ from training. Supervised adaptation can recover accuracy, but even a small target set requires costly high-fidelity simulations. We therefore ask how pretraining and transfer can be designed together to reduce this deployment cost. LatentDDM first pretrains a neural operator to predict fields on small subdomains. For a new setting, it freezes this operator and trains only a lightweight module that composes the local predictions. We evaluate our method on two complementary problems: steady Darcy flow, where long-range pressure coupling must extend across increasingly large porous domains, and unsteady incompressible flow around a pitching airfoil, where rollout errors compound as target pitching frequencies exceed the training range. Compared with the capacity-matched models that process the full domain at once, LatentDDM's error is 36-56% lower on larger Darcy domains after adaptation with 16 target simulations. It also improves 20-step field rollouts in fast-pitching airfoil flow, both zero-shot and after few-shot calibration. These results identify the co-designed local pretraining and composition-level transfer as a promising design principle for physical foundation models.

AI.tldr: LatentDDM提出了一种协同设计的预训练与迁移方法：先在小子域上预训练神经算子，冻结后仅训练一个轻量级组合模块来"拼接"局部预测，从而以极少的（约16个）目标域模拟样本显著降低跨几何尺寸和工况的部署误差（36-56%），并在多步滚动预测上同时改善零样本和少样本性能。
AI.motivation: 神经算子作为物理仿真的快速可微代理，在训练域外（几何变化、尺寸变化、工况变化）精度显著退化。监督式适应虽然可以恢复精度，但即使很小的目标域数据集也需要昂贵的高保真仿真。因此核心问题是：如何协同设计预训练与迁移策略，以降低部署阶段的高保真数据成本。
AI.method: LatentDDM分两步：首先在小的子域（subdomain）上预训练一个神经算子以预测局部物理场；面对新的目标设定时，冻结该局部算子，仅训练一个轻量级的组合/合成模块（lightweight module）将局部预测拼接为完整全局场预测。该"局部预训练+组合层迁移"策略在两个问题上验证：稳态Darcy流（长程压力耦合跨越大尺寸多孔介质域）和非定常不可压俯仰翼型绕流（多步滚动误差随目标俯仰频率超出训练范围而累积）。
AI.result: 在更大的Darcy域上，仅用16个目标仿真样本自适应后，LatentDDM相比在全域上直接处理的容量匹配模型误差降低36-56%；在高频俯仰翼型流场的20步场滚动预测中，无论是在零样本还是少样本校准下均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明"局部预训练+组合级迁移"的协同设计是一种有前景的物理基础模型设计原则，能够在显著降低部署仿真成本的同时保证跨域泛化能力。

title: Para-Pipe: Exploiting Hierarchical Operator Parallelism of ML Computational Graphs on SoCs
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems
summary: As edge-based deep learning applications become more complex, optimizing performance on heterogeneous System-on-Chips (SoCs) presents unique challenges. Traditional pipelining techniques distributing the computation across different on-chip processing units, while effective for throughput, do not address the latency demands posed by modern neural networks with complex interdependencies and extensive operator parallelism. There is a potential in leveraging operator parallelism to enable concurrent execution across multiple processing units, thereby reducing inference latency. However, prioritizing pipelining or parallel execution often necessitates a compromise, where optimizing one performance metric adversely impacts the other. This paper introduces Para-Pipe, a hierarchical mapping framework that integrates intra- and inter-stage operator parallelism within a pipelined architecture. Para-Pipe navigates the trade-off between throughput and latency by selectively fine-tuning parallelism levels within and across pipeline stages. This strategy can significantly reduce inter-processor communication overhead, significantly improving energy efficiency. Our evaluation demonstrates that Para-Pipe generates multiple Pareto-optimal configurations, achieving a balance between throughput and latency on an Amlogic SoC equipped with ARM big.LITTLE CPUs and GPU, as well as the Black Sesame Technology SoC featuring a deep learning accelerator and two DSPs. More importantly, throughput-optimized configurations under Para-Pipe on Amlogic SoC show an average energy efficiency improvement of 11.0% over purely pipelined strategies and 23.3% relative to non-pipelined parallel execution.

AI.tldr: Para-Pipe是一个面向异构SoC的分层映射框架，通过在流水线架构中集成操作符并行（intra-和inter-stage），实现吞吐量与延迟之间的权衡优化，并在Amlogic和Black Sesame SoC上验证了多个Pareto最优配置。相比纯流水线和纯并行策略，吞吐量优化配置分别带来11.0%和23.3%的能效提升。
AI.motivation: 传统流水线技术虽能提升吞吐量，但无法满足现代神经网络中复杂依赖关系和广泛操作符并行所带来的延迟需求。此外，在流水线与并行执行之间进行取舍时，优化一个性能指标往往会对另一个产生负面影响，缺乏同时兼顾吞吐量和延迟的系统性框架。
AI.method: Para-Pipe提出一个层次化的映射框架，在流水线架构内同时引入级内（intra-stage）与级间（inter-stage）的操作符并行，通过选择性微调流水线各阶段内部及跨阶段的并行度，在吞吐量与延迟之间动态权衡，同时降低处理器间通信开销。
AI.result: 在配备ARM big.LITTLE CPU和GPU的Amlogic SoC以及配备深度学习加速器和双DSP的Black Sesame Technology SoC上，Para-Pipe生成多个Pareto最优配置，实现了吞吐量与延迟的平衡。在Amlogic SoC上，吞吐量优化配置相比纯流水线策略的平均能效提升11.0%，相比非流水线并行执行提升23.3%。
AI.conclusion: Para-Pipe有效融合了流水线与操作符并行策略，提供了一个无需在吞吐量或延迟上强行取舍的可调映射框架，同时凭借通信开销的降低显著改善了能效，为复杂边缘AI工作负载在异构SoC上的部署提供了更优的性能-能效方案。

title: PPO-STGNN: A Proximal Policy Optimization Approach with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for DAG Task Scheduling in Cloud-Edge-End Computing
summary: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things, computation intensive directed acyclic graph (DAG) tasks have become increasingly common in cloud-edge-end collaborative environments. However, cloud, edge, and end nodes are highly heterogeneous in computing capacity, network bandwidth, and energy consumption, which makes the efficient scheduling of tasks with complex dependencies an NP-hard problem. Traditional heuristic algorithms and conventional reinforcement-learning methods often fail to capture the spatio-temporal dynamics of system resources. This paper proposes PPO-STGNN, a DAG task-scheduling algorithm that integrates proximal policy optimization (PPO) with spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs). The method uses an STGNN to extract features from both the DAG task topology and the physical cloud-edge-end resource graph, and then optimizes the scheduling policy through PPO to minimize makespan and schedule length ratio (SLR) while improving CPU and memory load balancing. To accelerate convergence, a multi-teacher behavior-cloning mechanism is introduced for pretraining. Experimental results show that PPO-STGNN significantly improves load balancing while maintaining a low completion time, making it suitable for dynamic and heterogeneous cloud-edge- end DAG scheduling scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出PPO-STGNN算法，将近端策略优化（PPO）与时空图神经网络（STGNN）相结合，用于云边端协同环境中依赖型DAG任务的调度，以最小化完成时间并改善负载均衡。
AI.motivation: 随着物联网的快速发展，云边端环境中计算密集型DAG任务日益普遍。然而云、边、端节点在计算能力、网络带宽和能耗方面高度异构，依赖复杂任务的调度是NP难问题。传统启发式算法和常规强化学习方法难以捕捉系统资源的时空动态特性。
AI.method: 将PPO（近端策略优化）与STGNN（时空图神经网络）相结合。利用STGNN同时从DAG任务拓扑和物理云边端资源图中提取特征，通过PPO优化调度策略以最小化makespan和SLR（调度长度比），同时改善CPU和内存负载均衡。为提高收敛速度，引入多教师行为克隆机制进行预训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，PPO-STGNN在保持较低任务完成时间的同时显著改善了负载均衡，适用于动态异构的云边端DAG调度场景。
AI.conclusion: PPO-STGNN有效解决了云边端异构环境中DAG任务调度难题，在完成时间与负载均衡之间取得了良好平衡，验证了将强化学习与图神经网络结合应用于分布式调度问题的可行性。

title: Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the IROS 2026 Workshop on Physical World Models for Scaling Embodied AI (PWMS 2026)
summary: Action-conditioned JEPA world models enable planning toward visually specified goals without reconstructing future pixels, yet latent prediction alone does not explicitly encourage the learned representations to retain information relevant to robotic control. We introduce an end-to-end JEPA world model that augments latent prediction with inverse dynamics (IDM) and state alignment (SA). While inverse dynamics discourages latent collapse and makes latent transitions informative of the actions that produced them, state alignment grounds consecutive representations in their associated physical configuration and motion. Across four benchmark tasks, our model attains the highest success rates on TwoRoom (100%), PushT (98%), and OGBench-Cube (87%), while performing comparably to LeWorldModel on Reacher. Our ablation further shows that adding state alignment consistently improves planning success over IDM alone across all four tasks. Although LeWorldModel, our primary baseline, attains higher average straightening on OGBench-Cube, transition-subspace analysis shows that its transition energy is concentrated in a substantially lower-dimensional subspace. Our state-aligned model exhibits a higher effective transition dimension than LeWorldModel and improves planning over IDM alone, supporting state alignment as an effective complement to inverse dynamics for robotic planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端JEPA世界模型，在潜在空间预测的基础上引入逆动力学（IDM）和状态对齐（SA），在不重建未来像素的前提下增强表征对机器人控制相关信息的保留能力，在多项基准任务上取得最优或相当的规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 行动条件JEPA世界模型虽能在不重建未来像素的情况下实现向视觉指定目标的规划，但纯粹的潜在预测并未显式鼓励学习到的表征保留与机器人控制相关的信息，导致规划能力受限。
AI.method: 构建端到端JEPA世界模型，将潜在预测与逆动力学（IDM）和状态对齐（SA）相结合。IDM通过逆向预测动作抑制潜在表征坍缩，并使潜在转移蕴含产生它们的动作信息；状态对齐则将连续的表征与实际物理构型及运动状态进行约束对齐。
AI.result: 在四个基准任务中，模型在TwoRoom（100%）、PushT（98%）和OGBench-Cube（87%）上取得最高成功率，在Reacher上与LeWorldModel表现相当。消融实验表明，状态对齐在所有任务中一致提升了单独使用IDM时的规划成功率。OGBench-Cube上LeWorldModel的平均平直度更高，但转移子空间分析显示其转移能量集中在一个维度显著更低的空间中；所提状态对齐模型的有效转移维度更高。
AI.conclusion: 状态对齐是逆动力学在机器人规划中的有效补充，能增加潜在转移的有效维度、保持表征对不同动作的区分度，从而提升规划成功率和表征的可控性。

title: An Ensemble-Based Self-Taught Learning Approach for Parking Space Classification Under Limited Data
summary: Parking spot classification is a fundamental task in intelligent transportation systems, yet most deep learning approaches rely on large amounts of annotated data and exhibit limited generalization across heterogeneous environments. To address these limitations, we investigate a self-taught learning framework based on unsupervised representation learning with convolutional autoencoders. The proposed approach learns transferable visual representations from unlabeled data and reuses the learned encoders as fixed feature extractors for supervised classification with limited annotated samples in the target domain. To further enhance robustness and mitigate architectural bias, an ensemble of heterogeneous autoencoders is employed, with independent classifier heads and prediction fusion at inference time. Experiments conducted on the PKLot and CNRPark benchmarks under cross-dataset evaluation protocols show that the proposed ensemble-based strategy substantially reduces annotation requirements while improving robustness under significant domain shifts, achieving accuracies between 93\% and 96\% in data-constrained scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于卷积自编码器无监督表示学习与异构集成策略的自学习框架用于停车位分类，在PKLot和CNRPark跨数据集基准上仅用少量标注样本即可达到93%-96%的准确率，有效缓解了标注依赖和跨环境泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 停车位分类是智能交通系统中的基础任务，但现有深度学习方法依赖大量标注数据，且在不同异质环境间泛化能力有限。为降低标注成本并提升跨域鲁棒性，作者引入基于无监督表示学习的自学习框架。
AI.method: 采用卷积自编码器从无标签数据中学习可迁移的视觉表示，并将学习到的编码器作为固定特征提取器，用于目标域中少量标注样本的监督分类。为增强鲁棒性并缓解架构偏差，引入异构自编码器集成策略，每个编码器配有独立的分类头，推理阶段进行预测融合。
AI.result: 在PKLot和CNRPark基准上采用跨数据集评估协议进行实验，所提集成策略在显著领域偏移下大幅降低标注需求并提升鲁棒性，在数据受限场景下达到93%至96%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 基于集成异构自编码器的自学习框架有效解决了停车位分类中标注稀缺与跨域泛化问题，在标注受限和强领域偏移条件下仍能保持高精度，验证了无监督表示学习在该任务中的实用价值。

title: After Cheap Discovery: From unknown to known-and-unfixed
summary: Automated vulnerability discovery has removed the scarcity of expert attention that protected most software. The response has concentrated on discovery and on repair, and both are becoming cheaper. This article argues that neither cost curve determines exposure. What determines it is remediation coverage at the release decision: the fraction of identified vulnerabilities fixed before a product ships, and the residue of known, assessed, unremediated flaws an organisation has decided to ship with. Four arguments follow. The residue is not a random sample of what was found, because triage sorts on cost and the expensive cases are architectural. The deferred backlog is itself a high-value artifact. Documented awareness alters an organisation's legal and market position, and produces an adverse selection that the price of software does not reflect. And no regulatory instrument reaching vendors triggers on internal knowledge -- every one fires on exploitation observed by a third party -- which leaves the distance between what a vendor knows and what it must disclose entirely at the vendor's discretion. CISA's Binding Operational Directive 26-04 is examined as the exception that shows what a solution requires. Release coverage is not currently measured, and measuring it is the precondition for liability, insurance or procurement to act.

AI.tldr: 本文论证决定软件系统暴露风险的不是漏洞发现与修复的成本曲线，而是"发布时刻的修复覆盖率"——即已知漏洞中在产品发布前被修复的比例，以及组织决定带着未修复缺陷发布的问题。文章提出四个论点，并指出CISA的BOD 26-04是例外案例，最后强调发布覆盖率目前未被测量，而这正是责任、保险和采购机制生效的前提。
AI.motivation: 自动化漏洞发现已经消除了过去依赖专家注意力匮乏来保护软件的脆弱平衡，漏洞发现和修复成本都在下降。现有讨论集中于发现与修复本身，但作者认为这两种成本曲线都不能决定系统暴露风险，需要重新审视决定风险的本质因素，即发布决策时的修复覆盖率。
AI.method: 本文采用论证性分析方法，提出四个核心论点：(1) 未修复的残留缺陷并非被发现问题中的随机样本，因为分类排序基于成本，而昂贵案例通常是架构层面的；(2) 被推迟处理的积压缺陷本身是高价值工件；(3) 文档化的漏洞意识改变了组织的法律和市场地位，产生市场无法反映的逆向选择；(4) 没有任何到达供应商的监管机制以内部知识为触发条件——所有机制都在第三方观察到利用行为时才激活，供应商知晓与必须披露之间的差距完全由其自行裁量。文章以CISA的Binding Operational Directive 26-04作为展示解决方案要求的例外案例。
AI.result: 文章揭示了一个系统性盲点：发布覆盖率（release coverage）目前未被测量。监管机制全部以外部的利用观察为触发点，而非供应商内部知识，导致组织可以在发布时携带已知未修复漏洞而无需面对匹配的责任机制。CISA的BOD 26-04被指出为能够触及该问题的少数例外。
AI.conclusion: 发布覆盖率是决定软件暴露风险的核心变量，但当前缺乏测量。测量发布覆盖率是让责任认定、保险和采购机制得以发挥作用的先决条件。修复成本下降并不会自动改善安全性，因为架构性、高成本的残留问题会被分类机制系统性排除在修复范围之外，而这些恰恰是决定暴露风险的关键。

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge: Concerning Rubric Artifacts in LLM-based Automated Text Generation Evaluation
comment: Accepted for publication at EMNLP 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines are increasingly used to evaluate AI-generated text, based on the assumption that judgments arise from reasoning over candidate responses with respect to a rubric. We show that this assumption warrants further scrutiny. Classifiers trained only on rubric text, without access to any evaluated response, achieve nontrivial predictive performance on judge outputs. This suggests that rubric formulations encode recoverable evaluative signals, allowing scores to be partially anticipated independently of model outputs. Finally, counterfactual perturbations reveal that judges often fail to reliably update their decisions when either the candidate response or the rubric criterion is reversed. Our findings raise concerns about the reliability of rubric-based LLM evaluation and highlight the need for further methodological study of automated evaluation via LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了"LLM作为评审"（LLM-as-a-Judge）自动评估管道中"评分源于对候选回复与评分标准进行推理"的基本假设。研究发现：(1) 仅基于评分标准文本训练的神经网络分类器（未接触任何被评估回复）就能对评审输出取得非平凡的预测性能，说明评分标准本身编码了可恢复的评估信号，分数可部分地被独立预测；(2) 反事实扰动实验显示，当候选回复或评分标准被反转时，评审者往往不能可靠地更新其决策。这些发现对基于评分标准的LLM评估可靠性提出了严重质疑。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge管道被广泛用于评估AI生成文本，其隐含前提是评审判断源于对候选回复与评分标准的推理。然而这一前提缺乏实证检验，本文旨在系统性地审视该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 采用三类实验：(1) 仅用评分标准文本训练分类器来预测评审输出，检验评估信号是否可独立于被评估回复而被恢复；(2) 反事实扰动实验——分别反转候选回复或评分标准中的关键维度，观察评审是否可靠地更新决策。方法本质上是因果性和信息论层面的诊断性测试。
AI.result: 仅基于评分标准训练的分类器即可在预测评审输出上达到非平凡准确率；同时，评审者在候选回复或评分标准被反转时，其决策往往不能可靠地随之更新，说明评审在很大程度上受到评分标准本身固有偏差的驱动，而非对内容的自适应推理。
AI.conclusion: 基于评分标准的LLM评估的可靠性存在严重隐患，现行LLM-as-a-Judge范式可能测量的是评分标准文本中固有的评估信号而非候选回复的实际质量，亟需对自动化评估方法进行更深入的方法学研究。

title: LeanStream: A Speculate-and-Refine Streaming Framework for Efficient on-Device LLM Inference
comment: 6 pages, 13 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking (MobiCom '26)
summary: On-device LLM inference is attractive for privacy and responsiveness, but remains challenging on mobile and embedded devices because model weights far exceed available DRAM. Prior systems exploit activation sparsity and offload weights to SSD or flash storage, but face a fundamental systems trade-off: accurate sparse execution decisions require the latest context, whereas efficient computation-I/O overlap requires early prediction. As a result, existing designs either serialize execution or incur redundant weight fetches, extra computation, and large cache overheads. We present LeanStream, a streaming speculate-and-refine framework for efficient on-device LLM inference. LeanStream progressively refines computation, loading, and cache-retention priorities using partial GPU results, enabling fine-grained overlap between GPU execution and storage I/O. We implement LeanStream on both mobile and embedded platforms. Compared with prior on-device LLM inference systems, LeanStream reduces memory usage by 4.8$\times$ to 7.5$\times$ at the best throughput achieved by prior work, while further improving token generation throughput by 1.6$\times$ to 2.1$\times$.

AI.tldr: LeanStream是一个面向端侧设备大语言模型（LLM）推理的"推测-精炼"流式框架，通过利用部分GPU结果渐进式精炼计算、加载和缓存保留的优先级，实现了GPU执行与存储I/O的细粒度重叠，在降低内存占用的同时提升token生成吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 端侧LLM推理具有隐私保护和响应速度快等优点，但模型权重大大超过设备可用DRAM容量，面临挑战。虽然已有系统利用激活稀疏性并将权重卸载到SSD或闪存，但这些系统存在一个根本性的系统权衡：精确的稀疏执行决策需要最新上下文，而高效的计算-I/O重叠需要提前预测。这导致现有设计要么串行执行，要么招致冗余权重获取、额外计算和大量缓存开销。
AI.method: LeanStream提出流式"推测-精炼"（speculate-and-refine）框架，利用部分GPU结果逐步精炼计算、加载和缓存保留策略的优先级，从而实现GPU执行与存储I/O之间的细粒度重叠。该框架已在移动端和嵌入式平台上实现。
AI.result: 与先前的端侧LLM推理系统相比，LeanStream在先前工作达到的最优吞吐量下将内存使用量减少了4.8倍至7.5倍，同时进一步将token生成吞吐量提升了1.6倍至2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: LeanStream通过增量式的推测与精炼机制有效解决了端侧LLM推理中稀疏执行决策准确性与计算-I/O重叠效率之间的根本矛盾，在显著降低内存需求的同时实现更高的推理吞吐，为资源受限设备上的轻量级LLM部署提供了有效的系统方案。

title: What Matters for Aggressive Decoding-Time KV Eviction? Temporal Aggregation and Ranking Preservation
summary: Decoding-time KV cache compression research focuses heavily on designing better token scoring functions, while the temporal rule that aggregates scores across decode steps is often treated as an implementation detail. Under aggressive KV compression, we find that exponential-moving-average (EMA) aggregation makes approximately order-preserving scorer modifications largely indistinguishable at the eviction-set level. Value-norm and entropy variants remain highly correlated with attention and produce nearly unchanged retention sets, whereas KeyDiff, key norm, recency, and a learned scorer alter the ranking and degrade substantially. We associate this stability with the evaluated aggregation, which couples layer weighting and temporal retention. Building on this observation, we introduce InertiaKV, an EMA-based decoding-time eviction method, and InertiaKV-Lazy, its periodic-refresh variant, which yields 1.34-1.46x decode throughput relative to full refresh InertiaKV. We also study Score-Free decoding as a separate empirical operating point: it scores the full context once at the first decode step, freezes that ranking, and incurs an average quality change of +0.03 while removing all subsequent scoring. Across six open-weight backbones and the LongBench, LongBench-v2, and RULER benchmarks, the results identify temporal aggregation and ranking preservation as distinct, consequential design factors; they do not imply that scoring quality is irrelevant in general.

AI.tldr: 本文研究解码时KV缓存压缩中时间聚合规则的重要性，发现指数移动平均(EMA)聚合使近似保序的打分器在驱逐集层面几乎不可区分，并提出InertiaKV及其周期性刷新变体InertiaKV-Lazy，分别在吞吐量和质量间取得平衡。此外还探索了Score-Free解码作为独立运行点，全部上下文仅在首个解码步打分一次。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩研究过度聚焦于设计更好的token打分函数，而跨解码步聚合分数的时序规则（如EMA）常被视为实现细节被忽视。然而在激进压缩下，该时序规则对最终驱逐集的选择具有决定性影响，值得系统研究。
AI.method: 系统性比较不同打分函数（注意力、Value-norm、熵、KeyDiff、键范数、近期性、学习型打分器）在不同聚合规则下的行为，提出基于EMA的解码时驱逐方法InertiaKV，并设计周期性刷新变体InertiaKV-Lazy以减少刷新开销。另提出Score-Free解码，仅在首个解码步对整个上下文打分一次并冻结排序。
AI.result: 在六个开源骨干模型以及LongBench、LongBench-v2、RULER基准上验证：EMA聚合下近似保序的打分器（Value-norm、熵）与注意力高度相关并保持几乎相同的保留集；非保序打分器（KeyDiff、键范数、近期性、学习型）性能大幅下降。InertiaKV-Lazy相对全刷新InertiaKV获得1.34-1.46倍解码吞吐提升。Score-Free解码平均质量变化仅为+0.03且完全消除后续打分开销。
AI.conclusion: 时间聚合与排序保持是KV缓存压缩中独立且重要的设计因素，但研究结果不意味着打分质量整体上无关紧要。EMA聚合的稳定性可实现近零成本的懒惰刷新或一次性打分策略，为高效解码开辟新的优化空间。

title: Scaling Bimanual Household Manipulation from 1,500 hours of Demonstrations to On-Policy Corrections
summary: Learning generalist policies for robust bimanual manipulation is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high quality large scale human demonstration data. In this work, we release 1,500 hours of diverse bimanual manipulation demonstrations covering everyday household tasks, and use this comprehensive corpus to train XR-2, a powerful vision-language-action (VLA) model. Enabled by a purpose built high throughput data pipeline and a carefully designed multi stage training paradigm, XR-2 attains strong manipulation performance in our systematic experiments while retaining favorable training efficiency and high data utilization. We further study two critical scaling axes: varying the amount of expert demonstration data, and post training on DAgger correction data from real time human interventions. In both settings, task success rate improves steadily over the data ranges we probe, exhibiting a clear consistent scaling trend at our current data scale. These results validate both the learning capacity of XR-2 and the promising scaling properties of the released dataset, which we open source to support reproducible research on bimanual robot manipulation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了1500小时覆盖日常家庭任务的双手操作演示数据集，并基于该语料训练了XR-2视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过高吞吐量数据管道和多阶段训练范式，XR-2在系统实验中表现出强大的操作性能，同时保持良好的训练效率和数据利用率。研究表明在专家演示数据和DAgger纠错数据两个维度上，任务成功率均随数据量稳定提升，呈现一致的扩展趋势。
AI.motivation: 学习通用型的鲁棒双手操作策略受限于高质量大规模人类演示数据的稀缺，亟需大规模数据资源和相应的学习范式来解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 释放1500小时多样化的日常家庭双手操作演示数据；构建高吞吐量数据收集管道；设计多阶段训练范式训练XR-2视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型；沿两个关键维度研究扩展性：专家演示数据量变化和基于DAgger实时人类干预纠错数据的后训练。
AI.result: XR-2在系统实验中取得强大的操作性能，同时保持有利的训练效率和高数据利用率；在专家演示数据和DAgger纠错数据两个维度上，任务成功率随数据规模持续提升，在当前数据规模下表现出清晰一致的扩展趋势。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了XR-2的学习能力以及所发布数据集的良好扩展特性，数据集将以开源方式发布以支持双手操作机器人学习领域的可复现研究。

title: MedQA-MM: Shortcuts Behind Medical Visual Reasoning
summary: A benchmark score credits final answers, but not the route by which an item can be answered. In medical multimodal multiple-choice questions (MCQs), this distinction matters because a correct answer can be supported by the intended image finding or by benchmark-preserved cues in the wording of answers, non-visual clinical text, visible image text, artificial annotations, or device/context artifacts. We call the resulting score-level overinterpretation reasoning inflation. Here, a route is an observable input path that can support answer selection, not a claim about the model's hidden cognition. Across six medical multimodal MCQ datasets, we separate candidate cues from behavioral evidence through prompt- and image-side audits, modality ablations, and matched repairs that preserve the medical target and answer key. In a 13-configuration open-model panel, full-input accuracy is 62.63%, while text-only and options-only settings achieve 53.96% and 29.71%, respectively. Removing length-gap, absolute/conspicuous, and spatial/prepositional cues lowers accuracy by 6.58, 3.50, and 4.77 percentage points. We also construct MedQA-MM, a 1,000-item shortcut-mitigated subset, where text-only and options-only accuracy fall to 5.21% and 12.33%. This does not imply that models never use images; it shows that medical image-reasoning claims require route-level evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"推理膨胀"（reasoning inflation）概念，指医学多模态多项选择题中模型可能通过非预期线索（如选项措辞、非视觉临床文本、图像文字、人工标注等）获得正确答案，而非真实的医学图像推理。作者通过提示侧与图像侧审计、模态消融及配对修复等方法，在六个医学多模态MCQ数据集上量化了各类线索的贡献，并构建了去除捷径线索的MedQA-MM子集。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准评分仅依据最终答案，忽略了答案是经由"预期图像发现"还是"基准保留的捷径线索"获得的。医学多模态选择题中，图像推理能力的高分可能被各类非预期线索所夸大，导致对模型医学视觉推理能力的过高估计，因此需要区分不同答案路径并进行路由级证据验证。
AI.method: 将"路由"定义为可观察的输入路径（支持答案选择），而非模型内部认知主张。采用提示侧与图像侧审计、模态消融（全文、纯文本、纯选项）、以及保留医学目标与答案键的配对修复实验，在六个医学多模态MCQ数据集上对13种开放模型配置进行系统分析，并区分长度差、绝对/显眼、空间/介词等线索类型。
AI.result: 13配置开放模型面板中，全文输入准确率62.63%，纯文本53.96%，纯选项29.71%。去除长度差线索降低6.58个百分点，绝对/显眼线索降低3.50个百分点，空间/介词线索降低4.77个百分点。在剔除捷径的MedQA-MM 1000项子集上，纯文本与纯选项准确率分别降至5.21%和12.33%。
AI.conclusion: 结果并非表明模型从不使用图像，而是说明医学图像推理能力的主张需要路由级证据支撑。仅有分数层面的高准确率不足以证明模型具备预期的医学图像理解能力，基准必须审计正确答案所依赖的输入路径。

title: Long-Range Indirect Control-Flow Prediction in Stripped Binaries via Dual Virtual Hubs and Multi-Task Graph Learning
summary: Recovering indirect control-flow (ICF) edges is fundamental to binary security analysis, yet existing methods struggle with long-range dependencies, isolate different ICF types, and are often evaluated under protocols vulnerable to label noise and data leakage. We present ICFlowNet, a unified framework for long-range ICF prediction in stripped binaries. ICFlowNet introduces candidate-aware Dual Virtual Hubs, a Global Code Hub and a Global Data Hub, to create short routing paths between distant code and data evidence, and combines them with multi-task graph learning to jointly model indirect calls, indirect tail calls, jump tables, and returns. To enable credible evaluation, we further develop a leakage-aware, noise-controlled pipeline with package-level splits, function-level mnemonic-hash deduplication, and a clean test protocol built from dynamic positives and absolute negatives. Using this pipeline, we construct a dataset of 15,901 unique stripped x86-64 binaries, including 1,351 with dynamic ground truth. Experiments show that simply scaling static supervision yields only marginal gains, whereas our structural and multi-task designs are essential: Dual Virtual Hubs improve long-range F1 by up to 9.13 points, multi-task learning adds up to 5.81 points, and the final model outperforms prior baselines by more than 13 F1 points on long-range indirect calls while adding only 11.44 percent topological overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICFlowNet，一个用于剥离二进制文件中长距离间接控制流预测的统一框架，通过候选感知的双虚拟枢纽（全局代码枢纽和全局数据枢纽）创建代码与数据证据间的短路由路径，并结合多任务图学习联合建模间接调用、间接尾调用、跳转表和返回边。同时构建了泄露感知、噪声控制的评估管道，实验表明该框架在长距离间接调用上比现有基线F1值提升超过13个点，且仅增加11.44%的拓扑开销。
AI.motivation: 现有间接控制流恢复方法存在三个关键问题：难以处理长距离依赖关系、将不同类型的ICF（间接调用、尾调用、跳转表、返回）彼此孤立建模、以及评估协议易受标签噪声和数据泄露影响，导致评测结果不可信。
AI.method: ICFlowNet采用统一框架：1) 提出候选感知的双虚拟枢纽结构——全局代码枢纽和全局数据枢纽，在相距遥远的代码证据与数据证据之间建立短路由路径；2) 结合多任务图学习，联合建模四种ICF类型；3) 构建泄露感知、噪声控制的评估管道，包括包级分割、函数级助记符哈希去重，以及由动态正样本和绝对负样本构成的干净测试协议。
AI.result: 构建了包含15,901个唯一剥离后的x86-64二进制文件的数据集（其中1,351个具有动态真值）。实验表明：纯静态监督扩展带来的收益边际化；双虚拟枢纽在长距离任务上F1提升最高达9.13点；多任务学习最多增加5.81点；最终模型在长距离间接调用上超越既有基线超过13个F1点，仅引入11.44%的拓扑开销。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明结构设计（双虚拟枢纽）和多任务学习框架对于长距离ICF预测至关重要，简单的数据扩展无法替代结构创新；同时强调需要严格、无泄露的评估协议来确保ICF恢复方法的可信评测。

title: LexIssue: Benchmarking Legal Issue Identification in Chinese Civil Litigation
summary: Identifying the issues disputed between litigating parties is a crucial component of real-world litigation. However, legal issues remain comparatively underexplored in legal AI research. In this work, we study the computational modelling of legal issue identification in litigation. We introduce a legally grounded hierarchical schema that represents legal issues through both free-form issue descriptions and structured legal categories, and formulate legal issue identification as two complementary tasks: legal issue generation and legal issue classification. Based on this formulation, we construct LexIssue, a benchmark containing 430 real-world Chinese civil litigation cases and 1,303 expert-annotated disputed legal issues. We further develop an issue-centric legal knowledge base spanning 27 causes of action and 441 candidate legal issue entries to support retrieval-augmented reasoning. Experimental results across a diverse set of models show that retrieval-augmented generation using the constructed legal issue knowledge base consistently improves performance in identifying disputed legal issues and their corresponding legal attributes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究诉讼中法律争议焦点的计算建模，提出层次化法律争议焦点模式，将法律争议焦点识别定义为生成与分类两个互补任务，构建了包含430个真实中国民事案件和1303个专家标注争议焦点的LexIssue基准，以及覆盖27个案由、441个候选争议焦点条目的法律知识库，实验表明基于该知识库的检索增强生成能持续提升争议焦点及法律属性识别性能。
AI.motivation: 法律争议焦点识别是真实诉讼中的关键环节，但在法律AI研究中相对未被充分探索，亟需系统性的计算建模研究。
AI.method: 1) 提出具有法律依据的层次化模式，将争议焦点表示为自由文本描述与结构化法律类别两种形式；2) 将法律争议焦点识别形式化为两个互补任务：争议焦点生成与争议焦点分类；3) 构建LexIssue基准及面向争议焦点的法律知识库，用于支撑检索增强推理。
AI.result: 在多种模型上的实验表明，使用所构建的法律争议焦点知识库进行检索增强生成，能够在识别争议焦点及其对应法律属性方面持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 法律争议焦点知识库辅助的检索增强生成是一种有效提升诉讼争议焦点识别能力的方法，验证了结构化法律知识对法律AI任务的增益价值。

title: The Gradient Does Not See Rank: Rank-Indifference in Matrix-CODI on ProsQA
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop, https://openreview.net/forum?id=Spof4PusVI. 9 pages. Corrects a data-entry error in the workshop version: the seed-1337 accuracy in the three-seed replication was reported as 80.47% (a control run); the archived value is 78.91%, so the three-seed mean is 81.0 +/- 2.0pp (was 81.5 +/- 1.2pp). All other results are unchanged
summary: Continuous chain-of-thought models compress reasoning into latent tokens. Matrix-valued variants, which route each latent token through a d x d matrix bottleneck, introduce rank as a single-sample structural observable on the latent matrix Z. If matrix latents carry parallel reasoning paths via superposition, rank should track them, and truncating Z to low rank should hurt accuracy on tasks whose solutions plausibly require multiple components. Across four training regimes of a matrix-CODI model (three on ProsQA, one on GSM8K-Aug below the learning threshold), the rank-k projection ablation curve is flat to within 0.6 percentage points. A three-seed replication yields 81.0 +/- 2.0 percentage points accuracy while the final effective rank of Z spans {4, 12, 13}; the loss does not reward any particular rank. To test whether rank-blindness arises from the flatten-then-project readout alone, we trained four readouts: a bilinear reparametrization, a bilinear-plus-GELU readout nonlinear in Z, an SVD-augmented readout feeding singular values through an MLP, and a quadratic readout in Z Z^T. All four rank-k curves remain flat (Spearman p-values 0.63, 0.14, 0.82, 0.46). The flat curves persist for readouts nonlinear in Z. A linear probe on Z underperforms a raw pretrained hidden state at target prediction (AUC 0.673 vs. 0.846). A negative control on vanilla GPT-2 SFT (no matrix bottleneck, no Z, three seeds, n=500) reproduces a flat rank-k curve under the same intervention paradigm with pooled-mean range 0.20pp, and a random-h sensitivity floor lands at the same accuracy: the rank-k ablation alone conflates rank-blindness with position-irrelevance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究矩阵链式思维（matrix-CODI）模型中潜在矩阵Z的秩作为单样本结构可观测量的意义。实验发现，无论在四种不同训练机制、多种非线性读出器（bilinear、GELU、SVD增强、二次读出）还是负对照GPT-2 SFT中，秩k投影消融曲线始终平坦（波动≤0.6个百分点），线性探针表现也不如原始预训练隐状态。结论是秩k消融本身无法区分"秩无关性"与"位置无关性"，矩阵潜在表示可能并不携带可消融的并行推理路径。
AI.motivation: 连续链式思维模型将推理压缩为潜在token，而矩阵值变体通过d×d矩阵瓶颈路由每个潜在token，引入了秩作为潜在矩阵Z上的单样本结构可观测量。核心假设是：若矩阵潜在表示通过叠加携带并行推理路径，则秩应能追踪这些路径，截断Z至低秩应损害需要多分量解决方案的推理任务准确性。作者希望通过秩k投影消融实验验证矩阵潜在表示的秩是否承载可用的结构信息。
AI.method: 作者在四种矩阵-CODI模型训练机制（三个ProsQA、一个GSM8K-Aug亚学习阈值）上进行秩k投影消融实验；进行三种子复制测试有效秩范围与准确率的关系；训练四种不同读出器（双线性重参数化、双线性+GELU非线性读出、SVD增强MLP读出、ZZ^T二次读出）排除展平-投影读出的影响；用线性探针比较Z与原始预训练隐状态的目标预测能力；最后在vanilla GPT-2 SFT（无矩阵瓶颈）上做负对照并增加random-h敏感性基线。
AI.result: 所有秩k投影消融曲线在四种训练机制下均平坦（±0.6个百分点以内）。三种子复制中有效秩跨{4,12,13}，但准确率稳定在81.0±2.0个百分点，损失函数不奖励任何特定秩。四种非线性读出器的秩k曲线仍然平坦（Spearman p值0.63/0.14/0.82/0.46）。线性探针AUC为0.673，低于原始预训练隐状态的0.846。负对照GPT-2 SFT同样复现平坦秩k曲线（pooled-mean范围0.20pp），且random-h敏感性基线落在相同准确率水平。
AI.conclusion: 秩k消融单独无法证明秩无关性，因为它与位置无关性（position-irrelevance）混淆——即使在没有矩阵瓶颈和Z的标准GPT-2 SFT中也能产生相同的平坦曲线。矩阵潜在表示的秩可能并不编码可分离的并行推理组件；需要更精细的干预手段（如位置相关消融或依赖秩的读出损失约束）来区分矩阵结构的真实功能角色。

title: CulturalMenuBench: Probing the Knowledge-Application Gap in Multimodal Culinary Reasoning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings. Code and data: https://github.com/BobTsang-NLP/CulturalMenuBench
summary: Multimodal language models achieve near-ceiling scores on food recognition benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether this success reflects genuine cultural understanding or mere visual matching. To probe this distinction, we introduce CulturalMenuBench, a benchmark of 4,870 items in 10 languages across 18 regions; its 10 tasks pair final-dish and step-by-step cooking images with ingredients, procedural text, and regional labels, spanning basic recognition to process-grounded cultural attribution. Evaluating 12 models exposes a substantial knowledge-application gap: models exceeding 94% on standard multiple-choice tasks drop to at most 56% when attributing dishes to Chinese regional cuisines, despite an identical four-way format. Diagnostic analyses explain why: error patterns are consistent with random guessing, accuracy tracks visual distinctiveness rather than cultural structure, and models classify cuisines more accurately from dish names alone than from images (+7-18 points). The knowledge is thus present but cannot be activated through visual input. An ablation confirms these tasks genuinely require procedural evidence: removing sequential cooking images selectively degrades process-grounded tasks while others remain stable. Overall, CulturalMenuBench shows that near-perfect recognition can conceal an inability to apply cultural knowledge, motivating training that explicitly connects perception, procedure, and cultural context. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CulturalMenuBench基准，包含18个地区、10种语言、4,870个数据项的多模态食物文化理解评测。实验发现12个模型在标准多项选择任务上超过94%，但在将菜肴归属到中国区域菜系时准确率最多仅56%，揭示了"知识应用鸿沟"：模型具备文化知识但无法通过视觉输入激活。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型在食物识别基准上接近满分，但现有基准无法区分模型是真正理解文化还是仅进行视觉匹配。作者希望通过区分"菜品识别"与"基于流程的文化归因"来揭露这一区别，从而推动训练将感知、流程和文化背景显式连接。
AI.method: 构建CulturalMenuBench：覆盖18个地区、10种语言的4,870个条目，10个任务将成品菜肴图和逐步烹饪图与食材、步骤文本及区域标签配对，难度从基础识别到流程驱动文化归因。对12个模型进行评测，并辅以三类诊断分析：(1)错误模式是否与随机猜测一致；(2)准确率是否跟随视觉区分度而非文化结构；(3)用菜名vs图像进行分类的对比。另设消融实验移除顺序烹饪图像以验证任务需要流程证据。
AI.result: 模型在标准多项选择任务超过94%但文化归因任务最多56%。错误模式与随机猜测一致；准确率追踪视觉区分度而非文化结构；仅凭菜名分类比凭图像分类高7-18个百分点。移除顺序烹饪图像只选择性降低流程驱动任务的表现，其他任务保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 近乎完美的识别率可能掩盖模型无法应用文化知识的缺陷。CulturalMenuBench揭示了知识-应用鸿沟，表明需要开发将感知、流程与文化语境显式连接起来的训练方法。

title: FailBench: How Reliable are VLMs at Judging Robot Task Success?
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate robot manipulation outcomes, but existing benchmarks offer limited evidence of cross-domain generalization. We introduce FailBench, a benchmark for robot failure detection comprising 2,197 manipulation attempts across 14 public sources (12 real-world, 2 simulated). In FailBench, 75% of failures occur naturally, and six real-world sources come from non-failure-detection datasets. Evaluating 13 VLM-based detectors, we find the best model achieves only 0.77 mean balanced accuracy. Notably, models fine-tuned for failure detection consistently underperform general-purpose VLMs and their own pretrained baselines. Performance depends heavily on required visual evidence: models approach saturation when outcomes depend on observable object motion, but degrade to near-chance (<0.60 balanced accuracy) on contact-intensive assembly tasks. Error analysis reveals a systematic bias toward predicting success under ambiguous evidence, which persists even with increased reasoning effort. Finally, we show that input-level intervention--spatially localizing and cropping outcome-relevant regions--improves the top detector by 2.4 percentage points without extra training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FailBench基准测试，用于评估VLM在机器人操作失败检测中的跨域泛化能力。该基准包含来自14个公开来源（12个真实世界、2个模拟）的2,197次操作尝试，其中75%的失败是自然发生的。通过对13种VLM检测器的评估发现，最佳模型仅达到0.77的平均平衡准确率，且专门微调用于失败检测的模型竟劣于通用VLM及其预训练基线。模型在依赖于可观察物体运动的任务上接近饱和，但在接触密集的装配任务上性能跌至接近随机水平（<0.60）。误差分析揭示了模型在模糊证据下系统性偏向预测成功的偏差。最后，通过输入层面的空间定位和裁剪出结果相关区域的干预，无需额外训练即可将最佳检测器性能提升2.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM用于机器人操作结果评估的基准缺乏跨域泛化证据，需要更严格的基准来系统评估VLM在机器人失败检测中的真实能力与局限性。
AI.method: 构建包含2,197次操作尝试的FailBench基准（跨14个公开数据源），其中75%失败自然发生，6个真实世界源来自非失败检测数据集。系统评估13种VLM检测器，并进行错误分析和输入级干预实验（空间定位与裁剪结果相关区域）。
AI.result: 最佳VLM检测器仅达0.77平均平衡准确率；失败检测微调模型一致劣于通用VLM和其预训练基线；性能严重依赖视觉证据类型——物体运动可观测时接近饱和，接触密集装配任务跌至<0.60；存在系统性偏向预测成功的偏差且推理努力无法消除；通过空间定位与裁剪干预使最佳检测器提升2.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VLM在机器人失败检测上的跨域泛化能力仍不足，尤其是在接触密集任务上表现接近随机；微调策略反而损害性能；仅依赖推理增强无法解决模糊证据下的成功偏差，但输入层面的空间定位干预可有效提升检测性能。

title: Spruce: Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made dense retrieval over large document collections a standard building block. Organizations increasingly outsource vector indexes to untrusted clouds, exposing proprietary corpora and user queries. Cryptographic protection is challenging because each query searches corpus-scale state, causing computation, correlated randomness, and communication to grow with the corpus. At million-document scale, a naive secure implementation takes minutes and about 90 GB of communication per query. Even recent optimized systems require 10--22 seconds.
  We propose Spruce (Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings), which co-designs representations with the cryptographic protocol. Spruce learns compact binary codes that preserve candidates for full-precision reranking, replacing corpus-wide embedding scoring with efficient Hamming-distance computation under two-server multi-party computation (MPC). A corpus-calibrated fixed-radius protocol avoids multi-round candidate selection while preserving retrieval quality. Spruce also provides private cluster pruning, which trades minor quality loss for substantially less computation, and a one-core owner-operated dealer that removes cloud OT preprocessing bottlenecks. Across four corpora containing 383K--5.42M documents, Spruce preserves the original search quality with median candidate sets of only 382--1,952. At 10 Gbps inter-server bandwidth, full scans take 0.21--2.97 seconds, $4.8$--$6.7\times$ faster than the closest measured prior work. Private pruning takes 0.06--1.09 seconds, achieves $13.1$--$22.9\times$ speedups, and retains $93.9\%$--$97.3\%$ of full-float NDCG. On the largest corpus, pruning and the dealer jointly improve sustained throughput by $31.5\times$ at 1 Gbps per link.

AI.tldr: Spruce提出了一种可扩展的私有外包检索系统，通过设计紧凑二元编码与两方多方计算（MPC）协议协同工作，取代全精度嵌入的语料库级评分，在百万级文档规模下实现亚秒到数秒级的私有检索，同时保持检索质量。
AI.motivation: RAG使稠密检索成为标准组件，但组织将向量索引外包给不可信云会暴露专有语料库和用户查询。现有加密保护方案因每次查询需处理语料库级状态，导致计算、相关随机性和通信量随语料库规模增长，在百万文档规模下单查询需数分钟和约90GB通信，即使优化的系统也需10-22秒，亟需更高效的隐私保护检索方案。
AI.method: Spruce采用协同设计方案：1）学习紧凑二元编码保留全精度重排序候选，用高效汉明距离计算替代语料库级嵌入评分；2）语料校准的固定半径协议避免多轮候选选择；3）提供私有聚类剪枝牺牲少量质量换取大幅计算减少；4）采用单核所有者运营的dealer消除云OT预处理瓶颈。整体在双服务器MPC架构下运行。
AI.result: 在383K-5.42M文档的四个语料库上，Spruce保持原始搜索质量，候选集中位数仅382-1,952。在10Gbps带宽下全扫描耗时0.21-2.97秒，比最接近的先前工作快4.8-6.7倍；私有剪枝耗时0.06-1.09秒，加速13.1-22.9倍，保留93.9%-97.3%的全浮点NDCG。在最大语料库上，剪枝与dealer在1Gbps/link下将持续吞吐量提升31.5倍。
AI.conclusion: Spruce证明通过协同设计表征学习与密码协议，可以在不牺牲检索质量的前提下实现大规模私有外包检索的实用性能，显著优于现有方法，为隐私保护的RAG部署提供了可行路径。

title: Unifying Conformal Language Tasks with In-Context Ensembles
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/conformal-relevance
summary: Many NLP tasks, such as summarization and extractive question answering, reduce to retrieving relevant content from documents under two constraints: coverage, retaining enough pertinent information to achieve some goal, and conciseness, removing as much irrelevant information as possible. Conformal prediction methods have been used to guarantee coverage, and must be optimized for conciseness through design of a score function. State-of-the-art scoring functions use hand-engineered LLM prompts asking the model to rate the importance of content, but manual prompt engineering is labor-intensive and task-specific. We introduce the Conformal Relevance framework which uses in-context learning example curation and ensembling to create a score function which maintains coverage while improving conciseness with minimal manual input. We demonstrate this framework's application on seven NLP tasks, and also theoretically study the impact of diversity for ensembled conformal scores, giving a complementarity condition that characterizes when ensembling improves worst-case sentence scores, and a saturation bound on ensemble improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Conformal Relevance框架，利用上下文学习的示例筛选和集成方法自动构建评分函数，在维持覆盖率的同时提升简洁性，并在七个NLP任务上验证其有效性。理论上还分析了集成对一致性评分的影响，给出互补性条件和饱和界。
AI.motivation: 许多NLP任务（如摘要、抽取式问答）需要在覆盖率（保留足够信息）和简洁性（去除无关信息）两个约束下从文档中检索相关内容。现有的一致性预测方法依赖人工设计的评分函数（通常基于LLM提示词来评估内容重要性），但手动提示工程费时费力且依赖具体任务。
AI.method: 提出Conformal Relevance框架：(1)利用上下文学习中的示例筛选(curation)自动选择有效示例来构建评分函数；(2)通过集成(ensembling)多个评分函数来提升性能；(3)在理论上推导了互补性条件(complementarity condition)，刻画集成何时能改进最坏情况下的句子得分，以及集成改进的饱和界(saturation bound)。
AI.result: 在七个NLP任务上验证了该框架的有效性，在维持覆盖率的同时相比现有方法提升了简洁性。理论分析揭示了集成策略提升的一致性得分性能的条件与上限。
AI.conclusion: Conformal Relevance框架通过自动化评分函数构建，减少了人工提示工程负担，实现了覆盖率与简洁性的良好平衡，并通过理论分析为集成式一致性评分提供了指导原则。

title: Distilling deep optical flow stereo methods to retrieve dense three-dimensional wind fields
summary: Geostationary atmospheric motion vectors (AMVs) provide the dense horizontal wind vectors (u,v) and heights ingested into data assimilation systems. Traditional AMVs track features using window-based cross-correlation and estimate heights via infrared brightness temperatures paired with numerical weather prediction (NWP) background states, creating a circular dependency that yields inaccurate heights, high computational cost, and sparse retrievals. Stereo winds from GEO-GEO and GEO-LEO geometrically resolve heights from parallax shifts across different poses, eliminating NWP dependence and improving accuracy, but they remain computationally heavy with limited coverage. In this work, we replace window-based tracking in stereo matching with deep optical flow for efficient, improved retrieval. Fine-tuning balances a self-supervised geometric residual loss with supervised radiosonde reconstruction. To eliminate multi-satellite overlap requirements, we distill the stereo teacher into a single-satellite student model. Chi-square and height uncertainties from the teacher are emulated by the student for quality assurance. The student generates winds across full-disk GEO imagery globally. Validation compares stereo and student models against radiosondes, operational AMVs, ERA5 reanalysis, and EarthCARE cloud profiles. Results through triple collocation show that stereo winds improve performance beyond operational AMVs for water vapor bands (6.2, 6.9, and 7.3 μm), wit degradation in the long-wave infrared (11.2 μm) band.

AI.tldr: 本文用深度学习光流替代传统的窗口相关追踪方法，用于从地球静止卫星影像中提取大气运动矢量（AMV）风场。通过自监督几何残差损失与有监督无线电探空重建的微调策略，训练立体匹配风场模型；通过知识蒸馏将多卫星立体教师模型压缩为单卫星学生模型，使全球全圆盘成像（full-disk）影像均可生成风场，并在多个验证数据集上展示了优于业务AMV的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统AMV反演依赖窗口交叉相关跟踪特征，并通过红外亮温配合NWP背景态估计高度，存在循环依赖、高度不准、计算成本高和反演稀疏等问题。立体测量虽能通过视差消除NWP依赖并提升精度，但计算量大且覆盖范围有限。作者希望用高效的深度学习光流替代窗口追踪，并通过知识蒸馏突破多卫星重叠覆盖的限制，实现单卫星大范围高质量的风场反演。
AI.method: (1) 用深度光流替代立体匹配中的窗口追踪，提高立体风场提取效率；(2) 采用自监督几何残差损失与有监督无线电探空重建相结合的微调策略训练模型；(3) 将多卫星立体教师模型蒸馏为单卫星学生模型，消除多卫星重叠要求；(4) 学生模型仿效教师的卡方统计和高度不确定性用于质量控制；(5) 通过三重碰撞（triple collocation）等方法对模型进行验证。
AI.result: 立体风场模型在水汽波段（6.2、6.9和7.3μm）上通过三重碰撞验证优于业务AMV，但在长波红外（11.2μm）波段出现性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度光流和知识蒸馏的AMV反演框架可提升水汽波段立体风的精度和效率，并实现单卫星覆盖的全球风场反演，但长波红外波段的退化表明仍需进一步改进该波段的高度分配或跟踪策略。

title: NeoRed: A Knowledge-Logic-Alignment Multimodal Large Language Model for Neonatal Respiratory Disease Diagnosis
summary: Neonatal respiratory diseases are a major cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality, posing substantial challenges in clinical practice. Despite recent advances, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face two key limitations in neonatal diagnosis: (1) domain gap arising from predominantly adult training data; (2) insufficient integration of multidimensional clinical context for accurate diagnosis. To address these challenges, we collect two real-world clinical datasets (NeoCXR and NeoCXR-EV) and propose NeoRed, to the best of our knowledge, the first MLLM tailored for neonatal respiratory disease, filling the gap in neonatal diagnostic reports generation. To enhance joint diagnosis from heterogeneous clinical context and chest X-rays, we design a novel Knowledge-Logic-Alignment (KLA) framework which constrains model behavior from three perspectives: 1) Knowledge Prior Injection (KPI) incorporates neonatologist-inspired diagnostic priors into multimodal representations, guiding disease-specific attention across modalities; 2) Diagnostic Logic Constraint (DLC) aligns the semantics of generated reports with multimodal diagnostic logic; and 3) Visual Semantic Alignment (VSA) establishes semantic correspondence between visual features and imaging conclusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeoRed enables accurate neonatal diagnostic reports generation, achieving ROUGE-L of 53.29% and Clinical Efficacy F1 score of 65.19% on NeoCXR, outperforming existing MLLMs. NeoRed also preserves competitive report generation performance on adult benchmarks (MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray). Datasets will be available upon application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NeoRed，据作者所知这是首个专为新生儿呼吸系统疾病定制的多模态大语言模型（MLLM），通过创新的知识-逻辑-对齐（KLA）框架解决新生儿诊断中的领域差距和多维临床上下文整合不足两大问题，在新生儿数据集上取得了优于现有MLLM的诊断报告生成性能，同时在成人基准上保持了竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 新生儿呼吸系统疾病是新生儿发病率和死亡率的主要原因，临床实践面临巨大挑战。现有MLLM存在两个关键局限：一是训练数据以成人为主导致领域差距（domain gap）；二是对多维临床上下文（如X光片与临床信息）的整合不足，难以支撑准确诊断。因此需要专门为新生儿诊断场景定制MLLM。
AI.method: 作者收集了两个真实临床数据集（NeoCXR和NeoCXR-EV），提出NeoRed MLLM，并设计了知识-逻辑-对齐（KLA）框架，从三个视角约束模型行为：1）知识先验注入（KPI），将新生儿科医生的诊断先验融入多模态表征，引导跨模态的疾病特定注意力；2）诊断逻辑约束（DLC），使生成报告语义与多模态诊断逻辑对齐；3）视觉语义对齐（VSA），建立视觉特征与影像结论之间的语义对应关系。
AI.result: 在NeoCXR数据集上，NeoRed实现了53.29%的ROUGE-L和65.19%的临床效能F1分数，优于现有MLLM；在成人基准（MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray）上仍保持具有竞争力的报告生成性能。
AI.conclusion: NeoRed作为首个新生儿呼吸系统疾病专用的MLLM，成功弥合了新生儿诊断报告生成的空白，证明了结合专业知识先验与多模态对齐约束可以显著提升新生儿诊断的准确性，同时不牺牲在成人领域的泛化能力。

title: QLAUN: A Research-Oriented, Robust, Agile, Modular, and Affordable Torque-Controlled Quadruped Robot
comment: Extended abstract presented at IEEE ICRA@40, Rotterdam, Netherlands, September 2024. 2 pages, 1 figure
summary: QLAUN Bot (Quad-Legged Adaptive Unmanned Navigator Robot) is a torque-controlled quadruped robot that is research-oriented, cost-effective, and aimed at achieving simultaneous robustness and agility while being completely 3D-printed. It is a quadruped robot that is aimed at empowering robotics research at universities and research institutes in Lebanon and the MENA region. Using a novel electronics-free leg design strategy, we present a modular robot with interchangeable and easily replaceable legs. The 15 kg robot possesses 12 DoF (Degrees-of-Freedom) with three per leg, each paired with a completely 3D-printed Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuator that consists of a brushless DC motor and a low-ratio gearbox transmission that is connected to a belt transmission system for significantly increasing the torque outputs at the joints. We present legs that have decoupled hip and knee actuators to improve the overall modularity of the robot. QLAUN is almost completely 3D-printed using polylactic acid (PLA) and assembled using off-the-shelf parts to create a robust, agile, and affordable robot for legged robot locomotion research. The legs possess joints with wide ranges of motion, including a continuous hip flexion-extension joint. A compliant foot, printed using TPU-95A is also implemented for alleviating hard impacts and handling terrain uncertainties. This extended abstract aims to introduce QLAUN, a novel platform for robotics research, emphasizing the design concepts and principles that underpin its development to the academic and research communities in the field of robotics.

AI.tldr: QLAUN是一个面向研究与教学用途的、几乎完全3D打印的扭矩控制四足机器人平台，采用模块化可互换腿设计和自制准直驱（QDD）执行器，旨在以低成本实现鲁棒性与敏捷性，服务于黎巴嫩及MENA地区的机器人研究。QLAUN是一个面向研究与教学用途的、几乎完全3D打印的扭矩控制四足机器人平台，采用模块化可互换腿设计和自制准直驱（QDD）执行器，旨在以低成本实现鲁棒性与敏捷性，服务于黎巴嫩及MENA地区的机器人研究。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在为黎巴嫩及中东和北非（MENA）地区的大学和研究机构提供一个研究导向、成本效益高且兼具鲁棒性与敏捷性的四足机器人平台，以赋能腿式机器人运动研究并填补该地区高端机器人研究平台的空白。
AI.method: 采用全新的无电子器件的腿设计方案，实现模块化与可互换的腿部设计；每条腿拥有3个自由度（共12 DoF），每个关节配备完全3D打印的准直驱（QDD）执行器，由无刷直流电机、低减速比齿轮箱和皮带传动系统组成以提升关节扭矩输出；腿部采用髋关节和膝关节解耦设计以增强模块性；机器人主体使用PLA材料几乎完全3D打印，采用商用标准零件组装，并配备TPU-95A打印的柔性足部以缓解硬冲击和处理地形不确定性。
AI.result: 成功设计并构建了一台重15kg、12自由度的3D打印四足机器人QLAUN，其关节具有广泛运动范围（包括连续的髋关节屈伸关节），实现了高度模块化、低成本且易于更换零部件的设计目标，为腿式机器人研究提供了可复现的平台。
AI.conclusion: 该文介绍了QLAUN这一新型机器人研究平台及其核心设计概念与原则，旨在向机器人领域的学术界和研究界推广这一经济实惠且功能强劲的四足平台，促进低成本腿式机器人研究的发展。

title: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies for Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
comment: Accepted to Pacific Graphics 2026 (conference track). Project page: https://sorenzhang574.github.io/Laplacian-GS/
summary: A key bottleneck in 3D Gaussian Splatting training is the continual growth of Gaussian primitives, which increases optimization cost and slows convergence, especially at high resolutions. We propose Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies, a simple yet efficient 3DGS scheme that combines Laplacian image decomposition with coarse-to-fine, frequency-staged training. After fitting lower-frequency structure, we archive the corresponding Gaussian field so that subsequent fields can optimize higher-frequency residuals without carrying the full primitive burden, and we compose the rendered components in the image domain via a Laplacian-style reconstruction at inference time. This design reduces the number of active Gaussians during training, thereby lowering optimization overhead and accelerating training. The proposed scheme is plug-and-play and orthogonal to prior 3DGS accelerations: it can be directly combined with strong backbones such as Taming-3DGS and FastGS to improve training speed with competitive reconstruction quality. It achieves average speedups of 1.73x and 1.21x at 1K setting, and 1.74x and 1.33x at 4K setting on Taming-3DGS and FastGS, with larger gains on more challenging scenes and increasingly pronounced benefits at higher resolutions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为"拉普拉斯频率层次"（Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies）的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）训练加速方案，通过将拉普拉斯图像分解与由粗到细的频率分阶段训练相结合，在高频残差优化时归档已收敛的低频高斯场，从而减少训练中活跃高斯原语数量、降低优化开销并加速训练。该方案即插即用，可与现有3DGS加速框架正交组合。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射训练的主要瓶颈在于高斯原语数量持续增长，导致优化成本增加、收敛变慢，尤其在更高分辨率下问题更为突出。
AI.method: 1）采用拉普拉斯图像分解思想，将训练分为由粗到细的频率分阶段过程；2）低频频段拟合完成后，将对应高斯场归档/冻结，使后续阶段仅优化更高频的残差，避免携带完整原语集合；3）推理阶段在图像域通过拉普拉斯式重建合成各渲染组件。
AI.result: 与Taming-3DGS和FastGS两个强基线结合时，在1K设置下分别获得1.73x和1.21x的平均加速，4K设置下分别获得1.74x和1.33x的加速；在更具挑战性的场景和高分辨率下增益更为显著，同时保持具有竞争力的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方案是一种简单高效、即插即用且与现有3DGS加速方法正交的训练加速策略，通过减少训练过程中的活跃高斯数，在保持重建质量的同时显著提升训练速度，且分辨率越高收益越大。

title: Privacy, Robustness, and Fairness Trade-offs in Federated Intrusion Detection: Geometric Indistinguishability at the Aggregation Interface
summary: Federated learning enables privacy-conscious collaboration for network intrusion detection without centralizing sensitive traffic data, yet its deployment in operational environments must simultaneously satisfy three competing requirements: formal differential privacy guaranties, tolerance to Byzantine-adversarial participants, and reliable detection coverage across severely imbalanced attack categories. Existing literature treats these properties as independently composable, an assumption that this paper challenges both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we study how these requirements interact in class-imbalanced federated NIDS and introduce geometric indistinguishability as a conceptual lens for a regime in which privacy-induced dispersion in client updates can make minority-class signals harder for robust aggregation to preserve. Using UNSW-NB15 as a case study, we evaluate DP-SGD combined with coordinate-wise median under label-flip and model-poisoning attacks, with threat coverage assessed across attack categories. Our results provide initial evidence that the joint use of privacy noise and robust aggregation can disproportionately degrade detection of rare attacks relative to majority classes. We also show that part of the observed collapse under strong privacy can arise from training miscalibration, while a residual performance floor may remain for ultra-rare categories even after epsilon-dependent tuning. These findings motivate studying privacy, robustness, and rare-attack coverage jointly rather than as independently composable properties, and suggest that aggregation-aware modeling and sample-aware evaluation are promising directions for trustworthy federated NIDS.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦学习在网络入侵检测（NIDS）中同时满足差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒性和不平衡攻击类别检测覆盖率这三个相互竞争的需求时，隐私与鲁棒性并非独立可组合的问题。实验表明DP噪声与鲁棒聚合的联合使用会不成比例地降低罕见攻击的检测性能，部分崩溃源于训练误校准，且超稀有类别存在剩余性能下限。
AI.motivation: 现有文献将差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒性和不平衡类别的检测覆盖率视为可独立组合的属性，但该假设在联邦NIDS实际部署中缺乏理论及实证验证。作者旨在挑战这一独立性假设，揭示隐私诱导的客户端更新分散如何使少数类信号更难被鲁棒聚合保留。
AI.method: 以几何不可区分性（geometric indistinguishability）为概念框架，以UNSW-NB15数据集为案例，将DP-SGD与坐标中位数聚合（coordinate-wise median）结合，在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击下进行实验，并按攻击类别评估威胁覆盖率。
AI.result: 初步证据表明，隐私噪声与鲁棒聚合的联合使用会不成比例地降低稀有攻击相对多数类别的检测性能；强隐私条件下观察到的性能崩溃部分源于训练误校准，而即使在依赖epsilon调优后，超稀有类别仍可能保留性能下限。
AI.conclusion: 隐私、鲁棒性和罕见攻击覆盖率应作为联合属性进行研究，而非独立可组合的要素。聚合感知建模和样本感知评估是有前景的未来方向，有助于构建可信的联邦NIDS。

title: SHELF: A Synthetic Harness for Multi-Task Bibliographic Benchmarking
comment: 17 pages, 15 tables. Code available at https://github.com/mjbommar/shelf-benchmark ; data available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mjbommar/SHELF
summary: Libraries and archives manage large collections with limited staff and computing budgets, yet common benchmarks do not systematically test their bibliographic work. They need to know which methods work for their tasks and what those methods require to run. SHELF, the Synthetic Harness for Evaluating LLM Fitness, addresses this gap. It is a Python system that turns labelled taxonomies, writing specifications, and a generation budget into controlled benchmark data and evaluation tasks. This first release contains 62,899 model-written documents based on Library of Congress vocabularies, with tasks for classification, clustering, retrieval, pair classification, and instruction retrieval. We compare TF, TF-IDF, BM25, popular encoders, and, on subject classification only, zero-shot decoders; each method appears only on tasks that support it. Subject classification reaches 0.8887, while genre-form classification reaches only 0.2605, and several pair and clustering tasks remain near chance. Sparse methods remain competitive on classification, while TF-IDF is the fastest measured arm in the subject timing experiment. SHELF also varies bibliographic facets independently and can generate new, verifiably unseen documents after a model's training cutoff. Comparisons with LCSHBench and Project Gutenberg show that model rankings transfer more reliably than absolute scores, but SHELF scores do not estimate accuracy on production catalogue data. We release all source code and data under permissive licenses on GitHub and Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: SHELF是一个Python系统，通过标记好的词表、写作规范和生成预算，合成受控的基准数据来系统评估大语言模型在图书馆与档案编目工作上的表现。首个版本包含62,899篇基于美国国会图书馆词表生成的文档，涵盖分类、聚类、检索等多种任务。实验表明主（subject）分类F值达0.8887，而体裁-形式（genre-form）分类仅0.2605，部分成对与聚类任务接近随机水平。传统稀疏方法在分类上仍具竞争力，且TF-IDF速度最快。
AI.motivation: 图书馆和档案馆在大规模馆藏管理上受限于人力和计算资源，但现有基准测试未能系统覆盖其编目工作场景，导致从业人员难以判断哪些方法适合自身任务、以及这些方法的运行需求。
AI.method: 提出SHELF框架：利用带标签的分类词表、写作规范及生成预算，合成可控的基准文档与评测任务。当前版本基于Library of Congress词表生成62,899篇文档，构建主题分类、体裁-形式分类、聚类、检索、成对分类和指令检索等任务，并在各任务上对比TF、TF-IDF、BM25、流行编码器及零样本解码模型。
AI.result: 主题分类F值达0.8887，体裁-形式分类仅0.2605，部分成对与聚类任务接近随机水平；稀疏方法（TF-IDF等）在分类任务上仍具竞争力，TF-IDF在主题分类计时实验中速度最快。与LCSHBench和Project Gutenberg对比显示，模型排名一致性优于绝对分数迁移，但SHELF分数不能直接估计生产目录数据的准确率。
AI.conclusion: SHELF为图书馆与档案馆的LLM应用提供了一个可复现、可扩展的合成基准框架，能独立控制编目要素并生成模型训练截止后未见的新文档。代码与数据以宽松许可证在GitHub和Hugging Face上公开。

title: Scaling Laws, Tabular Data and Actuarial Ratemaking Models
summary: Scaling laws in modern deep learning describe how held-out loss improves as model capacity, training data, and compute increase, often following power-law trends. We investigate whether analogous scaling regularities arise in actuarial ratemaking, where data are tabular, heterogeneous, and noisy, and where classical models such as GLMs remain strong baselines. Using a real-world motor insurance portfolio, we train models from different families across increasing fractions of the training data and multiple random seeds, evaluating out-of-sample Poisson deviance, a likelihood-based loss for Poisson count predictions in which lower values indicate better held-out fit. We find that all model families improve with additional data, but scaling exponents differ substantially: TabM exhibits markedly stronger data scaling than purely supervised tabular Transformers and standard MLP baselines. Transformer variants show weak parameter scaling unless augmented with additional inductive biases (TabM-style adaptation or self-supervision). These results provide quantitative guidance on model selection by data regime and suggest that effective scaling on actuarial tabular tasks depends on architecture and loss function objective design, with simple increases in Transformer size providing limited gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了深度学习中的尺度律是否适用于精算费率厘定（actuarial ratemaking）这一表格数据场景。通过在真实机动车保险组合上对不同模型家族（TabM、Transformer、MLP等）进行训练数据比例和数据量的缩放实验，发现所有模型随数据增加均有改善，但缩放指数差异显著：TabM的数据缩放能力明显强于纯监督表格Transformer和标准MLP；仅增大Transformer参数量带来的收益有限，除非辅以TabM式适配或自监督等归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习中的尺度律（scaling laws）揭示了模型容量、训练数据与算力如何按幂律关系改善损失，但这一规律是否适用于精算费率厘定这类表格、异构且噪声大的数据场景尚不清楚，而GLM等经典模型在此领域仍是强基线。作者希望通过探索该问题，为表格数据的模型选择提供数据规模相关的量化指导。
AI.method: 使用真实机动车保险组合数据集，训练多个不同家族（TabM、表格Transformer、标准MLP及变体）的模型，在递增的训练数据比例和多个随机种子下进行评估，以泊松偏差（Poisson deviance）作为似然型评价指标衡量样本外拟合。通过比较不同模型族的缩放指数，量化数据规模和参数规模对各模型性能改善的影响。
AI.result: 所有模型家族的数据增加都能改善性能，但缩放指数差异显著：TabM的数据缩放能力明显强于纯监督表格Transformer和标准MLP基线；Transformer变体在缺少归纳偏置增强（TabM式适配或自监督）时参数量缩放表现较弱，单独增加Transformer规模带来的收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 精算表格任务上的有效缩放依赖于架构设计和损失函数目标设计，单纯增大Transformer模型尺寸不能带来显著增益；研究为不同数据规模下选择模型提供了定量依据，表明数据缩放表现可作为模型选择的重要参考维度。

title: Feature Reconfiguration With Visual Prior for Medical Lesion Segmentation
summary: Lesion segmentation in medical images plays a critical role in clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite significant advances, lesion segmentation remains challenging due to two major factors: (1) complex background interference; (2) diverse lesion morphology. Existing encoder-decoder based methods mainly focus on enhancing feature extraction or redesigning decoding strategies. However, they lack early prior guidance and feature reconfiguration during the encoding stage, limiting their effectiveness in handling these challenges. To address these limitations, we propose FreNet, a feature reconfiguration framework with visual priors, which performs pixel-level reconfiguration before encoding and feature-level reconfiguration during encoding for precise medical lesion segmentation. To suppress background responses, we propose an Implicit Prior Neural Network (IPNN), which models a continuous spatial field and leverages visual prior from SAM to reconfigure input image before encoding stage. To better handle diverse lesion morphology, we design a Dual-domain Feature Reconfiguration (DFR) module to progressively reconfigure backbone features during encoding stage. Within DFR, the Frequency Decoupling Module (FDM) decouples backbone features in frequency domain to enhance foreground-background discriminability, while the Spatial Localization Module (SLM) spatially relocates and improving spatial stability after frequency decoupling. Extensive experiments on 9 medical image segmentation benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that FreNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. On the challenging ETIS dataset, our method achieves Dice improvements of 5.0% over SOTA method and 7.2% over SAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FreNet，一个带有视觉先验的特征重配置框架，用于精确的医学病灶分割。该框架在编码前通过隐式先验神经网络（IPNN）进行像素级重配置以抑制背景干扰，在编码阶段通过双域特征重配置（DFR）模块逐步重配置主干网络特征以处理多样病灶形态。实验表明FreNet在9个跨三种成像模态的医学分割基准上显著优于SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有编码器-解码器方法主要侧重于增强特征提取或重新设计解码策略，但在编码阶段缺乏早期先验引导和特征重配置，限制了其处理复杂背景干扰和多样化病灶形态这两大挑战的能力。
AI.method: FreNet包含两个核心组件：(1) 隐式先验神经网络（IPNN），在编码前建模连续空间场并利用SAM视觉先验对输入图像进行像素级重配置，以抑制背景响应；(2) 双域特征重配置（DFR）模块，在编码阶段逐步重配置主干特征，其内部包含频率解耦模块（FDM）通过频域解耦增强前景-背景可区分性，以及空间定位模块（SLM）在频率解耦后进行空间重定位以改善空间稳定性。
AI.result: 在涵盖三种成像模态的9个医学图像分割基准上的大量实验表明，FreNet显著优于最先进（SOTA）方法。在具有挑战性的ETIS数据集上，该方法较SOTA方法Dice提升5.0%，较SAM提升7.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在编码前后分别引入像素级和特征级特征重配置，FreNet有效解决了医学病灶分割中复杂背景干扰和病灶形态多样两大难题，在多个基准上确立了显著优势。

title: Local Path Planning and Obstacle Avoidance for an Omnicopter Platform
summary: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly operate in cluttered environments where global planners such as RRT* are not directly deployable at control rates. This paper presents a real-time local planning and obstacle avoidance module for an omnidirectional multirotor (omnicopter) by extending the Dynamic Window Approach to six degrees of freedom (6D-DWA). Our method achieves real-time feasibility through (i) local-map voxelisation, (ii) a compact sphere-based approximation of the vehicle geometry, and (iii) adaptive velocity sampling in the 6D search space. To improve reactivity to unknown obstacles, we introduce a context-aware "Agile Mode" that adjusts scoring weights online to trade-off between goal progress, clearance, and heading/facing constraints during evasive manoeuvres. We evaluate our approach in simulation across computational stress tests, dense-waypoint path tracking, and static/unknown obstacle scenarios. Our planner runs consistently within a 0.2s control loop, tracks waypoint-dense global paths with < 0.1m average cross-track error and 13deg average heading error, and avoids collisions in static environments. For unknown obstacle avoidance, Agile Mode achieves 79.3% success for an off-centre obstacle and 41.4% for a centred obstacle, highlighting both the effectiveness of adaptive weighting and remaining limitations in highly constrained geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将动态窗口法(DWA)扩展至六自由度(6D-DWA)的实时局部规划与避障模块，用于全向多旋翼无人机(omnicopter)，通过局部体素化地图、球体几何近似和自适应速度采样实现200ms控制周期内的实时可行性，并引入上下文感知的"Agile Mode"在线调整评分权重以增强对未知障碍的反应能力。
AI.motivation: 自主无人机在杂乱环境中运行时，RRT*等全局规划器无法直接以控制速率部署，需要能够在六自由度全向多旋翼上实现实时局部规划和避障的方法。
AI.method: 将动态窗口法(DWA)从传统的平面/三自由度扩展至六自由度(6D-DWA)，通过三项关键技术实现实时可行性：(i)局部地图体素化以加速碰撞检测；(ii)基于紧凑球体的飞行器几何近似以简化避碰计算；(iii)在六维搜索空间中采用自适应速度采样以减少计算复杂度。此外引入上下文感知的"Agile Mode"机制，在线调整评分权重以在机动规避过程中权衡目标进度、安全间隙和航向/朝向约束。
AI.result: 在仿真中，规划器稳定运行于0.2秒控制周期内；在稠密航点全局路径跟踪中平均横向误差<0.1m，平均航向误差13度；静态环境避障成功。未知障碍场景下，Agile Mode对偏心障碍的成功率为79.3%，对中心障碍为41.4%，既验证了自适应加权的有效性，也揭示了高度受限几何构型下仍存在的局限。
AI.conclusion: 6D-DWA方法在计算效率、跟踪精度与静态避障方面表现良好；Agile Mode能提升对未知障碍的反应能力，但对中心对称的高约束障碍场景仍有改进空间。

title: PointGT: Simultaneous Geometry and Texture Editing for Point-Based Representations
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zvict.github.io/pointgt/
summary: We present PointGT, a point-based 3D representation that enables simultaneous editing of object geometry and appearance. Existing reconstruction and view synthesis techniques produce volumetric 3D representations that are high-quality and photorealistic, but are difficult to edit. In particular, recent efforts to enable texture editing for 3D Gaussian Splatting representations are not compatible with geometry edits and deformations. Our method combines a point-based representation that is well-suited for geometry deformations with a learned UV mapping technique that enables high-resolution texture editing. We show that PointGT enables fine-grained editing of both geometry and texture in point-based neural representations with high rendering quality.

AI.tldr: PointGT是一种基于点的3D表示方法，通过将点云表示与学习的UV映射技术相结合，实现对象几何与外观（纹理）的同时精细编辑，并保持高渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的重建和视图合成技术（如3D Gaussian Splatting）虽然能产生高质量、照片级逼真的体积3D表示，但难以编辑。特别是，支持3D Gaussian Splatting纹理编辑的方法与几何编辑及形变不兼容。因此需要一种既能支持几何形变又支持纹理编辑的统一表示方法。
AI.method: PointGT结合两种关键技术：（1）基于点的3D表示，天然适合几何形变与编辑；（2）学习的UV映射技术，用于实现高分辨率纹理编辑。通过将两者结合，使点云神经表示同时支持精细的纹理编辑和几何编辑。
AI.result: 实验表明PointGT能够在基于点的神经表示上实现几何和纹理的细粒度编辑，同时保持高渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: PointGT提供了一种统一的点级3D表示方案，解决了现有体积表示方法中纹理编辑与几何编辑不兼容的问题，在提升可编辑性的同时维持高保真渲染效果。

title: The Native-Signature Boundary in Post-Quantum Distributed Authorization
summary:
Post-quantum signature migration poses a distinct systems problem when authorization is distributed among multiple parties. In native threshold signing, the signature algorithm may determine key generation, share state, preprocessing, interaction, combination, refresh, and recovery. Architectures that evaluate threshold policy outside the native signing relation can reduce this coupling, but their authorization evidence is not accepted by an unchanged native verifier unless a trusted complete-key signer translates approval into a native signature.
  This paper organizes that design boundary through three properties: native-signature compatibility, unilateral-signing resistance, and threshold-layer agility. We classify specialized threshold signatures, generic MPC signing, distributed hash-based constructions, programmable multisignature and dual-gate authorization, and threshold-authorized HSM signing. A migration impact surface identifies which components change with the signature algorithm. Across the surveyed families, no design simultaneously provides native output, unilateral-signing resistance, and threshold-layer agility. This is an architectural tension, not an impossibility claim, and it clarifies why a replaceable API alone does not make distributed authorization cryptographically agile.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨后量子签名迁移中的分布式授权系统设计问题，提出三个关键属性（原生签名兼容性、单方签名抵抗性、阈值层敏捷性），并通过分类学方法梳理五类阈值签名方案，揭示不存在同时满足三个属性的设计——这是一个架构性张力而非不可能性结论。
AI.motivation: 后量子签名迁移面临分布式多参与方授权场景下的独特系统难题：原生阈值签名中签名算法决定了密钥生成、份额状态、预处理、交互、组合、刷新和恢复等全链路，而将阈值策略外包到原生签名关系之外又会因缺少原生验证器支持而无法被标准验证者接受（除非引入可信完整密钥签名者进行翻译）。作者希望通过形式化设计边界来澄清这一架构冲突。
AI.method: 论文通过三个属性（native-signature compatibility、unilateral-signing resistance、threshold-layer agility）组织设计边界，对五类方案进行分类：专用阈值签名、通用MPC签名、分布式哈希基构造、可编程多重签名与双门授权、阈值授权HSM签名；并定义迁移影响面（migration impact surface）来标识哪些组件会随签名算法变化。
AI.result: 在综述的全部方案族中，没有任何一种设计能同时提供原生输出、单方签名抵抗性和阈值层敏捷性。这表明三项属性之间存在固有的架构张力，而非简单的技术实现问题。
AI.conclusion: 该架构张力虽非不可能性定理，但解释了为何仅依赖可替换API无法使分布式授权具备密码学层面的敏捷性——分布式授权系统的密码学敏捷性需要更根本的架构设计考量。

title: Large Language Models in Resolving Contextual Knowledge Conflicts
summary: Most prior works focused on conflicts between an LLM's internal parametric knowledge and externally provided context. In contrast, we investigate how LLMs handle conflicts that arise within contextual knowledge itself. We introduce a taxonomy of six types of contextual conflicts (factual, inferential, temporal, granularity, perspective, and ambiguity) and contribute a comprehensive dataset ContextConflict for this setting. The dataset contains 5,781 samples, covers both reasoning and summarization tasks, and includes both explicit contradictions and implicit conflicts that require multi-step reasoning. Experiments on nine LLMs show that current models still fall short in resolving contextual knowledge conflicts. We further provide mechanistic interpretability insights into how LLMs process such conflicts, revealing their latent awareness of conflicts and the representational geometry underlying conflict processing. In addition, our analysis uncovers a consistent model bias towards earlier evidence, and this positional preference serves as a key obstacle to effective conflict resolution. Motivated by these findings, we further propose a simple training-free, label-free steering method that steers activations to encourage a more comprehensive incorporation of evidences for better conflict resolution. On our dataset, the method consistently improves accuracy on reasoning tasks and generates higher-quality, more balanced summaries for summarization tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究LLM处理"上下文内部矛盾"（而非参数知识与外部上下文之间的矛盾）的能力，提出六类上下文冲突分类法，构建了包含5,781个样本的ContextConflict数据集，涵盖推理与摘要任务及显式/隐式冲突。实验表明九个LLM在解决此类冲突上表现不足，并揭示模型对早期证据存在位置偏置。作者提出一种无需训练、无需标签的激活引导方法，可提升推理准确率与摘要质量。
AI.motivation: 以往研究聚焦于LLM内部参数知识与外部提供上下文之间的冲突，却忽略了冲突可能发生在上下文信息内部本身。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统研究LLM在处理上下文内部知识冲突时的能力与机理。
AI.method: (1) 提出六类上下文冲突分类法：事实性、推断性、时间性、粒度、视角和歧义；(2) 构建ContextConflict数据集，含5,781个样本，覆盖推理与摘要任务，包含显式矛盾和需多步推理的隐式冲突；(3) 在九个LLM上进行实验评估；(4) 进行机械可解释性分析，揭示LLM如何感知和处理冲突及其表征几何结构；(5) 提出一种训练-free、标签-free的激活引导方法，通过操纵激活方向促使模型更全面地融合多方证据以解决冲突。
AI.result: 实验发现九个当前LLM在解决上下文知识冲突上仍不理想。机械可解释性分析揭示了LLM对冲突存在潜在意识及相应的表征几何特征。分析还发现模型对较早出现的证据存在一致偏置，该位置偏好是有效冲突解决的关键障碍。所提出的激活引导方法在推理任务上一致提升了准确率，并在摘要任务中生成更高质量、更均衡的摘要。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在上下文内部冲突处理上仍有显著不足，位置偏置是核心障碍。基于机制的激活引导方法（无需训练且无需标签）可有效缓解该问题，为未来提升LLM冲突解决能力提供了可解释且实用的方向。

title: Kernel Reboot: Breaking the Boundaries of Neural Tangent Kernels for Neural Fields
comment: Published in IEEE TPAMI, vol. 48, no. 9, pp. 10940-10957, Sep. 2026. Author version adds related-work references and biography updates; Figures 12 and 13 were regenerated from the same locked hyperparameter sweep. Tabulated results, reported best points, scientific claims, and conclusions are unchanged
summary: Neural fields (NFs) map continuous coordinates to signals such as color or density, but fast high-quality reconstruction from sparse observations remains difficult. Classical Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regression gives closed-form fits, yet it is fundamentally linear and cannot accumulate reusable task priors. We develop three algorithms that address these gaps. NTK-KIP learns a distilled support set of coordinates (and optional labels) so that a finite NTK can inpaint large missing regions from little observed data, yielding a compact non-linear representation instead of a raw kernel solve. MetaQuill meta-learns a shared initialization for an INR so that new scenes can be adapted by updating only a small task-specific weight offset, which provides true feature learning and a reusable prior. Finally, MetaQuill-KIP fuses both ideas: it seeds the task with a KIP-style non-linear warm start, then refines only that small offset around the meta-learned initialization. MetaQuill-KIP achieves high-PSNR reconstructions and semantically plausible inpainting under very sparse observations, while requiring only lightweight per-instance adaptation, whereas diffusion-style baselines typically depend on large pretrained generative priors and costly per-image tuning. This shows that NTK-driven neural fields can be made both non-linear and meta-learnable, narrowing the gap between analytic kernels and practical few-shot reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种算法解决神经场（NF）从稀疏观测中快速高质量重建的问题：NTK-KIP通过蒸馏支持集坐标实现非线性补全、MetaQuill通过元学习共享初始化实现可复用先验的特徵学习，以及融合两者的MetaQuill-KIP算法，在极稀疏观测下实现高PSNR重建和语义合理的修复，同时只需轻量级的逐实例适配。
AI.motivation: 神经场将连续坐标映射为信号（如颜色或密度），但从稀疏观测中进行快速高质量重建仍然困难。经典NTK回归虽能给出闭式解，但其本质上是线性的，无法累积可复用的任务先验，限制了其在实际少样本重建场景中的应用。
AI.method: 提出三种算法：(1) NTK-KIP：学习一个蒸馏支持集（坐标及可选标签），使有限NTK能从小量观测数据中修复大范围缺失区域，得到紧凑的非线性表示；(2) MetaQuill：为INR元学习一个共享初始化，通过仅更新小的任务特定权重偏移量来适配新场景，实现真正的特征学习和可复用先验；(3) MetaQuill-KIP：融合两者，先用KIP风格的非线性热启动为任务播种，再围绕元学习初始化仅细化该小偏移量。
AI.result: MetaQuill-KIP在极稀疏观测下实现高PSNR重建和语义合理的修复，仅需轻量级逐实例适配，而扩散式基线通常依赖大型预训练生成先验和高成本的逐图像调优。
AI.conclusion: NTK驱动的神经场可以被同时改造为非线性和可元学习的，缩小了解析核方法与实用少样本重建之间的差距。

title: Dalek: A Constructive Agent Machine
summary:
We present Dalek, a closed machine designed for agents that realizes self-maintenance, self-evolution, self-reproduction, and self-organization on any substrate satisfying a general host contract. The machine is built from three primitives---actors, messages, and channels. Four obligations---a host boundary, a construction language, admissible transitions, and rule heredity---give its boundary, identity, and closure a structural basis.
  Von Neumann's 1948 self-reproducing automaton supplies a hereditary constructional core: a self-description together with a constructor, a copier, and a controller. Dalek combines this core with the four obligations and rederives its medium for a text-and-message agent substrate, adding explicit structures for boundary, identity, history, and growth. A large language model and a compiler occupy the payload position and form a general capability producer. New capabilities are authored, compiled, installed into the description, and inherited by descendants. The same path produces the machine's own organs and even its runtime, closing heredity and evolution within the machine.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Dalek，一个封闭机器学习架构，基于 actors、messages、channels 三种原语实现自我维护、自我进化、自我复制和自我组织。它融合 Von Neumann 自复制自动机的遗传建构核心与四个义务（宿主边界、构造语言、允许转换、规则遗传），允许 LLM 与编译器作为能力产生器位于载荷位置，使新能力可被编写、编译并继承给后代。
AI.motivation: 探索如何设计一个真正意义上"封闭"且能够实现自主演化（自维护、自进化、自繁殖、自组织）的代理系统，为代理赋予结构性的边界、身份与封闭性，而非仅在功能层面模拟。
AI.method: 提出 Dalek 架构：由三种原语（actor、messages、channels）构建，以四个义务（宿主边界、构造语言、允许转换、规则遗传）提供边界与身份的结构基础。借鉴 Von Neumann 自复制自动机的核心（自描述+构造器+复制器+控制器），在该文本与消息型代理宿主上重新推导底层介质，并将 LLM 与编译器置于载荷位置充当通用能力产生器。
AI.result: 证明了新能力可通过"编写-编译-安装到描述-被后代继承"的路径在系统中生成；同一路径还能产生系统自身器官甚至运行时，从而在机器内部将遗传与进化闭环。
AI.conclusion: Dalek 实现了在满足通用宿主合约的任何基底上，一个可自维护、自进化、自复制、自组织的封闭代理机器，将遗传性、身份与增长等概念以显式结构落地。

title: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Post-training VLA policies typically rely on supervised fine-tuning with costly expert demonstrations or reinforcement learning with expensive and potentially unstable real-world exploration. World models offer a promising alternative by evaluating candidate behaviors through imagined futures, yet effective post-training requires more than accurate prediction: imagination must be scheduled where it is useful, bounded within reliable horizons, and translated into trustworthy policy supervision. In robotic manipulation, the value of imagination varies substantially across execution stages, while extended rollouts can accumulate prediction errors and introduce unreliable learning signals. We introduce WISE (World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models), a unified framework that coordinates when and how world-model imagination is used during policy refinement. WISE selectively invokes imagination at interaction-relevant states, performs bounded multi-view rollouts, evaluates candidate futures using progress and completion signals, and uses their relative outcomes to refine actions generated from real interaction contexts. Extensive experiments with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse manipulation tasks while reducing GPU computation time by approximately 80% compared with full imagination. Real-world evaluations further show substantial gains in robustness and generalization under diverse real-world distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: WISE是一个统一的框架，通过世界模型引导的想象力调度来高效后训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，在π₀和π₀.₅上均取得一致改进，并将GPU计算时间降低了约80%。
AI.motivation: 后训练VLA策略通常依赖昂贵的专家示范（监督微调）或代价高昂且可能不稳定的真实世界探索（强化学习）。世界模型虽是替代方案，但有效的后训练不仅需要准确预测，还需要在有用的地方调度想象力、限制在可靠的预测范围（horizon）内，并将其转化为可信的策略监督信号。在机器人操作中，想象力的价值随执行阶段变化显著，而延长rollout会累积预测误差并引入不可靠的学习信号。
AI.method: WISE框架协调了世界模型想象力在后训练中的使用时机与方式：(1) 在交互关键（interaction-relevant）状态选择性触发想象力；(2) 执行有界的多视角（multi-view）rollout；(3) 使用进展（progress）和完成（completion）信号评估候选的未来状态；(4) 利用候选未来的相对结果来优化从真实交互上下文中生成的动作。
AI.result: 在π₀和π₀.₅上进行了大量实验，在多种操作任务中展现出一致的性能改进，同时相比全量想象力方法将GPU计算时间减少约80%。真实世界评估进一步展示了在多种分布偏移下的鲁棒性和泛化能力有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: WISE表明，通过智能的想象力调度（何时使用、如何使用世界模型），可以显著提升VLA后训练的效率和效果，在降低计算成本的同时提升策略的鲁棒性和泛化性，为世界模型在机器人操作中的实际应用提供了可行方案。

title: P-CORE: Self-Supervised Surface Consistency for Point-Based Neural Editing
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://zvict.github.io/p-core/
summary: Advances in neural rendering have enabled high-fidelity multi-view reconstruction of 3D scenes. However, free-form non-rigid shape editing remains a significant challenge. Point-based neural representations are highly desirable for multi-view reconstruction because they lack fixed connectivity, which does not constrain the learned surface topology to that of the initialization. Yet this same property causes point-based representations to struggle with holes and surface discontinuities under large deformations. To address this, we propose a novel self-supervised method to enable point-based representations to adapt to large deformations without requiring ground truth multi-view images of deformed geometry. The key idea is to generate random deformations and to ensure consistency in the predicted surface before and after deformation. In particular, the surface prediction from the deformed point cloud should be the same as the deformation applied to the surface prediction from the original point cloud. We incorporate our approach into attention-based point representations, which differ from splatting-based point representations in their use of a learned interpolation kernel between points as opposed to a Gaussian kernel around each point. This learned interpolation kernel can learn to adapt to large deformations, without requiring addition or removal of points. We show that our framework significantly enhances its robustness to large deformations. Experiments on synthetic geometry editing benchmarks (Neural Editor, Objaverse) demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing point-based methods in zero-shot editing and significantly reduces artifacts. Furthermore, qualitative results on the DTU and Mip-NeRF 360 datasets demonstrate our method's effectiveness on real-world scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督方法，使基于点的神经表示能够适应大形变下的自由形式非刚体形状编辑，通过在随机形变前后保持表面预测一致性来实现，无需形变后几何的真实多视图图像。
AI.motivation: 基于点的神经表示虽然不受固定拓扑结构限制，适合多视图重建，但正因缺乏固定连接，在大形变下易出现孔洞和表面不连续问题。现有方法难以实现自由形式的非刚体形状编辑。
AI.method: 核心思想是生成随机形变，并保证形变前后表面预测的一致性——即变形点云的表面预测应等于对原始点云表面预测施加相同的形变。该方法被整合到基于注意力的点表示中，利用可学习的插值核（区别于splatting方法中的高斯核），使其无需增删点即可适应大形变。
AI.result: 在合成几何编辑基准（Neural Editor, Objaverse）上，该方法在零样本编辑中优于现有基于点的方法，显著减少伪影；在DTU和Mip-NeRF 360数据集上的定性结果验证了其在真实场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于注意力的点表示配合自监督形变一致性约束，能够显著增强点表示对大形变的鲁棒性，为自由形式非刚体编辑提供了可行方案。

title: Security and Privacy in the Musical Metaverse: Threat Analysis and Design Implications
comment: IEEE International Symposium on Emerging Metaverse 2026
summary: The Musical Metaverse (MM) introduces immersive, real-time environments for collaborative musical interaction, characterized by ultra-low-latency constraints, continuous multimodal data streams, and heterogeneous devices. These properties create a distinctive security and privacy landscape that differs significantly from conventional XR or multimedia systems. This paper presents a multi-layer threat analysis of MM ecosystems, identifying key assets including live musical content, expressive interaction data, identity and session metadata, and intellectual property. Threats are analyzed across network, application, data/AI, device, intellectual property rights, and social layers, with particular attention to risks arising from expressive and neurophysiological data, which enable inference, re-identification, and potential privacy violations. We describe a stakeholder-driven survey involving 14 participants from 13 organizations, revealing that neurophysiological data leakage and real-time stream disruption are perceived as the most critical risks, followed by intellectual property infringement and avatar impersonation. We further evaluate the suitability of existing security protocols under strict latency constraints, showing that conventional approaches such as TLS over TCP are often incompatible with real-time musical interaction, while lightweight, stream-oriented mechanisms (e.g., SRTP, DTLS) provide a more suitable balance between security and performance. Based on these findings, we derive a set of design guidelines for MM systems, emphasizing latency-aware security, differentiation of interaction paths, data minimization, and edge-centric processing. The results support a security-by-design approach that enables trust and compliance without compromising real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文对音乐元宇宙（MM）生态系统进行了多层次威胁分析，基于14名参与者（来自13个组织）的调查，识别出神经生理数据泄露和实时流中断为最关键风险，并评估了现有安全协议在超低延迟约束下的适用性，最终提出了一套面向MM系统的安全设计指南。
AI.motivation: 音乐元宇宙引入了超低延迟、连续多模态数据流和异构设备的沉浸式实时协作音乐环境，其安全与隐私特性显著区别于传统XR或多媒体系统。然而现有安全机制未考虑这些独特约束，亟需系统性的威胁分析和安全设计指导。
AI.method: 采用多层威胁分析方法，对MM生态系统的网络层、应用层、数据/AI层、设备层、知识产权层和社会层进行威胁建模；识别关键资产（乐内容、表达性交互数据、身份与会话元数据、知识产权）；开展14名参与者/13个组织的利益相关者调查以评估威胁严重性；并评估SRTP、DTLS等流式轻量协议与传统TLS over TCP在超低延迟约束下的适配性。
AI.result: 调查显示神经生理数据泄露和实时流中断被视为最高风险，其次是知识产权侵权和虚拟化身冒充；传统TLS over TCP在实时音乐交互场景中不适用，而SRTP和DTLS等轻量流式机制在安全性与性能间提供了更优平衡。
AI.conclusion: 提出了延迟感知安全、交互路径差异化、数据最小化和边缘中心处理等设计指南，支持在不牺牲实时性能的前提下实现可信任与合规的安全自设计方法。

title: No country for old linguists: LLM-brain alignment underdetermines neural computation
summary: Nastase et al. (2026) argue that large language models (LLMs) may illuminate language processing because both rely on distributed, context-sensitive representations shaped by statistical learning.
