Their rejection of simple cortical "boxology" is persuasive, and they articulate a strong case for the value of LLM-brain alignment research. The key question is what kind of inference LLM-brain alignment licenses. My claim here will be narrow: representational alignment can in principle constrain mechanistic hypotheses, but it does not by itself identify a mechanism. Nastase et al. acknowledge that an encoding model can capture features represented in neural activity without establishing a shared architecture or algorithm. Yet the authors sometime move from alignment to "shared computational principles" and ultimately to LLMs as mechanistic models of natural language. Indeed, their methodological caveat that alignment does not establish a shared architecture or algorithm sits uneasily with their conclusion that LLMs might instantiate the same computational principles as biological brains and provide a "fully mechanistic model" of language. I discuss what I consider to be problems of logical, causal, and computational underdetermination in Nastase et al.'s (2026) proposal.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Nastase et al. (2026)观点的批判性评述。作者认可LLM与大脑表征对齐研究的价值，但核心论点是：表征对齐本身可以约束机制性假说，却不足以确立或识别具体机制。作者指出Nastase等人从"表征对齐"滑向"共享计算原则"乃至"LLM作为语言的完全机械模型"的推理存在逻辑、因果和计算层面的欠定问题。
AI.motivation: Nastase等人主张LLM与大脑共享分布式、上下文敏感的表征以及"共享计算原则"，并将LLM视为语言的"完全机械模型"。作者认为这些结论超出了对齐证据所能支撑的范围，需要澄清表征对齐究竟允许多强的推理。
AI.method: 本文是一篇论证性/批判性评述，通过区分"表征对齐能说明什么"与"Nastase等人声称其能说明什么"之间差距，从逻辑欠定、因果欠定和计算欠定三个维度系统分析其推理问题。
AI.result: 作者认为表征对齐是约束机制假说的有用工具，但不构成机制识别。Nastase等人自身承认编码模型捕获表征不等于确立共享架构或算法，但他们的结论却暗示LLM与大脑存在相同计算原则，这种逻辑张力在逻辑、因果和计算三个层面都存在欠定问题。
AI.conclusion: 表征到机制的推断需要额外的理论约束和实验证据；研究者应当审慎区分"建立表征对齐"与"声称机制等价"之间的推理鸿沟。

title: Routing Is Not Enough: Diagnosing Intra-Adapter Subspace Contention in MoE+LoRA Fine-Tuning
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Multi-domain fine-tuning often combines MoE routing with LoRA, assuming that token-level routing separates domain-specific updates. We test this assumption in MoE+LoRA using Python code paired with biomedical text and mathematical reasoning. Although these domains show near-disjoint expert routing, adding biomedical data substantially increases code perplexity, indicating that routing separation alone may not prevent negative transfer. To localize the failure, we introduce Jaccard routing overlap and adapter-gradient cosine similarity, which measure expert sharing and update compatibility, respectively. These diagnostics indicate that interference arises mostly from nearly orthogonal domain gradients competing within the same low-rank adapter subspace. We address this issue with SpawnLoRA, which dynamically adds gated sub-adapters inside MoE experts when adapter-level contention is detected, while keeping the router fixed. We evaluate SpawnLoRA on Phi-tiny-MoE-instruct and OLMoE-1B-7B across multiple mixture settings and find that it effectively reduces negative transfer compared with standard and rank-adaptive LoRA. These results demonstrate that structural separation inside experts provides benefits beyond routing or rank expansion alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MoE+LoRA多领域微调中路径分离不足以防止负迁移的问题，提出SpawnLoRA方法，在检测到适配器级别冲突时动态地在MoE专家内部添加门控子适配器，实验证明其在Phi-tiny-MoE-instruct和OLMoE-1B-7B上有效降低了负迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有工作假设MoE路由的token级分离足以将不同领域的更新隔离，从而避免多领域微调中的负迁移。作者通过实验检验这一假设，发现即使不同领域（代码、生物医学、数学推理）的专家路由近乎不相交，领域间仍会发生严重的负迁移（如增加生物医学数据会显著提高代码困惑度），说明路径分离本身不足以防止干扰。
AI.method: 1) 提出两个诊断指标：Jaccard路由重叠度（衡量专家共享程度）和适配器梯度余弦相似度（衡量更新兼容性），用于定位负迁移来源；2) 通过诊断发现干扰主要产生于近正交的领域梯度在共享低秩适配器子空间内的竞争；3) 提出SpawnLoRA方法，在检测到适配器级争用时动态地在MoE专家内部添加带门控的子适配器，同时保持路由器固定不变。
AI.result: 在Phi-tiny-MoE-instruct和OLMoE-1B-7B上、多种混合比例设置下，SpawnLoRA相比标准LoRA和rank-adaptive LoRA均能有效降低负迁移，表明专家内部的结构性分离比单纯的路由分离或秩扩展提供更多收益。
AI.conclusion: 多领域MoE+LoRA微调中，专家路由层面的分离不足以防止负迁移；干扰本质上发生在共享低秩适配器子空间内。SpawnLoRA通过在专家内部动态创建门控子适配器来解决这一冲突，证明了结构分离的重要性超越了路由或秩层面的策略。

title: GPS-Bench: A Governance Policy Benchmark for Automating Policy Analysis
summary: Policy analysis requires more than predicting whether a proposal will pass: it requires identifying who will be affected, how those actors respond, and what follows. LLM-based policy simulations model these processes at scale, but their validity is hard to establish when plausible behaviour is never compared with observed outcomes. We introduce GPS-Bench, an evidence-grounded benchmark for governance policy simulation that links policies to relevant actors, actor actions and downstream impacts using legislative records, lobbying disclosures, regulatory documents, corporate filings, economic data and other public evidence. Actors are reconstructed from the dated record rather than prompted as archetypes, so a persona is an evidence object with provenance; a human-annotated pool forms the Gold evaluation set, while cases labelled by a separate LLM from retrieved evidence are treated as Silver supervision and never as test labels. Because every inference mode reads the same grounded state and emits the same schema, GPS-Bench turns "does multi-agent simulation help?" into a controlled comparison: we contrast joint reasoning, independent and communicating actor agents, graph-based methods and weight-level fine-tuning over one policy state. Fine-tuning on the grounded record gives the strongest actor-level impact prediction, and decomposition does not beat it; what decomposition adds is mechanism. Agents hold private, non-identical evidence, each seeing its own exposure clause, and address named partners with concrete joint proposals, what they offer, what they need in return, and why acting together beats acting alone, so the coalitions that form can be checked against the commitments the record holds. GPS-Bench therefore gives a common empirical setting for studying when evidence, actor modelling and multi-agent interaction improve the prediction and interpretation of policy outcomes.

AI.tldr: GPS-Bench是一个基于证据的政策模拟基准，利用立法记录、游说披露、监管文件等公开证据将政策与相关行动者、行为及下游影响联系起来。通过时间戳记录重建行动者（而非提示原型），并提供Gold（人工标注）和Silver（LLM标注）评估集，支持多智能体仿真与微调方法的受控比较，旨在研究证据、行动者建模和多智能体交互何时能提升政策结果的预测与解释。
AI.motivation: 政策分析不仅需要预测提案能否通过，还需要识别谁将受影响、这些行动者如何回应以及后续影响。基于LLM的政策仿真虽能大规模建模这些过程，但其有效性难以验证——因为看似合理的行为从未与实际观测结果进行比较，缺乏一个能够将仿真输出与真实世界中记录在案的行为和结果相对照的基准。
AI.method: GPS-Bench通过立法记录、游说披露、监管文件、公司申报、经济数据等公共证据，将政策链接到相关行动者、行动者行为及下游影响。行动者从带日期的记录中重建而非用提示原型构建，persona成为一种有出处的证据对象。人工标注池构成Gold评估集，由另一LLM从检索证据中标注的案例作为Silver监督而非测试标签。所有推理模式读取相同的grounded状态并输出相同schema，从而实现了联合推理、独立与通信行动者智能体、图方法及权重级微调在同一政策状态上的受控对比。
AI.result: 在grounded记录上进行微调在行动者层面的影响预测中表现最强，分解（多智能体）方法未能超越它；分解的优势在于提供机制解释。智能体持有私有的、非完全相同证据，各自看到自己的暴露条款，并与具名伙伴提出具体的联合提案——说明提供什么、需要什么回报及为何合作优于单干——使形成的联盟可与记录中保留的承诺进行对照核查。
AI.conclusion: GPS-Bench为政策模拟研究提供了一个统一的实证环境，用于探索证据、行动者建模和多智能体交互何时能够改善政策结果的预测与解释。

title: Predictive Zonotope Reduction: Precise Runtime Monitoring under Uncertainty
summary: Robots operating in physical environments make control decisions based on uncertain sensor measurements, which can lead to unsafe or suboptimal actions. Runtime monitors that check their behavior against safety specifications must represent this uncertainty soundly. Zonotopes are a widely used representation, but continuously incorporating new measurements grows their order unboundedly, so monitors must periodically apply an over-approximating reduction. The choice of the reduction method substantially affects the zonotope's precision, yet existing approaches typically utilize a fixed method throughout the run, even though the optimal choice depends on the current state. This paper presents a Predictive Zonotope Reduction (PZR) approach, which frames reducer selection as an optimal control problem and solves it using beam-search model predictive control. Policy distillation into a small neural policy further provides substantially higher execution speed than model predictive control while maintaining improved performance, enabling uncertainty-aware runtime monitoring on resource-constrained real-time systems. We implement our approach in the RLola runtime monitoring framework and evaluate it on a 5-degree-of-freedom robotic arm simulated in MuJoCo, with sensor uncertainty modeled according to ISO 5725. Experiments on a Raspberry Pi 5 show that dynamic reduction significantly lowers false-positive rates in monitoring compared with static reduction strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出预测性zonotope缩减（PZR）方法，将zonotope缩减器选择建模为最优控制问题，利用波束搜索模型预测控制求解，并通过策略蒸馏得到小型神经策略以提升执行速度，用于不确定性感知的运行时监控。
AI.motivation: 在物理环境中运行的机器人基于不确定传感器测量做控制决策，需运行时监控器安全检查。Zonotope是广泛使用的不确定性表示，但持续融合新测量会使阶数无界增长，须周期性应用过近似缩减。现有方法在全程使用固定缩减方法，然而最优选择取决于当前状态，因此需要动态选择缩减策略。
AI.method: 将zonotope缩减器的选择形式化为最优控制问题，采用波束搜索模型预测控制（MPC）求解；进一步通过策略蒸馏将MPC策略压缩为小型神经策略以提高执行速度，实现在资源受限实时系统上的不确定性感知运行时监控。实现集成在RLola运行时监控框架中。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo仿真模拟的5自由度机械臂上评估，传感器不确定性依据ISO 5725建模。在Raspberry Pi 5上的实验表明，动态缩减相比静态缩减策略显著降低了运行时监控中的误报率，且策略蒸馏后的神经策略比MPC执行速度明显更高。
AI.conclusion: 动态选择zonotope缩减器相比固定策略能够显著提升运行时监控的精度（降低误报率），策略蒸馏可兼顾性能与执行效率，使该方法适用于资源受限的实时系统监控场景。

title: When Depth Hurts: Reliability-Aware Geometry Distillation for Depth-Free RGB-D Salient Object Detection
summary: Depth can resolve appearance ambiguity in RGB-D salient object detection (SOD), yet sensor depth is not uniformly reliable. Missing regions, blurred boundaries, and structural artifacts can propagate through multimodal fusion and make an RGB-D detector less accurate than its RGB-only counterpart. Existing quality-aware approaches regulate observed depth but remain dependent on the same potentially defective modality. We propose \method, a reliability-aware geometry distillation framework developed for RGB-D SOD benchmarks without using dataset-provided depth during training or inference. A frozen Depth Anything V2 model serves only as a training-time teacher, transferring dense relative geometry, hierarchical spatial attention, and boundary structure to a compact edge-aware geometry branch. Pooled bidirectional interaction aligns geometry with appearance, and a pixel-wise reliability estimator selectively injects geometry that is compatible with the current RGB representation. The teacher is removed after training, leaving an RGB-only inference network. Trained on 2,985 RGB-mask pairs, \method{} achieves the best or tied-best result in 26 of 36 metric-dataset comparisons against ten recent RGB-D SOD methods, including a 13.4\% relative MAE reduction on ReDWeb-S. When retrained on DUTS-TR, it also improves the strongest prior $F$-measure by 4.2\% on PASCAL-S, showing that the distilled geometry transfers beyond a particular sensor or dataset domain. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需传感器深度数据的RGB-D显著目标检测框架。该方法在训练时利用冻结的Depth Anything V2模型作为教师，将密集相对几何、层次空间注意力和边界结构蒸馏到紧凑的边缘感知几何分支中；推理时移除教师模型，仅使用RGB图像即可完成检测。在36组指标-数据集对比中，于26组取得最佳或并列最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 传感器深度在RGB-D显著目标检测中并非均匀可靠，存在缺失区域、模糊边界和结构伪影等问题，这些缺陷会通过多模态融合传播，导致RGB-D检测器性能反而低于RGB-only方法。现有质量感知方法虽然对观测深度进行调控，但仍依赖同一可能存在缺陷的模态。因此需要一个不依赖数据集提供的深度、仅通过蒸馏几何知识来提升检测精度的方法。
AI.method: 提出可靠性感知几何蒸馏框架，主要包括：(1) 使用冻结的Depth Anything V2作为训练期教师，向紧凑的边缘感知几何分支蒸馏密集相对几何、层次空间注意力和边界结构；(2) 池化双向交互模块对齐几何与外观特征；(3) 像素级可靠性估计器选择性注入与当前RGB表示兼容的几何信息；(4) 训练结束后移除教师，留下仅需RGB输入的推理网络。
AI.result: 在2,985个RGB-掩膜对上训练后，方法在36组指标-数据集对比中于26组取得最佳或并列最佳结果，在ReDWeb-S上相对MAE降低13.4%。在DUTS-TR上重新训练后，在PASCAL-S上相较最强先前的F-measure提升4.2%，表明蒸馏的几何知识可跨传感器和数据集域迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练时几何蒸馏而非推理时依赖传感器深度的策略，可以有效规避RGB-D SOD中深度质量不可靠的固有问题，同时保留深度信息对外观歧义消解的贡献，实现优于现有RGB-D方法且仅需RGB输入的检测性能。

title: AlcaTRAz - Anchored Tree-Rule Defense Against Jailbreaks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety alignment through carefully crafted prompts. Many existing defenses require access to model weights or internals, making them difficult to apply to black-box deployments. We propose AlcaTRAz (Anchored Tree-Rule defense Against jailbreaks), a prompt-level defense based on rule trees that operates exclusively on the input text and requires no modification or retraining of the target model. The method automatically learns a transferable transformation rule that inserts controlled character-level perturbations at selected positions, thereby disrupting structural regularities exploited by jailbreak attacks while largely preserving the model's utility on benign queries. We evaluate the proposed method across 33 open-weight models, 22 jailbreak attack types, and a benchmark of short, single-turn benign questions, comparing against three representative prompt-level baselines (Llama Guard, RA-LLM, Goal Prioritization). Among the compared defenses, AlcaTRAz achieves the best composite security and functionality score in 73.4 % of model-attack combinations and shifts the aggregate score from a modal value of 10 (maximal-severity response to the malicious request) in the undefended setting to a modal value of 2 (near-refusal) after defense, while keeping the mean benign score within 0.27 points of the undefended baseline (8.35 vs. 8.62 on a 0-10 scale). AlcaTRAz substantially reduces but does not eliminate jailbreak success: a high-severity tail remains, and we do not consider adaptive attackers, so we position it as one layer within a defense-in-depth strategy rather than a standalone guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlcaTRAz，一种基于规则树的提示词级越狱防御方法，仅操作输入文本，无需修改或重训练目标模型。该方法自动学习可迁移的转换规则，在选定位置插入受控字符级扰动，破坏越狱攻击利用的结构规律，同时基本保持模型在良性查询上的效用。在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型上评估，在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全与功能得分，但作者明确表示该方法不能完全消除越狱风险，定位为纵深防御体系中的一层。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型容易受到通过精心构造提示词绕过安全对齐的越狱攻击。现有的许多防御方法需要访问模型权重或内部状态，难以应用于黑盒部署场景。因此需要一种仅在输入文本层面进行操作、无需修改目标模型的提示词级防御方法。
AI.method: AlcaTRAz基于规则树自动学习可迁移的转换规则，在输入提示词的选定位置插入受控的字符级扰动（如插入字符），从而破坏越狱攻击所依赖的结构规律性，同时尽量减少对良性查询的负面影响。该方法仅作用于输入文本，不访问模型内部，也不需要重训练。
AI.result: 在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型及短单轮良性问题基准上评估，并与Llama Guard、RA-LLM、Goal Prioritization三种提示词级基线对比：AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全与功能得分；将未防御时最大严重度响应（众数10分）降至接近拒绝的水平（众数2分）；良性查询平均得分仅下降0.27分（8.35 vs 8.62，满分10分）。
AI.conclusion: AlcaTRAz显著降低但未完全消除越狱成功率，仍存在高严重度的尾部风险，且未考虑自适应攻击者。因此该方法应作为纵深防御（defense-in-depth）策略中的一层，而非独立的防御保障。

title: Jina-OCR-v1: Efficient Document Parsing with Speculative Decoding and Dense Verifiable Rewards
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Model at https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-ocr-v1
summary: We present Jina-OCR-v1, an end-to-end document parsing model built to serve on low-budget GPUs. It combines the compressed-vision encoder and the 3B mixture-of-experts decoder of DeepSeek-OCR, which activates about 570M parameters per token, with a FastMTP speculative decoding head that shares a single draft block recursively across K=3 prediction steps. Greedy verification makes decoding lossless. Post-training combines instruction alignment, robustness fine-tuning on difficult documents, and GRPO under dense verifiable rewards: deterministic formula, table, and structural checks that award partial credit. The training data mixes cleaned public corpora with targeted synthetic pages. At the default dynamic-resolution setting, Jina-OCR-v1 scores 91.14 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and 83.4 on olmOCR-Bench, and reaches the highest page throughput in our comparison at 2.57 pages per second. On a low-budget GPU such as the NVIDIA L4, FastMTP doubles decoding speed over greedy autoregressive decoding. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-ocr-v1.

AI.tldr: Jina-OCR-v1是一个端到端文档解析模型，面向低预算GPU设计。它结合了DeepSeek-OCR的压缩视觉编码器和3B混合专家解码器（每token仅激活约570M参数），并采用FastMTP投机解码头实现无损耗加速。在OmniDocBench v1.6上得分91.14，在olmOCR-Bench上得分83.4，在低预算GPU（如NVIDIA L4）上通过FastMTP可将解码速度提升一倍。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能文档解析模型通常计算资源需求高，难以在低预算GPU上运行，需要构建一个在有限算力下仍能保持高解析质量和高吞吐量的端到端文档解析模型。
AI.method: 结合DeepSeek-OCR的压缩视觉编码器与3B MoE解码器（每token约570M激活参数）；引入FastMTP投机解码头，以单一草稿块递归共享K=3步预测，通过贪心验证实现无损耗解码；训练采用指令对齐、困难文档鲁棒性微调及基于稠密可验证奖励（确定性公式、表格和结构检查，提供部分分数）的GRPO强化学习；训练数据混合清洗后的公开语料与针对性合成页面。
AI.result: 在默认动态分辨率设置下，OmniDocBench v1.6得分91.14，olmOCR-Bench得分83.4；比较中最高吞吐量达2.57页/秒；在NVIDIA L4上，FastMTP相比贪婪自回归解码将解码速度提升2倍。
AI.conclusion: Jina-OCR-v1证明通过高效的模型架构（稀疏MoE）和投机解码技术，可以在低预算GPU上实现与高性能模型相当甚至更优的文档解析精度与吞吐量，且模型已公开供社区使用。

title: Frontier LLMs are effective batch optimizers: Assessing reasoning models in continuous and discrete settings
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) have become attractive priors for optimization due to their large-scale pretraining that enables them to navigate a variety of optimization settings. However, the effectiveness of modern reasoning LLMs in batch optimization settings remains underexplored. Here we investigate the performance of the current generation of frontier LLMs as batch optimizers in both continuous and discrete settings. We find that while LLMs are competitive zero-shot batch optimizers for numerical test functions, their performance is brittle compared to classical non-LLM optimization approaches. However, LLM priors are significantly better in semantically rich settings, indicating that their batch optimization behavior is highly effective when navigating and reasoning over the discrete spaces most similar in structure to their pretraining data.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了前沿大语言模型（LLM）作为批量优化器在连续和离散优化问题中的表现。研究发现LLM在数值测试函数上是具有竞争力的零样本批量优化器，但性能比传统非LLM优化方法更脆弱；然而在语义丰富的设置中，LLM显著优于传统方法，表明其批量优化行为在处理与预训练数据结构相似的离散空间时非常高效。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练使前沿LLM具备强大的先验知识，有望成为有吸引力的优化先验，但现代推理型LLM在批量优化场景中的有效性尚未被充分探索，这一空白需要被填补。
AI.method: 系统评估当前一代前沿LLM作为批量优化器在连续和离散两种优化场景中的性能，并与经典的、非LLM的优化方法进行对比分析。
AI.result: LLM在数值测试函数上可作为有竞争力的零样本批量优化器，但鲁棒性不如传统优化方法；在语义丰富的离散空间中，LLM展现出显著优于传统方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM的优化能力高度依赖问题空间的语义丰富性和与预训练数据的结构相似性；在语义丰富的领域（如离散搜索空间）中，LLM是高效的批量优化工具，但在纯数值/连续空间中其稳定性仍需改进。

title: HalluPeer: A Taxonomy-driven Benchmark for Detecting Hallucinations in Scientific Peer Reviews
summary: The growing scale of academic peer review has motivated the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as review assistants, yet LLMs can generate fluent but unsupported claims that undermine review reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks are not designed for peer review, where verification requires grounding claims in long, technical papers. We introduce HalluPeer, a benchmark for detecting hallucinations in scientific peer reviews, providing aligned triples of paper content, human-written reviews, and hallucination-injected reviews, annotated for detection, classification, and localization. Our pipeline induces a peer-review-specific hallucination taxonomy, identifies review contexts, and injects hallucinations with automated filtering. Experiments on 12K papers and 38K reviews show that existing detectors struggle to separate hallucinations from legitimate critique, while evaluation on authentic reviews demonstrates that HalluPeer-defined hallucination patterns occur in real peer reviews, highlighting the critical need for source-aware verification. Our project page can be found in https://github.com/Lin-TzuLing/HalluPeer.git

AI.tldr: 提出了HalluPeer基准，用于检测科学同行评审中的幻觉，提供论文内容、人工撰写评审和注入幻觉的评审对齐三元组，支持幻觉的检测、分类和定位。在12K论文和38K评审上的实验表明现有检测器难以区分幻觉与合理批评，且真实评审中存在HalluPeer定义的幻觉模式。
AI.motivation: 同行评审规模增长促使使用LLM作为评审助手，但LLM会生成流畅却缺乏依据的主张，削弱评审可靠性。现有的幻觉基准并非针对同行评审设计，因为该场景需要将声明锚定在长篇幅的技术论文中进行验证，迫切需要专门的幻觉检测基准。
AI.method: 构建HalluPeer基准：设计同行评审特有幻觉分类体系；识别评审上下文；通过自动化过滤注入幻觉；生成论文内容、人工评审与幻觉注入评审对齐的三元组数据集并标注检测、分类和定位任务。
AI.result: 在12K篇论文和38K条评审上的实验表明，现有检测器难以将幻觉与合理批评区分开；在真实评审上的评估进一步证明HalluPeer定义的幻觉模式确实存在于实际同行评审中。
AI.conclusion: 同行评审中的幻觉检测需要依据来源的验证方法，现有检测器在该场景表现不佳，HalluPeer基准凸显了开发源感知验证机制的必要性。

title: Toward an~Integrated Cognitive--Ergonomic Architecture for~Human--Machine Interaction: Combining Cognitive Models with~Human Factors Ergonomics
summary: This paper presents an integrated approach to modeling human competencies by combining the theoretical foundations of cognitive architectures with principles from Human Factors Ergonomics (HFE). Through a comparative analysis of established cognitive models-SOAR, ACT-R, LIDA, and COCOM-we synthesize a tailored architecture designed to address the complexities of human-machine interaction (HMI) in dynamic environments. By contextualizing this model within ergonomic frameworks, we elucidate the mechanisms underlying decision-making, skill acquisition, and adaptive behavior, bridging the gap between cognitive theory and applied system design. Our framework is empirically grounded in industrial robotics applications, where operator expertise, normative knowledge, and real-time feedback loops are critical. The proposed architecture not only enhances the cognitive alignment of HMI systems but also provides a scalable methodology for designing intelligent, human-centered interfaces in high-stakes environments. This work advances both the theoretical understanding of human competencies and the practical implementation of adaptive, ergonomically optimized systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种集成的认知建模方法，将认知架构（SOAR、ACT-R、LIDA、COCOM）的理论基础与人因工效学（HFE）原则相结合，构建适用于动态人机交互环境的定制化认知架构。该框架在工业机器人应用中进行了实证，用于增强操作员决策、技能获取和自适应行为。
AI.motivation: 弥合认知理论与应用系统设计之间的鸿沟，解决动态环境中人机交互的复杂性，并构建能够准确建模人类能力的统一框架。
AI.method: 对SOAR、ACT-R、LIDA与COCOM四种代表性认知模型进行比较分析，综合其各自优势，在人因工效学框架内进行情境化建模，并在工业机器人应用场景中进行实证验证。
AI.result: 所提出的架构增强了人机交互系统的认知对齐性，并提供了一种可扩展的方法论，用于在高风险环境中设计智能、以人为中心的界面。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时推进了人类能力建模的理论理解，以及自适应的、符合工效学优化系统在工业实践中的实际应用。

title: FoRIS: Progressive Foreground Refinement for Training-Free In-Context Segmentation
summary: In-Context Segmentation (ICS) aims to precisely segment arbitrary semantic concepts, such as objects or parts, given one or a few annotated visual exemplars. In this paper, we revisit ICS from a more classical segmentation perspective, viewing it as a coarse-to-fine progressive refinement process. Rather than directly predicting the final mask through reference-query matching, we progressively refine the segmentation from coarse and ambiguous foreground responses to precise and complete foreground structures. Building upon this perspective, we propose a training-free in-context segmentation framework, termed FoRIS. Specifically, FoRIS consists of three key stages: Foreground Purification, Foreground Localization, and Foreground Consolidation, which progressively suppress background distractions, localize discriminative target regions, and recover complete foreground structures through semantic aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that FoRIS achieves SOTA performance across semantic and part segmentation tasks, with average improvements of 4.5 and 4.8 mIoU points over existing approaches in the 1-shot and 5-shot settings, respectively. Code: https://github.com/Xi-Mu-Yu/FoRIS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FoRIS，一个无需训练的上下文分割框架，将上下文分割视作由粗到细的渐进细化过程，通过前景净化、前景定位和前景合并三个阶段逐步细化分割结果，在语义和部件分割任务上达到SOTA性能（1-shot和5-shot分别提升4.5和4.8个mIoU点）。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文分割方法直接通过参考与查询特征匹配来预测最终掩码，忽略了从粗粒度到细粒度的渐进细化过程。作者希望从经典分割视角重新审视ICS，将其建模为渐进细化过程以提升分割精度和完整性。
AI.method: 提出三阶段无训练框架FoRIS：(1)前景净化——抑制背景干扰；(2)前景定位——定位具有区分性的目标区域；(3)前景合并——通过语义聚合恢复完整的前景结构。整个过程由粗到细地渐进细化分割掩码。
AI.result: FoRIS在语义分割和部件分割任务上均达到SOTA性能，在1-shot设置下平均提升4.5 mIoU点，在5-shot设置下平均提升4.8 mIoU点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文分割重构为训练免费的渐进式细化过程，FoRIS在无需额外训练的情况下显著超越现有方法，验证了由粗到细细化范式在上下文分割中的有效性。代码已开源。

title: Rent-a-RAG: Embedding-Space Watermarks for Auditing Third-Party RAG
summary: Third-party retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) marketplaces create a new auditing problem: data providers may license corpora to a RAG operator, yet later have no visibility into whether their documents are being reused without compensation. Auditing this misuse is difficult because the operator is non-cooperative, answers are paraphrased by the generator, and one response may combine evidence from many providers. We propose DirBucket, a provider-side semantic watermarking and black-box auditing framework for document-level reuse in multi-provider RAG. DirBucket watermarks documents by meaning-preserving paraphrases whose embeddings are biased toward provider-bucket secret directions, enabling detection from black-box answers while preserving retrieval utility. On a challenging benchmark that reflects mixed-provider reuse under black-box access, DirBucket is the only method that consistently achieves strong target detection with no non-target activation, detecting non-compliance in every audit within 23 audited answers on our primary benchmark. The watermark survives adversarial post-answer laundering, and none of the evaluated evasion strategies simultaneously defeats detection while preserving user-perceived answer quality. Detection transfers unchanged to a second benchmark built from real clinical, cyber-threat-intelligence, and legal provider corpora. These results suggest that embedding-space watermarking can make document reuse in third-party RAG statistically auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DirBucket，一种面向多提供商RAG系统的提供商侧语义水印与黑盒审计框架。通过将文档改写为嵌入空间偏向提供商秘密方向的语义等义改写，实现对文档级复用的检测，且不依赖RAG运营商的配合，也不需要白盒访问。该系统在混合提供商复用的基准上实现了最强的目标检测性能与零误触发，且水印能抵抗对抗性后处理清洗。
AI.motivation: 第三方RAG市场引入了一个新的审计问题：数据提供商将语料库授权给RAG运营商后，无法获知自己的文档是否被未经补偿地重复使用。由于运营商不配合、生成器会对回答进行改写、且单个响应可能融合多个提供商的证据，审计此类滥用十分困难。
AI.method: DirBucket采用提供商侧语义水印方法：通过保持语义的改写对文档进行水印化，使改写后文档的嵌入向量偏向提供商指定的秘密存储桶方向。审计时仅需黑盒访问RAG系统给出的答案，通过检测答案嵌入是否被偏置到该秘密方向来判断文档是否被复用，同时保持检索效用。
AI.result: 在反映黑盒访问下混合提供商复用的挑战性基准上，DirBucket是唯一一致实现强目标检测且无非目标激活的方法，在主要基准上每轮审计最多23个被审计答案内即可检测出不合规行为。水印可抵抗对抗性后处理清洗，且评估的所有规避策略均无法在规避检测的同时保持用户感知的答案质量。检测结果无需调整即可迁移到由真实临床、网络威胁情报和法律提供商语料构建的第二基准。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间水印可以使第三方RAG中的文档复用具备统计可审计性，为数据提供商提供了一种无需运营商配合即可追踪其内容使用的可行手段。

title: MemoryLACE: Memory Lifecycle-Aware Consolidation and Evidence Retrieval
summary: Long-term LLM agents must preserve information across interactions while distinguishing repeated evidence, historical states, updates, and unresolved contradictions. Existing textual memory systems retrieve semantically relevant memories efficiently but often leave these relationships implicit, whereas richer structured approaches model them through global graphs, hierarchical abstractions, or reflection at greater complexity. We introduce MemoryLACE (MemLACE), a lightweight memory framework that explicitly models the lifecycle of textual evidence through sparse merge, supersession, and contradiction relations while preserving atomic natural-language memories and their provenance. Rather than retrieving memories independently, MemLACE reconstructs relation-aware evidence units that expose current, historical, supporting, and conflicting evidence for downstream reasoning. Across BEAM and StructMemEval, using open-weight and proprietary LLM backbones, MemLACE achieves the highest overall performance in same-backbone comparisons while reducing end-to-end runtime on BEAM by 66.6% relative to Hindsight, the strongest reported reflective-memory baseline. Ablation studies identify lifecycle expansion and temporal awareness as the principal contributors to these gains. Together, the results demonstrate that explicitly modeling the local lifecycle of textual evidence is sufficient to substantially improve long-term memory reasoning without requiring comprehensive knowledge graphs or global reflection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemoryLACE（MemLACE），一种轻量级记忆框架，通过稀疏的合并（merge）、取代（supersession）和矛盾（contradiction）关系显式建模文本证据的生命周期，同时保留原子自然语言记忆及其来源信息，在BEAM和StructMemEval基准上超越现有方法，并在BEAM上将端到端运行时间相比最强反射记忆基线Hindsight缩短66.6%。
AI.motivation: 长期LLM代理需要在多次交互中保持信息，同时区分重复证据、历史状态、更新和未解决的矛盾。现有文本记忆系统虽然能高效检索语义相关的记忆，但往往隐式处理这些关系；而更丰富的结构化方法通过全局图、层次抽象或反思来建模，但复杂度更高。作者希望寻找一种无需全局知识图谱或全局反思即可显式建模文本证据生命周期的方法。
AI.method: MemoryLACE引入三种稀疏关系——merge（合并重复证据）、supersession（取代/更新关系）、contradiction（矛盾关系）——来显式建模文本证据的生命周期，同时保留原子自然语言记忆及其provenance（来源）。与独立检索记忆不同，MemLACE重构出关系感知的证据单元，为下游推理暴露当前证据、历史证据、支持性证据和冲突证据。该方法无需全局图或全局反射，保持轻量级复杂度。
AI.result: 在BEAM和StructMemEval两个基准上，使用开放权重和专有LLM骨干，MemLACE在同类骨干比较中取得最高整体性能。在BEAM上相比最强反射记忆基线Hindsight，端到端运行时间减少66.6%。消融实验表明生命周期扩展（lifecycle expansion）和时间感知（temporal awareness）是性能提升的主要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，无需全面的知识图谱或全局反射，仅通过显式建模文本证据的局部生命周期即可大幅提升长期记忆推理能力。这一发现为长时记忆系统设计提供了一种更简洁、高效的替代路径。

title: Portable Causal Fairness Across Synthetic Data Generator Families
summary: When a statistical agency or regulator releases synthetic data in place of sensitive records, it chooses the generator that produces the table, and can shape that generator so unfair pathways are absent. DECAF made this concrete on one non-private GAN: three fairness definitions become three sets of edge cuts on the generator's causal graph. Whether the mechanism belongs to DECAF, or to causal factorisation itself, was untested. We port all three definitions to nine generators from three unrelated families (marginals-based, GAN, and diffusion, each with differentially private variants), across three levels of formal privacy guarantee, over 2,520 matched-pair runs on Adult and COMPAS datasets. The mechanism transfers everywhere, and our new causal diffusion backbone yields the fairest release of any family we tested, at fidelity close to the marginals tier. Applying the cut barely moves fidelity, only costs a downstream classifier about $0.07$ to $0.15$ AUC on average, and adding privacy guarantees don't make the data less fair.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了DECAF框架中基于因果图边切割实现公平性的机制是否具有普适性。作者将三种公平性定义移植到九个来自三个不相关族（边际分布、GAN、扩散模型，各含差分隐私变体）的生成器上，在Adult和COMPAS数据集上进行了2,520次配对实验。结果表明该机制在所有生成器中均有效，且新提出的因果扩散骨干模型在所有测试族中产生了最公平的发布结果，保真度接近边际层水平。应用边切割对保真度影响很小，仅使下游分类器AUC平均降低0.07~0.15，且添加隐私保证不会降低数据公平性。
AI.motivation: 先前DECAF框架证明了在单个非私有GAN上，三种公平性定义可转化为生成器因果图上的三类边切割。但该机制究竟是DECAF框架特有的，还是因果分解本身固有的属性，此前未经检验。作者旨在验证这一公平性机制的可迁移性和普适性。
AI.method: 将DECAF中三种公平性定义（对应三类因果边切割）移植到九个生成器上，涵盖三个不相关生成族（基于边际分布、GAN、扩散模型），每个族均包含差分隐私变体，涉及三个正式隐私保证级别。在Adult和COMPAS数据集上进行大规模配对实验，共2,520次运行，并引入新的因果扩散骨干作为生成骨干。
AI.result: 该公平性机制在所有生成器族中均成功迁移。新提出的因果扩散骨干在公平性上优于所有被测家族，且保真度接近边际分布层。应用边切割对数据保真度几乎没有负面影响，仅使下游分类器AUC平均下降0.07至0.15；此外，添加差分隐私保证并不会使合成数据更加不公平。
AI.conclusion: DECAF所展示的公平性机制并非其框架特有，而是因果分解本身的内在属性，可推广至包括扩散模型在内的多种生成器家族。这一发现为实际部署中"公平性—隐私—保真度"之间的权衡提供了积极证据：三者可以同时获得较优表现。

title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
summary: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage. We study these models by probing and analyzing the ``attention triangle,'' comprising the three cross-attention edges connecting the text, audio, and video streams, and examine how semantic information is routed across modalities during generation. Our analysis reveals that routing along the audio-video edge is bidirectional: audio can influence video generation, while video can influence audio generation. This edge is shaped by biases encoded in the model's parameters and emerges as a major contributor to leakage: when prompts are in tension with learned priors, cross-modal interactions may override the intended conditioning and reroute semantics toward visually canonical but incorrect outcomes. These effects suggest that semantic artifacts arise not merely from attention spreading beyond its intended target, but from structured, bias-driven interactions along specific pathways. Building on this perspective, we extract attention-derived signals that expose how semantics are distributed and grounded across modalities, and use them as a diagnostic tool to both analyze and deliberately incur leakage under controlled conditions. This enables us to probe the internal dynamics of cross-modal routing and isolate the role of individual interactions. We further leverage these signals to guide inference-time interventions that encourage more consistent cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments support our analysis and demonstrate improved semantic grounding while preserving generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析音频-视频扩散模型中"注意力三角"（文本-音频-视频三条跨模态注意力边），揭示了语义泄漏的结构化机制：音视频边上的跨模态信息路由是双向的，且受模型参数中编码的偏差驱动，导致在提示与先验冲突时产生语义伪影。作者提出注意力派生信号作为诊断工具来分析和可控地诱发泄漏，并以此指导推理时干预，改善跨模态一致性同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 音频-视频扩散模型通过跨模态注意力协调文本、声音和视觉内容，但该机制可能引入微妙且系统的语义泄漏。现有研究缺乏对这种泄漏机制的系统性理解，尤其是跨模态路由的偏差驱动特征，因此需要深入剖析注意力结构以揭示语义泄漏的来源和传播路径。
AI.method: 1) 定义并系统分析"注意力三角形"，涵盖文本-音频-视频三条跨模态注意力边；2) 探针分析验证音视频边的双向路由特性及其受参数偏差塑造的方式；3) 提取注意力派生信号，揭示语义如何在各模态间分布和锚定；4) 使用这些信号作为诊断工具，在受控条件下分析和蓄意诱发泄漏；5) 利用这些信号指导推理时干预，增强跨模态对齐一致性。
AI.result: 实验证实：音频-视频注意边是双向信息流通道；该边由模型参数编码的偏差塑造，是语义泄漏的主要贡献者；当提示与学习先验冲突时，跨模态交互会覆盖预期条件，将语义路由到视觉上典型但错误的结果。注意力派生信号能够有效暴露语义分布与锚定情况，以此指导的推理时干预在保持生成质量的同时改善了语义接地。
AI.conclusion: 语义伪影并非仅仅源于注意力扩散到目标之外，而是来自特定路径上结构化、偏差驱动的交互。理解并利用跨模态路由的内部动态，可以设计有效的推理时干预手段来提升多模态生成的一致性和语义忠实度。

title: MINERVA: How Small Can a Manipulation Policy Be and Still Solve LIBERO?
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters now dominate the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, but the model capacity actually required by the benchmark remains unclear. We introduce MINERVA (MINimal Efficient Robotic Vision-Action policy), a family of deliberately compact visuomotor policies designed to measure this task-specific capacity floor. A 0.54M-parameter policy achieves 95.1% average success over 2,000 rollouts on the four standard LIBERO suites, only 2.4 points below the reported LeRobot $π_{0.5}$ result despite using 7,700$\times$ fewer parameters. Performance saturates near 1M parameters and collapses below 0.25M. Across broad architectural, training, and inference sweeps, only action-chunk length and vision capacity consistently exceed a $\pm$1-point training-seed band. Flow matching provides no detectable advantage over direct L1 regression across three seeds, while regression is up to 3.8$\times$ faster on GPU. A task-ID permutation probe shows that standard LIBERO instruction conditioning primarily selects among memorized tasks: changing only the task-ID mapping reduces success to near chance. The same recipe achieves 94.6% success across 89 LIBERO-90 tasks, while LIBERO-Plus perturbations reduce performance to 46--56%, with near-zero robustness to photometric shifts. The 0.54M policy replans every control step in 5--9 ms per chunk on a laptop CPU, 113$\times$ faster than SmolVLA and 1,400$\times$ faster than $π_{0.5}$, without a GPU. These results establish a first empirical estimate of LIBERO's task-specific capacity floor and motivate capacity-aware design and distillation for deployment-efficient robot policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MINERVA，一组极紧凑的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略模型，用于测量LIBERO操作基准的任务特定能力下限。仅0.54M参数的策略在LIBERO四个标准套件中达到95.1%的平均成功率，比LeRobot π0.5仅低2.4个点，但参数少了7700倍。结果表明LIBERO基准的实际容量需求远低于当前主导该基准的大规模VLA模型。
AI.motivation: 当前数十亿参数的VLA模型主导LIBERO操作基准，但该基准实际所需的最小模型容量仍然未知。理解任务特定的能力下限对于计算效率、部署约束和模型蒸馏至关重要，因此需要一种系统的方法来量化这一下限。
AI.method: 提出MINERVA——一组刻意紧凑的视觉运动策略。在广泛的架构、训练和推理扫描中测试模型，分析动作块长度、视觉容量、流匹配与直接L1回归的影响，并设计任务ID置换探针来检验指令条件机制。在LIBERO标准套件、LIBERO-90和LIBERO-Plus扰动下评估性能，并在笔记本电脑CPU上测量推理延迟。
AI.result: 0.54M参数策略在LIBERO四个套件2000次rollout中平均成功率95.1%，仅比π0.5低2.4点。性能在约1M参数处饱和，低于0.25M时崩溃。仅动作块长度和视觉容量对结果影响超过±1点训练种子带宽。流匹配与直接L1回归相比无显著优势，回归GPU速度快3.8倍。任务ID置换探针显示标准LIBERO指令条件化主要从记忆化任务中选择。在LIBERO-90中达到94.6%，而LIBERO-Plus扰动使性能降至46-56%，对光度变化鲁棒性近乎为零。0.54M策略在笔记本电脑CPU上每块重规划需5-9毫秒，比SmolVLA快113倍，比π0.5快1400倍。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次对LIBERO的任务特定容量下限进行了经验估计，证明该基准可被极紧凑的策略解决。这些发现促使采用容量感知的设计和蒸馏方法，以实现部署高效的机器人策略。

title: Exploring the Potential of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to AAAI 2027
summary: Contrastive language-image learning (CLIP) has become a key paradigm for remote sensing vision-language understanding. However, existing remote sensing contrastive learning methods are mostly built on RGB-oriented CLIP architectures, making it difficult to exploit heterogeneous sensors such as SAR, multi-spectral imaging (MSI), and hyperspectral imaging (HSI). To address this limitation, we propose OmniRSCLIP, an end-to-end contrastive learning framework that supports multi-source sensor inputs for remote sensing vision-language modeling. The key idea is to extend CLIP beyond its fixed RGB input interface without breaking the pretrained visual knowledge. To this end, OmniRSCLIP introduces Spectral-Spatial Basis Decomposition (SSBD), which formulates arbitrary-channel adaptation as a basis recomposition problem: pretrained CLIP patch embeddings provide transferable spatial bases, while wavelength-conditioned coefficients span sensor-specific embedding kernels within a constrained visual prior space. This design avoids forcing heterogeneous sensors into a fixed-channel input space, while aligning them in a unified image-text semantic space. We further introduce a spectral-context-aware mask-based contrastive learning scheme to suppress modality-specific redundant features and enhance fine-grained image-text alignment. Finally, to support multi-modal training, we construct OmniRS5M, the first large-scale remote sensing image-text corpus covering RGB, SAR, MSI, and HSI. Experiments on retrieval, zero-shot classification, and semantic localization show that OmniRSCLIP preserves strong RGB-domain performance while effectively extending CLIP to heterogeneous remote sensing modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出了OmniRSCLIP，一种支持多源传感器输入（RGB、SAR、MSI、HSI）的遥感视觉语言对比学习框架。通过光谱-空间基分解将任意通道输入适配到预训练CLIP中，并构建了首个大规模多模态遥感图像-文本语料库OmniRS5M，在检索、零样本分类和语义定位任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感对比学习方法大多基于面向RGB的CLIP架构，难以充分利用SAR、多光谱（MSI）和高光谱（HSI）等异构传感器数据，限制了遥感视觉语言理解的能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出Spectral-Spatial Basis Decomposition (SSBD)：将任意通道适配建模为基重组问题，预训练CLIP的patch嵌入提供可迁移的空间基，波长条件系数在受限视觉先验空间中生成传感器特定的嵌入核。2) 引入光谱上下文感知的掩码对比学习机制，抑制模态特异冗余特征，增强细粒度图文对齐。3) 构建OmniRS5M，首个覆盖RGB、SAR、MSI和HSI的大规模遥感图像-文本语料库。
AI.result: 在检索、零样本分类和语义定位实验中，OmniRSCLIP在保持强RGB域性能的同时，有效将CLIP扩展至异构遥感模态。
AI.conclusion: 通过基分解策略避免了将异构传感器强行纳入固定通道输入空间，同时将其对齐到统一的图像-文本语义空间，实现了跨模态的遥感视觉语言理解。

title: Beyond the Trust Boundary: A Critical Reassessment of the FIDO2 Threat Model
summary: FIDO2/WebAuthn has been widely deployed as a phishing-resistant authentication scheme. Because FIDO2 relies on public-key cryptography and hardware-backed authenticators, its security is often assumed to be guaranteed by design, provided that the cryptographic implementation is correct. In this work, we critically reassess the FIDO2 threat model and show that several commonly assumed security properties do not hold under realistic deployment conditions. We extend the threat model beyond the cryptographic layer to examine eight attack vectors across the FIDO2 stack: malicious browser extensions, platform-handler malware, passive sniffing, virtual device drivers, CTAP2-specific malware, USB/hardware implants, malicious USB hubs/docks/extenders, and NFC relay attacks. Our analysis shows that FIDO2 depends on environmental assumptions that may not hold in practice. We demonstrate how AAGUID and timing information can enable user profiling and targeted attacks, and how compromise of the browser, operating system, or hardware can undermine FIDO2 security even when the underlying cryptographic primitives remain uncompromised. We further show that attack chains spanning multiple layers can bypass the intended security guarantees of FIDO2. These findings indicate that the primary weakness in a FIDO2 deployment is often not the cryptographic layer, but the surrounding trusted environment. We also examine how these attack vectors can undermine device attestation by targeting the FIDO Metadata Service (MDS3), which serves as a root of trust for authenticator metadata. Finally, we characterize the attacks according to privilege, skill, and resource requirements. We conclude that effective FIDO2 security requires layered mitigations covering the browser, operating system, hardware, protocol stack, and metadata infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地重新评估了FIDO2/WebAuthn的威胁模型，指出其安全性不仅依赖于密码学实现，还受制于周边可信环境（浏览器、操作系统、硬件等）。作者识别了八个跨越FIDO2堆栈的攻击向量，包括恶意浏览器扩展、平台处理器恶意软件、被动嗅探、虚拟设备驱动程序、CTAP2专用恶意软件、USB/硬件植入、恶意USB集线器/坞站/扩展器以及NFC中继攻击。研究表明，即使底层密码学原语未被攻破，浏览器、操作系统或硬件的妥协也会破坏FIDO2的安全性；攻击链可跨越多个层次绕过FIDO2的预期安全保证，并可通过AAGUID和时序信息实现用户画像和定向攻击。此外，攻击还可针对FIDO元数据服务（MDS3）破坏设备证明。
AI.motivation: FIDO2/WebAuthn被广泛部署为抗钓鱼认证方案，其安全性通常被认为由密码学和硬件背书保证。然而，这种假设忽略了现实部署条件下周围环境的安全脆弱性。作者旨在通过扩展威胁模型到密码学层之外，揭示FIDO2在实际环境中并不满足的若干安全假设。
AI.method: 作者将FIDO2威胁模型扩展到密码学层之外，系统性地考察了横跨FIDO2堆栈的八个攻击向量，并通过分析AAGUID和时序信息泄露、多层攻击链组合、对FIDO元数据服务（MDS3）的攻击路径，以及按权限、技能和资源要求对攻击进行分类，来全面评估FIDO2在真实部署条件下的安全性。
AI.result: 研究发现FIDO2依赖的环境假设在实践中可能不成立；AAGUID和时序信息可被用于用户画像和定向攻击；浏览器、操作系统或硬件的妥协可在密码学原语未受损的情况下破坏FIDO2安全性；跨多层的攻击链可绕过FIDO2的设计安全保证；MDS3作为认证器元数据的信任根同样易受攻击。
AI.conclusion: FIDO2部署的主要弱点往往不在密码学层，而在其周围的可信环境。有效保障FIDO2安全性需要在浏览器、操作系统、硬件、协议栈和元数据基础设施多个层面实施分层缓解措施。

title: LLMs Learn Better In-Context from Rules than from Examples
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit in-context learning capabilities, where they can learn new tasks from prompt contexts without weight updates. We compare the learning efficacies of two prominent modes of in-context learning: (1) learning from descriptions of rules (instruction following); and (2) learning from examples of input-output demonstrations (few-shot prompting). Through five learning tasks that cover diverse domains (games, arithmetic, linguistic inferences), we compare two modes of learning (rules vs. examples) specifying the same underlying task. We furthermore explore model and task properties that modulate the learning efficacies. We find that models generally learn more reliably from rules than from examples alone, and additional examples on top of rules or simply scaling up the number of examples do not lead to consistent and significant gains. Instruction tuning amplifies the benefit of rule-based learning while keeping example-based learning capacities intact. Surprisingly, we find no privileged effect of example-based learning in base models, and rules still lead to gains in algebraic task domains. Overall, the comparative efficacy of rules over examples is larger when the task recruits algebraic abstractions and computations, and smaller when the task requires distributional sensitivity and/or recruits parametric knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了LLM的两种上下文学习模式——基于规则描述的指令跟随与基于输入输出示例的少样本提示——在五个跨领域任务上的学习效能，发现模型普遍从规则中比从示例中学习更可靠，指令微调进一步放大了规则学习的优势。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出上下文学习能力，能够在提示上下文中快速学习新任务而无需更新权重。然而，对于两种主要的上下文学习模式（基于规则描述的指令跟随 vs. 基于输入输出示例的少样本提示）在相同任务上的学习效能孰优孰劣，以及哪些模型和任务属性会调节这种效能差异，尚缺乏系统性比较研究。
AI.method: 作者设计了五个覆盖不同领域（游戏、算术、语言推理）的学习任务，针对每个任务构建了两种表达同一底层任务的模式：规则模式（描述性规则）和示例模式（输入输出演示）。通过控制变量，比较两种模式的学习效能，并进一步探索模型规模、是否指令微调以及任务性质（是否需要代数抽象计算 vs. 分布敏感性/参数化知识）等调节因素对学习效能的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 模型通常从规则中学习比仅从示例中学习更可靠；(2) 在规则之上添加额外示例或单纯扩大示例数量并未带来持续且显著的增益；(3) 指令微调放大了基于规则学习的优势，同时保持了基于示例学习的能力；(4) 令人惊讶的是，基础模型中示例学习并无特权效应，规则在代数任务领域仍然带来增益；(5) 规则相对示例的效能优势在任务涉及代数抽象与计算时更大，在任务需要分布敏感性或调用参数化知识时更小。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，LLM的上下文学习中基于规则的学习普遍优于基于示例的学习，且这种优势受任务性质（代数vs.分布性）和模型状态（是否指令微调）的调节。这一发现对理解LLM的上下文学习机制以及如何设计更有效的提示策略具有重要启示。

title: Language-encoded network topology enables large language models to reason about complex networks
summary: Networks describe systems in biology and beyond, from protein interactions and social relationships to power grids and citation records. Reasoning about such systems requires understanding their structure: which elements are central, which connections bridge separate communities, and how it changes when elements are removed. Although large language models (LLMs) excel at natural language, they struggle with such questions when networks are given as edge lists, sentences or measurement tables, because their structural meaning must be inferred. Here we introduce BioGlyph, which compiles network topology into an interpretable and transferable language of structural roles. BioGlyph combines graph partitioning and structural measurements to identify roles such as hubs, community cores and cross-community connectors, and fixed rules to translate them into a universal vocabulary. The representation describes each element through its structural role, supporting evidence and semantic consequences, leaving both the network and the LLM unchanged. Across twenty networks spanning five domains, BioGlyph substantially improves open LLMs' ability to answer structural reasoning questions, outperforming edge-based, numerical and learned representations by up to 26 percentage points in system accuracy. Ablations show that the gain comes from explicitly encoding structural roles in semantically interpretable terms. The gain is more prominent in dense, community-structured networks and diminishes in sparse networks whose topology is more readily inferred from text. In a budding-yeast protein-interaction network, BioGlyph exposes biological organization: cross-community connectors are enriched for essential genes, whereas peripheral proteins are depleted. BioGlyph thus provides an interpretable representation for both language models and scientists to reason about network structure.

AI.tldr: BioGlyph是一种将网络拓扑结构编译为可解释且可迁移的结构角色语言的表示方法，通过结合图分区与结构测量识别枢纽、社区核心、跨社区连接器等角色，并用固定规则将其翻译为通用词汇。在跨越五个领域的二十个网络上，BioGlyph显著提升了开源大语言模型回答结构推理问题的能力，系统准确率相比基于边、数值和学习到的表示方法最高提升26个百分点。消融实验表明增益来源于以语义可解释的术语显式编码结构角色，该增益在密集、社区结构明显的网络中更突出。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自然语言上表现出色，但当网络以边列表、句子或测量表形式给出时，由于需要推断结构含义，模型难以回答关于网络结构的推理问题（如哪些元素重要、哪些连接桥接不同社区、元素移除时如何变化）。现有表示方法未能将网络拓扑的结构语义显式传递给LLM，因此需要一种能够将网络结构编译为LLM可理解、可推理的表示形式。
AI.method: BioGlyph将网络拓扑编译为一种"结构角色语言"：(1) 结合图分区和结构测量来识别网络中每个元素的结构角色（如枢纽、社区核心、跨社区连接器等）；(2) 使用固定规则将这些角色翻译为通用词汇表；(3) 每个元素的表示包含其结构角色、支持证据和语义后果，保持网络和LLM本身不变。该方法不改变底层网络或LLM架构，仅改变对网络拓扑的编码表示方式。
AI.result: 在覆盖五个领域的二十个网络上进行实验，BioGlyph显著提升了开源LLM回答结构推理问题的准确率，相比基于边的、数值的和学习到的表示方法，系统准确率最高提升26个百分点。消融实验表明增益来自以语义可解释术语显式编码结构角色。增益在密集、社区结构明显的网络中更为显著，在结构可从文本更容易推断的稀疏网络中增益减弱。在芽殖酵母蛋白互作网络上，跨社区连接器富集必需基因，而外围蛋白则相反（贫乏）。
AI.conclusion: BioGlyph为LLM和科学家提供了一种可解释的、可用于推理网络结构的表示方法。它显式编码结构角色这一语义层面，使得LLM无需从原始数据中推断结构含义即可进行有效的结构推理，同时该表示具有生物学意义，能揭示如跨社区连接器富集必需基因等现象，实现了AI网络推理与领域科学的衔接。

title: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
summary: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchmark for measuring this capability across world-knowledge conflicts, input inconsistencies, and multi-source temporal conflicts. Its 238 tasks are manually screened from more than 1,000 generated candidates and combine a user simulator, stateful tools, deterministic environment assertions, an open-source natural-language evaluator, and human trajectory verification. Evaluation of nine models, including DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3, shows substantial cross-domain variation: no model handles factual correction, identity consistency checking, and temporal conflict resolution reliably across all settings. In the simulated environments, missed conflicts can propagate to tool calls or synthetic protected-data flows. KC-Bench isolates this model-level behavior rather than ranking complete agent frameworks, and provides a reproducible diagnostic for developing conflict-aware reasoning and execution safeguards.

AI.tldr: KC-Bench是一个用于测量LLM在工具使用过程中处理多源冲突能力的受控多轮基准测试，包含238个手工筛选的任务，涵盖世界知识冲突、输入不一致性和多源时间冲突三类场景。评测9个模型后发现，没有模型能在事实纠正、身份一致性检查和时间冲突解决上跨所有设置可靠工作。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地通过工具采取行动，模型必须在采取行动前协调用户指令、参数化知识与动态环境观察三者之间的关系。然而现有基准缺乏对这一"冲突感知推理"能力的系统性测量，因此需要一个受控基准来隔离并评估模型在处理不同类型冲突时的表现。
AI.method: 构建KC-Bench基准：从超过1000个生成候选中人工筛选出238个任务，覆盖三类冲突（世界知识冲突、输入不一致、多源时间冲突）。基准整合了用户模拟器、有状态工具、确定性环境断言、开源的NLP评估器，以及人工轨迹验证。对9个模型（包括DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2和MiniMax-M3）进行多轮评测。
AI.result: 评测结果表明模型存在显著的跨领域表现差异：没有任何模型能在事实纠正、身份一致性检查和时间冲突解决三类任务上跨所有设置可靠工作。在模拟环境中，未被发现的冲突可能传播为错误的工具调用或合成受保护数据的流动。KC-Bench成功隔离了模型层面的行为，而非对完整智能体框架进行排名。
AI.conclusion: KC-Bench提供了一个可复现的诊断工具，用于评测和开发冲突感知推理与执行安全保障机制，帮助推动LLM在工具使用场景中更可靠地融合多源信息并做出正确决策。

title: RoughSense: Lightweight Terrain-Induced Rover Vibration Prediction Using Point Clouds and IMU Feedback
summary: Autonomous navigation in space requires reliable terrain assessment for safe operations, especially in underground environments with limited communication, computing resources, and power budget. This paper presents a lightweight method for real-time vibration-aware traversability mapping using a Light Detecting And Ranging (LiDAR) point cloud and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements. An initial vibration proxy is estimated from terrain geometry by applying Random sample consensus (RANSAC) to local point-cloud patches produced by a Simultaneous Localisation And Mapping (SLAM) algorithm. In parallel, the IMU provides local observations of the vibration experienced by the rover during traversal. The point-cloud-based prediction is then corrected online using Recursive Least Squares, allowing the system to adapt the geometric estimate to the measured rover response. The approach is evaluated in a lunar analogue environment, an outdoor field, and an underground mine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LiDAR点云和IMU测量的轻量级实时颠簸感知可通行性测绘方法，用于地下等资源受限环境中的自主导航。该方法通过RANSAC从SLAM生成的局部点云补丁估计初始振动代理，并行利用IMU观测实际颠簸，并通过递推最小二乘（RLS）在线校正几何估计，使系统适应真实的车辆响应。方法在月球模拟环境、户外场地和地下矿井中进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 太空自主导航需要可靠的地形评估以确保安全操作，然而地下环境通信受限、计算资源和功耗预算有限，现有的可通行性测绘方法难以同时满足实时性、轻量化和颠簸感知的精度需求。
AI.method: 使用SLAM算法生成局部点云补丁，通过RANSAC拟合并估计地形几何特征作为初始振动代理；同时利用IMU测量漫游车实际经历的振动；最后采用递推最小二乘（RLS）在线校正点云几何估计，将几何预测与实测响应自适应融合。
AI.result: 方法在月球模拟环境、户外场场地和地下矿井三个场景中进行了实验评估，验证了其在真实环境中进行实时颠簸感知可通行性测绘的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了利用LiDAR几何信息与IMU实测振动信号相结合，通过在线自适应校正机制，可以在计算和功耗受限的地下环境中实现可靠的实时颠簸可通行性测绘，为太空自主导航提供了轻量级解决方案。

title: Neural-Collapse-guided Task-Free Continual Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent years have witnessed growing interest in continual anomaly detection for industrial visual inspection. However, real-world manufacturing environments exhibit unpredictable shifts in data distributions, rendering task-dependent continual learning assumptions impractical. To address this limitation, we formulate industrial anomaly detection as a task-free continual learning problem and propose NC-TFAD, a neural-collapse-inspired, geometry-driven framework for learning from non-stationary data streams without task boundaries. NC-TFAD freezes a pretrained backbone and aligns streaming features to a simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) prototype space to stabilize representation geometry under non-stationary streams. To satisfy the NC-inspired geometric construction in the absence of real anomalies, we generate synthetic anomaly samples as auxiliary anchors during training. Building on this geometry, we further introduce inter- and intra-class regularization together with a Focal Neural Collapse Contrastive (FNCC) loss to suppress representation drift and improve normal-anomaly separability. Finally, a normal-patch-prototype-guided localization branch constructs calibrated patch-wise deviation maps from normal training samples and fuses them with a weak self-attention prior, producing anomaly heatmaps without pixel-level annotations. Extensive experiments on MVTec AD and VisA show that NC-TFAD consistently outperforms representative task-free continual learning methods adapted from general vision, as well as unified anomaly detection baselines, in both image-level detection and pixel-level localization under the task-free continual learning protocol. These results highlight that geometry-driven modeling offers an effective and robust solution for task-free continual anomaly detection in real-world industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NC-TFAD，一个受神经塌缩（Neural Collapse）启发的几何驱动框架，用于无任务边界的工业异常检测持续学习。该框架冻结预训练骨干网络，将流式特征对齐到单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）原型空间，结合合成异常样本、类间/类内正则化和焦神经塌缩对比（FNCC）损失来抑制表征漂移，并通过正常patch原型引导的定位分支生成异常热图，在MVTec AD和VisA上优于现有无任务持续学习方法。
AI.motivation: 真实制造环境中的数据分布会发生不可预测的漂移，传统基于任务边界假设的持续异常检测方法不切实际。现有方法缺乏在无任务边界、数据流式到达场景下同时保持检测精度和表征稳定性、且无需像素级标注的解决方案。
AI.method: NC-TFAD包含以下核心设计：(1) 将工业异常检测形式化为无任务持续学习问题，冻结预训练骨干，将流式特征对齐到单纯形ETF原型空间以稳定表征几何；(2) 通过生成合成异常样本作为辅助锚点，满足无真实异常情况下NC几何构造的需求；(3) 引入类间/类内正则化与FNCC损失，抑制表征漂移并增强正常-异常可分性；(4) 正常patch原型引导的定位分支构建逐patch校准偏差图，与弱自注意力先验融合生成异常热图，无需像素级标注。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上的实验表明，NC-TFAD在无任务持续学习协议下的图像级检测和像素级定位任务中，一致优于从通用视觉适配的代表性无任务持续学习方法以及统一异常检测基线。
AI.conclusion: 几何驱动的建模方法为真实工业应用中无任务持续的异常检测提供了有效且稳健的解决方案，神经塌缩理论在流式无监督异常检测场景中具有较大潜力。

title: Inferring Hidden User Models from the Behavior of Personalized LLM Agents
summary: Recent personalized LLM agents increasingly transform information retained in memory into compressed or structured representations, which we call user models, to guide later decisions. When source wording is removed from the state reachable through the ordinary interface, these models are commonly treated as more privacy-preserving because direct memory-extraction attacks lose the text they target. Yet we argue that user models expose a new attack surface because an attacker can still recover the private information from the personalized choices they shape, even when source records and backend state remain inaccessible. We therefore introduce UMPeek, a black-box attack based on hypothesis-guided adaptive probing to infer such hidden user model. It forms hypotheses from choices left open by a request, switches among ordinary follow-up tasks, and retains only claims supported and not contradicted by visible behavior. We conduct an extensive benchmark evaluation across diverse personalization tasks and user-model backends against existing attacks. We further validate UMPeek in real-world systems using information confirmed to be retained, and we evaluate defenses against its adaptive probing. Overall, UMPeek outperforms existing attacks in both benchmark and real-world comparisons and continues to recover user information under response-level defenses, showing that keeping records and backend state inaccessible does not guarantee semantic privacy when retained information shapes visible behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UMPeek，一种针对个性化LLM智能体中隐藏用户模型的黑盒攻击方法。尽管后端状态和源记录无法直接访问，UMPeek通过假设引导的自适应探测，从个性化选择中推断出私有用户信息，证明仅通过不暴露记录和后端状态无法保证语义隐私。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM智能体将记忆压缩为用户模型来指导决策，通常被认为更保护隐私，因为直接的内存提取攻击找不到目标文本。但作者认为，用户模型暴露了新的攻击面——即使源记录和后端状态不可访问，攻击者仍可以从这些模型所塑造的个性化选择中恢复私人信息。
AI.method: UMPeek是一种黑盒攻击方法，基于假设引导的自适应探测。它从请求所开放的选择空间形成假设，在不同普通后续任务之间切换，仅保留被可见行为支持且未被反驳的声明，从而逐步推断隐藏的用户模型。
AI.result: 在多样化的个性化任务和用户模型后端上进行大规模基准评估，并在真实系统上验证，UMPeek均优于现有攻击方法。同时，即使在响应级防御下仍能持续恢复用户信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当保留的信息塑造可见行为时，即便源记录和后端状态都不可访问，也不足以保证语义隐私。个性化智能体需要重新审视其隐私保护假设，并考虑针对自适应探测的新型防御策略。

title: SWIM: Student Writing Simulation via Proficiency-Conditioned Generation
summary: Writing proficiency manifests in how students develop content, organize ideas, choose words, and use language. Despite growing interest in LLM-based student simulation, whether LLMs can reproduce such multidimensional variation in extended writing remains largely unexplored. In this work, we explore if language models can realistically simulate student writing, and introduce SWIM, a task that formulates Student Writing sIMulation as proficiency-conditioned essay generation. We evaluate prompting, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) methods for writing simulation using automated essay scoring as a measure of profile alignment. Extensive experiments reveal that prompting provides limited proficiency control, even for strong proprietary LLMs with rubric-grounded strategies. In particular, while models can adjust content-oriented traits, they struggle to reproduce the lexical, grammatical, and organizational variation in different proficiency levels. SFT substantially improves alignment, while RL with the proposed proficiency-alignment reward yields further gains across all writing traits and essay prompts. Our findings suggest that explicit supervision enables substantially stronger profile alignment than prompting alone, while authentic low-proficiency writing remains challenging to reproduce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWIM任务，探索LLM是否能够真实模拟学生写作，通过自动化作文评分衡量不同写作能力维度的对齐情况。研究发现：提示方法对能力控制有限，尤其在词汇、语法和组织等风格维度上；监督微调（SFT）显著提升对齐效果，而基于能力对齐奖励的强化学习（RL）进一步改善各写作维度和提示条件的表现。真实低水平写作仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM学生模拟日益受到关注，但现有研究尚未系统探索LLM是否能在扩展写作中再现学生写作的多维度变化（如内容发展、观点组织、词汇选择和语言使用）。需要一种标准化的方法来评估和提升LLM对学生写作的模拟能力。
AI.method: 引入SWIM任务，将学生写作模拟形式化为能力条件化的作文生成。评估三种方法：提示（prompting）、监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），并使用自动化作文评分作为能力配置文件对齐的度量指标。RL方法使用了提出的能力对齐奖励（proficiency-alignment reward）。
AI.result: 提示方法（即使是强专有LLM配合评分标准策略）对能力水平的控制有限，模型能调整内容相关特征但难以再现不同能力级别的词汇、语法和组织差异。SFT大幅改善对齐效果，而结合能力对齐奖励的RL在所有写作特质和作文提示上带来进一步提升。但真实低水平写作的复现仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: 显式监督比仅靠提示能实现更强的能力配置文件对齐，建议在需要精确模拟特定写作能力水平时使用SFT或RL而非提示方法。真实低能力写作的模拟仍是开放挑战，未来工作可聚焦于此。

title: The 2026 PNPL Competition: Word Classification and Efficient Cross-Subject Generalisation in LibriBrain100
summary:
The ambition of the 2025 PNPL competition (Landau et al., 2025) was to launch a multi-year curriculum for non-invasive speech decoding. Designed to progress from foundational tasks toward the linguistic complexity required for a practical brain-computer interface (BCI), it set the stage with speech detection and phoneme classification tasks. Winning submissions reached F1-macro scores of 95.6% and 73.6% on the respective tasks (Elvers et al., 2026), highly significant advances. This success was built on the LibriBrain dataset (Özdogan et al., 2025), the largest within-subject MEG dataset recorded at the time with ${\sim}50$ hours of data for one subject. However, while within-subject scale drives strong decoding performance, a practical BCI must generalise to new users from minutes of data, not hours.
  The 2026 PNPL competition responds to this challenge with LibriBrain100 (Mantegna et al., 2026), an extended LibriBrain dataset with 32 additional subjects (${\sim}40$ minutes each) plus even more within-subject data (${\sim}80$ hours). Advancing the curriculum of tasks to focus on word classification, two complementary tracks are presented in this competition: the Deep track targets within-subject word classification at scale, aiming at the best possible performance; the Broad track targets cross-subject generalisation, progressively reducing the amount of subject-specific fine-tuning data from ${\sim}40$ to ${\sim}20$ to ${\sim}10$ minutes, a duration that falls within a clinically feasible range and brings us a step closer to a non-invasive BCI capable of restoring communication to people living with profound paralysis.

AI.tldr: 2026 PNPL竞赛基于扩展的LibriBrain100数据集（新增32名被试及约80小时个体内数据），聚焦词分类任务，设计Deep和Broad两条赛道，分别针对个体内大规模词分类和跨个体泛化，微调数据从约40分钟递减至10分钟，迈向临床可行的非侵入性脑机接口。
AI.motivation: 实际可用的脑机接口需从少量数据中泛化到新用户，而现有以个体内大规模数据驱动的解码性能（如2025 PNPL竞赛的95.6%和73.6% F1）无法满足这一临床需求。因此需要推进竞赛课程至跨个体泛化场景，并验证分钟级微调数据的可行性。
AI.method: 扩展LibriBrain数据集至LibriBrain100，新增32名被试（各约40分钟）及更多个体内数据（约80小时）；竞赛任务从语音检测和音素分类推进至词分类，设置两条互补赛道：Deep赛道专注个体内大规模词分类，Broad赛道聚焦跨个体泛化，并系统递减微调数据量（40→20→10分钟）以测试临床可行边界。
AI.result: 2025 PNPL竞赛获胜方案分别达到95.6%（语音检测）和73.6%（音素分类）的F1-macro分数；2026年竞赛通过上述赛道设计和数据集扩展，向分钟级跨个体泛化目标推进。
AI.conclusion: 通过多学科竞赛驱动的课程化设计，从中级词分类任务出发，逐步逼近需要少量新用户数据即可实现非侵入式语音解码的临床脑机接口目标，为重度瘫痪患者恢复沟通能力提供可能。

title: A computable representation of the physical laboratory enables verifiable workflows
summary: Making science computable requires representations of both scientific knowledge and the physical world in which scientific claims are tested. A computable representation of the physical laboratory is established through typed research objects, capability-bound operations and a compositional workflow algebra. It provides the physical-world counterpart to machine-readable knowledge, expressing workflows as programs over evolving laboratory states with explicit dependencies, decisions, iteration and concurrency. The representation was implemented in a modular agentic robotic laboratory by binding formal operations to executable Function Skills. For diverse scientific intents, capability-relative workflows were generated, while stateful simulation propagated object transformations and verified operation preconditions and laboratory constraints before dispatch. The proposed representation and its engineering framework jointly establish a general computational interface between agent reasoning and capability-bound physical transformations, providing a foundation for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可计算表示物理实验室的框架,通过类型化研究对象、能力约束操作和组合式工作流代数,将科学工作流表达为可执行程序,并在模块化智能机器人实验室中实现,为端到端自主科学发现奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 使科学可计算不仅需要机器可读的科学知识表示,还需要对物理世界（科学主张得以检验的场所）的可计算表示。现有方法缺少将物理实验室操作与智能推理相连接的通用计算接口。
AI.method: 建立基于类型化研究对象的物理实验室可计算表示,定义能力约束操作和组合式工作流代数,将工作流表达为程序（支持依赖、决策、迭代与并发）。在模块化智能机器人实验室中,将形式化操作绑定到可执行功能技能(Function Skills),并通过有状态模拟传播对象变换、验证操作前置条件和实验室约束后再调度。
AI.result: 针对多种科学意图生成了能力相对的工作流；状态模拟能够正确传播对象变换并验证操作前置条件与实验室约束,最终在物理实验室中成功执行。
AI.conclusion: 该可计算表示及其工程框架共同建立了智能体推理与能力约束物理变换之间的一般性计算接口,为端到端自主科学发现提供了基础。

title: A Multi-Vine Soft Robot Enabling Accessible Working Channel and Steering
summary: Soft eversion robots, also known as vine robots, have attracted growing interest for navigation and inspection tasks, including minimally invasive medical applications [1]. A vine robot consists of a thin, flexible, inextensible tube folded inward that everts and grows forward when pressurized. This tip-growth enables navigation with minimal friction, making vine robots well suited for complex environments such as the human colon [2]. While their inherent softness allows passive conforma- tion to curved pathways in confined spaces, navigation performance strongly depends on environmental inter- actions, including contact angle and the length of un- constrained deployed material [3], [4]. Sharp directional changes, such as those in the sigmoid colon, often limit passive growth and necessitate active steering. Existing solutions include distributed artificial muscles [5] or dedicated tip-based steering mechanisms [6]. In addition, many applications require payload delivery, such as sensors and tools [7], [8]. Within the ERC Synergy project EndoTheranostics, this motivates the development of vine robots capable of delivering micro- surgical tools during growth. Prior work has integrated working channels within the vine body [8], [9], but these approaches constrain tool size, introduce friction, and limit access to the environment to the robot tip. In this work, we propose a multi-vine architecture in which two vine robots are coupled to an externally integrated working channel via soft mounting tips [10]. Independent vine actuation enables active tip steering while advancing the working channel without embed- ding it within the vine bodies Figure 1. Experiments demonstrate sharp steering of nearly 90 degrees during growth, highlighting the potential of this architecture for versatile medical and non-medical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多藤蔓（multi-vine）软体外翻机器人架构，通过将两根藤蔓机器人通过软安装尖端与外部集成的工作通道耦合，实现了在生长过程中近90度的锐角主动转向，避免了将工作通道嵌入藤蔓主体所带来的工具尺寸限制和摩擦问题。
AI.motivation: 藤蔓机器人（vine robots）因尖端生长机制使其在曲折环境中（如人体结肠）能以最小摩擦导航，但被动生长在急转弯（如乙状结肠）处受限，需要主动转向。同时，现有应用中需要负载递送（传感器、工具等），而先前将工作通道嵌入藤蔓内部的方法会限制工具尺寸、引入摩擦，且只能通过机器人尖端接触环境。这促使研究者探索新的架构以同时解决主动转向和外部工具通道递送问题。
AI.method: 提出一种多藤蔓架构：将两根藤蔓机器人通过软安装尖端耦合到一个外部集成的工作通道上。两根藤蔓可独立驱动，从而在不将工作通道嵌入藤蔓本体的情况下实现主动尖端转向，同时推进工作通道前进。软安装尖端用于连接藤蔓与工作通道，兼顾柔顺性。
AI.result: 实验表明该架构在生长过程中能够实现近90度的锐角转向，验证了该设计在主动导航和工具递送方面的可行性，展示了其在医疗及非医疗领域的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 多藤蔓耦合外部工作通道的架构为藤蔓机器人提供了一种新颖且有效的设计方案，克服了传统嵌入工作通道方式的尺寸与摩擦限制，同时实现主动锐角转向，具有广泛的医学和非医学应用前景。

title: Mudragen: Geometrically Supervised Generation of Interacting Two-Hand Mudras for Preserving Indian Classical Dance Heritage
comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage (JOCCH) Special Issue on Visual Heritage
summary: Automatic generation of hand gestures is essential for the transmission of Indian classical dance and critical for its preservation. Indian classical dance gesture datasets are inherently low-resource, and the canonical Sanskrit definitions of many mudras lack precise textual descriptions, limiting the effectiveness of conventional text-conditioned image generation models. We present \textbf{MudraGen}, a conditional diffusion framework that synthesizes realistic RGB images of \textit{Samyukta Hasta Mudras} -- interactive two-hand gestures from Bharatanatyam (an Indian classical dance form). Unlike prior work on simple hand signs or single-hand gestures, MudraGen introduces geometry-aware supervision to capture the precise coordination, anatomical validity, and cultural nuance of interacting hands. We formulate three geometry-aware objectives: Keypoint Loss for 3D joint alignment, Joint Offset Loss for inter-hand spatial coherence, and Shape Consistency, which serves as an anatomical regularizer by encouraging consistent hand morphology while allowing independent hand poses. Together, these objectives guide the diffusion model toward anatomically plausible and well-coordinated hand configurations, enabling the synthesis of photorealistic and pose-accurate gesture images. Experimental results show that MudraGen surpasses existing state-of-the-art generative approaches in visual realism, anatomical correctness, and preservation of fine hand-pose structure, enabling faithful reproduction of complex Samyukta Hasta mudras. Beyond quantitative gains, its ability to generate culturally grounded and structurally consistent gestures highlights practical applications in cultural preservation and dance education.

AI.tldr: MudraGen是一个基于条件扩散框架的模型，用于自动生成Bharatanatyam古典舞中的Samyukta Hasta Mudras（双手交互手势）的真实RGB图像。该模型通过引入三个几何感知目标（关键点损失、关节偏移损失和形状一致性）来监督扩散模型，确保生成的手势在解剖学上合理且双手协调精准，超越了现有的生成方法。
AI.motivation: 印度古典舞手势的自动生成对其传承和保护至关重要。然而，该领域数据集资源稀缺（低资源），且许多mudras的梵文经典定义缺乏精确文本描述，限制了传统文本条件图像生成模型的有效性。此外，以往研究仅针对简单手语或单手手势，无法处理双手交互手势中复杂的协调与解剖结构。
AI.method: 提出MudraGen条件扩散框架，引入三个几何感知监督目标：(1) Keypoint Loss用于3D关节对齐，(2) Joint Offset Loss用于双手间的空间一致性，(3) Shape Consistency作为解剖学正则化器，在允许双手独立姿态的同时保持手部形态的一致性。这些目标共同引导扩散模型生成解剖学合理且双手协调的Samyukta Hasta Mudra图像。
AI.result: 实验表明，MudraGen在视觉真实感、解剖学正确性和精细手部姿态结构保持方面均超越了现有最先进的生成方法，能够忠实地复现复杂的Samyukta Hasta Mudras手势。
AI.conclusion: MudraGen不仅能产生定量上的性能提升，还能生成具有文化根基且结构一致的姿态，展示了其在文化保护和舞蹈教育中的实际应用价值。

title: Flip, Don't Shuffle: Watermarking LLMs at the Speed of Inference
summary: We introduce Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking (SBW), a new statistical watermark for Large Language Models that determines green list membership through independent per-token Bernoulli trials. Unlike KGW's vocabulary permutation or SynthID's multi-layer tournament, SBW requires only a single comparison per token against a counter-based random number generator, reducing membership complexity to $O(1)$ and enabling single-kernel execution with zero intermediate allocations. We prove that this formulation preserves the same detection guarantees as fixed-size green lists: the z-score test remains $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$ under the null. The stateless architecture enables capabilities unavailable to existing methods: full-vocabulary self-salt watermarking (over 6000$\times$ faster than KGW's self-salt and 2$\times$ faster than SynthID despite biasing the entire vocabulary with candidate-dependent seeding) and architectural compatibility with distributed inference. In end-to-end generation benchmarks, SBW adds less than 1\% overhead at all batch sizes. We additionally identify hash function design as a previously unexplored axis for watermark quality, showing that a GPU-native Jenkins hash improves null calibration by 1.8$\times$ while producing more diverse text. Experiments across two seeding schemes and eight $(γ, δ)$ configurations confirm statistical equivalence with ROC-AUC differences below 0.01.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking (SBW)的新型大语言模型统计水印方法，通过独立逐token伯努利试验确定green list成员关系，实现O(1)的成员复杂度、零中间分配的单一内核执行，同时保持与固定大小green list相同的检测保证。
AI.motivation: 现有水印方法如KGW的词汇置换需要较高的成员判定复杂度，SynthID的多层锦标赛结构复杂且存在中间分配开销。此外，无状态架构缺失导致无法实现全词表自盐渍水印和分布式推理兼容性。作者还发现哈希函数设计作为水印质量的影响轴未被充分探索。
AI.method: SBW使用基于计数器的随机数生成器进行独立的逐token伯努利试验来决定green list membership，将成员复杂度从置换/锦标赛方案降低到O(1)。该方法采用无状态架构支持全词表自盐渍水印，并提出GPU原生Jenkins哈希来改善检测判定和改进文本多样性。使用z-score检验进行检测，数学上证明了原假设下z-score服从N(0,1)。
AI.result: SBW在自盐渍水印方面比KGW快6000倍以上，比SynthID快2倍；在各种批量大小的端到端生成基准中，SBW引入的开销低于1%；Jenkins哈希使null校准改善1.8倍且产生更多样化的文本；在两种种子方案和八个(γ, δ)配置下，ROC-AUC差异小于0.01，确认了统计等价性。
AI.conclusion: SBW通过无状态伯努利设计在保持检测保证的同时实现了计算效率的显著提升，开启了全词表自盐渍和分布式推理等新能力，并揭示了哈希函数选择作为水印质量优化的重要维度。

title: The Analyst in the Prompt: Role, Retrieval, and Memory Biases in LLM Financial Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly use user context such as memory, profiles, and role prompts to personalize their responses. This personalization can affect evidence-based judgment: the same evidence may lead to different conclusions under different user contexts. Finance provides a high-stakes setting to study this problem because decisions often depend on interpreting long and complex documents. We test this using 3,575 SEC filings across twelve LLMs. We compare persona-conditioned retrieval, neutral retrieval, and memory-framed context to separate the effect of evidence selection from the effect of interpretation. We find that most user-context spillover comes from how models interpret the same evidence under different roles, rather than from retrieving different evidence. We then test two simple mitigation strategies: expressing the same investor mindset as a user profile instead of an assistant role, and separating evidence-based and personalized outputs. Both reduce spillover, but neither removes it completely, and their effectiveness varies substantially across models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLMs）中的用户上下文（如记忆、角色提示）如何影响以证据为基础的判断。通过12个LLM分析3575份SEC文件，发现多数用户上下文溢出效应源于模型在不同角色下对相同证据的解释差异，而非证据检索差异。两种缓解策略（将投资者思维表述为用户画像而非助手角色；分离基于证据的输出与个性化输出）均能减少但无法完全消除溢出，且效果因模型而异。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地使用记忆、画像和角色提示等用户上下文进行个性化回应，这可能影响基于证据的判断——相同证据在不同用户背景下可能得出不同结论。金融领域是高风险的测试场景，因为决策常依赖于解读冗长复杂的文档。
AI.method: 使用3575份SEC（美国证券交易委员会）文件，在12个LLM上进行测试。设计三种条件——人格条件化检索（persona-conditioned retrieval）、中性检索（neutral retrieval）和记忆框架上下文（memory-framed context）——以区分证据选择效应与解释效应的各自影响。随后测试两种缓解策略：将相同的投资者思维表述为用户画像而非助手角色，以及分离基于证据的输出与个性化输出。
AI.result: 大多数用户上下文溢出效应来自于模型在不同角色下对相同证据的解读差异，而非检索不同证据所致。两种缓解策略都能减少溢出，但均无法完全消除，且其有效性在不同模型之间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 用户上下文对LLM基于证据的判断有可测的影响，主要来源是解释层面的偏差。已测试的简单缓解策略虽有效但有局限，说明需要更深入的方案来解决用户上下文与证据推理之间的干扰问题。

title: B2B Customer Conversion Prediction: A Document Representation, Graph Theory, and CatBoost Driven Methodology
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Presented at the 2nd Workshop on End-End Customer Journey Optimization at KDD 2023
summary: In the one-time selling B2B context, the buying cycle may last months or even years. During the long process, targeting customers that have a high potential to make purchases and recommending personalized campaigns accordingly are important for effective marketing. For this goal, we study the following problems, B2B customer data aggregation, customer feature generation, and prediction of whether a B2B customer would show interest in making a purchase (i.e., prediction of conversion into sales funnel). We propose an algorithm to aggregate individual contacts to the B2B customer level based on multiple keys. For non-standardized keys such as company names, we propose a novel architecture to cluster them in a domain encompassing irregularities such as spelling mistakes and spelling variants. We then define and generate a set of features and apply the CatBoost model for customer conversion prediction. Our framework achieves 91\% prediction accuracy. Based on the prediction results and analysis of the model, we then discuss personalized campaign recommendations to foster conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文针对B2B一次性销售场景中购买周期长的问题，提出了从客户数据聚合、特征生成到购买意向预测（转化率预测）的完整框架，采用基于多键的聚合算法和CatBoost模型，实现了91%的预测准确率，并基于预测结果讨论个性化营销活动推荐。
AI.motivation: 在B2B一次性销售中，购买周期可能长达数月甚至数年，需要识别高潜力客户并推荐个性化营销活动以提升营销效果。同时，B2B客户数据存在字段非标准化（如公司名称拼写错误和变体）等挑战，亟需有效的聚合和预测方法。
AI.method: 提出一个三层框架：(1) 基于多键的B2B客户级数据聚合算法；(2) 对非标准化键（如公司名称）提出一种新型聚类架构，能处理拼写错误和拼写变体等不规则情况；(3) 定义并生成一组特征，应用CatBoost模型进行客户转化预测。
AI.result: 所提出的框架在客户转化预测任务上达到91%的预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测结果和模型分析，进一步讨论了针对高潜力客户的个性化营销活动推荐策略，以促进销售漏斗中的有效转化。

title: Analysis of Prompt Engineering for Drug Toxicity Prediction
summary: Clinical trials in the UK can cost up to £1.3 million, with approximately 90% drug failure rate. Toxicity is a major contributing factor in drug failure. Testing is time and cost intensive. In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence has been increasingly explored to aid in the prediction of drug toxicity, with extensive use of large language models (LLMs). However, LLMs can show considerable variation when minor changes are made to prompts, which raises concerns about their sensitivity to prompt engineering. Prompt engineering is used to optimise a prompt given to an LLM to generate the desired output. This paper proposes a method to analyse prompt engineering for drug toxicity prediction. The aim of the paper is to investigate the importance of prompt phrasing for drug toxicity prediction. LLMs were prompted to identify chemical properties of significance when predicting drug toxicity. Prompts were constructed to investigate; job role, prompt structuring, and rule interpretation. LLMs were then used to generate datasets, using the identified features from initial prompting, which were then passed to machine learning algorithms. The experiments show that the natural variance which occurs in LLMs outweighs any fine-tuning of prompts. There were, however, substantial improvements in model performance when using chemoinformatic code to extract features instead of using LLM-generated values. The proposed analysis methodology is applicable to a wide range of prompt types across different areas of bioinformatics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分析提示工程对药物毒性预测影响的方法。实验表明，LLM的自然方差超过了任何提示微调带来的影响，而使用化学信息学代码提取特征比使用LLM生成的值能显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 英国临床试验成本高达130万英镑且药物失败率约90%，毒性是药物失败的主要因素。虽然LLM被广泛用于药物毒性预测，但LLM对提示工程的微小变化极为敏感，这一敏感性影响预测结果的可靠性，因此需要系统研究提示措辞对药物毒性预测的重要性。
AI.method: 设计多种提示变量（职业角色、提示结构、规则解释），让LLM识别对药物毒性预测有意义的化学性质；随后使用LLM生成的数据集输入机器学习算法，同时对比使用化学信息学代码提取特征的方式，以评估不同提示工程策略对预测性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现LLM内在的自然方差超过了提示微调带来的性能差异；然而，使用化学信息学代码提取特征相较LLM生成的特征值，能带来显著的模型性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分析方法论适用于生物信息学领域广泛的提示类型，为评估LLM在药物毒性预测中的可靠性提供了系统框架，并提示应优先考虑确定性特征提取方法。

title: Virtual Testing of Automated Driving Systems through Credible Simulations
summary: Simulation is increasingly used to support safety-related decision-making in road transport, particularly for the assessment and approval of automated driving systems (ADS). The complexity of ADS behavior and size of their operational design domains make exclusive reliance on physical testing impractical, leading to extensive use of virtual testing (VT) during the approval phase. This shift raises critical questions regarding the credibility of modelling and simulation (M&S) results used to support road safety decisions. Current VT accreditation approaches in the ADS domain typically rely on validation-only practices, which have been shown to scale poorly when applied to complex, multi-tool simulation environments. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a risk-based framework for assessing the credibility of simulation toolchains used in ADS safety evaluation, drawing inspiration from established practices in other safety-critical domains, notably NASA's STD-7009 for models and simulations. The framework extends traditional verification and validation (V&V) by explicitly linking credibility requirements to the intended use of simulation outputs and to the safety criticality of the decisions they support within the approval process. It provides a lifecycle-oriented assessment scheme integrating toolchain management, modelling assumptions and limitations, verification, validation, and sensitivity analysis. Credibility acceptance thresholds are defined proportionally, allowing differentiated requirements depending on whether simulation is used for exploratory safety analysis, partial decision support, or as a substitute for physical testing. While demonstrated for ADS, the proposed approach is directly applicable to road safety and simulation studies where VT plays a central role in safety assessment and regulatory decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于风险的可信度评估框架，用于评估自动驾骳系统（ADS）安全评估中仿真工具链的可信度，借鉴NASA STD-7009等安全关键领域的实践，将可信度要求与仿真输出的预期用途及决策安全关键性显式关联。该框架提供覆盖工具链管理、建模假设与局限、验证、确认及敏感性分析的生命周期导向评估方案，可信度接受阈值按比例定义，支持从探索性安全分析到替代物理测试的不同用途差异化要求。
AI.motivation: ADS的复杂性和运营设计域（ODD）规模使得纯物理测试不切实际，虚拟测试（VT）在审批阶段被广泛使用，但现有ADS领域的VT认证方法通常仅依赖验证（validation-only）实践，在复杂多工具仿真环境中扩展性差。需要在审批决策中评估仿真结果的可信度，以支持道路安全决策。
AI.method: 提出一个基于风险的仿真工具链可信度评估框架：1）借鉴NASA STD-7009等安全关键域实践；2）扩展传统V&V，将可信度要求与仿真输出的预期用途及所支持决策的安全关键性显式关联；3）提供生命周期导向的评估方案，涵盖工具链管理、建模假设与局限、验证、确认及敏感性分析；4）可信度接受阈值按比例（proportional）定义，根据用途差异（探索性安全分析、部分决策支持、替代物理测试）设置差异化要求。
AI.result: 该框架在ADS领域得到演示验证，证明了其适用性。可信度接受阈值的比例化定义允许根据仿真用途的安全关键程度区分要求，解决了验证-only方法在复杂多工具环境中扩展性差的问题。该框架还可直接应用于道路安全和以虚拟测试为核心的仿真研究。
AI.conclusion: 该风险驱动的可信度评估框架为ADS审批中仿真工具链的可信度评估提供了系统化方法，超越了传统的验证-only实践，实现了与安全关键性匹配的差异化认证要求。虽在ADS领域演示，但可直接推广到道路安全及以VT为核心的安全评估和监管决策场景。

title: When Do Frozen VLMs Respond to Image-Free Object-Token Edits? An Answer-Key-Free Protocol and What It Reveals
summary: Answering what-if queries about a scene with a VLM usually means injecting the assumption as text or repainting the scene with a generative model. We instead move the edit to the representation level, before the model input. The image is abstracted into a set of object-level tokens, and the original image never enters the VLM. This design rests on an open question: when do frozen VLMs actually respond to such token edits? We introduce an answer-key-free protocol: no post-edit answer is annotated. It scores edits whose answers are logically determined, and audits itself by reversing each scoreable choice. The protocol reveals three structures. The response is not free: explicit edit teaching, not ordinary VQA training, produces it in dense scenes and multiplies it in sparse ones, on all three operations. Once on, it is governed by token cleanliness and density, with deployable detector+segmenter tokens competitive with the oracle and outperforming it on VRSBench. And reading is a separable axis: the image-free token route preserves 92-96% of a matched patch-token baseline's free-text VQA, and the answers measurably depend on the tokens. The response, cleanliness, and reading structures are sign-preserved across two remote-sensing datasets (iSAID, VRSBench) and three frozen LM backbones. We release the probe generator, records, judge logs, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需答案标注的协议，探究冻结VLM在"编辑对象级token而非原始图像"的假设性问题回答场景下是否真正响应此类编辑，并揭示响应存在的三个结构：需要显式编辑教学引导、受token清洁度与密度调控、以及可分离的阅读轴。
AI.motivation: 回答场景中的"what-if"假设性问题通常需要将假设以文本注入或用生成模型重绘场景，但这些方法都有局限。作者提出在表征层面（即模型输入之前）对图像进行对象级token编辑，但这一设计依赖于一个开放问题：冻结的VLM何时真正响应此类token编辑？本文旨在系统性探究这一问题。
AI.method: 将图像抽象为一组对象级token集合，原始图像不进入VLM。引入"无答案键"协议：不标注编辑后的答案，仅对逻辑上可确定的编辑进行评分，并通过反转每个可评分选择来自我审计。实验覆盖三种编辑操作、两个遥感数据集（iSAID、VRSBench）和三个冻结LM骨干。
AI.result: 揭示三个结构：(1) 响应不是免费的——显式编辑教学（而非普通VQA训练）才能触发密集场景中的响应并在稀疏场景中放大之；(2) 响应受token清洁度和密度调控，实际探测器+分割器token在VRSBench上可媲美甚至超越oracle；(3) 阅读是可分离轴——无图像token路线保留了匹配patch-token基线自由文本VQA的92-96%。三种结构在两个数据集和三个骨干上均保持符号一致。
AI.conclusion: 冻结VLM确实能在特定条件下"响应"对象级token编辑，且响应可调控、可预测。该无答案标注协议为评估此类编辑提供了可行框架，同时发现实际部署的视觉token可以与oracle竞争，为应用提供实用指导。作者已发布探针生成器、记录、法官日志及代码。

title: NACRE: Rethinking Confidential Containers through Native Architectural Support
comment: This is a position paper. We will update the manuscript once we complete the evaluation on FPGA platforms
summary:
Linux containers achieve high density and fast lifecycle operations by sharing the host kernel, but this design also lets a compromised host inspect or modify container state. Existing
  confidential-computing systems protect an enclave address space or an entire guest operating system, while recent container-granularity systems still add a separate protection context.
  These abstractions do not make a dynamic group of host-managed Linux processes the architectural protection unit.
  This paper presents NACRE, a RISC-V hardware-software co-design for native confidential containers. Its key insight is to separate the host's authority to manage resources from its
  authority to access or commit protected state. Hardware-recognized container identities direct protected traps to an isolated S-mode agent, while an M-mode monitor commits security-
  sensitive identity, mapping, and page transitions. The agent delegates services to host Linux without changing satp; services that neither access private bytes nor modify protected
  state also avoid M-mode. We prototype NACRE by extending QEMU, OpenSBI, Linux, a trusted agent, and runc. The prototype implements the single-container private-memory substrate and
  covered launch, fault, fork/COW, user-access, and teardown paths. Across five lmbench syscall and pipe metrics, the three-run means remain within 3.5% of the runc-origin baseline. With
  the eight nginx object-size means weighted equally, aggregate throughput is 1.9% lower.
