AI.tldr: NACRE是一个RISC-V硬件-软件协同设计的原生机密容器系统，通过将宿主机管理资源的权力与其访问/提交受保护状态的权力分离，以硬件识别的容器身份和隔离的S-mode代理实现容器粒度的机密保护，性能开销在3.5%以内。
AI.motivation: 现有Linux容器因共享宿主机内核而面临宿主妥协后容器状态可被检查或修改的安全威胁。已有的机密计算系统要么保护enclave地址空间，要么保护整个客户操作系统，而容器粒度的系统仍需额外增加保护上下文，未能将宿主机管理的动态Linux进程组作为架构级保护单元。
AI.method: NACRE采用RISC-V硬件-软件协同设计方法。核心洞察是分离宿主机管理资源的权限与其访问/提交受保护状态的权限。具体机制包括：硬件识别的容器身份将受保护的trap导向隔离的S-mode代理；M-mode监控器负责提交安全敏感的容器身份、映射和页面转换；代理在不改变satp的前提下向宿主机Linux委派服务，不访问私有字节且不修改受保护状态的服务可绕过M-mode。原型通过在QEMU、OpenSBI、Linux、可信代理和runc上的扩展实现。
AI.result: 原型实现了单容器私有内存子结构以及launch、fault、fork/COW、用户访问和teardown路径。在五项lmbench系统调用和管道指标中，三次运行均值与runc原始基线差距在3.5%以内；在八项nginx对象大小均值中，聚合吞吐量仅比基线低1.9%。
AI.conclusion: NACRE通过权限分离和硬件辅助的容器身份识别，在保持对宿主机Linux委派能力的同时实现了容器粒度的机密保护，且性能开销极低，证明了该设计在高密度容器场景下的可行性与实用性。

title: Counterfactual Fairness Audits of Multi-Step Clinical LLM Agents Require a Measured Per-Action Instability Floor
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/rohithreddybc/FairMedAgent
summary: Counterfactual audits are the standard tool for checking whether a clinical agent treats demographically distinct but clinically identical patients differently. They report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient descriptor changes. We show that this quantity is uninterpretable on its own. Re-running an identical condition ten times over sixteen vignettes (same narrative, same descriptor string, nothing varied) moved a clinical agent's action in 8.7% of outcome-vignette cells, and instability was heterogeneous across actions by a factor of eight, from 0.022 for ICU escalation to 0.179 for controlled-substance caution. No demographic contrast in our data was distinguishable from that floor. A second model gives a pooled floor of 6.7% and ranks the six actions almost identically (Spearman 0.94, exact p=0.017), so the floor is not one system's artefact. Majority-vote aggregation over five draws removes 39% of it and then flattens, and a null simulation attributes the residue to heterogeneous per-cell rates, so replication mitigates without eliminating. Any counterfactual fairness estimate reported without a per-action floor beside it therefore cannot be read as evidence of disparity. The measurements were taken with FairMedAgent, an evaluation harness for disparity in the actions of clinical LLM agents whose estimand, the within-range counterfactual flip rate, counts only flips between actions a published decision rule admits and a clinician has adjudicated. That estimand requires band adjudication, which is under way; no disparity result is claimed here. Each synthetic vignette runs a six-stage trajectory (five model-facing decisions around a deterministic environment step) under fixed-form conditions spanning race, sex, age, insurance, English proficiency, and their intersections. The harness, the floor protocol, and every analysis script are released.

AI.tldr: 本文指出"反事实审计"中常用的翻转率（flip rate）指标单独使用时不可解释。实验表明，即使完全复现相同条件（同一叙述、同一描述符、无任何改动），临床智能体在16个小场景中仍有8.7%的动作翻转；该不稳定性在不同动作间差异高达8倍（从ICU升级的0.022到管制药物警示的0.179），且任何人口学对比都无法与此基线区分。第二个模型给出类似的下限（6.7%），两模型动作排序几乎一致（Spearman 0.94），证明该下限并非单一系统的伪影。五次多数投票聚合可消除39%的噪声，零假设模拟表明残余噪声来源于异质性的个体格概率。因此，任何未附带逐动作基线的反事实公平性估计都不能被视为差异证据。
AI.motivation: 反事实审计是检验临床智能体是否对不同人口学描述但临床相同的患者区别对待的标准工具，其报告的翻转率被用于公平性判断。然而作者发现该指标存在严重的自身不稳定性（即使条件完全不变也会触发翻转），导致人口学对比结果无法与噪声基线区分，因此需要揭示这一缺陷并为该领域建立正确的评估方法论。
AI.method: 使用FairMedAgent评估框架，在16个小场景中复现同一条件十次（相同叙述、相同描述符串、无任何变量改变），测量临床LLM智能体动作的翻转率。实验涵盖六个动作类别和六种人口学维度（种族、性别、年龄、保险、英语熟练度及其交叉），计算逐动作不稳定性的"下限"（floor）。进行两次模型对照验证下限普遍性，采用多数投票聚合（五次抽取）测试降噪效果，并使用零假设模拟归因残余噪声。
AI.result: 同一条件复现十次产生了8.7%的动作翻转率（模型一），且不稳定性的逐动作异质性达8倍（0.022-0.179）；模型二下限为6.7%，六动作排序高度一致（Spearman 0.94, p=0.017），说明下限是跨系统的普遍现象。所有人口学对比均无法与该下限区分。多数投票聚合（五次）移除39%的噪声后趋于平稳，残余噪声由各格异质性的翻转率引起，即复现可缓解但无法消除噪声。所有工具和脚本已开源，人口学差异结论有待带裁决（band adjudication）后给出。
AI.conclusion: 反事实公平性估计在未附逐动作下限（floor）对照的情况下不可被解读为差异证据。翻转率指标本身因人为主观噪声的干扰而不具备可解释性，研究社区需要引入基线对照与聚合策略才能得出可信的公平性结论。

title: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience
comment: 28 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code and blog available
summary: A reasoning model can improve from its own on-policy experience, but this inner loop is fragile: terminal verifiers provide reliable yet sparse supervision, while dense same-model guidance can reinforce false confidence or overconcentrate learning on a narrow solution mode. We introduce FlowBalance, a verifier-grounded self-improvement method that learns a normalized distribution over complete responses. For each on-policy trajectory, a frozen training-time view of the same policy uses privileged context to produce token-level log-probability gains, which are aggregated into a trajectory-level self-guidance score. FlowBalance calibrates this score with the verifier-derived group advantage: guidance is retained on positive-advantage trajectories, reversed on negative-advantage trajectories, and disabled when the rollout group provides no outcome preference. The resulting energy exponentially reweights a reference policy, and profiled trajectory balance fits the normalized target with one log-partition estimate per rollout group. This realizes outcome-calibrated self-guidance via trajectory balance, without a separate token-level imitation loss. Our analysis establishes within-group contrast preservation, a minimum-change reverse-KL characterization, monotonic verifier control of target reward, and an exact correction against false-positive self-guidance on rejected responses. On mathematical reasoning, FlowBalance improves average performance over FlowRL on both Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, while also improving training speed and stability, avoiding direct OPSD's response-length collapse, and exhibiting higher correct-strategy diversity in a controlled AIME24 diagnostic.

AI.tldr: FlowBalance是一种基于验证器（verifier）的自我改进方法，通过轨迹平衡（trajectory balance）学习完整响应的归一化分布，利用冻结训练视角的策略产生token级对数概率增益作为自我引导分数，并与验证器派生的组优势（group advantage）进行校准，实现对正优势轨迹保留引导、负优势轨迹反转引导、无偏好时禁用引导的效果。在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上数学推理性能超越FlowRL，且训练更快更稳定。
AI.motivation: 推理模型可以从自身的on-policy经验中改进，但这一内循环是脆弱的：终端验证器虽然可靠但监督稀疏，而密集的同模型引导可能强化错误自信或将学习过度集中于单一解题模式。需要一种既利用验证器可靠性又能提供密集且校准良好的自我引导的方法。
AI.method: FlowBalance的核心方法包括：(1) 对每条on-policy轨迹，用冻结的训练期同策略视图结合特权上下文生成token级对数概率增益，聚合成轨迹级自我引导分数；(2) 用验证器派生的组优势对该分数进行校准——正优势轨迹保留引导，负优势轨迹反转引导，无结果偏好时禁用引导；(3) 通过能量函数对参考策略进行指数重加权，利用profiled trajectory balance对每个rollout组估计一次log-partition来拟合归一化目标，无需额外的token级模仿损失。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了组内对比保持、最小变化reverse-KL特征刻画、验证器对目标奖励的单调控制，以及对被拒响应上假阳性自我引导的精确修正。在数学推理任务上，FlowBalance在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的平均性能均优于FlowRL，同时提升了训练速度和稳定性，避免了OPSD直接方法的响应长度坍缩问题，在AIME24诊断中展现出更高的正确策略多样性。
AI.conclusion: FlowBalance验证了通过轨迹平衡实现"结果校准的自我引导"（outcome-calibrated self-guidance）是可行且有效的，它融合了验证器的可靠信号与策略自身的密集引导，克服了终端验证器监督稀疏和同模型引导可能误导的局限，为推理模型的自改进提供了一个稳定且高效的训练范式。

title: Synthetic Semantic Supervision for Contrastive Code Representation Learning in Small Transformers: An Empirical Study
summary: General-purpose code embeddings power tools for code search, classification, and retrieval. Compact transformer encoders for code typically rely on either human-written docstrings (labor-intensive and inconsistent) or mined structural signals such as execution traces (setting-specific and costly to collect). We empirically study an alternative: contrastive pretraining of small encoders with synthetically generated natural-language descriptions emphasizing code functionality and intent, paired with code in a dual-encoder framework at training and discarded at inference. We benchmark this approach against pretraining-based baselines, generalist LLMs, and embedding-specific models on eight retrieval, classification, and generation tasks across C, C++, and Java. Synthetic semantic supervision yields statistically significant gains over pretraining baselines of the same inference-time size on five of eight tasks, with parity on two more; once fine-tuned, it matches or exceeds zero-shot models two orders of magnitude larger on classification, and it stays on par with execution-aware supervision at matched pretraining data, suggesting a scalable, effective alternative to existing code-representation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过对比预训练方式，使用合成生成的自然语言描述（强调代码功能与意图）来训练小型代码嵌入编码器。该方法在训练时采用双编码器框架，推理时丢弃文本信息。在C、C++、Java的八个检索、分类和生成任务上，该方法在五个任务上显著优于同规模预训练基线，微调后可与大两个数量级的零样本模型匹敌，且与执行感知监督效果相当。
AI.motivation: 通用代码嵌入是代码搜索、分类和检索等工具的基础。现有紧凑型Transformer编码器主要依赖人工编写的docstring（费力且不一致）或挖掘的结构信号如执行轨迹（受环境限制且收集成本高）。作者希望探索一种可扩展且有效的替代方案，即利用合成生成的自然语言描述作为语义监督信号来训练小型代码编码器。
AI.method: 采用对比预训练方法，在训练阶段通过双编码器框架将合成生成的自然语言描述与代码配对，突出代码的功能性和意图语义；推理阶段丢弃文本编码器，仅保留代码编码器进行嵌入计算。
AI.result: 在八个任务中，合成语义监督相对同推理规模的预训练基线在五个任务上有显著统计提升，两个任务持平；微调后可在分类任务上匹敌或超越大两个数量级的零样本模型；在与匹配预训练数据量的条件下，与执行感知监督方法表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 合成语义监督是现有代码表示范式的可扩展且有效的替代方案，在不需要人工标注或昂贵执行信号的前提下，能够以小型编码器获得具有竞争力的代码嵌入性能。

title: Robot Aware Computational Design of Object Specific Passive Grippers for Additive Manufacturing
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end computational pipeline that converts a selected object mesh, a measured object state, and a selected six-axis robot into an object-specific, unactuated, additively manufacturable gripper. The method couples exact-mesh RGB-D/ICP pose registration, deterministic surface-contact sampling, uncertainty-aware wrench screening, selection among six passive capture mechanisms, object-conformal surface synthesis, full-orientation robot inverse kinematics, a swept-volume-aware manufacturing domain, directional fused-deposition finite-element screening, and constrained three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization. Unlike workflows that treat grasp selection, tool geometry, motion, and structural design as separate problems, every exported design is bound to the source mesh, object pose, robot flange, contact set, and insertion hypothesis by a traceable design identifier. We derive the implemented registration, contact, fit-tolerance, finite-element, and density-optimization equations and prove three properties of the numerical construction: nodal load preservation, monotonic compliance sensitivity under SIMP interpolation, and voxel-domain containment after topology post-processing. Four archived object-specific attempts - a rabbit, camera flange, 3DBenchy, and faceted bust - meet the nominal fit, uncertain-wrench, runtime-sweep, and baseline/post-topology FEA gates. A deliberately enlarged +/-3 mm, +/-5 degree pose stress check differentiates the designs, retaining 29-134 of 160 simulated trials. Their reconstructed topologies retain 92.0-97.6% of the FE domain because functional regions are protected. Archived robot photographs show the corresponding printed assemblies qualitatively, while nominal material properties and absent coupon-calibrated, instrumented tests keep all four at digital-screening status rather than operational release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端计算流水线，可将选定网格、被测对象状态与六轴机器人转化为对象专属、无主动驱动、可增材制造的夹爪，并实现从感知、接触采样、机构选型到结构与制造联动的全流程可追溯设计。
AI.motivation: 传统工作流将抓取选择、工具几何、运动规划和结构设计分开处理，缺乏跨环节的一致性绑定，难以保证最终夹爪在真实物理与制造约束下的有效性。
AI.method: 方法由多项耦合模块构成：精确网格RGB-D/ICP位姿配准、确定性表面接触采样、考虑不确定性的力螺旋筛选、六种被动捕获机构的选择、对象贴合表面合成、全位姿机器人逆运动学、扫掠体积感知制造域、定向FDM有限元筛选，以及约束三维SIMP拓扑优化；并将所有设计以可追溯标识绑定各输入假设。
AI.result: 四个归档对象（兔子、相机法兰、3DBenchy、刻面半身像）通过名义配合、不确定力螺旋、运行时扫掠和基线/后拓扑FEA门控；在增大的±3 mm、±5度位姿压力检查中保留160次模拟中的29-134次，重建拓扑保留92.0%-97.6%的FE域。
AI.conclusion: 此流水线能在数字筛选层面可靠地产出可行且可打印的夹爪设计与拓扑，但尚缺coupon标定与仪器化测试，所有设计仍停留在数字筛选状态而非可投入使用。

title: OCR-EDR: Rendering-Aware Diagnosis and Repair for Closed-Loop OCR Improvement
summary: Although document OCR systems perform increasingly well on routine documents, complex formulas, structured text, and long-tail formats remain error-prone. OCR predictions may omit fine-grained content or hallucinate unsupported outputs, while equivalent encodings of the same visible content must be accommodated. Existing OCR evaluation methods mostly report aggregate metrics, offering limited support for analyzing case-level errors and improving OCR performance. We propose OCR-EDR (OCR Error Diagnosis and Repair), a rendering-aware framework that advances from fine-grained diagnosis to iterative repair. Given a source image, an editable OCR prediction, and its rendered image, OCR-EDR first jointly assesses whether the prediction and its rendering are consistent with the source, preserving valid predictions, including rendering-equivalent ones, while diagnosing and localizing genuine errors. It then applies executable edits and may request an updated rendering for iterative reassessment. We construct OCRErrBench from diverse real OCR predictions, covering text and formulas, exact and rendering-equivalent positives, and genuine errors, and develop the DocEDR model to execute the diagnosis--repair loop. On OCRErrBench, DocEDR achieves 94.78% diagnostic accuracy. It repairs 86.23% of erroneous inputs to visual consistency, raises formula Case-F1 by 30.99 percentage points over DOCR-Inspector-7B on DOCRcaseBench, and improves formula CDM by up to 4.62 percentage points on the identified Bad subsets of four OCR systems on UniMER-Test. These results show that OCR-EDR turns fine-grained OCR analysis into verified corrections and performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OCR-EDR框架，通过渲染感知的细粒度诊断与迭代修复来评估和改进OCR预测质量。构建OCRErrBench基准和DocEDR模型，在诊断准确率（94.78%）、错误修复率（86.23%）及公式评估指标上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR评估方法主要报告聚合指标，无法支持逐例错误分析，难以帮助改进OCR性能。此外，OCR系统在复杂公式、结构化文本和长尾格式上仍容易出错，可能遗漏细粒度内容或产生幻觉输出，同时需要容忍渲染等价的编码差异。
AI.method: 提出OCR-EDR（OCR Error Diagnosis and Repair）渲染感知框架：首先联合评估OCR预测及其渲染图像与源图像的一致性，区分有效预测（包括渲染等价预测）和真实错误并进行定位；随后应用可执行的编辑修正并请求更新的渲染进行迭代再评估。构建OCRErrBench基准（覆盖文本和公式、精确与渲染等价正例、真实错误），开发DocEDR模型执行诊断-修复循环。
AI.result: DocEDR在OCRErrBench上达到94.78%的诊断准确率；修复86.23%的错误输入至视觉一致；在DOCRcaseBench上公式Case-F1较DOCR-Inspector-7B提升30.99个百分点；在UniMER-Test上对四个OCR系统的Bad子集公式CDM最高提升4.62个百分点。
AI.conclusion: OCR-EDR成功将细粒度OCR分析转化为验证过的修正和性能增益，证明从诊断到迭代修复的闭环框架能够有效提升OCR系统的可靠性和准确率。

title: A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors
summary: Modern AI agent harnesses expose lifecycle hooks that bind shell commands to runtime events such as session start, tool calls, and file edits. These commands run with host privileges yet ship as lifecycle-hook configuration and may fire at times the LLM never observes. We identify the lifecycle-hook update path, which harnesses trust blindly, as a new attack surface. Under a supply-chain threat model in which an attacker controls only plugin metadata and lifecycle-hook configuration, a benign versioned plugin can be trojanized by an update that silently binds attacker-chosen commands to benign events, yielding malicious host-side behavior such as privilege escalation. We propose HookPry, an open-source and fully automated attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability across heterogeneous AI agent harnesses. HookPry realizes ten attack objectives; across 25 combinations of harnesses and backends in 1,000 end-to-end runs, it compromises all seven evaluated harnesses, with per-harness success rates reaching 92.5%. Representative defenses remain insufficient: Microsoft Defender has 0% recall, and the union of three static defenses misses 47.5% of malicious artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文发现AI agent框架中的生命周期钩子（lifecycle hooks）是一个新的攻击面。攻击者仅需控制插件元数据和钩子配置，即可将良性插件木马化，静默绑定恶意shell命令到良性事件，实现主机端恶意行为（如提权）。作者提出开源自动攻击框架HookPry，在25种框架-后端组合、1000次端到端运行中攻破了全部7个被测框架，单框架成功率高达92.5%，且现有防御（Microsoft Defender召回率为0%，三种静态防御联合仍漏检47.5%）均不足。
AI.motivation: 现代AI agent框架暴露生命周期钩子，将shell命令绑定到运行时事件（如会话开始、工具调用、文件编辑）。这些命令以主机权限运行，却以钩子配置形式分发，可能在LLM从未观察到的时机触发。框架盲目信任生命周期钩子的更新路径，构成了新的攻击面。在供应链威胁模型下，攻击者仅需控制插件元数据和钩子配置，就能将良性版本化插件木马化——通过一次"更新"静默地将攻击者选定的恶意命令绑定到良性事件上，从而实现提权等恶意主机行为。
AI.method: 作者提出HookPry，一个开源、全自动的攻击框架，系统地利用跨异构AI agent框架的此漏洞。HookPry实现了十种攻击目标，覆盖25种框架与后端的组合，进行1000次端到端运行验证。
AI.result: HookPry攻破了全部七个被测的AI agent框架，单一框架的成功率最高达92.5%。代表性防御被证明无效：Microsoft Defender对恶意产物的召回率为0%，三种静态防御联合仍漏检47.5%的恶意产物。
AI.conclusion: AI agent框架的生命周期钩子供应链路径存在系统性安全漏洞，现有防御手段严重不足。HookPry证明了该攻击面的普适性和可利用性，提示业界需要对生命周期钩子配置采取与代码同等的信任与安全审查机制。

title: SGD-KV: Summarization Guided KV Cache Compression
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS2026 Efficient Reasoning Workshop
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks in long-context inference due to the linearly growing size of key-value (KV) caches. Existing KV cache compression techniques typically rely on simple heuristics, overlooking the distinct functional roles of different attention heads. We present SGD-KV (Summarization-Guided KV Cache Compression), a head-aware framework that leverages a novel chunk-summarization diagnostic task to systematically identify and prioritize attention heads specialized in hierarchical information aggregation. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B-1M and Qwen3-32B across diverse long-context benchmarks demonstrate that SGD-KV achieves state-of-the-art performance with contexts up to 1M tokens, while reducing KV cache memory usage by up to 75%. Our findings show that strategically allocating the KV cache budget based on the summarization score distribution of attention heads yields a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off for long-context inference.

AI.tldr: SGD-KV是一种基于头部感知的KV缓存压缩框架，通过新颖的块摘要诊断任务来识别和优先保留擅长层级信息聚合的注意力头，在Qwen2.5-7B-1M和Qwen3-32B上实现了最长1M context下的SOTA性能，并将KV缓存内存占用减少高达75%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存的线性增长导致严重的内存瓶颈，现有KV缓存压缩技术依赖简单启发式方法，忽视了不同注意力头在功能上的角色差异，缺乏对注意力头特异性功能的有针对性利用。
AI.method: 提出SGD-KV框架，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 设计新颖的块摘要诊断任务，用于系统性评估各注意力头在层级信息聚合上的专长；(2) 基于注意力头的摘要分数分布来识别和排序高价值注意力头；(3) 根据各头的摘要能力分数战略性地分配KV缓存预算，优先压缩擅长聚合信息的头部。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-1M和Qwen3-32B模型上的多个长上下文基准测试中，SGD-KV在多达100万token的上下文下实现了最先进的性能，同时将KV缓存内存使用量降低高达75%，展示了更优的效率-准确性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 战略性分配KV缓存预算——依据注意力头摘要分数分布进行分配，而非统一压缩——能够在长上下文推理中获得更优的效率-准确性权衡，验证了头部感知的压缩策略相对于传统统一压缩方法的显著优势。

title: Selective Hypergraph Refinement for Frozen Graph Clustering
summary: Existing graph-clustering methods typically improve clustering performance by optimizing model parameters and node representations. Effective means of further improving the clustering results of an already trained and frozen model, however, remain limited. We study post-processing for frozen graph clustering. After checkpoint fixation, the procedure uses no labels and updates neither model parameters, node representations, nor the original graph structure. Instead, it exploits an attribute hypergraph to supplement higher-order relations that ordinary graphs cannot readily express, thereby refining existing cluster assignments. Because global hypergraph refinement can yield both performance gains and erroneous updates, we propose Selective Hypergraph Refinement (SHR). The method generates candidate residual directions from the hypergraph and evaluates their reliability using graph structure, node attributes, and matched-null evidence. It updates only nodes with sufficient support and otherwise retains their original assignments. Further analysis shows that whether a node changes cluster is jointly governed by its native assignment gap and the directional strength of the refinement. In a controlled common-suite evaluation, 13 of 15 backbone-dataset cells had a positive mean macro gain, one produced exact no-action, and one was negative. The cell-equal macro gain was 0.066 pp (95% bootstrap CI, [0.030, 0.107] pp), while only 0.209% of hard assignments changed on average. A broader 15-combination native-interface evaluation yielded a macro gain of 0.137 pp at a mean change ratio of 0.375%. These results indicate that frozen clustering outputs retain a limited but measurable refinement space after training. The effect is heterogeneous across backbone-dataset pairs, and broader coverage also increases exposure to negative transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究冻结图聚类的后处理问题：在模型参数、节点表示和图结构均固定的情况下，利用属性超图补充高阶关系来精修已有聚类结果。提出的选择性超图精修（SHR）方法通过评估超图候选残差方向的可靠性，仅更新有充分支持的节点，在控制实验中13/15个主干-数据集组合取得正增益，平均宏增益0.066个百分点，仅改动0.209%的硬分配。
AI.motivation: 现有图聚类方法多通过优化模型参数和节点表示来提升性能，但对已训练冻结模型的聚类结果如何进行后处理式精修的研究十分有限。作者希望探索：在不使用标签、不更新模型参数/节点表示/图结构的前提下，是否存在可利用的提升空间。
AI.method: 1）利用属性超图补充普通图无法表达的高阶关系，生成候选残差方向；2）提出选择性超图精修（SHR），结合图结构、节点属性与匹配零模型证据评估候选方向的可靠性；3）仅更新有充分支持的节点，对证据不足的节点保留原始分配；4）通过理论分析揭示节点聚类的变化由原生分配间隙与精修方向强度共同决定。
AI.result: 在受控共同套件评估中，13/15个主干-数据集单元取得正平均宏增益，1个无变化，1个为负；单元等权宏增益为0.066个百分点（95%自助法置信区间[0.030, 0.107]），平均仅0.209%的硬分配发生改变。更广泛的15组合原生接口评估中取得0.137个百分点的宏增益，平均变化率为0.375%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结聚类输出在训练后确实保留了有限但可测量的精修空间；全局超图精修可能同时带来增益与错误更新，选择性策略是必要的。效果在不同主干-数据集对间具有异质性，且更广的覆盖范围会增加负迁移的暴露风险。

title: Counterfactual Routing Using Integer Programming with Constraint Generation
summary: We present our submission to the IJCAI 2025 'Counterfactual Routing Competition' (CRC 25). The goal of the competition is to find counterfactual explanations for the shortest path problem. This requires deciding what the minimal changes to a road network would make a route chosen by the user the optimal route. This enables explanations such as "Your suggested route would indeed have been optimal, if road X were not a bicycle path." Our solution models the problem as an integer program, iteratively incorporating constraints until an exact solution is found. In the final evaluation on held-out test instances, our method ranked fourth in solution quality and obtained its solution fastest on every instance, with an average runtime of 9.0 seconds compared to 118.8 seconds for the next-fastest submission.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了IJCAI 2025反事实路由竞赛的参赛方案，将最短路径问题的反事实解释建模为整数规划，通过迭代添加约束直至找到精确解，在最终评测中排名第四，但求解速度最快（平均9.0秒，远快于次快方案的118.8秒）。
AI.motivation: 竞赛目标是寻找最短路径问题的反事实解释，即确定对道路网络的最小改动使得用户所选路线成为最优路线，从而能生成直观的解释，例如"如果X路不是自行车道，你建议的路线确实是最优的"。
AI.method: 将问题建模为整数规划，采用迭代方式逐步添加约束条件，直到找到精确解。该方法不依赖启发式或近似策略，而是保证收敛到精确最优解。
AI.result: 在官方保留的测试实例上最终排名第四（按解质量），但在求解速度上显著领先——所有实例均最快完成，平均运行时间仅9.0秒，而次快提交需要118.8秒，差距超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了将反事实路由解释问题精确建模为整数规划的可行性与高效性，尽管解质量排名第四，但其极快的求解速度证明了该方法的计算效率优势，未来有望通过优化目标或加速约束生成进一步提升解质量。

title: A comparative study on the accuracy & repeatability of mobile robotic platforms for the delivery of precision NDE measurement
summary:
Mobile robotic platforms offer a flexible alternative to fixed manipulators for non-destructive evaluation (NDE) of large aerospace structures, but their base-positioning accuracy and how that accuracy should inform deployment have not been assessed under a common, externally referenced protocol. This work presents a laser tracker-based evaluation workflow (ground truth approximately 6 micrometers) that measures the static and segmented trajectory positioning accuracy of five commercial mobile platforms (KUKA KMP-1500, KUKA KMR, MiR250, Boston Dynamics Spot, Clearpath Husky) under a common protocol. A coupled multi-corner calibration recovers the laser-to-robot transformation and reflector offsets; ordinary least squares over all poses is used, with robust estimation retained only as a blunder check.
  Static positioning accuracy ranged from a median of 8.2 mm (KMP-1500) to 63.5 mm (Spot), with the wheel-odometry-only Husky uncalibratable. Dynamic path following was characterised by cross-track error; the component was insensitive to temporal alignment, which ranged from 6.9 mm (KMP-1500) to 112.1 mm (Spot). Both accuracy and calibratability tracked localisation capability, from the newest LiDAR SLAM platform to map-free visual odometry. No configuration meets the 0.2 to 1.0 mm aerospace NDE tolerance from the base alone; the results are framed as a design input that sizes the supplementary sensing each platform requires: roughly one order of magnitude for the best platform and nearly two for the worst, providing a reproducible basis for platform selection rather than a feasibility claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于激光跟踪仪的外部参考评估协议（精度约6微米），系统评测了五种商用移动机器人平台（KUKA KMP-1500、KUKA KMR、MiR250、Boston Dynamics Spot、Clearpath Husky）在航空航天无损检测场景下的静态和分段轨迹定位精度，并作为补充传感需求的量化设计输入。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人平台为大型航空航天结构的无损检测提供了比固定机械臂更灵活的替代方案，但其基座定位精度以及该精度应如何指导部署决策，此前未在统一的外部参考协议下进行评估。缺乏可复现的对比基准导致平台选择缺乏量化依据。
AI.method: 开发了一套基于激光跟踪仪的评估工作流（真实值精度约6微米），在统一协议下测量五种商用移动平台的静态与分段轨迹定位精度。采用耦合多角点标定恢复激光-机器人变换和反射镜偏移；所有位姿采用普通最小二乘估计，稳健估计仅作为粗差检查保留。静态精度以中位数表示，动态路径跟随以横向跟踪误差表征，并检验其对时间对齐的敏感性。
AI.result: 静态定位精度中位数从8.2 mm（KMP-1500）到63.5 mm（Spot）不等，仅依赖轮式里程计的Husky无法标定。动态路径跟随的横向误差从6.9 mm（KMP-1500）到112.1 mm（Spot）不等，该指标对时间对齐不敏感。精度和可标定性均与定位能力正相关，从最新的LiDAR SLAM平台到无地图视觉里程计平台依次递减。没有任何单一配置的基座精度能达到0.2至1.0 mm的航空航天无损检测容差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果作为设计输入，量化了每个平台所需的补充传感规模：最优平台约需提升一个数量级，最差平台约需提升近两个数量级。该工作提供了可复现的平台选择基础，而非可行性声明。

title: Preserving Knowledge across Space and Time for Continual Video Deepfake Detection
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2025. Code will be available at github.com/rama0126/MSFD
summary: The continuous emergence of high-quality video deepfakes requires detectors that continually adapt to new forgery patterns, yet existing approaches, which are designed for deepfake images, fail to capture video-specific cues. Unlike deepfake images that contain only spatial artifacts, deepfake videos leave distinct evidence along both spatial and temporal axes, necessitating the separate preservation of each modality during sequential model updates. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a continual deepfake video detection framework, Modality-Specific Frequency Distillation (MSFD), that explicitly decomposes video features into spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal modalities in the frequency domain. This decomposition enables independent preservation of each modality, as different deepfake video types exhibit varying reliance on spatial and temporal cues across tasks. Furthermore, MSFD adopts a cross-modality decorrelation loss that encourages spatiotemporal representations to remain orthogonal to single-modality cues. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves stronger adaptation and preserves performance more effectively than state-of-the-art methods across diverse continual deepfake video scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向持续深度伪造视频检测的框架MSFD，通过频域分解将视频特征显式拆分为空间、时间和时空模态，各模态独立保留，并引入跨模态去相关损失促进时空表征与单模态线索正交，从而在持续学习场景中兼顾适应性和旧任务性能保持。
AI.motivation: 高质量视频深度伪造的持续出现要求检测器能够持续适应新的伪造模式，但现有针对深度伪造图像设计的持续检测方法无法捕捉视频特有的线索。与仅含空间伪影的图像不同，深度伪造视频在空间和时间轴上都留有证据，需要在模型顺序更新时分别保留每种模态的信息，而现有方法未能解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出模态特定的频域蒸馏框架（MSFD），核心包括：(1) 在频域中将视频特征显式分解为空间、时间和时空三种模态，实现各模态的独立保留；(2) 采用跨模态去相关损失，使时空表示与单模态线索保持正交，减少模态间干扰；(3) 通过蒸馏机制在持续学习过程中保留各模态的旧知识。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，在多种持续深度伪造视频场景下，MSFD相比最先进方法在适应能力与性能保持方面均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视频伪造线索按空间/时间模态显式解耦并独立蒸馏保留，同时以跨模态去相关促进表征正交性，可有效解决持续深度伪造视频检测中多模态信息相互干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题。

title: Practice Makes (Im)Perfect: A Look Back at Benchmarking Practices for Microarchitectural Side-Channel Attacks
summary: Microarchitectural side-channel research has grown at an exceptional pace in recent years, increasing the need for rigorous and meaningful benchmarking. Early attack papers typically relied on indirect proxies, such as covert-channel bandwidth or key-recovery on naive AES and RSA implementations, setting de facto standards that many subsequent works continued to replicate, sometimes by directly comparing against raw numbers from prior work. While these practices offer convenient points of comparison, current benchmarks may not be the most relevant to assess specific properties of new primitives. Even more problematic, microarchitectural attacks are notoriously sensitive to experimental conditions: minimal changes in the target system can significantly alter outcomes and performance. As a result, inadequate evaluation practices undermine reproducibility and cast doubt on the relevance of comparisons, even in top-tier venues where such issues should be identified. This paper tackles the core problem of proper benchmarking for microarchitectural side-channel attacks and examines its broader impact on research quality in the field. We survey 83 attack papers published in top-ranked security and architecture conferences from 2014 to 2024. From this corpus, we identify and define 19 recurrent benchmarking flaws that affect evaluation completeness, relevance, soundness, and reproducibility. These flaws include unfair or absent comparisons, missing code or materials, and the failure to evaluate the key attack properties. On average, each paper exhibits 5.5 such flaws, highlighting how widespread the issue is, even in highly selective venues. Based on our findings, we identify and suggest key properties that are relevant to properly evaluate new attacks. We also highlight trends over time and different practices between security and architecture conferences.

AI.tldr: 本文系统调查了2014-2024年间发表在顶级安全与体系结构会议上的83篇微架构侧信道攻击论文，识别并定义了19种反复出现的基准测试缺陷（平均每篇论文存在5.5种），问题涵盖评估完整性、相关性、合理性和可复现性等方面，并据此建议了相关的评估属性和改进方向。
AI.motivation: 微架构侧信道研究近年来快速增长，但现有基准测试方法存在严重问题：早期研究依赖间接代理指标（如隐蔽信道带宽或在朴素AES/RSA实现上的密钥恢复），后续工作盲目复制这些基准甚至直接与传统工作对比原始数字。同时微架构攻击对实验条件极为敏感，细微变化即可显著改变结果，导致评估实践不足、可复现性差，即便在顶级会议中也难以识别这些问题。
AI.method: 作者系统调查了2014年至2024年间发表在最顶级安全与体系结构会议上的83篇攻击论文。通过这一语料库，识别并定义了19种反复出现的基准测试缺陷，这些缺陷影响评估的完整性、相关性、合理性和可复现性，涵盖不公平或缺失的比较、缺失代码或材料、未能评估关键攻击属性等方面。作者还分析了时间趋势以及安全会议与体系结构会议之间的实践差异。
AI.result: 调查发现每篇论文平均存在5.5种基准测试缺陷，表明即使在高度选择性的会议中问题也极为普遍。作者识别出19种具体缺陷，包括不公平或缺失的比较、代码或材料缺失、关键攻击属性评估失败等。基于研究结果，论文提出了用于恰当评估新攻击的关键属性，并揭示了时间趋势及安全会议与体系结构会议之间的不同实践。
AI.conclusion: 当前微架构侧信道攻击的基准测试实践存在系统性的缺陷，严重损害了研究的可复现性和可比性。该研究为领域内提供了明确定义的缺陷分类体系，并提出了改进评估实践的指导性建议，呼吁研究社区建立更严谨、更具相关性的评估标准。

title: What Else Needs Fixing? Exploring Cost-Effective Test-Time Compute for Revision Propagation in Artifacts Generated Through Conversation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. The code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-revision-propagation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often help users generate artifacts through iterative cycles of generation and revision in conversation. A challenge here is that, when users specify only a local change during revision, LLMs must instead identify the relevant dependencies and propagate the revision to all affected parts of the artifact. This paper studies this ability of LLMs on conversationally generated artifacts, where the artifact context and its dependencies may be embedded in the conversation history. Toward practical use, we also explore cost-effective test-time compute for this new setting. Specifically, we introduce a new benchmark for this setting, and evaluate nine revision methods, including sequential reflection and parallel sampling variants, using gpt-oss-20b/120b, gpt-5.4-mini, and qwen3.5-9b/27b/122b on the benchmark. The results show that baselines achieve accuracies of 68.3--93%, and the most cost-effective method is selecting from three parallel samples using either LLM-based or medoid selection, which improves accuracy by 2.2--9.7%. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-revision-propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在对话式生成场景中如何将局部修订传播到整个文物的能力，提出了一个基准测试并评估了九种修订方法，发现基于三个并行样本的选择策略（LLM选择或medoid选择）是最具成本效益的方案。
AI.motivation: LLM帮助用户生成文物（如文档、代码等）通常需要多轮对话迭代修订，但用户往往只指定局部修改，模型需要识别依赖关系并将修改传播到所有受影响的部分。现有研究缺乏对该场景的系统性评估，特别是当文物上下文和依赖关系嵌入在对话历史中时。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个针对对话式生成文物修订传播的新基准，评估了九种修订方法（包括顺序反思和并行采样变体），在多款模型（gpt-oss-20b/120b、gpt-5.4-mini、qwen3.5-9b/27b/122b）上进行实验，并探索了成本有效的test-time compute策略。
AI.result: 基准方法达到68.3%-93%的准确率；最经济有效的方法是从三个并行采样的候选中进行选择（采用LLM-based或medoid选择），可将准确率提高2.2%-9.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过适度的并行采样结合有效的选择策略，可以在不显著增加推理成本的情况下显著提升LLM在对话式文物修订传播任务中的表现。

title: Latent Energy Action Planning with World Models
summary: Latent world models support efficient model predictive control from high-dimensional observations, yet optimizing a single learned latent objective can favor action sequences whose decoder-predicted terminal descriptor does not match the goal descriptor. We introduce Latent Energy Action Planning (LEAP), which treats the complete action horizon as a differentiable variable and optimizes it through a frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM). LEAP couples terminal latent goal matching with a terminal-window state energy. Low energy requires the predicted terminal latent to agree with the goal latent and the decoder-predicted terminal descriptor to agree with the goal descriptor. A frozen goal-conditioned proposal initializes the search, a quasi-Newton solver refines actions through the autoregressive rollout, and post-optimization projection enforces the admissible action range. Across four control domains using the officially released LeWM checkpoints, the complete LEAP planning system raises mean success from 77.5% for LeWM planned with the cross-entropy method (LeWM+CEM) to 94.8% under a matched protocol, a 17.3-percentage-point improvement, while retaining the frozen LeWM representation and predictor.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP方法，将完整动作时域视为可微变量，利用冻结的Latent世界模型（LeWM）进行优化，同时耦合终端隐变量目标匹配与终端窗口状态能量，将四域平均成功率从77.5%（LeWM+CEM）提升至94.8%。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型支持从高维观测进行高效的模型预测控制，但优化单一学习到的潜在目标会偏向于解码器预测的终端描述符与目标描述符不匹配的动作序列。
AI.method: LEAP将完整动作时域视为可微变量，通过冻结的LeWM进行优化。具体包括：(1) 耦合终端隐变量目标匹配与终端窗口状态能量，低能量需同时满足预测终端隐变量与目标隐变量一致、解码器预测的终端描述符与目标描述符一致；(2) 用冻结的目标条件式提议初始化搜索；(3) 用拟牛顿求解器通过自回归展开精炼动作；(4) 优化后投影强制动作在允许范围内。
AI.result: 在四个控制域中使用官方发布的LeWM检查点，LEAP将平均成功率从LeWM+CEM的77.5%提升到94.8%（匹配协议下），实现了17.3个百分点的提升，且保持LeWM表示与预测器冻结不变。
AI.conclusion: LEAP通过在保持世界模型参数冻结的同时改进规划优化策略，显著提升了基于潜在世界模型的模型预测控制的任务成功率，验证了能量耦合优化范式的有效性。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Energy Optimization in Data Centers
summary: Data centers are increasingly optimized by artificial intelligence and, at the same time, increasingly loaded by it. The literature treats these as two unrelated problems: control studies model workload as an exogenous arrival process, while sustainability studies model infrastructure as a fixed multiplier. We screen roughly 194 papers retrieved through a documented protocol, code 63 of them, and report what the coding shows. Of 28 primary control-oriented studies, 18 are validated in simulation alone and 5 reach physical hardware or a production facility; none account for water withdrawal, and none account for embodied carbon. Reported savings intervals across four technique families overlap almost completely, which means the field cannot presently rank its own methods. Ten recurring gaps are scored for consequence and tractability, and we set out CLEAR-DC, a framework coupling a control-policy branch to a workload-demand branch through an explicit elasticity term, reads out net rather than direct benefit, and emits a schema-conformant record covering energy, carbon, water, embodied share and validation venue. The framework is an architectural and methodological proposal, not a trained system; the contribution we defend empirically is the corpus analysis and the reporting schema derived from it. Coding sheet, derived statistics and all result artifacts: https://github.com/Kimalice/AI-for-Energy-Optimization-in-Data-Centers-Closing-the-Optimizer-Load-Loop

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了约194篇关于数据中心AI优化与AI负载的文献，编码63篇后发现：控制类研究多在纯仿真中验证、普遍忽略水消耗与隐含碳排放、四个技术族报告的节能区间几乎完全重叠导致无法排序自身方法。作者据此提出CLEAR-DC框架，将控制策略分支与工作负载需求分支通过显式弹性项耦合，输出涵盖能源、碳、水、隐含份额及验证场所的合规记录。核心贡献是语料分析及衍生报告模式的实证辩护。
AI.motivation: 数据中心既被AI优化又因AI而负载增加，但文献将二者视为两个不相关问题：控制研究把工作负载当作外生到达过程，可持续研究把基础设施当作固定乘数。这一割裂使该领域无法对自身方法排序，也无法全面衡量真实收益。
AI.method: 通过记录化协议筛选约194篇论文并编码63篇；对28篇主要控制导向研究进行验证场所与覆盖维度审计；按四个技术族统计节能区间；对十个重复出现的缺口按后果与可处理性打分；提出CLEAR-DC架构——将控制策略分支与工作负载需求分支通过显式弹性项耦合，读取净收益而非直接收益，并输出符合schema的记录。
AI.result: 28篇主要控制导向研究中18篇仅在仿真验证、5篇达到物理硬件或生产设施；无一考虑水取用，无一考虑隐含碳。四个技术族报告的节能区间几乎完全重叠，说明领域当前无法对自身方法排序。框架为架构与方法学提案而非已训练系统。
AI.conclusion: 作者以语料分析与报告模式作为核心实证贡献，提出CLEAR-DC框架以弥合优化器与负载之间的闭环，补齐水、隐含碳等被忽视的可持续性维度，并为数据中心能效研究提供可复现的编码与报告基础设施。

title: FWBC-VLA: Force-Aware Whole-Body Compensation for Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich loco-manipulation requires a bridge between semantic action generation and physical interaction control. Existing Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate task-level actions from visual and linguistic observations, but cannot interpret the physical interactions induced by those actions. While the whole-body control (WBC) policy can stabilize the robot, it cannot distinguish task-relevant interaction forces from forces induced by external disturbances during manipulation. Although force/torque sensors provide direct measurements of physical interactions, retrofitting them entails additional hardware costs and substantial integration effort, particularly for platforms not designed with sensor integration in mind. To address this problem, we propose FWBC-VLA, a force-aware framework that bridges task-level VLA action generation and low-level whole-body compensation control for wheeled-legged robots. First, we introduce HSR-Force, a sensorless residual-torque estimator for inferring contact strength and its temporal variation. These contact estimates are then encoded as tokens and injected into the VLA action expert during action decoding, enabling the policy to perceive contact onset, sustained loading, and release. For loco-manipulation tasks, all parameters of the pretrained VLA backbone are fine-tuned on our WL\&Arm Dataset, which comprises more than 5,000 episodes. Moreover, the robot's proprioceptive state, the Jacobian-derived body-frame force estimate, and the estimated contact state are jointly fed into a compensation generator to produce corrective actions. The manipulation-centric actions are subsequently combined with the corrective actions and passed to the WBC policy for execution. Real-world experiments on whiteboard wiping and door opening with a door closer demonstrate the effectiveness of our FWBC-VLA in contact-rich loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出了FWBC-VLA，一个力感知框架，通过无传感器的残余扭矩估计器推断接触状态，将其编码为token注入VLA动作解码器，并结合补偿生成器产生校正动作，由WBC策略执行，用于轮腿式机器人的接触丰富型移动操作任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型无法解释动作引起的物理交互；全身控制(WBC)策略不能区分任务相关交互力与外部扰动引起的力；力/扭矩传感器改装成本高且集成工作量大。因此需要一个无传感器的力感知桥接框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出HSR-Force无传感器残余扭矩估计器，推断接触强度及其时间变化；2) 将接触估计编码为token注入VLA动作专家进行动作解码，使策略感知接触开始、持续加载和释放；3) 在5,000+场景的WL&Arm数据集上微调预训练VLA骨干的全部参数；4) 将本体感知状态、雅可比导出的机体坐标系力估计和估计的接触状态联合输入补偿生成器产生校正动作；5) 将操作动作与校正动作组合后传给WBC策略执行。
AI.result: 在白板擦拭和带闭门器的门打开等真实世界实验中验证了FWBC-VLA在接触丰富型移动操作中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FWBC-VLA成功桥接了任务级VLA动作生成与低级全身补偿控制，通过无传感器的力感知使轮腿式机器人在接触丰富场景中实现稳定有效的移动操作，避免了额外的传感器硬件改造成本。

title: STARS-GS: Structure-Aware Regularized Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Aerial Surface Reconstruction
summary: Large-scale 3D surface reconstruction from aerial imagery is fundamental to geospatial mapping and urban modeling. Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated considerable potential for this task. However, existing methods still face three major challenges in large and complex scenes: scene partitioning may split continuous scene elements across independently optimized sub-regions; geometric constraints mainly focus on the attributes of individual Gaussians while overlooking their local organization; and uniform regularization struggles to accommodate heterogeneous geometric structures. To address these issues, we propose STARS-GS, a structure-aware 3DGS framework for large-scale surface reconstruction. First, we introduce a structure-aware scene partitioning strategy that better preserves continuous scene structures during partitioning and reduces cross-region geometric inconsistencies and stitching artifacts through boundary refinement. Second, we develop neighborhood-aware Gaussian organization that extends geometric constraints from individual primitives to their neighborhood organization, encouraging Gaussians to better conform to local surface geometry. Third, we introduce adaptive surface regularization that adjusts the regularization strength according to local geometric characteristics, promoting geometric consistency in structured regions while preserving plausible variations in unstructured regions. Extensive experiments on large-scale aerial photogrammetry benchmarks demonstrate that STARS-GS consistently outperforms the evaluated Gaussian-based methods in surface reconstruction. It increases the average F1-score from 0.640 for the second-best method to 0.698, corresponding to a relative improvement of approximately 9.1\%, demonstrating effective improvements in geometric accuracy and surface completeness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STARS-GS，一个结构感知的3D高斯泼溅框架，用于大规模航空影像的三维表面重建。通过结构感知的场景分区、邻域感知的高斯组织和自适应表面正则化三大创新，解决了现有方法在场景分割、几何约束和正则化方面的不足，在F1-score上相较次优方法相对提升约9.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的大规模表面重建方法面临三大挑战：场景分区可能切断跨子区域的连续结构元素；几何约束仅关注单个高斯属性而忽视局部组织方式；统一的正则化难以适应异质几何结构。
AI.method: STARS-GS包含三个核心组件：(1) 结构感知场景分区策略，在分区过程中保持连续场景结构，并通过边界细化减少跨区域几何不一致和拼接伪影；(2) 邻域感知高斯组织，将几何约束从单个基元扩展到邻域组织，使高斯更好地贴合局部表面几何；(3) 自适应表面正则化，根据局部几何特征动态调整正则化强度，在结构区域促进几何一致性，在非结构区域保持合理变化。
AI.result: 在大规模航空摄影测量基准上，STARS-GS在表面重建中一致优于评估的高斯类方法，将平均F1-score从次优方法的0.640提升至0.698，相对提升约9.1%，在几何精度和表面完整性方面均表现有效改进。
AI.conclusion: STARS-GS通过结构感知的设计原则，系统性解决了3DGS在大规模复杂场景表面重建中的关键瓶颈，证明了在几何精度和表面完整性上的显著优势，为大规模城市与地理空间建模提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: A Black Box for Agentic Processes: Blockchain-Anchored Evidence for AI Agent Communication, Human Oversight, and GRC Audits
summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly communicate with other agents, invoke tools, exchange intermediate results, and request human approvals. These workflows create a new auditability problem: organizations must reconstruct what happened, when it happened, which agent or human was involved, which control or policy applied, and whether records were modified afterwards. Motivated by the 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face incident, this position and architecture paper proposes a product- and vendor-neutral black-box architecture for agentic processes. The architecture creates blockchain-anchored cryptographic commitments for selected agent communications, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool calls, and process artifacts without placing sensitive content on-chain. We define an evidence model that distinguishes temporal anchoring and artifact integrity from event ordering, capture authenticity, authorized anchoring, and causal traceability. The latter properties require additional architectural controls. We then discuss practical use for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), including compliance testing, risk-based evidence selection, monitoring evidence streams, incident reconstruction, and regulatory reporting readiness under the EU AI Act, NIS2, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). This position and architecture paper does not present an empirical performance or security evaluation. The approach does not prevent agent misbehavior or prove semantic truth. Rather, it strengthens the evidentiary basis for later verification of critical process traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种产品与供应商中立的黑盒架构，用于自主AI代理工作流的可审计性，通过区块链锚定的密码学承诺来记录关键过程痕迹（如代理间通信、人工审批、工具调用），而无需将敏感内容上链，以支持治理、风险与合规（GRC）场景。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理之间的通信、工具调用、中间结果交换及人工审批流程日益复杂，产生了新的审计难题：组织需要重构"发生了什么、何时发生、涉及哪个代理或人类、适用何种控制策略、记录是否事后被篡改"。受2026年OpenAI/Hugging Face事件启发，现有审计方法不足以应对代理化流程的可信追溯需求。
AI.method: 提出一个黑盒架构，包含：(1) 为选定的代理通信、人在环审批、工具调用及过程工件创建区块链锚定的密码学承诺，但不将敏感内容上链；(2) 定义了一个证据模型，区分时间锚定与工件完整性与事件排序、捕获真实性、授权锚定和因果可追溯性之间的差异，后者需要额外的架构控制；(3) 探讨该架构在GRC中的实际应用，包括合规测试、基于风险的证据选择、证据流监控、事件重构及法规报告准备。
AI.result: 本文为立场与架构论文，未提供实证性能或安全评估。主要产出是架构设计与证据模型的定义，明确了区块链锚定能够提供哪些保证（时间锚定、工件完整性）与哪些需要额外架构控制（如捕获真实性、授权锚定、因果可追溯性），并分析了在EU AI Act、NIS2和Cyber Resilience Act下的GRC应用场景。
AI.conclusion: 该方法并不阻止代理的不当行为，也不证明语义真理性，而是通过增强关键过程痕迹的事后验证证据基础来支撑可审计性。区块链锚定方案在满足法规合规要求方面具有实用价值，但需要认识到其能力边界和额外架构控制的必要性。

title: Contextual Tamil Spelling and Grammar Correction Using Progressively Fine-Tuned Sequence-to-Sequence Transformers
summary: Tamil spell and grammar correction is challenging because Tamil is an agglutinative low-resource language with rich verbal morphology, complex sandhi (phonetic transformation) rules at word boundaries, and a script of 247 distinct letters. Prior work targets word-level surface errors with rule-based methods, statistical n-gram models, Minimum Edit Distance, or hybrid pipelines with a transformer re-ranker; such methods cannot reliably handle contextual errors - subject-verb agreement, tense consistency, or cross-word sandhi - which require sentence-level understanding. We propose an end-to-end sequence-to-sequence formulation and fine-tune mT5-small and mBART-50 on a synthetic corpus of up to 657,720 noisy-clean Tamil sentence pairs spanning ten error categories. Both backbones follow the same four-stage progressive schedule, each stage targeting one weakness: surface noise (v2), contextual grammar (v3), single-site sandhi (v4), and multi-site cross-word sandhi (v5). On a 1,000-sentence balanced diagnostic set verified disjoint from all training data, our best model, mBART-50 v5, reaches 69.3% top-1 exact-match accuracy, with 87.5% on sandhi and 43.5% on subject-verb agreement. The schedule is what produces these gains: subject-verb accuracy rises from 1.0% to 52.5% once contextual pairs are introduced, and sandhi from 0% to 87.5% once multi-site sandhi pairs are. We additionally quantify a precision-recall trade-off this literature has not reported: sandhi recall is paid for monotonically in identity accuracy. Finally, Tamil-LLaMA-7B-Instruct reaches 19.0% zero-shot and 24.7% with three demonstrations against a 20.0% copy baseline, showing that a Tamil-adapted instruction model does not transfer to specialised sentence-level correction without task-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端序列到序列方法进行泰米尔语拼写与语法纠错。作者在高达657,720对合成"噪声-清洁"泰米尔语句子上微调mT5-small和mBART-50，采用四阶段渐进式训练调度（v2表面噪声→v3上下文语法→v4单点sandhi→v5多点跨词sandhi）。最佳模型mBART-50 v5在1,000句均衡诊断集上达到69.3%的top-1精确匹配准确率，其中sandhi 87.5%、主谓一致43.5%。渐进调度是关键贡献：引入上下文对后主谓一致从1.0%升至52.5%，引入多点sandhi后sandhi从0%升至87.5%。论文还首次量化了sandhi召回率与身份准确率之间的单调权衡。对比实验表明Tamil-LLaMA-7B-Instruct即使经过泰米尔语适配，零样本19.0%、三示例24.7%（拷贝基线20.0%），仍难以迁移至专门的句级纠错任务。
AI.motivation: 泰米尔语作为一种黏着、低资源语言，具有丰富动词形态、复杂sandhi规则和247个字母的脚本，现有方法（规则法、统计n-gram、最小编辑距离、混合Transformer重排流水线）只能处理词级表面错误，无法可靠处理需要句级理解的上下文错误（主谓一致、时态一致性、跨词sandhi）。核心动机是开发能同时处理表面与上下文层面错误的端到端纠错模型。
AI.method: 采用端到端序列到序列（seq2seq）框架，在合成语料（最多657,720对噪声-干净句子，覆盖十类错误）上微调mT5-small和mBART-50。两个骨干模型遵循相同的四阶段渐进式训练调度：v2针对表面噪声、v3针对上下文语法、v4针对单点sandhi、v5针对多点跨词sandhi，每阶段依次引入新的训练数据以逐步提升模型能力。
AI.result: 使用与训练数据不重叠的1,000句均衡诊断集评估：最佳模型mBART-50 v5达69.3% top-1精确匹配，sandhi类别87.5%、主谓一致43.5%。渐进调度的效果显著：主谓一致准确率在引入上下文对后从1.0%升至52.5%，sandhi在引入多点sandhi对后从0%升至87.5%。同时首次量化了sandhi召回率与身份（identity）准确率之间的单调权衡。对比方面，Tamil-LLaMA-7B-Instruct零样本19.0%、三示例24.7%，仅略高于20.0%的拷贝基线。
AI.conclusion: 端到端seq2seq搭配精心设计的渐进式训练调度是可行的泰米尔语句级拼写语法纠错方案，显著优于传统词级方法和通用LLM。但sandhi召回与身份保留之间存在内在权衡，且即便泰米尔语适配的指令模型在没有任务特定监督的情况下也无法胜任专门的句级纠错，说明此类任务仍需专门的训练策略。

title: Geometry-Aware Graph Construction via Adaptive Spectral Bandwidth Control
comment: Accepted at IEEE MLSP 2026. 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Kernelized graph methods - spectral clustering, diffusion maps, and sparse kernel -regression graphs - that use Gaussian kernels depend on the choice of Gaussian bandwidth sigma, which governs the spectral character of the local kernel operator. When sigma is too small, the kernel overestimates local complexity and treats each sample as an independent direction; when sigma is too large, the kernel collapses multiple directions together, the condition number diverges, and all geometric discrimination is lost. We propose a choice of scale to make the spectral complexity of the kernel consistent with the intrinsic complexity of the underlying manifold. We propose a per-node bandwidth criterion that operationalizes this principle by jointly matching the kernel's effective rank to the local intrinsic dimension estimated via minimum spanning tree, anchoring the search in the manifold-consistent log-log scaling regime. We evaluate SSL embeddings from six encoders on CIFAR-100, showing that adaptive bandwidth consistently improves leave-one-out (LOO) classification and label propagation (LP) accuracy over fixed-bandwidth methods and competing adaptive methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应高斯核带宽选择准则，使核的谱复杂度与底层流形的内在复杂度保持一致。该方法通过最小生成树估计局部内在维度，并匹配核的有效秩来确定每个节点的带宽。在CIFAR-100上使用六个SSL编码器进行验证，该方法在留一法分类和标签传播准确率上优于固定带宽方法和现有自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 基于高斯核的图方法（谱聚类、扩散映射、稀疏核回归图）性能高度依赖带宽σ的选择。σ过小会高估局部复杂度，将每个样本视为独立方向；σ过大则导致多个方向坍缩、条件数发散且丧失几何判别能力。现有方法缺乏将核的谱复杂度与底层流形内在复杂度对齐的原则性带宽选择方案。
AI.method: 提出使核的谱复杂度与底层流形内在复杂度一致的尺度选择原则。具体实现为逐节点带宽准则：(1) 通过最小生成树估计局部内在维度；(2) 将核的有效秩与局部内在维度相匹配；(3) 在对数-对数标度（manifold-consistent regime）中锚定搜索范围，避免陷入退化区域。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上使用六个自监督学习（SSL）编码器评估，自适应带宽方法在留一法（LOO）分类和标签传播（LP）准确率上一致优于固定带宽方法及其他自适应带宽方法。
AI.conclusion: 将核带宽的选择从经验启发式提升为有原则的准则——即使核的谱复杂度与流形内在复杂度相匹配——能够稳定地改善基于核的图方法在下游任务上的性能，说明了"尺度选择应反映数据内在几何结构"这一原则的有效性。

title: Proactive Service Agents: A Unified Decision Framework, Methods, and Evaluation
summary: Large language model agents can plan, invoke tools, and modify external states, yet most systems still take an explicit user instruction as a fixed starting point. Proactive service moves the decision upstream: an agent must infer service opportunities from incomplete environmental and user signals, choose among remaining silent, asking, assisting, and acting, and account for interruption, misunderstanding, overreach, and privacy costs. This survey gives an operational definition centered on initiative and formulates the problem as a partially observable sequential decision process constrained by authorization and risk. The formulation represents timing, content, and delivery within one structured action, while making explicit the option value of waiting, the decision value of questions, and feedback-induced state changes. On this basis, we organize existing methods along one decision pipeline (state and need estimation, intervention gating, action construction, and feedback adaptation) and describe prescribed, predictive, model based, and return optimizing mechanisms as nonexclusive policy-construction components. We further normalize decision units and three-axis evidence descriptors across streaming dialogue, screen, video, software-engineering, and human-agent collaboration resources, and formalize metrics for triggering, timing, calibration, user burden, safety, and policy value. The synthesis shows why offline classification performance alone does not predict deployment benefit and why long-term memory is not a defining condition of proactivity. Reliable proactive service instead requires calibrated incremental intervention value, verifiable authorization, recoverable execution, and counterfactual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文对"主动服务"（proactive service）进行了系统性综述，将其定义为从用户显式指令上游的决策问题，形式化为受授权和风险约束的部分可观测序贯决策过程，并沿决策管线组织现有方法，规范化了统一的决策单元、证据描述子和评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体多以显式用户指令为固定起点，缺乏对主动服务能力的系统性研究。主动服务需要从不完备的环境与用户信号中推断服务机会，并权衡沉默、询问、协助、行动等多种选择，兼顾打断、误解、越权与隐私成本，缺乏统一定义与理论框架。
AI.method: 作者首先给出以"主动性"（initiative）为核心的运行定义，将问题形式化为受授权与风险约束的部分可观测序贯决策过程（POMDP），将时机、内容与交付整合为统一的结构化动作，并显式建模等待的期权价值、提问的决策价值及反馈导致的状态变化。在此基础上，沿单条决策管线（状态与需求估计、干预门控、行动构建、反馈自适应）组织现有方法，并将规定的、预测的、基于模型的和回报优化的机制视为非互斥的策略构建组件。同时，跨流式对话、屏幕、视频、软件工程和人机协作资源统一了决策单元与三轴证据描述子，形式化了触发、时机、校准、用户负担、安全与策略价值等指标。
AI.result: 分析揭示了两个关键结论：离线分类性能本身并不能预测部署收益；长期记忆并非主动性的必要条件。可靠的主动服务需要满足：校准的增量干预价值、可验证的授权、可恢复的执行以及反事实证据。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的主动服务系统的核心在于精确的增量干预价值估计、明确的授权验证机制、执行失败后的可恢复性以及基于反事实的评估证据，而不仅仅是分类准确率或记忆能力的堆叠。该框架为未来主动服务智能体的设计与评估提供了统一的理论基础与规范化基准。

title: A hybrid pipeline for dynamic ontology-based semantic mapping
summary: Semantic mapping plays a crucial role in the ability of a robot to interact with objects, operate and navigate a complex environment. The most common pipeline for semantic mapping consists of geometric mapping and localization (SLAM), perception, semantic fusion and semantic representation. However, more recent works also integrate a form of prior knowledge in their application, most notably knowledge graphs or semantic scene graphs, to improve contextual understanding of the environment. In this paper, we present a hybrid pipeline for semantic mapping. Our system incorporates an external calibrated camera using homography projection for geometric mapping and localization, combined with object detection, persistent object tracking and ontology driven semantic updates to build a dynamic semantic world model. Linear regression models are also used for correction of the estimated values of real world coordinates. The system continuously updates object instances, spatial properties and semantic relations based on real time sensory data. Ontologies are selected as form of knowledge representation due to their hierarchical structure, semantic expressiveness and support for dynamic world modelling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合语义映射管线，结合外部校准相机（单应性投影）实现几何建图与定位，融合目标检测、持续目标跟踪和本体驱动的语义更新，并使用线性回归模型校正真实世界坐标，构建动态语义世界模型。
AI.motivation: 语义映射对机器人操作和导航至关重要，现有管线虽整合了几何建图、感知与语义融合，但对上下文理解能力不足。近年来虽引入知识图谱或语义场景图等先验知识，仍缺少能持续动态更新对象实例、空间属性和语义关系的统一系统。
AI.method: 提出混合管线：(1) 外部校准相机结合单应性投影实现几何建图和定位；(2) 集成目标检测与持续目标跟踪进行感知；(3) 采用本体论（ontology）驱动语义更新，利用其层级结构、语义表达能力和动态建模支持来构建语义世界模型；(4) 使用线性回归模型校正真实世界坐标估计值。
AI.result: 系统能够基于实时传感数据持续更新对象实例、空间属性和语义关系，实现动态语义世界模型的构建，并通过线性回归有效提升真实世界坐标的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 选用本体作为知识表示形式，因其具有层级结构、语义表达力强且支持动态世界建模，所提出的混合管线在构建机器人动态语义地图方面展现出有效性。

title: Preprocessing Failure and Adversarial Detection in Depthwise-Separable Edge Vision Systems
summary: Preprocessing-based defenses are the standard first-line response to adversarial attacks on edge vision systems, requiring no retraining, no architectural changes, and widely recommended as model-agnostic mitigations. Yet the foundational evaluations of these defenses were conducted on residual or Inception-class architectures, not on the depthwise-separable CNNs that dominate edge deployments. This untested assumption leaves a gap in the security evaluation literature. This paper closes that gap by evaluating six preprocessing defenses against adversarial perturbations across both architecture families. Across all perturbation levels and defenses tested, the two depthwise-separable architectures show consistently poor recovery while the residual architecture shows partial recovery; ablation results are consistent with an architectural rather than parametric explanation, though only three architectures and one attack family are evaluated. Crucially, this failure is not merely a negative result. The same output divergence that disqualifies preprocessing as a recovery mechanism reveals a detection opportunity: preprocessing consistently disrupts clean predictions while leaving adversarial predictions largely unchanged, an asymmetry that is directly measurable without retraining or architectural modification. We further show that standard image quality metrics are unreliable proxies for defense effectiveness, a methodological gap in current evaluation practice. A practitioner decision framework is provided for adversarially resilient edge vision deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了六种预处理防御在深度可分离卷积网络（边缘视觉系统主力架构）和残差网络上的有效性，发现预处理防御在深度可分离架构上表现持续不佳，但这一"失败"反而揭示了可无训练利用的检测机会；同时指出图像质量指标不能可靠代理防御效果，并提供了面向实际部署的决策框架。
AI.motivation: 现有预处理防御的基准评估大多基于残差或Inception类架构，而非边缘部署中占主导地位的深度可分离卷积网络。这一未被检验的假设导致安全评估文献存在空白——预处理防御作为边缘视觉系统的第一道防线却未在其实际部署架构上被验证。
AI.method: 系统性地在两类架构家族（残差网络与深度可分离CNN）上评估六种预处理防御对抗对抗扰动（多种扰动水平和攻击族）的表现；通过消融实验区分架构性与参数性解释；进一步分析预处理前后干净样本与对抗样本的输出分歧模式；并使用标准图像质量指标与防御有效性进行关联检验。
AI.result: 在所有扰动水平和防御组合下，两种深度可分离架构恢复能力持续较差，而残差架构表现部分恢复；消融结果支持架构性而非参数性解释（仅三种架构、一个攻击族被评估，存在局限性）。关键发现是预处理能持续干扰干净预测但对对抗预测影响甚微——这一不对称性无需重训练或架构修改即可直接测量，构成一种检测机会。此外标准图像质量指标无法可靠代理防御有效性。
AI.conclusion: 预处理防御不能作为深度可分离边缘架构的通用恢复机制，但输出发散的不对称性可转化为实际可用的对抗检测手段；同时应废弃将质量指标视为防御效果的评估做法。论文提供了面向对抗弹性边缘视觉部署的实践者决策框架。

title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
summary: Personalized assistants should not only comply with user requests but also assess whether those requests are appropriate given the user's current circumstances. However, prior work has primarily focused on accurately executing requests, overlooking the need for assistants to account for context and engage in conflict-based refusal. Furthermore, while existing work on conflict or safety detection relies on explicitly provided factors, real-world scenarios often involve implicit factors that must be retrieved from a knowledge base (KB). To this end, we introduce Personalized Assistants for Conflict Evaluation (PACE), a dataset for evaluating whether models can identify latent constraints, expressed as egocentric knowledge or events, that render seemingly reasonable user requests inappropriate. PACE pairs user requests grounded in well-defined personas with egocentric KB facts, requiring models to integrate contextual evidence to determine whether a request is conflicting. This implicit retrieval setting hinders the direct association between user requests and conflict-inducing knowledge, making it difficult for existing models to identify relevant user-specific facts. To address this challenge, we further propose PaceMaker, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents coordinate across query reformulation, multi-hop graph traversal, and conflict-aware filtering to retrieve contextually decisive evidence. Experiments on PACE evaluate both evidence retrieval quality and conflict decision accuracy, showing that PaceMaker consistently outperforms existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE数据集和一个多智能体框架PaceMaker，用于评估和提升个性化助手识别用户请求与隐性上下文约束（如个人中心知识或事件）之间冲突的能力，证明PaceMaker在证据检索质量和冲突决策准确性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化助手主要关注准确执行用户请求，却忽视了评估请求在当前情境下是否恰当这个需求；同时已有冲突/安全检测工作依赖显式提供的因素，而真实场景中往往需要从知识库（KB）中检索隐性的约束因素。
AI.method: 提出PACE数据集，将基于明确定义人物画像的用户请求与自我中心知识库事实配对，要求模型整合上下文证据判断请求是否冲突。进一步提出PaceMaker多智能体框架，通过专门的智能体协调查询重构、多跳图遍历和冲突感知过滤来检索上下文决定性证据。
AI.result: 实验在PACE上评估了证据检索质量和冲突决策准确性，结果表明PaceMaker一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PACE和PaceMaker填补了个性化助手中隐性约束冲突检测的研究空白，为构建更符合用户真实场景的个性化助手提供了新的评估基准和有效方法。

title: Risk and Anomaly Identification for Distribution Network Optimal Operation Based on Reinforcement Learning and Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Reliable operation of modern distribution networks requires timely identification of operational risks and anomalous events under pervasive uncertainty. In practice, operators must identify risks that are inherent in stochastic yet in-distribution conditions, and anomalies that correspond to out-of-distribution behaviors such as unusual load patterns, extreme weather or cyber-physical attacks. This paper addresses this joint risk and anomaly identification problem for optimal distribution network operation and proposes a deep reinforcement learning framework that is explicitly uncertainty aware. We integrate distributional and Bayesian deep reinforcement learning to realize a second- order uncertainty quantification scheme that decomposes total uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components, which are respectively used to characterize inherent risk and out-of- distribution anomalies. The resulting epistemic estimates drive both exploration during training and out-of-distribution detec- tion with fallback control during deployment, whereas aleatoric estimates are used to characterize intrinsic operational risk. Simulation results demonstrate the performance of our DRL agent and the effectiveness of the uncertainty quantification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现代配电网络在普遍不确定性下联合风险识别与异常检测的问题，提出了一种显式不确定性感知的深度强化学习框架，通过整合分布式强化学习与贝叶斯深度强化学习实现二阶不确定性量化，将总不确定性分解为认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，分别用于表征分布外异常与固有运行风险。
AI.motivation: 现代配电网络的可靠运行需要在普遍不确定性下及时识别运行风险和异常事件。然而，实际中既存在随机但属于分布内条件所固有的风险，又存在对应分布外行为的异常（如异常负荷模式、极端天气或网络物理攻击）。现有方法难以同时有效地联合处理这两类问题。
AI.method: 提出一种不确定性感知的深度强化学习框架。通过整合分布式深度强化学习（distributional DRL）与贝叶斯深度强化学习，实现二阶不确定性量化方案，将总不确定性分解为认知不确定性（epistemic）和偶然不确定性（aleatoric）两个分量。认知不确定性驱动训练过程中的探索和部署阶段中的分布外检测及回退控制，而偶然不确定性用于刻画内在运行风险。
AI.result: 仿真结果证明了所提出DRL智能体的性能以及不确定性量化方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够同时实现运行风险的量化表征与分布外异常的检测，并通过回退控制机制保障部署阶段的可靠性，为配电网络在不确定性环境下的最优运行提供了新的解决方案。

title: SimSkill: A Lifelong Learning AI Agent for Autonomous Mastery of Traffic Simulation
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the long-term value of AI systems depends not only on solving individual requests, but also on transforming experience and accumulated knowledge into durable, reusable competence. We introduce SimSkill, a self-evolving agent built around the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) traffic simulator. SimSkill identifies capability gaps, generates and solves environment-grounded tasks, verifies solutions through an action--critic loop, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory without updating the backbone model. Through autonomous exploration, it builds a reusable library spanning the traffic-simulation workflow. We evaluate SimSkill on two held-out benchmarks with three backbone LLMs and independent artifact-based verification. SimSkill improves verified completion by up to 25 percentage points, while ablations show complementary contributions from procedural and semantic memory. Its benefits remain backbone- and budget-dependent: memory does not improve every model or uniformly reduce inference cost. More broadly, SimSkill illustrates a design paradigm in which natural language preserves and composes computational capabilities, while executable tools and code provide precise and reproducible execution. All code and experimental data are publicly available at https://github.com/qiliuchn/SimSkill-V1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimSkill，一个基于SUMO交通仿真器的自进化智能体，通过识别能力差距、生成并解决环境接地任务、以行动-评论家循环验证解决方案，并将经验巩固为情景、程序和语义记忆（不更新骨干模型），构建可复用的技能库。在保留基准上的最优结果达到25个百分点的验证提升。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型能力不断增强，AI系统的长期价值不仅取决于解决单个请求，还取决于将经验和积累的知识转化为持久、可复用的能力。现有方法通常依赖模型参数更新来积累知识，缺乏一个能够在不修改骨干模型的前提下自我进化、系统性地将经验沉淀为组件化技能库的范式。
AI.method: SimSkill是一个围绕SUMO交通仿真器构建的自进化智能体，其核心流程包括：识别能力缺口，生成并解决环境接地任务，通过行动-评论家循环（action-critic loop）验证解决方案，并将经验沉淀为三类记忆——情景记忆（episodic）、程序记忆（procedural）和语义记忆（semantic），全程不更新骨干LLM模型参数。通过自主探索，逐步构建覆盖交通仿真工作流的可复用库。
AI.result: 在两个保留基准测试上，使用三个不同骨干LLM及独立构件级验证进行评估，SimSkill将验证完成率最高提升25个百分点。消融实验显示程序记忆和语义记忆存在互补贡献；其收益与骨干模型和计算预算相关——记忆机制并非对所有模型都有提升，也不能统一降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: SimSkill展示了一种新的设计范式：自然语言负责保留和组合计算能力，而可执行工具和代码提供精确、可复现的执行。该工作证明了在不更新模型参数的情况下，通过自主探索和经验分层记忆实现智能体能力持续自我进化是可行的，代码与实验数据均已公开。

title: Revisiting Topological Graphs for Macro Action based Closed-loop Reinforcement Learning of Vision Language Navigation in Continuous Environment
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow natural language instructions through unseen environments. Existing imitation learning (IL) pipelines struggle in this closed-loop setting: behavior cloning suffers from distribution shift, and DAgger's expert actions become ambiguous upon trajectory deviation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a natural paradigm to address this, directly applying RL to micro action spaces is sample-inefficient due to reward sparsity. To overcome this bottleneck, we reformulate VLN-CE as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (MDP), explicitly decoupling high-level planning from low-level control. By abstracting the environment into a topological graph, our high-level policy operates on a macro action space of frontier nodes, with a training-free low-level controller acting as its state transition, which significantly compresses the decision horizon and makes closed-loop RL tractable. To support RL optimization on the macro MDP, we propose an action-aware value head to effectively evaluate state values under the dynamic frontier action space, powering a graph-based PPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our architecture. Finally, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将连续环境中的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）重构为分层马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过拓扑图将环境抽象为宏动作空间，高层策略在边界节点上进行规划，低层控制器负责执行，并设计动作感知价值头配合基于图的PPO算法进行强化学习优化，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习管线在VLN-CE闭环环境中面临分布偏移和DAgger专家动作歧义等问题；直接应用强化学习到微观动作空间因奖励稀疏而样本效率低下，亟需一种更高效的闭环决策范式。
AI.method: 将VLN-CE建模为分层MDP，通过拓扑图抽象环境使高层策略在动态前沿节点宏动作空间上决策，训练-free的低层控制器负责状态转移；提出动作感知价值头以在动态动作空间下有效评估状态价值，并基于此实现图结构的PPO算法进行强化学习优化。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了所提架构的有效性，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE两个基准上均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层MDP重构并结合图基PPO，成功解决了VLN-CE中RL训练样本效率低下的问题，为闭环指令导航提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: BMCTrack-d: Pig re-identification and tracking via back marks in challenging camera settings
summary: Automated pig monitoring is essential for assessing their health, behaviour, and welfare. To date, most pig monitoring solutions operate on the group-level, because individual-level monitoring requires reliable long-term identification and tracking of each animal. For domesticated pigs this remains challenging because pigs of the same breed often have highly uniform appearances. Moreover, research on pig monitoring is almost exclusively reported in top-down view camera settings, which considerably ease tracking, but are not always an option in practice. In this work, BMCTrack-d is presented, a novel tracking-by-detection approach that leverages unique back marks to enable robust pig re-identification and tracking in a challenging side-view camera setting, afflicted by rapidly moving pigs, severe occlusions and low resolution. The method first predicts the detected pigs' identities using a neural network-based back mark classifier. To improve re-identification reliability over time, two dedicated post-processing stages are introduced: a temporal prediction consistency check, which validates the identity assignments against the recent prediction history, and deduplication, which resolves conflicting identity assignments in each time step. By explicitly prioritising accurate, appearance-based re-identification over continuous tracking, the proposed approach addresses a key limitation of existing trackers for individual-level monitoring scenarios. On a demanding test set BMCTrack-d outperforms two strong baselines, BoT-SORT-ReID and TrackTrack-ReID, by 9.11% and 1.03%, respectively, in higher-order tracking accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of back mark-based re-identification and tracking for robust individual-level pig monitoring in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 提出BMCTrack-d，一种基于背部标记的检测-跟踪方法，用于在侧视摄像头设置下实现猪的个体级再识别与稳健跟踪，解决了同品种猪外观高度相似、运动剧烈、遮挡严重和低分辨率等挑战。
AI.motivation: 猪的自动化监测对健康、行为和福利评估至关重要，但现有监测多在群体级别进行。个体级监测需要可靠的长时识别和跟踪，而同类猪外观高度统一，且传统研究几乎仅在俯视摄像头设置下进行，实践中并非总可用。因此需要一种在侧视设置下也能实现稳健个体级猪跟踪的方法。
AI.method: BMCTrack-d采用基于检测的跟踪框架：首先使用基于神经网络的背部标记分类器预测被检测猪的身份；接着引入两个后处理阶段：(1)时间预测一致性检查，根据近期预测历史验证身份分配；(2)去重处理，解决每个时间步内冲突的身份分配。该方法明确优先考虑基于外观的准确再识别而非连续跟踪。
AI.result: 在严苛测试集上，BMCTrack-d在更高阶跟踪精度上分别比两个强基线方法BoT-SORT-ReID和TrackTrack-ReID高出9.11%和1.03%。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了基于背部标记的再识别和跟踪方法在挑战性场景中实现稳健个体级猪监测的有效性，为侧视摄像头设置下的个体级猪监测提供了可行方案。

title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching
summary:
AI agents have recently demonstrated strong performance in automated vulnerability patching. However, existing evaluations often validate a patch only by testing whether the provided Proof-of-Concept (PoC) input still triggers a crash. This leaves two key threats to validity: agents may reproduce memorized historical developer patches, or they may generate surface-level fixes that only suppress the reported crash.
  We study these concerns for C/C++ vulnerability patching. We introduce a patch similarity metric to detect memorized patches. On average, 25% of the agent patches exhibit substantial similarity to historical developer patches, indicating that patch memorization is a real threat to the validity of vulnerability patching evaluations. Meanwhile, agents also frequently exploit benchmark structures to pass patch validation by patching on the crash stack trace to suppress the crash, rather than localizing and fixing the root cause of the vulnerabilities.
  To handle these issues, we propose PatchBench, a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on realistic vulnerability patching tasks. PatchBench selects vulnerabilities whose ground-truth fixes lie outside the crash stack and uses vulnerability transplant and code mutations to migrate historical vulnerabilities into new repository contexts, reducing the risks of surface-level fixes and patch memorization. We develop new patch validation methods that thoroughly evaluate both security and semantic correctness of agent patches. Across 11 state-of-the-art agents, including the top three AIxCC agents, the original PoC-only validation inflates the patching task solve rate of agents by 1.83$\times$ on average. Our results reveal key limitations of current patching agents and point to future research directions for more reliable vulnerability repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PatchBench基准，用于更可靠地评估AI智能体在C/C++漏洞修复任务中的真实表现。研究发现现有评估存在两大问题：约25%的智能体补丁与历史开发者补丁高度相似（补丁记忆），以及智能体常利用崩溃堆栈进行表面修复而非定位根因。PatchBench通过选择根因修复不在崩溃堆栈中的漏洞、使用漏洞移植和代码突变迁移到新仓库上下文来缓解这些问题，并开发了更全面的补丁验证方法。实验表明，当使用仅PoC验证时，11个SOTA智能体的修复成功率平均被夸大1.83倍。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体漏洞修复评估存在两个关键有效性威胁：(1)智能体可能复现记忆的历史开发者补丁而非真正理解漏洞；(2)智能体可能生成仅抑制崩溃的表面修复而非修复根因。现有评估仅通过检查PoC是否仍触发崩溃来验证补丁，无法识别这些问题，导致对智能体真实修复能力的高估。
AI.method: 作者提出补丁相似度度量来检测记忆化补丁，并提出PatchBench基准：选择真实修复超出崩溃堆栈范围的漏洞，通过漏洞移植（vulnerability transplant）和代码突变（code mutation）将历史漏洞迁移到新的仓库上下文中，以降低表面修复和补丁记忆风险。同时开发了同时评估补丁安全性与语义正确性的新验证方法。
AI.result: 平均25%的智能体补丁与历史开发者补丁表现出高度相似性；智能体频繁利用崩溃堆栈抑制崩溃而非修复根因。在11个SOTA智能体（包括AIxCC前三名）上，原始仅PoC验证使修复成功率平均高估1.83倍。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI漏洞修复智能体的真实能力被显著高估，现有评估方法存在的记忆化补丁和表面修复问题需要被严肃对待。PatchBench为更可靠地评测智能体漏洞修复能力提供了新方向，结果也揭示了现有修复智能体的关键局限性。

title: Decoupling Turn-Taking from Semantics: A Decoupled Data Approach for Finite-State-Machine-Based Full-Duplex Dialogue
summary: The Neural Finite State Machine (NFSM) framework offers a pragmatic path to full-duplex dialogue by serializing turn-taking control and response generation onto a single causal tape under the standard next-token prediction objective, thereby preserving semantic prowess at a low fine-tuning cost. However, its reliance on synthetic text data fundamentally limits turn-taking naturalness, as Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot faithfully simulate the fine-grained acoustic temporal dynamics of real human dialogues. In this work, we propose a decoupled data approach that learns turn-taking from real Human-Human (HH) spoken dialogues while shaping semantic behavior through configurable Human-Agent (HA) text dialogues. To operationalize this approach, we introduce a rule-based event-guided data transformation method that serializes HH spoken dialogues into FSM tapes by classifying turn-taking events and applying deterministic mapping rules, enabling scalable supervision without LLM-generated annotations. We further propose a Source-Aware Calibrated (SAC) Loss that jointly calibrates the long-tailed distribution of state transition tokens and channels each data source toward the capability it best supervises. Experiments show that our approach substantially improves turn-taking proficiency while recovering the foundation LLM's semantic capability. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/Liyht/def-fsm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解耦数据方法DEF-FSM，通过学习真实人类对话的轮转控制来提升神经有限状态机（NFSM）框架的全双工对话自然度，同时利用可配置的人机文本对话塑造语义行为。通过引入基于规则的event-guided数据变换方法和Source-Aware Calibrated (SAC) Loss，显著提升了轮转能力并恢复了基础LLM的语义能力。
AI.motivation: NFSM框架虽然在标准next-token预测目标下将轮转控制和响应生成序列化到统一因果带中，能够以低微调成本保留语义能力，但该框架依赖合成文本数据训练轮转控制，而LLM无法忠实模拟真实人类对话中细微的声学时间动态，导致轮转自然度受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出解耦数据方法：从真实人-人(HH)口语对话学习轮转控制，从可配置的人-智能体(HA)文本对话塑造语义行为。2) 引入规则驱动的事件引导数据变换方法：通过分类轮转事件并应用确定性映射规则，将HH口语对话序列化为FSM磁带，无需LLM生成标注即可进行可扩展监督。3) 提出Source-Aware Calibrated (SAC) Loss：联合校准状态转移token的长尾分布，并将每个数据源引导至其最能监督的能力方向。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升了轮转交互能力，同时恢复了基础LLM的语义能力。
AI.conclusion: 解耦数据方法结合规则驱动变换和SAC Loss，有效解决了NFSM框架中合成数据导致的轮转不自然问题，在不牺牲语义能力的前提下实现更好的全双工对话体验。

title: DE-Venus: A Data-Efficient RLVR Framework for Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves large language model reasoning, but its practical scaling is constrained by expensive on-policy rollouts and the cost of obtaining reliable targets at scale. Existing methods address sample selection, incomplete supervision, or noisy labels separately, often entangling supervision logic with distributed training and hindering controlled comparison and reuse. We present DE-Venus, a unified framework for data-efficient RLVR that treats supervision as evolving state across data preparation and policy optimization. It organizes this lifecycle into three modules: Active Data Selection allocates training and annotation budgets; Weak Supervision Construction derives learning signals from unlabeled examples; and Training-Time Supervision Refinement filters or corrects unreliable supervision. DE-Venus supports seven representative methods and a data-selection pipeline by expressing method-specific decisions as offline dataset transitions or online transformations of targets, rewards, batches, and advantages while preserving verl's distributed execution contracts. Across public benchmarks and three business scenarios, separate configurations preserve or improve model quality with only 10% of labels or as little as 13% of relevant data; selected business configurations also reduce observed convergence steps by 63%--75%. DE-Venus thus reduces annotation and training costs without sacrificing scalable RL execution.

AI.tldr: DE-Venus是一个面向数据高效RLVR的统一框架，将监督信号视为贯穿数据准备与策略优化的演化状态，通过三大模块（主动数据选择、弱监督构建、训练时监督精炼）支持七种代表性方法，在保持verl分布式执行契约的同时，以10%的标签量或13%的相关数据保持或提升模型质量，并在部分业务配置中减少63%-75%的收敛步数。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽能提升大语言模型推理能力，但实际扩展受限于昂贵的on-policy rollout成本和获取可靠监督目标的高昂代价。现有方法分别处理样本选择、不完整监督或噪声标签，常将监督逻辑与分布式训练纠缠，阻碍了受控比较和复用，亟需统一框架。
AI.method: DE-Venus将监督视为随时间演化的状态（贯穿数据准备与策略优化），组织为三个模块：主动数据选择（分配训练与标注预算）、弱监督构建（从未标注样本中推导学习信号）、训练时监督精炼（过滤或纠正不可靠监督）。方法通过将方法特定决策表达为离线数据集转换或在线对targets、rewards、batches和advantages的变换，同时保持verl的分布式执行契约。框架支持七种代表性方法及一个数据选择流水线。
AI.result: 在公共基准和三个业务场景中，独立配置在仅使用10%标签或低至13%相关数据的条件下保持或提升模型质量；部分业务配置将可观测的收敛步数减少了63%-75%。
AI.conclusion: DE-Venus能在不牺牲可扩展RL执行的前提下降低标注与训练成本，证明了将监督逻辑模块化、与分布式训练解耦的统一框架在数据高效RLVR中的有效性。

title: Rethinking World Models for Safety-Critical Embodied Systems
summary: World models have progressed from compact latent dynamics to generative, controllable, and interactive simulators of embodied environments. However, high predictive likelihood and visual fidelity do not necessarily ensure that a model preserves the evidence required for safe decision-making. This perspective identifies three structural mismatches in current world modeling: likelihood versus risk, prediction versus intervention, and finite-horizon prediction versus accumulated consequences. We propose the Risk-Informed World Model (RIWM) as a decision-centric research direction for safety-critical embodied systems. RIWM organizes world modeling around consequences, intervention, epistemic uncertainty, and recoverability, and integrates four interdependent capabilities: decision-relevant representation, counterfactual reasoning, safety-critical episodic memory, and runtime safety assurance. It distinguishes physical, social, and operational consequences while using epistemic uncertainty to qualify the evidence supporting action. We further discuss open challenges in identifying consequential futures, validating counterfactual reasoning, maintaining revisable safety memories, translating learned consequences into executable constraints, and determining when evidence is sufficient to act. This perspective argues that future world models should move beyond predicting likely futures toward identifying which futures matter, revising judgments through experience, and recognizing when to act, revise, sense, defer, or abstain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"风险知情世界模型"（RIWM）作为安全关键型嵌入系统世界模型的研究方向，指出当前世界模型存在三个结构性错配（似然vs风险、预测vs干预、有限时域预测vs累积后果），并主张未来世界模型应从预测"可能的未来"转向识别"重要的未来"。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型从紧凑潜在动力学演进为生成式、可控、交互式的模拟器，但高预测似然和视觉保真度并不保证模型保留了安全决策所需的证据。本文识别出三个结构性错配：似然与风险不匹配、预测与干预不匹配、有限时域预测与累积后果不匹配，说明当前方法无法直接支撑安全关键决策。
AI.method: 提出RIWM作为决策中心的研究方向，围绕后果、干预、认知不确定性、可恢复性四大要素组织世界建模，并整合四种相互依赖的能力：决策相关表征、反事实推理、安全关键情节记忆、运行时安全保障。同时区分物理、社会与操作三类后果，利用认知不确定性来限定支持行动的证据。
AI.result: 本文为观点型论文，无实验数据。主要贡献在于系统性地识别了世界模型在安全决策中的结构性缺陷，提出了RIWM的理论框架和四大核心能力，并指出了五个开放挑战：识别后果性未来、验证反事实推理、维护可修正的安全记忆、将学习到的后果转化为可执行约束、判断证据何时足以采取行动。
AI.conclusion: 未来世界模型应超越预测"可能的未来"，转向识别"哪些未来重要"，通过经验修订判断，并识别何时该行动、修订、感知、延迟或放弃。

title: Toward Unified Robot Learning: Bridging Representation, Vision-Language-Action, and World Models
summary: For robots to operate reliably in real-world environments, they need to perceive their surroundings, act, and reason about the consequences of those actions. Rapid progress in the domains of representation learning, VLA models, and world models has significantly enhanced the capabilities of robot learning systems, enabling robots to work in increasingly complex environments. However, these paradigms are typically developed in isolation, resulting in fragmented systems that struggle with generalization, long-horizon temporal reasoning and planning, and deployment in unstructured environments. In this survey, we present a unified perspective on robot learning by organizing the existing methods along three complementary axes: understanding through representation learning, acting through VLA models, and reasoning through world models. We introduce a structured taxonomy that captures key design choices in environment representation, policy learning, and predictive modeling, and summarize the recent progress in these domains. Beyond classifying the existing works, we analyze how these components interact, discuss common limitations, and highlight emerging trends towards more integrated systems. Through this lens, we identify the challenges in the domain of robot learning, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution generalization, cross-embodiment transfer, long-context understanding, and long-horizon planning. We argue that these challenges arise not only from limitations within individual components but also from the lack of integration across perception, action, and reasoning. Building on this analysis, we outline future directions towards unified, physically grounded, and probabilistic robot learning to develop robust robotic systems that maintain consistent internal representations and support decision making over extended interactions in real-world environments.

AI.tldr: 本综述提出了一种统一的机器人学习视角，将现有方法沿着理解（表征学习）、行动（VLA模型）和推理（世界模型）三个互补轴进行组织，建立了结构化分类体系，并分析各组件间的交互关系、共同局限性及向更集成系统发展的趋势。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人学习中的表征学习、VLA模型和世界模型三大范式通常是孤立开发的，导致系统碎片化，难以实现泛化、长时域推理与规划以及在非结构化环境中的部署。因此需要统一的视角来整合这些互补方法。
AI.method: 提出三个互补轴的组织框架（理解-表征学习、行动-VLA模型、推理-世界模型），构建结构化分类体系以捕捉环境表征、策略学习和预测建模中的关键设计选择，并综述这些领域的近期进展，同时分析组件间交互及挑战。
AI.result: 识别出机器人学习领域面临的关键挑战，包括不确定性量化、分布外泛化、跨具身迁移、长上下文理解和长时域规划，并论证这些挑战既源于各独立组件的局限，也源于感知、行动与推理之间缺乏集成。
AI.conclusion: 未来方向应朝向统一、物理扎根且概率化的机器人学习系统发展，以构建能维持一致内部表征并支持在真实环境中长时间交互中决策的稳健机器人系统。

title: SafeRestore: Detector-Relative Risk Certificates for Selective Industrial Image Restoration
comment: 27 pages, 10 figures, 6 main-text tables, and 17 supplementary tables. Shares the Carinthia-S image identities with arXiv:2607.17401 by the same authors; the overlap and the distinct estimand are stated in Section 2.4 and Table 1
summary: Industrial inspection pipelines often restore a measured image before a detector acts on it, yet restoration can suppress detector-supported defect structure or create clean-region activations. We formulate restoration as a selective action problem over the measured display, five restored candidates, and review. SafeRestore ranks candidates with action-specific fitted scores, chooses a gate on threshold-tuning data, and evaluates the fixed gate on a disjoint certification sample with two one-sided exact binomial bounds: one for the positive-conditional evidence-loss incident rate and one for the all-accepted excess-activation incident rate. The guarantee is marginal for one policy fixed before its certification outcomes are observed, under an image-level i.i.d. working model. In a retrospective split-sample study of 4,591 public Carinthia-S images, the protocol yields auditable risk-coverage behavior. The primary all-action policy passes in one of five training repetitions (12.0% +/- 26.9% pass-gated test coverage when failures count as zero), whereas fixed bicubic and reduced-complexity variants pass more often. On reserved morphologies, evidence-loss incidence rises to 81.1-90.3%, and KolektorSDD lacks both detector competence and enough positive certification images for the stated target. The contribution is therefore an auditable, detector-relative framework for deciding when a transformed image may be returned automatically and when review remains necessary -- not a claim that adaptive routing outperforms simpler policies on the present evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeRestore框架，将工业检测管线中的图像复原视为一种"选择性行动"问题，在测量图像、五个复原候选及人工复核之间进行带可审计风险保证的决策路由，并以精确二项界对固定策略的证据丢失率和过激活率进行认证。
AI.motivation: 工业检测流程通常先对测得图像做复原再交给检测器，但复原操作可能抑制检测器所依赖的缺陷结构，或在不含缺陷区域产生误激活。因此需要一种框架来判断何时可以自动返回变换后的图像、何时必须转人工复核。
