AI.method: 将复原建模为选择性行动问题，涉及测量显示、五个复原候选和人工复核。SafeRestore通过行动特定拟合分数对候选排序，在阈值调优数据上选择门控决策，并在不相交的认证样本上用两个单侧精确二项界（一个针对正样本条件下的证据丢失事件率，一个针对全部被接受样本的过激活事件率）评估固定门控。整体保证是在图像级i.i.d.工作模型下、策略固定于认证结果观测之前的边际保证。
AI.result: 在4,591张公开Carinthia-S图像上的回顾性分样本研究中，主要全行动策略在五次训练重复中仅一次通过（失败计零时，通过门控的测试覆盖率为12.0%±26.9%），而固定的双三次插值及降复杂度变体通过率更高。在保留形态上，证据丢失发生率升至81.1%-90.3%；KolektorSDD数据集则既缺乏检测器能力、又缺少足够的正样本认证图像来达到声明的目标。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献是一个可审计的、与检测器相关的框架，用于决定变换后图像何时可自动返回、何时仍需复核，而非声称自适应路由在当前证据上优于更简单的策略。

title: A Non-Formulable Theorem: A Fundamental Limit of Finite Syntactic Systems and Its Consequences for Security and AI
summary: For every coherent and sufficiently expressive finite syntactic system S, we prove the existence of at least one theorem that S cannot produce autonomously. The result is a metatheorem: it proves the existence of a theorem, and applies to every finite syntactic system - security mechanisms, AI systems, formal verifiers, legal systems, economic models, and the formal system in which it is itself proved.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了一个元定理：对于任何连贯且足够表达力的有限句法系统S，都存在至少一个S无法自主产生的定理。该结果适用于所有有限句法系统，包括它自身。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机在于证明所有有限形式系统（从安全机制、AI系统到法律和经济模型）都存在内在的表达/推理局限——即系统无法完全自足地产生所有定理。
AI.method: 作者采用元定理的方法（metatheorem），通过对一般有限句法系统进行形式化分析，证明存在性的而非构造性的结论。该定理在元层面自指地适用于自身作为证明系统的情况。
AI.result: 证明了在任何一致的、足够表达力的有限句法系统中，至少存在一个该系统无法自主推导的定理。该结果对所有有限句法系统普遍成立，包括安全系统、AI系统、形式验证器、法律体系、经济模型以及证明该定理自身的系统。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：有限句法系统在本质上不具备完全的自主定理生成能力，这一局限性是结构性且不可避免的；该元定理自身的自指应用也暗示了形式系统局限性的普遍性。

title: How Perturbations Propagate: A Multi-Level Analysis of Robustness in Large Language Models
summary: Language models encounter typos, corrupted text, altered words, and disrupted token order, yet robustness is usually evaluated only through output behavior. We study how six naturalistic and synthetic input perturbations propagate through decoder-only language models at three levels: output behavior, hidden-state geometry, and attention-head function. We evaluate behavioral effects across four GPT-2 and two Qwen2.5 checkpoints by analyzing layerwise geometry using centered kernel alignment and intrinsic dimension, and examine attention-head responses in GPT-2. Perturbation types produce distinguishable metric profiles that are not fully captured by output measures and are only partly consistent across the tested checkpoints. Copying scores are especially associated with activation-patching recovery under token substitution and shuffling. Gradient-guided HotFlip perturbations also cause stronger behavioral and representational disruption than rate-matched random token substitutions in GPT-2; their behavioral effects are consistent across all six tested checkpoints. Our results show that robustness claims based on a single behavioral or representational metric can be misleading, and motivate multi-level evaluation of how perturbations alter language-model computation.

AI.tldr: 本文从三个层面（输出行为、隐状态几何、注意力头功能）系统研究六种自然与合成输入扰动对仅解码器语言模型的影响，使用中心核对齐和内在维度等指标进行分析，发现不同扰动类型产生可区分的度量轮廓，并揭示基于单一行为或表征指标的鲁棒性评估可能产生误导。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型鲁棒性研究通常仅通过输出行为进行评估，忽略了扰动如何影响模型内部的计算过程。作者希望填补这一空白，在更深层次上理解输入扰动对模型的影响，特别是隐状态几何和注意力头功能层面的变化。
AI.method: 在四个GPT-2和两个Qwen2.5检查点上评估六种自然与合成输入扰动（包括单词替换、洗牌、HotFlip等），通过层间几何度量（中心核对齐CKA和内在维度）分析隐状态变化，检查注意力头响应，并计算复制分数与激活修补恢复之间的关联。同时，将梯度引导的HotFlip扰动与速率匹配的随机标记替换进行对比。
AI.result: 不同扰动类型产生可区分的度量轮廓，这些轮廓无法被纯输出指标完全捕获，且在不同检查点间仅部分一致。复制分数与标记替换和洗牌下的激活修补恢复高度相关。在GPT-2中，HotFlip扰动比速率匹配的随机替换造成更强行为和表征层面的破坏，且其行为影响在所有六个检查点上一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于单一行为或表征指标的鲁棒性声明可能具有误导性，需要采用多层次评估来理解扰动如何改变语言模型的计算过程。

title: A Large Open Multi-Energy Corpus of Soil Compaction Tests, with Machine-Learning Baselines
summary: Every engineered fill is specified by a maximum dry density and an optimum moisture content. Each determination needs a full Proctor test. Published correlations rest on one to four hundred specimens, usually from one laboratory at one compactive energy, and are seldom released. This paper releases a corpus without those limits. It holds 2,854 laboratory compaction tests from six public sources, across 162 provenance groups and four Proctor energy levels, with fines from 1.5 to 100%. Every record is audited to the Proctor method its source names, and no energy is inferred. Screening on the zero-air-voids condition removed 11.8% of harmonised records, and 5.7% of those with a measured specific gravity. A material share of published compaction data is physically impossible. The optimum degree of saturation over the corpus is 0.815 at a coefficient of variation of 11%. That is a baseline, not a constant. Both parameters are then estimated from one classification suite and the compaction standard. A tabular foundation model reaches R2 0.824 for density and 0.784 for water content under random folds. It reaches 0.727 and 0.696 with folds drawn around provenance, and 0.520 and 0.614 with a whole source held out. Compactive energy is negligible marginally yet decisive conditionally. Density on the 66 modified-Proctor records is predicted at R2 0.740 with it and -0.651 without. Symbolic regression yields closed forms coupled through a phase relation. No predicted pair can then exceed the zero-air-voids line. The predictions are for screening, not acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个包含2,854项实验室击实试验的大型语料库（来自6个公共来源、162个出处组、4种Proctor能量等级），经零气隙条件筛选后，建立了从单一分类参数和击实标准预测最大干密度与最优含水率的模型。表格基础模型在随机折下R²达0.824（密度）和0.784（含水率），符号回归提供闭合形式解并通过相位关系耦合，确保预测不越过零气隙线。
AI.motivation: 现有的土体击实相关性研究受限于样本量小（仅1-400个试件）、通常来自单一实验室和单一压实能量，且很少公开发布。缺乏大范围、多来源、跨能量等级的数据集来建立可靠的击实参数预测关系。
AI.method: 构建了2,854项实验室Proctor击实试验的审校数据集，覆盖6个公共来源、162个出处组和4种Proctor能量等级。每条记录按其来源命名的方法进行审计，不推断能量。采用零气隙条件筛选去除11.8%的不可行记录。使用表格基础模型和符号回归，从单一分类套件和击实标准预测最大干密度和最优含水率。通过三种折叠策略（随机、按出处、整源留出）评估泛化性能。
AI.result: 语料库中最佳饱和度为0.815（变异系数11%），是一个基线而非常数。表格基础模型在随机折下R²为0.824（密度）和0.784（含水率）；按出处折叠时降至0.727和0.696；整源留出时为0.520和0.614。压实能量边际上可忽略但条件性上至关重要——对66条改良Proctor记录，含能量的R²为0.740，不含能量则为-0.651。符号回归产生的闭合形式通过相位关系耦合，确保预测对不越过零气隙线。
AI.conclusion: 相当比例已发表的击实数据在物理上不可能（需通过零气隙条件筛选剔除）。击实参数预测应在压实能量等条件下使用，预测用于筛选而非验收。符号回归与相位关系的耦合提供了一种保证物理可行性的预测框架。

title: DNative-Twin: Decision Graphs and Digital Twins for Reconstructable Agentic Decisions
summary: AI agents increasingly gather evidence, invoke tools, apply constraints, and produce decisions that people or software may commit to action. A final output alone cannot show which evidence, tool state, rule, authorization, or action path produced it. We present DNative-Twin, a graph-native digital twin that records a committed agentic decision as a typed trajectory and re-executes its decision mechanism under declared conditions. The graph links the state observed by the agent, the path it followed, and the authority behind the resulting action. The twin synchronizes this information, replays the mechanism in isolation, and compares it under controlled changes. We instantiate the framework in enterprise decision processes using three public process logs and controlled replay suites. The experiments identify a specific failure: graph structure localizes represented changes but cannot determine the consequence of an unobserved tool state. In a three-condition controlled experiment with 300 injected instances, unresolved-divergence recall increased from 0 to 0.667 when replay-contract state was added and to 1.0 when verification results were also available; the held-out set contained no critical-class instance. Across 500--5,000 BPI 2020 cases, median end-to-end time increased from 0.794 to 8.889 seconds on the reported platform. These results separate the roles of graph structure, replay context, and verification evidence in reviewing a decision mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DNative-Twin，一种图原生的数字孪生框架，用于记录和复盘AI代理的自主决策过程。它将决策记录为类型化轨迹，通过图结构连接代理观察到的状态、遵循的路径和行动背后的授权，支持在受控条件下重放和比较决策机制。实验发现图结构只能定位表示变化，无法判定未观察工具状态的后果；通过引入重放合约状态和验证证据，关键失效检测的召回率从0提升至1.0。
AI.motivation: AI代理越来越多地收集证据、调用工具、应用约束并产生决策，但仅凭最终输出无法展示是哪些证据、工具状态、规则、授权或行动路径产生了该决策，缺乏可审计和可验证的决策过程。
AI.method: 提出DNative-Twin图原生数字孪生框架：(1)将已实施的代理决策记录为类型化轨迹；(2)在声明条件下重新执行决策机制；(3)用图结构关联代理观察状态、路径和行动授权；(4)支持同步信息、隔离重放机制并在受控变化下比较。在企业决策过程中使用三个公开流程日志和受控重放套件进行实例化。
AI.result: 在三条件受控实验中（注入300个实例），加入重放合约状态后未解决分歧的召回率从0提升至0.667，进一步加入验证结果后达到1.0；留出集无关键类别实例。在BPI 2020的500-5,000个案例中，端到端中位时间从0.794秒增加至8.889秒。结果区分了图结构、重放上下文和验证证据在决策机制审查中的不同作用。
AI.conclusion: DNative-Twin有效分离并揭示了图结构、重放上下文和验证证据在审查代理决策机制中的各自职责：图结构只能定位表示变化，无法判定未观察工具状态的实际后果，必须结合重放合约状态与验证证据才能实现完整的可审计决策复盘。

title: Automated Weld Seam Recognition and 3D Mapping for Robotic Post Processing Using Photogrammetry and Semantic Segmentation
comment: Extended abstract not yet published to a conference or journal
summary: Accurate identification of weld seam geometries is essential for automated robotic post processing operations such as grinding, finishing, and inspection. For large workpieces, complete surface scanning using high precision laser scanners or structured light sensors can be time consuming and often generates substantial amount of data that are not relevant. This paper presents an experimental vision based pipeline for the approximate localization of weld seams. This serves as a preliminary stage before high precision measurement. The proposed approach aims to reduce the overall scanning effort and data acquisition efficiency. The proposed method includes capturing images of the workpiece from multiple viewpoints, identifying weld seams from the images using semantic segmentation, reconstructing the workpiece using photogrammetry, and projection of identified weld seams into the reconstructed model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的焊缝近似定位实验流程，作为高精度测量前的预备阶段，通过多视角图像采集、语义分割焊缝识别、摄影测量重建及焊缝投影映射，减少大型工件扫描所需的时间和数据处理量。
AI.motivation: 大型工件使用高精度激光扫描仪或结构光传感器进行完整表面扫描耗时且产生大量无关数据，需要一种高效的预定位方法来缩小高精度测量的扫描范围，提升数据采集效率。
AI.method: 该方法包括四个步骤：从多视角拍摄工件图像；利用语义分割从图像中识别焊缝；通过摄影测量重建工件三维模型；将识别出的焊缝投影到重建模型中，实现焊缝的近似空间定位。
AI.result: 论文呈现了实验性视觉管线，验证了该流程作为高精度测量前置阶段的可行性，能够有效减少整体扫描工作量并提高数据采集效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的视觉管线可在高精度测量前完成焊缝的近似定位，从而减少扫描成本与数据冗余，为机器人自动化后处理（如磨削、精整和检测）提供高效的前置支持。

title: Tree species mapping in Denmark: A comparison of spectral-temporal features with geospatial foundation model embeddings
comment: Submitted to Remote Sensing of Environment. This preprint presents a national-scale tree species mapping framework for Denmark using Sentinel-1/2 time series, National Forest Inventory data, and EO foundation model embeddings. The resulted national map can be found here: https://zenodo.org/uploads/22108850
summary: We map tree species across Denmark using National Forest Inventory plots and EO data, while evaluating the potential of foundation models for large-scale forest characterization. We compare two alternative input representations for tree species classification: (i) manually engineered spectral-temporal features (STF) derived from multi-temporal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations, and (ii) embeddings generated by the EO FMs TESSERA and AlphaEarth. Both representations are complemented with canopy height information. Random forest, XGBoost, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers are evaluated for all input representations, with separate assessments for pure and mixed forest stands. The STF-based MLP achieves the highest classification performance, yielding macro F1 scores of 0.843 and 0.653 for pure and mixed stands, respectively. The MLP trained on TESSERA embeddings delivers competitive performance for pure stands, achieving results within 1.1 percentage points of the best-performing model. TESSERA consistently outperforms STF-based models when fewer than approximately 25% of training plots are available, demonstrating a substantial advantage under limited training data. Multi-year observations systematically improve classification accuracy relative to single-year inputs, while ablation experiments reveal the complementary contributions of Sentinel-1 backscatter, spectral indices, and canopy height data. The best-performing model is subsequently applied at the national scale to generate a 10 m tree species map of Denmark. Area-adjusted validation indicates an overall map accuracy of 79.9%. The resulting map, released as an open-access product, is the first high-resolution national tree species map of Denmark and provides a valuable resource for forest monitoring, ecological research, and land management applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用国家森林清查数据和地球观测基础模型（TESSERA、AlphaEarth），在丹麦范围内绘制树种分布图。STF+MLP组合表现最佳（纯林宏F1=0.843，混交林=0.653），TESSERA嵌入在训练数据不足时（<25%样地）更具优势，最终生成丹麦首个10米分辨率开源高精度树种图（总体精度79.9%）。
AI.motivation: 大尺度森林精确表征对森林监测、生态研究和土地管理至关重要。传统方法依赖人工设计的遥感特征，成本高且泛化能力有限。作者旨在评估地球观测基础模型（EO foundation models）在大规模树种分类中的潜力，并与传统特征工程方法进行系统对比，以探索更高效、可扩展的森林表征方案。
AI.method: 利用丹麦国家森林清查样地数据，比较两种输入表征：(1)基于Sentinel-1和Sentinel-2多时相观测的人工设计光谱-时间特征(STF)；(2)由EO基础模型TESSERA和AlphaEarth生成的嵌入特征。两种表征均辅以冠层高度信息，分别使用随机森林、XGBoost和MLP三种分类器评估，并区分纯林和混交林场景。包含消融实验、样本量敏感性分析及多年观测增益分析，最佳模型用于生成全国10米树种图并做面积调整验证。
AI.result: STF+MLP取得最高分类性能（纯林宏F1=0.843，混交林=0.653）；TESSERA嵌入MLP在纯林场景与最优模型差距仅1.1个百分点；训练数据少于约25%样地时，TESSERA一致优于STF模型；多年观测数据稳定提升精度；消融实验证实Sentinel-1后向散射、光谱指数和冠层高度的互补贡献；生成的全国10米树种图面积调整后总体精度为79.9%，为丹麦首个高分辨率全国树种分布图并开源发布。
AI.conclusion: 地球观测基础模型（尤其是TESSERA）在充足训练数据下与人工特征工程表现相当，在数据稀缺条件下具有显著优势，证明其在可扩展的大尺度森林表征与制图方面具有实际应用价值。生成的丹麦10米树种图作为开放数据产品，为森林监测、生态研究和土地管理提供了重要基础资源。

title: SENTINEL-RL: Offloading Topological Reasoning from LLM Agents in the Security Operations Center
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous SOC analysts, but two limitations make them unreliable at enterprise scale: a finite context window cannot hold a multi-thousand-host authentication graph, and free-form generation offers no guarantee that a recommended containment action is consistent with the topology it operates on. We present Sentinel-RL, an agentic-SOC architecture that decouples topological reasoning from semantic reasoning: a heterogeneous graph attention encoder summarizes the live authentication subgraph into a fixed-dimensional state, a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy maps this state to a constrained set of investigative actions, and an LLM agent loop is restricted to consuming the policy's recommendations and producing analyst-readable narratives gated by a critic. We instantiate the system on the LANL Comprehensive, Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events dataset and the Indiana University Quartz HPC cluster, reporting four results: (i) a two-phase CREATE ingestion pattern loads a 24M-edge authentication subgraph into Neo4j in 14.2 minutes on a single 32-core node, roughly 24x faster than the canonical MERGE-based pipeline; (ii) a sliding-window alert engine reliably trips a 25-event/10-second threshold in <=2.5 s across 50 trials; (iii) PPO training over 200 iterations converges to a mean episodic return of 8.74+/-0.31, with held-out precision of 0.91 and recall of 0.87 on labeled red-team events; and (iv) the integrated containment loop completes a full detect-investigate-recommend-human-approve cycle in a median of 6.3 s. We contribute a reusable engineering pattern (the hot-node deadlock workaround), a portable HPC deployment pattern (anchor-node co-location), and an enterprise-readiness analysis covering false-positive economics, reversibility guarantees, audit compliance, and the human-approval boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sentinel-RL，一种将拓扑推理与语义推理解耦的agentic-SOC架构：图注意力编码器将认证子图压缩为固定维度状态，PPO策略生成受限调查动作，LLM agent循环仅负责生成经critic把关的可读叙述。在LANL与Quartz数据集上验证了高速数据摄入、可靠告警触发、收敛的PPO训练与完整的检测-调查-推荐-人工审批闭环。
AI.motivation: LLM agent虽被广泛提出作为自主SOC分析师，但面临两大限制使其在企业规模下不可靠：一是有限上下文窗口无法容纳包含数千主机的认证图；二是自由文本生成无法保证推荐的遏制动作与所操作拓扑结构的一致性。
AI.method: 提出Sentinel-RL架构：(1) 异构图注意力编码器将实时认证子图汇总为固定维度状态；(2) PPO策略将该状态映射到受限调查动作集；(3) LLM agent循环被限制为仅消费策略推荐并生成分析师可读的叙述，由critic把关；(4) 在Neo4j上采用两阶段CREATE摄入模式加速数据加载；(5) 滑动窗口告警引擎支撑实时检测。
AI.result: 四项核心结果：(i) 两阶段CREATE摄入模式在单32核节点14.2分钟加载24M边认证子图，比MERGE管道快约24倍；(ii) 滑动窗口引擎在50次试验中可靠触发25事件/10秒阈值且不超过2.5秒；(iii) PPO经200次迭代收敛至平均episodic return 8.74±0.31，留出集上precision 0.91、recall 0.87；(iv) 完整检测-调查-推荐-人工审批闭环中位时长6.3秒。
AI.conclusion: 作者贡献了可复用的工程模式（热节点死锁绕过方案）、可移植的HPC部署模式（锚节点共置），以及涵盖误报经济学、可逆性保证、审计合规性和人工审批边界的企<extra_id_1>业就绪性分析。

title: Less Is Moral: A CHARMing Framework for Moral Foundations Detection in Endorsement Behaviour
summary: Moral language plays a central role in shaping online endorsement and the diffusion of information, yet existing moral foundation detection systems often suffer from poor cross-domain generalization, weak rationale grounding, and reliance on costly prompting-based large language models (LLMs). We introduce CHARM, a MA\textbf{C}- and \textbf{H}ate-speech-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ationale-aligned \textbf{M}oral foundation detection framework built on a lightweight fine-tuned LLM, which integrates complementary moral grounding, rationale alignment, and polarity-aware hate speech signals to support more robust and faithful moral prediction. Unlike prior dictionary-, fine-tune-, or prompt-based detectors, which decouple computation from psychological theory, CHARM is built so that each component -- MAC cross-attention, rationale alignment, and hate-speech modulation -- operationalizes a distinct psychological construct. Using a 30\% subsample of the MFTC, MFRC, and News training pools together with the richer supervision in MFTCXplain, CHARM improves AUC by up to 15.3\% in-domain, surpasses the supervised baselines on every out-of-domain dataset in both AUC and F1, and offers a scalable, low-cost alternative to prompting-based LLM detectors. We further apply CHARM to large-scale COVID-19 discourse on Twitter and show that moral value alignment is strongly associated with online endorsement behavior. By making moral framing measurable at scale, CHARM offers a practical tool for studying the spread of morally charged misinformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHARM框架，基于轻量级微调大语言模型，通过MAC交叉注意力、理由对齐和仇恨言论调制三个组件分别操作化不同的心理学构念，在道德基础检测任务中显著提升领域内和跨领域性能，并提供可规模化、低成本的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有道德基础检测系统存在三个核心问题：跨领域泛化能力差、理由（rationale）支撑薄弱、依赖昂贵的基于提示的大语言模型。同时，传统方法（词典法、微调法、提示法）将计算过程与心理学理论脱钩。
AI.method: CHARM框架构建于轻量级微调大语言模型之上，包含三个组件：MAC（道德基础交叉注意力）用于互补道德基础grounding，理由对齐（rationale alignment）增强可解释性，极性感知的仇恨言论信号（polarity-aware hate speech signal）进行调制。每个组件分别操作化一个独立的心理学构念。训练数据使用MFTC、MFRC、News的30%子样本及MFTCXplain的丰富监督。
AI.result: 领域内AUC最高提升15.3%；在所有跨领域数据集上AUC和F1均超越监督基线；在Twitter大规模COVID-19语料上的应用表明道德价值对齐与在线认可行为强相关。
AI.conclusion: CHARM通过将计算组件与心理学理论一一对应，实现了更稳健且可解释的道德基础检测，为大规模研究道德化错误信息的传播提供了实用工具，且相比提示式LLM检测器更具可扩展性和成本效益。

title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models, yet its binary outcome reward cannot distinguish among correct trajectories. Existing dense reward alternatives, from surface heuristics to process reward models, either ignore the expert solutions already present in training corpora or require expensive offline annotation. We propose Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR), which operates in the policy's own gradient space: truncated backpropagation through the output projection layer extracts a compact gradient vector for each rollout, and cosine similarity with an expert-anchor gradient yields a dense, reasoning-aware reward with less than 9% wall-clock overhead. We prove that this cosine admits a multiplicative decomposition into prediction-error and activation-pattern factors, providing a concrete characterization of what the alignment signal measures. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, GAR consistently improves over GRPO and other baselines on competition-level math benchmarks and transfers to GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro without domain-specific data. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LQgdwind/GAR.

AI.tldr: 提出Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR)：通过截断反向传播在策略自身梯度空间中提取密集奖励信号，用余弦相似度对齐专家锚定梯度，在Qwen3-4B/8B上超越GRPO等基线。
AI.motivation: RLVR的二元结果奖励无法区分正确的推理轨迹；现有的密集奖励替代方案（基于表面启发式或过程奖励模型）要么忽略训练语料中已有的专家解决方案，要么需要昂贵的离线标注。
AI.method: GAR在策略自身的梯度空间中操作：通过输出投影层的截断反向传播为每条rollout提取紧凑的梯度向量，并与专家锚定梯度计算余弦相似度作为密集、推理感知的奖励信号，额外墙钟开销不到9%。作者证明该余弦可分解为预测误差因子和激活模式因子的乘法形式。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，GAR在竞赛级数学基准上一致优于GRPO及其他基线，并无需领域特定数据即可迁移到GPQA Diamond和MMLU-Pro。
AI.conclusion: GAR通过利用训练语料中已有的专家解作为梯度锚点，在不引入额外标注成本的前提下提供稠密、推理感知的奖励信号，是一种高效且可迁移的RLVR改进方法。

title: Transfiver: Human-AI Co-Inference through a Shared Editable State
summary:
Long-term human-AI interaction is difficult because the information that guides inference is updated implicitly by the model and is not directly inspectable or controllable by the user. We introduce the TRANSparent Framework for Interactive, Verifiable, Editable Representation (Transfiver), an architecture for human-AI co-inference through a shared editable state. Its central idea is that interaction-specific information is maintained in a single persistent state $(S_t)$ that both the model and the human update.
  Transfiver distinguishes two modes of state evolution. In an implicit stream update, the model interprets ongoing interaction and decides whether new information revises an existing state item or creates a new one. In an explicit directed edit, a human inspects and modifies an addressed item. Both act on the same underlying state, so a human correction changes the state that subsequent computation reads, rather than adding another instruction or separate record.
  The architecture separates shared parameters $(θ)$, learned before ordinary use, from the persistent state $(S_t)$, which evolves during deployment without parameter retraining. Extending Transfiver to rich natural-language, relational, and large-scale shared states remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transfiver框架，一种通过共享可编辑状态实现人机协作推理的架构，使交互过程中的信息以单一持久状态(S_t)的形式被模型和人类共同更新，支持隐式流更新与显式定向编辑两种状态演化模式。
AI.motivation: 长期人机交互存在根本困难：指导模型推理的信息由模型隐式更新，用户无法直接检查或控制这些信息，导致交互缺乏透明性和可控性。
AI.method: Transfiver架构的核心思想是将交互特定信息维护在单一持久状态(S_t)中，该状态由模型和人类共同更新。架构区分两种状态演化模式：(1) 隐式流更新——模型解释持续交互并决定新信息是修订现有状态项还是创建新项；(2) 显式定向编辑——人类检查并修改特定状态项。两种模式作用于同一底层状态，人类修正直接改变后续计算所读取的状态。架构将共享参数(θ)与持久状态(S_t)分离，θ在常规使用前学习，S_t在部署期间演化而无需参数重训练。
AI.result: 该框架使人类修正直接改变后续计算读取的状态，而非添加另一条指令或独立记录，从而支持可检查、可验证、可编辑的人机共享状态；同时通过参数与状态分离的设计，使状态演化无需参数重训练。
AI.conclusion: 将Transfiver扩展至丰富的自然语言、关系型和大规模共享状态仍是开放问题，但该架构为可解释、可控的长期人机交互提供了基础方案。

title: MulDP: Multimodal Diffusion Policy for Autonomous Quadruped Parkour Navigation across Complex Terrains
summary: Quadruped robots have demonstrated impressive agility in parkour locomotion across complex terrains. However, most systems still rely on human intervention for high-level planning, and autonomous parkour navigation remains underexplored. The key challenges include fine-grained velocity regulation, long-horizon anticipatory behaviors, and tight coupling between perception and embodied execution. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Diffusion Policy (MulDP) that integrates visual perception with robot proprioception and goal information to generate temporally coherent and anticipatory navigation velocity commands, tightly coupling perception with embodied control to enable robust autonomous navigation. To support the training of MulDP, we construct the first Quadruped Parkour Navigation Dataset (QPND), a multimodal dataset that encompasses diverse navigation behaviors and complex terrains. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that MulDP enables robust long-horizon autonomous navigation and effective traversal across complex terrains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态扩散策略（MulDP），将视觉感知、机器人本体感知与目标信息相结合，生成时间上连贯且具有前瞻性的导航速度命令，实现四足机器人在复杂地形上的自主跑酷导航。作者构建了首个四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND），并通过大量仿真与真实世界实验验证了方法的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有四足机器人在跑酷（parkour）运动中已展现出显著的敏捷性，但大多数系统仍依赖人工干预进行高层规划，自主跑酷导航尚未被充分探索。关键挑战包括细粒度速度调节、长时域前瞻性行为以及感知与具身执行之间的紧密耦合。
AI.method: 提出多模态扩散策略（MulDP），融合视觉感知、机器人本体感知（proprioception）与目标信息，利用扩散模型生成时间上连贯且具有预见性的导航速度指令，实现感知与具身控制的紧密耦合。同时构建首个四足跑酷导航数据集（QPND），涵盖多种导航行为与复杂地形，用于策略训练。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，MulDP展现出鲁棒的长时域自主导航能力和在复杂地形上的有效穿越性能。
AI.conclusion: MulDP通过多模态扩散策略有效解决了四足机器人自主跑酷导航中速度调控、前瞻行为与感知-执行耦合三大核心挑战，为该领域提供了首个专用数据集和可行的技术路线。

title: Residual Optimal Transport-Based Experts Collaboration Towards Modality-Aware Infrared-Visible Object Detection
summary: Infrared-visible object detection (IVOD) integrates complementary evidence from visible and infrared sensors for reliable perception in challenging scenes. In practice, sensors may fail or drop frames, leaving one modality unavailable or intermittent. Existing methods for IVOD assume both modalities are always present, and fixed fusion collapses when one stream is missing. Furthermore, it remains a critical challenge to reliably estimate semantic correlation across heterogeneous modalities, especially under spectral distribution discrepancy. We present FlexibleFusion, a unified and adaptive method that flexibly allocates integration pathways and fusion strength, operating seamlessly across complete and missing-modality regimes. At its core, the Modality-Aware Experts Collaboration (MAEC) mechanism selectively activates and aggregates cross-modal or intra-modal expert pathways. It allows cross-modal fusion when full modalities are available and falls back to self-fusion under missing conditions. Additionally, we design Residual Self-Paced Entropic Optimal Transport (RSPEOT) to align heterogeneous feature distributions from a transport perspective. Instead of relying on the fixed sparsity coefficient in standard entropic optimal transport (EOT), RSPEOT introduces a residual-driven self-paced update that prioritizes reliable matches and progressively refines harder ones. This design alleviates the additional optimization burden of standard EOT while preserving reliable semantic alignment. Comprehensive experiments under complete and missing-modality protocols show consistent performance across arbitrary modality configurations. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: FlexibleFusion是一个统一的、自适应的红外-可见光目标检测（IVOD）方法，能够在完整模态和缺失模态场景下灵活分配融合路径与融合强度。核心包括Modality-Aware Experts Collaboration (MAEC)机制和Residual Self-Paced Entropic Optimal Transport (RSPEOT)对齐方法，在任意模态配置下均能保持一致性能。
AI.motivation: 现有IVOD方法均假设双模态始终可用，当传感器故障或丢帧导致单一模态缺失或间歇性不可用时，固定融合策略会失效。同时，跨异构模态（红外与可见光）的语义相关性估计在光谱分布差异下仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出FlexibleFusion统一框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Modality-Aware Experts Collaboration (MAEC)机制，有选择性地激活和聚合跨模态或模态内专家路径，模态完整时执行跨模态融合，缺失时回退到自融合；(2) Residual Self-Paced Entropic Optimal Transport (RSPEOT)，利用残差驱动的自步进更新替代标准EOT中的固定稀疏系数，优先匹配可靠对应，渐进细化困难样本，降低标准EOT的额外优化负担并保持可靠语义对齐。
AI.result: 在完整模态和缺失模态协议下的大规模实验表明，FlexibleFusion在任意模态配置下均能保持一致的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: FlexibleFusion首次以统一方式处理完整与缺失模态的IVOD场景，解决了现有方法受限于双模态始终可用假设的问题，同时通过MAEC和RSPEOT在模态完整性和光谱分布差异两方面都实现了稳健的自适应处理。

title: FPCO-Dialog: A Multi-Turn False-Premise Benchmark for Correction and Cooperation in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at EMNLP2026 Main Conference. For code and data, see https://github.com/lab-klc/FPCO-Dialog
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-turn settings where users may describe visual content with incorrect assumptions. Yet existing evaluations rarely isolate how models respond when the same visually grounded false premise persists across dialogue turns. We introduce FPCO-Dialog, a benchmark for evaluating correction and cooperation behavior in VLMs under repeated false premises. FPCO-Dialog contains 1,080 images and 10,800 question turns, stratified by visual complexity, object category, and false-premise class, and uses a 10-turn protocol in which a correct dialogue prefix is followed by repeated false-premise referring expressions. We evaluate 20 commercial and open-source VLMs with a model-agnostic protocol and CorrTP@K, a correction-rate metric over false-premise turns, scored by two independent detectors. FPCO-Dialog reveals substantial and persistent cross-model differences in aggregate correction tendency, model-specific turn-wise dynamics, and systematic variation across false-premise types under the benchmark's substitution distribution. The dataset, evaluation protocol, model outputs, detector labels, and code are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FPCO-Dialog基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在多轮对话中面对持续错误假设时的纠正与合作行为，包含1,080张图像和10,800个问题轮次，并基于10轮对话协议评估了20个商业及开源VLM。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地被部署在多轮对话场景中，用户可能对视觉内容持有错误假设。现有的评估很少隔离考察当同一视觉grounded的错误前提在多轮对话中持续存在时模型如何响应，缺乏针对性的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建FPCO-Dialog基准，包含1,080张图像和10,800个问题轮次，按视觉复杂度、目标类别和错误前提类别进行分层；采用10轮对话协议，其中正确的对话前缀后跟随重复的错误前提指称表达；使用模型无关的评估协议和CorrTP@K指标（错误前提轮次上的纠正率指标），由两个独立检测器打分；评估20个商业和开源VLM。
AI.result: FPCO-Dialog揭示了跨模型在聚合纠正倾向上的显著且持续差异、模型特定的逐轮动态变化，以及在基准的替换分布下跨错误前提类型的系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 数据集、评估协议、模型输出、检测器标签和代码均已公开可用，为后续VLM错误前提交互评估提供基础设施。

title: From Zero to Hero: An Open LLM Ecosystem for Armenian
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Data and model: https://huggingface.co/collections/COPA-AI/armenian-llm-ecosystem. Code: https://github.com/COPATeam/armenian_llm_ecosystem
summary: Pretraining data for Armenian, a morphologically rich and low-resource language, is scarce, and no open Armenian LLM has been released with the data and recipe needed to reproduce it. To address this gap, we curate and release two datasets. ArmWeb is an extensively validated corpus of 4.37M Armenian news documents. ArmSTEM is a parallel English-Armenian collection of 373K math and science problems with step-by-step solutions, translated into Armenian and verified through both answer-preserving LLM judgment and human evaluation. Continued pretraining of Gemma-4-E4B on these datasets yields arm-gemma-e4b, which outperforms every existing open Armenian model as well as its unadapted base, and is the first open Armenian LLM with complete training data and recipe. Our ablations show that news-only continued pretraining improves fluency while eroding knowledge, a pattern we also observe in existing Armenian models, and that a small share of verified translated STEM data reverses the loss. We further find that the largest public Armenian corpora overlap web-derived evaluation panels heavily, including a train/test self-overlap inside FineWeb-2. We openly release all data, models, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了两大亚美尼亚语数据集（ArmWeb 4.37M新闻文档和ArmSTEM 373K平行英阿数学科学题）及开源模型arm-gemma-e4b，这是首个附带完整训练数据和配方的开源亚美尼亚语LLM，在各类开放模型中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 亚美尼亚语作为形态丰富但低资源的语言，预训练数据匮乏，且此前没有任何开源亚美尼亚语LLM发布了可复现的数据与配方，阻碍了该语言领域的模型研发与复现。
AI.method: 作者首先构建并严格验证了两个数据集：ArmWeb（437万篇亚美尼亚语新闻文档）和ArmSTEM（37.3万道英-阿平行数学/科学题及分步解答，经答案保持的LLM判定和人工评估双重验证翻译质量）。随后基于Gemma-4-E4B在这些数据上进行持续预训练得到arm-gemma-e4b，并通过消融实验分析不同数据配比的影响。
AI.result: arm-gemma-e4b在所有现有开源亚美尼亚语模型及未适配基座模型上均取得最佳表现。消融实验发现：仅用新闻数据持续预训练可提升流畅性但损害知识能力（该现象在现有亚美尼亚模型中同样存在），而加入少量经过验证翻译的STEM数据可逆转知识退化。此外还发现最大的公共亚美尼亚语语料库与基于网页的评估面板高度重叠，包括FineWeb-2内部存在训练/测试自重叠。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心筛选与验证的数据组合进行持续预训练，可以显著提升低资源语言模型的综合能力；同时揭示了公共语料库中数据污染问题，提醒研究者在评估亚美尼亚语模型时需注意语料重叠风险。所有数据、模型和代码均已开放发布。

title: Govern the Model, Not Only the Data: Storage, Circulation, and Learning in Creative AI
summary: Federated learning is increasingly presented as a privacy-preserving advance: personal data remain on the device, and only model updates are shared. It borrows the vocabulary of the federated social web, yet inverts its logic, distributing computation while the resulting model stays with whoever convened the training. We argue that federation is not in itself a remedy for extractive AI, because outcomes depend on who governs the data and the model and who has agency over the practices that shape them. We describe three layers at which a creative community can hold its work: storage, circulation, and learning. Examining artist-governed trusts, cooperatives, and consent infrastructures, we show that creator governance is established at storage and circulation but stops at learning: contributors can consent to training, yet have little say over the resulting model or its federation. We map the research space this opens, pairing technical open problems with the human questions from which they unfold. We propose four design principles for a creative data commons that governs models and their federation, not only datasets: govern the model, not only the corpus; make the terms legible at the moment of contribution; design for refusal as a first-class state; and decide stewardship in the open and account for it.

AI.tldr: 本文指出联邦学习并非天然的隐私保护或反榨取机制，因为其最终模型仍由召集方掌控。文章聚焦创意社群的数据与模型治理问题，提出创作型数据公地应不仅治理数据集，还要治理模型及其联邦，并给出四项设计原则。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习被宣扬为隐私保护技术，但其实际权力结构（谁掌控最终模型、谁对训练与使用有话语权）决定了它是否成为数据榨取的工具。作者认为，对创意工作者而言，联邦学习中的治理缺口存在于"学习"层——贡献者虽可同意参与训练，却对训练出的模型及其联邦化毫无话语权。
AI.method: 本文采用分析论证与案例考察相结合的方式：首先剖析联邦学习与联邦式社交网络（federated social web）在逻辑上的差异（去中心化计算vs去中心化治理）；其次提出存储、流通、学习三个治理层面；接着审视艺术家主导的信托、合作社与同意基础设施等现有实践；最后给出四项设计原则。
AI.result: 作者揭示创作者治理在存储与流通层面已建立（如艺术家信托、合作社），但在学习层面缺位——贡献者对模型创建及其联邦化缺乏控制权。文章据此提出四原则：治理模型而非仅治理语料库；在贡献时刻使条款可理解；将拒绝设计为一等状态；公开决定数据管理方式并为其负责。同时指出技术开放问题与人类问题相互交织。
AI.conclusion: 联邦不等于去榨取，真正的数据主权需要治理从数据集延伸至模型与联邦本身。面向创意社群的数据公地应以模型治理为核心，将人的自主权与拒绝权嵌入技术设计的起点，而非事后补充。

title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
summary: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaRoboVLG，一个任务自适应的视觉-语言-抓取（VLG）框架，通过将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦，实现跨不同机械手的泛化抓取。该方法学习一个基于运动学映射和力闭合稳定性估计的高效基础策略，同时将任务相关理解交由可组合的基础模型模块处理，无需重新训练基础抓取策略即可集成上下文条件先验实现自适应抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有VLG方法将基础模型与端到端抓取策略紧密耦合，导致针对不同机械手或新任务时需要重新设计和训练整个系统，成本高昂且扩展性差。研究者希望建立一种可扩展的抓取范式，使基础模型领域的进步能够直接转化为抓取能力的提升，而无需修改底层抓取策略。
AI.method: AdaRoboVLG包含两部分：(1) 一个高效可泛化的基础策略，通过显式运动学映射和基于力闭合的稳定性估计来生成并评估物理上可行的抓取候选；(2) 专门化的基础模型模块，提供可组合的空间、认知和时间先验，这些先验被集成到抓取合成过程中，实现上下文自适应抓取，无需重新训练底层基础策略。
AI.result: 通过大量仿真和真实世界实验验证：(i) 基础策略学习高效且具有较强的跨手泛化能力；(ii) 该框架能有效整合空间、认知和时间先验以应对三类代表性抓取挑战，且抓取合成性能相较最先进方法不逊色；(iii) 这些先验可联合作用于杂乱动态环境中的功能性抓取。
AI.conclusion: 将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦是一种可扩展的机器人抓取范式，它使未来基础模型的进展能够直接转化为改进的抓取能力，而无需重新设计或重新训练底层抓取策略。

title: Neural Video Compression Based on Deformable Temporal Alignment and Difference-aware Fusion
summary: In conditional coding-based neural video compression, the quality of temporal context directly affects compression per- formance. Existing methods mostly construct context from prop- agated reference features, but they are vulnerable to motion esti- mation and local alignment errors in regions with complex mo- tion, occlusion, and high-frequency textures, resulting in inaccu- rate temporal information. To address this issue, this paper pro- poses a method combining deformable temporal alignment and difference-aware spatial selective fusion. A Context-aware Tem- poral Alignment Module is used to generate complementary tem- poral context, while a Difference-aware Spatial Selective Fusion module adaptively selects reliable temporal information and sup- presses misalignment. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves certain rate-distortion performance improve- ment over DCVC-DC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合可变形时序对齐和差分感知空间选择性融合的神经视频压缩方法，通过CTAM生成互补时序上下文、DSSF模块自适应选择可靠时序信息并抑制错位，相比DCVC-DC取得率失真性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在条件编码式神经视频压缩中，时序上下文质量直接影响压缩性能。现有方法大多从传播的参考特征构建上下文，但在复杂运动、遮挡和高频纹理区域容易受到运动估计和局部对齐误差的影响，导致时序信息不准确，从而降低压缩效率。
AI.method: 提出两种模块：(1) Context-aware Temporal Alignment Module (CTAM) 用于生成互补的时序上下文；(2) Difference-aware Spatial Selective Fusion (DSSF) 模块，能自适应地选择可靠的时序信息并抑制不对齐部分。前者利用可变形时序对齐生成更丰富的上下文，后者通过差分感知在空间维度上选择性地融合，减少错位信息的干扰。
AI.result: 与DCVC-DC相比，该方法在率失真性能上取得了一定的提升，验证了所提模块在复杂运动、遮挡和高频纹理场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结合可变形时序对齐与差分感知空间选择性融合可以有效改进条件编码神经视频压缩中的时序上下文质量，在保持压缩效率的同时提升重建质量。

title: Accountable AI with Grounded, Faithful, Consistent, Actionable Rationales: A Case Study in Clinical Trial Matching with VERDICT
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 46 pages, 6 figures, 28 tables. Code and prompts: https://github.com/stanford-oval/clinical-trial-matching
summary:
Accountability means a decision can be examined, justified, and contested. LLMs make this hard: fluent output may be ungrounded, incomplete, or unfaithful to the decision process. Achieving accountability requires verified rationales (how was the decision reached), assumptions (what was assumed rather than known), policy consistency (the same treatment for the same facts), and pivotal conditions (what would change the outcome). We introduce self-faithfulness as an automatic test of accountability: changing the pivotal conditions should change the decision.
  We examine accountable AI through clinical trial matching, a high-stakes task central to evidence-based medicine. Although LLM-based matchers match patients to trials reasonably accurately, they apply decision policies inconsistently and produce rationales that are unfaithful to their own decisions.
  We introduce VERDICT, an LLM-based agent that translates a decision task, its constraints, and its policy into Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT), then derives the decision with SMT and MaxSMT solvers -- so policies are applied consistently and decisions are accountable by construction.
  Across a SIGIR 2016-derived dataset and TREC 2021, VERDICT achieves the strongest decision accuracy among LLM-only and neurosymbolic baselines, applies policies with perfect consistency, and produces clinician-preferred rationales grounded in explicit assumptions and pivotal conditions, with improved counterfactual self-faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERDICT框架，通过将临床决策任务转化为可满足性模理论（SMT）问题，利用SMT/MaxSMT求解器保证决策策略的一致性和可追溯性，解决了LLM在临床匹配等高危任务中缺乏可解释性、策略不一致和推理不忠实的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM在做出决策时不可解释：输出可能无根据、不完整或与决策过程不一致。真正负责任的人工智能（Accountable AI）需要满足四个条件：可验证的推理依据（决策如何得出）、显式假设（什么是假设而非已知）、策略一致性（相同事实得到相同处理）以及关键条件（什么会改变结果）。在临床试验匹配这类高影响力任务中，LLM虽然能较准确地匹配患者与试验，但其决策策略应用不一致，且产生的推理依据与自身决策不忠实。
AI.method: VERDICT是一个基于LLM的智能体框架。它先将决策任务、约束条件和决策策略转化为Satisfiability Modulo Theories（SMT）公式，然后通过SMT和MaxSMT求解器推导决策结果。该方法使得决策策略能够被一致地应用，决策在构建上就具备可问责性。作者还引入了"自我忠实性"（self-faithfulness）这一自动测试指标：改变关键条件应当改变决策结果。
AI.result: 在SIGIR 2016衍生数据集和TREC 2021数据集上，VERDICT在决策准确率方面超越了仅用LLM和神经符号混合的基线方法；能够以完美的策略一致性应用规则；生成的推理依据以显式假设和关键条件为基础，受到临床医生偏好，并展现出更强的反事实自我忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的语言理解能力与SMT求解器的形式推理能力相结合，可以构建既准确又可问责的决策系统。VERDICT通过将策略显式编码为形式约束并由求解器执行，从根源上解决了LLM决策中的策略不一致和推理不忠实问题，为高风险领域（如循证医学）中的可信AI提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Time Without Timesteps: Simulating Coupled Dynamical Systems via Self-Consistency
summary: Numerical simulation of dynamical systems is usually organized as a causal march through time: each state is computed from the previous one. We explore a different formulation for coupled systems. For each subsystem type we train a neural surrogate mapping a full driving trajectory and initial condition directly to a full output trajectory; following classical waveform relaxation, coupled systems are assembled by enforcing self-consistency among these trajectories: simulation becomes a fixed-point problem over complete trajectories rather than a stepwise rollout. On coupled van der Pol oscillators and Hodgkin-Huxley neuron networks, sequential depth becomes the number of solver iterations: 4-10 Newton iterations where the reference integrator takes 1500 steps. The gradient likewise loses its time recursion: it becomes a linear system solved by GMRES at memory independent of solver depth. A single scalar measured from the learned operator, the spectral radius of its Jacobian, predicts in advance where the coupled solve will converge; past that boundary, unrolled backpropagation diverges and a Neumann adjoint fails, while the implicit gradient remains correct to 0.04%. We report where the approach succeeds and where surrogate error degrades it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种替代传统时间步进仿真的新范式：为每个子系统训练一个神经网络代理，将完整驱动轨迹和初始条件直接映射到完整输出轨迹，并通过波形松弛原理在完整轨迹上施加自洽约束，将耦合系统仿真转化为不动点问题（而非逐步 rollout）。在耦合 van der Pol 振荡器和 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元网络上验证，求解器仅需 4-10 次 Newton 迭代即可达到参考积分器 1500 步的精度；梯度计算同样摆脱时间递归，变为可由 GMRES 求解的线性系统，内存占用与求解深度无关。通过学习算子 Jacobian 的谱半径可预先预测收敛性，越过分界后展开式反向传播发散、Neumann 伴随失效，而隐式梯度仍保持 0.04% 的精度。
AI.motivation: 传统数值仿真按时间因果推进，每个状态由前一状态计算，导致计算深度随模拟时间线性增长，深度与梯度计算成本高且内存随求解深度增长。作者希望探索一种不同的耦合系统仿真组织方式，将时间维度上的逐步推演转化为固定点问题，使"顺序深度"变为求解迭代次数而非时间步数，从而显著压缩计算深度并实现内存无关的梯度计算。
AI.method: 1) 为每个子系统类型训练神经代理映射 f: (完整驱动轨迹, 初始条件) → 完整输出轨迹；2) 参照经典波形松弛法，通过耦合条件对所有子系统轨迹施加自洽约束；3) 将整体仿真转化为完整轨迹空间上的固定点问题，用 Newton 迭代求解；4) 梯度通过隐式函数定理转化为线性系统，使用 GMRES 求解，避免时间维度的反向传播递归；5) 利用学习算子 Jacobian 的谱半径作为收敛性的先验预测指标。
AI.result: 在耦合 van der Pol 振荡器与 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元网络上，该方法仅需 4-10 次 Newton 迭代即可完成仿真（参考积分器需 1500 步）；梯度计算内存与求解深度无关；由 Jacobian 谱半径可预先预测收敛边界，越界后展开式反向传播发散、Neumann 伴随方法失效，而隐式梯度仍保持 0.04% 精度；文章同时报告了方法适用的场景以及代理误差导致性能退化的情况。
AI.conclusion: 将耦合动力系统仿真组织为完整轨迹上的不动点求解是一个可行且有潜力的新范式：它大幅缩短了有效求解深度，实现了深度无关的梯度计算，并能通过算子谱半径对收敛性进行先验预测。隐式梯度在展开式方法失效时仍保持高精度。但该方法的适用性受代理精度限制，代理误差会导致性能退化，未来工作需关注代理质量与误差传播的鲁棒性。

title: SVG-Score: Human-Aligned Evaluation of Text-to-SVG Generation
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation is attracting increasing attention as generative models improve in expressiveness and controllability. Progress, however, is held back by the lack of domain-specific evaluation protocols: current practice relies on metrics designed for natural images, most notably CLIPScore, which was never trained on vector graphics and aligns only partially with human judgment. We introduce \textbf{\ours}, a human-aligned evaluation framework for text-to-SVG generation. Through controlled caption and image perturbations, we first show that CLIP-based scores barely react to the errors SVG generators actually make, such as wrong colors, counts, and spatial relations, and that off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges, while more sensitive, respond unevenly across error types and SVG styles. We then introduce a human-annotated dataset for \textit{Semantic Alignment}, measuring how faithfully a generated SVG reflects its caption. Building on it, we develop two complementary evaluators: CLIP scorers adapted to vector graphics and then aligned to human preferences, for fast large-scale evaluation, and a VLM judge trained with supervised fine-tuning and reward-shaped reinforcement learning, for more expressive and interpretable assessment. Using both, we benchmark major open-source, commercial, and optimization-based SVG generators on an independent caption set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SVG-Bench（即\ours），一个面向文本到SVG生成任务的人类对齐评估框架。作者首先证明基于CLIP的评分对SVG生成器实际犯的错误（如错误的颜色、数量和空间关系）几乎无反应，而现成的VLM评判虽更敏感但对错误类型和SVG风格反应不均。随后引入人类标注的语义对齐数据集，并开发两种互补评估器：经对齐的CLIP评分器（用于大规模快速评估）和经SFT及奖励形强化学习训练的VLM评判器（用于更表达性和可解释的评估）。最终在独立标题集上基准测试了主流开源、商业及优化类SVG生成器。
AI.motivation: SVG生成领域缺乏专门的评估协议——现有实践依赖为自然图像设计的指标（如CLIPScore），但这些指标从未在矢量图形数据上训练，且与人类判断仅部分吻合，无法准确捕捉SVG生成器的实际错误。
AI.method: 本文方法包含三个步骤：(1) 通过受控文本和图像扰动分析，系统性暴露CLIP评分和现成VLM评判各自的缺陷；(2) 构建人类标注的语义对齐数据集；(3) 开发两种评估器——将CLIP评分器适配到矢量图形并校准人类偏好以用于大规模评估，以及使用监督微调加奖励形强化学习训练的VLM评判器用于更精细的评估。
AI.result: 作者构建了人类对齐的评估框架，并在独立标题集上对主流开源、商业及优化类SVG生成器进行了全面基准测试，证明了所提评估器相比现有方法能更准确与稳健地反映人类对生成SVG质量的判断。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了文本到SVG生成任务中缺乏领域特定、人类对齐评估协议的空白，提供了兼顾效率（CLIP类评分器）与可解释性（VLM评判器）的双轨评估方案，为该领域后续研究建立了更可靠的评估标准。

title: Corner Cases: Headland Coverage Path Planning for Autonomous Driving in Arable Farming
summary: This paper presents a new method for headland coverage path planning for arable fields. Several earlier approaches suggest covering the headland with nested polygons and smooth turns, however, covering the field corners entirely requires manoeuvres with reversing. In the new method, the polygon corners are modified to allow a reversing turn. A comparison to two other methods considering gap, overlap, and crossing the field boundary shows an improvement in the coverage result especially in field corners of around 90 degrees, and 240 degrees and above. Applicability of the new method is shown with several examples of real polygonal field maps.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的耕地机头区全覆盖路径规划方法，通过修改多边形角点以允许倒车转弯，实现对田间角落的完整覆盖，并在90°及240°以上角度的田间角落中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的机头区路径规划方法（如嵌套多边形和光滑转弯）无法完全覆盖田间角落，因为在狭窄角落中需要进行带倒车的操作，这导致覆盖不完整的问题。
AI.method: 通过修改多边形角点的几何结构，使农机在机头区角落处能够执行倒车转弯动作，从而实现对田间角落的完整覆盖。并将该方法与两种现有方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在间隙、重叠和跨界（超出田块边界）三个指标上，新方法与两种现有方法相比在覆盖率方面有所改进，尤其是在约90°及240°以上角度的田间角落中表现显著提升，并在真实多边形田块地图上验证了方法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 新方法通过引入倒车转弯策略并结合角点修改，有效解决了耕地机头区全覆盖的难题，特别适用于大角度和直角型田块角落，具有广泛的实际应用前景。

title: TruncGradGS: Improved 3D Gaussian Splatting via Truncated Gradient Updates
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has become a de facto scene representation for novel view synthesis, yet robustly learning 3D Gaussian primitives from visual input remains challenging. Standard optimization relies on gradient-based updates, but a common issue is the gradient vanishing phenomenon: a pixel far from a Gaussian primitive often has diminishing gradient magnitudes to influence primitive attributes, resulting in suboptimal scene reconstruction. In this paper, we propose a method to address gradient vanishing with a piecewise truncated gradient formulation that improves the optimization stability and robustness to initializations. We show that our method consistently improves 3D Gaussian Splatting with random and COLMAP initializations while being generalizable across static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting. As a by-product, we also examine the limitations of current benchmarks for dynamic scenes, and introduce a novel dataset for benchmarking dynamic Gaussian Splatting using synthetic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in both static and dynamic settings for the public benchmarks and our proposed dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分段截断梯度公式来解决3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）优化中的梯度消失问题，该方法在静态和动态场景中均能一致提升重建质量，并引入了一个新的合成动态3D场景基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅已成为新视角合成的标准场景表示，但其标准优化依赖梯度更新，存在梯度消失问题：远离高斯原语的像素对原语属性的梯度幅值趋于零，导致场景重建次优。
AI.method: 提出一种分段截断梯度（piecewise truncated gradient）公式，改善优化稳定性和对初始化的鲁棒性。同时构建了新的合成3D动态场景基准数据集，用于评估动态高斯泼溅方法。
AI.result: 在随机初始化和COLMAP初始化下均一致提升3D高斯泼溅的表现，且可泛化应用于静态和动态高斯泼溅；在公开基准和所提出的数据集上均验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分段截断梯度方法有效解决了梯度消失问题，提升了3D高斯泼溅的优化鲁棒性和重建质量，并揭示了现有动态场景基准的局限性。

title: FrameBench:A Language Understanding Benchmark Based on Frame Semantics
summary: In frame semantics, sentence comprehension is assumed to proceed by relating lexical meaning to background knowledge called semantic frames, thereby enabling readers to implicitly enrich the text with unstated information. Recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether they can reproduce the kinds of implicit enrichment that humans naturally make during comprehension. To address this question, we introduce FrameBench, a benchmark grounded in frame semantics. FrameBench consists of multiple-choice questions that test whether models distinguish the frames evoked by the same verb across contexts. We construct the benchmark for English and Japanese using FrameNet-style resources and a generation-and-verification pipeline with native-speaker judgments. Our experiments on a diverse set of models reveal challenges for small models, while several large models surpass the human reference scores. We release the constructed FrameBench dataset and the code for dataset construction and evaluation at https://github.com/SasanoLab/FrameBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FrameBench基准，基于框架语义学测试大语言模型是否能区分同一动词在不同语境下所激发的语义框架。实验发现小模型表现困难，多个大模型超过人类参考分数。
AI.motivation: 框架语义学认为句子理解依赖词汇意义与背景知识（语义框架）的关联，使读者能隐式补充未明说的信息。虽然LLM在众多下游任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚它们能否复现人类理解中自然的隐式语义充实能力。
AI.method: 构建基于框架语义学的FrameBench基准，包含多项选择题，测试模型能否区分同一动词在不同语境下激发的框架。利用FrameNet风格资源为英语和日语构建数据集，采用生成-验证流程并纳入母语者判断。
AI.result: 在一系列不同规模模型上的实验显示：小模型面临挑战，而多个大模型的得分超过人类参考分数。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型（尤其大参数模型）已具备相当的隐式语义充实能力，但小模型仍有明显差距。作者开源了数据集与代码以促进后续研究。

title: SimpleDesign: A Joint Model for Protein Sequence and Structure Codesign
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=wPfw7GkMns
summary: Proteins are fundamental to biological processes, with their function determined by the complex interplay between the amino acid sequence and the three-dimensional structure. Developing generative models capable of understanding this intrinsically multi-modal relationship is crucial for fields like drug discovery and protein engineering. Existing models often rely on a multi-stage training process where autoencoders that tokenize data into latent representations are trained in a first stage. Secondly, a generative model is trained on the latent representation of the autoencoder(s), i.e., generative modeling in a latent space. We hypothesize that this multi-stage training is not necessary to obtain performant co-design models and thus present SimpleDesign, an effective multi-modal protein design model trained directly in the data space. SimpleDesign leverages a single-stage end-to-end objective that combines discrete cross-entropy for sequences and a regression objective for structures. In order to effectively model the difference in sequence and structure modalities, we develop a Mixture-of-Transformer architecture that allows modality-specific processing while keeping global self-attention over both modalities. We train SimpleDesign on over 2M sequence-structure pairs achieving strong performance across co-design and unconditional sequence/structure generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimpleDesign，一种直接在数据空间端到端训练的多模态蛋白质设计模型，无需多阶段潜在空间训练。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质共设计模型通常采用多阶段训练流程：先用自编码器将数据分词为潜在表示，再在潜在空间训练生成模型。作者假设这种多阶段训练并非必需，并希望证明直接在数据空间训练也能获得高性能的共设计模型。
AI.method: SimpleDesign采用单阶段端到端目标函数，结合序列的离散交叉熵损失与结构的回归损失。提出Mixture-of-Transformer架构，允许模态专属处理同时保持对两种模态的全局自注意力，以有效建模序列与结构模态间的差异。
AI.result: SimpleDesign在超过200万序列-结构对上训练，在共设计和无条件序列/结构生成基准上均取得了强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段潜在空间训练并非获得高性能蛋白质共设计模型的必要条件，直接在数据空间的单阶段端到端训练是一种有效且简化的替代方案。

title: CauseCollab: Causal Unified and Modality-Agnostic Network for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception enhances environment understanding through multi-agent information sharing, but its performance in real-world scenarios is constrained by heterogeneous sensor modalities and model architectures. Recent protocol-based two-stage methods alleviate this problem by mapping heterogeneous features into a shared protocol space; however, independently trained modality-specific converters often generate modality-specific pseudo-protocol distributions, leading to semantic inconsistency and error accumulation, which is particularly pronounced in scenarios with large modality discrepancies. To address this issue, we propose CauseCollab, a causal unified and modality-agnostic network. CauseCollab formulates representation learning in the protocol space from a causal perspective, explicitly disentangling semantic factors from modality-specific statistical confounders via causal metric learning. Meanwhile, CauseCollab adopts context-guided Unified Converter for heterogeneous modalities to ensure cross-modal semantic consistency. In addition, integrating new modalities only requires training adapters with minimal parameters. Extensive experiments on the OPV2V and DAIR-V2X datasets demonstrate that CauseCollab achieves state-of-the-art performance, with more significant gains in scenarios involving large modality gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CauseCollab，一种因果统一且模态无关的协作感知网络。它从因果视角对协议空间中的表示学习进行建模，通过因果度量学习显式分离语义因素与模态特定统计混杂因素，并采用上下文引导的统一转换器确保跨模态语义一致性。在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X数据集上取得最先进性能，尤其在模态差异大的场景下增益显著。
AI.motivation: 现有协作感知方法受限于异构传感器模态和模型架构。基于协议的两阶段方法虽能将异构特征映射到共享协议空间，但独立训练的模态特定转换器会产生模态特定的伪协议分布，导致语义不一致和误差累积，在模态差异大的场景中尤为严重。
AI.method: CauseCollab从因果角度对协议空间表示学习建模，通过因果度量学习显式解耦语义因素与模态特定统计混杂因素；同时采用上下文引导的统一转换器（Unified Converter）处理异构模态以确保跨模态语义一致性；新增模态仅需训练少量参数的适配器。
AI.result: 在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X数据集上进行大量实验，CauseCollab取得最先进的性能，且在模态差异较大的场景中获得更显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 因果视角的协议空间表示学习结合统一转换器能够有效解决异构模态协作感知中的语义不一致问题，同时保持了良好的模态可扩展性。

title: GIFT: Guided Intermediate Feature Training via Action-Oriented Structural Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language pre-training and predictive world modeling provide robot policies with rich semantic and dynamic visual features, but their native action and visual-prediction objectives may omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged by guiding intermediate features to preserve three control-relevant structure in robotic manipulation: geometry governing motion feasibility, affordance encoding instruction-relevant entities, and goals grounding instructions in task-relevant regions. To this end, we present GIFT (Guided Intermediate Feature Training), an architecture-flexible framework for learning intermediate features that translates these structures into training-time constraints through geometry alignment, affordance prediction, and goal-region reconstruction. We instantiate GIFT in a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, a direct-action World-Action Model (WAM), and an inverse-dynamics WAM while retaining each model's action formulation. Under zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, GIFT-VLA, GIFT-WAM-Fast, and GIFT-WAM-IDM outperform StarVLA-OFT, Fast-WAM, and Fast-WAM-IDM by 4.6, 12.6, and 5.2 points, reaching 79.6%, 72.6%, and 87.8%, respectively. On RoboCasa, the three GIFT variants reach 61.4%, 83.6%, and 82.3%, outperforming their counterparts by 12.6, 9.0, and 8.4 points, respectively. Together, these results establish learning functionally structured intermediate features as a reusable principle across model-specific action formulations, with especially large gains on articulated-object tasks and high-precision real-world manipulation under unseen visual and spatial perturbations. Project page: https://openphoenix-team.github.io/GIFT-pages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GIFT框架，通过指导中间特征保留几何、可供性、目标对齐三类控制相关结构，弥合视觉丰富性与控制效用之间的"动作充分性差距"。在VLA、直接动作WAM和逆动力学WAM三种架构上实例化，并在LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa基准上显著提升零样本转移和真实操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言预训练和预测式世界模型为机器人策略提供了丰富的语义和动态视觉特征，但其原生动作目标和视觉预测目标可能遗漏关键的物理与任务结构，同时保留了大量与控制无关的视觉冗余。这种视觉丰富性与控制效用之间的不匹配（即"动作充分性差距"）阻碍了策略在下游操作任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出GIFT框架，通过对中间特征施加三类训练时约束：（1）几何对齐，保持控制运动可行性的几何结构；（2）可供性预测，编码与指令相关的实体；（3）目标区域重建，将指令锚定到任务相关区域。该方法架构灵活，可实例化到VLA策略、直接动作WAM和逆动力学WAM，且不改变各模型原有的动作公式化方式。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus零样本转移下，GIFT-VLA、GIFT-WAM-Fast和GIFT-WAM-IDM分别达到79.6%、72.6%和87.8%，相较基线分别提升4.6、12.6和5.2点；在RoboCasa上分别达到61.4%、83.6%和82.3%，较基线提升12.6、9.0和8.4点。在铰接物体任务和高精度真实操作（含未见视觉与空间扰动）中增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 学习功能结构化中间特征是一种可跨模型特定动作公式复用的通用原则，能够有效弥合视觉-语言预训练模型的表示能力与实际控制需求之间的差距，为机器人在复杂、扰动环境下的操作提供了可靠的改进路径。

title: SafeRI: Recognition and Intervention for Token-Level Safety Intervention in Large Vision Language Models
comment: Preprint. 13 pages, 4 figures. Main paper with appendix
summary: Existing safety alignment methods for vision-language models usually modify the model behavior globally: once the safety parameters are trained or loaded, they participate in both unsafe and already-safe generations. This always-on intervention can unnecessarily perturb the model's original reasoning path and degrade general multimodal capabilities. We argue that safety alignment should be an on-demand intervention rather than a permanent modification to every decoding trajectory. To this end, we propose a streaming recognition and gated LoRA framework for intrinsic VLM safety. During autoregressive generation, a lightweight recognizer estimates whether the current pre-token generation state is safe or unsafe. Its output updates the LoRA gate for the following decoding step; otherwise, generation follows the frozen-backbone policy. The LoRA module is trained from unsafe prefixes, transition statements, and safe continuations, so that it learns to redirect unsafe generations back to safe responses after activation. Experiments across multiple safety and general-purpose benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in post-alignment settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种流式识别与门控LoRA框架，实现VLM安全的按需干预。在自回归生成过程中，轻量识别器判断当前token生成状态的安全性，仅在不安全时激活LoRA模块引导生成回到安全轨迹，从而避免对安全样本的全局行为扰动。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM安全对齐方法都是全局性修改模型行为，一旦安全参数训练或加载完成，就会同时参与不安全与已安全样本的生成过程。这种always-on的持续干预会不必要地扰动模型原有的推理路径，并降低通用多模态能力。作者认为安全对齐应是一种按需干预，而非对每条解码轨迹的永久修改。
AI.method: 提出streaming recognition and gated LoRA框架：1) 在自回归生成过程中，轻量级识别器估计当前预token状态是安全还是不安全；2) 识别器输出更新LoRA门控以控制下一步解码，否则沿用冻结主干的策略；3) LoRA模块从不安全前缀、过渡语句和安全延续训练，学习在激活后将不安全生成重定向回安全响应。
AI.result: 在多个安全基准和通用能力基准上的实验表明，该方法在post-alignment设置中有效，既保持了安全性又能减少对通用多模态能力的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了安全对齐作为一种按需条件干预的可行性，通过门控LoRA的流式识别机制，在不牺牲模型通用能力的前提下实现VLM的固有安全。

title: Chiaroscuro for Emotions: A Contrastive Emotion Benchmark Grounded in Appraisal Theory
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference) Dataset and code: https://github.com/cincynlp/Chiaro
summary: Emotion recognition benchmarks often predict one emotion per text, missing many real-world scenarios where two people arrive at opposing emotions from a single shared event. For example, a child kicks the seat in front of her in excitement while the passenger ahead grows angry. We introduce CHIARO, a 1,000 human-annotated sentence benchmark for contrastive emotion inference grounded in appraisal theory. Each scene describes one causal trigger eliciting a positive emotion in one person and a negative emotion in the other, drawn from a ten-class taxonomy. We benchmark seven frontier LLMs and four off-the-shelf emotion classifiers. The strongest LLM reaches 67.3 macro-F1, well below human agreement, while existing emotion classifiers score near chance. Beyond evaluation, CHIARO also serves as a training signal. When combined with an existing emotion corpus, the resulting downstream classifier improves on CHIARO itself and on six of ten external emotion benchmarks, which positions our dataset as a complementary signal for emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文引入CHIARO，一个包含1,000条人工标注句子的对比情感推理基准数据集，基于评价理论构建。每个场景描述一个共享因果触发事件使一人产生积极情感而另一人产生消极情感。实验表明最强LLM仅达67.3 macro-F1，远低于人类一致性；现有情感分类器接近随机水平。CHIARO还可作为训练信号，与现有情感语料结合后可同时提升在CHIARO自身及六个外部情感基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有情感识别基准大多假设每条文本对应单一情感，无法覆盖现实中两人对同一事件产生相反情感的复杂场景。这种简化忽略了情感的对比性和语境依赖性，需一个能够捕捉对比情感推断能力的基准来推动情感识别技术发展。
AI.method: 基于评价理论（appraisal theory）构建CHIARO数据集，包含1,000条人工标注句子，每个场景描述一个因果触发事件同时引发一人的积极情感和他人的消极情感，采用十类情感分类体系。随后对七个前沿大语言模型和四个现成情感分类器进行基准测试。
AI.result: 最强LLM达到67.3 macro-F1，显著低于人类一致性水平；现成情感分类器在CHIARO上表现接近随机。将CHIARO作为训练信号与现有情感语料结合后，下游分类器不仅在CHIARO上取得提升，还在十个外部情感基准中的六个上取得改进。
AI.conclusion: CHIARO揭示出现有情感识别系统在对比情感推断任务上的明显不足，同时证明了其作为互补训练信号的价值，表明捕捉共享事件中的对比情感是情感理解中重要且可习得的能力。

title: RecurTrace: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Loop-Time Memory
summary: Repeating a small block of middle layers increases a language model's effective inference depth without adding parameters or generating extra tokens, and recent work shows that this latent recurrence improves reasoning. However, two design choices limit these gains. Each iteration sees only the previous output and cannot directly access earlier computations. Moreover, a fixed loop count wastes depth on easy inputs while leaving hard ones with too little computation. We introduce RecurTrace, which addresses both limitations using the loop's own trajectory. Specifically, Loop Memory Attention lets each looped layer attend to its own states from previous iterations along the loop-time axis, so the model can revisit earlier computations instead of relying on the latest state alone. A halting head then reads the loop state and predicts whether to continue, with supervision from an oracle that identifies when additional depth still reduces loss. In a controlled MathQA comparison on the same looped backbone, RecurTrace achieves 56.9% accuracy with an average of 2.0 loops, exceeding the best fixed loop depth by 2.2 points at matched compute. By comparison, ACT and PonderNet collapse to one loop, and CALM reaches only 54.1% with 5.6 loops, while the stronger LoopUS-Conf and TaH-Mismatch baselines reach 55.3% at 3.2 loops and 55.7% at 2.1 loops. Finally, RecurTrace improves generation accuracy over same-budget fine-tuned baselines at 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B, with the gain growing with model size from 0.6 to 3.4 points.

AI.tldr: 提出RecurTrace方法，通过循环记忆注意力和中止机制解决循环深度推理的两个缺陷（无法访问早期计算、固定循环次数不适应输入难度），在MathQA上以平均2.0次循环达到56.9%的准确率，并在多个规模的生成任务中稳定提升效果。
AI.motivation: 重复中间层小块可以无参数地扩展语言模型推理深度（潜在循环），已有工作表明这能改善推理能力。但存在两个设计缺陷限制了增益：(1) 每次迭代只看前一轮输出，无法直接访问更早的计算结果；(2) 固定的循环次数对简单输入浪费深度，对困难输入计算不足。
AI.method: 提出RecurTrace，利用循环自身的轨迹解决上述两个限制。具体包含两个组件：(1) Loop Memory Attention：让每个被循环的层沿"循环时间轴"关注自己在之前迭代中的状态，从而可以回顾更早的计算而非仅依赖最新状态；(2) 中止头（Halting Head）：读取循环状态并预测是否继续循环，训练时由oracle提供监督信号——该oracle能判断额外深度是否仍能降低损失。
AI.result: 在相同循环骨干网络上的受控MathQA对比中，RecurTrace以平均2.0次循环达到56.9%准确率，比最佳固定循环深度在匹配计算量下高2.2个百分点。基线对比：ACT和PonderNet退化为单次循环失效，CALM仅54.1%（5.6次循环），LoopUS-Conf和TaH-Mismatch达到55.3%（3.2次循环）和55.7%（2.1次循环）。此外，RecurTrace在0.6B、1.7B、4B和8B规模下均优于同预算微调基线，增益随模型规模增大从0.6增至3.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RecurTrace通过循环记忆注意力（访问早期计算）和自适应中止机制（按需动态调节循环次数），有效解决了潜在循环推理中计算访问受限和固定循环数的两大瓶颈，在数学推理和生成任务中均显著超越基线，且增益随模型规模扩大而增强，验证了利用循环轨迹本身来优化推理深度分配的可行性。

title: Semantic Bayesian World Models
summary: Knowledge graphs describe reality in crisp assertions, while the systems now consuming them, foundation models and autonomous agents, reason natively in probabilities. We argue that this mismatch is why the integration of language models and knowledge graphs remains a data-feeding pipeline rather than a unified reasoning architecture. We envision Semantic Bayesian World Models (SBWMs): a Web that describes the world not as a database of facts but as a shared, evolving fabric of beliefs over knowledge graphs, where ontological axioms constrain priors, observations update beliefs by Bayesian conditioning, and actions intervene upon the world. We work through what an agent gains from such a model: a home-security agent deciding whether the figure at the gate is a courier or a burglar, an actuarial estimate aggregated by entailment rather than by string frequency, a planning task that language models reliably fail, and the estimation of quantities that no document has ever stated. We then set out what the community must build to make them possible: belief annotation over RDF~1.2, probabilistic entailment regimes, semantic calibration layers, and protocols by which agents that have never met can exchange, and disagree over, calibrated beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了语义贝叶斯世界模型（SBWMs）的概念，主张将知识图谱从精确事实数据库转变为共享的信念织构，使本体公理作为先验约束、观测通过贝叶斯条件化更新信念、行动对世界进行干预，从而弥合知识图谱的确定性与大模型概率推理之间的根本鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 当前知识图谱以精确断言描述世界，而消费它们的系统（基础模型与自主智能体）天然以概率进行推理。这种不匹配导致语言模型与知识图谱的整合仅仅停留在数据喂入流水线层面，而无法成为统一的推理架构——这是阻碍二者深度融合的根本问题。
AI.method: 提出语义贝叶斯世界模型架构：将网络描述从事实数据库转变为信念织构（belief fabric），其中（1）本体公理约束先验分布；（2）观测通过贝叶斯条件化更新信念；（3）动作作为对世界的干预。文中通过多个具体场景（家庭安防智能体判别门厅人物身份、精算估计的事务性聚合、语言模型失效的规划任务、文档中从未陈述过的量的估计）展示该模型的增益，并提出实现路线图：RDF 1.2上的信念标注、概率蕴含机制、语义校准层、以及陌生代理间交换和争议校准信念的协议。
AI.result: 论文通过四个示例论证了SBWM相对现有范式的增益：概率判别的家庭安防场景、基于蕴含而非字符串频率的精算聚合、大语言模型系统性失败的规划任务、以及对无文档陈述量的估计能力。同时明确了实现该愿景所需的社区构建路径与关键技术挑战。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱与概率推理的统一不应经由数据喂入的繁琐管道，而应直接以信念为底层表示。作者呼吁社区构建语义贝叶斯世界模型所需的基础设施，使网络从确定性事实之库演进为可共享、可演化、可争议的信念之网。

title: WIDE: Wildcard Inference with Dynamic Expansion for Cross-Modal Generative Retrieval
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). 10 pages, 5 figures
summary: Generative retrieval has demonstrated significant success by unifying representation learning and search into a single sequence-to-sequence generation task. However, extending this paradigm to cross-modal retrieval reveals a critical challenge arising from the inherent information asymmetry across different modalities, such as the gap between concise text queries and dense visual candidates. This structural mismatch causes the autoregressive decoder to suffer from forced hallucination when generating identifiers via standard trie-constrained beam search, where the model is severely penalized for failing to guess fine-grained details absent from the query, allowing irrelevant candidates to hijack top rankings. To address this issue, we propose Wildcard Inference with Dynamic Expansion (WIDE). WIDE employs Adaptive Entropy Thresholding (AET) to calibrate layer-specific uncertainty boundaries offline. During the decoding generation phase, Asymmetry-aware Wildcard Decoding (AWD) detects semantic blind spots and emits wildcards instead of forced deterministic identifiers, dynamically expanding the search space without incurring log-probability penalties. Finally, Blind-Spot Re-ranking (BSR) evaluates the expanded candidate pool using a hybrid scoring mechanism that combines discrete generation confidence with continuous semantic similarity. Extensive experiments on the M-BEIR benchmark demonstrate that WIDE outperforms state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods, effectively suppressing forced hallucination while maintaining compact index structures.

AI.tldr: 提出WIDE方法解决跨模态生成式检索中因模态信息不对称导致的强迫幻觉问题，通过自适应熵阈值、通配符动态扩展解码和盲区重排序，在M-BEIR基准上超越SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索在单模态中表现优异，但扩展到跨模态时面临核心挑战：不同模态间存在固有的信息不对称（如简洁文本查询与密集视觉候选之间的鸿沟）。这种结构不匹配导致自回归解码器在使用标准trie约束束搜索生成标识符时遭受强迫幻觉——模型因无法猜测查询中不存在的细粒度细节而受到严重惩罚，使无关候选占据排名前列。
AI.method: 提出WIDE（Wildcard Inference with Dynamic Expansion）框架，包含三个核心组件：1）Adaptive Entropy Thresholding (AET)：离线校准层级的语义盲区不确定性边界；2）Asymmetry-aware Wildcard Decoding (AWD)：在解码阶段检测语义盲区并发出通配符代替强制确定性标识符，动态扩展搜索空间且不引入对数概率惩罚；3）Blind-Spot Re-ranking (BSR)：使用混合评分机制（离散生成置信度+连续语义相似度）对扩展后的候选池进行重排序。
AI.result: 在M-BEIR基准上的大量实验表明，WIDE优于现有最先进的生成式检索方法，有效抑制了强迫幻觉，同时保持了紧凑的索引结构。
AI.conclusion: WIDE通过识别并绕过模型语义盲区，而非强迫其生成不确定的标识符，成功解决了跨模态生成式检索中因信息不对称引发的幻觉问题，验证了通配符动态扩展策略在跨模态检索中的有效性和优越性。

title: TabScope: Question-Adaptive Scope Selection for Table Question Answering
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on table question answering, yet their accuracy often degrades as table size increases. We find that this degradation is not uniform across question types. Localization-sensitive questions are particularly affected by irrelevant table content, while questions requiring broader evidence may still benefit from full-table reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose a question-adaptive framework that dynamically selects between localized and full-table reasoning. The framework constructs question-specific sub-tables through operation-aware table decomposition and uses the predicted question type to determine the appropriate reasoning mode. We further introduce silver reference sub-tables for evaluating evidence selection and construct SLQA, a benchmark based on real-world long tables. Experiments on WikiTQ and SLQA show that localization is particularly effective for lookup and local reasoning questions, while adaptive selection between localized and full-table reasoning achieves the best overall performance. These results highlight that long-table QA requires deciding not only how to localize, but also when to localize. Our code and datasets will be made available upon publication of the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向大语言模型长表格问答的自适应框架，根据问题类型动态选择局部推理或全表推理，并通过操作感知的表分解构造子表，在WikiTQ和SLQA基准上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: LLMs在表格问答中随着表格增大其准确率下降，且这种下降在不同问题类型上并不均匀。局部化敏感问题受无关表格内容影响大，而需要更广证据的问题可能受益于全表推理，因此需要根据问题类型自适应地选择推理模式。
AI.method: 提出问题自适应框架：1）通过操作感知的表格分解构造问题特定的子表；2）利用预测的问题类型决定采用局部推理还是全表推理；3）引入银标准参考子表以评估证据选择质量，并构建基于真实世界长表格的SLQA基准。
AI.result: 在WikiTQ和SLQA上的实验表明，局部化对查找类和局部推理类问题特别有效，而局部推理与全表推理之间的自适应选择取得了最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 长表格QA的关键不仅在于如何局部化，还在于何时进行局部化。研究结果为解决长表格场景下的LLM问答精度退化提供了新思路。

title: TIGPO: Temporal Instance-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Graph-based policy optimization improves credit assignment for long-horizon LLM agents by organizing rollout trajectories into state-transition graphs. However, existing methods construct graphs independently within each policy update, discarding transitions discovered by earlier policies and limiting advantage estimation to small, batch-local rollout groups. We propose \emph{Temporal Instance-Graph Policy Optimization} (TIGPO), which extends graph-based credit assignment across policy updates. TIGPO maintains a persistent transition graph for each task, allowing valid transitions discovered by different policy versions to jointly determine credit for current rollouts. To actively reconnect current exploration with historical experience, TIGPO allocates a fixed rollout budget between Exploration slots for ordinary task sampling and Revisit slots for delayed reattempts of previously explored tasks. For each revisit, TIGPO pairs the current rollout group with its corresponding earlier Exploration group to construct a cross-temporal reference. The enlarged reference is designed to stabilize relative advantage estimation under small rollout groups, while comparison on the same task directly captures policy improvement across training stages. Historical transitions and scores serve only as structural and detached statistical references and are never replayed in the policy loss. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that TIGPO consistently outperforms prior group-based and graph-based policy optimization methods.

AI.tldr: TIGPO是一种跨策略更新维护持久性转换图的时间实例图策略优化方法，通过将当前探索组的展开与历史探索组配对构建跨时间参考，以稳定优势估计并捕获策略改进，在ALFWorld和WebShop上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的策略优化方法在每个策略更新内独立构建图，丢弃了早期策略发现的历史转换，限制了优势估计只能在小规模的批次局部展开组内进行，无法充分利用跨策略更新阶段积累的经验来实现更好的信用分配。
AI.method: TIGPO为每个任务维护持久转换图，使不同策略版本发现的有效转换能共同决定当前rollouts的信用。在探索槽和回访槽之间分配固定rollout预算，回访时将当前rollout组与对应的早期探索组配对，构建跨时间参考以增强相对优势估计的稳定性，同时历史转换和分数仅作为结构和去关联的统计参考，不会在策略损失中重放。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，TIGPO持续优于先前的基于组和基于图的策略优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨策略更新的持久图和跨时间参考组，TIGPO能够更有效地进行长程LLM智能体的信用分配，同时避免历史数据重放带来的问题。

title: Adapting to Evolving Requirements: Agentic AI for Retail Supply Chain Operations
summary: Retail supply chain operations rely on coupled decision modules that must adapt as requirements evolve. LLMs offer a natural-language interface for this task, but existing methods primarily focus on individual optimization models. Extending them to heterogeneous decision pipelines is challenging because a requirement may admit multiple intervention paths with different downstream effects. We formulate requirement-driven adaptation as the joint selection of an intervention route and an admissible module-level change, and propose a graph-constrained agentic framework in which domain agents expose admissible reformulation interfaces and a central processor searches over bounded intervention paths. Candidates are validated and compared using downstream KPIs. In collaboration with a large retail partner, we evaluate 100 warehouse requirements elicited from practitioner interviews, with GPT, Qwen, and DeepSeek as base LLMs. Relative to direct LLM reformulation, our framework improves correctness and end-to-end success across all three models, raising end-to-end success from 72--76% to 79--83%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种图约束的智能体框架，用于零售供应链中需求驱动的异构决策流水线自适应改造，通过联合选择干预路径与模块级变更来提升端到端成功率。
AI.motivation: 零售供应链运营依赖多个耦合决策模块，需求变化时需联合调整。现有方法主要关注单一优化模型，难以扩展到异构决策流水线，因为一个需求可能对应多条干预路径且下游影响不同，缺乏系统性的多路径干预选择方法。
AI.method: 将需求驱动的自适应建模为干预路线与模块级可接受变更的联合选择问题。提出图约束智能体框架：领域智能体暴露可接受的改造接口，中央处理器在受限的干预路径上进行搜索；候选方案通过下游KPI进行验证和比较。
AI.result: 与大型零售伙伴合作，基于从业者访谈收集100条仓储需求，使用GPT、Qwen和DeepSeek作为基础LLM评估。相比直接LLM改造，该框架在三个模型上均提升了正确性和端到端成功率，端到端成功率从72%-76%提升至79%-83%。
AI.conclusion: 图约束智能体框架能有效处理异构决策流水线的需求驱动自适应，显著优于直接LLM改造方法，且在不同基础LLM上均表现稳定。

title: SV-WAM: An Efficient Surround-View World-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World models (WMs) have demonstrated strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by learning predictive representations of future scene dynamics. However, generating future videos during inference introduces substantial computational overhead, leading many recent driving WMs to adopt a single front camera as input for efficient deployment. This design restricts spatial coverage in safety-critical maneuvers such as lane changes, merges, and turns. To address this limitation, we propose SV-WAM, a surround-view world-action model (WAM) that preserves full six-camera observations while maintaining efficient inference. SV-WAM leverages future-video prediction as dense training supervision for action learning within a shared generative model, rather than as an inference-time output. At the core of this design is an action-centered causal mask that prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens during joint action-video denoising. Consequently, the video branch can be discarded at deployment, enabling efficient action-only planning. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable drivable-area compliance regularizer that penalizes vehicle-footprint corners approaching or crossing drivable boundaries, improving planning safety and boundary awareness. Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIMv2 benchmark and the open-loop nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that SV-WAM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance with low inference latency and competitive zero-shot transfer capability.

AI.tldr: SV-WAM提出了一种环视世界-动作模型（WAM），在不牺牲推理效率的前提下保留六摄像头环视观测，利用未来视频预测作为动作学习的密集训练监督而非推理输出，通过动作中心因果掩码使部署时无需视频分支，并引入可微可行驶区域一致性正则化器提升规划安全性，在NAVSIMv2和nuScenes基准上达到SOTA规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型在推理时生成未来视频会带来巨大计算开销，因此多数方法退化为单前摄像头输入，牺牲了变道、合流、转弯等安全关键场景的空间覆盖范围。作者希望同时保留周视六摄像头观测与高效推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出SV-WAM，采用共享生成模型，将未来视频预测作为动作学习的密集训练监督而非推理输出；2) 设计动作中心因果掩码，在联合动作-视频去噪过程中阻止动作标记关注未来视频标记，从而可在部署时丢弃视频分支实现纯动作规划；3) 引入可微可行驶区域一致性正则化器，惩罚车辆足迹角点接近或越过可行驶边界，提升规划的安全性与边界感知。
AI.result: 在闭环NAVSIMv2基准和开环nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明，SV-WAM实现了SOTA规划性能，推理延迟低，具备有竞争力的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SV-WAM证明了视频预测监督可以在训练阶段充分服务于动作学习而不需要在推理阶段执行，从而在保持环视输入的完整空间感知的同时实现了高效的动作规划，为自动驾驶世界模型的实用化设计提供了新思路。

title: Building Pretraining Data for World Models: An Unreal Engine-Based Pipeline for Action-Conditioned Video Generation
summary: Action-conditioned video models require large-scale visual data paired with control signals that are temporally aligned with the resulting scene transitions. Such supervision is difficult to obtain from ordinary real-world video because the actions that caused each visual change are typically unknown. We present a large-scale synthetic data production pipeline built on Unreal Engine for generating action-conditioned, multi-view video. To accommodate the different execution requirements of real-time physics and high-quality offline rendering, the pipeline executes trajectory generation and final rendering in two stages: Stage I runs real physics in PIE and records per-frame character states, control inputs, and camera states into an intermediate trajectory representation; Stage II replays those trajectories in a new engine process and renders them offline with Movie Render Queue (MRQ). Around this core, we develop a distributed production system with cache-aware task partitioning, node-local slot scheduling, automated scene screening, aesthetic and luminance filtering, partial-output recovery, asynchronous upload, and continuous cluster health monitoring. The production cluster contains 25 servers with eight NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPUs per server. From 2,384 asset packs, 429 levels were retained for production together with a pool of 40 humanoid characters. The pipeline has produced 2,691 hours of 1080p video and 6,076 hours of 720p video. We describe the system architecture, the implementation decisions that emerged from production failures, and the limitations of using perceptual quality proxies for world-model data curation. The pipeline described in this report constitutes the Unreal Engine synthetic-data production component used in EchoWM.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于Unreal Engine的大规模合成数据生产流水线，用于生成动作条件化、多视角视频。该流水线采用两阶段设计：第一阶段在PIE中运行实时物理并记录角色状态与控制输入，第二阶段在新的引擎进程中用Movie Render Queue进行离线高质量渲染。生产集群包含25台服务器（每台8块RTX 5090 GPU），已产出2,691小时1080p和6,076小时720p视频。该流水线构成EchoWM的Unreal Engine合成数据生产组件。
AI.motivation: 动作条件化视频模型需要大量与场景变化时间对齐的视觉数据和对应的控制信号，而真实世界视频中引起视觉变化的动作通常是未知的，难以获得此类监督信号。因此需要一种能够生成动作-视觉严格对齐的大规模数据的方法。
AI.method: 该流水线基于Unreal Engine实现两阶段生产的分布式系统：Stage I在PIE环境下运行实时物理模拟，记录每帧角色状态、控制输入和相机状态为中间轨迹表示；Stage II在新引擎进程中重放轨迹并使用Movie Render Queue离线渲染。系统围绕核心实现了缓存感知的任务分区、节点本地槽调度、自动化场景筛选、美学与亮度过滤、部分输出恢复、异步上传及集群健康监控等功能。
AI.result: 生产集群包含25台服务器、每台8块RTX 5090 GPU。从2,384个资源包中筛选出429个关卡和40个人形角色用于生产。流水线已产出2,691小时1080p视频和6,076小时720p视频。
AI.conclusion: 本文描述了系统架构、生产失败驱动的实现决策，以及使用感知质量代理进行世界模型数据筛选的局限性。该流水线是EchoWM所使用的Unreal Engine合成数据生产组件。

title: To What Extent Do Large Language Models Understand Bangla Idioms?
summary: Idiomatic expressions are an integral part of natural language, reflecting cultural nuances and posing unique challenges for computational models, particularly in low-resource languages. In this paper, we present the first large-scale benchmark dataset of Bangla idioms, complemented by a synthetic multiple-choice question (MCQ) dataset for idiom meaning identification. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of recent large language models (LLMs) across three idiom-related tasks: paraphrasing, idiom span detection, and meaning identification, leveraging zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies. Our results reveal substantial variability in model performance, with no single LLM consistently outperforming others across all tasks. Notably, Phi-4-mini-instruct excels in paraphrasing, Kimi-K2-32b-instruct in span detection, and Gemini-2.5-flash in meaning identification. We believe that our datasets and analyses will provide valuable resources to guide future research in improving LLM comprehension of idiomatic expressions, particularly in Bangla and other low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文首次构建了孟加拉语习语的大规模基准数据集及配套的合成多项选择（MCQ）数据集，并在三个习语相关任务（释义、习语跨度检测和意义识别）上对多种最新的LLM进行了零样本和少样本提示策略的全面评估。结果显示不同模型在不同任务上各有优势，没有任何模型能在所有任务上持续领先。
AI.motivation: 习语表达是自然语言的重要组成部分，反映文化细微差别，但在低资源语言中对计算模型构成独特挑战。目前缺乏针对孟加拉语习语的大规模基准数据集和系统性的LLM评估，因此作者希望填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了首个孟加拉语习语大规模基准数据集和一个用于习语意义识别的合成多选问答数据集；随后在释义、习语跨度检测和意义识别三个任务上，利用零样本和少样本提示策略对近期多个大语言模型进行了全面评估。
AI.result: 模型性能存在显著差异：Phi-4-mini-instruct在释义任务中表现最优，Kimi-K2-32b-instruct在跨度检测中表现最好，而Gemini-2.5-flash在意义识别任务中最佳；没有任何单一LLM能在所有任务中稳定超越其他模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提供的数据集和分析为未来研究提供了宝贵资源，有助于提升LLM对孟加拉语及其他低资源语言中习语表达的理解能力。

title: Inferred Generative-Process Diversity Predicts Correlated Failure Across Language Models
summary: Diversity is a widely observed factor in the resilient function of collective systems, yet the type of diversity that matters depends on the properties and failure modes of the system. This distinction is important for systems composed of multiple language models. Different models may be treated as independent components even when their behaviour and failures remain strongly correlated. Assessments of language-model populations using semantic similarity demonstrate limited semantic diversity, but this captures only differences in the meaning of observed outputs. We argue that a more fundamental notion of model diversity is generative-process diversity, the differences between processes capable of generating the observed outputs. Drawing from Algorithmic Information Theory, we use Normalised Compression Distance between raw model outputs, residualised against a permutation control, as a measure of inferred generative-process diversity.
