Across 38 language models, this measure identifies population structure missed by semantic similarity and predicts cross-task variation in chance-corrected correlated failure among model pairs across ten disjoint benchmark families, beyond semantic similarity and model-pair capability. The cross-benchmark partial rank association is $-0.216$ with a 95% interval of $[-0.309,-0.122]$, and the estimate is negative on all ten benchmarks. These results indicate that increased generative-process diversity is associated with reduced correlated failure in model pairs that is not attributable to semantic similarity or capability. Inferred generative-process diversity offers a novel and practical approach for investigating diversity of multi-model systems in safety-relevant contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"生成过程多样性"（而非语义相似性）来衡量多语言模型集体系统的多样性，基于算法信息论中的归一化压缩距离（NCD），辅以排列对照进行残差化，作为推断生成过程多样性的指标。在38个语言模型上的实验表明，该指标能识别语义相似性遗漏的群体结构，并在十个基准上显著预测模型对间的负相关失败（部分秩相关系数为-0.216，95%区间[-0.309,-0.122]），且在所有十个基准上估计均为负。
AI.motivation: 多样性对集体系统的韧性至关重要，但多语言模型系统（多智能体系统）中不同模型可能被当作独立组件，即使其行为与失败模式高度相关。现有基于语义相似性的多样性评估无法捕捉更深层的、与失败模式相关的模型差异，因此需要更根本的"生成过程多样性"概念来识别模型间潜在的共同失败风险。
AI.method: 借鉴算法信息论，使用原始模型输出之间的归一化压缩距离（Normalised Compression Distance, NCD），并对排列对照（permutation control）进行残差化，以推断生成过程多样性。在38个语言模型上计算该指标，并在十个不相交基准族上检验其与模型对机会校正相关失败（chance-corrected correlated failure）之间的关系，控制语义相似性和模型对能力等混淆因素。
AI.result: 该指标识别出了语义相似性遗漏的群体结构。跨基准部分秩关联为-0.216（95%区间[-0.309,-0.122]），在所有十个基准上估计均为负，表明生成过程多样性越高，模型对的关联失败越低，且该效应不能归因于语义相似性或能力差异。
AI.conclusion: 推断的生成过程多样性为研究多模型系统的多样性提供了新颖且实用的方法，对安全相关的多模型系统（如多智能体集体决策、冗余容错系统）具有重要意义，可作为评估和选择模型组件的有效工具。

title: Bioinfoysis Technical Report
summary: Large language model agents have shown promise in bioinformatics, but most existing systems focus primarily on producing final answers, treating planning, tool use, and code execution as transient interactions. This design is poorly suited to long-horizon bioinformatics tasks, where conclusions must remain connected to the data, computations, and intermediate evidence that support them. We introduce \textbf{Bioinfoysis}, a multi-agent harness that represents each request as a persistent, artifact-grounded analysis run. Bioinfoysis combines global planning with step-wise, evidence-driven replanning: the planner maintains an executable checklist and revises pending steps using structured handoffs returned after each worker execution. These handoffs bind intermediate results to their responsible agent, checklist step, and plan generation, preventing stale evidence from being silently reused after replanning. A controlled runtime validates generated scripts, tables, and figures before they are used in downstream analysis or reporting, while role-specific context, persistent memory, and governed bioinformatics skills support reliable execution over long analysis trajectories. We evaluate Bioinfoysis on BixBench and two question-answering tracks of LAB-Bench 2. On BixBench, Bioinfoysis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 82.4\%. Across four underlying language models, Bioinfoysis increases average accuracy from 27.81\% to 64.13\% on SeqQA2 and from 3.13\% to 31.25\% on DbQA2. These results demonstrate that reliable bioinformatics automation depends not only on model capability, but also on the harness that governs planning, execution, memory, and evidence flow. We hope that the emergence of Bioinfoysis will play a driving and leading role in the development of the bioinformatics community. Our demo website can be seen in https://report.bioinfoysis.com/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bioinfoysis，一个多智能体框架，将生物信息学请求表示为持久的、以工件为锚点的分析运行，结合全局规划与逐步的证据驱动重规划，通过结构化交接防止过期证据复用，并配备受控运行时验证脚本、表格和图形。在BixBench上取得82.4%的SOTA准确率，并在四个底层语言模型上将SeqQA2平均准确率从27.81%提升至64.13%，DbQA2从3.13%提升至31.25%。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体系统主要关注产生最终答案，将规划、工具使用和代码执行视为短暂交互，难以胜任长时程生物信息学任务。在生物信息学中，结论必须与支持它们的数据、计算和中间证据保持可追溯的关联，因此需要一种将分析过程持久化并工件锚定的框架。
AI.method: Bioinfoysis采用多智能体框架，核心设计包括：(1) 全局规划器维护可执行检查清单，并在每次工作节点执行后通过结构化交接进行逐步重规划；(2) 交接机制将中间结果绑定到其负责智能体、检查清单步骤和规划代次，防止重规划后过期证据被静默重用；(3) 受控运行时在下游分析前验证生成的脚本、表格和图形；(4) 角色特定上下文、持久记忆和受治理的生物信息学技能支持长分析轨迹中可靠执行。
AI.result: 在BixBench上取得82.4%的SOTA准确率。在SEQQA2上，四个底层LM平均准确率从27.81%提升至64.13%；在DBQA2上从3.13%提升至31.25%。结果表明可靠自动化取决于智能体框架对规划、执行、记忆和证据流的管理，而非仅依赖模型能力。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的生物信息学自动化不仅依赖底层模型能力，更关键的是框架对规划、执行、记忆和证据流的治理。Bioinfoysis通过工件锚定的持久化分析运行设计证明了这一点，并希望在生物信息学社区中发挥引领作用。

title: Understanding Autonomous Driving Datasets by Describing Differences between Image Subsets in Natural Language
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, submitted to the IEEE Open Journal of Intelligent Transportation Systems (OJ-ITS), our implementation and benchmark dataset are available at https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff
summary: Understanding the composition of large-scale autonomous driving datasets is essential for safety, robustness, and reliable operation across domains. For example, domain shift between locations could lead to the operating environment being misaligned with the training data, resulting in potentially dangerous performance degradation. Yet, existing data analysis pipelines largely rely on metadata, predefined labels, or manual inspection, which provide limited semantic insight or do not scale. This paper studies set difference captioning: given two subsets of images, the goal is to produce a natural-language hypothesis describing differences between the target and reference set. Building on a two-stage formulation, we adapt the method to autonomous driving by focusing on object-centric patches derived from object detection, which simplifies aggregation and enables attribution of differences to specific object instances or categories. To evaluate this setting in-domain, we introduce a new benchmark, AD-Diff Bench. Low-concentration experiments assess the suitability of set-difference-captioning approaches to sparse, real-world differences. We restrict our experiments to open-weight models to support reproducibility and ease of deployment. The proposed benchmark and analysis provide a step towards practical, human-interpretable dataset introspection for autonomous driving datasets. Our implementation and benchmark dataset are available at https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动驾驶数据集的集合差异描述（set difference captioning）问题：给定两个图像子集，自动生成自然语言假设来描述目标集与参考集之间的差异。作者将两阶段方法适配到自动驾驶场景，聚焦于由目标检测导出的以对象为中心的图像块，引入新基准AD-Diff Bench，并使用开放权重模型进行低浓度实验评估。
AI.motivation: 大规模自动驾驶数据集的构成理解对安全性、鲁棒性和跨域可靠运行至关重要（例如地理位置之间的域偏移可能导致运行环境与训练数据不匹配，引发危险的性能退化）。然而现有数据分析流程多依赖元数据、预定义标签或人工检查，语义洞察有限或不可扩展，缺乏能够自动、可解释地描述两个图像子集之间语义差异的方法。
AI.method: 基于两阶段（two-stage）公式构建集合差异描述方法，并将其适配至自动驾驶领域。核心策略是聚焦于从目标检测中获得的以对象为中心的图像块（object-centric patches），这简化了聚合过程，并能将差异归因到具体对象实例或类别。同时引入新基准AD-Diff Bench来评估该设置，并仅使用开放权重模型以保证可复现性和部署便利性。
AI.result: 提出了自动驾驶专用的集合差异描述基准AD-Diff Bench，并进行低浓度（low-concentration）实验，评估集合差异描述方法在处理稀疏、真实世界差异场景中的适用性。实验严格限制在开放权重模型上。
AI.conclusion: 该基准和分析为自动驾驶数据集的实用、人类可解释的数据集内省（dataset introspection）迈出了一步，代码和基准数据已开源（https://github.com/KIT-MRT/AD-Diff）。

title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow
summary: We present FlashRender, a few-step generative rendering framework that retakes a source video along a target camera trajectory in seconds. We identify sampling-step-dependent camera control as a prominent manifestation of discretization error in existing multi-step generative rendering models and show that resolving this inconsistency substantially lowers denoising trajectory curvature, facilitating subsequent step distillation. To this end, we introduce Representation Transformation and Alignment (RETA), which aligns hidden source-video representations with target-video features from a frozen visual geometry model. This directly encodes the geometric transformation within the source-video stream, enabling sampling-step-consistent camera control. We then fine-tune the model with the MeanFlow objective on the lower-curvature denoising trajectory induced by RETA, allowing the model to more effectively address discretization error. Finally, we apply on-policy flow map distillation to correct self-rollout errors under fixed few-step sampling. Extensive experiments show that RETA, MeanFlow, and on-policy flow map distillation play complementary roles in few-step generative rendering. Together, they enable our approach to match multi-step baselines in video quality and geometric consistency at 25x lower sampling cost while achieving superior camera controllability, even under out-of-distribution target camera trajectories.

AI.tldr: FlashRender是一个几步式生成渲染框架，通过RETA、MeanFlow和on-policy流图蒸馏三个互补组件，在25倍更低的采样成本下实现与多步基线相当的视频质量和几何一致性，并具有更优的相机可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式渲染模型存在采样步数依赖的相机控制问题，这是离散化误差的显著表现。作者旨在通过解决这种不一致性来降低去噪轨迹曲率，从而促进步数蒸馏，实现几秒内沿目标相机轨迹重拍源视频。
AI.method: 1) RETA (Representation Transformation and Alignment)：将源视频的隐表示与冻结的视觉几何模型中的目标视频特征对齐，直接在源视频流中编码几何变换，实现采样步数一致的相机控制；2) MeanFlow目标：在RETA诱导的更低曲率去噪轨迹上微调模型，更有效地解决离散化误差；3) On-policy流图蒸馏：在固定少步采样下纠正自滚动误差。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RETA、MeanFlow和on-policy流图蒸馏在少步生成渲染中发挥互补作用。该方法在视频质量和几何一致性上匹配多步基线，采样成本降低25倍，且在分布外的目标相机轨迹下仍具有优越的相机可控性。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决采样步数依赖的相机控制不一致性（离散化误差的关键体现），并采用互补的三组件策略，FlashRender实现了高效、高质量、几何一致且强相机可控的少步生成渲染，为生成式渲染的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Lngram v2: Latent N-Gram Memory with Interpretable Discrete Representations
summary: Transformers lack a native lookup mechanism, requiring repeated dense computation to recognize and reuse local static patterns. Lngram v1 introduces tokenizer-independent conditional memory through discrete latent n-gram addressing, but its memory capacity is coupled with the backbone width, limiting scalability due to high parameter and activation costs. We propose Lngram v2, which decouples the number of routes, memory dimension, and backbone width, and introduces a context-aware grouped-query attention readout to scale memory capacity independently. A zero-value Sink and counterfactual surrogate gradients further improve readout selectivity and routing trainability while preserving hard discrete addressing. Experiments across vision--language models (VLMs) of different scales show consistent improvements, including successful scaling to a 30B-parameter model. Compared with Lngram v1, Lngram v2 substantially reduces both total and activated memory parameters while maintaining or improving language modeling performance. Further analysis shows that its discrete IDs preserve substantial semantic structure of continuous hidden states, enabling semantic recovery from IDs alone and stable ID--semantic associations across datasets. These results establish Lngram v2 as an efficient and scalable latent conditional memory mechanism whose discrete addresses also provide a structured interface for analyzing internal model representations.

AI.tldr: Lngram v2提出了一种解耦路由数量、记忆维度和骨干宽度的离散潜在条件记忆机制，通过上下文感知的组查询注意力读取和零值Sink+反事实替代梯度，实现了记忆容量的独立扩展，并在30B参数规模的VLM上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: Transformer缺乏原生查找机制，需要重复密集计算来识别和重用局部静态模式。Lngram v1虽然引入了基于离散潜在n-gram寻址的与分词器无关的条件记忆，但其记忆容量与骨干宽度耦合，导致参数和激活成本高、可扩展性受限。因此需要一个记忆容量可独立扩展的高效机制。
AI.method: Lngram v2 包含三个关键设计：(1) 解耦路由数量、记忆维度与骨干宽度，使记忆容量可独立扩展；(2) 引入上下文感知的组查询注意力（context-aware grouped-query attention）读出机制；(3) 使用零值Sink（zero-value Sink）和反事实替代梯度（counterfactual surrogate gradients）来提升读出选择性和路由可训练性，同时保持硬离散寻址。
AI.result: 在不同规模的语言-视觉模型（VLM）上进行实验均获得一致改进，成功扩展到30B参数模型。相比Lngram v1，Lngram v2显著减少了总记忆参数和激活记忆参数，同时保持或提升了语言建模性能。进一步分析显示，离散ID保留了连续隐藏状态的大量语义结构，可仅从ID恢复语义，且跨数据集保持稳定的ID-语义关联。
AI.conclusion: Lngram v2被确立为一种高效可扩展的潜在条件记忆机制，其离散地址还为分析模型内部表征提供了结构化接口，在效率和可扩展性上优于前代方案。

title: TraveL: Transformer-based Multi-view Path Distributional Representation Learning
summary: Path representation learning (PRL) for road networks has received increasing research attention, due to various path-related applications. Existing works on PRL typically exploit the co-occurrence relationship among road segments and paths to learn a vector as the path representation, without exploring the varied traveler behaviors and the regional correlation on the path. In this work, we propose to learn distributional representations, which provide valuable information for use in path-related applications, by capturing the varied traveler behaviors as well as the various dependencies within regions of road segments. We propose a novel Transformer-based Multi-view Distributional Representation Learning (TraveL) framework to encode a path along with a travel starting time to a distributional representation, which can be used to decode possible samples of on-path traveler behavior. Moreover, by analyzing the regional correlation which reveals various road segment relationships, we propose a regional attention to encode these correlations in a path. Also, we explore the idea of Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) test to compare the sampled traveler behavior against the collected ground truth to facilitate training. Experimental results show that the proposed TraveL model outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets, by 14.7% in Mean K-S distance for travel time distribution estimation, 16.7% in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for path similarity prediction, and 3.97% in MAE for destination prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TraveL框架，一种基于Transformer的多视角分布表示学习方法，用于道路网络的路径表示学习，通过捕捉旅行者行为变化和区域相关性，将路径及出发时间编码为分布表示，在旅行时间分布估计、路径相似性预测和目的地预测任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有路径表示学习方法通常仅利用路段与路径的共现关系来学习向量表示，未考虑多样化的旅行者行为以及道路网络中路段间的区域相关性，导致路径表征信息不充分，限制了路径相关应用的效果。
AI.method: 提出Transformer-based Multi-view Distributional Representation Learning (TraveL)框架。具体包括：(1) 将路径及旅行起始时间编码为分布表示，通过解码生成可能的路径旅行者行为样本；(2) 分析区域相关性，提出区域注意力机制编码路径中的区域关联；(3) 利用Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S)检验比较采样的旅行者行为与真实数据，以辅助模型训练。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有最优方法：在旅行时间分布估计任务上Mean K-S距离提升14.7%，路径相似性预测的MAE提升16.7%，目的地预测的MAE提升3.97%。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布表示学习结合区域注意力与K-S检验约束，能够有效捕捉旅行者行为的多样性与区域间的依赖关系，显著提升路径表示在下游任务中的表现，验证了分布级路径表征的优越性。

title: STAIR (STructure Aware Information Retriever): A novel dataset and LLM based retriever for document structure augmentation
summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a key component for generating accurate and hallucination free answers using Large Language Models (LLMs). LLMs are improving at handling long context, but still suffer from "lost in the middle" problem. Thus, precise and accurate retrieval is important. Current retrievers chunk long context into length-based manageable chunks - in the process throwing away rich and informative semantic global structure in the corpus. We introduce a novel retrieval system STAIR that empowers an LLM to exploit global structure in a corpus such as a Table of Contents (ToC) to efficiently store and retrieve information from its model parameters. Our thorough and careful ablation studies with a finetuned Differentiable Search Index (DSI) system show that ToC helps build a low hallucination (less than 0.05%) generative Information Retrieval (IR) system and can generalize to examples where very few training samples are available. To further research in this novel direction of ToC based retrieval we release SearchTome - a diverse benchmark created from 18 books across 6 diverse domains to further research in this novel direction. STAIR achieves a high Recall@1 score of 82.6% on SearchTome as compared to DSI (76.9%), where the difference is found to be statistically significant. STAIR easily beats other strong baselines such as BM25 (59.5%), DPR (68.7%) and out-of-the-box Mistral (13.8%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAIR，一种利用目录（ToC）等全局结构信息来增强检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的检索能力的新型检索系统，通过可微搜索索引（DSI）微调实现低幻觉、高精度的生成式信息检索，并构建了SearchTome基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前的检索器通常将长文本切割成基于长度的块，在此过程中丢失了语料库中丰富且有信息量的语义全局结构（如书籍的目录）。同时大语言模型在处理长上下文时仍存在"lost in the middle"问题，因此精确和准确的检索至关重要。
AI.method: STAIR利用LLM将语料库的全局结构（如表目录ToC）编码到模型参数中，通过微调Differentiable Search Index（DSI）实现高效的存储与检索；并进行了系统性的消融实验，同时构建了SearchTome基准（涵盖18本书、6个领域）用于评估。
AI.result: 在SearchTome基准上，STAIR达到82.6%的Recall@1，显著优于DSI（76.9%）、BM25（59.5%）、DPR（68.7%）和Mistral（13.8%）；且实现了低于0.05%的低幻觉率，并能泛化到极少量训练样本的场景。
AI.conclusion: 利用ToC等全局结构信息可以显著提升生成式信息检索系统的准确性和鲁棒性，降低幻觉率，为RAG系统在长文档场景下的检索开辟了新方向，并通过公开发布SearchTome基准促进该领域的进一步研究。

title: DropClick: Semi-Automated One-Click Segmentation for Agricultural Robotic Data
summary: Labelling vision datasets, especially for segmentation tasks, is a laborious and costly process that stymies novel developments in agricultural robotics. In this paper, we present DropClick, a click-guided segmentation tool that simplifies the annotation process. Our system utilises single-click inputs on objects to generate pseudo-labels, which can replace manual annotations. DropClick stands out as it is a semi-automated approach and does not require a click for every object in the scene. It can therefore further reduce the required amount of user input drastically. We evaluate our method on two challenging agricultural robotic datasets, SB20 and BUP20 for plant and fruit segmentation, respectively. DropClick is first trained on a small subset of just 5 images from the original training data. This DropClick model can then be deployed as a one-click segmentation system and achieves comparable or higher performance than other one-click methods achieving an mIoU of 70.0 and 72.6 points, for SB20 and BUP20 respectively. DropClick then excels at maintaining high performance when clicks are not given (e.g. dropped); when 50% of the clicks are missing it still maintains an mIoU of 68.9 and 71.3 points, for SB20 and BUP20 respectively. We validate DropClick as a pseudo-labelling approach by taking its outputs to train a Mask2Former instance-based segmentation model in a semi-supervised manner. In this process, partially removing user input from DropClick yields similar high performance when compared to providing all clicks, at 70.1 vs 70.7 points AP50 for SB20 and no difference for BUP20 at 77.0 for both models; at the same time saving 46.3% of total input for SB20 and 31.9% for BUP20.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DropClick，一种点击引导的半自动分割标注工具，利用单个点击生成伪标签，无需对场景中每个物体都点击，可大幅减少标注所需用户输入。在两个农业机器人数据集（SB20和BUP20）上验证，DropClick仅用5张图像训练即可达到与全点击方案相当或更优的性能，并在点击缺失（如50%丢失）时仍保持高性能，同时节省高达46.3%的用户输入。
AI.motivation: 视觉数据集的标注，尤其是分割任务的标注，是劳动密集且成本高昂的过程，严重阻碍了农业机器人领域的新发展，因此需要一种能显著减少人工标注投入的工具。
AI.method: DropClick是一种点击引导的分割工具，采用半自动化方法：只需对部分物体进行单击输入即可生成伪标签，替代全手动标注；该方法首先在原始训练数据中极小子集（仅5张图像）上训练，随后可部署为一键分割系统，并支持在部分点击缺失（被drop）的情况下仍维持高性能，其输出的伪标签可进一步用于半监督方式训练下游分割模型（如Mask2Former）。
AI.result: 在SB20和BUP20两个农业数据集上，DropClick实现mIoU分别达到70.0和72.6；当50%点击缺失时仍保持68.9和71.3的mIoU。作为伪标签方法训练Mask2Former时，部分移除用户输入与提供全部点击性能相当（SB20为70.1 vs 70.7 AP50，BUP20两者均为77.0），同时节省SB20的46.3%和BUP20的31.9%总输入。
AI.conclusion: DropClick作为一种半自动点击引导伪标注方案，能在极小训练数据和部分点击缺失的条件下保持高分割性能，显著降低标注成本与用户输入量，为农业机器人领域的分割任务标注提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Occlusion-Robust Multimodal Emotion Recognition in VR via Fusion of Facial Images and EMG
comment: Joint Proceedings of the ACM Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI) Workshops 2026
summary: Head-mounted displays (HMDs) fundamentally limit emotion recognition in virtual reality (VR): by occluding the upper face, they render conventional image-based facial expression analysis incomplete, particularly for applications requiring real-time affective assessment. We address this challenge by fusing lower-face video with facial electromyography (EMG) from the occluded upper face to classify seven emotional categories (six basic emotions plus neutral). We introduce a synchronized multimodal dataset from 20 participants, pairing lower-face video with seven-channel upper-face EMG elicited by validated emotion stimuli. Under subject-independent test, our proposed late-fusion architecture merging convolutional visual embeddings with RBF-kernel EMG representations achieves 51% macro-F1, outperforming both image-only (41%) and EMG-only (43%) baselines. These results demonstrate that upper-face EMG provides robust complementary information under HMD-induced visual occlusion and establish a foundation for multimodal emotion recognition in naturalistic VR environments. This approach facilitates affect-adaptive applications, including communication training and therapeutic interventions. The dataset will be shared upon request under an ethical-use agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合下半脸视频与上半脸肌电(EMG)信号的多模态情绪识别方法，以解决头戴式显示器(HMD)遮挡上半脸导致传统图像表情分析失效的问题。在20名受试者的同步多模态数据集上，晚期融合架构实现了51%的宏F1分数，优于仅图像(41%)和仅EMG(43%)基线。
AI.motivation: 头戴式显示器(HMD)遮挡了用户上半面部，使得依赖完整面部图像的情绪识别在VR环境中失效，需要探索不受遮挡影响或受遮挡影响较小的替代信号源，以实现实时情感评估。
AI.method: 构建包含20名受试者、同步采集下半脸视频与七通道上半脸EMG的多模态数据集，采用验证过的情绪刺激诱发七类情绪(六种基本情绪加中性)。提出晚期融合架构，将基于卷积神经网络的视觉嵌入与基于RBF核的EMG特征表示进行融合分类。
AI.result: 受试者独立测试下，晚期融合方法达到51%的宏F1分数，显著优于仅图像基线(41%)和仅EMG基线(43%)，证明上半脸EMG在HMD视觉遮挡下提供了稳健的互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了上半脸EMG与下半脸视觉融合的有效性，为自然VR环境下的多模态情绪识别奠定基础，可促进情感自适应应用（如沟通训练和治疗干预）的发展。

title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large language models achieve superior performance on tasks that require extended reasoning, but long chains of thought make the KV cache a severe memory bottleneck. Existing KV cache compression methods share one paradigm: score each cached token by some estimate of how much it will matter later, and keep the top-scoring ones. We show that the selection signal contributes almost nothing. Random Attention keeps the prompt and evicts uniformly at random within each attention head, computing no score at all; across four models and six reasoning tasks it matches the strongest prior evictor while serving 32-43% higher throughput than it in vLLM deployment. Controlled experiments explain this by showing that 1) the prompt is the fragile part of the cache, and most of the gap between selectors is just whether their selection signal happened to keep it; 2) the reasoning trace protects itself against eviction with redundancy at two levels, in the text (the model restates what it still needs as it works) and across attention heads (each keeps its own copy of the trace), so once the prompt is safe, a random draw retains enough copies of what the model still needs, and no score is required to pick them. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/Random-Attention.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有KV缓存压缩方法中的评分/选择信号几乎是无效的。随机丢弃缓存（Random Attention）在四个模型和六个推理任务上与最强的先验驱逐方法性能相当，但由于无需计算分数，吞吐量提升32-43%。关键在于：提示（prompt）是缓存中最脆弱的组成部分，而推理轨迹通过文本层级和注意力头两个层面的冗余实现了自我保护。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在需要扩展推理的任务上表现优异，但长思维链使得KV缓存成为严重的内存瓶颈。现有KV缓存压缩方法都基于同一范式：对每个缓存token打分以评估其未来重要性，仅保留高分token。作者质疑这一范式，认为选择信号本身贡献甚微，因此探索是否存在更简单的、无需打分的高效压缩方案。
AI.method: 提出Random Attention方法：保留prompt对应的缓存，在每个注意力头内对后续推理轨迹的token进行均匀随机驱逐，不计算任何重要性分数。通过受控实验解释其有效性的两个机制：（1）prompt是缓存中最脆弱的部分，选择器之间的性能差异主要源于它们的选择信号是否恰好保留了prompt；（2）推理轨迹通过两层冗余自我保护——文本层面模型会复述其仍需要的信息，注意力头层面每个头各自保存轨迹的副本，因此prompt安全后随机采样足以保留模型所需的足够副本。
AI.result: 在四个模型和六个推理任务上，Random Attention与最强的先验驱逐器性能持平，同时相比最强基线可实现32-43%更高的吞吐量（vLLM部署场景下）。受控实验证实了推理轨迹的两层冗余机制，解释了为何无需打分即可实现同等效果。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存压缩中复杂的评分选择机制是不必要的——保留prompt后，均匀随机驱逐即可达到与最先进打分方法相同的性能，且因节省计算开销而获得显著的吞吐量提升。该发现挑战了现有KV压缩的范式，揭示了推理过程中缓存内在冗余的结构性特征。

title: It's the Problem, Not the Path: Budget and Difficulty Confounds in LLM Reasoning Trajectories
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Also available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22261107. Code and pre-registered protocols: https://github.com/bulutyigit/problem-not-path
summary: Reasoning traces of large language models are widely read as containing "breakthrough" moments and early-legible fates. Both readings rest on measurements missing a counterfactual control at the level of the claim; we supply both controls. First, a restart-controlled truncation probe separates when a solution fits the continuation budget from when a prefix carries value that fresh computation cannot buy, comparing per-anchor continuation solve rates against from-scratch restart curves at matched total generated-token budget. Applied to 178 problem-model cells (89 MATH problems x two small open models, an outcome-blind but difficulty-targeted cohort), exactly 1 of 178 cells survives as prefix-limited; restart dose-response separates a compute-starved model from a capability-limited one; and wherever the matched budget lies inside the restart grid, continuing the model's own prefix beats restarting (9 of 9) -- predominantly compute compression rather than expanded reachability. Second, a pre-registered, difficulty-controlled test finds no detectable outcome information in early-window internal signals beyond a problem-difficulty baseline, and two generation-free analyses of public corpora show why this control is needed: a trace-blind difficulty proxy reaches AUROC 0.873 on 192K DeepSeek-R1 generations -- inside the published probe range -- and a closely matched reconstruction of the closest published early-window positive recovers a comparable pooled result (0.849) while within problem it is statistically indistinguishable from chance at all ten anchors (0.496 at t=4); a post-hoc within-targeted probe finds only a small average residual, concentrated in three low-failure problems. High pooled probe AUROCs cannot by themselves establish within-attempt information; a question-only baseline or within-problem evaluation is required.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过引入反事实对照，质疑了大语言模型推理轨迹中"突破时刻"和"早期注定成败"这两种常见解读。文章提供了两类对照实验：(1) 重启控制的截断探针，区分"续写预算范围内可解"与"前缀具有无法通过全新计算获得的价值"，在178个"问题-模型"单元中仅1个单元表现出前缀限制性；(2) 预注册的难度控制测试发现早期窗口内部信号不包含超出题目难度基线的结果信息，并指出已有文献中高池化AUC并不能单独证明尝试内信息的存在。
AI.motivation: 现有关于大语言模型推理轨迹的研究普遍将推理链中读到的"突破时刻"或早期线索解读为模型推理真实过程的心智证据，但这些解读依赖的测量缺少在"断言/主张"层面的反事实控制——即没有区分"前缀本身携带的信息"与"问题难度等混淆变量带来的虚假信号"。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 重启控制的截断探针：比较每个锚点上继续模型自身前缀的解答率与在匹配的总生成token预算下从头开始重跑的曲线，从而区分前缀限制性与计算限制性；(2) 预注册、难度控制的事前测试：检验早期窗口内部信号是否包含超出题目难度基线的结果信息，辅以两个不依赖生成的分析（trace-blind难度代理与对已发表早期窗口报告的紧密重建）验证控制变量的必要性。
AI.result: 在178个"问题-模型"单元中仅1个单元通过前缀限制性检验；重启剂量-反应可将计算资源不足的模型与能力受限的模型区分开来；在9个匹配预算落在重启网格内部的单元中，继续自身前缀均优于重启，主要体现为计算压缩而非扩展的可达性。预先登记测试发现早期信号无法超越难度基线；对公开语料的重建分析显示trace-blind难度代理AUC达0.873（落在已发表范围），紧密重建的最接近发表结果池化AUC为0.849但在问题内部与机会水平无显著差异（t=4时为0.496），事后定向探针仅发现集中于少量低失败率问题的微弱残余信号。
AI.conclusion: 高池化探针AUC本身不能建立尝试内信息的存在；必须引入仅含问题的基线或进行问题内部评估。该研究对现有"突破时刻"叙事提出系统性质疑，认为多数看似有价值的推理前缀本质上是计算压缩而非扩展了可达性，且早期内部信号在很大程度上可归因于问题难度等混淆因素。

title: Xiaomi-TabLDM: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
summary:
We introduce Xiaomi-TabLDM, a tabular large data foundation model for classification and regression via in-context learning, which delivers superior prediction accuracy without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data generated from structural causal models (SCMs), our model enables more flexible context utilization and more efficient capacity scaling.
  i) A new performance standard. Strong regression performance across benchmarks: Xiaomi-TabLDM ranks 1st on OpenML-CTR23 and 2nd on regression across TALENT, TabArena, and BCCO, demonstrating consistently strong regression performance across four complementary benchmark suites. Favorable performance--efficiency trade-off: Xiaomi-TabLDM combines strong predictive performance with substantially lower computational cost. For example, on TabArena regression, it achieves the second-highest Elo while using 82% less training time and 68% less prediction time than the top-ranked TabFM.
  ii) Large-scale synthetic pretraining. Xiaomi-TabLDM expands the coverage and diversity of synthetic tabular data used for pretraining. We also adopt a three-stage training strategy together with dual-stream feature grouping, lightweight Attention Residual, and sparse Mixture-of-Experts, enabling Xiaomi-TabLDM to learn richer feature interactions and expert specialization across diverse tabular tasks.
  iii) Test-time scaling. Xiaomi-TabLDM further extends tabular prediction through test-time compute scaling, where allocating additional computation at inference time consistently improves predictive performance over the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Xiaomi-TabLDM，一个基于合成数据预训练的表格大型基础模型，通过上下文学习实现分类与回归任务，无需任务特定微调，在多个基准上取得领先的回归性能，同时具备显著的计算效率优势，并支持测试时计算扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有表格预测模型通常需要任务特定的微调，计算成本高昂且难以高效扩展容量；此外，预训练所用合成数据的覆盖度和多样性有限，限制了模型学习丰富特征交互与专家特化的能力。本文旨在构建一个无需微调、支持高效上下文学习且计算代价更低的表格大模型。
AI.method: Xiaomi-TabLDM 采用结构因果模型（SCMs）生成大规模多样化合成数据进行预训练；采用三阶段训练策略结合双流特征分组、轻量级注意力残差模块和稀疏混合专家（MoE）架构，以增强特征交互学习与专家特化能力；此外引入测试时计算扩展机制，通过推理时分配额外计算持续提升预测性能。
AI.result: 在 OpenML-CTR23 排名第1，在 TALENT、TabArena 和 BCCO 回归任务中排名第2；在 TabArena 回归上达到第二高 Elo，同时比排名第一的 TabFM 减少82%的训练时间和68%的预测时间；测试时计算扩展在多个基准上一致超越基础模型。
AI.conclusion: Xiaomi-TabLDM 在预测精度与计算效率之间实现了有利的权衡，证明了大规模合成预训练与测试时扩展是构建通用表格基础模型的有效路径。

title: Drive-HWM: Hierarchical World Models for Dynamic-Latent Guided Autonomous Driving
summary: World models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by predicting how traffic scenes may evolve and using such predictions to support action generation. However, existing approaches either separate future prediction from action generation or jointly predict them at the same temporal scale, making it difficult to simultaneously achieve long-horizon anticipation and responsive, observation-grounded decision making. We present Drive-HWM, a hierarchical slow--fast world modeling framework that organizes future representation prediction and action generation at complementary temporal scales. The slow world model predicts multi-step future representations to capture extended scene evolution. To explicitly model the abundant motion dynamics in driving environments, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Latents learned through optical-flow prediction. Guided by these future representations, the fast model uses a lightweight multimodal backbone and an autoregressive expert to jointly predict the next frame and the immediate action from the latest observation. Next-frame prediction encourages the fast model to capture imminent scene evolution, while one-step action generation allows decisions to be continuously updated as new observations arrive. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v1 and v2 demonstrate the strong driving performance of Drive-HWM. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the hierarchical slow--fast design, dynamics-aware future representations, and joint next-frame and action prediction.

AI.tldr: Drive-HWM是一个用于自动驾驶的分层慢-快世界建模框架，通过在不同时间尺度上组织未来表征预测和动作生成，同时实现了长时程预见和基于观测的即时决策，在NAVSIM v1和v2上展现出优异的驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界模型要么将未来预测与动作生成分离，要么在相同时间尺度上联合进行，难以同时实现长时程预见（需要更大的时间跨度）和响应式、基于观测的即时决策（需要更快的时间粒度）。
AI.method: Drive-HWM包含两个核心组件：(1) 慢世界模型：预测多步未来表征以捕捉扩展的场景演化，并引入通过光流预测学习的动态感知潜变量（Dynamic-Aware Latents）来显式建模驾驶环境中的丰富运动动态；(2) 快模型：受未来表征引导，使用轻量级多模态主干网络和自回归专家联合预测下一帧和即时动作，其中下一帧预测帮助捕捉即将发生的场景演化，单步动作生成允许随新观测到达而持续更新决策。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2上的大量实验证明了Drive-HWM的强驾驶性能，全面的消融研究验证了分层慢-快设计、动态感知未来表征以及联合下一帧与动作预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分层慢-快世界建模通过在不同时间尺度上解耦未来表征预测与动作生成，能够同时兼顾长时程场景演化的预见能力和即时响应的决策能力，是自动驾驶世界模型的一种有效设计范式。

title: Decoupled Analysis-Judging: An Automated Creativity Evaluator Using LLMs in Complex Multi-step Creativity Tasks
summary: Automated evaluation of creativity tasks remains challenging for LLM-as-a-Judge, as LLM is susceptible to biases such as verbosity bias and leniency bias. Such limitations are particularly evident in Contextually-Grounded and Procedurally-Structured Tasks (CGPST), a complex multi-step creativity task where inter-step dependencies, highly subjectivity, and wide scoring ranges lead to more unstable and biased judgments. Existing approaches either rely on task-specific training or directly apply LLM-as-a-Judge, both of which struggle to ensure reliable evaluation under such complexity. To bridge these gaps, we propose CreaEval, an automated creativity evaluator for CGPST that decouples typical LLM-as-a-Judge into analysis and judging. Correspondingly, CreaEval involves two critical phases: Memory-augmented Analysis, a SoT-LLM converts multi-step responses into structured evaluation evidence, incorporating cross-step memory; and Evidence-based Judging, a Judge-LLM uses the extracted evidence for judging without accessing raw responses. Comprehensive experiments show that CreaEval achieves an average performance improvement of 22.74% over the second-best baselines across CGPST and two classic simple creativity tasks, demonstrating its generalizability. The code is available at https://github.com/Jaong/CreaEval.

AI.tldr: 提出CreaEval，一种面向复杂多步创意任务（CGPST）的自动评估系统，通过将LLM-as-a-Judge解耦为记忆增强分析和基于证据的评判两个阶段，解决直接使用LLM判定时的偏见与不稳定问题，在实验中较次优基线平均提升22.74%。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge在创意任务评估中易受冗长偏差和宽松偏差影响，尤其在上下文扎根且程序化结构的复杂多步创意任务（CGPST）中，由于步骤间强依赖、主观性高、评分范围宽，现有方法（任务特定训练或直接LLM评判）均难以保证评估的可靠性和稳定性。
AI.method: CreaEval将典型的LLM-as-a-Judge解耦为两个阶段：（1）记忆增强分析阶段——使用SoT-LLM将多步应答转化为结构化评估证据，并整合跨步骤记忆；（2）基于证据的评判阶段——Judge-LLM仅基于提取的证据进行判定，不直接访问原始应答，从而减少偏差干扰。
AI.result: 在CGPST及两种经典简单创意任务上的综合实验中，CreaEval较次优基线取得了平均22.74%的性能提升，并展现出良好的泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: CreaEval通过解耦分析与评判、引入跨步记忆的证据提取机制，有效缓解了LLM-as-a-Judge在复杂创意任务中的偏差问题，为可靠自动化创意评估提供了一种通用且可迁移的解决方案。

title: Guide, Not Bind: Why Defeasible Priors Fail in Augmented Lagrangian Causal Discovery
summary: Differentiable causal discovery methods increasingly encode expert priors as forbidden-edge constraints enforced by an Augmented Lagrangian (ALM) penalty, on the assumption that a data-adaptive relaxation mechanism will discount and eventually override a rule the data consistently contradicts. We show this design, which we call \emph{guide, not bind}, fails for two independent, precisely characterized reasons, and that directly repairing both restores it only partially. First, sequential penalty-ramping ALM suppresses a wrongly-forbidden true edge before any counterfactual check can detect it: we give three necessary conditions any adaptive relaxation must satisfy to avoid this (Proposition~\ref{prop:conditions}), prove that DADU---the natural relaxation rule this paper introduces as the object of study---violates all three (Corollary~\ref{cor:dadu_failure}), and confirm the failure across 3{,}072 training runs spanning graphs from 4 to 32 nodes, where a single wrong prior suppresses a true edge in 87--97\% of trials under DADU. Second, and independent of any fix to the mechanism, we prove in closed form that the standard correlation-matching objective ties a true edge and its reverse to an identical cost of exactly $2r^2$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:tie}), not because the underlying equal-variance model is unidentifiable, but because normalizing to correlation discards exactly the variance information that would make it identifiable; covariance matching instead separates the two directions by a provable margin of at least $w_0^4$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:separation}).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了可微因果发现方法中"引导而非约束"（guide, not bind）的专家先验编码机制的双重失败：DAU自适应松弛规则在惩罚逐步提升过程中会先于任何反事实检验抑制错误的真边，且无论机制如何修复，标准化相关性匹配目标在数学上无法区分因果方向（成本恒定为2r²），而协方差匹配则可提供至少w₀⁴的可证明分离边界。
AI.motivation: 可微因果发现方法广泛使用增广拉格朗日惩罚将专家先验以禁止边约束形式编码，假设数据自适应的松弛机制会折扣并最终覆盖与被数据持续矛盾的规则。作者希望验证这一设计假设是否成立，并为自适应松弛机制提供理论依据。
AI.method: 通过理论分析提出自适应松弛必须满足的三个必要条件（命题）；对DEU规则给出违反三个条件的推论证明；进行3,072次跨4至32节点图的训练实验验证失败；通过引理证明标准化相关性匹配目标在因果方向上存在精确的成本捆绑（2r²），并证明协方差匹配能提供至少w₀⁴的方向分离边界。
AI.result: 在DEU规则下，单个错误先验在87-97%的试验中抑制了真实边；证明了相关匹配目标下真边与其反向绑定相同成本2r²的封闭形式结论；协方差匹配则能以至少w₀⁴的余量分离两个方向。
AI.conclusion: "引导而非约束"设计在可微因果发现中根本性失败：一是惩罚顺序机制导致错误约束先于检验生效，二是相关匹配标准化丢弃了方向可识别所需的关键方差信息。修复机制只能部分恢复，因为第二个问题独立于机制存在，必须转向协方差匹配等保留方差信息的目标函数。

title: GraFT: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via 3D Scene Graphs
summary: 3D spatial reasoning underpins understanding and acting in the physical world, yet it remains unreliable in current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). These models falter at precise geometric measurement, at transforming between egocentric and allocentric viewpoints, and at grounding fine-grained appearance. The most common remedies fine-tune the model on large-scale curated spatial-reasoning datasets or attach dedicated encoders for 3D geometry, which typically couples the solution to costly supervision and a specific backbone. We instead introduce GraFT, a training-free framework that supplies the missing 3D structure through a compact, easily maintained 3D scene graph (3DSG). From this 3DSG, GraFT provides three spatial reasoning capabilities: (1) deterministic geometry through symbolic tools, (2) allocentric layout through a bird's-eye-view (BEV) rendering, and (3) visual-attribute grounding through task-relevant egocentric frames. On ScanQA, GraFT improves every metric over the same-backbone baseline, raising CIDEr by 27%. On VSI-Bench, GraFT improves frozen MLLMs by up to 65%, surpassing every proprietary and general-purpose open-source baseline, and several prominent fine-tuned spatial models.

AI.tldr: GraFT是一个无需训练（training-free）的框架，通过紧凑且易维护的3D场景图（3DSG）为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）补充缺失的3D结构信息，提供几何确定性、鸟瞰图布局和视觉属性定位三种空间推理能力，显著提升空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在3D空间推理上不可靠，尤其在精确几何测量、自我中心与异中心视角转换以及细粒度外观定位方面表现不佳。现有的解决方案（如大规模数据微调或专用3D编码器）通常依赖昂贵的监督信号和特定骨干网络，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: GraFT引入了一个训练自由的框架，通过紧凑且易维护的3D场景图（3DSG）提供缺失的3D结构信息。框架包含三个核心能力：(1) 通过符号工具实现确定性几何计算；(2) 通过鸟瞰图（BEV）渲染提供异中心布局；(3) 通过任务相关的自我中心帧实现视觉属性定位。该框架无需微调，可适配冻结的MLLM骨干。
AI.result: 在ScanQA数据集上，GraFT在相同骨干网络下全面超越基线，CIDEr提升27%。在VSI-Bench数据集上，GraFT使冻结的MLLM性能提升最高达65%，超越所有专有和通用开源基线，并超过多个著名的微调空间模型。
AI.conclusion: GraFT证明了一种无需训练、不依赖特定骨干的空间推理增强范式，通过外部3D场景图提供的结构化信息，能够以低成本显著提升MLLM的空间推理能力，甚至在多个基准上超越需要昂贵微调的专用模型。

title: Text2Thermal: Physics-Aware Thermal Image Synthesis from Textual Priors
summary: Thermal infrared imaging offers reliable perception in darkness and adverse weather, but thermal datasets remain scarce, motivating extensive work on translating abundant RGB images into thermal. Such translation is fundamentally ill-posed as thermal appearance is governed by surface emissivity and object temperature, neither of which is observable in the visible spectrum, so a single RGB image is consistent with many valid thermal outputs. We argue that language offers a natural means of resolving this ambiguity, and propose Text2Thermal, a framework for physics-aware thermal image synthesis from textual priors. Rather than inferring the unobservable radiometric factors from RGB, we supply them explicitly through thermally grounded captions encoding material, weather, time-of-day, and heat-emission state, and adapt a pretrained Stable Diffusion backbone to the thermal domain. Because the radiometric content is determined entirely by the prompt, Text2Thermal synthesizes thermal imagery without requiring a registered RGB image at inference; where spatial guidance is desired, an optional control signal imparts scene geometry without disturbing the prompt-specified radiometry. Experiments on M3FD, FLIR, and FMB show that Text2Thermal achieves state-of-the-art FID among thermal image synthesis methods while offering text-level control that translation-based approaches cannot provide.

AI.tldr: 提出Text2Thermal框架，利用文本先验（材料、天气、时段、热发射状态）进行物理感知的热红外图像合成，无需配准RGB图像即可生成高质量热图像，并支持文本级控制与可选的几何引导。
AI.motivation: 热红外数据集稀缺，现有工作多将丰富的RGB图像翻译为热图像。然而这种翻译本质上是病态的——热外观由表面发射率和物体温度决定，而这些辐射参数在可见光谱中不可观测，单一RGB图像对应多种合法的热输出，存在根本性的歧义问题。
AI.method: 提出语言可作为解决热图像合成歧义的自然手段。通过热学标注的文本（编码材料、天气、时段和热发射状态）显式提供辐射信息，而非从RGB推断不可观测的辐射因子；将预训练的Stable Diffusion主干适配到热域。由于辐射内容完全由提示词决定，推理时无需配准RGB图像；若需空间引导，可选的control信号在不干扰提示指定辐射学的前提下注入场景几何信息。
AI.result: 在M3FD、FLIR和FMB数据集上，Text2Thermal在热图像合成方法中取得了最先进的FID（Fréchet Inception Distance），并提供了基于文本的控制能力，这是传统的RGB-to-Thermal翻译方法所不具备的。
AI.conclusion: 显式语言先验能够有效解决RGB到热图像翻译中的固有歧义问题，实现无需配准RGB输入的物理感知热图像合成，并在生成质量和可控性上超越现有翻译方法。

title: When Retrieval Helps: Selective Retrieval for Single-Turn Mental-Health QA
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Presented at the KDD 2026 Undergraduate Consortium
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve the specificity and grounding of large language model responses, but its effect is not uniformly beneficial in single-turn mental-health question answering, where user queries often combine emotional distress, treatment concerns, and safety-sensitive needs. We study when retrieval helps or hurts mental-health QA, and whether a lightweight selective retrieval policy can better control this trade-off. We operationalize retrieval need using three draft-conditioned utility dimensions: psychoeducational need, coping need, and response specificity, together with a rule-based safety trigger. Following psychotherapy-grounded RAG systems such as coTherapist, we construct a compact and controllable guideline corpus comprising coping-strategy, psychoeducational, and safety resources. We fine-tune an instruction-tuned generator on MentalChat16K using QLoRA and compare Closed-book, Always Retrieval, and Selective Retrieval settings on CounselBench-Eval and CounselBench-Adv. Experiments show that retrieval is not uniformly beneficial in this domain. Always Retrieval improves specificity but lowers overall quality and introduces additional safety-sensitive failures. Selective Retrieval preserves closed-book behavior for low-need cases while avoiding the additional degradation caused by unconditional retrieval, supporting the view that retrieval activation is a safety-sensitive control decision.

title: Beyond Straightness: Non-Crossing Flow Matching via Quantile AlignTree Coupling
summary: The performance of Flow Matching largely depends on the quality of the coupling between the source and target distributions. However, independent coupling often leads to path crossings and local velocity ambiguity, while OT-based couplings typically incur high construction costs. To address this challenge, we propose Quantile AlignTree Flow Matching (QAT-FM), an efficient structured coupling strategy that constructs a hierarchical coupling between a Gaussian prior and the target data distribution via a quantile-aligned tree structure. QAT-FM constructs the coupling in $\mathcal{O}(Nd\log N)$ time and supports per-pair source sampling with $\mathcal{O}(d)$ complexity, enabling scalable training for large-scale high-dimensional generative tasks. Theoretically, we prove that the QAT coupling satisfies marginal consistency, induces non-crossing linear interpolation paths, and consistently improves path separation at intermediate times compared with independent coupling, thereby alleviating local velocity ambiguity. QAT-FM further extends naturally to conditional generation, enabling structured conditional coupling while preserving global Gaussian alignment. Experiments across diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that QAT-FM achieves competitive generative performance while substantially reducing coupling construction cost.

AI.tldr: 提出QAT-FM，一种基于分位数对齐树结构的Flow Matching耦合策略，通过层次化树结构构建高斯先验与目标分布之间的耦合，以O(Nd log N)时间完成耦合构建并支持O(d)的逐对采样，在理论上证明其边际一致性、无交叉路径和更好的中间时刻路径分离性，实验表明在降低耦合成本的同时保持有竞争力的生成性能。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching的性能高度依赖于源分布与目标分布之间耦合的质量。独立耦合常导致传输路径交叉和局部速度模糊性问题，而基于最优传输（OT）的耦合虽然能改善这些问题，但构建成本高昂。因此需要一种既能提供高质量结构化耦合、又保持计算效率的耦合策略。
AI.method: QAT-FM通过分位数对齐的树结构（quantile-aligned tree structure）在高斯先验与目标数据分布之间构建层次化耦合。该方法以O(Nd log N)时间构建耦合，并支持每对源样本以O(d)复杂度采样。方法还自然扩展到条件生成场景，在保持全局高斯对齐的同时实现结构化条件耦合。
AI.result: 在理论上证明QAT耦合满足边际一致性、诱导非交叉的线性插值路径，并在中间时刻相较于独立耦合持续改善路径分离度，从而缓解局部速度模糊性。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，QAT-FM在显著降低耦合构建成本的同时取得了有竞争力的生成性能。
AI.conclusion: QAT-FM提供了一种兼具效率与质量的结构化耦合方案，有效权衡了独立耦合的低成本低质量与OT耦合的高质量高成本之间的矛盾，为大规模高维生成任务提供了一种可扩展的训练方案。

title: Lose the Order, Keep the Hierarchy: Deordering HTN Plans
summary: Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning is a powerful planning formalism based on task decomposition. Although most of the literature studied plan generation, comparatively less attention has been paid to post-plan optimization. In particular, plan deordering has been extensively studied in classical planning but remains under-researched in the HTN setting. Plan deordering removes unnecessary ordering constraints between actions in a plan whilst keeping the plan valid. In this paper, we adapt two established plan deordering techniques from classical planning by extending the techniques to account for hierarchical decomposition constraints. We evaluate our proposed approaches on the IPC 2023 Partial-Order HTN benchmarks and we compare them against Optiplan, an HTN planner that generates partially ordered plans directly. Our results show a substantial reduction in number of ordering constraints in both our implementations. Although we also observe a reduction in critical path length, the improvements are less pronounced.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了HTN规划中的计划去序问题（plan deordering），将经典规划中的两种去序技术扩展到层次化分解约束场景下，并在IPC 2023 Part-Order HTN基准上与Optiplan规划器对比，结果表明两种方法均大幅减少了顺序约束数量，但在关键路径长度上的改善相对有限。
AI.motivation: HTN规划是强大的基于任务分解的规划形式体系，但现有研究多关注规划生成（plan generation），对计划后优化（post-plan optimization）关注不足。经典规划中的计划去序已被深入研究，但在HTN场景中仍缺乏探索。去序可以移除计划中不必要的动作间顺序约束，同时保持计划有效，有助于提升计划的并行性和灵活性。
AI.method: 从经典规划中借鉴两种成熟的计划去序技术，并将其扩展以考虑HTN中的层次化分解约束（hierarchical decomposition constraints）。将改进后的方法应用于HTN规划生成的计划，去除其中冗余的顺序约束。
AI.result: 在IPC 2023 Partial-Order HTN基准上与直接生成偏序计划的Optiplan规划器进行对比。两种去序实现在顺序约束数量上均有大幅减少；虽然关键路径长度（critical path length）也有减少，但改善幅度相对较小。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明经典规划中的去序技术可以被成功扩展到HTN领域并带来显著的顺序约束削减，但关键路径长度的优化仍有进一步改善空间，可视为后续工作方向。

title: Catalogue Photography as a Cold Start: Toward Deployable Carbide Burr Recognition
comment: Extended abstract not yet published to a conference or journal
summary: Verifying that manufactured batches of milling tools or carbide rotary burrs conform to production order sheets remains a largely manual and error-prone quality assurance task. Automating this process with computer vision faces a critical cold-start constraint since no labelled imagery is available, leaving manufacturer catalogue photography as the sole source of supervision. We investigate how far catalogue supervision can support an industrial recognition pipeline under domain shift, explicitly measuring the gap between catalogue separability and performance on held-out field photographs. Our findings reveal three key insights. First, off-the-shelf frozen feature extractors do not reliably separate the two task attributes, head shape and tooth profile, motivating targeted representation learning. Second, metric learning produces near-perfect unsupervised cluster discovery on catalogue images (adjusted Rand index 0.94--0.97), but less than half of this gain transfers to field photographs. Third, the largest transfer gains do not come from model scale or representation complexity, but from simple changes that reduce domain sensitivity: converting images to grayscale (+0.22) and constraining retrieval using the known order sheet via Hungarian assignment (+0.11). We therefore treat catalogue photography as a useful cold start rather than a deployment-ready training domain, and provide empirical baselines and an evaluation protocol for catalogue-to-field transfer in precision tool manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在无标注现场图像的情况下，如何利用制造商目录照片作为唯一监督源来训练硬质合金旋转锉/铣刀的工业视觉识别系统。实验表明目录照片可作为有效冷启动，但其域迁移增益有限；最大增益来自灰度化转换和基于订单表的匈牙利匹配约束等降低域敏感性的简单手段。
AI.motivation: 铣刀/硬质合金旋转锉批次制造中的质量验证（核对生产订单表）仍依赖手工且易出错。自动化视觉识别面临冷启动难题：无标注现场图像可用，制造商目录照片是唯一的监督来源。作者旨在量化目录监督在域偏移下能对工业识别管线提供多大支持。
AI.method: 研究了三类问题：(1) 评估现成冻结特征提取器对头部形状和齿形两个任务属性的分离能力；(2) 使用度量学习（metric learning）在目录图像上进行无监督聚类，并测量其向现场照片的迁移率；(3) 系统比较不同策略的迁移增益，包括模型规模、表示复杂度、灰度化预处理以及基于订单表的匈牙利指派约束检索。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：(1) 现成冻结特征提取器无法可靠分离两个任务属性，需定向表示学习；(2) 度量学习在目录图像上达到近乎完美的无监督聚类发现（ARI 0.94-0.97），但不足一半增益能迁移到现场照片；(3) 最大的迁移增益并非来自模型规模或表示复杂度，而是来自降低域敏感性的简单改动：灰度化（+0.22）和匈牙利指派约束检索（+0.11）。
AI.conclusion: 作者将目录照片视为有效的冷启动而非可直接部署的训练域，并为精密刀具制造中的目录到现场迁移提供了经验基线和评估协议。

title: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increas- ingly deployed as long-horizon conversational agents, motivating growing interest in mem- ory systems. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate memory through QA-style probing rather than in-situ conversational usage. We introduce LOCOMO-CONV, a conversa- tional memory benchmark derived from Lo- CoMo with four query styles: dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed. Across five rep- resentative memory systems, we evaluate both retrieval recall and end-to-end response qual- ity. Our experiments show that conversational framing exposes substantial retrieval gaps over- looked by QA benchmarks, especially on im- plicit and composed queries, which multi-facet query rewriting narrows for raw-turn mem- ory but not abstractive memory. We further find that strong retrieval does not fully trans- late into response quality, and that implicit queries exhibit silent grounding, where mem- ory improves contextual grounding without ex- plicitly surfacing the gold fact. These results point to reasoning-based memory elaboration as a promising direction, and we release aux- iliary supportive_memory annotations captur- ing conversationally useful context beyond the original gold evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出了LOCOMO-CONV，一个基于LoCoMo衍生出的对话式记忆基准，包含四种查询风格（对话、隐式、反事实、组合式），在五种代表性记忆系统上评估检索召回和端到端响应质量，发现对话框架暴露了QA基准遗漏的检索差距，并指出基于推理的记忆细化是未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准主要通过QA式探针评估记忆能力，而非真实对话场景中的使用情况，这可能导致对LLM长时对话记忆系统能力的误判。
AI.method: 从LoCoMo衍生出LOCOMO-CONV基准，包含四种查询风格（对话、隐式、反事实、组合式）；在五种代表性记忆系统上评估检索召回与端到端响应质量；分析对话框架下的检索差距、查询重写影响、检索与响应质量的关系，以及隐式查询中的静默接地现象；释放辅助supportive_memory标注。
AI.result: 对话式框架暴露了QA基准遗漏的显著检索差距，尤其在隐式和组合式查询上；多面查询重写能缩小原始轮次记忆的差距但对抽象记忆无效；强检索并未完全转化为响应质量提升；隐式查询存在静默接地现象（记忆改善上下文接地但未显式呈现黄金事实）。
AI.conclusion: 基于推理的记忆细化（reasoning-based memory elaboration）是值得探索的 promising 方向，相关工作已发布supportive_memory标注资源以捕捉黄金证据之外对对话有用的上下文。

title: A Two-Stage Forecasting System for CPU Workload Prediction in Private Clouds
summary: Accurate cloud resource forecasting is essential for proactive resource provisioning, maintaining Quality of Service (QoS), and reducing operational costs in dynamic cloud environments. The existing forecasting approaches predominantly estimate future CPU workload directly from historical resource traces, which often overlook the relationship between customer service demand and subsequent resource consumption. This study proposes a two-stage integrated forecasting model that explicitly models this dependency by first forecasting customer service requests, expressed as Transactions Per Second (TPS), and subsequently estimating future CPU workload from the TPS forecast. Both the forecasting component and resource prediction component employed the XGBoost model within a cascaded learning architecture, complemented by adaptive online retraining using an expanding-window strategy to address concept drift in continuously evolving cloud workloads. The proposed work was evaluated using real-world traces collected from a private cloud environment comprising ten applications. Experimental results demonstrate robust forecasting performance by achieving Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE) below $7\%$ for most applications, with the best-performing application achieving an MAE of $0.7372$, RMSE of $1.1866$, SMAPE of $3.57\%$, and an R2 of $0.9185$. Horizon-wise drift analysis confirmed stable recursive forecasting behavior with controlled error accumulation across a 60-step prediction horizon. Compared with the conventional direct CPU forecasting method, the proposed two-stage integrated model gives improved forecasting robustness, computational efficiency, and interpretability, making it well-suited for proactive resource management and intelligent auto-scaling in cloud computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段集成云资源预测模型，先预测客户服务请求（TPS），再基于TPS预测结果估计CPU负载，采用XGBoost级联学习架构及自适应在线重训练（扩展窗口策略）应对概念漂移。在私有云十应用真实数据集上验证，SMAPE低于7%，最佳MAE为0.7372、RMSE为1.1866、SMAPE为3.57%、R²为0.9185，且在60步预测范围内误差累积受控，优于传统直接CPU预测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有云资源预测方法大多直接从历史资源痕迹预测未来CPU负载，忽略了客户服务需求与后续资源消耗之间的依赖关系，导致预测精度和可解释性受限。
AI.method: 构建两阶段集成预测框架：第一阶段预测客户服务请求量（TPS），第二阶段基于TPS预测结果结合资源预测组件估计CPU工作量。两个组件均采用XGBoost模型，在级联学习架构中运行。同时引入基于扩展窗口策略的自适应在线重训练机制，以应对云负载持续演化带来的概念漂移。
AI.result: 使用私有云环境十个应用的真实轨迹进行实验评估。绝大多数应用SMAPE低于7%；最佳应用MAE为0.7372、RMSE为1.1866、SMAPE为3.57%、R²为0.9185。水平方向漂移分析表明在60步预测范围内具备稳定的递归预测行为和受控的误差累积。相比传统直接CPU预测，所提方法在预测鲁棒性、计算效率和可解释性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段集成预测模型显式建模了服务需求与资源消耗的因果关系，在预测精度、鲁棒性、效率与可解释性上均优于直接预测方法，适用于云环境的主动资源管理和智能自动伸缩场景。

title: Value-Preserving Architectures for Agentic AI Systems
comment: Accepted to AgenticDev Workshop at ASE 2026
summary: The emergence of agentic AI and LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) presents unprecedented opportunities for automating complex tasks, while simultaneously raising critical concerns about the preservation of fundamental human-centered values, such as privacy, fairness, and safety. Although software engineering has traditionally focused on functional correctness, the adoption of LLMs and AI agents into complex socio-technical systems has intensified the need for responsible software engineering and robust value alignment. In MAS, architectural design decisions, such as coordination mechanisms, communication protocols, and system topologies, play a central role in shaping system behavior and the outcomes they produce. This paper argues that architectural choices influence not only the functionality and performance of MAS but can also promote value-oriented system behavior. Therefore, we investigate how different architectural designs support different human-centered values, discussing the following value-preserving architectural patterns: (i) a privacy-aware architecture with a federated topology, (ii) a distributed architecture to promote pluralism and diversity, and (iii) a guard-agent architecture to detect and mitigate unfairness. Finally, we introduce representative use cases to illustrate the proposed architectures in real-world scenarios. By linking architectural design with human-centered values, this work lays the foundation for a unified set of architectural patterns and guidelines towards the design of trustworthy MAS.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）中，架构设计如何影响以人为中心的价值观（隐私、公平性、安全性），并提出三种价值保持的架构模式：联邦拓扑的隐私感知架构、分布式多样化架构和守护智能体公平性检测架构，旨在为可信MAS的设计奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 随着agentic AI和基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）被广泛用于自动化复杂任务，隐私、公平性和安全性等以人为中心的价值观面临严峻挑战。传统的软件工程仅关注功能正确性，而LLM和AI代理融入复杂社会技术系统后，迫切需要负责任的软件工程和稳健的价值对齐。架构设计决策（协调机制、通信协议、系统拓扑）是塑造系统行为的关键因素，但目前缺乏系统性地将架构设计与人类价值观相联系的框架。
AI.method: 本文采用论证与模式分析的方法：首先指出MAS的架构选择不仅影响功能与性能，还能促进面向价值的系统行为；随后提出并讨论三种具体的价值保持架构模式：(i)联邦拓扑的隐私感知架构，(ii)促进多元性与多样性的分布式架构，(iii)用于检测和缓解不公平性的守护智能体（guard-agent）架构；最后引入代表性用例在真实场景中说明所提出的架构。
AI.result: 文章提出了三种具体的价值保持架构模式，并通过代表性用例展示了这些架构在真实场景中的应用。结果表明，不同的架构设计能够支持不同的以人为中心的价值观，从而将架构设计与人类价值观系统地联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 通过将架构设计与以人为中心的价值观相联系，本文为可信MAS的设计奠定了统一的架构模式和指南的基础，推动了朝着可信赖多智能体系统设计的方向发展。

title: Subspace Inference Enables Efficient Active Reward Learning from Preferences
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a powerful yet sample-inefficient approach for learning reward models from human preferences, making active learning a critical component in synthesizing informative preference queries. However, effective uncertainty quantification required for active learning remains a key challenge for large neural network reward models. In this paper, we introduce PreferenceEKF, a sample-efficient approach that tracks reward model uncertainty by framing active preference learning as a sequential Bayesian filtering problem. Instead of relying on computationally prohibitive posterior inference over the full neural network parameter space, our method performs sequential inference via an extended Kalman filter within a low-dimensional parameter subspace, continuously updating the reward model posterior as new preference queries arrive. Our approach enables scalable sampling of neural network parameters to efficiently compute acquisition functions for active reward learning. Experiments on the D4RL and V-D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves better sample efficiency, runtime, scalability, and calibration compared to other Bayesian deep learning approaches, and the learned reward models lead to competitive offline reinforcement learning policy performance. This highlights the potential of scalable Bayesian methods for preference-based reward modeling in RLHF. Our code is available at https://github.com/yutaizhou/bnn_pref.

AI.tldr: 提出了PreferenceEKF，一种通过扩展卡尔曼滤波在低维参数子空间中进行顺序贝叶斯推断的方法，用于基于人类反馈的强化学习中的主动偏好学习。该方法在D4RL和V-D4RL基准上实现了更高的样本效率、更优的运行时间和更好的校准度。
AI.motivation: RLHF虽然强大但样本效率低，需要主动学习来合成信息丰富的偏好查询。然而，对于大型神经网络奖励模型，有效的不确定性量化（主动学习的关键）仍是一个主要挑战。
AI.method: 将主动偏好学习建模为顺序贝叶斯滤波问题，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器在低维参数子空间中进行顺序推断，避免了对整个神经网络参数空间进行计算上不可行的后验推断。该方法能够可扩展地对神经网络参数进行采样，以高效计算主动奖励学习的采集函数。
AI.result: 在D4RL和V-D4RL基准上，该方法相比其他贝叶斯深度学习方法在样本效率、运行时间、可扩展性和校准度上均表现更优，且学习到的奖励模型能够带来具有竞争力的离线强化学习策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的贝叶斯方法在RLHF中基于偏好的奖励建模具有巨大潜力，PreferenceEKF展示了通过贝叶斯滤波进行不确定性跟踪的有效性。

title: Auditing Patient Privacy in Medical Generative Models: Scalable Memorization Detection with DeepSSIM++
summary: While deep generative models offer new opportunities for medical image synthesis and data sharing, their ability to memorize and reproduce training samples raises serious concerns about patient confidentiality. Detecting such memorization at scale remains challenging: traditional pixel-based metrics are sensitive to generation artifacts, whereas generic embedding-based metrics often lack the anatomical sensitivity required for medical data. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSSIM++, a self-supervised similarity metric for scalable memorization auditing in medical generative models. By leveraging multi-scale feature aggregation and anatomy-preserving augmentations, DeepSSIM++ learns an embedding space where cosine similarity approximates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), eliminating the need for exact pixel-level registration. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, DeepSSIM++ achieves an average Macro F1 improvement of 33 percentage points under ideal alignment and 46 percentage points under realistic spatial and intensity perturbations. Furthermore, it accelerates large-scale similarity computation by several orders of magnitude compared with analytical SSIM. By combining anatomical sensitivity and computational efficiency, DeepSSIM++ provides an open-source tool for scalable memorization auditing in medical generative AI. Code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/brAIn-science/DeepSSIM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepSSIM++，一种自监督相似性度量方法，用于大规模审计医学生成模型中的训练样本记忆（memorization）问题。该方法通过多尺度特征聚合和解剖结构保持的数据增强，学习一个用余弦相似度逼近SSIM的嵌入空间，无需精确像素级配准。相比基线方法在理想对齐下Macro F1提升33个百分点，在真实空间和强度扰动下提升46个百分点，同时计算速度比解析SSIM快数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型在医学图像合成和数据共享方面提供新机会，但其记忆并重现训练样本的能力引发患者保密性的严重担忧。现有检测方法存在瓶颈：基于像素的指标对生成伪影敏感，而通用嵌入指标缺乏医学数据所需的解剖敏感性。因此需要一种既能保持解剖敏感性又具备计算效率的可扩展记忆审计方法。
AI.method: DeepSSIM++采用自监督学习框架，通过多尺度特征聚合与解剖结构保持的增强策略，学习一个嵌入空间，使得该空间中的余弦相似度能够近似替代SSIM。这种方法消除了对精确像素级配准的需求，从而支持大规模相似性计算。
AI.result: 与最先进基线相比，DeepSSIM++在理想对齐条件下Macro F1平均提升33个百分点，在真实的空间和强度扰动条件下提升46个百分点；与解析SSIM相比，大规模相似性计算加速数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: DeepSSIM++融合了解剖敏感性与计算效率，为医学生成式AI提供了可扩展的记忆审计开源工具，代码和数据已公开。

title: Pattern Over-Generalization of Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) demonstrates its effectiveness for predicting missing links in knowledge graphs (KGs) by projecting entities and relations into a low-dimensional vector space. It is crucial for KGE models to effectively capture inference patterns (patterns) inherent in KGs, such as symmetry/antisymmetry, inversion and composition. Although recent KGE models exhibit strong capabilities in modeling such diverse patterns, they suffer from inherent limitations stemming from pattern over-generalization, where embeddings learned from only a single pattern instance inevitably generalize that pattern to all related instances, i.e., generalize the pattern universally. To address this issue, we propose PogRE (Pattern Over-Generalization Robust Embedding), a simple but effective method that utilizes dense linear transformations and compound operations for relation representation. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that a dense linear transformation allows a pattern to become progressively universal as more triples are observed in the pattern. Furthermore, after observing d+1 linearly independent entities (d+1 denotes the dimension of entity), the linear transformation guarantees universal generalization of the pattern across all related instances. Experimental results on three standard benchmark datasets show that PogRE outperforms existing state-of-the-art KGE models in link prediction. Moreover, our empirical results indicate that PogRE effectively addresses the negative impact of over-generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出PogRE（Pattern Over-Generalization Robust Embedding）方法，利用稠密线性变换和复合运算表示关系，以缓解知识图谱嵌入中模式过度泛化问题（即仅从单个模式实例学习后将该模式普遍应用于所有相关实例）。理论分析和实验表明该方法优于现有SOTA KGE模型，在链接预测任务上表现更佳。
AI.motivation: 现有KGE模型虽然能建模对称/反对称、逆反、组合等多样推理模式，但存在模式过度泛化的固有限制——模型仅从单个模式实例中学到的嵌入会不可避免地将该模式推广到所有相关实例，即普遍化该模式，这种过度泛化会对知识图谱嵌入的准确性造成负面影响。
AI.method: 提出PogRE方法：利用稠密线性变换和复合运算进行关系表示。理论分析表明，稠密线性变换可以使模式随着观察到的三元组增多而逐步变得普遍化；当观察到d+1个线性无关的实体（d+1为实体维度）后，线性变换能够保证模式在所有相关实例上的普遍泛化。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准数据集上的实验表明，PogRE在链接预测任务上优于现有的SOTA KGE模型；实证结果进一步表明PogRE有效缓解了模式过度泛化带来的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过稠密线性变换与复合运算的巧妙设计，在理论层面刻画了模式普遍化的条件，并在实践中验证了该方法的有效性，为知识图谱嵌入中模式过度泛化问题提供了有效的解决思路。

title: Mind the Gap: Robustness Risks in PII Detection Systems
summary:
Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection is a foundational component of data protection infrastructure where missed entities constitute direct privacy and security risks. Although modern PII systems report strong performance on standard benchmarks, we show that these evaluations mask substantial robustness failures under realistic distribution shifts encountered in deployment. Rather than comparing state-of-the-art accuracy, we study how different PII detection paradigms fail under noisy, unstructured, and informal inputs. We construct a stress test benchmark spanning seven categories of natural distribution shift and evaluate representative systems from three widely deployed architectural families: encoder-based NER (SpaCy), rule-based hybrid detection (Presidio), and generative LLM extraction (Qwen2.5-3B).
  All three exhibit significant degradation on out-of-distribution inputs, but with distinct and complementary failure modes. Encoder models primarily fail on unseen surface forms and boundary detection, rule-based systems fail on non-standard formats, and LLMs exhibit entity-type confusion and generation instability. These results show that aggregate benchmark scores obscure deployment-critical weaknesses and that no single architecture is uniformly reliable across PII categories. Motivated by these findings, we propose a hybrid detection pipeline with a QA-driven feedback loop for iterative risk mitigation, and release our benchmark to support OOD-aware evaluation of PII systems.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前PII检测系统在标准基准上表现出色，但在真实部署中面对噪声、非结构化输入时会显著退化。作者构建了覆盖七种自然分布偏移的压力测试基准，评估了三种主流架构（SpaCy、Presidio、Qwen2.5-3B），发现三者有不同的互补性失败模式，并提出了带QA反馈循环的混合检测管线。
AI.motivation: 现有的PII检测系统在标准基准上报告强性能，但这些评估掩盖了部署中真实分布偏移下的稳健性缺陷。作者旨在研究不同PII检测范式在噪声、非结构化和非正式输入下如何失败，而非比较最先进的准确率。
AI.method: 构建覆盖七类自然分布偏移的压力测试基准，评估三类广泛部署的架构家族：基于编码器的NER（SpaCy）、基于规则的混合检测（Presidio）、以及生成式LLM提取（Qwen2.5-3B），分析其在分布外输入下的失败模式。
AI.result: 三种系统在分布外输入上均表现出显著退化，但失败模式互补：编码器模型主要失败于未见表面形式和边界检测，规则系统失败于非标准格式，LLM则表现出实体类型混淆和生成不稳定性。聚合基准分数掩盖了部署关键弱点，没有单一架构在所有PII类别上一致可靠。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种带有QA驱动反馈循环的混合检测管线用于迭代风险评估，并发布基准以支持对PII系统进行OOD感知评估。

title: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
summary: In online meeting delegation, LLM agents fail to recognize when to speak. With no structured way to track stances, coverage, and floor, they miss the moments where they should contribute. Prompt-only delegates stay silent on 51.4% of the absent participant's talking opportunities on the AMI corpus. We present CAPA (Collaborative Agent Predictive Architecture), an architecture for online meeting delegation. A Perceiver updates the meeting state from each observed turn. A Predictor forecasts how the conversation will continue. A Controller decides whether to speak and which proposition to surface. A Generator phrases the chosen contribution in the participant's style. Two judges score the forecast and the action against the next observed turn. A Recalibrator updates the meeting state from those verdicts for future decisions. To evaluate online delegation, we introduce an episode-level protocol that scores whether, when, and what a delegate contributes around the participant's actual idea units. The protocol's schema-constrained LLM judges align with human annotations at Cohen's kappa = 0.71. On 137 AMI meetings, CAPA reduces the silence rate from 51.4% to 2.5%, doubles credited recovery (26.1 --> 52.2), and keeps hallucination at 0.6%. The failure mode shifts from omission to selection, with each residual near-miss attributable to a specific module of the architecture. Mechanism ablations identify the meeting state as the lever that closes the recognition gap, where raw-context scaling alone does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPA（协作代理预测架构），用于解决在线会议委派中LLM代理无法识别发言时机的问题。核心思路是将发言决策分解为"状态更新-预测-决策-表达-评估-校准"的循环管线，通过显式的会议状态跟踪与会话预测机制，使代理能识别缺失参与者的发言机会并代其发言。在AMI语料库137场会议上，发言沉默率从51.4%降至2.5%，被认可的恢复翻倍（26.1→52.2），幻觉率保持在0.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有在线会议委派场景中，LLM代理缺乏结构化的方式跟踪立场（stances）、覆盖度（coverage）和发言权（floor），导致它们无法识别应该在何时发言。实验显示仅靠提示词的委派代理在AMI语料库上会错失缺失参与者51.4%的发言机会，说明纯语言提示无法弥合发言时机的识别缺口。
AI.method: CAPA架构由六个模块构成：Perceiver从每个观察到的轮次更新会议状态；Predictor预测会话将如何继续；Controller基于状态和预测决定是否发言以及呈现哪个命题；Generator以参与者的风格措辞表达所选贡献；两个裁判（judges）对预测和行动与下一个观察到的轮次进行打分；Recalibrator根据这些裁定更新会议状态以指导后续决策。评估方面，作者引入了一种事件级（episode-level）协议，评判代理围绕参与者实际观点单元所做的贡献的"是否、何时、什么"三个维度，并采用schema约束的LLM裁判进行评估。
AI.result: 在137场AMI会议上，CAPA将沉默率从51.4%降至2.5%，被认可的恢复从26.1提升至52.2（翻倍），幻觉率维持在0.6%。评估协议的schema约束LLM裁判与人类标注的一致性达到Cohen's kappa = 0.71。失败模式从遗漏转向选择问题，每个剩余的近失错误都可归因于架构中的特定模块。机制消融实验表明，会议状态模块是弥合识别缺口的关键杠杆，单纯扩展原始上下文（raw-context scaling）无法达到同样的效果。
AI.conclusion: CAPA通过将发言时机识别转化为显式的结构化管理任务，有效解决了在线会议委派中LLM代理的发言识别缺口。该工作不仅提出了一个工程架构，还建立了一套事件级评估协议来衡量委派代理"是否、何时、什么"三个层面的贡献质量。主要失败瓶颈已从遗漏（错过该发言的时机）转变为选择（在时机正确但选择了次优命题），为后续研究指明了更精细的优化方向。

title: Continuous Actions from Discrete Minds: Latent-Aligned Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Bridging the gap between the discrete reasoning of Vision-Language Models and the continuous, physics-constrained nature of autonomous driving remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce LaPla, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework featuring latent-aligned planning to seamlessly ground semantic understanding in precise motion execution. We first design an action tokenizer based on a residual vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE), capturing vehicle kinematics and encoding trajectory features into a structured latent space. Rather than discrete codebook lookups that inevitably introduce quantization errors, LaPla repurposes this representation as a physical prior to bridge the modality gap between high-dimensional semantics and the raw action space. Specifically, given multimodal inputs integrating multi-view images, historical actions, and textual instructions, LaPla incorporates concurrent action queries to causally attend to the multimodal context in a single forward pass, projecting hidden states directly into the pretrained VQ-VAE latent space. The frozen decoder then translates these continuous latents into actions, effectively eliminating quantization errors and ensuring physically plausible trajectories while bypassing time-consuming autoregressive generation. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that LaPla achieves competitive open-loop performance, reducing long-horizon L2 error by 15.52% compared to state-of-the-art VLA methods. Closed-loop evaluations on the NVIDIA AlpaSim simulator further confirm its superior capability in ensuring smooth driving progress, improving the success rate by 33.34 percentage points with significantly reduced inference latency.

AI.tldr: LaPla是一个统一的Vision-Language-Action(VLA)框架，通过潜在对齐规划（latent-aligned planning）弥合VLM离散推理与自动驾驶连续物理约束之间的差距。它采用基于残差VQ-VAE的动作分词器编码车辆运动学，但放弃离散码本查找（避免量化误差），而是将连续隐状态直接投影到预训练的VQ-VAE潜在空间中，由冻结解码器生成物理合理的轨迹。在nuScenes上长时程L2误差降低15.52%，在NVIDIA AlpaSim闭环评估中成功率提升33.34个百分点且推理延迟显著降低。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的离散推理模式与自动驾驶所需的连续、受物理约束的决策之间存在根本性的模态鸿沟。现有的VLA方法通常依赖离散码本查找将语义嵌入映射到动作空间，这会不可避免地引入量化误差，且生成过程需要耗时的自回归解码，难以满足自动驾驶对实时性和轨迹物理合理性（平滑性、可控性）的严格要求。
AI.method: LaPla包含两个关键设计：(1) 基于残差VQ-VAE的动作分词器，用于捕获车辆运动学并将轨迹特征编码到结构化的潜在空间中；(2) 潜在对齐规划机制——并非使用离散码本查找，而是将预训练的VQ-VAE表示的潜在空间作为物理先验（physical prior），通过输入多视角图像、历史动作和文本指令，在单次前向传播中引入并发动作查询（concurrent action queries）因果地关注多模态上下文，将隐藏状态直接投影到该潜在空间，再由冻结的解码器将连续潜在向量解码为动作，消除了量化误差并规避了自回归生成。
AI.result: 在nuScenes基准上的开环评估中，LaPla达到了具有竞争力的性能，长时程L2误差相比最先进的VLA方法降低了15.52%。在NVIDIA AlpaSim模拟器上的闭环评估中，成功率先提升了33.34个百分点，同时推理延迟显著降低，证明了其在确保平滑驾驶进程方面的优越能力。
AI.conclusion: LaPla通过创新地利用VQ-VAE潜在空间作为语义与动作之间的物理桥接管，成功实现了端到端单向传播的连续动作生成。这种"连续潜在对齐"策略既保留了VQ-VAE对物理轨迹的结构化表达能力，又消除了离散化带来的量化误差和生成延迟，为VLA框架在自动驾驶中的应用提供了新的范式。

title: EraseSAE: Surgical Concept Erasure in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Recent advances in text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable generative capabilities, yet their reliance on loosely curated training data raises pressing safety and copyright concerns. Concept erasure offers a principled remedy by removing unwanted semantics from pretrained models while preserving remaining concepts. However, existing approaches typically operate at a coarse granularity misaligned with the fine-grained, distributed nature of concept representations, leading to incomplete removal or degraded generation quality. We argue that surgical erasure fundamentally requires intervention at the level of monosemantic features, where each unit encodes a single interpretable concept. To this end, we propose EraseSAE, a novel framework that leverages sparse autoencoders to achieve surgical concept erasure in DiT-based T2V diffusion models via a principled decompose-attribute-erase pipeline. We first introduce the Partitioned Convolutional Sparse Autoencoder, which decomposes dense spatiotemporal activations into disentangled, interpretable sparse features while preserving spatiotemporal coherence. A contrastive attribution mechanism then contrasts activations from paired prompts to isolate concept-specific feature kernels. At inference, timestep-resolved spatiotemporal masks derived from the identified kernels confine erasure to regions where the target concept is active, leaving unrelated content intact. Extensive experiments across diverse diffusion models and concept erasure tasks demonstrate that EraseSAE achieves precise and robust concept removal with minimal quality degradation, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/HiDream-ai/EraseSAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EraseSAE框架，利用稀疏自编码器对基于DiT的文生视频扩散模型进行外科手术式的概念擦除。通过Partitioned Convolutional Sparse Autoencoder将稠密的时空激活解耦为可解释的稀疏特征，结合对比归因机制隔离概念特定特征核，并在推理时用时序分辨的时空掩码精准限制擦除区域，实现精确且鲁棒的概念去除。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V扩散模型因训练数据松散管理而存在安全和版权问题，概念擦除是解决手段，但现有方法操作粒度粗糙，与概念表示的细粒度、分布式特性不匹配，导致移除不彻底或生成质量下降。作者认为外科手术式的擦除需要从单语义特征层面进行干预。
AI.method: 提出EraseSAE框架，采用"分解-归因-擦除"管线：(1)引入Partitioned Convolutional Sparse Autoencoder将稠密时空激活分解为解耦的可解释稀疏特征，同时保持时空连贯性；(2)通过对比归因机制，用配对提示词的激活对比来隔离概念特定特征核；(3)推理时基于识别的特征核构建时序分辨的时空掩码，仅将擦除限制在目标概念活跃的区域。
AI.result: 在多种扩散模型和概念擦除任务上的大量实验表明，EraseSAE实现了精确且鲁棒的概念去除，且质量退化最小，显著优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 单语义特征层面的干预是实现精确概念擦除的关键，EraseSAE通过稀疏自编码与对比归因的结合，为基于DiT的T2V模型提供了有效的可解释概念擦除范式。

title: Building and Evaluating Fixed-Voice Thai TTS from Synthetic Speech
summary: In low-resource settings, deploying TTS typically requires choosing between a large voice-cloning model with costly inference or a compact fixed-voice system that requires a speaker-specific corpus. We study a third route: using a large voice-cloning model as a programmable data source to turn a short voice reference (e.g., 15 seconds) into a compact fixed-voice student trained entirely on synthetic speech. This setting makes pipeline design consequential: teacher errors become training targets, while filtering failed generations can reduce coverage of difficult texts. Thai further introduces challenges from ambiguous word boundaries, lexical tone, names and loanwords, numeric verbalization, and Thai-English code-switching. We study how text preparation, synthetic generation, quality filtering, rejection sampling, and frontend choices affect the resulting student, and where teacher limitations remain. We evaluate CER, Challenge-Set Keyword Accuracy, Prosody Pause Accuracy, speaker similarity, and speaking rate. The resulting 82M-parameter model, Wayu-Paxa-TTS-Edge, enables on-device Thai TTS without reference audio. It achieves 68.2% Challenge-Set Keyword Accuracy (85.5% of Gemini 3.1) and 91.4% pause precision, outperforming its OmniVoice teacher (89.9%) and reaching 94.8% of Gemini 3.1. It also achieves the lowest pause-placement error and intra-word pause rates among the three systems, and 3.7% and 1.1% CER on Thai and English, respectively. We open-source the model and evaluation framework for Thai TTS development.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了低资源场景下的第三条TTS路线：利用大型声音克隆模型作为可编程数据源，将15秒的声音参考转化为一个完全在合成语音上训练的紧凑固定声音学生模型。针对泰语特有的文字切分、声调、外来词、数字口语化及泰英代码转换等挑战，系统研究了文本准备、合成生成、质量过滤、拒绝采样和前端的pipeline设计影响，最终得到82M参数的Wayu-Paxa-TTS-Edge模型，可在设备端实现无需参考音频的泰语TTS，并开源模型和评估框架。
AI.motivation: 低资源场景下部署TTS面临两难：大型声音克隆模型推理成本高，紧凑固定声音系统需要说话人特定的语料库。作者旨在探索第三种路径——利用大型声音克隆模型作为数据生成器，将短声音参考转为紧凑学生模型，以兼顾质量与可部署性，并专门解决泰语特有的语言挑战。
AI.method: 采用"教师-学生"蒸馏框架：大型OmniVoice声音克隆模型作为教师，为15秒短语音参考生成大规模合成语料；在此基础上训练82M参数的紧凑固定声音学生模型。系统性地研究并操控了五个关键pipeline组件：文本准备、合成生成、质量过滤、拒绝采样和前端（frontend）选择，分析每个环节对最终学生模型的影响及教师模型遗留的局限性。
AI.result: Wayu-Paxa-TTS-Edge实现68.2%的Challenge-Set关键词准确率（达Gemini 3.1的85.5%），91.4%的停顿精度（优于其教师OmniVoice的89.9%，达Gemini 3.1的94.8%）。在三系统中取得最低的停顿位置错误率与词内停顿率，泰语CER为3.7%，英语CER为1.1%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了利用大型声音克隆模型作为合成数据源来训练紧凑固定声音TTS的可行性，并通过精细的pipeline设计在低资源泰语场景中获得接近甚至部分超越大型模型的性能。模型和评估框架均开源，为低资源泰语TTS提供可直接使用的解决方案。

title: Spectral characteristics of autoencoder parameters as a vector representation of data
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. This is a shortened (theorem proofs are skipped) and translated version of the paper published in a Russian-language peer-reviewed journal, the citation is in the paper footnote
summary: This paper examines the relationship between the parameters of autoencoder models and the statistical properties of the data on which they are trained. Autoencoders are defined as models with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained to reconstruct input data through a compressed latent representation. It is proposed that the model parameters can be viewed as a dense vector representation of the corresponding sample. To test this hypothesis, a theoretical and experimental study is conducted in which a vector representation is formed based on the spectral characteristics of the autoencoder parameter matrices. Theoretical analysis shows that the singular values of the model parameter matrices are related to the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix of the training data, ensuring the transfer of information between the data space and the parameter space. Experimental results on the CIFAR-10 and FashionMNIST datasets confirm that the resulting vector representations allow for a high degree of accuracy in distinguishing between models trained on different data subsets, without resorting to complex vector generation algorithms or using the original samples. These results suggest that the parameters of trained autoencoders can be viewed as sample representations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自编码器模型参数与训练数据统计属性之间的关系，提出将模型参数视为样本的稠密向量表示。通过理论分析和实验验证（CIFAR-10和FashionMNIST），发现基于参数矩阵奇异值构建的向量表示能够高精度地区分在不同数据子集上训练的模型，无需复杂算法或原始样本。
AI.motivation: 探索自编码器参数是否可以作为训练数据的向量表示，以建立数据空间与参数空间之间的信息传递桥梁，从而在不访问原始样本的情况下实现数据表征与模型区分。
AI.method: 理论部分分析了模型参数矩阵的奇异值与训练数据协方差矩阵特征值之间的关系；实验部分基于CIFAR-10和FashionMNIST数据集训练自编码器，依据参数矩阵的谱特征构建向量表示，并通过区分不同数据子集上训练的模型来评估表示质量。
AI.result: 理论分析证实参数矩阵奇异值与数据协方差矩阵特征值存在关联；实验表明所构建的向量表示能在不依赖复杂生成算法或原始样本的情况下，高精度地区分在不同数据子集上训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 训练后的自编码器参数可以被视为样本的表示形式，这为利用模型参数进行数据表征和模型分析提供了新的理论依据和实践路径。

title: Towards Numerical TOHTN Planning with SMT-based HTN-SAT Encoding
summary: While HTN planning has received significant attention in recent years, support for numerical reasoning remains very limited. In this paper, we investigate numerical Totally-Ordered HTN (TOHTN) planning and show how standard SAT-based encodings can be naturally extended with SMT to handle numeric fluents. In addition, we introduce a benchmark suite for numerical TOHTN planning, providing a first common basis for evaluation in this setting. Experimental results show that this simple encoding already constitutes a competitive baseline. This work opens the way to more expressive approaches to HTN planning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数值型全序HTN（TOHTN）规划问题，提出将标准SAT编码自然地扩展为SMT编码以处理数值流，并引入了首个数值TOHTN规划基准测试套件。实验表明该简单编码已构成具有竞争力的基线，为更富表达力的HTN规划方法开辟了道路。
AI.motivation: 尽管HTN规划近年来受到广泛关注，但对数值推理的支持仍然非常有限，缺乏处理数值流的方法和统一的评估基准。
AI.method: 将标准基于SAT的TOHTN规划编码自然地扩展为SMT编码，利用SMT求解器处理数值流（numeric fluents）；同时设计并发布了数值TOHTN规划的基准测试套件，为后续评估提供公共基础。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，这种简单的SMT编码已经能够构成一个具有竞争力的基线方案，足以在数值TOHTN规划中取得良好表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为更具表达力的HTN规划方法（如支持更复杂数值推理的变体）的探索打开了可能性。

title: A Low-Cost, Open Platform for End-to-End Autonomous Driving on a Miniature Ackermann Vehicle
summary: This paper presents a low-cost, open experimental platform for research in end-to-end autonomous driving with miniature Ackermann vehicles. The platform combines a physical vehicle, a printed urban track, data collection tools, trajectory registration, and a Webots digital twin, enabling controlled experiments that connect simulation-based autonomous-driving methods to real-world execution. As a first baseline, we implement command-conditioned behavior cloning, in which a neural policy receives an on-board camera image and a high-level navigation command and outputs steering and speed. The system is evaluated both on the physical vehicle and in simulation. In real closed-loop experiments, the learned policy follows lanes and executes commanded turns, reaching a mean cross-track error of 6.1 cm with respect to the reference route, close to the 4.7 cm observed in human demonstrations. In the digital twin, camera field of view has a strong effect on performance, reducing the mean cross-track error from 35.6 to 3.3 cm when widened from 58 to 120 degrees. Using the digital twin to generate synthetic driving data and a learned sim-to-real image translator to reduce the appearance gap, we further show that a higher-capacity policy trained on this synthetic data combined with real demonstrations is the only configuration that completes all four track routes in closed loop, whereas the compact baseline and the same network trained on real data alone complete fewer. These results establish the open platform as a practical testbed for sim-to-real studies and provide an initial command-conditioned imitation-learning baseline; we release it to support reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个低成本的开放实验平台，用于微型Ackermann车辆的端到端自动驾驶研究，结合物理车辆、打印城市轨道、数据采集工具、轨迹配准和Webots数字孪生。以此平台为基础实现了命令条件下的行为克隆基线，在真实闭环实验中平均横向误差为6.1 cm，接近人类演示的4.7 cm；使用数字孪生生成合成数据并结合sim-to-real图像翻译后，高容量策略是唯一能完成全部四条赛道闭环的方案。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶研究需要可控的实验环境来连接仿真与真实世界，但现有平台要么昂贵（全尺寸车辆），要么缺乏与真实物理车辆对应的数字孪生环境，阻碍了sim-to-real研究的可重复性。作者希望提供一个低成本、开放、连接仿真与真实实验的平台。
AI.method: 构建了一个集成平台：(1) 物理微型Ackermann车辆；(2) 打印的城市轨道场景；(3) 数据采集与轨迹配准工具；(4) Webots数字孪生环境。在此基础上实现命令条件行为克隆策略——神经网络接收车载相机图像和高层导航命令，输出转向和速度。策略在物理车辆和仿真中分别评估，并探索了利用数字孪生生成合成数据、配合sim-to-real图像翻译器缩小域差距的方法。
AI.result: 真实闭环实验中，学习策略实现了6.1 cm的平均横向误差（人类演示为4.7 cm）。数字孪生中，相机视场角从58度扩展到120度可使平均横向误差从35.6 cm降至3.3 cm。结合合成数据与真实演示训练的高容量策略是唯一能在闭环中完成全部四条赛道配置的方案，而紧凑基线和仅用真实数据训练的相同网络完成更少的赛道。
AI.conclusion: 该开放平台验证了作为sim-to-real研究实用测试床的价值，提供的命令条件模仿学习基线可靠且可复现。平台已公开发布以支持可重复研究。

title: Stabilizing Camera-Controlled Novel View Synthesis at Inference Time
summary: Training-free, camera-controlled novel view synthesis from a single image using pre-trained video diffusion models often becomes unstable under large camera motion and long generation horizons. Existing approaches commonly combine several inference-time components, making it unclear which design choices are most important for stability. We show that the main source of stability is simple. Decomposing camera motion into small autoregressive steps limits per-step geometric distortion and reduces error accumulation. A controlled camera-step study shows that performance remains stable for small motions and degrades more strongly as the per-step motion approaches $18$-$20^\circ$.
