We further evaluate geometry-constrained spatial attention and low-frequency appearance anchoring as supporting refinements, together with an efficient registration-free warping pipeline. Across RealEstate10K and MegaScene, CamTrol++ improves temporal and geometric consistency, downstream 3D reconstruction quality, and generation efficiency over training-free baselines. The method remains effective for 56-frame generation and under substantial controlled depth corruption. These results show that careful control of camera motion at inference time can substantially improve the stability of camera-controlled novel view synthesis without retraining or modifying the diffusion backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CamTrol++，一种无需训练的相机可控新视角合成方法，通过将相机运动分解为小步长自回归步骤来提升预训练视频扩散模型的稳定性。研究发现每步相机运动控制在18-20度以内是稳定性的关键因素，并辅以几何约束空间注意力和低频外观锚定等改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的训练免费、相机可控的新视角合成方法在大的相机运动和长生成周期下往往不稳定。现有方法通常组合多种推理时组件，但哪些设计选择对稳定性最重要并不清晰，缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 1) 将相机运动分解为小的自回归步骤，限制每步几何畸变并减少误差累积；2) 进行受控相机步长实验，发现每步超过18-20度时性能显著下降；3) 引入几何约束空间注意力和低频外观锚定作为支持性改进；4) 采用高效的注册无关（registration-free）的扭曲管道。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和MegaScene数据集上，CamTrol++相比训练免费基线方法在时间一致性、几何一致性、下游3D重建质量和生成效率上均有提升。该方法在56帧长序列生成以及显著的深度损坏条件下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在推理时仔细控制相机运动可以显著提升相机控制的新视角合成稳定性，无需重新训练或修改扩散模型骨干网络，验证了相机运动分解作为核心稳定性来源的关键作用。

title: Lost in Reordering: Structural Sensitivity of Multilingual LLMs under Semantics-Preserving Perturbations
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong multilingual reasoning performance, yet their robustness to semantics-preserving structural variation remains underexplored, particularly for relatively free word-order languages. We investigate the structural sensitivity of multilingual LLMs using two linguistically grounded perturbation settings in Hindi and Malayalam: constrained constituent reordering and active-passive voice transformation. We introduce a benchmark dataset IndicReStruct, with two variants, GSM8K-Reordered and GSM8K-Voice, constructed from GSM8K while preserving semantic meaning. Across six state-of-the-art LLMs and multiple prompting strategies, we observe consistent and significant degradation in mathematical reasoning performance under structurally perturbed inputs. To further understand these failures, we perform qualitative error analysis and mechanistic interpretability experiments using residual-stream activation patching. Our analyses show that reasoning failures frequently arise from disruptions in entity-quantity alignment and that intermediate transformer layers contribute most strongly toward reasoning restoration. Overall, our findings suggest that current multilingual LLMs remain highly sensitive to surface syntactic realization and lack robust compositional invariance under structurally different but semantically equivalent inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言大语言模型（LLMs）对语义等价但句法结构不同输入的鲁棒性，特别是针对印地语和马拉雅拉姆语等自由语序语言。作者构建了IndicReStruct基准数据集（含GSM8K-Reordered和GSM8K-Voice两个变体），通过受限成分重排和主动-被动语态转换两种语言学扰动词干，对六个SOTA LLM和多种提示策略进行测试，发现模型在这些结构扰动下数学推理性能显著下降。通过定性错误分析和残差流激活修补的机制性可解释性实验，作者揭示推理失败常源于实体-数量对齐的中断，且中间变压器层对推理恢复贡献最大，表明当前多语言LLM缺乏稳健的组成不变性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs展现出强大的多语言推理能力，但它们对保持语义不变的结构变化（如同义异形的句法实现）的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索，尤其是对语序相对自由的低资源语言。理解这种结构敏感性对评估和改进多语言模型的推理泛化能力至关重要。
AI.method: 作者构建了基于GSM8K的IndicReStruct基准，包含两种维持语义的扰动变体：(1) GSM8K-Reordered——受限成分重排；(2) GSM8K-Voice——主动-被动语态转换。在印地语和马拉雅拉姆语上，对六个SOTA LLM采用多种提示策略进行评估，并结合定性错误分析与基于残差流激活修补（activation patching）的机制性可解释性实验来理解失败模式。
AI.result: 所有模型在所有提示策略下，面对结构扰动输入时均表现出一致且显著的数学推理性能下降。定性分析和机制性实验表明：推理失败主要源于实体-数量对齐关系的破坏；中间变压器层在推理恢复中发挥最关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 当前多语言LLMs对表面句法实现高度敏感，缺乏在结构不同但语义等价的输入下应有的稳健组成不变性（compositional invariance）。这揭示了多语言推理模型在句法泛化方面的局限性，为未来提升模型的鲁棒性提供了方向。

title: Restricted Eigenvalues Beyond Gaussian Width: Threshold Occupancy under Heavy Tails
summary: Restricted eigenvalue (RE) bounds govern stable recovery by norm-regularized estimators. For isotropic sub-Gaussian measurements, the benchmark sample size is $1+w(A)^2$, where $w(A)$ is the Gaussian width of the normalized descent cone. The COLT 2015 open-problem note (Banerjee et al., 2015) asked whether the same law follows for heavy-tailed designs from a uniform small-ball condition alone. We give an explicit and systematic negative answer to the general question as formulated there: the proposed law fails in its full dimension-free, arbitrary-set form, and the missing obstruction is simultaneous threshold occupancy. A constant-width polyhedral descent cone with fixed small-ball constants has zero empirical RE on every sample path up to half the ambient dimension. More generally, every finite range space admits exact threshold encoding in an arbitrarily narrow spherical cap and a lift to a full polyhedral descent-cone section. For every fixed threshold VC dimension $d$, as $β\downarrow0$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity is $Θ(β^{-1}[d\log(1/β)+\log(1/δ)])$. The separation persists under exact isotropy and all finite moments: on the same constant-width cone, Gaussian measurements succeed with $O(1+\log(1/δ))$ samples, whereas an isotropic heavy-tailed design fails pathwise for $n\lesssim\sqrt{p/\log p}$. Gaussian smoothing yields an everywhere-positive $C^\infty$ density while retaining arbitrarily poor RE. Under isotropy, a distribution-free fallback governed by affine dimension times squared enclosing radius is sharp on this family.

AI.tldr: 本文对COLT 2015开放问题给出了系统性的否定回答：仅从均匀小球条件（uniform small-ball condition）出发，无法推出各向同性次高斯测量下由高斯宽度刻画的经验RE界。障碍是"同时阈值占用"（simultaneous threshold occupancy），且该分离在精确各向同性和有限矩条件下依然存在。
AI.motivation: COLT 2015开放问题（Banerjee et al., 2015）询问：对重尾设计，是否仅靠均匀小球条件就能类似次高斯情形地获得以高斯宽度为基准的RE界（样本量为1+w(A)^2）。回答这一问题对理解范数正则化估计器在重尾分布下的稳定恢复能力具有根本意义。
AI.method: 构造一系列反例与下界：1) 构建常宽多面体下降锥，在任意样本路径上直到半维数前经验RE为零；2) 利用有限值域空间在任意窄球冠中实现精确阈值编码，并提升为完整多面体下降锥截面；3) 推导依赖VC维的锐利最坏情形样本复杂度Θ(β^{-1}[d log(1/β)+log(1/δ)])；4) 证明在相同常宽锥上高斯测量O(1+log(1/δ))样本即可成功而各向同性重尾设计在n≲√(p/log p)内逐路径失败；5) 展示高斯光滑化可得处处正的C^∞密度但仍保留任意差的RE性质，并提出以仿射维数与平方包围半径刻画的分布无关回退界。
AI.result: 对原始问题给出明确且系统的否定回答：原始问题所提的"全维度自由、任意集合"形式的定律不成立，缺失的障碍是同时阈值占用。建立了锐利的最坏情形样本复杂度刻画，并证明该负结果在精确各向同性及所有有限矩条件下依然成立，同时与高斯测量的正结果形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 均匀小球条件不足以支持重尾设计下基于高斯宽度的RE界，需要在分布无关意义下以"仿射维数×平方包围半径"作为回退度量；同时阈值VC维刻画了该构造族下的锐利样本复杂度下界。

title: More Criticism Does Not Make a Better Review: EquiReview-R
summary: AI reviewers can now produce many specific criticisms, but more criticism is not necessarily a better review. A review may miss a consequential weakness or retain an allegation that available evidence does not support. These failures require opposite corrections, yet generation-oriented systems and aggregate measures obscure the distinction. We therefore recast AI-assisted review as evidence-guided refinement of a structured concern set, with omission and overcritique treated as separate risks. Building on this formulation, we introduce EquiReview-R, which resolves existing concerns against localized evidence, searches for missing issues from independent and review-conditioned perspectives, and returns stop, continue, or defer. To expose the failure mode that motivates this design, we construct an evidence-linked trajectory corpus. Its retrospective analysis shows why revision must precede further search: nearly all concerns in a high-recall review lack a definitive evidential disposition, while an earlier refinement mechanism cannot revise them. On a frozen cohort of previously unseen papers, EquiReview-R satisfies the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for major omission, reduces major overcritique from 15.5% to 8.1%, and attains a one-sided omission upper bound of 9.9% while stopping on 52.4% of papers. Computation-matched controls, controlled pairs, and ablations show that the gain comes from revision rather than extra inference or shorter output. We release the corpus as ReviewTrace, an evidence-linked resource for studying review revision, disagreement, and provenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EquiReview-R，将AI审稿重新定义为基于证据引导的结构化关注点集细化过程，将"遗漏"和"过度批评"视为两类独立风险。通过证据链轨迹语料库验证，EquiReview-R在保持遗漏非劣效的前提下将重大过度批评从15.5%降至8.1%，并在52.4%的论文上触发提前停止。系统还发布ReviewTrace语料库以支持审稿修订、分歧和溯源研究。
AI.motivation: AI审稿人能够产生大量具体批评，但批评数量多并不等于审稿质量高。现有系统可能遗漏重要缺陷，也可能保留缺乏证据支持的指控。这两种失败需要相反的修正方向，但面向生成式的系统和聚合指标混淆了这两者之间的区别。因此需要将审稿重新形式化为证据引导的关注点集细化问题，将遗漏与过度批评视为独立风险进行管理。
AI.method: EquiReview-R将AI审稿视为对结构化关注点集的证据引导式细化：(1) 针对已有关注点，对照局部证据进行消解修订（resolve）；(2) 从独立视角和审稿条件化视角搜索遗漏问题（search）；(3) 输出停止（stop）、继续（continue）或推迟（defer）三态决策。作者还构建了证据链接的轨迹语料库，并通过回顾性分析证明修订必须先于进一步搜索——高召回审稿中的几乎所有关注点都缺乏明确证据处置，而早期的细化机制无法对其进行修订。
AI.result: 在冻结的未见论文队列上，EquiReview-R满足预指定的重大遗漏非劣效标准，将重大过度批评从15.5%降至8.1%，遗漏单侧上界达到9.9%，并在52.4%的论文上提前停止。计算匹配对照、受控配对和消融实验表明，性能提升来自修订机制而非额外推理或缩短输出。
AI.conclusion: 将审稿视为证据引导的关注点集细化，并将遗漏与过度批评分离处理，比单纯的批评生成更有效。修订先于搜索的顺序至关重要。作者发布ReviewTrace语料库，为审稿修订、分歧和证据溯源提供研究资源。

title: Tree-Structured Vector Quantization For Efficient And Progressive Image Compression
summary: Vector-quantization based image compression has achieved strong rate--distortion performance, yet most of them still produce a separate compressed representation for each target bitrate. Such variable-rate behavior allows one model to operate at multiple rates, but it does not necessarily provide a progressive bitstream whose prefixes are themselves decodable and can be refined by appending additional bits. We propose \textbf{Tree-VQ}, a progressive tree-structured vector quantization framework for learned image compression. Tree-VQ organizes discrete codewords as a hierarchical binary tree and represents each latent token by a routed root-to-leaf path. Crucially, every prefix of this path corresponds to a valid quantized representation, so shallow internal nodes serve as coarse reconstruction codes and deeper nodes provide successive refinements. This allows a compressed image to be decoded from an early prefix and progressively improved as more branch symbols are received, rather than being re-encoded for different target rates. To make this structure practical for compression, we introduce a prefix-compatible tree entropy model that codes progressive continuation decisions and routed branch refinements using only causally available decoded contexts. We further use rate-aware refinement scheduling to decide which spatial blocks should receive additional tree bits under a given prefix budget, and hierarchical prefix supervision to ensure that internal nodes are directly decodable at low rates. Experiments show that Tree-VQ achieves a superior performance--efficiency trade-off, delivering the best perceptual compression results with much fewer parameters and lower latency than competing methods.

AI.tldr: Tree-VQ是一种渐进式树结构向量量化图像压缩框架，将离散码字组织为层次化二叉树，每个潜在token通过根到叶的路径表示，路径前缀本身就是可解码的有效量化表示。通过前缀兼容的树熵模型、率感知精化调度和分层前缀监督，实现了无需重新编码的多码率渐进压缩，在更少参数和更低延迟下取得最佳感知压缩效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于向量量化的图像压缩方法虽然实现了较强的率失真性能，但大多数需要为每个目标码率生成单独的压缩表示。即便支持可变码率，也不一定提供渐进式比特流（即前缀本身可解码且可通过附加比特进一步精化）。传统方法需要针对不同目标率重新编码，效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 提出Tree-VQ框架，将码字组织为层次化二叉树，每个潜在token由根到叶路径表示，路径每个前缀都是有效的量化表示（内部节点作粗重建码，深层节点提供逐级精化）；2) 引入前缀兼容的树熵模型，仅使用因果可用的解码上下文对渐进续继决策和路由分支精化进行编码；3) 提出率感知精化调度，决定在给定前缀预算下哪些空间块应接收额外树比特；4) 采用层次化前缀监督，确保内部节点在低码率下可直接解码。
AI.result: 实验表明，Tree-VQ在性能-效率权衡上表现优越，以更少的参数和更低的延迟实现了最佳的感知压缩效果，优于其他对比方法，同时提供真正的渐进式比特流解码能力。
AI.conclusion: Tree-VQ通过树结构的层次化向量量化设计，成功实现了原生渐进式图像压缩，解决了传统可变码率方法缺乏渐进解码能力的问题，在感知质量和计算效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: Language, Language Models, and What We're Talking About
comment: In Proceedings of the Twelfth Italian Conference on Computational Linguistics (CLiC-it 2026)
summary: Language models are commonly discussed as technical artefacts, but they are obviously shaped by the linguistic worlds conveyed by data during their training. Using Italian language models as evidence, I want to bring attention to the nature of the systems which result from training and specialising models on translated and synthetic data, and further curating them, and to the meaning of testing them on equally unnatural data. Are these eventually models of Italian? Are they models of language? Does NLP still care about language? These questions yield another, more concrete question: what language do we actually want language models to produce? I argue that this question cannot be answered if we do not first consider a clearer distinction between language models designed as technical products and language models designed as tools for studying language itself. The answers then might be diverse, the languages we are talking about might be diverse, and the picture might not be as pessimistic as we fear.

AI.tldr: 本文以意大利语语言模型为证据，探讨训练于翻译数据和合成数据上的语言模型究竟是否代表真实的语言，并呼吁区分作为技术产品的语言模型与作为语言研究工具的语言模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被当作技术产物讨论，但忽略了它们是由训练数据中承载的语言世界所塑造的。当模型在翻译数据和合成数据上训练、特化并经过策展，再在同样不自然的数据上测试时，我们有必要追问：这些模型是否真正代表一种语言（如意大利语）？是否代表语言本身？NLP是否还关心语言？这些问题的核心是一个更具体的追问：我们究竟希望语言模型产出什么样的语言？作者认为，若不先厘清作为技术产品的语言模型与作为语言研究工具的语言模型之间的区别，这个问题无从回答。
AI.method: 以意大利语语言模型为实证案例，通过对翻译数据、合成数据训练及策展过程的分析，提出对语言模型本质的批判性反思；并采用概念区分的方法，将语言模型划分为"技术产品"与"语言研究工具"两种定位。
AI.result: 作者认为，一旦区分了作为技术产品的语言模型与作为语言研究工具的语言模型，关于"我们想要什么样的语言"的答案可能是多元的、所讨论的语言也可能是多元的，整体图景并非如人们担忧的那般悲观。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的评价与讨论需要先厘清其定位——是服务于工程技术目标还是服务于语言本身的研究——只有在明确这一区分的基础上，关于"模型产出何种语言"的问题才能得到有意义且多元的回答。论文对新语种NLP的生态持相对乐观的态度。

title: An Adversarial Zero-Shot Learning Approach for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate IoT Traffic Data
summary: Anomaly detection in Internet of Things (IoT) networks presents unique challenges due to the diversity of devices, lack of labeled data, and domain variability across environments. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection that leverages adversarial learning and contrastive loss within a sequence-based Variational Autoencoder (VAE) architecture. Our method enables zero-shot domain adaptation by jointly optimizing domain-invariant latent representations and semantically structured embedding spaces, without requiring labeled data or raw feature transfer. To address the heterogeneity of IoT deployments, we introduce encoder and decoder adaptor layers that align feature distributions across domains while preserving contextual semantics. Additionally, we propose a destination-based segmentation strategy to better model real-world communication structures in IoT traffic. Our framework is comprehensively evaluated on six distinct datasets spanning industrial, enterprise, general-purpose, smart home, and military automation domains across 44 transfer scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization in several cross-domain settings and competitive performance against a contrastive domain-adaptation baseline under realistic, heterogeneous, and privacy-constrained IoT conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对抗学习和对比损失的序列变分自编码器（VAE）框架，用于IoT网络中的多元时间序列异常检测，支持零样本跨域适应，无需标注数据或原始特征迁移。通过在六个不同领域数据集上的44个迁移场景评估，验证了其零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: IoT网络中的异常检测面临设备多样性、缺乏标注数据以及跨环境领域差异等独特挑战，现有方法难以在无标签情况下实现有效的跨域零样本适应。
AI.method: 提出一个基于序列VAE的框架，联合优化对抗学习和对比损失，以学习领域不变的潜在表示和语义结构化的嵌入空间。引入编码器和解码器适配器层来对齐跨域特征分布，同时保持上下文语义；并提出基于目标地址的分段策略更好地建模IoT流量中的真实通信结构。
AI.result: 在涵盖工业、企业、通用、智能家居和军事自动化等领域的六个数据集上进行44个跨域迁移场景的全面评估，在多个跨域设置中展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，并在现实、异构和隐私受限的IoT条件下达到与对比域适应基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在无标签且隐私受限的IoT场景下实现有效的零样本跨域异常检测，为IoT网络中的异构多域部署提供了可行方案。

title: FiMI Banking: A Sovereign Model for Indian Retail Banking
summary: Banks need conversational systems that can answer product questions, assist customers with account-related requests, and operate safely within strict operational and regulatory constraints. General-purpose language models do not reliably meet these requirements. They fall short when a task requires grounded information, correct tool use, or cautious handling of bank-specific sensitive situations. We introduce FiMI Banking, a controlled Indian retail-banking setting. We build it from vetted banking documents, structured ground truth, synthetic customer backgrounds, and banking tools. We evaluate two post-training approaches: preference optimization for response-level behavior, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for multi-turn tool-use tasks. Preference optimization improves safe behavior substantially: out-of-scope refusal rises from 52% to 80%. Reinforcement learning improves edge-case performance from 0.509 to 0.718 and order-sensitive task performance from 0.590 to 0.679, while using 29% fewer generated tokens. These results show that preference optimization and verifiable-reward reinforcement learning address complementary requirements for reliable banking agents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍FiMI Banking，一个受控的印度零售银行业务环境，并评估了两种后训练方法：偏好优化（提升安全行为）和带可验证奖励的强化学习（提升多轮工具使用任务的边缘案例性能与顺序敏感任务性能），两者互补地满足了可靠银行智能体的需求。
AI.motivation: 银行需要能够回答问题、协助客户处理账户请求并在严格运营与监管约束下安全运作的对话系统，而通用语言模型在需要基于事实的信息、正确的工具使用以及对银行特定敏感情况的谨慎处理时无法可靠满足这些要求。
AI.method: 构建FiMI Banking受控环境，包含经过审查的银行文档、结构化真值、合成客户背景和银行工具。评估两种后训练方法：(1)偏好优化用于响应级行为（如安全拒绝越界请求）；(2)带可验证奖励的强化学习用于多轮工具使用任务。
AI.result: 偏好优化使越界请求的拒绝率从52%提升至80%；强化学习将边缘案例任务性能从0.509提升至0.718，顺序敏感任务性能从0.590提升至0.679，同时生成token减少29%。
AI.conclusion: 偏好优化和可验证奖励强化学习分别解决了银行智能体的互补需求：前者提升安全行为，后者提升工具使用任务的准确性和效率，两者结合可构建更可靠的银行业务智能体。

title: PL-SCEA: Reconfiguring Pretrained Attention for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide transferable patch representations for few-shot industrial anomaly detection, but their attention computation is typically inherited from pretraining objectives centered on semantic aggregation. This creates a potential mismatch: token relations that support semantic recognition may not adequately expose the localized texture and structural deviations required for anomaly localization. We therefore investigate the hypothesis that the attention computation of a frozen VFM can be reconfigured as a task-relevant component of anomaly detection. We instantiate this idea with Power-Law Self-Correlation Enhanced Attention (PL-SCEA), which retains the semantic context of pretrained query-key attention while constructing token-adaptive self-correlations over contextualized value features. Positive-correlation filtering and power-law reweighting then emphasize relations that are salient relative to each token's relational background, without introducing additional trainable attention projections. The resulting features are modeled by a lightweight variational autoencoder that provides a fixed-size reconstruction-based representation of category-specific normality. The two stages serve complementary roles: attention reconfiguration shapes how local relational deviations are represented, while reconstruction-based modeling converts deviations from learned normality into anomaly scores. Across MVTec AD and VisA, the complete framework achieves competitive image-level detection and consistently strong pixel-level localization across the evaluated few-shot settings. Ablations further show that PL-SCEA improves localization with either the VAE or a memory bank under the tested setting. These results support the view that task-aligned attention reconfiguration can improve the anomaly-localization capability of frozen pretrained representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PL-SCEA方法，通过重构冻结视觉基础模型的注意力计算（幂律自相关增强注意力），使预训练表示更好地服务于小样本工业异常检测的像素级定位任务，并在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上取得有竞争力的效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFMs）的注意力计算源自以语义聚合为导向的预训练目标，而异常定位需要的是细粒度的纹理和结构偏差感知。这种预训练目标与下游任务之间的不匹配可能导致token间关系无法充分暴露局部异常，因此作者假设冻结VFM的注意力计算可以重构为与异常检测任务高度相关的组件。
AI.method: 提出Power-Law Self-Correlation Enhanced Attention (PL-SCEA)：保留预训练的query-key注意力语义上下文，同时在上下文化的value特征上构建token自适应的自相关关系；通过正相关性过滤和幂律重加权来强调相对于每个token关系背景显著的关系模式；无需引入额外可训练的注意力投影。随后使用轻量级变分自编码器（VAE）对重构后的特征进行建模，提供固定大小的重建式类别正常性表示。两个阶段互补：注意力重构塑造局部关系偏差的表示，重建建模将偏差转化为异常分数。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上，该方法在小样本设定下实现了有竞争力的图像级检测和一致的强像素级定位性能。消融实验表明，PL-SCEA无论在VAE还是记忆库方案下都能改善定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 任务对齐的注意力重构能够提升冻结预训练表示的异常定位能力，验证了将注意力计算本身作为异常检测可重构组件的可行性。

title: How Far Can Synthetic Data Take Thai OCR?
summary: We investigate what makes synthetic OCR supervision transfer to real Thai documents and use the resulting insights to build Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero, a Thai OCR model adapted without OCR labels from real Thai document pages. Synthetic data provide exact labels at scale, but "realism" conflates source domain, page context, typography, spatial structure, and glyph variation. We disentangle these factors with a controlled document-reconstruction pipeline and evaluate each variant under page- and crop-level training on printed and handwritten Thai documents. Non-text context has little consistent effect, whereas typeface diversity, two-dimensional structure, and real handwriting glyphs improve transfer; moreover, source-domain matching depends on training granularity, with in-domain reconstruction approaching real printed supervision under page-level training (1.82% versus 1.31% median character error rate) but underperforming out-of-domain reconstruction under crop-level training (15.59% versus 5.52%). Guided by these findings, we adapt the 0.9B-parameter PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 into Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero using 45,723 synthetic pages: relative to its base checkpoint, it reduces median character error rate from 6.64% to 1.24% on printed pages and from 74.87% to 20.55% on handwriting and outperforms Typhoon OCR v1 7B on all five evaluation sets, showing that synthetic-only training can be competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文系统解构了合成OCR数据向真实泰文文档迁移的影响因素，并据此构建了无需真实OCR标注的泰文OCR模型Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero，证明纯合成数据训练可与大规模模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 合成数据能提供大规模精确标注，但"真实性"一词混淆了源域、页面上下文、字体排印、空间结构和字形变化等多个因素，缺乏对这些因素如何影响从合成到真实文档迁移的清晰理解。
AI.method: 通过受控的文档重建流程分解各因素，分别在页面级和裁剪级训练下评估印刷与手写泰文文档；基于洞见将0.9B参数的PaddleOCR-VL-1.6用45,723张合成页面微调为Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero。
AI.result: 非文本上下文影响甚微；字体多样性、二维结构和真实手写字形可提升迁移效果；源域匹配依赖训练粒度：页面级训练中同域重建接近真实印刷监督（1.82% vs 1.31%中位CER），裁剪级训练中则不如异域重建（15.59% vs 5.52%）。Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero将印刷页中位CER从6.64%降至1.24%，手写从74.87%降至20.55%，并在五个评估集上超越Typhoon OCR v1 7B。
AI.conclusion: 纯合成数据训练可以具备竞争力，合理的消融实验设计能有效指导合成数据生成策略的选择。

title: LongCounsel-8: A Benchmark Suite for Longitudinal Depression Tracking from Multi-Session Counseling Dialogues
summary: Tracking depression from multi-session counseling dialogues requires estimating both current symptom severity and how it changes across sessions. Yet progress on this task is constrained by the scarcity of longitudinal counseling data with standardized session-level depression labels. Existing resources typically provide either multi-session conversations without depression labels or labeled interviews in a single session. Building such a benchmark poses three challenges: maintaining longitudinal consistency and diversity, grounding symptom progression in empirical patterns, and expressing controlled depression states naturally without exposing target labels. To address these challenges, we introduce LongCounsel-8, a benchmark suite of three independently generated datasets totaling 7,749 five-session counseling trajectories, grounded in real-world client profiles, depression trajectories, symptom compositions, and counseling patterns. We combine profile-grounded simulation, empirically informed state construction, and indirect behavioral realization to address these challenges. Across the benchmark, simulated self-reports closely recover the controlled states, supporting label fidelity. Experiments on existing depression tracking methods reveal three key findings: (1) lower single-session score error does not guarantee accurate identification of trend, i.e., improvement or worsening; (2) existing methods are consistently less reliable on worsening trajectories; and (3) additional session history may reduce the accuracy of trend prediction. Together, these findings establish LongCounsel-8 as a foundation for advancing depression assessment from static, single-session prediction toward reliable longitudinal tracking of mental-health change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongCounsel-8基准套件，包含三个独立生成的数据集，共7,749条五会话咨询轨迹，用于从多次咨询对话中追踪抑郁症状严重程度及其跨会话变化。实验发现现有方法在趋势识别（改善/恶化）上存在缺陷，尤其对恶化轨迹的可靠性不足。
AI.motivation: 从多次咨询对话中追踪抑郁需要同时估计当前症状严重程度及其跨会话变化，但缺乏带标准化会话级抑郁标签的纵向咨询数据，现有资源要么无标签的多会话对话，要么单次会话的有标签访谈。构建此类基准面临三个挑战：保持纵向一致性和多样性、基于实证模式锚定症状进展、以及在不暴露目标标签的情况下自然表达受控抑郁状态。
AI.method: 构建LongCounsel-8基准套件，包含三个独立生成的数据集，共7,749条五会话咨询轨迹。核心方法包括三种技术：(1) 基于档案的模拟（profile-grounded simulation）以真实世界客户档案为基础；(2) 经验知情状态构建（empirically informed state construction）基于真实抑郁轨迹、症状构成和咨询模式；(3) 间接行为实现（indirect behavioral realization）自然表达受控抑郁状态而不直接暴露目标标签。
AI.result: 模拟的自我报告能紧密恢复受控状态，支持标签保真度。实验发现三个关键结论：(1) 更低的单次会话分数误差并不保证能准确识别趋势（改善或恶化）；(2) 现有方法在恶化轨迹上的一致性可靠性较低；(3) 额外会话历史可能降低趋势预测的准确性。
AI.conclusion: LongCounsel-8作为基础基准，推动抑郁评估从静态单会话预测走向可靠的纵向心理健康变化追踪。

title: Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring
comment: 39 pages, 14 pages main text. Code, data, and pre-registrations: https://github.com/nebula-1999/Interface-Induced-Trajectory-Censoring
summary:
Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack. That number can be zero while the model is emitting well-formed calls: the interface censors the trajectory before anything downstream sees it.
  On BFCL v4's own data, executor and scorer, holding weights, cases, decoding and seeds fixed and changing only the serving adapter, the same model scores 0.00 or 0.96 / 0.19. A 2x2 over chat template and parser locates the effect exactly: both main effects are exactly zero and all of it sits in the interaction -- no component is defective, and repairing one side of the contract buys precisely nothing. On tau-bench's 115 interactive retail tasks the same swap moves server-parsed calls from 0 to 636 and tasks reaching any tool execution from 0 to 103. Our probe reproduces the funnel across a 21x scale range of Qwen2.5-Coder: the server parses 0/100 at every size while well-formed emitted calls rise to 80/100 at 32B (~72 after calibration against an adjudicated gold standard). Under a matched envelope, across a comparable scale span, the silent fraction stays at 0-2, a prediction committed to the repository before the run. Llama-3.1-8B's 23% rate of calling the task function itself as a tool falls to 0 under one strict:true flag.
  The mismatch reaches inside the training loop, and its consequence is scale-dependent: in verl's AgentLoop at 7B, 45 of 115 generations carry a complete call; 0 are accepted, 0 execute, 0 return an observation. At 1.5B the same zero is over-determined, so we report the two scales separately. At evaluation time, repairing the adapter restores the mechanism but not a significant outcome gain: parsing 0->84, rescues 0->9, pass rate 53->62 (n.s.). We release a 98-line preflight check that catches every silent failure here. The observed tool-call rate is not a property of the model alone; it is a property of the model-interface stack that measures it.

AI.tldr: 工具调用率并非模型本身的属性，而是"模型-接口-服务栈"共同作用的产物。研究证明仅更换服务适配器（保持权重、案例、解码和种子不变），同一模型在同一基准上的得分可在0.00与0.96/0.19之间剧烈波动，并揭示了该现象源于聊天模板与解析器的交互作用，而非任一组件单独缺陷。
AI.motivation: Agent评估中报告的工具调用率明明读到的是服务栈上的数值，却常被理解为模型能力。实际上接口层可能在模型发出格式良好的调用之前就进行审查/拦截，使下游看不到任何调用。作者旨在揭示这一"静默失败"（silent failure）现象的普遍性与机制根源。
AI.method: 作者在BFCL v4、tau-bench及21x规模范围的Qwen2.5-Coder上，固定权重、案例、解码和种子，仅更换服务的聊天模板与解析器适配器，构造2x2实验分离主效应与交互效应；在verl AgentLoop训练循环中检查该机制影响；并提出一个98行预检检查（preflight check）以捕获静默失败。
AI.result: （1）BFCL v4上同一模型得分可在0.00和0.96/0.19之间跳动，且聊天模板与解析器各自主效应为零，全部差异来自交互；（2）tau-bench 115个任务上，服务端解析调用从0升至636，执行任务的数目从0升至103；（3）Qwen2.5-Coder上服务端在100个生成中解析0/100，而格式良好调用在32B升至80/100；（4）Llama-3.1-8B中strict:true标志可将23%的错误工具调用率降至0；（5）verl AgentLoop训练中7B虽45/115代含有完整调用，但0被接受、0执行、0返回观测。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的工具调用率是模型-接口栈的共同属性而非模型单独属性。修复适配器端可恢复机制（解析率0→84，救援0→9），但通�率仅从53%升至62%且不显著，说明机制修复与结果提升之间存在鸿沟。文中发布的98行预检工具可捕获本文所有静默失败模式。

title: Rethinking 3D Noise: Learning 3D-Aware Video Priors via Optimization-Free Morphological Perturbations
summary: 3D scene representations like NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) suffer severe artifacts in sparse-view settings. Recent generative 3D artifact fixers attempt to address this, but rely on paired corrupted and clean renders requiring costly, per-scene reconstructions across varying view configurations. While 2D image augmentations act as instant regularizers, no explicit equivalents exist for 3D representations to preserve spatial consistency across views, an essential property for 3D-aware training. We propose 3D Morphological Perturbations as an optimization-free regularizer that preserves spatial consistency. Leveraging explicit 3DGS, we treat each Gaussian as a fundamental building block - analogous to a 2D pixel - and apply perturbations across its morphological parameter space via scale, rotation, and pruning. Our method eliminates per-scene 3DGS optimization loops from dataset curation while enabling models to learn stronger geometric priors than sparse-view baselines in diagnostic ablations conducted on a lightweight video diffusion sandbox. Scaled to a 14B-parameter video model via ControlNet, our approach maintains visual fidelity while reducing mean depth error by 12.5% over state-of-the-art image-to-image 3D artifact refiners, ultimately boosting downstream robotics policy success rates by up to 8.0% across 3 of 4 manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出3D形态扰动（3D Morphological Perturbations）作为一种无需优化的正则化方法，通过在3DGS上对每个高斯进行尺度、旋转和剪枝扰动，提升稀疏视角下3D场景表示的几何一致性，并将模型规模扩展到14B参数视频模型，降低了12.5%的深度误差，并在下游机器人操作任务中提升了最高8.0%的成功率。
AI.motivation: NeRF和3DGS在稀疏视角设置下会产生严重伪影。现有的生成式3D修复器依赖配对的损坏/干净渲染数据，需要针对每个场景在不同视角配置下进行昂贵的重建，缺乏类似于2D图像增强那样的即插即用且保持跨视角空间一致性的3D数据增强手段。
AI.method: 将3DGS中的每个高斯视为类似于2D像素的基本构建单元，在其形态参数空间（尺度、旋转、剪枝）上施加扰动，构造优化无关的正则化器。该方法在数据准备阶段豁免了逐场景的3DGS优化循环，并在轻量视频扩散沙箱上进行诊断消融实验；随后通过ControlNet将方法扩展到14B参数视频模型中。
AI.result: 在诊断消融实验中，模型比稀疏视角基线学习了更强的几何先验。扩展到14B视频模型后，在保持视觉保真度的同时，平均深度误差比最先进的图到图3D伪影修复方法降低12.5%；在下游机器人策略评估中，4个操作任务中有3个的成功率最高提升8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 3D形态扰动是一种高效、优化无关的3D正则化方法，能够在不引入额外逐场景重建开销的情况下改善稀疏视角3D重建的几何一致性，并且能在大规模生成模型中有效泛化，带来下游任务的实质性提升。

title: KhatianDoc: A Human-Verified Benchmark Diagnosing Multimodal LLM Failure on Bengali Legal Land Records
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables, NLLP Workshop @ EMNLP 2026. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/KhatianDoc
summary: Land ownership in Bangladesh is recorded in Ana-Ganda-Kora-Kranti-Til, a base-16 positional fraction system with dedicated Unicode glyphs, no mainstream font, and no coverage in any OCR pipeline or tokenizer. The handwritten records that carry these fractions, RS Khatians, are the authoritative title record for millions of parcels and a frequent subject of civil litigation, yet no benchmark has asked whether a machine can read one. We introduce KhatianDoc, a four-task benchmark built from 107 real RS Khatian records from the Vumi (land) Office of Munshiganj, Bangladesh: symbol recognition, base-16-to-decimal conversion, structured field extraction, and legal document question answering over 1,634 QA pairs. Ground truth was transcribed by hand, verified by a land-law practitioner to full agreement, and anonymized through positional tokens that keep the referential distinctions multi-hop questions depend on. We evaluate six multimodal LLMs (8B to 72B+, open and closed) under a fixed zero-shot protocol. Five QA categories, 39.3% of our stratified set, return zero correct answers from every model; on the arithmetic task, every model that emits a number does worse than a constant-mean baseline, with exact- and near-match scores coinciding: decorrelation, not approximation. Auditing our own metrics surfaced two artifacts in opposite directions: we correct a refusal-scoring bug and report the fixed scores beside the originals, and flag an inflated metadata metric as an upper bound. KhatianDoc documents not a performance gap but the absence of a capability, with verified ground truth for future systems. Code and data, with a redacted image release, are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KhatianDoc基准，用于测试多模态大语言模型解读孟加拉国RS Khatian土地权属记录中使用的base-16分数制符号Ana-Ganda-Kora-Kranti-Til的能力。基准包含107份真实记录、四个任务和1,634个QA对。评估六个多模态LLM后发现：39.3%的分层QA问题所有模型零正确率，算术任务上所有模型均劣于常数均值基线，表明这不是性能差距而是能力缺失。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国的土地所有权以base-16位置分数系统记录，这些手写记录（RS Khatians）是数百万地块的权威权属凭证并频繁卷入民事诉讼，但没有任何OCR管道或分词器覆盖这一系统，也没有基准测试过机器能否读取这些记录。
AI.method: 构建KhatianDoc基准：从孟加拉国Munshiganj Vumi（土地）办公室收集107份真实RS Khatian记录，设计四个任务（符号识别、base-16转十进制、结构化字段提取、法律文档问答1,634对）。人工转写并由土地法从业者验证至完全一致，通过位置化令牌实现匿名化并保留多跳问题所需的指称区别。在固定零样本协议下评估六个8B至72B+的多模态LLM（开源和闭源）。
AI.result: 五个QA类别中占分层集39.3%的问题所有模型均返回零正确；算术任务上每个输出数字的模型都劣于常数均值基线，精确匹配和近似匹配分数重合，表明是去相关而非近似。指标审计发现两个方向相反的伪影：修正了拒答评分错误并报告修正后的分数，同时标记了一个被夸大的元数据指标作为上界。
AI.conclusion: KhatianDoc记录的并非性能差距，而是能力的完全缺失，并提供经过验证的真实数据供未来系统使用。代码、数据和脱敏图像发布均为公开可用。

title: Common-Witness Certificates and Sharp Feature Bounds for Counterfactual Image Auditing
summary: An image editor may satisfy every regional plausibility constraint separately even when no single latent explanation fits the complete output. We formalize this local-to-global failure using a common witness grade and witness nerve. The framework separates auditing from causal identification: shared exogeneity alone allows every coupling of the regime marginals, whereas an externally justified witness relation yields sharp partial-identification bounds for prespecified image features. Helly-type arguments provide short incompatibility certificates for quasiconvex losses, heterogeneous action strata, and finite witness atlases; a blocker-hypergraph formula gives exact repair counts. Simultaneous confidence regions for the regime marginals give finite-sample outer coverage of the complete identified interval. Controlled MNIST, Morpho-MNIST, and smallNORB studies demonstrate the predicted local-global separation, while synthetic experiments test sharp bounds, certificate recovery, and structured computation. The method audits a declared feature relation and does not identify unrestricted pixel-level counterfactuals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于检测图像编辑器中"局部约束各自合理但整体不存在单一潜在解释"的局部-全局失败问题，通过共同证人等级（witness grade）和证人神经（witness nerve）实现审计与因果识别的分离。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑器可能分别满足每个区域性的合理性约束，但没有任何单一的潜在解释能匹配完整输出。现有方法缺乏对这种局部到全局不一致性的系统性检测与量化框架。
AI.method: 框架将审计与因果识别分离：仅凭共享外生性可耦合所有机制边际分布；外部证人的合理性关系则提供图像特征的尖锐部分识别界限。利用Helly型论证为拟凸损失、异质行动层和有限证人图谱提供短不兼容性证书；用阻塞超图公式计算精确修复数量；为机制边际分布构建联立置信域以提供覆盖完整识别区间的有限样本保证。
AI.result: 在受控MNIST、Morpho-MNIST和smallNORB数据集上验证了预测的局部-全局分离现象；合成实验检验了尖锐界限、证书恢复和结构化计算的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法用于审计声明的特征关系，而不识别无限制的像素级反事实。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Reliability of Explainable Artificial Intelligence for RhythmFormer Remote Photoplethysmography
summary: Background. Remote photoplethysmography estimates the cardiovascular pulse from facial video, and its explanations have rested on inspecting heatmaps rather than on quantitative evidence about where a model reads it. We quantified the explanations and asked whether such explanations transfer between datasets and track model performance. Method. We trained eight condition-specific RhythmFormer models on NCKU-rPPG, recorded under three illumination levels, speaking, rotation, and cycling, estimated one heart rate per 5.12-second clip, and set them beside a UBFC-rPPG reproduction. Raw attention, rollout, attention flow, and Beyond Intuition were assessed by skin coverage and the Salience-guided Faithfulness Coefficient (SaCo). Results. Beyond Intuition ranked highest on both datasets, at median coverage 0.789 and SaCo 0.837 on Static level 3 against 0.826 and 0.917 on UBFC-rPPG; lower ranks differed. Within one participant of one condition, neither measure was related to a clip's heart-rate error, waveform correlation, or signal-to-noise ratio on either dataset: 186 of the 252 coefficients fell below $|ρ|=0.10$ and 28 reached $p<0.05$ against the 13 expected by chance. Across the eight scenarios only Beyond Intuition's coverage followed the three performance measures, at $ρ=-0.43$, $+0.57$, and $+0.43$, while the attention-only methods' SaCo ran opposite to each. It failed at 40 lux alone, its median coverage falling to 0.180 and its median SaCo to $-0.178$, whereas motion degraded the estimates far more without such a drop. Conclusions. Skin coverage and SaCo carry information complementary to the performance measures rather than a proxy for them: attributing to the skin does not guarantee an accurate estimate. What an attribution reveals about a condition is where the model looks rather than how faithfully its map is ordered.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了远程光电容积描记（rPPG）深度学习模型的解释性归属（attribution），发现皮肤覆盖率和SaCo指标携带与模型性能互补而非替代的信息，模型是否关注皮肤并不能保证心率估计准确。
AI.motivation: 以往对rPPG模型的解释多依赖热图视觉检查，缺乏关于模型在何处读取心血管脉冲信号的定量证据。作者旨在量化这些解释，并探究解释是否能在数据集间迁移、是否与模型性能相关。
AI.method: 在NCKU-rPPG（三种光照水平、说话、旋转、骑行共8种条件）上训练了8个条件特异性的RhythmFormer模型，每个5.12秒片段估计一次心率，并与UBFC-rPPG复现模型对比。使用原始注意力（raw attention）、rollout、attention flow和Beyond Intuition四种归属方法，以皮肤覆盖率（skin coverage）和显著度引导保真系数（SaCo）进行评估。
AI.result: Beyond Intuition在两个数据集上排名最高（Static level 3中位覆盖率为0.789、SaCo为0.837；UBFC-rPPG上为0.826和0.917），较低排名因数据集而异。在同一参与者单条件内，两种度量与单片段心率误差、波形相关性或信噪比均无相关：252个系数中186个低于|ρ|=0.10，仅28个达到p<0.05（随机期望为13）。跨8种场景，仅Beyond Intuition的覆盖率与三种性能指标相关（ρ=-0.43、+0.57、+0.43），而纯注意力方法的SaCo方向反而相反。在40 lux光照下该方法失败，覆盖率和SaCo中位数分别降至0.180和-0.178，而运动造成的退化并未伴随此类下降。
AI.conclusion: 皮肤覆盖率和SaCo携带的信息与性能度量互补而非代理——归属到皮肤并不能保证估计准确。归属能揭示的是模型在何种条件下看哪里，而非其图的有序性在多大程度上忠实于模型。

title: Remember and Reweight: Enhancing Multi-Agent Debate with Experience Memory and Confidence Estimation
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models by having multiple agents iteratively refine their responses through discussion. However, MAD suffers from a critical vulnerability known as shared misconception: when a majority of agents initially converge on an incorrect answer, the debate process tends to amplify rather than correct the error. Existing methods primarily address peer skew but leave the agents' inherently biased concept priors unaddressed. To mitigate this systematic weakness, we propose R$^2$-MAD (Remember and Reweight for Multi-Agent Debate), a framework that equips agents with an experience memory accumulated from past debates. R$^2$-MAD intervenes on both failure modes through two complementary mechanisms: A debate-state-aware retrieval policy dynamically calibrates the concept prior by retrieving relevant historical evidence based on the current consensus level. Then these retrieved experiences provide a basis for estimating per-agent reliability, yielding confidence weights to modulate peer influence. Experiments on various benchmarks show that R$^2$-MAD achieves consistent improvements over existing single-agent and MAD baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R²-MAD框架，通过为多智能体辩论系统配备经验记忆库，同时引入辩论状态感知的检索策略和基于经验的重加权机制，来缓解多数智能体初始收敛于错误答案时被放大的"共享误解"问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论（MAD）虽能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但存在"共享误解"的关键漏洞：当多数智能体初始收敛于错误答案时，辩论过程往往放大而非纠正错误。现有方法主要应对同伴偏差（peer skew），但未从根本上解决智能体本身固有的概念先验偏差。
AI.method: R²-MAD通过两种互补机制作用于两类失败模式：(1) 辩论状态感知的检索策略——根据当前共识水平动态检索历史辩论中的相关证据，以校准概念先验；(2) 利用检索到的经验估计每个智能体的可靠性，生成置信权重来调节同伴影响力。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，R²-MAD相比现有的单智能体和MAD基线方法取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: R²-MAD通过"记忆+重加权"双重机制有效缓解了多智能体辩论中的共享误解问题，填补了现有方法在智能体内在概念先验偏差处理上的空白。

title: Coupled Scaling: A Representational Accessibility Framework for Neural Scaling Laws
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/quintonvina/coupled-scaling/tree/v1.0-reanalysis
summary: Existing theories derive neural scaling from data geometry or a specified data-model spectrum, but systems trained on the same data can scale differently when architecture or optimization changes the representations they can efficiently reach. We introduce Coupled Scaling, a task-conditioned framework in which finite-budget scaling depends on the relation between task structure and the geometry accessible to an architecture-optimization system. In a solvable mode-truncation model, loss separates into target energy outside architectural support and an unresolved supported tail. For an arbitrary priority order, the residual lies between the best-N supported tail and the tail beyond the largest completed high-value prefix. If the cumulative-tail and coverage log-rates are $γ_{A,T}$ and $ρ_{A,O,T}$, the residual exponent lies in $[ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T},γ_{A,T}]$. Under bounded off-prefix gain, the completed prefix is rate-determining and $α_{A,O,T}=ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}$; for $a_{A,T,j}\asymp j^{-b_{A,T}}$, this gives $α_{A,O,T}=ρ_{A,O,T}(b_{A,T}-1)$. A fixed-kernel specialization derives the training-time exponent from the near-zero tail of a task-weighted spectral measure defined independently of the loss fit. The framework separates architectural support from finite-budget acquisition and motivates two tests: static task-relevant geometry should track loss at a common budget, while multiscale geometry should track coupling-specific exponent ordering, including reversal across contrasting tasks. An audit of released emergence trajectories identifies the controls needed for a direct factorial test that measures geometry separately from the scaling fit.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种"耦合缩放"框架，用于解释在相同数据上训练的不同架构-优化系统为何会出现不同的神经缩放指数。该框架将缩放定律与任务结构与系统可达几何之间的关系联系起来，推导出残差指数在由覆盖率和累积尾部对数速率限定的区间内，并提出了两种可测试的预测及审计方案。
AI.motivation: 现有理论将神经缩放归因于数据几何或指定的数据-模型谱，无法解释为何相同数据上不同架构或优化方式会导致不同的缩放行为。需要一种任务条件下的框架来统一捕捉架构支撑与有限预算获取之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 提出任务条件下（task-conditioned）的耦合缩放框架。在可解模式截断模型中将损失分解为架构支撑外的目标能量和未解决的支撑尾部。推导残差指数界于[ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}, γ_{A,T}]之间；在有限离前缀增益下得到α=ργ；固定核特化中从任务加权谱测度的近零尾部导出训练时间指数。框架将架构支撑与有限预算获取分离，并提出两类测试（静态几何追踪损失、多尺度几何追踪指数排序）。
AI.result: 推导出残差指数公式α_{A,O,T}=ρ_{A,O,T}γ_{A,T}（有界离前缀增益时），对于a_{A,T,j}≍j^{-b}，指数为ρ(b-1)。将缩放系数分解为架构覆盖性质（γ、b）与优化覆盖速率（ρ）的乘积。通过审计公开涌现轨迹数据，识别出直接析因测试所需的控制条件。
AI.conclusion: 缩放指数不是数据的固有属性，而是任务结构、架构支撑和优化覆盖能力三者耦合的结果。该框架为分离几何测量与缩放拟合提供了可操作的实验设计方向。

title: The Dually Flat Geometry of Planning as Inference
summary: We present an alternative characterization of the occupancy measure of reinforcement learning, obtained by embedding the planning criterion into the dynamics through a resetting planning process. Its stationary measure, which we term visitation measure, is the object on which the information geometry of decision making is most naturally expressed. The achievable visitation measures form a dually flat statistical manifold whose two affine charts are the visitation probabilities and the log-policies, dual under the conditional entropy. This structure makes planning-as-inference generalize from linear rewards to nonlinear functionals of the visitation, each iterate solved by one natural-gradient step, and gives the temporal-difference error the interpretation of a marginal-utility estimate. We develop the geometry and its consequences for reinforcement learning and theoretical neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种驻留测度（visitation measure）作为强化学习中占用测度的替代表征，通过将规划准则嵌入动力学的重置规划过程得到。驻留测度构成了一个对偶平坦统计流形，使规划即推理（planning-as-inference）从线性奖励推广到访视的非线性泛函。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中占用测度的传统表征在表达决策的信息几何时不够自然，作者希望寻找一种更本质的对象来统一规划、推理与非线性奖励下的决策问题。
AI.method: 作者将规划准则嵌入动力学中，构造一个带重置的规划过程，其平稳测度即驻留测度。可达到的驻留测度集合构成一个对偶平坦统计流形，其两个仿射坐标为驻留概率和对数策略，二者在以条件熵为对偶函数的框架下互为对偶。
AI.result: 该结构使得规划即推理方法从线性奖励推广到访视的非线性泛函，每次迭代仅需一个自然梯度步即可求解；时间差分误差被赋予了边际效用估计的几何解释。
AI.conclusion: 作者开发了这一几何框架及其在强化学习和理论神经科学中的推论，表明对偶平坦流形结构为理解决策中的信息几何提供了统一视角。

title: ARCOS: Zero-shot Boundary Localization for Corneal Layer Segmentation Across Optical Coherence Tomography Devices
summary: Accurate segmentation of corneal layers in optical coherence tomography (OCT) is essential for quantitative assessment of corneal morphology, including layer thickness and structural changes associated with disease or surgery. However, automatic segmentation remains challenging because corneal interfaces are thin, affected by speckle noise, and variable across acquisition devices. In this work, we propose ARCOS, a patch-based zero-shot boundary localization framework for corneal layer segmentation in clinical anterior-segment OCT images. Rather than performing conventional region classification, the method predicts boundary heatmaps for the main corneal interfaces from overlapping native-resolution patches. Patch-level predictions are stitched across the full B-scan and converted into boundary locations to obtain continuous, anatomically ordered layer segmentations. The network combines multi-scale feature fusion with a self-conditioned refinement module that uses intermediate boundary information to improve local heatmap predictions while preserving spatial detail. The method was evaluated on clinical OCT images acquired from multiple devices and compared with representative segmentation baselines using boundary localization and derived thickness metrics. The proposed method achieved an off-by-one boundary localization accuracy of 95.1% and a mean absolute boundary error of 0.514 pixels on the matched-device test set. In zero-shot cross-device evaluation, it maintained an average off-by-one accuracy of 84.3% and a mean absolute boundary error of 0.855 pixels across unseen acquisition devices, outperforming the baseline models. Thickness estimates derived from the predicted boundaries showed low error across corneal regions, supporting the method's use for quantitative corneal OCT analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARCOS，一种基于补丁的零样本边界定位框架，用于眼前段光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像中的角膜层分割。该方法通过预测角膜界面的边界热力图而非传统区域分类，结合多尺度特征融合与自条件细化模块，在多设备临床数据上实现了高精度边界定位和零样本跨设备泛化。
AI.motivation: 角膜层在OCT图像中的自动分割具有重要临床价值，但由于角膜界面薄、受散斑噪声影响且在不同采集设备间存在差异，自动分割仍然具有挑战性。现有方法难以同时兼顾高精度边界定位与跨设备泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出ARCOS框架：(1) 采用基于重叠原生分辨率补丁（patch）的方式预测角膜主要界面的边界热力图，而非传统区域分类；(2) 将补丁级预测拼接至整个B扫描并将其转换为边界位置，获得连续且解剖有序的层分割结果；(3) 网络结合多尺度特征融合与自条件细化模块，利用中间边界信息改善局部热力图预测同时保留空间细节；(4) 采用零样本评估策略，在未见过的设备上进行跨设备泛化测试。
AI.result: 在匹配设备测试集上，方法实现了95.1%的off-by-one边界定位准确率和0.514像素的平均绝对边界误差。在零样本跨设备评估中，在未见过的采集设备上保持了84.3%的平均off-by-one准确率和0.855像素的平均绝对边界误差，优于基线模型。基于预测边界得出的厚度估计在不同角膜区域均显示较低误差。
AI.conclusion: ARCOS证明了基于边界热力图的零样本分割方法在角膜OCT层分割中的有效性，不仅在多设备临床数据上实现了高精度边界定位，还展现出良好的跨设备泛化能力，支持用于定量的角膜OCT分析。

title: </think> Doesn't Stop Reasoning: Analysis of Spurious CoT Termination
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large reasoning models (LRMs) on complex tasks but often produces long, redundant traces. Recent training-free early-exit methods shorten these traces by choosing an intermediate point to stop reasoning. We study one such strategy that injects an end-of-think token (EoT, </think>) at this point to trigger the reasoning-to-answering transition, and find that the injected EoT does not always induce a clean answering phase. Answering-phase generation can continue before the model regenerates another EoT, with the span preceding this regenerated EoT scaling with the reasoning tokens saved by early exit and exhibiting continued reasoning behavior. We call this spurious CoT termination, where reasoning-like generation continues into the answering phase. We hypothesize that insufficient attention to the injected EoT contributes to spurious CoT termination and probe this hypothesis with Exit-token Attention Biasing (EAB). Across four LRMs, five benchmarks, and two early-exit methods, increasing attention to the injected EoT reduces spurious CoT termination and answering-phase length. These results reveal a limitation of controlling LRMs by externally matching their explicit think-block format. Inserting the EoT token conforms to this format but does not by itself guarantee the intended reasoning-to-answering transition. Our code is available at https://github.com/Seunghee-Koh/Spurious-CoT-Termination.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在推理大模型上通过注入</think>结束记号（EoT）实现训练无关的早停策略时，模型并不总是干净地切换到回答阶段——其回答阶段可能继续产生类似推理的内容，直到再次生成EoT。作者称之为"虚假思维链终止"，并提出"退出记号注意力偏置"（EAB）方法通过增强对注入EoT的注意力来缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 思维链推理虽能提升复杂任务的性能，但会产生冗长冗余的推理轨迹。训练无关的早停方法通过在中间点注入结束思考记号（</think>）来缩短推理轨迹，然而现有研究未充分验证注入EoT是否真正触发干净的推理到回答的转换，因此需要深入理解该机制失效的原因。
AI.method: （1）系统分析注入EoT后模型的行为，识别出"虚假思维链终止"现象——即回答阶段仍会继续生成推理式内容，直至模型自行重新生成EoT，且此跨度随早停节省的推理token数增长；（2）提出"注意力偏置至退出记号"（EAB）方法，在推理过程中增强对注入EoT的注意力权重，以促进干净的状态转换；（3）在四个大型推理模型、五个基准和两种早停方法上验证EAB的有效性。
AI.result: 实验表明，增强对注入EoT的注意力可显著减少虚假思维链终止和回答阶段长度，在四个LRM、五个基准和两种早停方法上均一致有效，验证了注意力不足导致虚假终止的假设。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一个关键局限：通过外部匹配显式think块格式来控制推理模型可能不可靠——注入EoT在形式上符合该格式，但并不能保证模型内部实现预期的推理到回答状态转换。这为设计更可靠的大模型控制机制提供了新视角。

title: WeatherNext 3: Increasing resolution and performance of global weather models with raw observations
summary: State-of-the-art AI weather models have shown impressive medium-range forecast skill and computational efficiency, but suffer two key shortcomings: their forecasts have lower spatial and temporal resolution than the best physics-based models and they are exclusively initialized with and trained on analysis data. As a result, they cannot directly make use of observations, and any biases in the analysis are inherited by the forecast. WeatherNext 3 addresses these shortcomings and establishes a new state-of-the-art for probabilistic medium-range forecasting skill. First, WeatherNext 3 generates new forecasts every hour (rather than every 6 hours like traditional global models) by ingesting low-latency geostationary satellite data. Second, WeatherNext 3's temporal and spatial resolution are on par with physics-based global models, with hourly time steps and 0.1 degree resolution for single-level variables, including solar radiation and cloud cover. Third, WeatherNext 3 moves beyond traditional analysis variables by learning to predict satellite-derived precipitation estimates, as well as tropical cyclone and station observations. Modelling sparse station data allows WeatherNext 3 to make 2m temperature and dewpoint predictions at any location and time, conditioned on local geographical features, with substantially lower error than competing global models, even when evaluated against unseen stations. Together, WeatherNext 3's capabilities move operational AI-based weather forecasting beyond emulating the traditionally distinct stages of data assimilation, forecasting and post-processing, which helps to further push the frontier of performance and granularity for global weather prediction.

AI.tldr: WeatherNext 3是一个新一代AI天气预测模型，通过直接利用低延迟卫星数据每小时生成预报，实现与物理模型相当的时空分辨率（小时级时间步长、0.1度空间分辨率），并可预测卫星降水估计、热带气旋和站点观测数据，建立了概率中期预报的新基准，将AI天气预报从传统的数据同化-预报-后处理的仿真模式推向更一体化、更高效的范式。
AI.motivation: 现有顶级AI天气模型存在两个关键缺陷：一是预报的空间和时间分辨率低于最好的物理模型；二是它们仅用分析数据初始化和训练，无法直接利用观测数据，分析数据中的偏差会被预报继承，限制了模型的性能和实用性。
AI.method: WeatherNext 3通过三个关键创新解决上述问题：(1) 摄取低延迟地球静止卫星数据，实现每小时（而非6小时）生成一次新预报；(2) 将时间分辨率提升至小时级、单层变量空间分辨率提升至0.1度，与物理全球模型持平，覆盖太阳辐射和云量等变量；(3) 超越传统分析变量，学习预测卫星反演降水估计、热带气旋和站点观测，通过建模稀疏站点数据，结合局部地理特征，实现任意位置和时间的2m温度和露点预测。
AI.result: WeatherNext 3在概率中期预报技能上达到了新的最优水平。在对未见站点的评估中，其2m温度和露点预测误差显著低于竞争性全球模型。模型在时间分辨率（每小时）、空间分辨率（0.1度）和变量覆盖范围上均与物理模型看齐甚至超越。
AI.conclusion: WeatherNext 3展示了AI天气预报可以从仿真传统"数据同化-预报-后处理"三阶段模式的局限中解放出来，通过直接融合观测数据实现更一体化的预测流程，在性能和颗粒度上进一步推动全球天气预报的前沿。

title: LLM4CKD: Large Language Models for Early Stage Chronic Kidney Disease Screening
summary: Early screening of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is critical for timely intervention, yet most machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches require labeled data and model training, limiting their use in real-world screening settings. This study evaluates the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) for CKD screening under zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning settings and compares them with traditional ML and DL methods. We propose a framework that uses clinically selected tabular features and structured prompt templates to enable LLM-based inference without task-specific training. LLM performance is evaluated across multiple prompt styles, feature configurations, and data settings, and compared with standard ML, DL, and tabular foundation model (TFM) baselines, and existing CKD screening tools. The results show that LLMs can achieve competitive performance using only a small number of examples, often matching or outperforming traditional approaches in low-data settings. However, their performance remains model-dependent and less stable as input complexity increases. In contrast, ML, DL, and TFM models show more consistent improvement with larger training data. Overall, the findings highlight a trade-off between data efficiency and stability, suggesting that LLMs may serve as a flexible complementary approach for CKD screening when labeled data are limited.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在零样本和少样本上下文学习设置下进行慢性肾脏病（CKD）筛查的效果，并与传统机器学习和深度学习方法进行对比。结果表明LLMs在少量样本下能达到有竞争力的表现，但在低数据场景下提供补充性方案的同时存在稳定性和模型依赖性方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾脏病的早期筛查对及时干预至关重要，但大多数机器学习/深度学习方法需要标注数据和模型训练，限制了其在真实筛查场景中的应用。作者希望通过LLM的上下文学习能力，在没有任务特定训练的情况下实现CKD筛查。
AI.method: 提出一个基于临床筛选的表格特征和结构化提示模板的框架，使LLM无需任务特定训练即可进行推理。在多种提示风格、特征配置和数据设置下评估LLM性能，并与传统ML、DL、表格基础模型（TFM）基线以及现有CKD筛查工具进行对比。
AI.result: LLMs仅需少量示例即可达到有竞争力的表现，在低数据场景下常常匹配或超越传统方法。但LLM性能具有模型依赖性，且随输入复杂度增加而变得不稳定；相反，ML、DL和TFM模型在更多训练数据下表现出一致的改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了数据效率与稳定性之间的权衡，表明LLMs在标注数据有限时可作为CKD筛查的灵活补充方法，但需注意其模型依赖性和稳定性问题。

title: Do Video Generators Track the World Across Segments? A Benchmark and Method for World-State Reasoning in Video Continuation
summary: Video generators build long videos by composing shorter parts, either by generating segments one after another or by autoregressively extending chunks. Each new part usually depends on memories of historical observations, such as recent frames, selected key frames, memory banks, or cached features. These memories preserve visible evidence from the past, but current generators do not reliably turn such evidence into a world-state interface: what holds in the video world after previous actions and how it should change under the next prompt. A past frame remains valid history, but it may not describe the state needed by the next segment; some states must instead be inferred from occluded or implicit changes rather than copied from a directly observed frame. This creates a simple but overlooked question for video continuation: given a previous video, its prompt, and a new prompt, can a model generate a continuation that reflects the state determined by both the historical video and the new prompt? To answer this question, we introduce Statebench, a benchmark that targets this gap by testing continuations over three state categories: past-visible states, occluded-process states, and complex-transition states. We further propose Stateagent, which explicitly maintains an entity-state representation, updates it under the new prompt, grounds the predicted post-action state as a future end frame, and renders the next video. Experiments show that our method improves controlled video continuation by raising the all-case state score (SCS-All) from 45.2 to 69.3, and also benefits story generation at the one-minute scale. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/StateAgent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Statebench基准测试和Stateagent方法，用于解决视频续生中"世界状态"的确立问题——即生成器能否基于历史视频和新提示推断出当前世界状态并正确续写视频。Stateagent通过显式维护实体状态表示、在新提示下更新状态、将预测的动作后状态作为未来结束帧锚定，并将SCS-All从45.2提升到69.3。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成器通过记忆（最近帧、关键帧、记忆库、缓存特征）保留历史观测证据，但无法将这些证据可靠地转化为"世界状态接口"——即前序动作后世界处于什么状态、新提示下应如何变化。过去帧是有效历史，但不一定描述下一段所需的状态；某些状态需从遮挡或隐式变化中推断而非直接复制。这引出一个被忽视的关键问题：给定历史视频、历史提示和新提示，模型能否生成符合两者共同决定状态的续集。
AI.method: 提出Statebench基准，覆盖三类状态：过去可见状态、遮挡过程状态、复杂转换状态。提出Stateagent方法，显式维护实体状态表示，在新提示下更新该表示，将预测的动作后状态锚定为未来结束帧，并据此渲染下一段视频。
AI.result: Stateagent将全场景状态得分（SCS-All）从45.2提升至69.3，在帧级和分钟级故事生成任务上均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式实体状态建模而非仅依赖历史帧记忆，可以显著提升受控视频续生的状态一致性和长期故事生成质量，填补了视频生成中世界状态接口缺失的空白。

title: The Impact of Synthetic Data Augmentation on Discourse-Pragmatic Function Classification
summary: Synthetic data augmentation has become a common strategy for addressing class imbalance in NLP, but most approaches focus on the quantity and diversity of generated examples rather than their geometric relationship to real training data. We investigate this question in the context of discourse pragmatic function classification, a task where data sparsity is a structural feature rather than a collection artefact. Using 410 manually annotated instances of the English word look drawn from the British National Corpus, spanning four functions: Attention Signal, Directive, Discourse Marker, and Interjection. We generate synthetic training examples with Llama 3.1 and partition them by their cosine distance from real training data in RoBERTa embedding space. We compare six training conditions that differ in the placement of synthetic examples relative to the empirical decision boundary, while holding augmentation quantity constant across conditions. All augmented conditions improve macro F and accuracy over the real only baseline, but core proximal examples (NEAR) yield the largest gains in macro F (0.113), while a distance balanced mix achieves the highest accuracy (0.748). No condition improves AUC, indicating that augmentation shifts the decision boundary rather than improving the model's underlying probability estimates. These findings suggest that where synthetic examples land in representation space matters as much as how many are generated, with implications for low resource pragmatic classification more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成数据增强中生成样本与真实训练数据之间的几何关系对分类性能的影响。针对话语语用功能分类这一结构性数据稀缺任务，基于410条人工标注的英语词"look"语料，使用Llama 3.1生成合成训练样本，并按其在RoBERTa嵌入空间中与真实数据的余弦距离进行分区。对比六种训练条件后发现：所有增强条件均优于仅用真实数据的基线，其中核心邻近样本(NEAR)带来最大macro F增益(0.113)，而距离平衡混合方案获得最高准确率(0.748)；但所有条件均未改善AUC，表明增强改变了决策边界而非底层概率估计质量。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据增强研究多关注生成样本的数量和多样性，而忽视了生成样本与真实训练数据在表示空间中的几何关系。该研究旨在探究合成样本在表征空间中的位置（相对于真实数据和经验决策边界）如何影响分类性能，尤其是在话语语用功能分类这类结构性数据稀疏的任务中。
AI.method: 使用Llama 3.1生成合成训练样本，将样本按其在RoBERTa嵌入空间中与真实训练数据的余弦距离进行分区，区分NEAR（核心邻近）、FAR（远距）等不同区域。设计六种训练条件，这些条件中合成样本相对经验决策边界的位置不同，同时保持各条件的增强样本数量恒定。基于410条来自英国国家语料库(BNC)的带注释"look"实例，覆盖Attention Signal、Directive、Discourse Marker和Interjection四种语用功能。
AI.result: 所有增强条件在macro F和准确率上均优于仅真实数据基线。NEAR条件（核心邻近样本）产生最大的macro F增益(0.113)；距离平衡混合方案获得最高准确率(0.748)。没有任何条件改善AUC，表明增强仅移动决策边界而未提升模型底层的概率估计质量。
AI.conclusion: 合成样本在表征空间中的"落点"位置与生成的"数量"同等重要。这一发现对低资源语用分类任务具有启示意义：在构建数据增强策略时，需考虑合成样本与真实数据的几何关系及其相对于决策边界的分布，而非仅仅追求样本的数量和多样性。

title: Neural-Network Maxent: a general extension with learned nonlinearity, applied to time-series for Desert Locust distribution modelling
summary: Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) is essential for understanding how environmental conditions shape biodiversity, particularly for destructive pests such as the Desert Locust (Schistocerca gregaria), whose breeding dynamics are tightly coupled to rapidly evolving environmental conditions. Maxent has become the dominant method for presence-only data, but its reliance on a linear combination of hand chosen feature transforms limits its ability to capture the nonlinear, temporal relationships common in ecological monitoring, where covariates such as precipitation, soil moisture, and vegetation indices evolve meaningfully over time. Standard implementations flatten time-series covariates into independent features, discarding sequential structure that carries critical signal. We introduce RNN Maxent, an extension of the Maxent framework that replaces the fixed feature dictionary with a neural network, specifically a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), trained end to end via backpropagation. The approach preserves Maxent's presence only statistical foundations, background normalization, and probability calibration, differing only in that the nonlinearity is learned from data rather than fixed in advance. We apply RNN Maxent to map suitable habitat for the Desert Locust using 50 day environmental time series derived from ERA5 Land, MODIS, and Sentinel 3, maintaining a 7 day gap between covariates and presence records to yield forecasting behavior. Compared against standard Maxent, RNN Maxent improves performance across metrics (ROC AUC 0.862 std 0.036 vs. 0.792; F1 0.671 std 0.056 vs. 0.590).

AI.tldr: 本文提出RNN Maxent，一种将Maxent框架中的固定特征词典替换为GRU神经网络的扩展方法，用于沙漠蝗虫栖息地适宜性预测。该方法在50天环境时间序列（ERA5 Land、MODIS、Sentinel 3）上训练，较标准Maxent在ROC AUC（0.862 vs 0.792）和F1（0.671 vs 0.590）上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 标准Maxent依赖手工选择的线性特征组合，无法捕捉生态监测中常见的时间序列协变量（如降水、土壤湿度、植被指数）之间的非线性时序关系。现有实现将时间序列展平为独立特征，丢弃了重要的序列结构信息。
AI.method: RNN Maxent保留了Maxent的presence-only统计基础、背景归一化和概率校准，仅将固定特征词典替换为GRU神经网络，通过反向传播端到端训练。应用到沙漠蝗虫时使用50天环境时间序列，并设置协变量与存在记录之间7天的间隔以实现预测行为。
AI.result: 相比标准Maxent，RNN Maxent在所有评估指标上均有所提升：ROC AUC从0.792提高到0.862（std 0.036），F1从0.590提高到0.671（std 0.056）。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习数据而非预先固定非线性特征，RNN Maxent能够更有效地利用时间序列的结构信息，显著改善沙漠蝗虫栖息地适宜性预测的准确性，展示了一种结合深度学习与传统SDM统计基础的可行路径。

title: InSituMeasure: Probing Situated Measurement Grounding in Industrial Scenes with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: For trained operators, gauge reading requires little specialized knowledge, low cognitive effort, and high repeatability. Yet Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable in continuous-valued measurement despite strong results on general multimodal benchmarks. Existing benchmarks expose this weakness but isolate measurement from realistic, knowledge-grounded settings, with limited situated context, specialized instruments, real-world noise, and matched diagnostic annotations, reducing realism and constraining root-cause analysis. We introduce InSituMeasure to evaluate situated measurement grounding. It contains 2,922 real industrial monitoring scenes across eight functional categories of professional engineering instruments, with dense gauge-attribute annotations and noise tags for failure diagnosis. We define metrics for numerical accuracy under predefined tolerances and unit consistency, rejection of fake or unanswerable tasks, and alignment between model failures and annotated error factors. Across 24 state-of-the-art MLLMs, the best model reaches only 25.7\% joint value-unit accuracy and 51.8\% confidence-diagnosis F1, revealing a substantial gap between general multimodal competence and reliable situated measurement. Further analysis identifies failures from text-induced shortcuts, overconfident responses, and authentic industrial noise, including mixed disturbances, viewpoint deviation, occlusion, and environmental interference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InSituMeasure基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在真实工业场景中的仪表读数测量能力。该基准包含2,922个真实工业监控场景、八类专业工程仪表、密集的表针属性标注和噪声标签。在24个SOTA MLLM上，最佳模型联合数值-单位准确率仅达25.7%，揭示通用多模态能力与可靠情境化测量之间仍存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM虽然在通用多模态基准上表现优异，但在连续值测量任务上不可靠。已有基准虽暴露了这一弱点，但未能将测量任务置于真实、基于知识的情境中，缺少情境上下文、专业仪器、真实噪声和匹配的诊断标注，降低了真实感并限制了根因分析。
AI.method: 构建了InSituMeasure基准，包含2,922个真实工业监控场景，覆盖八类专业工程仪器的功能类别，配备密集的仪表属性标注和用于故障诊断的噪声标签。设计了三个维度的评估指标：容差下的数值精度与单位一致性、对虚假/不可回答任务的拒绝能力、模型失败与标注错误因素间的对齐程度。
AI.result: 在24个SOTA MLLM上的评估中，最佳模型仅达到25.7%的联合数值-单位准确率和51.8%的置信度-诊断F1分数。失败分析识别出文本诱导的捷径、过度自信响应以及真实工业噪声（混合干扰、视角偏移、遮挡、环境干扰）引起的失败。
AI.conclusion: InSituMeasure揭示了通用多模态能力与可靠情境化测量之间的显著差距，为测量接地（measurement grounding）任务的失败提供了细粒度诊断视角，可作为推动MLLM走向可靠专业场景应用的基准资源。

title: CoFiE: Coarse-to-Fine Evidence Selection for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires Vision Language Models (VLLMs) to process growing video streams and answer user questions under tight latency constraints. Existing methods improve efficiency through token pruning and memory-bank schemes, but mainly reduce visual tokens after visual encoding. Consequently, downstream token pruning alone cannot substantially reduce end-to-end latency because the expensive frame encoding cost has already been incurred. We propose CoFiE, a Coarse-to-Fine Evidence Selection framework that decouples evidence selection into a coarse, query-agnostic filtering stage before the vision encoder and a fine, query-specific refinement stage during LLM prefill. CoFiE introduces Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering to retain visually distinctive candidate frames and Query-Specific Evidence Refinement to select the frames most relevant to the user query. This design removes substantial redundancy before frame encoding while preserving query-specific refinement once semantic information becomes available. Experiments show that CoFiE establishes a new state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple video understanding benchmarks, reaching 78.86% accuracy on StreamingBench and 68.72% on OvO-Bench, with improvements of up to 3.15% over prior methods. Even with up to 80% evidence-frame filtering, CoFiE outperforms strong open-source multimodal models while improving end-to-end inference latency by up to 2.54 times.

AI.tldr: CoFiE是一个粗到细的证据选择框架，通过在视觉编码器之前进行查询无关的粗粒度帧过滤、在LLM预填充期间进行查询特定的细粒度精炼，显著降低了流式视频理解的端到端延迟，同时保持甚至提升准确率，在多个基准上达到新的SOTA精度-效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解VLLM方法主要通过token剪枝和记忆库方案来优化效率，但这些方法都是在视觉编码之后才减少视觉token，而昂贵的帧编码成本已经产生，因此无法从根本上缩短端到端延迟。作者提出在视觉编码前就进行证据筛选，以解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: CoFiE采用两阶段解耦的证据选择框架：(1) 粗粒度阶段——在视觉编码器之前执行新颖性引导的帧过滤（Novelty-Guided Frame Filtering），保留视觉上有区分度的候选帧；(2) 细粒度阶段——在LLM预填充期间执行查询特定的证据精炼（Query-Specific Evidence Refinement），基于语义信息选择与用户问题最相关的帧。该设计在帧编码前移除大量冗余，同时在语义信息可用时保留查询特定的精炼能力。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到新的SOTA精度-效率权衡：StreamingBench准确率78.86%，OvO-Bench准确率68.72%，比先前方法最高提升3.15%。即使在过滤高达80%的证据帧时仍优于强开源多模态模型，端到端推理延迟最高提升2.54倍。
AI.conclusion: CoFiE证明将证据选择提前到视觉编码之前能够在不牺牲甚至提升精度的前提下大幅降低端到端延迟，为流式视频理解中的高效架构设计提供了新的范式。

title: Enhancing Financial Question Answering: A Novel Benchmark Dataset of Banks' financial statements
summary: The comparative analysis of banks' financial statements poses significant challenges for automated question answering systems due to their complexity, substantial length, technical language, and inhomogeneity of both textual and numerical content across different jurisdictions and institutions. We introduce FinRAG-QA, a novel benchmark dataset for financial question answering, which comprises 999 practitioner-curated questions on 10 standardised indicators, grounded in 209 annual and Pillar 3 reports from 24 major European and U.S. banks spanning 2019-2023. Unlike prior financial QA benchmarks, which centre on U.S. filings and single-institution analysis, FinRAG-QA targets cross-institutional retrieval over documents averaging 198k words, longer than any existing financial QA resource. On this benchmark we evaluate a multi-stage RAG pipeline and isolate the contribution of each component. Contextual chunk enrichment combined with a retrieval-optimised embedding model raises NDCG@10 from 0.322 to 0.710; conditional on the ground truth being retrieved, a reasoning-optimised generator raises answer accuracy from 44.6% to 79.0% (+34.4 percentage points), at roughly 20x the generation latency. We further show that cross-encoder reranking degrades retrieval when the first-stage ranking is already strong, and that a single top-ranked chunk outperforms larger contexts at generation time. Experiments were run in late 2024-early 2025 with the models available at that time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinRAG-QA，一个针对银行财务报表跨机构检索问答的新基准数据集，包含999个从业者构建的问题，覆盖24家欧美主要银行的209份年度及Pillar 3报告。论文在多阶段RAG流水线上对各组件进行消融分析，发现上下文分块增强结合检索优化的嵌入模型使NDCG@10从0.322提升至0.710；在正确上下文已检索到的条件下，推理优化的生成器可将答案准确率从44.6%提升至79.0%（+34.4个百分点），但生成延迟约为20倍。此外，交叉编码器重排在首阶段排序已很强时会损害检索性能，单条top-1分块在生成阶段优于更大的上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有金融问答基准聚焦于美国申报文件和单一机构分析，无法覆盖银行财务报表的复杂性、长篇幅（平均19.8万词）、技术性和跨机构、跨司法辖区的异构性，亟需一个面向跨机构检索的真实场景基准。
AI.method: 构建包含999个从业者筛选问题、10个标准化指标、24家欧洲和美国银行2019-2023年间209份报告的多阶段RAG基准；评估并分解每个组件（上下文分块增强、检索优化嵌入模型、推理优化生成器、交叉编码器重排、上下文长度）对端到端性能的独立贡献。
AI.result: 上下文分块增强+检索优化嵌入模型将NDCG@10从0.322提升至0.710；条件于正确上下文被检索到时，推理优化生成器将答案准确率从44.6%提升至79.0%（+34.4pp），但延迟约为20倍；交叉编码器重排在首阶段已很强时反而降低检索效果；单条top-1分块优于更大上下文。
AI.conclusion: FinRAG-QA填补了长文档跨机构金融QA基准的空白；通过组件级消融揭示了RAG流水线中各阶段的权衡（准确率与延迟），并提示重排和上下文扩展并非越多越好，需根据首阶段检索质量动态选择策略。

title: On the Interaction Between Model Compression and Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Deep neural networks deployed in the wild must be both efficient and adaptable, requiring model compression and test-time adaptation (TTA). While both are well studied in isolation, their interaction remains poorly understood. We systematically analyze how structured compression affects a model's ability to adapt under distribution shift. Using ResNet-18 and ViT-Base on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C, we evaluate multiple compression methods combined with standard TTA techniques. We introduce a diagnostic framework that examines representational expressivity and adaptation subspace compatibility. Our results reveal a consistent gap: although compressed models retain high accuracy under supervised adaptation, their TTA performance degrades significantly with increasing compression. We show that this stems from reduced representational diversity and structural constraints that limit recoverability. These effects strongly depend on the compression method, highlighting the need to design compression strategies that preserve adaptability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了模型压缩与测试时自适应（TTA）之间的交互关系，发现压缩模型虽在监督自适应下保持高精度，但其TTA性能随压缩加剧而显著下降，根源在于表征多样性降低和结构约束限制了可恢复性，且不同压缩方法影响差异显著。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在实际部署中既需要高效又需要可适应，通常需同时进行模型压缩和测试时自适应（TTA）。虽然两者各自被广泛研究，但它们之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文基于ResNet-18和ViT-Base在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C数据集上，结合多种压缩方法与标准TTA技术进行系统评估，并引入一个诊断框架来分析表征表达能力和自适应子空间兼容性。
AI.result: 研究发现压缩模型与未压缩模型之间存在一致的性能差距：虽然压缩模型在监督自适应下仍保持较高精度，但其TTA性能随压缩程度增加而显著退化。这种退化源于表征多样性降低以及结构性约束限制了模型的可恢复能力，且效果强烈依赖于具体采用的压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: 压缩方法对模型的适配性有显著影响，未来需要设计能够保持模型可适应性的压缩策略，而不仅仅是追求高精度和高压缩率。

title: FLY-EVAL++: An Evidence-Driven Evaluation Protocol for Safety-Constrained Flight Prediction with Large Language Models
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical, physics-governed environments requires more than accuracy-based metrics, because predictions that are numerically close to the ground truth can still violate operational constraints, combine fields in physically inconsistent ways, or fail to produce usable structured outputs. Existing evaluation protocols do not measure these failure modes reliably. We propose FLY-EVAL++, an evidence-driven evaluation protocol that combines deterministic verification of protocol compliance, physical feasibility, and safety constraints with fixed rubric-guided aggregation into interpretable multi-dimensional scores. We instantiate FLY-EVAL++ for Flight Trajectory and Attitude Prediction (FTAP) by extending the PilotBench setting with history-conditioned and multi-step prediction tasks. Across 66 LLMs, safety compliance is the most discriminative dimension of model behavior: models with comparable predictive performance differ by more than 28 points in safety score, and we observe recurrent failures including safety violations under physically plausible predictions and instability in multi-step rollouts. These results show that evaluation in safety-critical domains should measure constraint satisfaction and structured validity explicitly rather than rely on accuracy-centric reporting alone.

AI.tldr: 提出FLY-EVAL++评估协议，结合确定性验证与固定评分规则聚合，在飞行轨迹与姿态预测任务中对66个LLM进行多维评估，发现安全合规是区分模型行为最具判别力的维度，模型间安全分数差距可达28分以上。
AI.motivation: 现有评估协议过度依赖准确率指标，无法可靠衡量安全关键、物理约束环境中LLM的失败模式。数值上接近真实值的预测仍可能违反运行约束、在物理上不一致或产生不可用的结构化输出，而现有评估方式无法捕捉这些缺陷。
AI.method: 提出FLY-EVAL++证据驱动评估协议，包括：(1)对协议合规性、物理可行性和安全性约束进行确定性验证；(2)通过固定评分规则引导聚合为可解释的多维分数。在PilotBench基础上扩展，加入历史条件和多步预测任务，构成FTAP（飞行轨迹与姿态预测）实例化场景。
AI.result: 在66个LLM上的评估表明，安全合规是最具判别力的行为维度：预测性能相近的模型在安全分数上差异超过28分。同时观察到反复出现的失败模式，包括物理上看似合理但违反安全的预测，以及多步推演中的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 安全关键领域的评估应显式度量约束满足和结构化有效性，而非仅依赖以准确性为核心的报告。FLY-EVAL++提供了一种可解释、可区分、可迁移的多维评估框架。

title: A Circuit for Plural Reference: How LLMs Represent and Retrieve Singular and Plural Entities
summary: Coreference resolution is an important task in contextual reasoning. In this paper, we investigate the mechanism for representing and retrieving singular and plural entities for plural reference. We use a combination of mechanistic interpretability and attention pattern analysis to study the process in which LLMs predict a pronoun to refer back to previously mentioned entities. Using a range of causal intervention techniques, we find a set of attention heads that are responsible for (1) representing coreference information in the input, (2) identifying entities that form a plural reference, (3) transferring the information to the component that is responsible for selecting the antecedents and predicting the pronoun. We also find that LLMs align with humans in preference for plural pronoun. Specifically, entities in a plural construction are more likely to be referred to as a plural entity if they are ontologically similar and are linked by the conjunction "and".

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制可解释性和注意力模式分析，研究了大语言模型在复数指代消解中如何表示和检索单数及复数实体，并通过因果干预手段识别了负责核心指代信息表征、复数实体识别和信息传递的关键注意力头。
AI.motivation: 指代消解是上下文推理中的重要任务，理解LLM如何在复数指代场景中表示和检索实体，对于揭示模型内部工作机制以及评估其与人类认知的一致性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 结合机制可解释性与注意力模式分析，运用一系列因果干预技术，研究LLM预测指代先前提及实体的代词的过程，并识别负责不同功能（信息表征、复数实体识别、信息传递）的注意力头。
AI.result: 发现了一组负责三类功能的注意力头：表示输入中的核心指代信息、识别构成复数指代的实体、将信息传递到负责选择先行词并预测代词的部分。此外，发现LLM在复数代词偏好上与人类一致——当实体在存在论上相似且由连词"and"连接时，更倾向于被视为复数实体来指代。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备可分离的神经回路来处理复数指代消解，且其行为与人类在复数代词的语义偏好上具有一致性，这一发现有助于深入理解LLM的上下文推理机制。

title: Local Updates, Global Learning (LUGL): Playing Games with non-incremental Learners
summary: The dominance of Neural Networks (NNs) in RL is partially due to their incremental learning capability, which naturally suits the online, non-stationary nature of self-play training. However, gradient-boosted trees like LightGBM are widely recognised as the state of the art for tabular data in supervised learning, often outperforming NNs in accuracy and efficiency. Game states are inherently tabular---discrete actions, categorical card identities, structured board positions---which makes them an ideal candidate for tree-based methods. We introduce LUGL (Local Updates, Global Learning), a framework that decouples data collection from model fitting, enabling non-incremental learners such as GBTs to operate in RL settings where they would otherwise fail due to distributional shift. LUGL alternates between a local updates phase, where the agent plays self-play games and accumulates tabular updates (Q-values, V-values, policies, or regret values) in a finite table, and a global learning phase, where the table is used to train a function approximator that generalises to unseen states before the table is reset. We test our approach in four standard perfect-information games (Tic-tac-toe, Connect-4, Othello, and Hex) and five imperfect-information games (Kuhn's poker, Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, Goofspiel, and Flop5 Hold'em), and show that our results are competitive with or superior to DQN and DeepCFR. Our experiments demonstrate that the community's strong bias towards NNs in game-playing may be unwarranted, since LightGBM-based agents achieve competitive or superior performance across all tested benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUGL框架，将数据收集与模型拟合解耦，使梯度提升树等非增量学习器（如LightGBM）能够应用于强化学习的自博弈训练中，在完美信息与不完美信息博弈中均取得与DQN和DeepCFR相当或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在强化学习中的主导地位部分源于其增量学习能力，但梯度提升树（如LightGBM）在表格型监督学习中通常优于神经网络。博弈状态本质上是表格型的（离散动作、分类卡牌身份、结构化棋盘位置），然而非增量学习器因分布漂移问题无法直接用于RL。作者旨在挑战社区对神经网络在博弈中的强烈偏好。
AI.method: LUGL框架包含两个交替阶段：(1) 本地更新阶段（local updates）：智能体进行自博弈，将Q值、V值、策略或后悔值等表格型更新累积到有限表中；(2) 全局学习阶段（global learning）：利用该表格训练函数逼近器以泛化到未见过状态，随后重置表格。该设计使非增量学习器（如GBT）得以在RL场景中工作。
AI.result: 在四个完美信息博弈（井字棋、四子棋、黑白棋、六子棋）和五个不完全信息博弈（Kuhn扑克、Leduc德州扑克、骰子游戏、Goofspiel、Flop5德州扑克）中测试，基于LightGBM的智能体在所有基准上与DQN和DeepCFR相比表现具有竞争力或更优。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明社区对神经网络在博弈中的强烈偏见可能缺乏依据，梯度提升树方法在跨多种博弈基准上能够取得与神经网络竞争甚至更优的性能。

title: Instruction Duplication as an Inference-Time Control Primitive
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables. Code and frozen reproduction artifacts: https://github.com/victorlavrenko/answer-engineering/releases/tag/instruction-duplication-arxiv-v1
summary: Procedural instruction following is a basic requirement for controllable language-model systems, especially when generated trajectories are inspected or repaired downstream. We introduce instruction duplication, a minimal black-box inference-time control that repeats only the procedural instruction, without retraining or decoding changes. Across seven instruction-tuned models, 300 medical multiple-choice questions, eight placement conditions, and 16,800 scheduled generations, moving from one to two copies raises the deterministic All-8 diagnostic--responses passing all eight observable tests--from 90.22% to 93.17% (+2.95 percentage points), eliminating 30.2% of the failures remaining after one copy. Pre-provisional TF-IDF recall rises from 73.44% to 74.81% (+1.38 points; Holm-adjusted p < .001), while final-answer accuracy remains exactly 60.21%. Premature commitment increases from 1.52% to 2.30% (p_Holm = .00536). A blinded challenge audit yields 10/30 directional confirmations, 20/30 perceptual ties, and no reversals; its prespecified 28/30 confirmation criterion is not met. Yet this distinction can matter operationally when a downstream system acts on the generated trajectory. In Answer Engineering (AE), where explicit trajectory state determines local repair, the published reason-first no-editing SSNHL endpoint was 25.1%; system-only AE was later reproduced at 84.2%, and the same trailing duplicate raised it to 97.1%. For conductive diagnostic branch preservation, the corresponding values are 58.9% published without editing, 78.6% with reproduced AE, and 73.8% with AE plus duplication--a within-AE decrease, but still 14.9 points above the no-editing baseline. Instruction duplication is therefore a low-complexity, placement-sensitive control whose practical value can emerge through the downstream system that consumes the exposed trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指令重复（instruction duplication），一种仅重复程序性指令的黑盒推理期控制方法，无需重训或改动解码。在7个指令微调模型、300道医学选择题、8种位置条件和16,800次生成实验中，从1份指令增加到2份可使All-8诊断从90.22%提升至93.17%，消除1份后剩余失败的30.2%，但最终答案准确率保持不变（60.21%）。未经盲审预定的确认标准（28/30），且效果取决于下游系统是否消费暴露的轨迹。在Answer Engineering下游系统中可显著提升（84.2%→97.1%），但在特定分支场景中操作域内反而下降（78.6%→73.8%），说明该方法具有低复杂度和位置敏感性。
AI.motivation: 过程性指令遵循是可控语言模型系统的基本要求，尤其在轨迹需被下游检查或修复的场景中。作者希望探索一种无需重训或解码改动的最小黑盒推理期干预方式，以提升模型对程序性指令的遵循度。现有方法通常需要额外训练或修改解码策略，作者寻找一种更轻量且具有实际操作意义的控制手段。
AI.method: 指令重复（instruction duplication）：仅将程序性指令重复一次（从1份增到2份），不涉及任何重训或解码层改动。实验设计包括：7个指令微调模型、300道医学多选问题、8种指令放置条件和16,800次计划性生成。评估指标包括确定性All-8诊断（通过全部8项可观察测试）、前置TF-IDF召回、最终答案准确率、过早承诺发生率；并通过盲审挑战审计和Answer Engineering（AE）下游系统进行验证。
AI.result: 从1份到2份指令，All-8诊断从90.22%提升至93.17%（+2.95pp），消除1份后剩余失败的30.2%；TF-IDF召回从73.44%升至74.81%（+1.38pp，Holm校正p<.001）；最终答案准确率精确保持60.21%不变；过早承诺从1.52%升至2.30%（p_Holm=.00536）。盲审获得10/30方向性确认、20/30感知平局、无逆转，但未达到预先设定的28/30确认标准。在AE场景中，系统单独AE为84.2%，加尾随重复指令升至97.1%（对比无编辑基线25.1%）；但在传导分支保护中，单独AE为78.6%，加重复后降至73.8%（仍高于无编辑基线58.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 指令重复是一种低复杂度、位置敏感的黑盒控制方法。其统计显著性虽在盲审中未达预定标准，但在下游系统消费暴露轨迹时具有操作层面的实际价值。效果不均匀——某些场景（如AE）中显著提升，某些分支场景中在AE内部反而降低，因此实用性取决于具体下游系统及轨迹消费方式。

title: Opening mind by opening architecture: analysis strategies
comment: Presented at the 7th International Csound Conference (ICSC 2024), Vienna, September 2024
summary: In numerical signal processing for electroacoustic composition, the progressive loss of specific development and research environments caused by the increasing use of digital market tools has favoured the dominance of the closed-architecture audio processor model. This model, while powerful, envisions the possibility of describing output data about its perceived characteristics, but at the cost of ignoring its internal process and interacting systems, which become complex, powerful environments but closed in an inscrutable black box, a loss we must consider. Any digital signal processing technique tells a story. Just as the words of a language incorporate social, historical and technical polysemic layers, a signal processor has its own story of implementation, a gradual technological achievement with its inevitable aesthetic consequences. Through the looking-glass of literature, one can access those environments with renewed awareness by reestablishing a scientific method and an attitude to research. In this specific case, starting from the case study of Manfred Schroeder's historical reverbs, we illustrate the process of building analytical evaluation tools, as well as practical implementation, at the basis of a conscious study path.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨电子音乐数值信号处理领域中，封闭架构音频处理器模型占主导地位导致的研究环境流失问题，并以Manfred Schroeder的历史混响器为案例，阐述建立分析评估工具和实践实现方法的过程，以重建科学研究方法。
AI.motivation: 数字市场工具的普及导致特定开发和研究环境逐渐消失，封闭架构音频处理器模型虽强大但如"黑箱"，忽略内部处理过程与交互系统。作者认为任何数字信号处理技术都承载着实现的历史与美学后果，需要通过文学视角（文献调研）重新建立科学方法和对研究的审视态度，以意识化的方式研究这些环境。
AI.method: 以Manfred Schroeder的历史混响器为案例研究，通过文献研究进入这些封闭环境的内核，构建用于分析评估的工具（analytical evaluation tools），并进行实践性实现（practical implementation），以此为基础开展有意识的研究路径。
AI.result: 文章展示了一个基于文献研究、分析工具构建和实际实现相结合的有意识研究路径，使得研究者能够以更新颖的认知方式接触那些被封闭架构掩盖的数字信号处理环境。
AI.conclusion: 研究者需要通过文献回顾和重建科学方法来穿过"黑箱"，恢复对数字信号处理环境内部机制及其美学后果的自觉理解，这对于电子音乐创作中的声学处理和学术研究具有重要意义。

title: Extracting Forgotten Prompts from Targeted Unlearned Models
summary: Recent unlearning methods (e.g. NPO, DPO, LUNAR) make use of refusal alignment to suppress forgotten data.
