AI.tldr: VestigeKV提出了一种针对长生命周期KV缓存的无训练压缩方法：利用NoPE MLA模型中已被重新利用为显著性通道的64维解耦分支（RoPE的残留）作为查询无关的驱逐信号，仅读取每行11%即可将缓存分为"被关注层"与GPU驻留的"归档层"（精确移动而非删除），在8k至65k上下文下实现8x压缩时检索保持1.00、32x时0.92，且该方法仅在NoPE模型中有效（RoPE下退化为0.08）。
AI.motivation: 长生命周期KV缓存必然在将来读取它的查询存在之前就被压缩，而基于观测注意力的选择方法（H2O、SnapKV）在此场景完全失效（NoPE MLA模型上针检索仅0.00-0.33），因为token的重要性此时尚未被观测到。这暴露了"无查询条件下的压缩信号从何而来"这一核心难题。
AI.method: VestigeKV利用缓存自身已携带的查询无关信号：NoPE训练将64维解耦分支（RoPE的一种残留/痕迹）重新塑造成显著性通道。通过读取每行11%的数据将缓存分区：top-m行保留在被关注层（attended tier），其余行被精确移动（而非删除）到GPU驻留的归档层（archive），该归档层可通过认证触发器逐步访问。无需训练、量化或权重/内核改动。
AI.result: 性能无可测量损耗：8x压缩下检索保持1.00，32x下0.92，覆盖8k至65k上下文，与全行选择零差距。32x时被关注层仅占Kimi Linear每token缓存8.1KB中的0.25KB；归档层保持位精确且GPU驻留（VRAM回收变体为主机卸载）。召回层（标准配置）在128x下保持1.00。RoPE MLA上相同操作退化为0.08（普通驱逐为0.42），证明该查询无关显著性仅在无旋转时存在；所有阈值均在数据前冻结。
AI.conclusion: VestigeKV证明了NoPE模型的RoPE残留分支可被重新利用为一种免费的、查询无关的显著性信号，使得无查询条件下的KV精确压缩在实践上无损可行。该方法具有NoPE独占性——query-universal精确合并已被证明在RoPE下不可能实现。其可能推广到使用NoPE Gated-MLA变体的Kimi K3，但作者仅基于已测量模型声明，不作超出范围的推广断言。

title: Concept of a Sensor Test Environment for Dusty Agricultural Conditions
summary: Dust in agriculture presents a significant challenge for autonomous agricultural machinery. Dust can impair the performance of sensors and algorithms. This work, therefore, presents a concept for a proving ground consisting of an indoor and outdoor area. The indoor area comprises a laboratory test bench where dust circulates in a closed system and a test hall where life-size objects can be placed. The outdoor area features dedicated test setups that enable reproducible data to be recorded with and without dust during real-world agriculture work. The proving ground and the setups are visualized in 3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于农业机械粉尘测试的试验场概念，包含室内和室外两个区域。室内区域配有实验室测试台（封闭循环粉尘系统）和测试大厅（可放置实物），室外区域设有专用测试装置，可在实际农业作业中记录有/无粉尘条件下的可重复数据。整个试验场以3D方式可视化。
AI.motivation: 农业粉尘会损害自主农业机械的传感器和算法性能，但目前缺乏专门用于测试粉尘影响的试验设施，因此需要建立一个可控且可重复的试验场来评估和改善农业机械在粉尘环境下的性能。
AI.method: 设计了一个两部分的试验场概念：室内部分包括(a)一个封闭循环粉尘系统的实验室测试台，以及(b)一个可放置实物大小物体的测试大厅；室外部分设置了专用测试装置，能够在真实农业作业过程中分别在有粉尘和无粉尘条件下采集可复现的数据。全部设施通过3D可视化呈现。
AI.result: 该论文提出了一个包含室内（实验室测试台+测试大厅）和室外（可重复的粉尘测试装置）的试验场完整概念设计，并完成了3D可视化展示。目前停留在概念层面，尚未报告实际测试结果。
AI.conclusion: 该试验场概念为评估农业粉尘对自主农机传感器和算法的影响提供了系统的测试解决方案，兼具室内可控性和室外真实性的优势，为后续实际建设与测试奠定了基础。

title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
summary: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function. At compile time, teacher models generate task-specific examples that are used to train a small adapter for a compact interpreter. The resulting function runs without the teachers and can be stored, versioned, and composed like ordinary software. On FuzzyBench-Hard, a subset on which the Program-as-Weights fast compiler produced no exact matches, compile by training reaches 83.6% semantic accuracy. This higher accuracy comes with a higher compile-time cost: roughly a minute rather than seconds for the fast compiler. We deploy the compiler in a public interactive service and demonstrate compiled functions in a multi-site website helper, a language-controlled 3D avatar, and a bidirectional English-Claudish translator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"编译式训练"方法，将自然语言规范转化为可复用的神经函数。编译阶段由教师模型生成任务特定示例，训练一个小型适配器用于紧凑解释器，得到的函数无需教师模型即可运行，可像普通软件一样存储、版本化和组合。"编译式训练"在FuzzyBench-Hard上达到83.6%的语义准确率，优于仅产生部分精确匹配的方案，但编译时间约需一分钟，高于快速编译器的秒级耗时。
AI.motivation: 许多重复性的文本功能规则难以用规则实现，而每次输入都调用大型远程模型会带来重复成本、延迟和对服务提供商的依赖。需要一种能将自然语言描述转化为可复用、低成本、无外部依赖函数的方法。
AI.method: 方法分为两阶段："编译时"由教师模型（大型模型）生成针对特定任务的示例数据，用这些示例训练一个小型适配器，该适配器基于紧凑的解释器运行；编译后的函数在推理时无需教师模型，可离线运行并像普通软件一样存储、版本控制和组合。
AI.result: 在FuzzyBench-Hard数据子集（Program-as-Weights快速编译器未产生exact match的子集）上，编译式训练达到83.6%的语义准确率。但编译成本更高：约需一分钟而非快速编译器的数秒。该方法已部署于公开交互服务，并在多场景验证：多站点网站助手、语言控制的3D虚拟形象以及双向英-克劳迪什翻译器。
AI.conclusion: 编译式训练以更高的编译时成本换取更高的推理准确率，实现了从大模型驱动的运行时推理到可复用、可部署的小型函数编译的转变，在无需持续依赖外部大模型的情况下保持较高语义准确性。

title: OSR: Output Space Redistribution for Adaptive Label Removal in Classification Models
summary: Label removal occurs frequently in classification systems with evolving taxonomies, where categories must be dynamically updated or eliminated. To accommodate such changes, classification models must adapt accordingly. Existing solutions, broadly categorized as retraining-based and feature-space-adjustment-based, share common limitations despite their variations, including reliance on access to original data, substantial computational and storage costs, inconsistent results, poor scalability, and degradation of model utility. To address this, we propose a novel approach that leverages statistical redistribution in the output space to approximate the post-removal confidence vectors of a retrained model. Applicable as a modular output filter, our method bypasses the burden of feature-space adjustments or loss-function convergence, alleviating scalability limitations. Furthermore, by requiring only existing labels and prior output confidences, the method potentially mitigates privacy concerns inherent to data-dependent solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against full retraining, with improvements in computational efficiency and privacy preservation across several classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于输出空间统计重分布的标签移除方法，作为模块化输出过滤器近似重训练模型的置信向量，无需重新训练或特征空间调整，兼顾效率与隐私。
AI.motivation: 分类系统在标签动态演化的场景中常需移除标签，现有方法（重训练法和特征空间调整法）均存在对原始数据依赖、计算与存储开销大、结果不一致、扩展性差及模型效用下降等共同缺陷，亟需一种更高效、可扩展且保护隐私的标签移除方案。
AI.method: 提出一种利用输出空间统计重分布来近似重训练后置信向量的方法。该方法作为模块化输出过滤器直接作用于现有分类模型的输出，无需特征空间调整或损失函数收敛，仅需现有标签及先验输出置信度即可实现标签移除。
AI.result: 在多个分类任务上的大量实验表明，该方法与完整重训练相比具有竞争力的性能，同时在计算效率和隐私保护方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过避免数据依赖和降低计算成本，有效克服了现有标签移除方案的核心局限性，为演化分类体系下的标签移除提供了高效且隐私友好的可行方案。

title: OctWorld: Long-Range World-Consistent Video Generation with Octree-Based 3D Mapping
summary: We present OctWorld, a video diffusion framework with persistent 3D memory for generating explorable, world-consistent, and high-fidelity visual scenes. Given a single image, OctWorld performs stable autoregressive world generation along user-specified camera trajectories. We focus on long-range generation, characterized by extended camera paths and wide viewpoint coverage, where preserving spatial consistency is particularly challenging when previously generated regions are revisited. To address this problem, we introduce OctMap, an extensible and spatially adaptive 3D memory that progressively fuses generated visual observations and their corresponding depth maps into a global representation. OctMap employs TSDF fusion within a dynamic sparse octree whose spatial resolution adapts to image evidence. This design preserves geometric and appearance details across diverse scene scales while maintaining low memory overhead. Experiments demonstrate that OctWorld generates long-range, spatially consistent videos and outperforms prior methods on both existing benchmarks and challenging long-range generation settings. OctMap also provides clear advantages over point-based caches and fixed-resolution TSDF volumes. Project page: https://maxtirerror.github.io/octworldpage/

AI.tldr: 本文提出OctWorld，一个带有持久3D记忆的视频扩散框架。它从单张图像出发，沿用户指定的相机轨迹进行自回归世界生成，利用新颖的OctMap（一种基于动态稀疏八叉树和TSDF融合的空间自适应3D记忆）来保持长距离生成中跨视角的空间与外观一致性，在生成效果和内存效率上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长距离视频世界生成面临两大挑战：一是相机轨迹长、视点覆盖广，当模型重新访问之前生成的区域时难以保持空间一致性（即“回看”时几何与外观容易漂移）；二是现有方法（如点云缓存或固定分辨率的TSDF体积）在表达复杂场景时精度或内存开销存在明显局限。因此需要一个既精密又高效、可随图像证据自适应扩展的3D记忆机制。
AI.method: OctWorld将视频扩散模型与OctMap结合。OctMap是一种可扩展且空间自适应的3D记忆：它将生成的视觉观测及其对应深度图渐进地融合进一个动态稀疏八叉树表示的全局场景中，每个树节点使用TSDF融合进行几何重建；八叉树的空间分辨率根据图像证据（观测密度与细节）自适应调整，从而在大跨度场景尺度下保留几何和外观细节并控制内存开销。视频扩散模型以该记忆为条件，实现沿用户相机轨迹的稳定自回归生成。
AI.result: 实验表明OctWorld能够生成长距离、空间一致的视频，在现有基准和更具挑战性的长距离生成设定上均优于此前方法。OctMap相较于点云缓存和固定分辨率TSDF体积具有明显优势。项目页面已开放。
AI.conclusion: 持久且空间自适应的3D记忆（OctMap）是解决长距离视频扩散生成中空间一致性漂移问题的有效方案，在精度与内存效率上取得良好平衡，为可探索、世界一致的高保真视觉场景生成提供了一条可行路径。

title: RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models
comment: 28 pages, 13 numbered figures, 9 tables; full-page graphical abstract and supplementary material included. Submitted to the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association (JAMIA)
summary: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-independent detectors on held-out splits. Environment, noise, and adversarial transforms are swept over predefined hyperparameter grids. Each run reports sample- and event-level sensitivity, precision, F1, false positives per 24 h, Lead and Lag onset timing, and Monte Carlo dropout predictive agreement. RobustSeiz includes a Dockerized GPU pipeline, experiment registry, and full-evaluation and research-subset modes. We demonstrate the framework with a contemporary seizure detector on TUSZ across the complete implemented shift grid; an AWGN analysis illustrates how perturbation severity changes detection quality, onset timing, and predictive agreement. RobustSeiz provides a shared benchmarking standard for evaluating seizure-detector robustness under realistic clinical stressors, extending pre-deployment assessment beyond clean-data accuracy.

AI.tldr: RobustSeiz是一个开源、模型无关的框架，用于在临床驱动的分布偏移（环境、噪声和对抗性变换）下对癫痫发作检测器进行标准化压力测试和比较，弥补了现有检测器仅关注干净数据性能、忽视真实世界可变性的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的癫痫发作检测器在训练集（held-out EEG数据）上表现良好，但在真实世界的采集变异性、伪迹和对抗性输入下可能失效。缺乏标准化、可复现的方案来评估检测器在部署前的稳健性。
AI.method: 将四个公开头皮EEG语料库（CHB-MIT、TUSZ、Siena、SeizeIT1）标准化为BIDS-EEG树结构；采用受试者独立的评估协议；在预定义的超参数网格上扫描环境、噪声和对抗性变换；提供样本级和事件级的灵敏度、精确率、F1、每24小时假阳性、发作起止延迟、Monte Carlo dropout预测一致性等指标；包含Docker化的GPU流水线、实验注册表和两种运行模式（完整评估与研究子集）。
AI.result: 用一个当代癫痫检测器在TUSZ数据集上完成了完整移位网格的演示；AWGN分析展示了扰动严重程度如何影响检测质量、起止时间和预测一致性。
AI.conclusion: RobustSeiz为评估癫痫检测器在真实临床压力源下的稳健性提供了共享的基准标准，将部署前评估扩展到干净数据准确性之外。

title: Sparse auto-regressive modeling for scene generation from multi-view images
summary: Generating complete 3D scenes from sparse, unconstrained views is a fundamental challenge in 3D vision which requires reasoning beyond observed content while remaining computationally tractable. Existing feed-forward reconstruction methods are inherently limited to content visible in the input images, while 3D generative modeling is hindered by the high computational cost of dense volumetric representations and the scarcity of large-scale 3D supervision. We introduce SPAR3S, a sparse voxel-aligned 3D latent generative model for conditional scene completion without requiring ground-truth 3D data for supervision. Our key insight is to formulate 3D scene generation in a structured, compact, voxel-aligned 3D latent space where only occupied voxels are represented. We learn this sparse latent space directly from multi-view images using photometric supervision via differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting. Given a partial set of observed voxels encoded from sparse input views, scene completion reduces to predicting the missing latent tokens and their spatial support within the voxel grid. To this end, we train a masked autoregressive transformer that jointly models voxel occupancy and latent token values, enabling efficient and spatially consistent generation of unseen regions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on synthetic indoor scenes, achieving higher novel-view quality than prior work. We further validate its generalization on RealEstate10k, highlighting its applicability to real-world data.

AI.tldr: SPAR3S是首个无需3D真值标注的稀疏体素对齐3D潜变量生成模型，通过可微3D高斯泼溅的光度监督学习紧凑的稀疏体素潜空间，并利用掩码自回归Transformer联合建模体素占用与潜token值，实现从稀疏无约束视角的3D场景补全。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏无约束视角生成完整3D场景是3D视觉中的基础挑战，需在超越可见内容的推理与计算可处理性之间取得平衡。现有前馈重建方法局限于输入图像可见内容，而3D生成建模受限于稠密体素表示的高计算成本和大规模3D监督数据的稀缺。
AI.method: SPAR3S通过三个关键组件实现条件场景补全：(1)构建结构化、紧凑的体素对齐3D潜空间，仅表示被占用的体素；(2)通过可微3D高斯泼溅的光度监督，直接从多视图图像学习该稀疏潜空间而无需3D真值； (3)训练掩码自回归Transformer联合建模体素占用和潜token值，将场景补全转化为在体素网格中预测缺失的潜token及其空间支撑。
AI.result: 在合成室内场景中实现了优于先前工作的新视角生成质量，并在RealEstate10k上验证了对真实世界数据的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明利用稀疏体素对齐的3D潜空间配合掩码自回归建模，能够在无需3D监督的条件下高效、空间一致地生成未观察区域，为条件3D场景补全提供了可行方向。

title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce diffusion-augmented LLMs, a new class of models that defines an AR model distribution while using diffusion to draw multiple tokens in parallel from that distribution. We decouple the parameters of these models into two sets: AR weights, trained using the standard NTP objective, and lightweight diffusion weights, trained to generate multiple tokens simultaneously. The diffusion weights are learned through a simple Diffusion Distillation phase that adds negligible overhead to existing LLM training pipelines. We also introduce $Ψ$-Spec, a family of samplers that enables lossless acceleration and inference-time scaling at a fixed context length. Unlike speculative decoding, our method requires no separate draft model. Unlike diffusion LLMs (d-LLMs), it accelerates generation without sacrificing the quality of the underlying AR model. The resulting models, called Uno, can be trained from scratch or built by augmenting existing open-weight AR LLMs. Uno achieves higher throughput than leading speculative-decoding methods at every evaluated batch size and delivers up to $3\times$ speedups over the base AR model, including at the largest batch size supported by the device. Notably, our 8B Uno model outperforms the leading open d-LLM, the 26B DiffusionGemma, and the proprietary Mercury 2 across all evaluated benchmarks in agentic tool use, coding, and long-context reasoning. We release code and checkpoints at: https://s-sahoo.github.io/uno/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的模型类别"扩散增强LLM"，其定义一个自回归模型分布但利用扩散过程并行从该分布中抽取多个token。提出的Ψ-Spec采样器族可实现无损加速和固定语境长度下的推理时扩展。所构建的Uno模型在吞吐量上超越领先的投机解码方法，8B版本在多个基准上优于26B DiffusionGemma和Mercury 2。
AI.motivation: LLM的成功依赖于下一个token预测（NTP），但自回归架构需要逐token顺序生成，导致生成速度缓慢，成为推理瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 提出扩散增强LLM，将参数解耦为AR权重（用标准NTP目标训练）和轻量级扩散权重（用于并行生成多token，通过扩散蒸馏阶段学习）。2) 提出Ψ-Spec采样器族，支持无损加速和推理时扩展。3) 与传统投机解码不同，无需独立草稿模型；与扩散LLM不同，在不牺牲底层AR模型质量的前提下加速生成。
AI.result: Uno在每个评估批次大小上都比领先的投机解码方法获得更高吞吐量，相对基础AR模型获得高达3倍加速（包括设备支持的最大批次）。8B Unomodel在agentic工具使用、编码和长上下文推理的所有评估基准上均优于26B DiffusionGemma和Mercury 2。
AI.conclusion: Uno可从零训练或通过增强现有开源加权AR LLM构建，在保持自回归模型质量的同时实现显著的并行生成加速，且无需草稿模型。

title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models
summary: Camera-conditioned world models generate interactive videos in which commanded actions should induce the expected scene changes while appearance, geometry, and temporal dynamics remain coherent. Existing rewards assess these requirements separately: geometry-based rewards estimate trajectory execution but cannot judge the visual quality of the executed motion, whereas image-based rewards measure frame quality without capturing action execution or temporal dynamics. We posit that a vision-language model (VLM) offers a shared reasoning space for relating actions to their visual outcomes. However, judging a complete long video against its full action sequence creates a lengthy, noisy context in which short-lived local action evidence can be missed or diluted. We present WorldReward, a VLM-based pairwise preference reward model that unifies action-consistency and visual-quality evaluation for camera-conditioned world models. WorldReward decomposes paired videos into action-aligned chunks, organizes each chunk into structured visual evidence, and aggregates chunk-level decisions by voting into separate video-level action and visual-quality preferences. To train it, we construct a large-scale reasoning-augmented preference dataset using structured judgments generated by a frontier VLM and refined through tool-based agent auditing and targeted human review. We further introduce WorldReward-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark measuring reward-model agreement with human preferences across action consistency, appearance quality, and motion quality. WorldReward achieves the highest agreement on all three dimensions, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 3.42, 1.45, and 3.56 percentage points, respectively. When used for RL post-training of HY-WorldPlay 1.5, it consistently improves both action execution and visual quality across short- to long-term horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldReward,一种基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的成对偏好奖励模型,用于统一评估相机条件世界模型中的动作一致性和视觉质量。通过将视频分解为动作对齐的块并进行投票聚合,WorldReward在三项评估维度上均超越了GPT-5.5,并在RL后训练中同时改善了动作执行和视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励函数对相机条件世界模型的评估是割裂的:基于几何的奖励只能估计轨迹执行情况却无法判断动作执行的视觉质量,而基于图像的奖励虽能衡量帧质量却无法捕捉动作执行或时间动态。作者认为VLM提供了将动作与其视觉结果关联的共享推理空间,但直接对完整长视频进行全面动作序列判断会导致上下文冗长嘈杂,短时局部动作证据易被遗漏或稀释。
AI.method: WorldReward将成对视频分解为动作对齐的块,将每个块组织为结构化视觉证据,并通过投票将块级决策聚合为分离的视频级动作偏好和视觉质量偏好。训练时利用前沿VLM生成的结构化判断构建大规模推理增强的偏好数据集,并用基于工具的主体审计和针对性人工审核进行精炼。同时引入WorldReward-Bench人类标注基准,评估奖励模型与人类偏好的一致性度量为动作一致性、外观质量和运动质量三个维度。
AI.result: WorldReward在动作一致性、外观质量和运动质量三个维度上均取得与人类偏好最高的一致性,分别超过GPT-5.5达3.42、1.45和3.56个百分点。用于HY-WorldPlay 1.5的RL后训练时,在短到长时间范围内持续改善了动作执行和视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的块级分解与投票聚合策略能够有效统一世界模型中动作一致性与视觉质量的评估,该奖励模型不仅在基准上超越前沿模型,而且在实际RL训练中对世界模型产生实质性的性能提升,证明了其作为通用奖励机制的可行性和实用性。

title: A location-invariant estimator of extremal quantile treatment effects for heavy-tailed distributions
summary: Quantile treatment effects (QTEs) measure the effect of a treatment on the distribution of an outcome, and their estimation at extreme quantile levels is of central interest in applications where the target quantiles lie far beyond the range of the data. For heavy-tailed potential outcomes, existing extremal QTE estimators rely on extrapolation combined with a causal extreme value index (EVI) estimator, but the resulting estimator is not invariant under a common location shift of the potential outcome distributions, even though the population QTE is. We address this issue in two steps. First, we adapt the location-invariant Fraga estimator of the EVI to the causal setting using inverse propensity score weighting. Second, we replace the original extrapolation formula with a difference-based scheme, under which the location parameter cancels when quantile differences are taken. The resulting QTE estimator is therefore location invariant. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed extremal QTE estimators, and provide a consistent variance estimator, leading to asymptotically valid inference. A simulation study confirms the location invariance, the stability with respect to the threshold, and the coverage of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种位置不变的极端分位数处理效应(QTE)估计方法，结合因果极端值指数估计和差分式外推方案，解决了极端分位处理效应估计在潜在结果分布发生共同位置平移时不具备不变性的问题。
AI.motivation: 极端分位数水平的处理效应(QTE)在许多应用中至关重要，然而现有针对重尾潜在结果的极端QTE估计器依赖于外推与因果极端值指数的结合，但该估计器在潜在结果分布发生共同位置平移时并非不变（即使总体QTE是位置不变的），这导致估计结果不稳健。
AI.method: 采用两步策略：(1) 将位置不变的Fraga极端值指数估计器通过逆倾向得分加权适配到因果设定中；(2) 将原始外推公式替换为基于差分的方案，使位置参数在取分位数差时抵消。由此构建位置不变的极端QTE估计器，并推导其一致性与渐近正态性，提供一致的方差估计量。
AI.result: 建立了所提极端QTE估计量的一致性、渐近正态性及其一致方差估计量，可进行渐近有效的统计推断。模拟研究验证了该方法的位置不变性、对阈值选择的稳定性以及良好的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的位置不变极端QTE估计方法有效克服了现有方法的缺陷，在重尾数据的极端分位数处理效应推断中具有较好的理论保证和有限样本表现。

title: RARF: Region-Aware Rectified Flows for 3D Brain MRI Inpainting
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Preprint version corresponding to the initial submission prior to peer review, submitted as part of our participation in the BraTS 2026 Challenge. The final accepted version will be openly available in the official MICCAI proceedings on the conference website
summary: Medical image inpainting has the potential to improve automated brain MRI analysis by reconstructing healthy tissue within pathological regions. We introduce RARF, a task-agnostic region-aware rectified flow framework for masked data generation. We instantiate the framework for 3D brain MRI inpainting as our submission to the BraTS Inpainting Challenge 2026. RARF restricts the stochastic interpolation process to the inpainting region, while the observed voxels remain fixed and provide patient-specific anatomical context. A three-dimensional neural network receives the partially voided image, with Gaussian noise filling the missing region, together with the inpainting mask and the corresponding timestep. The model is trained using masked flow-matching and reconstruction-consistency objectives, combined with mask-aware preprocessing and data augmentation. During inference, the learned velocity field transports the initial noise toward a plausible reconstruction of the missing tissue, which is then combined with the unchanged observed anatomy. Experiments under the BraTS evaluation protocol show that the proposed approach produces competitive reconstructions while maintaining anatomical consistency. Source code is available at: https://github.com/TomasGuija/rarf.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RARF，一个任务无关的、区域感知的整流流框架，用于医学图像中的遮蔽数据生成。在BraTS 2026 Inpainting比赛中实例化为3D脑部MRI修复任务：随机插值过程被限制在病灶区域，观测体素固定不变以提供患者特定的解剖背景。训练结合遮蔽流匹配和重建一致性损失，推理时通过学习的速度场将初始噪声输送到合理的组织重建结果中。
AI.motivation: 医学图像修复能够通过在病理区域内重建健康组织来改善自动脑MRI分析，这是一项具有临床价值的需求。
AI.method: 提出RARF框架：1) 将随机插值过程限制在修复区域，保持观测体素不变以提供患者解剖上下文；2) 使用3D神经网络接收部分缺失的图像（缺失区域填充高斯噪声）、修复掩码和时间步；3) 采用遮蔽流匹配（masked flow-matching）和重建一致性目标联合训练；4) 结合掩码感知的预处理与数据增强；5) 推理时速度场将初始噪声变换为合理的组织重建并融合未改变的观测解剖结构。
AI.result: 在BraTS评测协议下，RARF产生了具有竞争力的重建结果，同时保持了解剖一致性。
AI.conclusion: 区域感知的整流流框架能够有效地实现病理性脑MRI区域的健康组织重建，具有良好解剖一致性，代码已开源。

title: Sharpening the Ensemble: An SSIM-Aligned Residual Refiner for Brain-MRI Inpainting Post-Processing
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI BraTS Local Synthesis of Brain Tissue Inpainting Challenge (Task 4), MICCAI 2026. 12 pages, 2 figures
summary: Brain-MRI inpainting replaces a masked region of a scan with synthesized, anatomically plausible healthy tissue, so that analysis tools built for healthy brains can be applied to images they would otherwise reject. On the BraTS local-synthesis benchmark, which ranks submissions on the structural similarity index (SSIM), the peak signal-to-noise ratio, and the mean squared error (MSE) jointly, the strongest recent models are accurate, but several report blurry synthesized regions and attribute this to the mean-seeking behavior of the $\ell_1$ and MSE terms in their training losses. We address this in post-processing, forming a deep ensemble of the two co-first-place 2025 models and training a lightweight residual refiner on the ensemble's own outputs under an $\ell_1$ loss augmented with a structural-similarity term whose weight $λ$ we vary. At a moderate $λ$ the refiner improves SSIM over the ensemble, from $0.8767$ to $0.8780$ on a held-out reproduction of the official scorer and from $0.8555$ to $0.8572$ on the official validation leaderboard, with essentially no change in MSE. The gain is small but consistent, improving $62.6\%$ of the held-out cases with a signed-rank $p=2.2\times10^{-7}$, whereas over-weighting the structural term reverses it. Two ablations bound the effect. Adding any third model to the two-model ensemble degrades it, and classical unsharp masking fails to improve SSIM at any strength (best $0.8765$ against $0.8767$), so the gain reflects learned rather than indiscriminate sharpening. The result is a cheap, reproducible post-processing stage that improves an already strong ensemble without any large-scale retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级后处理策略，通过在两个2025年BraTS局部合成基准共同第一名的模型组成的深度集成上训练残差精炼器（使用l1损失+结构相似性项），将SSIM从0.8767提升至0.8780（官方验证集从0.8555提升至0.8572），且不影响MSE。增益虽小但统计显著，消融实验证明集成模型优于添加第三个模型，学习式锐化优于经典非锐化掩模。
AI.motivation: 现有最强的脑MRI修补模型在BraTS局部合成基准上虽然准确，但生成的区域模糊。研究者将此归因于训练损失中l1和MSE项的均值寻求行为（mean-seeking behavior），导致生成结果过于平滑。作者希望在不进行大规模重新训练的情况下解决这一模糊问题。
AI.method: 将2025年两个共同位列第一的模型组成深度集成，在集成自身输出上训练一个轻量级残差精炼器，使用l1损失并加入结构相似性（SSIM）项，通过改变权重λ来调控精炼强度。此外进行了两组消融实验：向集成中添加第三个模型考察集成规模的影响，以及使用经典非锐化掩模（unsharp masking）作为基线对比。
AI.result: 在中等λ值下，精炼器将SSIM从0.8767提高到0.8780（内部复现的官方评分器）以及从0.8555提高到0.8572（官方验证排行榜），MSE几乎不变。62.6%的留出病例得到改善（符号秩检验p=2.2×10⁻⁷）。添加第三个模型会降低性能；经典非锐化掩模无论强度如何都无法超过集成基线（最优0.8765对比0.8767）。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了一种廉价、可复现的后处理阶段能够改善已有的强集成模型性能，无需大规模重新训练。收益虽小但具有统计一致性，且增益来源于学习式而非盲目式的锐化过程。

title: Conditioning Degenerate Diffusion Models
summary: Current conditioned generative models heavily rely on score functions for guidance during training. When the generative model is a diffusion process with a singular diffusion coefficient and the underlying (conditional) densities either do not exist or are not smooth, we use causal optimal transport to define \emph{approximate} loss functions that identify a minimum-entropy control for guidance under minimal assumptions. Our approach relies on causal optimal transport and its characterization through the predictable representation property of (conditioned) diffusion processes whose associated martingale problem is well posed, à la Üstünel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用因果最优传输定义近似损失函数，以替代传统条件生成模型中依赖得分函数（score function）的引导机制，适用于扩散系数奇异且条件密度不存在或不光滑的扩散过程。
AI.motivation: 当前条件生成模型严重依赖得分函数进行训练引导，但当生成模型是具有奇异扩散系数的扩散过程，且底层条件密度不存在或不光滑时，得分函数方法失效，需要更鲁棒的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用因果最优传输（causal optimal transport）定义近似损失函数，通过条件扩散过程的可预测表示性质（predictable representation property）进行刻画，并要求相关鞅问题是适定的（well posed），该框架根植于Üstünel的理论结果。
AI.result: 在最小假设条件下，所提出的近似损失函数能够识别出用于引导的最小熵控制（minimum-entropy control），有效规避了条件密度不存在或不光滑所带来的困难。
AI.conclusion: 因果最优传输为奇异扩散条件下的条件生成模型提供了一种理论上严密的引导机制，扩展了生成模型在非光滑/退化条件下的适用范围。

title: IchthyoNoma: Nomenclature and Context Sensitivity of Zero-Shot Biological Vision--Language Models for Bangladeshi Freshwater Fish Recognition
summary: Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as training-free species recognizers, but reported accuracy can reflect more than visual species knowledge. We audit CLIP, BioCLIP, BioCLIP2, and a multilingual Jina CLIP v2 control on seven freshwater-fish categories from two Bangladeshi sources (10,321 images). BioCLIP2 reaches 72.36% on BFF-15 with English common names and 68.91% on SylFishBD with scientific names, versus 25.15% and 14.40% for generic CLIP. BioCLIP2 Bengali prompts are near chance in balanced accuracy (14.22-14.29%); Jina partially recovers Bengali discrimination to 21.89% and 16.36%, but bare Bengali names return to 14.29% on both sources. Paired SylFishBD interventions show no significant weak-blur effect, modest losses from stronger blur/gray masking, a larger white-mask artifact, and strong species dependence. Zero-shot biological VLM scores therefore jointly reflect biological specialization, multilingual alignment, nomenclature, prompt formulation, and context.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了多种零样本视觉语言模型（CLIP、BioCLIP、BioCLIP2及多语言Jina CLIP v2对照）在孟加拉淡水鱼识别任务上的表现，发现BioCLIP2在英文/科学名称提示下显著优于通用CLIP，但孟加拉语提示下表现近乎随机；通过图像扰动实验揭示模型分数受生物专业度、多语言对齐、命名法、提示措辞及上下文等多种因素共同影响。
AI.motivation: 零样本VLM被广泛用作免训练物种识别器，但报告中的准确率可能并不能纯粹反映视觉物种知识，而是混杂了多种非视觉因素。作者希望厘清准确率究竟来自真正的生物视觉知识还是语言/提示/上下文等伪信号。
AI.method: 在来自孟加拉两个数据源的7个淡水鱼类别共10,321张图像上，对CLIP、BioCLIP、BioCLIP2及多语言Jina CLIP v2进行基准测试；采用英语常用名、科学名及孟加拉语等多种提示形式；同时对SylFishBD进行配对图像扰动干预（弱模糊、强模糊、灰度掩蔽、白掩蔽等）以分析上下文影响。
AI.result: BioCLIP2在BFF-15上以英语常见名达72.36%，在SylFishBD上以科学名达68.91%，远高于通用CLIP的25.15%和14.40%。孟加拉语提示下BioCLIP2的平衡准确率接近随机（14.22-14.29%），Jina可部分恢复至21.89%和16.36%，但纯孟加拉语名称在两个源上都回落到14.29%。扰动实验显示弱模糊无显著影响，强模糊/灰度掩蔽造成中等损失，白掩蔽产生更大伪影，且存在强烈物种依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 零样本生物VLM的准确率是生物领域专业化、多语言对齐、命名法选择、提示措辞与图像上下文等多种因素综合作用的结果，不能简单将其解读为纯粹的视觉物种知识能力。

title: Hardware-Aware FP4 FlashAttention-4
summary: Blackwell's 4-bit floating-point (FP4) tensor cores do not automatically make attention faster because softmax conversion and on-chip dependencies dominate once its matrix products shrink. We address this with \emph{Direct-P} for noncausal inference and a causal path that passes the forward quantization directly into backward. Direct-P maps scores directly to FP4 probabilities and reaches up to 2.13$\times$ the bfloat16 (BF16) forward throughput on an NVIDIA GB200. The causal path reconstructs probabilities from saved quantized queries and keys and uses 8-bit floating-point (FP8) gradient operands, accelerating a complete single-GPU 8-billion-parameter update by up to 1.14$\times$. Matched distributed training retains FP8 probabilities and values; every tested MXFP4 probability/value training trajectory diverges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Direct-P方法解决Blackwell FP4张量核心在attention加速中的瓶颈问题。Direct-P通过将softmax转换直接映射为FP4概率，并利用因果路径将前向量化直接传递到反向传播，在NVIDIA GB200上实现了比BF16高2.13倍的非因果推理前向吞吐量，以及单GPU 8B参数更新最高1.14倍的加速。分布式训练中，仅保留FP8概率和值才可收敛，而所有MXFP4概率/值训练轨迹均发散。
AI.motivation: Blackwell的4位浮点(FP4)张量核心本身并不能自动加速attention，因为当矩阵乘法规模缩小后，softmax转换和片上依赖成为性能瓶颈。作者旨在解决FP4张量核心在attention计算中的效率问题。
AI.method: 提出Direct-P方法，包含两条路径：(1) 非因果推理路径：将分数直接映射为FP4概率，绕过传统的softmax转换瓶颈；(2) 因果路径：将前向量化直接传递到反向传播中，从保存的量化查询和键重建概率，并使用8位浮点(FP8)梯度操作数。
AI.result: Direct-P在NVIDIA GB200上达到BF16前向吞吐量的2.13倍；完整单GPU 8B参数更新提速最高1.14倍。在分布式训练场景中，只有保持FP8概率和值才能匹配训练收敛性，所有测试的MXFP4概率/值训练轨迹均出现发散。
AI.conclusion: Direct-P有效解决了FP4张量核心在attention中的瓶颈问题，证明了通过将量化策略直接集成到attention计算通路中，可以在不牺牲训练收敛性的前提下获得显著的吞吐量提升，但FP4精度不足以用于训练，FP8是训练精度下限。

title: Constant regret in general games via higher-order optimism
summary: We introduce an uncoupled learning algorithm which, when employed by all players of an arbitrary $N$-player normal form game with up to $K$ actions per player, guarantees $O(N^3\log^2 K)$ individual regret, uniformly over the horizon of play. The proposed algorithm - which we call higher-order optimism with discounting (HOOD) is a variant of optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OptFTRL) that combines a discounted $(N+1)$-th order predictor with entropic regularization over a suitable "lifting" of the game's strategy space. This combination of ingredients is purposefully designed to dampen large oscillations of the induced sequence of play in a controlled manner, removing in this way a key stumbling block of previous attempts to achieve constant regret in general games. Our approach bears several striking similarities to the concurrent - and completely independent - work of Liu, Farina, and Ozdaglar (arXiv:2608.31166), who very recently derived an $O(N^{21}\log^{4} K)$ regret bound through the use of higher-order optimism and an exponential moving average estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为HOOD（高阶乐观带折扣）的解耦学习算法，用于任意N人标准型博弈，保证每个玩家获得$O(N^3\log^2 K)$的个人遗憾，该界在整个博弈时间范围内一致成立，打破了以往在一般博弈中实现常数遗憾的关键障碍。
AI.motivation: 在一般N人博弈中实现常数（或接近常数）个人遗憾是一个长期未解决的挑战。以往的方法（如OptFTRL）在面对一般博弈时，由于诱导策略序列的大幅振荡而无法获得理想的遗憾界。作者旨在通过设计一个能有效抑制这种振荡的算法来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: HOOD算法是乐观正则化后验（OptFTRL）的一个变体，其核心组件包括：(1) 折扣的$(N+1)$阶预测器，利用更高阶的历史信息进行更精确的预测；(2) 在博弈策略空间的适当"提升"（lifting）上使用熵正则化。这一组合设计旨在以可控方式阻尼诱导策略序列的大幅振荡，从而克服先前工作中阻碍实现常数遗憾的困难。
AI.result: 作者证明了当所有玩家都采用HOOD算法时，在具有最多$K$个动作的任意$N$人标准型博弈中，每个玩家的个人遗憾为$O(N^3\log^2 K)$，且该界在博弈时间范围内一致成立（即不随时间步数增长）。作者还指出该工作与Liu、Farina和Ozdaglar的独立并发工作有显著相似性，后者通过高阶乐观和指数移动平均估计器获得了$O(N^{21}\log^4 K)$的遗憾界（指数的依赖显著弱于本文）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了解耦的、无需通信的算法可以在任意一般博弈中实现常数遗憾，且对玩家数$N$和动作数$K$的依赖较此前结果（如并发工作）大幅改善，将依赖从$N^{21}\log^4 K$改进到$N^3\log^2 K$。该工作为一般博弈中的学习问题提供了新的理论保证和算法框架。

title: The Blind Spot in 2D Infants' Pose Estimation:Robust Learning from Noisy Annotations
summary: Noisy annotations pose a significant challenge for supervised deep learning, as neural networks rely on large-scale, high-quality labeled data whose corruption can severely impair model performance. Although robustness to label noise has been extensively studied for classification tasks, it remains relatively underexplored in Pose Estimation (PE). This limitation becomes critical in clinical contexts, including neonatology, where PE of preterm infants is used to support the assessment of spontaneous motility, a key indicator of neurodevelopmental trajectories. In such settings, infants' images labeling is further hindered by visual challenges (e.g., keypoint self-occlusions, caregiver interference), making the annotation process inherently susceptible to errors. To tackle noisy annotations in PE, we introduce REliable keypoint selection via Memory of traINing Dynamics (REMIND), a clustering-based keypoint-selection strategy that exploits keypoint-wise training dynamics to identify noisy labels without assuming any prior knowledge of the noise distribution, thus enabling noise-free model training. When evaluated on the proprietary NeoPose dataset, comprising 46 videos of 46 preterm infants recorded in real clinical settings, REMIND correctly identifies noisy annotations across multiple corruption scenarios, achieving up to 93\% Area Under the Curve (AUC) with three different PE architectures used in the relevant literature. To our knowledge, this is the first study to explicitly address label noise in preterm infants' PE, paving the way for the design of trustworthy learning-based algorithms for infants'monitoring support when data quality cannot be guaranteed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REMIND，一种基于聚类和训练动态的关键点选择策略，用于识别姿态估计任务中的噪声标注。该方法无需假设噪声分布，在包含46个早产儿真实临床视频的NeoPose数据集上，跨三种PE架构实现了最高93%的AUC，是首个专门针对早产儿姿态估计中标注噪声问题的研究。
AI.motivation: 噪声标注严重损害深度学习模型性能，尽管分类任务中的标签噪声鲁棒性已被广泛研究，但姿态估计（PE）中的噪声标注问题仍相对未被充分探索。在临床早产儿监测场景中，由于关键点自遮挡、护理人员干扰等视觉挑战，标注过程天然容易出错，而模型性能的可靠性对此类医疗应用至关重要。
AI.method: REMIND通过聚类方法利用关键点级别的训练动态（training dynamics）来识别噪声标签，无需假设任何噪声分布的先验知识。该方法选择可靠关键点以支持无噪声的模型训练，可适配三种不同结构的PE架构。
AI.result: 在包含46个早产儿真实临床场景视频的专有NeoPose数据集上，REMIND在多种腐败场景下正确识别噪声标注，以三种不同的PE架构实现了最高93%的AUC。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个明确解决早产儿姿态估计中标注噪声问题的研究，为在数据质量无法保证的情况下设计可信的婴儿监测学习算法铺平了道路。

title: Stable and Scalable Bundle Adjustment of Holistic 3D Structures
comment: To appear at ECCV 2026. Code available as part of the LIMAP toolbox at https://github.com/cvg/limap/
summary: Bundle Adjustment (BA) is a cornerstone of 3D computer vision and has benefited from decades of advances in sparse optimization and numerical methods. It was originally developed for jointly optimizing camera intrinsics, poses and sparse 3D points. While extensions incorporate lines and other primitives, integrating richer geometric structures such as parallelism, coplanarity, or wireframes often introduces significantly increased computational cost and reduced numerical stability. In this paper, we propose a unified framework that extends bundle adjustment to jointly optimize geometric features and higher-order relations. We first introduce a taxonomy that distinguishes scalable geometric features with direct 2D measurements (e.g., points and lines), from groups encoding higher-order relations (e.g., coplanarity, parallelism, etc.), where we show that groups can be modeled as camera-like entities within the bundle adjustment framework. Building on this formulation, we propose that both group constraints and cross-feature relations (i.e., point-line associations) can be expressed through 2D reprojection measurements. By formulating group-induced and cross-feature reprojection errors, we preserve the sparsity structure of classical point-based BA under Schur elimination, while avoiding direct 3D regularization that degrades the conditioning and stability. Experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate runtime performance comparable to classical point-only bundle adjustment, while producing significantly richer 3D structures and improved geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将光束法平差（BA）扩展到联合优化几何特征与高阶关系（如共面性、平行性、线框结构），通过将群组建模为类似相机的实体，并将群组约束与跨特征关系表达为二维重投影误差，保留经典基于点的BA的稀疏性结构，同时获得更丰富的三维结构和更高的几何精度。
AI.motivation: 传统光束法平差仅优化相机内外参和稀疏三维点，虽已有扩展纳入直线等基本元素，但整合更丰富的几何结构（如平行性、共面性、线框）会带来显著增加的计算成本和数值稳定性下降的问题。现有方法缺乏一个统一框架来同时处理多种几何特征与高阶关系。
AI.method: 首先提出一种分类法，区分可直接二维测量的可扩展几何特征（如点、线）与编码高阶关系的群组（如共面性、平行性）。关键洞察在于群组可被建模为类似相机（camera-like）的实体融入BA框架。基于此，将群组约束和跨特征关系（点-线关联）均通过二维重投影测量来表达，构建群组诱导的与跨特征的重投影误差，从而在Schur消元下保持经典基于点BA的稀疏结构，避免直接的三维正则化对条件数和稳定性的损害。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集上的实验表明，该方法运行时间与经典仅基于点的光束法平差相当，同时能生成显著更丰富的三维结构并提高几何精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高阶几何关系统一建模为重投影误差，该框架在保持效率的同时扩展了BA的表达能力，为把更丰富的几何先验融入经典三维重建优化提供了一条有效路径。

title: DSAQuant: Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training for Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models (VDMs) have achieved impressive progress in text-to-video generation, but their high memory and computational costs hinder practical deployment. Quantization-aware training (QAT) is an effective solution for compressing and accelerating advanced generative models without runtime overhead at inference. However, existing QAT methods suffer from a distinctive challenge in VDMs: while they often preserve prompt semantics, global layout, and coarse motion, the quantized model severely degrades visual details, texture fidelity, and sharpness. In this paper, we trace this degradation to the timestep-agnostic design of conventional quantization pipelines, which overlooks the stage-wise functionality of video denoising. In VDMs, early denoising steps mainly establish global structure and motion, whereas middle and late steps refine local appearance and high-frequency details. Based on this insight, we propose DSAQuant, a Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-aware training framework for VDMs. During training, Denoising-Stage Oriented Supervision preserves teacher distillation in early steps for stable structure planning, while shifting later steps toward target-driven optimization to enhance detail reconstruction. During inference, Denoising-Stage Gated Guidance disables CFG in the final denoising steps to prevent it from amplifying quantization-induced errors into high-frequency artifacts. Extensive experiments on the Wan and CogVideoX families under W4A4 and W3A3 settings show that DSAQuant consistently outperforms the SOTA QAT baseline, improving the VBench average score by up to 6.60 under aggressive W3A3 quantization while preserving strong text-video alignment. These results demonstrate that effective VDM quantization requires not only reducing quantization error, but also aligning quantization training and inference with the stage-wise nature of video diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSAQuant，一种针对视频扩散模型（VDM）的去噪阶段对齐的量化感知训练框架，通过阶段导向的监督和门控引导来解决量化后视觉细节退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型(VDM)虽在文本到视频生成上表现出色，但高内存和计算成本阻碍实际部署。量化感知训练(QAT)是有效的压缩方案，但现有QAT方法在VDM中面临独特挑战：量化模型虽然保留提示语义、全局布局和粗略运动，却严重退化视觉细节、纹理保真度和清晰度。作者将这一退化追溯到传统量化管线的时间步无关设计，忽略了视频去噪的阶段级功能。
AI.method: DSAQuant包含两个核心组件：(1) Denoising-Stage Oriented Supervision——在早期去噪步骤保留教师蒸馏以稳定结构规划，后期步骤转向目标驱动优化以增强细节重建；(2) Denoising-Stage Gated Guidance——在推理的最终去噪步骤禁用CFG（无分类器引导），防止其将量化引入的误差放大为高频伪影。
AI.result: 在Wan和CogVideoX系列模型上，W4A4和W3A3设置下的实验表明，DSAQuant在VBench平均分上比SOTA QAT基线提升最高达6.60（在激进的W3A3量化下），同时保持强大的文本-视频对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: 有效的VDM量化不仅需要降低量化误差，还需要使量化训练和推理与视频扩散的阶段级特性对齐。这验证了去噪阶段感知的量化策略对于保持生成质量至关重要。

title: Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games
comment: Main text: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; Appendix: 22 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: We introduce the first Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning framework for general-sum concurrent stochastic games (CSGs) with transition uncertainty, while addressing the challenge of Nash equilibrium (NE) existence. Our algorithm maintains data-driven $L^1$ confidence sets over transition kernels and solves a robust CSG to compute a social-welfare optimal $\varepsilon$-NE, using a robust MDP-based exploration mechanism to drive joint state-action coverage. Crucially, we introduce a Nash margin characterisation that enables principled reasoning about equilibrium existence: the framework either returns an $\varepsilon$-approximate NE whose social-welfare value is $\varepsilon$-close to optimal, or provides a sound certificate that no exact NE exists. Under a minimum reachability condition $p_{\mathrm{reach}}>0$ over relevant state-action pairs, the algorithm terminates after a polynomial number of trajectory samples, with sample complexity $\widetilde{O}\left( {R_{\max}^2 H^4 |S|^2 |A| / (p_{\mathrm{reach}} \varepsilon^2)} \right)$. Empirical results on benchmark CSGs demonstrate near-optimal performance, correct handling of equilibrium (non-)existence, and sample complexity consistent with theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了第一个面向一般和并发随机博弈（CSGs）且带转移不确定性的PAC学习框架，通过保数据的L1置信集和鲁棒CSG求解，既能返回ε近似纳什均衡（社会福祉ε接近最优），也能在无精确NE时给出可靠证明。在最小可达性条件下，样本复杂度为多项式级别。
AI.motivation: 一般和并发随机博弈中，纳什均衡的存在性本身就是一个开放性难题，而现有学习算法往往假设NE存在或无法处理转移不确定性。缺乏一个在理论上保证均衡存在性可判定、同时具备PAC样本效率的学习框架。
AI.method: 1）基于数据构建转移核的L1置信集；2）在每个置信集上求解鲁棒CSG，以社会福祉最优为目标计算ε-NE；3）采用鲁棒MDP驱动的探索机制实现联合状态-动作覆盖；4）引入纳什边际（Nash margin）刻画，用于判定均衡存在性——若模型存在NE则返回近似最优ε-NE，否则输出精确NE不存在的可靠性证明。
AI.result: 在最小可达性条件p_reach>0下，算法在多项式数量的轨迹样本后终止，样本复杂度为Õ(R_max² H⁴ |S|² |A| / (p_reach ε²))。基准CSG实验表明算法性能接近最优，能正确处理均衡存在/不存在的情形，实际样本复杂度与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次为一般和CSG建立了完整的PAC学习框架，将均衡存在性判定纳入了可计算的学习流程，实现了理论与算法的统一，为后续多智能体强化学习在不确定博弈环境中的研究奠定了理论基础。

title: Editable Visual Design
summary:
While diffusion base models such as GPT-Image-2 and Nano-Banana exhibit remarkable visual expressiveness, their end-to-end generation inherently yields flattened bitmaps with error-prone text, precluding layer-wise post-editing. Conversely, code-based visual generation via Coding Agents provides precise layout control and decoupled layers, yet remains constrained by a lack of global aesthetic intuition and the difficulty of coding complex visual assets.
  To address this, we propose Editable Visual Design, a new paradigm driven by a Coding Agent. We designate the VLM as the ``creative brain'' for requirement comprehension, task planning, and aesthetic judgment, while utilizing the image generation model as an on-demand ``visual world simulator'' to synthesize standalone visual assets. Operating under an ``imagine first, then act'' closed-loop workflow, the agent generates isolated assets, writes native HTML/CSS, and iteratively refines the design against visual rendering feedback.
  Furthermore, Agent Design Replay faithfully reproduces the creative and reasoning trajectory akin to that of professional human designers. Ultimately, the system delivers editable artifacts with decoupled layers and real text, enabling users to perform intuitive mouse dragging and layout adjustments on a graphical user interface. Validations on posters, infographics, and other scenarios show that this paradigm successfully achieves both refined aesthetics and production-grade editability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可编辑视觉设计"（Editable Visual Design）新范式，由编码代理（Coding Agent）驱动，将VLM作为"创意大脑"负责需求理解、任务规划与美学判断，将图像生成模型作为"视觉世界模拟器"按需合成独立视觉资产，采用"先想象后行动"的闭环工作流，生成原生HTML/CSS可编辑设计，并通过Agent Design Replay复现专业设计师的创作推理轨迹，最终实现带解耦图层和真实文本的可编辑产物，支持用户在图形界面直观拖拽调整。
AI.motivation: 扩散基础模型（如GPT-Image-2、Nano-Banana）虽具卓越视觉表现力，但端到端生成产生扁平化位图，文字易出错且无法进行分层后期编辑；而基于代码的视觉生成方式虽能提供精确布局控制和解耦图层，却缺乏全局审美直觉且难以编程复杂视觉资产。两种范式各有局限，需融合二者优势。
AI.method: 采用编码代理驱动的新范式：将VLM定位为"创意大脑"负责需求理解、任务规划与美学评判；图像生成模型作为按需"视觉世界模拟器"合成独立视觉资产。通过"先想象后行动"的闭环工作流，代理生成独立资产、编写原生HTML/CSS，并依据视觉渲染反馈迭代优化设计。同时提出Agent Design Replay机制忠实复现类似专业人类设计师的创作与推理轨迹。
AI.result: 系统最终交付带解耦图层和真实文本的可编辑产物，支持用户在图形界面上进行直观的鼠标拖拽和布局调整。在海报、信息图等场景上的验证表明，该范式同时实现了精致的审美效果和生产级可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了通过编码代理融合VLM的创意理解与图像模型的美学生成能力，能够突破扩散模型不可编辑与代码生成缺乏美感的双重瓶颈，在视觉设计领域实现美学质量与可编辑性的统一。

title: TAP-Path: Task-Adaptive Structural and Token Pruning for Efficient and Trustworthy Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology foundation models improve transferable representation learning for histopathology, but recent gains often rely on encoders with hundreds of millions of parameters and high inference cost. We propose TAP-Path, a task-adaptive compression framework that directly restructures a pretrained Virchow2 encoder rather than distilling it into a separate student. TAP-Path combines validation-driven transformer-block selection, physical removal of redundant blocks, input-adaptive patch-token pruning, multi-depth feature recovery, and a lightweight gated task head. The final model retains 24 of 32 transformer blocks and 70% of patch tokens after pruning, reducing encoder parameters by 24.96% (631.24M to 473.70M) and analytical encoder compute by 35.20% (340.13G to 220.40G FLOPs). Across three task-head optimization seeds, TAP-Path achieved $87.98 \pm 0.067%$ test accuracy, $81.26 \pm 0.49%$ balanced accuracy, and $82.38 \pm 0.48%$ macro-F1 on a 32-class histopathology benchmark, compared with 86.89% for full Virchow2 and 87.67% for UNI2-h. TAP-Path achieved a Brier score of $0.1800 \pm 0.0005$ and failure-detection AUROC of $0.9047 \pm 0.0060$. A validation-only rare-aware objective improved rare-class balanced accuracy in a secondary operating analysis. Frozen external evaluation on 433 CPTAC samples yielded $91.22 \pm 0.83%$ accuracy and $91.10 \pm 0.81%$ balanced accuracy. These results show that task-adaptive structural and token sparsification can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of large pathology foundation models while preserving reliability under internal and external evaluation.

AI.tldr: TAP-Path是一种任务自适应的病理学基础模型压缩框架，通过对预训练Virchow2编码器直接进行结构重构（而非蒸馏为独立学生模型），保留24/32个Transformer块和70%的patch token，使编码器参数减少24.96%、计算量减少35.20%。在32类组织病理学基准上，三个任务头优化种子的平均测试准确率为87.98%，优于完整Virchow2（86.89%）和UNI2-h（87.67%），同时保持可靠的失败检测能力和外部泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 病理学基础模型在表征学习上取得了显著进步，但近期模型往往依赖数亿参数的高推理成本编码器。现有的压缩方案通常将模型蒸馏成独立的学生网络，效率不高且可能丢失基础模型的知识。研究者希望提出一种直接重构原始编码器的任务自适应压缩框架，在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低参数和计算开销。
AI.method: TAP-Path框架包括五个核心组件：（1）验证集驱动的Transformer块选择，确定保留哪些块；（2）物理移除冗余Transformer块；（3）输入自适应的patch token剪枝（保留70%的token）；（4）多深度特征恢复机制；（5）轻量级门控任务头。该方法直接对预训练的Virchow2编码器进行结构化重构，而非蒸馏到单独的学生网络中。此外，还引入了一种仅基于验证集的稀有类别感知目标函数来优化稀有类别的平衡准确率。
AI.result: 保留24/32个Transformer块和70%的patch token，编码器参数从631.24M降至473.70M（减少24.96%），分析性编码器计算量从340.13G降至220.40G FLOPs（减少35.20%）。在32类基准上，TAP-Path在三个任务头种子中达到87.98±0.067%测试准确率、81.26±0.49%平衡准确率和82.38±0.48%宏F1分数，优于完整Virchow2（86.89%）和UNI2-h（87.67%）。Brier分数为0.1800±0.0005，失败检测AUROC为0.9047±0.0060。在433个CPTAC样本的外部冻结评估中达到91.22±0.83%准确率和91.10±0.81%平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: 任务自适应的结构和token稀疏化能够显著改善大型病理基础模型的精度-效率权衡，同时保持内部和外部评估下的可靠性。TAP-Path证明了直接结构重构（块剪枝+token剪枝）可以比完整模型实现更高的性能，同时大幅减少参数和计算开销，为大规模病理基础模型的高效部署提供了可行路径。

title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
summary: MLLM-based embedding models remain limited in compositional retrieval, often failing to distinguish scenes containing the same concepts but different attribute-object bindings. Yet the same backbone can resolve such distinctions when used as a cross-attentive reranker, motivating us to distill its compositional judgments into the embedding model. We propose CORE, which synthesizes candidate lists spanning five compositional matching levels and introduces a Rank-KL objective that trains the embedding model to reproduce the reranker's fine-grained ranking. We further introduce a graded evaluation protocol and compare contrastive learning, pairwise CoSENT, and listwise Rank-KL under the same data and tuning budget. Our comparison shows that both CoSENT and Rank-KL use the multi-level supervision more effectively than contrastive learning, with Rank-KL achieving the strongest overall performance. Across three compositional reasoning benchmarks (COLA, SUGARCREPE++, NEGBENCH), CORE-RERANKER-8B achieves an 82.7% total average, outperforming Jina-Reranker by 10.7 points, while CORE-EMBED-8B achieves the best total average (0.666) among all evaluated embedding models. The improvements transfer to the MCMR benchmark without sacrificing retrieval performance on COCO and Flickr30K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE方法，通过将跨注意力重排序器的组合判断蒸馏到嵌入模型中，解决组合检索中属性-对象绑定区分失败的局限。CORE引入五级候选列表和Rank-KL目标，在多个基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 基于MLLM的嵌入模型在组合检索任务中表现有限，难以区分包含相同概念但属性-对象绑定不同的场景。然而同一骨干网络作为跨注意力重排序器时却能解决此类区分，这种能力上的差距促使作者探索将重排序器的组合判断能力蒸馏到嵌入模型中。
AI.method: CORE方法：(1) 合成跨越五个组合匹配层级的候选列表；(2) 引入Rank-KL目标函数，训练嵌入模型模仿重排序器的细粒度排序输出；(3) 引入分级评估协议，在相同数据和调参预算下对比对比学习、成对CoSENT和列表式Rank-KL三种训练目标。
AI.result: 在COLA、SUGARCREPE++、NEGBENCH三个组合推理基准上，CORE-RERANKER-8B达到82.7%总平均，超出Jina-Reranker 10.7个百分点；CORE-EMBED-8B在嵌入模型中取得最佳总平均(0.666)。CoSENT和Rank-KL对多级监督的利用效率均优于对比学习，Rank-KL整体最强。改进可迁移至MCMR基准，且不损失COCO和Flickr30K上的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏重排序器的组合判断到嵌入模型是提升组合检索能力的有效途径，Rank-KL列表式目标优于对比学习和成对CoSENT，且性能提升具有跨基准泛化性而无损于传统检索任务。

title: Efficient Semantic Understanding from Digital Foveation
comment: Accepted at the 3rd Human-inspired Computer Vision Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Dense semantic segmentation allocates computational resources uniformly across the entire image, regardless of scene complexity or task relevance. Inspired by biological vision, we investigate whether semantic understanding can be achieved more efficiently through digital foveated perception. We introduce a lightweight active-vision pipeline that combines saliency-driven fixation selection, high-resolution foveal observations, low-resolution contextual information, semantic accumulation, and adaptive computation. Beyond conventional dense prediction metrics, we use object-level evaluation to measure semantic understanding under sparse observations. On ADE20K-Object, a single foveated observation achieves 95.9% of the baseline Top-1 accuracy and 96.9% of the baseline Top-3 accuracy while requiring only 4.7% of the computational cost. At the scene level, semantic accumulation recovers 90.6% of the baseline object recall while using 58.6% of the computation. These results suggest that substantial semantic understanding can emerge from sparse observations when computation is allocated selectively, highlighting active vision as an efficient alternative to uniform dense processing and motivating evaluation protocols beyond conventional pixel-wise segmentation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数字中央凹感知的轻量级主动视觉管线，通过显著性驱动的注视点选择、高分辨率中央凹观测与低分辨率上下文信息结合，以极低计算成本实现接近密集分割基线的语义理解效果。
AI.motivation: 密集语义分割在整个图像上均匀分配计算资源，不考虑场景复杂度或任务相关性。作者从生物视觉（中央凹/周边视觉）中获取灵感，探究是否能通过选择性分配计算实现更高效的语义理解。
AI.method: 提出一个轻量级主动视觉管线，包含以下组件：(1) 显著性驱动的注视点选择（saliency-driven fixation selection）；(2) 高分辨率中央凹观测（foveal observations）；(3) 低分辨率上下文信息；(4) 语义累积（semantic accumulation）；(5) 自适应计算。评估采用物体级别（object-level）的度量标准，而非常规的像素级密集预测指标。
AI.result: 在ADE20K-Object数据集上：单次中央凹观测达到基线Top-1准确率的95.9%和Top-3准确率的96.9%，而仅需4.7%的计算成本。在场景级别下，语义累积恢复了基线物体召回率的90.6%，仅使用58.6%的计算量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当计算被选择性地分配时，稀疏观测即可产生显著的语义理解能力，主动视觉可作为均匀密集处理的高效替代方案。同时本文也呼吁建立超越传统像素级分割指标的新型评估协议。

title: The Shape of Time: Video-Token Contrast for Temporal Understanding in VideoLMs
summary: Seeing frames in order does not mean representing time. Modern VideoLMs receive ordered video streams, yet their main supervision acts on generated text rather than video-token representations where event dynamics should first emerge. This mismatch allows models to learn temporal answers from shortcuts such as objects, scenes, and language priors, without requiring internal video representations to capture event progression. To address this, we propose VT-Contrast, a representation-level temporal counterfactual objective for VideoLMs. Its design asks where temporal supervision should act and what temporal differences it should expose. VT-Contrast supervises selected late-layer last-frame video tokens, where temporal information is expected to be integrated before language generation, and contrasts order-preserving views with same-video reordered counterfactuals graded by Kendall tau distance. It requires no architectural changes, is compatible with diverse VideoLM training tasks, and improves overall performance across temporal understanding benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/ANDgate99/VT-Contrast.

AI.tldr: 提出VT-Contrast，一种面向VideoLM的表示级时间反事实训练目标。它通过对比顺序保持视图与按Kendall tau距离分级重排的同视频反事实样本，对选定的晚期层最后帧视频token进行时序监督，无需架构改动即可提升时序理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现代VideoLM虽然接收有序视频流，但主要监督信号作用于生成的文本而非视频token表示，导致模型可通过物体、场景和语言先验等捷径学习时间答案，其内部视频表示并未真正捕捉事件动态与时间顺序。现有监督方式未能在表示层面引导模型形成时序理解。
AI.method: VT-Contrast包含两个核心设计决策：(1) 监督位置的选定——选取晚期层最后一帧视频token，该位置被认为是语言生成前时间信息最应整合之处；(2) 监督信号的对比设计——将顺序保持的视图与同视频经过重排的反事实视图进行对比，其中重排干扰程度由Kendall tau距离进行分级。该方法无需架构改动，可与多种VideoLM训练任务兼容。
AI.result: VT-Contrast在多个时序理解benchmarks上提升了VideoLM的整体表现，验证了在表示层施加时序对抗性监督的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VT-Contrast证明了时序监督应作用于视频token表示而非仅文本输出，为VideoLM的时序理解提供了一种轻量、通用且有效的训练增强方案。

title: BooM-VVT: Boosting Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On with Image-Level Pseudo Data
comment: 23 pages, 18 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary:
Video virtual try-on (VVT) aims to generate realistic videos of a person wearing a target garment. Recent methods leverage a keyframe-driven video generation paradigm to improve in-the-wild performance, yet they still rely on masks to localize try-on regions, making them vulnerable to large motions and severe occlusions. Although mask-free image-based try-on methods have shown promising results by leveraging large-scale pseudo data, extending this paradigm to videos remains difficult, as constructing video-level pseudo data is prohibitively expensive. Furthermore, coarse keyframe sampling and the scarcity of multi-view try-on data limit existing keyframe-driven methods in maintaining garment consistency and handling diverse try-on tasks.
  To address these challenges, we propose BooM-VVT, a mask-free VVT framework built upon the keyframe-driven paradigm. To achieve mask-free VVT, we introduce a multi-stage training strategy that leverages image-level pseudo data for mask-free localization learning, substantially reducing the need for costly video-level pseudo data. To improve garment consistency, we propose Garment-Sensitive Keyframe Sampling, which selects keyframes based on garment-relevant body regions to better capture garment appearance. We further introduce Frame-Shared 3D-RoPE to establish spatiotemporal correspondences between keyframes and target video frames for accurate garment-detail transfer. Finally, we construct OmniView, a large-scale multi-view try-on dataset to support reliable try-on video generation under complex camera viewpoints and diverse try-on tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BooM-VVT achieves superior temporal consistency and garment fidelity over existing methods. Project page: https://boomvvt.github.io/boomvvt.

AI.tldr: 提出了BooM-VVT，一个基于关键帧驱动的无掩码视频虚拟试穿（VVT）框架，通过多阶段训练策略利用图像级伪数据进行无掩码定位学习，采用服装敏感关键帧采样和帧共享3D-RoPE来增强服装一致性，并构建了大型多视角试穿数据集OmniView以支持复杂相机视角下的试穿任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基于关键帧驱动的视频试穿方法依赖掩码定位试穿区域，在面对大幅度运动和严重遮挡时表现脆弱；无掩码的图像级试穿方法虽有效但难以扩展到视频（视频级伪数据构建成本过高）；同时现有方法在关键帧采样过于粗糙以及多视角试穿数据稀缺，导致服装一致性保持不佳且难以处理多样化的试穿任务。
AI.method: 1) 引入多阶段训练策略，利用图像级伪数据进行无掩码定位学习，大幅降低对昂贵的视频级伪数据的需求；2) 提出Garment-Sensitive Keyframe Sampling（服装敏感关键帧采样），基于服装相关身体区域选择关键帧以更好地捕捉服装外观；3) 提出Frame-Shared 3D-RoPE，在关键帧与目标视频帧之间建立时空对应关系以实现精确的服装细节迁移；4) 构建OmniView大规模多视角试穿数据集，支持复杂相机视角下的试穿视频生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，BooM-VVT在时间一致性和服装保真度方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: BooM-VVT通过无掩码框架、多阶段训练、定制化关键帧采样与帧共享3D-RoPE，以及大规模多视角数据集，有效解决了视频试穿中掩码依赖、服装不一致及多视角数据的稀缺性问题，在时间一致性和服装保真度上达到了更优性能。

title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process continuous visual inputs and respond to user queries under strict causality and bounded memory. Existing approaches typically compress historical observations into an external memory bank and retrieve query-relevant evidence as additional visual context. Though effective, this store-and-retrieve paradigm keeps historical evidence as external visual context, preventing it from being internalized into a compact, evolving latent memory that can continuously guide streaming reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce LatentStream, a progressive latent working memory framework that shifts streaming memory from store-and-retrieve to retrieve-and-internalize. Specifically, LatentStream comprises three coordinated components. First, Query-agnostic Hierarchical Streaming Memory organizes visual history into short-, mid-, and long-term levels under a fixed memory budget through Jenks-guided adaptive consolidation. Once a query arrives, Hierarchical Latent Memory Evolution equips groups of latent memory tokens with progressively expanding memory receptive fields, enabling them to iteratively retrieve historical evidence from their corresponding scopes and internalize it into a compact, fixed-length latent memory. Finally, Progressive Confidence-guided Latent Memory Optimization constructs a hierarchical progression reward from group-wise predictive entropy and jointly refines the latent memory tokens and retrieved evidence, encouraging increasingly confident streaming reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LatentStream achieves new state-of-the-art results on existing online and offline video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: LatentStream提出了一种渐进式潜在工作记忆框架，将流式视频理解的记忆范式从"存储-检索"（store-and-retrieve）转变为"检索-内化"（retrieve-and-internalize），通过将历史证据内化为紧致的、不断演化的潜在记忆来实现流式推理。在现有在线和离线视频基准上取得了新的最先进结果。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频理解方法采用"存储-检索"范式，将历史压缩到外部记忆库并在查询时检索相关证据作为额外视觉上下文。尽管有效，但这种范式将历史证据作为外部视觉上下文，无法将其内化为紧致且不断演化的潜在记忆来持续指导流式推理，模型缺乏自主记忆增长的机制。
AI.method: LatentStream包含三个协调组件：(1) 查询不可知的层次化流式记忆（Query-agnostic Hierarchical Streaming Memory），通过Jenks引导的自适应整合，在固定记忆预算下将视觉历史组织为短期、中期和长期三个层次；(2) 层次化潜在记忆演化（Hierarchical Latent Memory Evolution），为潜在记忆token组配备渐进扩展的记忆感受野，使其能迭代地从对应范围检索历史证据并内化为紧致固定长度的潜在记忆；(3) 渐进式置信度引导的潜在记忆优化（Progressive Confidence-guided Latent Memory Optimization），从分组预测熵构建层次化渐进奖励，联合精细化潜在记忆token和检索到的证据，鼓励越来越自信的流式推理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明LatentStream在多个现有在线和离线视频理解基准上取得了新的最先进结果，验证了所提出框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LatentStream通过将"存储-检索"范式转变为"检索-内化"范式，成功弥合了历史上外部证据与内部动态记忆之间的鸿沟，使得多模态大语言模型能够以固定记忆预算持续内化并利用历史信息进行流式视频推理，为流式视频理解提供了新的框架方向。

title: Persistent Identity Preservation in Generative Image Models: A Benchmark and Evaluation System
summary: Generative image models can now produce high-quality images, follow complex instructions, and support precise edits, but they still struggle to preserve who or what is being depicted. When generating or editing images of a specific subject, identity may drift as the pose, expression, appearance, viewpoint, or surrounding scene changes. Existing subject-driven methods make fundamentally different choices about where identity is represented: through the input context (GPT-Image-2, NB2), as trainable subject-specific model parameters (LoRA), or as a persistent identity layer (PHOTA IDENTITY) reusable across generations and edits. We systematically benchmark these paradigms across subject-driven generation, editing, restoration, and multi-subject settings, with tasks designed to increasingly stress identity preservation. Our results show that identity preservation remains a distinct limitation of current generative foundation models: strong image quality and instruction following do not necessarily imply strong identity fidelity, and identity degradation becomes more pronounced under iterative edits, small subject scales, severe image degradation, and multi-subject composition. Persistent identity substantially reduces this degradation across generation, editing, and restoration, consistently improving identity preservation when applied to different foundation models while maintaining comparable instruction adherence and perceptual image quality. These results suggest that identity does not simply emerge from increasingly capable generative models, but can instead be represented as persistent subject knowledge that is composed independently with the underlying generative model.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性评估了生成图像模型中身份保持这一核心挑战，对比了三种主流身份表示范式（输入上下文、可训练参数、持久身份层），发现身份保真并不随图像质量和指令跟随能力的提升而自动涌现，而持久身份表示（PHOTA IDENTITY）在跨生成、编辑和修复任务中能持续减少身份漂移，且可独立于底层生成模型组合使用。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式图像模型在图像质量、复杂指令遵循和精确编辑方面已取得显著进展，但它们在保谁/保什么（即主题身份保持）方面仍然不足。当姿态、表情、外观、视角或场景变化时，身份容易发生漂移。现有的主体驱动方法在身份表征位置做出了根本性不同的选择，但缺乏对这些范式的系统性基准对比，身份保持是否随模型能力提升而自然涌现也尚不明确。
AI.method: 本文系统性地对三类主体驱动生成范式进行基准测试：(1) 输入上下文型（如GPT-Image-2、NB2）；(2) 可训练主体特定模型参数型（如LoRA）；(3) 可跨生成与编辑复用的持久身份层型（PHOTA IDENTITY）。基准覆盖主体驱动生成、编辑、修复和多主体场景，并设计递增压力任务以评估身份保持能力，同时测试持久身份方法在多种基础模型上的泛化表现。
AI.result: 结果表明：身份保持是当前生成基础模型的显著短板，强大的图像质量和指令遵循并不保证高身份保真度；在迭代编辑、小主体尺度、严重图像退化和多主体合成场景下身份劣化更为严重。持久身份表示（PHOTA IDENTITY）在生成、编辑和修复任务中持续降低身份退化，应用于不同基础模型时的一致性提升身份保持，同时保持相当的指令遵循度和感知图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 身份不会简单地从日益强大的生成模型中涌现出来，而可以被表示为持久的主题知识，与底层生成模型独立组合。这一发现表明，将身份作为独立可组合的持久表示，是提升生成模型身份保真度的有效路径。

title: Zero-Shot Novel Depth Synthesis Using 3D Foundation Models Scene Representations
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Project page: https://akola-mbey-denis.github.io/Z3D-page/
summary: 3D Foundation Models (3DFMs) such as VGGT have recently pushed the boundaries of 3D vision by predicting rich unified representations with feed-foward transformers. The scene representations learned by these models enable strong performance on multiple 3D vision tasks. In this paper, we investigate using their internal representations to infer 3D in the scene from new views. Our hypothesis is that in order to solve the task of 3D reconstruction, these models need to learn a representation that includes a large amount of general knowledge about 3D scenes. After showing that it is possible to decode hidden surfaces from internal 3DFM representations, we propose a method, Z3D, that estimates pointmaps in unseen views by doing latent diffusion on 3DFM representation. We show that Z3D can predict realistic depth maps for new views across multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用3D基础模型（如VGGT）的内部表征来推断新视图中的3D场景，提出Z3D方法，通过在3DFM表征上进行潜在扩散来估计未见视图的点图（pointmaps），从而预测新视图的真实深度图。
AI.motivation: 3D基础模型（3DFMs）在预测统一表征方面表现优异，但其内部表征是否包含足够的3D场景通用知识以支持从新视图推断3D信息这一问题尚未被充分探索。作者假设这些模型为了完成3D重建任务，必须学习包含大量3D场景通用知识的表征。
AI.method: 首先验证从内部3DFM表征中解码隐藏表面（hidden surfaces）的可行性，在此基础上提出Z3D方法，该方法通过在3DFM表征上进行潜在扩散（latent diffusion），估计未见视图中的点图（pointmaps），从而推理新视图的3D空间信息。
AI.result: Z3D能够在多个数据集上为新视图预测出逼真（realistic）的深度图，证明了从3DFM内部表征中进行3D场景推断的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 3DFM的内部表征蕴含了丰富的3D场景通用知识，可以通过潜在扩散等技术手段将其用于新视图的3D估计，为利用基础模型表征进行跨视图3D推理提供了新途径。

title: Seeing Before Synthesizing: VLM-Guided Transition Event Discovery for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
summary: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning aims to localize and describe multiple events in untrimmed videos given only an ordered set of event-level captions per video. Recent work synthesizes auxiliary transition captions via LLM to provide additional vision-language alignment, but these captions lack visual grounding and are rigidly assigned to every inter-event gap at a fixed location and duration. To address these, we propose Seeing Before Synthesizing (SBS), a framework that adaptively provides visually grounded linguistic guidance only where warranted. Leveraging a VLM, we generate frame-level narratives for the inter-event gaps and detect transitions from the semantic variation across them. For identified transitions, we then refine inter-event temporal masks by blending the temporal midpoint with the semantic change point and selecting the width that maximizes vision-language alignment. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions and YouCook2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both captioning and localization.

AI.tldr: 提出Seeing Before Synthesizing (SBS)框架，通过视觉语言模型先"看"再"合成"，为弱监督密集视频描述生成视觉上有依据的过渡字幕，而非盲目为所有事件间隔分配固定的辅助字幕。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督密集视频描述方法通过LLM合成辅助过渡字幕来增强视觉-语言对齐，但这些合成字幕缺乏视觉依据，且固定地分配在每个事件间空隙的固定位置和时长上，导致引导信号不可靠。
AI.method: 利用VLM为事件间空隙生成逐帧叙述，并通过帧间语义变化检测过渡点；对于识别出的过渡，通过融合时间中点和语义变化点来细化事件间时间掩码，并选择最大化视觉-语言对齐的宽度。
AI.result: 在ActivityNet Captions和YouCook2数据集上，字幕生成和事件定位均达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过"先看后合成"的自适应策略，仅在真实存在语义过渡处生成有视觉依据的语言引导，有效解决了合成过渡字幕缺乏视觉基础的问题，提升了弱监督密集视频描述的定位和描述精度。

title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing
summary: Video editing spans diverse editing paradigms, yet achieving high-quality instruction-guided and subject-guided editing within a single unified framework remains challenging. We introduce EditVid, a training-free framework combining sparse causal memory for local coherence, correspondence-based post-attention token injection for long-range identity preservation, and soft latent blending for edit locality. The same framework supports instruction-guided and reference-guided edits, including style transfer, attribute modification, object insertion, part-level editing, and subject replacement. On FiVE, EditVid achieves 78.16 FiVE-Acc, compared with 58.95 for the strongest evaluated training-free baseline, while obtaining competitive results on IVEBench. A user study further shows a 51.8\% overall preference for EditVid over 7 competing methods.

AI.tldr: EditVid是一个训练无关的统一视频编辑框架，通过稀疏因果记忆、基于对应的后注意力token注入和软潜变量混合三种技术，同时支持指令引导和参考引导编辑，在FiVE基准上达到78.16的FiVE-Acc（远超最强训练无关基线58.95），用户研究中获得51.8%的偏好率。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑涉及多种编辑范式，但目前缺乏一个统一的框架能够同时高质量地支持指令引导和主体引导编辑，现有方法往往只能覆盖单一编辑模式。
AI.method: EditVid是一个训练无关（training-free）的统一框架，包含三大核心组件：1）稀疏因果记忆（sparse causal memory）保证局部时间一致性；2）基于对应关系（correspondence-based）的后注意力token注入（post-attention token injection）实现长距离身份保持；3）软潜变量混合（soft latent blending）确保编辑局部性。同一框架支持指令引导和参考引导两类编辑。
AI.result: 在FiVE基准上，EditVid达到78.16的FiVE-Acc，而最强训练无关基线仅58.95；在IVEBench上取得有竞争力的结果；用户研究中EditVid在7个竞争方法中获得51.8%的整体偏好率。
AI.conclusion: EditVid通过统一的训练无关框架，同时实现了指令引导和主体引导的高质量视频编辑，在多项基准和用户研究中均优于现有训练无关方法，验证了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
summary: We propose Puffin-World, a unified multimodal architecture that integrates physical understanding, spatial simulation, and 3D world generation and reconstruction without relying on external offline modules. To reliably construct and interact with 3D worlds, our framework jointly models three native world states: physics (gravity field and latitude), geometry (depth), and appearance (image), together with a unified Omni-Camera representation that supports diverse tasks and flexible motions. Beyond modeling these states, we introduce a strategy for propagating physical dynamics across future frames. By grounding absolute camera properties in the real world, Puffin-World enables physically consistent and visually stable world generation. We further couple appearance and geometry within a single generative process, jointly synthesizing each future view and reconstructing its underlying geometry. This unified paradigm enables interleaved closed-loop applications requiring synergy across multiple tasks, including mimic and self-calibrated world exploration. To scale Puffin-World to complex scenarios, we construct Puffin-16M, comprising 15 million vision-language-camera triplets and 1 million trajectories featuring various and challenging motions. To foster further research in this area, we released the code, models, and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出Puffin-World，一个统一的模态架构，将物理理解、空间模拟和3D世界生成与重建集成为一体，无需依赖外部离线模块。通过联合建模物理（重力场/纬度）、几何（深度）和外观（图像）三种原生世界状态，并引入统一的全景相机表示和物理动力学传播策略，实现物理一致且视觉稳定的世界生成。同时构造了Puffin-16M大规模数据集（1500万视觉-语言-相机三元组和100万多样化轨迹）以支持复杂场景。
AI.motivation: 现有3D世界生成与理解方法通常依赖外部离线模块，难以在统一的生成框架中同时实现物理理解、空间模拟和3D重建。不同任务（物理、几何、外观）之间割裂，缺乏统一的表示来处理多任务协同和灵活的相机运动，导致生成的世界缺乏物理一致性和稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 构建统一的架构框架联合建模三种原生世界状态：物理（重力场和纬度）、几何（深度）、外观（图像）；2) 引入统一的Omni-Camera表示，支持多样化任务和灵活运动；3) 提出物理动力学跨未来帧传播策略，通过将绝对相机属性锚定到真实世界来保证物理一致性与视觉稳定性；4) 在单一生成过程内耦合外观与几何，联合合成未来视角并重建其底层几何；5) 支持多任务协同的交错闭环应用，包括模仿和自我校准的世界探索；6) 构建Puffin-16M数据集（1500万三元组+100万轨迹）以支持复杂场景扩展。
AI.result: 作者指出该统一的生成范式能够实现需要跨多任务协同的交错闭环应用，如模仿任务和自我校准世界探索。在物理一致性、视觉稳定性和多任务协同能力方面展现了统一的优势，并已发布代码、模型和数据集以促进进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: Puffin-World通过统一的架构设计消除了对外部离线模块的依赖，以物理、几何、外观三种状态的原生联合建模和Omni-Camera统一表示为核心，实现了从世界理解到世界生成的闭环，并佐以大规模数据集验证了该范式的可扩展性。未来的方向是在此统一框架上拓展更复杂的世界交互能力。

title: Principia: Relational Physics Tests for Video Models
summary: Evaluating physical reasoning in video models is difficult because absolute motion measurements depend on frame rate, object scale, and camera calibration, all of which are often ambiguous or unavailable in generated video. We propose a different approach. When two objects in the same scene obey the same physical law, their motions must satisfy predictable relationships, and these relationships hold independent of calibration. We introduce Principia, a benchmark that evaluates Newtonian physics through relational consistency between paired objects. Principia spans eight phenomena - gravity, restitution, friction, rotational inertia, projectile motion, momentum, pendulum, and mass-spring oscillation - across translational, rotational, collisional, and oscillatory dynamics, using real-world scenes recorded under controlled protocols. We also introduce a calibration-independent consistency score that quantifies physical violation directly in image space. Across thousands of generations from six state-of-the-art video generators, no model exceeds 0.42 on Principia despite all scoring around 0.8 on VBench. Vision-language models are evaluated on their ability to detect relational physics violations, with the best model achieving only 67% accuracy and most performing near chance level.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Principia基准，通过成对物体间的相对运动一致性来评估视频生成模型的牛顿物理推理能力，从而避免帧率、物体尺度和相机标定等绝对测量的歧义问题。
AI.motivation: 视频模型中的物理推理评估存在困难，因为绝对运动测量依赖于帧率、物体尺度和相机标定等参数，而这些参数在生成视频中往往模糊或不可用。因此需要一种与标定无关的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出Principia基准，利用同时场景中两个物体服从相同物理定律时，其运动必须满足的可预测关系来评估物理合理性。基准涵盖八种物理现象（重力、恢复系数、摩擦、转动惯量、抛体运动、动量、单摆和质量-弹簧振动），覆盖平移、转动、碰撞和振荡动力学。采用受控协议录制的真实场景，并引入标定无关的一致性评分，直接在图像空间中量化物理违例。
AI.result: 六种最先进的视频生成模型在数千次生成中，在Principia上均未超过0.42分，尽管它们在VBench上均得分约0.8。视觉-语言模型检测关系物理违例的最佳准确率仅为67%，大多数模型接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频生成模型虽然在传统基准上表现良好，但在物理合理性方面存在严重缺陷；同时视觉-语言模型在检测物理违反方面也能力有限，表明物理推理仍是生成与理解方向共同面临的重大挑战。

title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction
summary: Online 3D reconstruction models perform poorly on long videos. This happens because regressing poses relative to a fixed first-frame anchor forces extrapolation far beyond the training distribution. Small drifts accumulate and amplify into significant geometric collapse. However, we observe that per-frame depth remains stable throughout this failure. The backbone's local geometry remains intact; only the global pose head breaks down. Motivated by this decoupling, we introduce Scal3R. This approach reformulates online reconstruction as multi-reference relative pose querying. We use lightweight learnable tokens, which make up about ~1% of the parameters, and inject them into a completely frozen backbone via asymmetric attention. This setup queries poses relative to multiple past keyframes. An online pose-graph optimization system with loop closure suppresses long-range drift. Scal3R reaches convergence in 8 hours on a single GPU. It reduces the average ATE by over 60% on KITTI compared to the online baseline. It also achieves state-of-the-art performance across Virtual KITTI, Sintel, TUM-Dynamic, ScanNet, and 7-Scenes. Project page: https://linjohnss.github.io/scal3r/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Scal3R，一种面向长视频的在线 3D 重建方法。通过将在线重建重构为多参考相对位姿查询，并利用轻量级可学习 token 注入冻结的主干网络，配合在线位姿图优化与闭环机制，有效抑制长程漂移。在单 GPU 上 8 小时即可收敛，在 KITTI 上相较在线基线平均 ATE 降低超 60%，并在多项基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 在线 3D 重建模型在长视频上表现不佳。根本原因在于：回归相对于固定首帧锚点的位姿会迫使模型在训练分布之外进行外推，导致小的漂移逐渐累积并放大为显著的几何坍塌。需解决长视频中长期漂移导致的几何退化问题。
AI.method: 观察到逐帧深度在失效过程中仍保持稳定，即局部几何完整而全局位姿头崩溃。受此解耦现象启发，Scal3R 将在线重建重构为多参考相对位姿查询：使用占参数约 1% 的轻量级可学习 token，通过非对称注意力注入完全冻结的主干网络，查询相对于多个历史关键帧的位姿；配合在线位姿图优化系统及闭环机制抑制长程漂移。
AI.result: 在单 GPU 上 8 小时内收敛；在 KITTI 上较在线基线平均 ATE 降低超过 60%；在 Virtual KITTI、Sintel、TUM-Dynamic、ScanNet 和 7-Scenes 等多项基准上均达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全局位姿回归与局部几何解耦，采用多参考相对位姿查询策略并结合在线位姿图优化，能够在不改动主干的情况下有效解决在线重建的长视频漂移问题，兼顾效率与精度。

title: TokenMatch: 3D Mesh Correspondence Transformer with Curvature-Guided Tokenisation
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures and 12 tables; project page: https://4dqv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/TokenMatch/
summary: While data-driven 3D shape correspondence estimation has recently seen substantial progress, robust matching under partial observations and strong non-isometric deformations remains challenging. Existing learning-based approaches often rely on hand-crafted descriptors or template-based representations, whereas recent generative models over functional maps suffer from high inference cost, limited interpretability, and poor generalisation to partial shapes. In response to these limitations, this paper introduces TokenMatch, a new transformer-based unified model for estimating 3D shape correspondences. Our feed-forward approach trained exclusively on BeCoS, a challenging non-isometric partial-to-partial shape-matching dataset, can generalise to matching full shapes without retraining or fine-tuning. TokenMatch uses self- and cross-attention mechanisms to efficiently learn patch-level and point-level relations as well as dense correspondences between shape pairs. Our core insight is that meshes can be adaptively tokenised into patches using shape curvature guidance, enabling effective learning of shape-specific geometric descriptors for correspondence estimation. We evaluate TokenMatch on standard benchmarks for partial and full shape matching, including CP2P, PSMAL, BeCoS, FAUST, SCAPE, and SHREC'19. Our method achieves consistently high performance, in most cases outperforming existing methods for partial and full shape matching in the mean geodesic error and intersection-over-union metrics, while also running faster at sub-second inference speeds.

AI.tldr: TokenMatch是一种基于Transformer的统一模型，用于估计3D形状对应关系。该模型仅在BeCoS数据集（具有挑战性的非等距部分到部分形状匹配数据集）上训练，无需微调即可泛化到完整形状匹配。通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制学习块级和点级关系，并利用曲率引导的自适应网格标记化，TokenMatch在多个标准基准上取得了领先性能，同时推理速度快于亚秒级。
AI.motivation: 现有基于数据驱动的3D形状对应估计方法在部分观测和强非等距变形下仍具挑战性。现有学习方法依赖手工描述符或模板表示，而基于功能映射的生成模型推理成本高、可解释性有限，且对部分形状泛化能力差。
AI.method: TokenMatch是一个前馈式Transformer统一模型：1）采用自注意力和交叉注意力机制学习块级和点级关系，以及形状对之间的稠密对应；2）核心创新在于根据曲率引导将网格自适应标记化为补丁，从而有效学习形状特定的几何描述符用于对应估计。
AI.result: 在CP2P、PSMAL、BeCoS、FAUST、SCAPE和SHREC'19等多个标准基准上进行评估，TokenMatch在部分和完整形状匹配的平均测地误差和IoU指标上大多数情况下优于现有方法，同时推理速度快于亚秒级。
AI.conclusion: TokenMatch通过仅用BeCoS数据集训练即可跨域泛化到完整形状匹配，无需重训练或微调，证明了基于Transformer的自适应标记化方法在处理部分和非等距形状匹配问题上的有效性与高效性。

title: Temporal Self-Distillation: Learning Visual State Tracking in Videos Without Supervision
summary: We introduce S$^3$T (Self-Supervised Self-Distillation over Time), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first fully self-contained framework for continuous video state tracking. Our method treats temporal sampling density as privileged information, based on the hypothesis that a denser view of the same clip recovers the running state more accurately. This view serves as the teacher, while a sparse-view student with the same weights learns to match its next-token distribution. The model generates its own target, so training requires no labels, separate teacher, or reward signal, and adds no inference cost. On LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, S$^3$T improves VSTAT accuracy by $+1.74$ as a single model, $+2.38$ with souping, and $+2.70$ with additional vision-encoder adaptation, while prior self-evolving methods leave state tracking largely unchanged. The capability learned from unlabeled synthetic clips transfers to real videos, improving performance by $+7.95$ on VSTAT-YouTube state-tracking questions and $+4.50$ on MVBench Action Count.

AI.tldr: S³T是一种完全自包含的连续视频状态追踪框架，将时间采样密度视为特权信息：稠密视图作为教师，稀疏视图学生以相同权重学习匹配其下一token分布，无需标签、独立教师或奖励信号，且不增加推理成本。在LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B上，S³T将VSTAT准确率提升+1.74（单模型）、+2.38（模型汤）、+2.70（视觉编码器适配），而先前自进化方法几乎不改变状态追踪表现。从无标签合成片段学到的能力可迁移至真实视频，在VSTAT-YouTube和MVBench Action Count上分别提升+7.95和+4.50。
AI.motivation: 现有连续视频状态追踪方法依赖于有标签数据或外部教师模型，无法在无监督条件下自我改进。作者提出假设：同一片段在更密集的时间采样下能更准确地恢复运行状态，并据此设计自蒸馏框架，使模型无需任何外部信号即可从自身生成目标中学习。
AI.method: S³T将时间采样密度作为特权信息进行自我蒸馏：稠密时间采样的视频视图作为教师，稀疏视图作为学生（两者共享相同权重），学生通过学习匹配教师的下一token分布来实现状态追踪能力提升。训练由模型自身生成目标，完全自包含，无额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B上VSTAT准确率提升+1.74（单模型），结合模型souping提升+2.38，结合视觉编码器适配提升+2.70；与先前自进化方法（几乎不改变状态追踪）形成对比。跨域泛化方面，无标签合成片段的训练能力成功迁移至真实视频，VSTAT-YouTube提升+7.95，MVBench Action Count提升+4.50。
AI.conclusion: S³T证明了时间采样密度可作为一种有效的自监督信号，使视频状态追踪模型能够通过自蒸馏持续自我提升。该方法完全自包含、无需外部监督即可训练，并展现出从合成数据到真实视频的强迁移能力，为连续视频状态追踪提供了首个端到端自监督范式。
